Bai Song: "I'll follow behind and won't go out. If I see Lang Qiu, I can still trick him into saying a few words. Leader... if he has returned, Lang Chi will definitely hide him; we will definitely not have many chances to see him."

What he said also made sense.

The green-eyed beastmen looked at their leader again.

Green Ren hesitated, "Your feather color is too conspicuous..."

*

Lang Huo’s group chased after Lang Chi’s team from morning until noon before discovering they had run to the edge of the tribe again.

As soon as they got close, they heard a commotion.

Lang Huo was startled and immediately chased after them with the wolf beastmen.

As they drew near, they saw a small squad of beastmen standing under a tree, cursing incessantly at the top of the tens-of-meters-high tree.

Some wolf beastmen tried to climb the tree, causing the branches to bend, but before they could reach the top, the beastmen above would flap their wings and fly to other treetops.

It infuriated the beastmen below so much that they dug their claws into the ground, actually gouging out a hole.

"Green Jiao, your Green-eye tribe is too shameless! You come to steal things as soon as you see beastmen from Wolf Mountain! Do you think we're idiots?!"

Green Jiao was the leader of this scouting team; he was young, the same age as Lang Ye and the others.

He stood on a branch, expressionless, and said, "We were just passing by. This isn't even inside your tribe yet, don't act like everything belongs to you!"

"We were the ones who came to this land first!"

The wolf beastman: "Whoever has the ability to occupy it, it belongs to them! Get lost, don't appear in front of us!"

Hearing this, Lang Huo’s mouth crooked into a smile as he approached.

They couldn't even win a simple argument; the beastmen sent to the branch tribe couldn't all be idiots, could they?

Lang Huo: "What are you talking about?"

More than twenty wolf beastmen approached. The green-eyed beastmen perched on the treetops looked at each other, confirming that these were indeed from Wolf Mountain. They became vigilant and all flew higher.

"What are you afraid of?" Lang Huo’s gaze was filled with malice.

He sized up these green-feathered birds as if he were looking at where it would be best to take a bite out of them.

Green Jiao was on guard, "Are you from Wolf Mountain?"

Lang Huo leaned lazily against the wolf beastman who had just been arguing until his face turned red, glanced over, and then looked away as indifferently as if he had just seen a bug.

Green Jiao’s face turned cold as ice.

Not seeing Lang Qiu in the team, the sturdy wolf beastmen posed a greater threat to them than the thin group below. No matter how angry Green Jiao was, he didn't dare to clash head-on.

He directly ordered his tribesmen: "Go!"

No sooner said than done, the beastmen from Wolf Mountain, who had surrounded them at some point, darted up the tree with lightning speed.

"Run!"

The green-eyed beastmen were panicked and scrambled; those who didn't manage to fly away were immediately swatted by the wolf beastmen’s claws and smashed onto the ground.

Lang Huo hooked a clawful of feathers, dropped from the tree, and grinned as he looked at the beautiful feathers fluttering in the air.

His wolf teeth were sharp, and his eyes glowed with a ghostly light.

He looked at the green-eyed beastman caught on the ground, flicked his claw, and the feathers flew off.

"Qiu should like feathers of this color."

Lang Shun: "Then should we pluck some more?" As he spoke, he reached toward the green-eyed beastman.

The pinned beastman struggled desperately, his claws kicking up dust, and he stretched his neck and yelled, "You dare!"

Green Jiao landed back on the tree and, hearing the familiar name, his eyes flickered.

Lang Huo didn't like looking up at those weaker than him. He stepped on the green-eyed beastman’s back and said to the beastmen on the tree, "Come down. If you don't, I'll stomp him to death."

"You dare!" Green Jiao gripped the tree trunk tightly.

"Watch me," Lang Huo laughed in a devil-may-care manner, his claw gradually applying pressure.

"Ah... save me, Jiao, save..."

Green Jiao hardened his heart, swooped down, and went for the wolf’s face with his claws.

Lang Huo tilted his head to avoid it and sneered, "Idiot."

He swung his claw at the same time, throwing Green Jiao directly to the ground.

The beastman hit the ground hard and lay there; it took a long time for him to show any movement.

The other green-eyed beastmen landed one after another, all standing in front of Green Jiao to block the wolf beastmen. "Do you want to start a war between tribes?!"

Lang Huo: "I just don't like it when beastmen stand higher than me."

He gestured behind him.

Lang Shun was holding a beastman by the neck and looked at him in confusion.

Lang Huo rolled his eyes and said, "Don't you find it dirty? Throw him away."

"Oh." Lang Shun threw him aside casually; the green-eyed beastman looked like he wanted to bite him to death.

The Wolf Mountain beastmen were strong; the beastmen from the branch tribe were no match at all. If the branch tribe beastmen were only slightly stronger than them, the Wolf Mountain beastmen had an overwhelming advantage.

Green Jiao coughed a few times, a metallic taste of blood rising in his throat.

He climbed up, his body tense, and looked calmly at the dozens of wolf beastmen in front of him.

"What do you want?"

Lang Huo: "Nothing, just passing by. But you guys..."

Lang Huo sized up this group of beastmen; they were all ugly, their greenish feathers weren't even as imposing as the black-feathered beastmen, and they looked ill-intentioned no matter how he looked at them.

"Trying to steal things again."

Green Jiao’s heart tightened, "Bullshit!"

Lang Huo sneered, "Whether you're trying to steal or not, if you dare to come near the Wolf Tribe again, you won't be going back."

The green-eyed beastman: "This isn't your Wolf Tribe territory!"

"And is this your territory?"

The two tribes were really too close, the middle area was only a few dozen meters wide; what difference did it make whether it was marked or not?

Lang Huo couldn't be bothered to argue with them.

Appearing here could only mean they were coveting the things they had brought.

Lang Huo: "Get lost!"

The green-eyed beastmen were furious, but the giant wolves took two steps forward, their presence overwhelming. They hurriedly grabbed their companions and ran away without looking back.

In the face of absolute force, all words were nonsense.

Arguing was pointless and didn't accomplish anything.

The green-eyed beastmen didn't stop until they reached their own tribe.

Green Jiao’s chest was aching, and he watched as Bai Song walked out from the bushes.

"Did you see it?" Bai Song asked.

Green Jiao: "The wolf beastmen haven't abandoned Lang Qiu."

The beastman who had almost been plucked of his feathers nodded in fear; he had been close and seen it most clearly. When Lang Qiu was mentioned, there wasn't a hint of disgust in the eyes of the beastmen from Wolf Mountain, but rather joy.

Looking at it this way, Lang Qiu must be doing very well at Wolf Mountain.

"Then has he returned?" Bai Song asked urgently.

Without Lang Qiu, even though they usually acted against the wolf beastmen, they couldn't get into the core of the Wolf Tribe. As for that food, they couldn't even dream of it.

"Not sure."

Having worked for nothing and almost getting seriously injured, the beastmen of the Green-eye tribe were all dejected.

They didn't rush to leave, but instead guarded the edge of the territory, waiting for the next opportunity.

*

To increase the success rate of catching prey, Lang Chi had divided the beastmen into three teams. The one Lang Huo encountered was just one of them.

Everyone’s hands were empty, and after the argument just now, their stomachs were growling with hunger.

Lang Chi stopped the beastmen and told them to go find the main force.

If they couldn't catch prey, they couldn't catch it; they should go back with them first. Once they taught the beastmen how to fish, they could eat their fill just by relying on this territory full of lakes.

Hearing Lang Chi say there was something important, the beastmen didn't dare to delay and set off to find the main force.

The territory was flat, with few bushes and plenty of grassland, making it very easy to run.

When they found Lang Chi, the beastman’s claws were dug into the prey’s back, the tips buried deep under the beast’s skin. Blood flowed, covering its back and stimulating the beast to madness.

The prey roared in agony, desperately trying to shake the beastman off its back.

Lang Chi’s body was lifted, teetering on the edge.

Lang Huo watched, terrified.

The beastmen of the branch tribe were so hungry they were emaciated; how much weight could they possibly have?

Even for them, they only risked pouncing like this in the past when they were starving red-eyed; it was the most effective way to subdue prey, but also the easiest way to get injured.

Lang Huo seized the opportunity, rushed up, and grabbed the beast’s throat with all his might.

The prey’s neck tore open, and fresh blood sprayed onto his face, smelling of raw stench.

Lang Huo rolled on the ground, taking Lang Chi with him.

Lang Chi crashed into him, and Lang Huo almost lost his breath; he coughed dully and loosened his claws limply.

The prey swayed, shaking its four hooves as it looked angrily at the beastmen surrounding it, but it was just a death struggle.

Before long, it collapsed to the ground... the ground seemed to tremble.

Lang Huo kicked his claws, climbed up, and shook the blood off his fur.

"Uncle Chi, are you okay?"

Lang Chi sat up, his breathing heavy. He laughed, the sound seeming to be squeezed out of his throat, "I'm old, no longer useful."

Lang Huo: "You're not old, you're just not full."

Lang Chi stood up, glanced at Lang Huo, wiped the blood off his claws onto the grass, and asked, "Why aren't you staying put? Why did you come over here?"

Lang Huo smiled ingratiatingly: "I have something to do."

Lang Chi: "Let's go."

Having finally caught a Curved-horn beast, the beastmen were already exhausted from chasing it for so long. The Curved-horn beast had thick meat, enough for this group of little wolves to eat.

Lang Chi got up, and other beastmen went to carry the Curved-horn beast.

Having not eaten for almost a day, the beastmen’s legs went soft, and they almost knelt on the ground. Lang Huo frowned and immediately called Lang Shun and the others over.

Even for the Wolf Mountain beastmen, they didn't eat Curved-horn beast meat very often.

Lang Shun’s eyes lit up; he hurriedly snatched the job from the branch tribe beastmen and followed behind, happily carrying the Curved-horn beast.

Back at the tribe, the Wolf Mountain beastmen were also weak from hunger.

It had been a long time since they felt the pain of eating only once a day. Lang Shun lay on the ground, his four claws pressed under his belly, his head facing the clay pot.

Lang Huo lay on the ground, but halfway through, Lang Chi grabbed the fur on his neck, "You said you had something to do, let's go."

Lang Huo: "Uncle Chi, I'm hungry..."

Lang Chi: "I'm hungry too."

"Then let's eat first." Lang Huo saw that the sub-beastmen who had come were already teaching Lang Wan how to make meat soup.

Teaching the beastmen how to make food was one of the things.

"Let's go." The beastman was stubborn.

Lang Huo looked at him and climbed up, "Fine, fine, let's go to the lakeside."

Lang Huo carried the fishing net and signaled the branch tribe beastmen to follow.

"Fishing net, for catching fish. We eat at least twice a day at Wolf Mountain; if there isn't enough prey, we catch fish."

As he spoke, he threw the fishing net out in front of the beastmen.

In that instant, the net, which looked quite heavy when bundled together, spread out and submerged into the water.

Lang Huo pulled it up slowly, saying, "You need to learn how to use the fishing net. There are many fish in the lake; before the snow season arrives, hurry up and dry some fish."

There was a splash in the water, and fish hung on the net, half their bodies visible.

"Wow!"

"Ao?!"

Lang Huo: "What are you 'ao-ing' about? Did you see clearly?" He exerted force, lifted the entire net, and swung it onto the shore.

Several large fish were caught in the fine net, unable to break free.

Lang Chi had already seen the beastmen using the fishing net to catch fish in the morning; now, he leaned in closer, his gaze fixed on the net.

This was also made by Qiu.

His own cub, raised in the tribe, had never been exposed to these things; where did he learn them from?

Lang Chi saw that Lang Huo and the other young wolves were chubby, knowing they must have a stable food source, and seeing them use the net to catch fish steadily, he felt reassured.

But thinking of his own cub, he couldn't help but feel anxious.

His cub had never been away from him for so long; he wanted to know his current situation.

"Uncle Chi?"

"Uncle Chi! Did you see clearly?"

Lang Chi looked at Lang Huo’s sparkling eyes and said, "Let Lang Ye learn from you."

Lang Huo: "This is simple, you'll get it after doing it a few times. Have a few beastmen follow me to learn how to repair the fishing nets, so if we aren't here and they break, there's nowhere to fix them."

They had brought shuttles and hemp thread, so the beastmen didn't have to start from finding hemp grass.

Lang Chi called over a few beastmen, all of whom were middle-aged sub-beastmen.

Lang Chi: "Anything else?"

Lang Huo: "Making dried fruit, dried vegetables, and dried mushrooms."

Lang Chi pointed out a few more beastmen, and Lang Huo, seeing this, directly had two beastmen from the gathering team come out to teach.

Lang Huo: "Do you know how to use those medicines?"

Lang Chi: "Tell me. Anything else, I'll arrange it all together."

Lang Huo thought about the things they had brought and asked, "Uncle Chi, do you have bird droppings here?"

Lang Chi frowned, "No."

Lang Huo: "We also brought seeds for tail-grass; we can plant them after the snow season."

In the past, the yield of tail-grass was extremely low, and there were very few plump seeds that could be picked out. There wasn't enough to plant at Wolf Mountain, and they only sent some to the branch tribe to eat.

Lang Huo wasn't sure when the branch tribe would return to Wolf Mountain, so the planting matter had to be taught as well.

Counting it all up, it would still take a few days.

*

At Wolf Mountain, the gathering team knew Lin Qiu wanted purple-skinned fruits, so for several days in a row, they brought them back whenever they found them.

Wild grapes were in small bunches, thick-skinned, and had an exceptionally strong grape flavor.

Lin Qiu placed a clay basin beside him; he didn't have scissors, so he had to pick them off one by one by hand.

After Lang Yan finished running the mountain, he stayed by his side, busy helping him.

He was still radiating heat, his small stool placed right next to Lin Qiu’s, legs touching.

Lin Qiu bumped his knee against him, "Further away, it's hot."

Lang Yan shifted his butt, but didn't actually move an inch.

Lin Qiu watched him pick grapes, pinching them off and tossing them into the basin, "Don't rub off the fruit powder."

Lang Yan: "I didn't."

The grapes were too small, and every time he pinched them, he would press on the skin; Lang Yan’s fingers were stained purple.

The steps for making wine were simple: remove the stems, crush, ferment, separate the juice from the skins, and then secondary fermentation during aging.

This wasn't the first time Lin Qiu had done it himself; life used to be boring, and he would do these things to pass the time after work.

After cleaning up the grapes, there were only twenty jin.

After washing them in advance and using jars that had been boiled in water and dried, Lin Qiu crushed the grapes and put them in, leaving enough space, and then sealed the jar mouth.

Lang Yan looked at this jar of rotten grapes, thinking of the rotten fruit they hadn't finished eating during the snow season.

"Is this it?"

Lin Qiu: "How could it be that easy? It depends on whether the Beast God helps."

The fermentation of wine relied on environmental factors like temperature and humidity. Lin Qiu said it as a joke, but Lang Mo, who was passing by, suddenly turned his head.

His eyes were strange as he looked at the sealed jar of fruit.

"Qiu can really communicate with the Beast God!"

Lin Qiu didn't see him; he held the jar, intending to put it in the cave, and asked Lang Yan to carry it over.

Lin Qiu followed slowly behind him into the large cave.

He had to degrease the selected wolf fur and take advantage of his free time to spin thread.

Little did he know that Lang Mo, who had just heard his joke, ran off, and before long, all the beastmen at Wolf Mountain knew that Lin Qiu had communicated with the Beast God.

The things in that jar had the Beast God’s help!

No one was using the stove at the moment.

Lin Qiu soaked some wood ash in water to filter it, soaked the wolf fur in the water, washed it several times, and then spread it out to dry.

Lang Yan looked at the fur and then at his busy partner, walked up, and rested his chin on his shoulder.

Lin Qiu: "King, do you have nothing to do?"

Lang Yan: "Hmm."

Lin Qiu turned his head and pressed against his face, "Then please, King, go get the comb and the spindle; let’s spin the wolf fur into thread."

Lang Yan pressed his nose against Lin Qiu’s shoulder for a while, then got up to find the things.

Lin Qiu took the opportunity to move the wolf fur into the sunlight. The cubs who were playing wildly saw it, and the older ones brought the younger ones to surround him, their round eyes blinking without stopping as they watched him.

Lin Qiu gently flicked Lang Sheng’s little head; among these cubs, he was clearly the leader. The cubs obeyed his every command.

"Watch closely, don't let the wolf fur fly away."

Lang Sheng raised his dirty little face and nodded heavily, guarding the side like a little bodyguard.

Lin Qiu smelled the stinky sweat and the scent of little wolves on the cubs, wrinkled his nose, and the corners of his lips lifted slightly.

"Where's Guo?"

"Uncle Guo is with the cubs."

Recently, many cubs had transformed, and only three or four were still lagging behind. Lang Guo carried them every day, guarding the cubs himself, and would also go to the weaving cave to take a look, or go to Lang Qi’s cave to ask him to make some wooden puppets for the cubs to play with.

Hearing this, Lin Qiu wasn't in a hurry to find him.

He only thought that the downy fur shed by the cubs was softer than the wolf fur he had in his hands, and making it into vests or undershirts would be more suitable for the cubs.

The weather was cooling down fast, so he had to prepare for the cubs in advance.

As the wolf fur dried, when Lang Yan returned, Lin Qiu directly assigned him the job of combing the wolf fur.

Lin Qiu, bearing Lang Yan’s slightly burning gaze, walked calmly toward the west.

He still had to build a house for the Baa-baa beasts and remind Lang Mo and the others to burn more bricks. He was busy; let that clingy guy do his own work.
chapters.title: 第105章
chapters.source_text:
狼火带着小队兽人，从部落出发，这一路走来，林木葱茏，瓜果飘香。那些碧透如玉的湖里，时不时有鱼跃出水面，该是一片繁盛之景……
可狼兽人的眉头却越皱越紧。
有兽人低低道：“火，我们跑了这么久，怎么一头猎物都没遇到。”
那猎物不只是说呦呦兽、弯角兽这样的大型野兽，连圆鼻兽、红鸟在内的小兽他们都一个也没见到。
在狼山，圆鼻兽都还是被兽人们嫌弃的猎物。
狼火面色凝重，“他们比我们还缺猎物。”
以往他们送完东西就走，也没往支部落领地里跑着看看，这边这样，还不如回去，到了狼山总不会更差了。
得赶紧回去告诉王跟祭司。
狼火想也知道狼赤抓猎物要花费多少力气，直接道：“先找赤叔，赶紧把该教的教完，咱们回狼山。”
*
密林深处，数十人难以环抱的参天古树上，修筑着漂亮的树屋。这树屋完全是狼山木屋的精致版。
树屋错落，如巨大的蜂窝，密密麻麻几十个。
几个拖着长尾的绿眼兽人立在树梢，警惕望着狼部落的方向。他们通身羽毛翠绿，长尾舒展开，那尾上翎羽色调奇异，如眼睛一般，阳光下更是透出一股金绿。
被狼夜追着打了一顿的兽人跌跌撞撞跑了回来，惊动了部落里的兽人。
他们飞身而下，一群绿色兽人中，一个浑身白羽的兽人尤为显眼。
他落地，没站稳就急声问：“你们说狼山来兽人了？”
趴在地上的绿眼兽人疼得翅膀哆嗦，鼻青脸肿，眼睛挤得只剩一条缝。
他愤声道：“他们还带了很多东西，那兽皮袋鼓得要炸开，里面肯定有很多食物！”
兽人一动，疼得面皮抖了抖，愤声道：“该死的狼夜，差点把我翅膀咬下来！”
白松追问：“那狼楸呢？他回来没有？”
白松是绿眼部落的异类，他阿爸阿父都是绿色的羽毛，到他，却成了一只羽毛全白的绿眼兽人。
他阿爸跟阿父还以为自己的鸟蛋被其他部落的兽人换了，可随着白松长大，那模样分明与两个年长兽人都相像。
甚至因为白羽，形貌更加优异。
照兽人的目光看，就跟天上洁白无瑕的云似的。
绿眼部落并没有因此驱逐他，而是将他和其他幼崽一起养大。
白松羽毛雪白，在一群绿眼兽人当中很是夺目。当初部落熬不过去，看上了隔壁狼部落的食物，白松自请为部落做事，这才骗得了狼楸。
可后头食物没来得及搬出来，白松也被发现，狼兽人将他打得个半死。
为了不牵连部落，白松主动与他们撇清关系。绿眼兽人也当着狼部落的面，将他驱逐出部落。
不过等离开了狼部落，他们立马将白松带了回去，费心治疗。
大家都逼不得已，白松虽然没成功，却是部落的勇士。只要他不出去，狼兽人看不见他，那就不会有问题。
在他们看来，全是为了这一口吃，立场不同，他们没有错。
兽人听他一问，立马想到了那个蠢得对白松言听计从的狼楸。
这骗食物的事只要成功了第一次，就会有第二次，这次他们小心一点，那些兽皮袋里的食物就都是他们的。
兽人也不疼了，爬坐起来，仔细回想。
可想了半天，在族人期盼的眼神中，落寞摇头。
“没看到他。”
白松想到那一哄就听话的亚兽人，就算当初没偷食物之前，狼楸也常常悄悄给他食物，那段时间他难得吃饱。
藤条缠绕的腹部饥饿难耐，他忍不住道：“会不会是先回来了？”
“狼赤那么宠他，怎么可能放他在狼山那么久让他受折磨。”
兽人们想想也是。
想到食物，他们蠢蠢欲动，忍不住看向树上走来走去的族长身上。
“族长……”兽人馋得舔唇。
绿眼族长一下站定，爪子抓紧树干，沉声：“去打探一下。”
“那我也去。”白松道。
“松！你不行。”绿壬飞身下来，面上略有几分严肃。
他们把白松藏了这么久，要是让狼兽人发现了，又将之前的事牵扯出来，只会让狼兽人更加防备。
狼赤现在可是把白松当带坏幼崽的恶兽人，见了他，恨不得把他撕了。
白松：“我跟在后头，不出去。如果看见狼楸，我还能引他说几句话，族长……他如果回来，狼赤一定会将他藏起来，我们能见到他的机会绝对不多。”
他这样说也有道理。
绿眼兽人们又看向族长。
绿壬犹豫道：“你的羽毛颜色太显眼……”
*
狼火一行追逐狼赤队伍，从早上追到午间，才发现他们又跑到部落边缘去。
才靠近，就听到一阵吵闹声。
狼火心中一惊，当即跟狼兽人追过去。
走近了，就见一小队兽人站在树下，冲着那几十米高的树上骂个不停。
有狼兽人往树上爬，树枝压弯，没等爬到顶，上头的兽人拍着翅膀又飞到其他树梢。
气得下面的兽人爪子抓地，愣是刨出个坑来。
“绿皎，你们绿眼部落也太不要脸了，看到狼山来兽人了就跑来偷东西！你当我们是傻子吗？！”
绿皎是这次探查队领头的兽人，正年轻，与狼夜他们同岁。
他站在树枝上，面无表情道：“我们只是路过，这里还没进你们部落，别当什么都是你们的！”
“我们，才是先来这片土地的兽人！”
狼兽人：“谁有本事占到是谁的！滚远点，不要出现在我们面前！”
狼火听着，嘴角一歪，笑眯眯地靠近。
吵个架都吵不赢，分来支部落的兽人总不能都是笨蛋吧。
狼火：“说什么呢？”
二十多个狼兽人靠近，停在树梢的绿眼兽人相互看一眼，确认这些就是狼山来的。他们警惕起来，都往高处飞了飞。
“怕什么？”狼火目光透着邪意。
他打量着这些绿毛鸟，仿佛在看要从他们身上哪里下口才合适。
绿皎防备，“你是狼山来的？”
狼火往刚刚吵架吵得脸红的狼兽人身上懒懒一靠，瞥一眼过去，跟随便看了只虫子一样漠然收回。
绿皎面庞冷得结冰。
没见着队伍里有狼楸，健壮的狼兽人对他们的威胁比底下那群瘦弱的威胁更大，绿皎再气，也不敢硬碰硬。
他直接跟族人下令：“走！”
说时迟那时快，狼山来的兽人不知何时围拢过来，闪电般的速度蹿上树。
“跑！”
绿眼兽人慌不择路，没来得及飞走的，顿时教狼兽人爪子一拍，直接往地上砸去。
狼火勾了一爪子的毛，落下树，看着纷纷扬扬漂亮的羽毛，咧了咧嘴。
狼牙锐利，眼睛冒着幽光。
他看向地上被抓住的绿眼兽人，爪子一甩，羽毛飞落。
“楸应该会喜欢这个颜色的羽毛。”
狼顺：“那我们多拔点儿？”说着伸手往绿眼兽人身上去。
被压住的兽人拼命挣扎，爪子溅起尘土，伸长脖子叫道：“你们敢！”
绿皎重新落到树上，听到熟悉的名字，眼神闪了闪。
狼火不喜欢仰头看比自己弱的，他一爪子踩在绿眼兽人背上，对树上的兽人道：“下来，不下来我就踩死他。”
“你敢！”绿皎扣紧树干。
“你看我敢不敢。”狼火吊儿郎当笑，爪子渐渐用力。
“啊……救我，皎，救……”
绿皎心一狠，飞扑过来，爪子冲着狼脸招呼。
狼火侧头避开，冷笑一声，“蠢货。”
他同时挥爪，直接将绿皎甩落在地。
兽人重重砸下来，躺在地上，许久才有动静。
其它绿眼兽人纷纷落下，全部站在绿皎面前，挡住狼兽人。“你们想挑起部落之间的战争吗？！”
狼火：“我只是不喜欢有兽人站得比我高。”
他示意身后。
狼顺拎着兽人脖子，疑惑地看向他。
狼火翻个白眼，道：“也不嫌脏手，扔了。”
“哦。”狼顺随手一扔，绿眼兽人看着像要咬死他。
狼山兽人强壮，支部落这边的兽人根本比不上。若说支部落的兽人只比他们强一点，狼山的兽人对他们则是碾压式的优势。
绿皎闷咳几下，喉咙里涌上来一丝血腥味。
他爬起来，浑身绷直了，冷静地看着面前几十个狼兽人。
“你们想干什么？”
狼火：“没干什么啊，路过。倒是你们……”
狼火打量这群兽人，一个个长相难看，绿油油的羽毛还没黑羽兽人霸气，怎么瞧都是不怀好意。
“又想偷东西。”
绿皎心里一紧，“放屁！”
狼火冷嗤一声，“管你们是不是想偷，再敢靠近狼部落一步，让你们有来无回。”
绿眼兽人：“这里不是你们狼部落领地！”
“那这里又是你们领地？”
两个部落实在挨得近，中间地带就那么几十米宽，这划了跟没划有什么区别。
狼火懒得跟他们吵。
能出现在这里，无非就是觊觎他们带过来的东西。
狼火：“滚！”
绿眼兽人怒不可遏，可巨狼往前两步，压迫感十足。他们慌忙抓上同伴，头也不回地跑远了。
绝对的武力面前，什么话都是废话。
吵架嘛，不痛不痒的，有什么意思。
绿眼兽人一直跑到自家部落才停下来。
绿皎胸口闷痛，看着藏在灌丛的白松走出来。
“你看到了吗？”白松问。
绿皎：“狼兽人并没有厌弃狼楸。”
差点被拔毛的兽人恐惧地点头，他离得近，看得也最清楚。说起狼楸，那狼山来的兽人眼里没有一点厌恶，反而欣喜。
看这样子，狼楸应该在狼山混得很好。
“那他回来了吗？”白松急声问。
不靠狼楸，别看他们平时跟狼兽人对着干，但根本进不去狼部落的核心。那些食物，他们更是想都不要想。
“不清楚。”
白忙活一场，还差点受重伤。绿眼部落的兽人各个颓丧。
他们并没有急着走，而是守在这领地边界，等着下次机会。
*
狼赤为了提高抓捕猎物的成功率，将兽人分了三个队伍。狼火他们遇到的只是其中一支。
大伙儿手里空荡荡的，刚刚又吵了一架，肚子饿得咕咕叫。
狼赤拉住兽人，直接叫他们找大部队去。
抓不到猎物就抓不到，先跟他们回去，等教会了兽人捕鱼，靠着这片满是湖泊的领地，吃鱼都能吃个够。
听狼赤说有要紧事，兽人不敢耽搁，赶紧出发找大部队。
领地地平，树丛少，草地多，很是好跑。
找到狼赤时，兽人爪子抓在猎物背上，爪尖深入野兽皮下紧紧勾住。血珠流淌，铺了满背，刺激得野兽发狂。
猎物嘶声怒吼，拼命地想要将背上的兽人甩下来。
狼赤的身体被扬起，摇摇欲坠。
狼火看得心惊胆战。
支部落的兽人都饿得虚脱，瘦成那样有多少重量。
就算是他们，以前也只有饿红了眼睛才冒险这么扑上去，这样能制住猎物，却最容易受伤。
狼火找准时机冲上去，逮住野兽喉管用尽全力一抓。
猎物脖颈撕裂，鲜血飙在脸上，腥臭十足。
狼火就地一滚，顺带将狼赤勾下来。
狼赤砸在他身上，狼火一口气差点没上来，闷咳一声，软啪啪松开爪子。
猎物摇摇晃晃，甩着四个蹄子愤怒地看着包围他的兽人，却只是垂死挣扎。
没一会儿，它倒在地上……地面都好似震颤了下。
狼火爪子蹬了蹬，爬起来甩掉毛毛上的血。
“赤叔，你没事吧？”
狼赤坐起来，喘气声有些大。他笑了声，声音像从喉咙里挤出来的，“老了，不中用了。”
狼火：“您这不是老了，是没吃饱。”
狼赤站起来，斜了眼狼火，爪子上浸着血，胡乱在草丛上擦了擦，“不好好待着，跑过来干什么？”
狼火卖乖笑道：“有事。”
狼赤：“走。”
好不容易逮住一头弯角兽，兽人们追了半天已经疲惫。弯角兽肉厚，足够这群小狼吃。
狼赤起身，其他兽人去扛弯角兽。
快一天没吃东西，兽人腿下一软，差点跪在地上。狼火皱眉，直接叫狼顺几个过去。
就是狼山的兽人，吃弯角兽的次数也不多。
狼顺两眼放光，赶紧抢了支部落兽人的活儿，屁颠屁颠扛着弯角兽跟在后头。
回到部落，狼山的兽人也饿得虚了。
好久没体会到一天吃一顿的痛苦，狼顺趴在地上，四个爪子压在肚子下，脑袋冲着陶锅。
狼火往地上一躺，躺到一半，狼赤拎着他颈上的毛毛，“不说有事儿，走。”
狼火：“赤叔，饿……”
狼赤：“我也饿。”
“那咱们吃了再说。”狼火看见来的亚兽人已经在教狼晚做肉汤了。
教兽人做食物，这算一个事儿。
“走。”兽人可倔。
狼火看他一眼，爬起来，“走吧走吧，去湖边。”
狼火扛起渔网，示意支部落的兽人跟上。
“渔网，捕鱼用的。我们在狼山一天少说吃两顿，猎物不够就捕鱼。”
说着，他当着兽人们的面，直接将渔网甩出去。
那瞬间，拢在一起看起来颇沉重的渔网张开，没入水中。
狼火慢慢往上拉，边道：“渔网你们要学会用，湖里有很多鱼，趁着还没到雪季，赶紧晒些鱼干出来。”
水中一响，挂在网上的鱼露出半身。
“哇！”
“嗷？！”
狼火：“嗷什么嗷，看清楚没有？”他手上一用力，将渔网整个提起，再往岸上一甩。
好几条大鱼挂在细细的网上，居然挣脱不出来。
狼赤早上的时候已经见过兽人用渔网抓鱼，这会儿凑近了，目光落在那网上一直没移开。
这也是楸做的。
他自己的幼崽，养在部落并没接触过这些，又是从哪里学来的？
狼赤看狼火这些小狼胖了，知道他们应该有稳定的食物来源，见他们用网捞鱼起来也稳得住。
可联想到自己幼崽，他不免焦躁。
幼崽离开他从来没有这么久，他想知道他现在的情况。
“赤叔？”
“赤叔！你看清楚没有？”
狼赤看着狼火亮晶晶的眼睛，道：“让狼夜跟你学。”
狼火：“这个简单，多来几遍就会了。你让几个兽人跟着我学修补渔网，免得我们不在，坏了没地方补去。”
他们带了梭子跟麻线来，不用兽人从找麻草开始弄。
狼赤叫了几个兽人，都是些中年亚兽人。
狼赤：“还有？”
狼火：“做果干、菜干、蘑菇干。”
狼赤又点了几个兽人，狼火一瞧，也直接让采集队的两个兽人出来教。
狼火：“那些药知道怎么用不？”
狼赤：“跟我说。还有什么，我一起安排。”
狼火想了一圈他们带来的东西，问：“赤叔，你们这边有鸟粪吗？”
狼赤皱眉，“没有。”
狼火：“我们还带了尾巴草的种子，雪季过后就可以种了。”
以往尾巴草产量极低，能挑出来的颗粒饱满的种子极少，狼山那边都不够种，支部落这边也只是送一些给他们吃。
狼火不确定支部落什么时候才回狼山，种植的事儿也得一并教了。
这么算起来，还是需要几天时间。
*
狼山，采集队知道林楸要紫皮果，连续几天，遇到了都给他带回来。
野葡萄小小一串，皮厚，葡萄味格外浓。
林楸身旁放了个陶盆，手上没剪刀，只能动手一个个摘下来。
狼岩跑山完，就守在他一旁，跟着他忙活。
他身上还冒着热气儿，小凳子放在林楸身边，腿挨着腿。
林楸膝盖碰他一下，“远点，热。”
狼岩屁股挪挪，实际没动一分。
林楸看他摘葡萄，随手一掐就往盆里扔，“别把果粉蹭掉了。”
狼岩：“没有。”
葡萄太小，两手一掐就捏在了果皮上，狼岩指缝里都染了紫色。
制作葡萄酒的步骤简单，去梗，破碎，发酵，分离皮汁，然后陈放期间二次发酵。
林楸不是头一回自己做，以往生活枯燥，工作之余就做这些打发时间。
葡萄收拾出来，不过二十斤。
提前洗净，再用沸水滚过的罐子已经干燥，林楸将葡萄碾碎放进去，留足空间，再将罐口密封。
狼岩瞧着这罐子烂葡萄，想到以往雪季没吃完的烂果子。
“这就可以了？”
林楸：“哪能这么容易，要看兽神帮不帮忙。”
葡萄酒的发酵依赖气温、湿度等环境因素，林楸玩笑一说，路过的狼莫一下转过头来。
他眼神奇异，瞧着那罐密封好的果子。
“楸真能沟通兽神！”
林楸没见着他，捧着罐子打算放山洞里，叫狼岩抱了过去。
林楸慢慢跟在他身后，进了大山洞。
他要把挑选完的狼毛脱脂，趁着空闲赶紧纺线。
殊不知刚刚听了他一句玩笑话的狼莫拔腿就跑，不一会儿，狼山的兽人们都知道林楸沟通了兽神。
那罐子里的东西，有兽神帮忙！
灶台这会儿没兽人用。
林楸泡了些草木灰水过滤，狼毛泡在水中，然后清洗几遍，再将狼毛摊开晒干。
狼岩看着这些毛毛，再看看自己忙碌的伴侣，走上前，下巴落在他肩上。
林楸：“王，你没事做？”
狼岩：“嗯。”
林楸偏头贴了下他的脸，“那麻烦王拿梳子来，还有纺锤，咱们把狼毛纺成线。”
狼岩鼻尖抵着林楸肩窝，贴了会儿，起身找东西去了。
林楸趁机将狼毛移到阳光下，那群疯玩的幼崽见了，大的带着小的围过来，圆眼睛一眨不眨看着他。
林楸轻轻弹了下狼生的小脑袋，这些幼崽里，他显然是个孩子王。幼崽什么都听他指挥。
“看好了，别让狼毛飞了。”
狼生扬起脏兮兮的小脸，重重点头，像个小护卫一样守在一旁。
林楸闻到幼崽身上臭烘烘的汗味跟小狼味，皱了皱鼻子，唇角微微扬起。
“果呢？”
“果叔带幼崽。”
最近化形的幼崽多，只剩下三四个还跟不上队的幼崽。狼果每天都揣着，自个儿守着幼崽，又去织布的山洞转转，或者去狼起山洞叫他做些木偶给幼崽玩儿。
林楸闻言，也不着急找他。
只想着幼崽们身上换下来的绒毛，比他手上这些狼毛要柔软些，做成马甲或者背心，更适合幼崽。
天气凉得快，得提前给幼崽准备起来。
狼毛晒着，等狼岩回来，林楸直接给他安排梳狼毛的活儿。
林楸则顶着狼岩略微灼热的目光，淡定地往西边走。
他还要给咩咩兽建房子，要叮嘱狼莫他们，砖要多烧一点。忙着呢，让那黏人精自个儿干活去。

chapters.translated_text:
Lang Huo and his group stayed at the branch tribe for three days. Once they made sure everything that needed to be taught had been taught, they packed up and started their journey back.

They had a good meal before leaving, and Lang Chi led the beasts to see them off to the edge of the tribe.

Carrying a heavy load on his back filled with food prepared by the branch tribe, Lang Huo looked up at them and said, "Uncle Chi, we're leaving."

Lang Chi: "Be careful."

Remembering how they had almost been ambushed right when they arrived at the tribe, Lang Huo grinned.

Lang Chi: "Go on."

Lang Huo organized the team, took one last look at the stick-thin beastmen of the branch tribe, nodded, and set off on the return journey.

Lang Chi stood frozen in place, watching until the figures of the beastmen disappeared completely before slowly pulling back his gaze.

His lips moved. "Qiu is fine, why won't he come back? Is he holding a grudge..."

Next to him, Lang Wan wore a worried expression.

"Patriarch, they're gone." Over the past few days, the green-eyed beastmen hadn't left the edge of the Lang Tribe at all, closely observing the movements next door.

After staking out the place for so many days and getting bitten all over by bugs to form big and small bumps, it wasn't without results.

What could be confirmed was that Lang Qiu hadn't returned.

The green-eyed beastmen were extremely disappointed.

Seeing all that food brought back by the Lang Mountain side while they couldn't eat any of it, that miserable feeling surged from the soles of their feet straight to the top of their heads, making it hard for them to even sleep peacefully.

They couldn't steal it, and they couldn't win in a fight.

The green-eyed beastmen pulled in their stomachs, curled themselves up, and sank into low spirits.

*

The return journey was long, and Lang Huo didn't dare delay at all.

On the way here, they still had the mood to stop and hunt, but on the way back, they relied on eating dried fish. Pushing hard all the way, they finally reached Lang Mountain within half a month.

Although it had only been a little over a month since they left, Lang Mountain seemed to have completely changed its appearance.

The water level of the big river had dropped again, and the current was gentle. The tall grass was withered and yellow, and even the herbs in the fields showed signs of decay.

The wind brushed across the tip of the nose, dry enough to make the beastmen sneeze involuntarily.

The sound of hammering and tapping came from the woods, clinking and clanking with lingering echoes.

Twenty-some beastmen impatiently drilled out of the woods and saw a square-shaped structure being built on the west side. The beastmen were wearing beast-skin skirts, holding red stones, and sweating profusely.

Lang Mo, who was busy building the wall, turned around and spotted them. His eyes lit up, and he dropped the brick in his hand and trotted over with hurried thuds.

"You're back!"

"King! Lang Huo is back!"

Lang Mo had a loud voice, and as soon as he shouted, the echo rippled around the front of the mountain, causing the beastmen inside the caves to poke their heads out one after another.

In the cave used for woodworking, Lin Qiu was talking with Lang Qi about the kang bed.

Lang Qi's previous task was making a stone roller, and now that one was finished, it sat right nearby. The stone roller wasn't large, shaped like a cylinder, and pulled with wood and hemp ropes so that even a cub could pull it.

The Black Feather beastmen had finished shelling half of the foxtail grass seeds, leaving the rest untouched. Once they left, the remaining seeds could just be processed with the small stone roller.

This was considered a sample; any larger ones would have to be made specifically when they had free time.

The pens for raising the mianmian beasts and red birds were currently under construction, and as a top priority, Lin Qiu thought they might as well build the brick kang too.

That way, whether it was the snow season or not, they could provide a safeguard for the brooding red birds and the newborn mianmian beasts.

Lang Huo and his team carried their loads under the shed.

The Black Feather beastmen glanced over with some curiosity.

They all knew the Lang Tribe had many beastmen, and a branch had split off previously, but they didn't know where it was or what Lang Huo could bring back from there.

Yu Ya looked envious. "Why do these wolves have so much food?"

Yu Shan: "We'll have it in the future too."

He grabbed a handful of foxtail grass seeds on the stone slab. Compared to everything else, if they could grow these, they wouldn't be afraid of anything just like the wolf beastmen.

Still, he didn't bring it up yet; he would wait a bit longer.

Lin Qiu walked out, accompanied by Lang Yan who was coming down from Lang Mountain.

The news of Lang Huo's return had already been shouted out by Lang Mo. No matter what the beastmen were doing, they put down their tasks and gathered around.

In an instant, the Black Feather beastmen could no longer see what the scene under the shed looked like.

They withdrew their gazes and continued with what they were doing.

Lang Huo and his party of beastmen had lost a full circle of weight from this trip. The twenty-some wolf beastmen, who had been considered quite robust among the hunting beastmen before they left, now looked travel-worn and somewhat skinny.

Fortunately, their spirits were still decent, and the trip had been safe without encountering any major trouble.

The beastmen sprawled on the ground with their limbs limp, looking like a huge, thick plush blanket spread across the earth.

Lang An directed the beastmen to unload the goods and open them up.

After half a month on the road, they couldn't bring back anything fresh. It was all dried vegetables, dried smoked fish, and herb seeds—all prepared by the branch tribe after hearing about the situation on Lang Mountain.

Lang Yan told the beastmen to put the things away properly, while Lang An called out for the beastmen to quickly make some meat soup.

After Lin Qiu watched here for a while, Lang Qi anxiously pulled him away to continue discussing the construction of the kang.

When the crowd of curious beastmen finally dispersed, Lang Huo said, "King... the situation at the branch tribe is even harder than ours."

Lang Yan pulled over a low stool and sat down, gesturing for them to continue.

The twenty-some wolf beastmen sprawled messily under the shed, chiming in all at once to clearly explain the situation of the branch tribe.

"Their territory is so small over there that they might not even run into a single prey animal in a day."

"Uncle Chi's hair has all turned white; he looks even older than Uncle. Oh... Uncle Qi has more energy than us now and isn't old anymore."

"They're too close to other tribes. When we delivered the goods, we almost got robbed. The Green-Eyed Tribe is especially shameless. They just wait outside the branch tribe, refusing to hunt for food themselves, and stare them down to rob them."

"Right! King, if we hadn't gone, they'd be eating grass every single meal. Otherwise, why don't we just tell them to come back..."

"Yeah, our tribe can at least eat our fill of fish, and now we also need beastmen to work. At the very least... we can just plant more foxtail grass next year."

After listening, Lang Yan remained silent for a while, his gaze falling on the dust motes dancing in the beam of light.

"There's no rush for this."

Seeing that the tribe's food was gradually increasing and barely enough for the Lang Mountain beastmen, Lang Yan and the priest had originally planned to first teach the branch tribe beastmen how to fish and farm, while they provided some relief aid.

If the branch tribe came back, the pressure on Lang Mountain would suddenly spike.

It had to be carefully considered.

Putting this matter aside for the moment, Lang Yan suddenly asked, "Did you guys just mention the Green-Eyed Tribe?"

"Right! That's the tribe, standing in the trees every day staring at the Lang Tribe as if we wouldn't notice," Lang Shun spat in disgust. They just wanted to get something for nothing—how could they support any clansmen like that!

Lang Yan glanced toward the cave where Lin Qiu was, though nothing could be seen.

"Is the Green-Eyed Tribe right next to the branch tribe?"

"Right! That's the tribe that hooked up with Qiu in the past!"

Lang Yan's gaze suddenly darkened. "Hooked up with Qiu..."

Lang Huo was about to say more when Lang Shun hurriedly reached out and gave the beastman's fur a quiet tug.

Lang Yan: "Don't mention this in front of Qiu."

Meeting Lang Yan's ice-cold gaze, Lang Huo shivered inwardly. "Oh..."

Lang Yan: "You guys rest first. I'll discuss the branch tribe's matter with the priest."

Bringing the branch tribe back wasn't something that could be done just by talking about it. With those hundred-plus mouths, catching fish alone would require a dedicated team.

What he feared most was that the fish would be almost eaten up by them while prey remained scarce, and eventually, they would still end up having to separate.

Lang Huo and the twenty-some other beastmen ate the special meal prepared by Lang An, threw all worries to the wind, and crashed into deep sleep.

The beastmen organized the items brought back, and the priest came down to inspect them, taking several specially prepared leather bags of herbs back to his own cave.

Although the branch tribe didn't live with them, there was an advantage: herbs that didn't grow here could be accumulated in large quantities over there.

After finishing his discussion with Lang Qi, Lin Qiu left the cave.

He searched around and found Lang Guo sitting in a grass nest, knitting a sweater for a cub. The wool was made from the undercoat shed by the cubs, a dusty grey color.

Since the wool material wasn't enough, the fuzz previously combed off the adult beastmen came in handy.

Lin Qiu hadn't finished his own sweater yet either. He wasn't skilled in this area, having unraveled and restarted it several times to no avail, until he finally handed it over to Lang An to slowly study.

There weren't many demi-beastmen in the tribe, so individual sweaters weren't made uniformly by the tribe as a whole.

It was too much trouble.

If someone wanted one, they made it themselves or asked a beastman to help.

Now that the tribe had stored enough shelled foxtail grass seeds, they didn't need so many Black Feather beastmen, so a portion of the wolf beastmen set their sights on the demi-beastmen of that group.

The tribe also agreed, counting this work as contributing to the Lang Tribe.

Lin Qiu chatted with Lang Guo for a while and played with the cubs—who couldn't shift shapes yet—using a ball made of wolf wool. When the ball was thrown out, the chubby cubs scrambled to grab it.

Lang Guo glanced over and sighed softly. "Even now, there are still no newborn cubs this year."

Lin Qiu: "Without food, even if they're born, they're hard to raise. There should be next year."

The cub trotted back with the wolf-wool ball in its mouth and looked eagerly at Lin Qiu. Seeing that he didn't move, it placed its paw pads on his wrist to urge him.

Lin Qiu pinched the cub's little paw; the pads were soft, feeling a bit nicer to touch than his wolf king's paw pads.

The cub didn't have much patience; seeing him not move, it whimpered and nudged him with its head.

Lin Qiu let go and tossed the wolf-wool ball away again.

The ball hit a jar placed in the corner. Lang Guo's wooden needle missed a stitch, and looking at Lin Qiu, he asked, "Qiu, have you discussed it with the Beast God?"

"Huh?"

"I mean the stuff in that jar, is it ready?"

Lin Qiu couldn't help laughing. "What discussing with the Beast God? Where did you hear that?"

"Everyone knows, don't try to fool us," Lang Guo said.

Counting the time, it was indeed about time to open the jar and take a look.

The initial fermentation time for grape wine was seven to fifteen days, and this pottery jar was opaque, making it impossible to see what it looked like inside.

Lin Qiu simply washed his hands, came back, and opened the jar.

Lang Guo decisively put down the half-knitted wolf sweater and squatted down beside Lin Qiu. He twitched his nose and exclaimed in surprise, "So fragrant! It smells a bit like rotting fruit, has the scent of purple-skinned fruit!"

Lin Qiu: "That's the smell of fermentation."

The wine liquid had already separated from the grapes, with slightly discolored grape skins and pulp floating on top. Lin Qiu poked it with a spoon; it was full of bubbles.

"Qiu, do you want us to eat rotten purple-skinned fruit?"

Lang Guo poked his head forward while pulling the few cubs draped over the jar down and gathering them into his arms.

The big beastman's chin pressed against the cubs' heads as five pairs of watery eyes looked over simultaneously.

Lin Qiu: "It's not ready yet... what you eat isn't the purple-skinned fruit, it's the liquid inside."

Lang Guo: "Awo."

Cub: "Awo..."

Lin Qiu ladled out a bit of the wine to look at it; the color was purplish-red with a rich aroma. Lin Qiu silently swallowed his saliva.

He was craving it a little.

"Glug." Lang Guo's sound of swallowing saliva was even louder.

Staring straight at the spoon, having never seen such pretty water before, he asked somewhat urgently, "Qiu, can we drink it now?"

He felt it was even more tempting to a wolf than the tribe's honey water.

Lin Qiu: "No. It's not ready. If you drink it, your stomach will hurt."

"No way..."

Lang Guo's head was practically leaning right next to the spoon, and Lin Qiu hurriedly poured the wine back. "Wait a bit longer."

He resealed the jar and asked Lang An for a new piece of linen cloth. He then scalded a smaller jar with boiling water, let it air dry, and planned to filter out the grape pulp and skins in a couple of days.

While keeping an eye on the construction of the animal pens, he also kept watch over the pottery jar.

Whether it was because he had opened the pottery jar or not, the slightest trace of wine scent in the cave was caught by the beastmen's noses.

Two days later, when Lin Qiu walked in with the prepared tools, he found Lang Mo and Lang Xi squatting in front of the jar.

Holding four cubs, Lang Guo incited, "Qiu isn't here, let's take a look."

Lang Mo: "No way, Qiu hasn't finished discussing with the Beast God yet."

Lang Guo: "Qiu opened it and looked too, it's fine..."

"Ahem!"

The three beastmen jerked, freezing in place with their backs to Lin Qiu, not moving.

Lin Qiu: "Move aside."

Lang Guo retreated swiftly, leaving the four cubs in place. Lang Mo grabbed a cub in each hand, held them up as a shield in front of him, and sidstepped away like a crab.

Lang Xi: "Qiu, I didn't do anything."

Lin Qiu: "Opening the lid too much will ruin it."

Lang Mo's heart tightened, and he immediately blurted out, "We wouldn't touch it, it was all Lang Guo. We almost listened to him."

Lang Guo: "I was just talking, seeing if they would listen. If they had actually touched it, I definitely would have stopped them."

He spoke with righteous indignation, infuriating Lang Mo, who stuffed the two cubs right into Lang Guo's arms.

"Bad beastman."

Lin Qiu: "Alright, help out."

Amid the beastmen's chatter, he had already draped the linen cloth over the mouth of the empty jar. At his signal, Lang Mo picked up the jar containing the fruit wine and poured it upward.

The grape skins tumbled out, and accompanied by a splashing sound, the purplish-red wine seeped through the linen cloth into the jar below.

A rich fragrance hit them head-on; the grapes were sweet and fresh, and the wine was intoxicating.

Lang Mo faced that scent directly, saliva continuously pooling in his mouth. Although he had never tasted it, he was already craving it so much he could barely stand it.

How could it smell so good!

Lang Guo also gathered around, squatting honestly to the side and staring intently at Lang Mo's movements.

Qiu had only made this one single jar, and he was terrified someone would spill even a tiny bit!

"Qiu..."

"Qiu."

"Qiu-ah~"

It smelled too good; the beastmen were dying of craving. Their toes inched forward, and their eyes looked like they wanted to fall right into the pottery jar. They subconsciously called out to Lin Qiu, hoping he would relent and give them a taste right away.

After finally finishing the pouring, a commotion arose behind him.

Lin Qiu glanced back; the beastmen had all caught the scent and swarmed over.

Withdrawing his gaze, Lin Qiu squeezed the remaining wine out of the grape skins.

He resealed the jar, placed it back in its spot, and carried the grape skins away, signaling for the beastmen to make way.

Everyone obediently cleared a path, and as soon as Lin Qiu walked past, they immediately swarmed in pursuit.

"Qiu, is that the wine?"

"Qiu, should we make a bit more? That little bit looks like it won't be enough to eat."

"Qiu, I can help, I'm not busy."

"Qiu... c-can I taste those grape skins in your hand?"

Lin Qiu stopped and looked at Lang Yun in astonishment.

The beastmen behind him almost crashed into him, leaning their bodies far back to avoid stepping on his heels.

The little white wolf felt guilty. "There's still wine in there that hasn't been squeezed dry, there definitely has to be some left..."

Fearing these beastmen would flip open the pottery jar lid, Lin Qiu turned back and said earnestly to the group of foodies, "It's not ready yet, you can't eat it."

"Then let's make some more..."

Lin Qiu: "I have to ask if the gathering team has any left."

"They definitely do!"

"If they don't, I'll go find them for you!"

Realizing they couldn't eat it yet, the beastmen cast one reluctant look at Lin Qiu's hand, fantasized about asking him to make hundreds of jars, and ran off laughing foolishly.

Lang Yun had returned with the third hunting team.

The gathering team had also arrived.

Before they could even put down their things, they were enthusiastically surrounded by the beastmen.

Standing beside Lang Bei, Lang Qing caught a faint scent of purple-skinned fruit. A flash of light crossed her eyes, and combining it with the beastmen's expressions, did this mean... it succeeded?

"Bei! Can you guys find some more purple-skinned fruit, please?"

"Qiu made the wine, it smells so, so, so good..."

Lang Bei had never seen the beastmen treat them this warmly before. She lifted the rattan basket with one hand, dropped it casually on the ground, and said, "Got it."

"Bei, find a bit more, otherwise there won't be enough to go around later!"

Lang Bei said impatiently, "Nag me again and I won't look."

"Hey! We'll look, of course we'll look!" The beastmen immediately smiled ingratiatingly and scattered in a flash.

Before falling asleep, the wolf beastmen were still twitching their noses, sniffing hard at the lingering scent in the cave. Some even huddled right in front of the jar, practically pressing their noses against it.

Lang Yan grabbed a beastman by the back of his neck and tossed him aside.

"Go to sleep."

Seeing that the Wolf King had arrived, the beastmen obediently scrambled away, crawled into their grass nests, and lay flat with their eyes closed.

Lin Qiu had just taken a bath, his long hair half-dried in front of the fire, before coming over to sit in Lang Yan's grass nest.

He arranged the animal skins and sat leaning against the edge of the nest. His long-sleeved shirt and pants had been replaced by the singlet and shorts he usually wore to sleep.

The linen cloth had been washed until it was old and faintly translucent, with a wide neckline that revealed fair skin. The clothes were thin, and with the slightest movement, they outlined the curves of his waist and abdomen.

Completely oblivious, Lin Qiu was wholly engrossed in wrestling with the wolf-wool yarn.

Lang Yan flipped aside the animal skin draped over Lin Qiu's legs and sat down beside him.

Lin Qiu's yarn became a tangled mess in his hands, and when he pulled slightly too hard, the thread snapped again.

In a fit of anger, he tossed the items right onto Lang Yan, pulled the animal skin up high, and lay down with his back to Lang Yan.

He had never seen him get this angry before.

Lang Yan chuckled, carefully tidied the yarn, and placed it outside.

"If you don't know how, don't do it."

Lin Qiu rolled over, moving with as much vigor as a fish just scooped from the river.

Lang Yan got kicked in the leg by him, the sole of Lin Qiu's foot twisting against his skin and hurting slightly.

Helplessly, he lay down, gathered Lin Qiu into his arms, patted his back gently, and coaxed him: "Qiu can do plenty of things, doesn't matter if he misses this one."

Lin Qiu's voice was cold and firm: "Not doing it anymore."

Still stubbornly fighting with himself.

Lang Yan wanted to laugh but was afraid of angering him. He pressed his lips against Lin Qiu's soft hair and curved them upwards.

"If you don't do it, you don't do it. Did you open the jar again today?"

"Mm."

"They've even come to me begging for wine."

Hearing this, Lin Qiu rolled over and sprawled across his chest. The loose singlet rolled up a fraction with his movement, their stomachs pressing together like they were leaning against a washboard, prompting Lin Qiu to instinctively rub his hand against it.

Lang Yan's eye color changed instantly. His Adam's apple bobbed as he drew in a sharp breath, closed his eyes, and pressed against Lin Qiu's neck.

"The fruit wine looks very successful."

"That's good."

Feeling Lang Yan's throat, Lin Qiu asked in confusion, "Why is your voice hoarse?"

Lang Yan lifted him off his chest, backed away slightly, and said in a low voice, "I'm sleepy, go to sleep."

Lin Qiu inched forward, suddenly feeling something hard pressing against him. As he touched it out of habit, both of them froze simultaneously.

Lang Yan took a sharp breath, hooked his delicate palm, and interlocked his fingers with Lin Qiu's.

There was only a single campfire in the cave, making it very dim.

The corners of Lin Qiu's eyes were flushed pink, and he instantly understood what was going on.

Lifting his head, Lin Qiu leaned closer to Lang Yan and whispered, "I-I'll help you..."

The warm breath puffed against his ear, causing Lang Yan's breathing to stall once more. Looking into Lin Qiu's undefended eyes, he suppressed himself repeatedly, but still couldn't resist pressing a fierce kiss on him.

Burying his head on Lin Qiu's shoulder, he held him tightly.

"Be good, go to sleep."

Lin Qiu: "King..."

Lang Yan lowered his head, his nose brushing against Lin Qiu's. Eye to eye, Lin Qiu saw the deep, heavy desire in his gaze.

A jolt went through him, and he didn't dare speak another word.

Lang Yan remained tight-lipped and silent, only holding him tighter.

Beastmen weren't that casual either; intimacy with a mate was a very private matter that would absolutely never happen in their current environment.

A male beastman who had confirmed his mate would usually clear out a small, separate cave, decorate it nicely with a nest large enough and beast skins soft enough, prepare food and drink, and then welcome his mate over.

Lang Yan was naturally doing the same.

However, as the Wolf King, he had many responsibilities on his shoulders, and now with the Black Feather beastmen in the tribe, it was inconvenient no matter how he looked at it.

He planned to wait until the Black Feather beastmen left before moving out with Qiu.

Lin Qiu had formed a habit of falling asleep at this exact time every night.

Held tightly in his arms, he couldn't turn over. After lying face down for a long time with his cheek pressed against Lang Yan's chest—like hiding in a nest that shielded against wind and rain—he gradually drifted off to sleep.

Lang Yan's palm, resting on Lin Qiu's lower back, moved up to stroke his mate's face.

It was so small he could cover it with a single hand.

After his thumb rubbed across the thin skin, leaving a red mark, Lang Yan paused, then obediently placed his hand back on Lin Qiu's lower back.

His waist was also narrow, and he couldn't resist measuring it—it was barely the length of one of his hands (and his hands were large).

It was a torturous night, but fortunately he had to keep watch on Lang Mountain during the day and didn't need to hunt, so not being able to sleep didn't affect much.

It was just that he yawned a lot more, causing the old priest to glance at him and toss over a package of herbs.

Lang Yan, who had come over to discuss the matter of the branch tribe returning, caught it reflexively and looked somewhat puzzled.

The old priest said with an air of profound wisdom, "You've only grown a tiny bit of meat, don't overdo it."

Setting the herb package aside without even looking at it, Lang Yan said with a straight face, "What does the priest think about the branch tribe's situation?"

Seeing that his goodwill wasn't appreciated, the old priest hummed and immediately took the herbs back.

Don't look down on this tiny pouch of herbs; they weren't easy to find.

Although wolf beastmen didn't need them, whenever the market used to be open, these herbs sold extraordinarily well.

"This matter needs to be asked of Lang Chi first. Right now, Lang Mountain is slightly better off than before because of the fish, but the prey we catch still isn't much. We aren't beastmen who specialize in eating fish to begin with, and as time goes on, look around—fish isn't as popular as it used to be..."

"Besides, even though foxtail grass can be planted and the harvest has improved, overall it's still not that much."

"The beastmen of the branch tribe are equivalent in number to the ones on Lang Mountain. If they come and eat fish for half a year, what about a year or two later?"

"The problem of prey still hasn't been solved."

Lang Yan nodded; this was also what he had been thinking.

"Qiu mentioned raising red birds and mianmian beasts. If that succeeds..."

The old priest said, "I can only hope he succeeds. I've told the tribe's beastmen to pay close attention; whatever Qiu wants, they are to do."

"If we could raise other beasts along with them..."

Lang Yan: "Only mianmian beasts live in large herds; catching even four other beasts at once is difficult."

The priest sighed, "That's true."

Lang Yan: "Then let's not rush. What needed to be taught to the branch tribe has already been taught, and they can hold on a bit longer. If Qiu succeeds, we can discuss it with Uncle Chi and call them back."

The old priest agreed as well.

"Qiu has familiarized himself with raising red birds and mianmian beasts now, but the numbers are still too few. When you have time, catch a few more back."

Lang Yan: "Mm."
chapters.title: 第106章
chapters.source_text:
狼火在支部落停留了三天，确保该教的教完了，收拾收拾，打道回府。
走前好好吃了一顿，狼赤带着兽人给他们送到部落边缘。
狼火背上背着沉甸甸的，带着支部落这边准备的食物，仰头冲他们道：“赤叔，我们走了。”
狼赤：“谨慎点。”
狼火想起刚到部落差点被偷袭，咧嘴笑了笑。
狼赤：“走吧。”
狼火整队，最后看了眼支部落这些麻杆似的兽人们，头一点，踏上返程的路。
狼赤伫立在原地，一直目送到再也看不见兽人身影，才慢慢收回目光。
他唇动了动，“楸没事了，为什么不回来，是不是怨……”
旁边的狼晚目光忧愁。
“族长，他们走了。”这些天，绿眼兽人就没从狼部落边缘离开过，他们密切观察着隔壁的动静。
蹲守这么多天，身上被虫子咬出来大大小小的疙瘩，也不是没有收获。
可以确认的是，狼楸没有回来。
绿眼兽人失望极了。
眼看狼山那边带来那么多的食物，他们却吃不着，那股难受劲儿从脚底蹿上头顶，睡觉都睡不安稳。
偷是偷不到的，抢也抢不过。
绿眼兽人压紧肚子，将自己蜷缩起来，情绪低迷。
*
回程路漫漫，狼火一点不敢耽搁。
来时还有心情停下来打猎，回去就指着鱼干吃，紧赶慢赶，终于在半个月内赶到了狼山。
分明才一个多月没回，狼山却好似换了一副模样。
大河水位又下降了，水流平缓。深草枯黄，连地里那些香草也有了枯败之态。
风抚过鼻尖，干得兽人不禁打个喷嚏。
林子传出敲敲打打的声音，叮叮当当，回声悠远。
二十几个兽人迫不及待钻出林子，就看到西边垒起来一个四四方方的东西。兽人围着兽皮裙，举着那红石头，挥汗如雨。
正忙着砌墙的狼莫转头就看见他们，眼睛一亮，扔下手里的砖噔噔噔跑了过来。
“你们回来了！”
“王！狼火回来了！”
狼莫声音大，喊完山前回音一圈一圈荡开，山洞中的兽人纷纷往外探头。
做木工活儿的山洞中，林楸正跟狼起说火炕的事儿。
狼起前一个活儿是做石碾，如今做出来一个，就放在旁边。石碾个头不大，滚轮状，用木头与麻绳做牵拉，幼崽都能拉动。
黑羽兽人给尾巴草籽脱壳脱得有一半了，剩下的不动。等他们走了，余下那些只用小的石碾就成。
这算是个样品，再大的，得专门找空闲时候做。
养咩咩兽跟红鸟的圈正在修，当务之急，林楸想着干脆把火炕也给盘了。
到时候不管是不是雪季，能给孵蛋的红鸟和新生的咩咩兽一个保障。
狼火带着队伍驮着东西到了棚子底下。
黑羽兽人看了眼，也有些好奇。
他们都知道狼部落兽人多，原先分出去一支，就是不知道在哪儿，又能让狼火带回来什么东西。
羽涯羡慕，“怎么这些狼这么多食物？”
羽山：“以后我们也会有。”
他抓了一把石板上的尾巴草籽，比起其他，要是他们能种这个，也就跟狼兽人一样什么都不怕了。
不过他还是没提，再等等。
林楸出来，与狼山下来的狼岩同行。
狼火回来的消息已经被狼莫嚷嚷开了，不管兽人正在做什么，都放下手头的事情围过来。
瞬间，黑羽兽人也就看不到棚子底下是个什么样的景象。
他们收回目光，继续手中的事。
狼火一行兽人走这一趟，直接瘦了一圈。二十几个狼兽人走之前还是狩兽人里算健硕的，这会儿看着风尘仆仆，又有些瘦巴巴的。
好在精神尚可，一路平安，没遇到什么事儿。
兽人们趴在地上，四肢瘫软，像个巨大且厚实的绒毯铺在地上。
狼安指挥着兽人将东西卸去，打开。
这路上十天半月的，带不回来什么新鲜东西。都是些菜干、熏鱼干、香草种子，全是支部落那边听了狼山这边的事给准备的。
狼岩叫兽人收好，那边狼安招呼兽人赶紧做点肉汤出来。
林楸在这边看了会儿，狼起就急急忙忙拉他继续商量盘炕的事儿。
待到兽人看完热闹散去，狼火才道：“王……支部落那边，日子比我们还难过。”
狼岩拎个矮凳坐下来，示意他们继续。
二十几头狼兽人乱七八糟趴在棚子底下，兽人七嘴八舌把支部落的情况说清。
“那边领地小，一天都不一定碰到一头猎物。”
“赤叔头发都白了，看着比起叔还老。哦……起叔现在精力比我们还足，已经不老了。”
“那边跟其他部落挨得太近，我们送东西过去，差点就被抢了。绿眼部落特别不要脸，就守在支部落外面，自己不去找食，盯着他们抢。”
“对！王，我们要不去，他们都顿顿吃草了。要不然，干脆叫他们回来算了……”
“就是，咱们部落至少吃鱼能吃饱，而且现在也要兽人干活，大不了……咱明年多种点尾巴草。”
狼岩听完，沉默了会儿，目光落在光束中跃动的尘灰上。
“这事不急。”
眼见部落食物渐多，勉强够狼山兽人食用，狼岩跟祭司原本的打算是先教支部落的兽人也学着捕鱼种地，他们再接济一下那边。
如果支部落回来，狼山压力一下大了。
还得仔细考虑。
狼岩将这事儿暂且一放，忽然问：“你们刚刚说绿眼部落？”
“对！就是那个部落，天天站在树上盯着狼部落，当我们没发现一样。”狼顺唾弃不已，就想着不劳而获，能养活什么族人！
狼岩看了眼林楸所在的山洞，瞧不见什么。
“绿眼部落在支部落隔壁？”
“对！就是那个以前勾搭了楸的部落！”
狼岩眼神骤暗，“勾搭了楸……”
狼火还要说，狼顺赶紧悄悄扒拉下兽人毛毛。
狼岩：“别在楸面前提这事儿。”
狼火对上狼岩冰凉的眼神，心里一颤，“哦……”
狼岩：“你们先休息，支部落的事等我跟祭司商量商量。”
要支部落回来不是说说而已就行，那一百多张嘴巴，单是吃鱼就需要专门的小队去捕捞。
怕就怕鱼被他们吃得差不多了，猎物也只少不多，久而久之，还是得分开。
狼火二十几个兽人吃了狼安开的小灶，万事不管，倒头就睡觉去了。
兽人们将带回来的东西归置起来，祭司下来看过，又把专门装草药的几个兽皮袋拿到了自己山洞。
支部落虽与他们不在一处，也有好处，这边没有的草药，那边能攒下许多。
林楸跟狼起商量完，离开山洞。
找了一圈，找到狼果正坐在草窝里给幼崽织毛衣。毛毛用的幼崽换下来的胎毛，灰扑扑的颜色。
毛料不够，先前从兽人们身上梳下来那些就有了用处。
林楸的毛衣也还没弄完，他不是这方面的能手，翻来覆去开了几遍头都不成，最后叫狼安接过去，慢慢研究去了。
部落亚兽人也不多，兽人各自的毛衣不由部落统一做。
太费事儿。
若想要的，就自己做，或者自己请兽人帮忙做。
如今部落储存的去壳的尾巴草籽足够多了，用不着那么多黑羽兽人，一部分狼兽人便打起了人家亚兽人的主意。
部落里也同意，将这事儿也算作是为狼部落干活。
林楸与狼果说了会儿话，用狼毛扎的球逗着还不会变形的幼崽玩了会儿。球丢出去，胖墩墩的幼崽争着去抢。
狼果瞥了眼，轻叹：“到现在了，今年还是没有新生幼崽。”
林楸：“没有食物，有也难养。明年应该就有了。”
幼崽把狼毛球叼回来，眼巴巴看着林楸。见他不动，爪垫搭在他手腕催促。
林楸捏住幼崽的小爪子，爪垫软乎，比他家狼王的爪垫好摸一些。
幼崽没多少耐性，见他不动，哼哼唧唧拿脑袋拱他。
林楸松手，再将狼毛球抛出去。
球打在角落放置的罐子上，狼果手上的木针扎空，他看着林楸道：“楸，你跟兽神商量好了吗？”
“嗯？”
“就是那罐子里的东西，好了吗？”
林楸失笑，“什么跟兽神商量，你哪儿听来的？”
“大家都知道了，你别想骗我们。”狼果道。
算算时间，是该开罐子看看了。
葡萄酒头一次发酵时间在七到十五天，这陶罐不透明，看不出里面什么样子。
林楸干脆洗干净手回来，将罐子打开。
狼果果断放下手中织了半截的狼毛衣，蹲在林楸身边。他动了动鼻子，惊讶：“好香啊。有点像放烂的果子，有紫皮果的味道！”
林楸：“那是发酵的味道。”
酒液已经与葡萄分层，上面悬浮着有些失了色泽的葡萄皮跟果肉。林楸用勺子拨了下，全是气泡。
“楸，你想让我们吃烂紫皮果？”
狼果探着脑袋，顺带将趴在罐身上的几个幼崽拨下来，拢在怀里。
大兽人下巴挤着幼崽脑袋，五双水汪汪的眼睛同时看来。
林楸：“还没好……吃的不是紫皮果，是里面的水。”
狼果：“嗷。”
幼崽：“嗷……”
林楸又盛出一点酒液来看，颜色紫红，带着浓烈的香气。林楸默默咽了咽口水。
他有点馋了。
“咕咚。”狼果咽口水的声音更大。
他直勾勾看着那勺子，没见过这么漂亮的水，有些迫切问：“楸，现在能喝吗？”
他感觉比部落的蜂蜜水还诱狼。
林楸：“不能。没好，喝了肚子疼。”
“不会吧……”
狼果脑袋都往勺子旁边凑了，林楸忙将酒液倒回去，“再等等。”
他重新将罐子密封，又去狼安那里要了一截新的麻布。再重新用沸水烫了个小一点的罐子，晾干，打算过两日把葡萄果肉跟果皮过滤出来。
他一边守着建造畜圈的事儿，一边守着陶罐。
也不知道是不是他开了陶罐，山洞里一丁点的酒味儿就叫兽人闻出来。
两天后，林楸拿着准备好的工具进去，就看着狼莫跟狼西蹲在罐子前面。
狼果抱着四个幼崽，撺掇道：“楸不在，咱们看看。”
狼莫：“不行，楸还没跟兽神商量完。”
狼果：“楸也打开看了的，没关系……”
“咳！”
三个兽人一抖，僵着身子背对着林楸没动。
林楸：“让一让。”
狼果迅速撤退，将四个幼崽留在原地。狼莫一手抓一个幼崽，举起挡在面前，螃蟹一样，脚下往旁边挪。
狼西：“楸，我什么都没干。”
林楸：“掀盖子掀多了，会坏。”
狼莫心一紧，顿时道：“我们才不会动，都是狼果，差点就听了他的话了。”
狼果：“我就说说，看看他们听不听话。要是他们真的动了我一定会阻止的。”
他说得正义凛然，狼莫一气，揣着两幼崽塞他怀里。
“坏兽人。”
林楸：“行了，帮忙。”
兽人说话间，他已经将麻布盖在空罐子罐口。狼莫在他的示意下，抱起盛着葡萄酒的罐子往上面倒。
葡萄皮滚出来，伴随着哗啦啦的声音，紫红色的酒酿透过麻布，落到下方罐子里。
浓香扑面而来，葡萄清甜，酒液醉人。
狼莫直面那味道，口中不断分泌唾液。虽没有吃过，但已经馋得有些受不了。
怎么就这么香呢！
狼果也围了过来，老老实实蹲在一旁，紧盯狼莫动作。
楸就只做了这一罐子，生怕他倒出来一丁点儿！
“楸……”
“楸。”
“楸啊~”
太香了，几个兽人馋得不行，脚尖往前挪，眼睛快掉进陶罐里。嘴上无意识叫着林楸，盼着他松松口，赶紧给自己来一口。
好不容易倒完，身后吵吵嚷嚷的。
林楸往后一瞥，兽人闻到味儿全找来了。
林楸收回目光，将果皮中的酒液挤出来。
罐子重新密封，放在原处，林楸拎着葡萄果皮，示意兽人们让路。
大伙儿乖乖让开一条道，等林楸走过，立马簇拥着追上来。
“楸，那个就是酒吗？”
“楸，咱们要不要多做一点啊，那点看起来不够吃。”
“楸，我可以帮忙的，我没事。”
“楸……我、我能尝尝你手上那果皮吗？”
林楸停下，诧异地看着狼云。
后头的兽人差点撞上来，身体直往后仰着，才没踩到林楸脚后跟。
小白狼心虚，“那里面的酒还没挤干呢，肯定还有……”
林楸怕这些兽人掀了陶罐盖子，回过头，冲着一群馋嘴的认真道：“还没好，不能吃。”
“那咱们再多做点嘛……”
林楸：“要问采集队还有没有。”
“肯定有！”
“没有我给你找回来！”
兽人知道吃不上，依依不舍看了眼林楸手上，盘算着叫林楸再做上百十罐，傻乐呵着跑远。
狼云是跟着狩猎三队回来的。
采集队也到了。
他们还没等放下东西，就叫兽人们热情地围住。
狼清立在狼贝身边，闻到了一点浅浅的紫皮果的味道。她眼中光芒微闪，再结合兽人们的表情，这是……成了？
“贝！你们再找点紫皮果好不好？”
“楸把酒做出来了，好香好香好香……”
狼贝还没见兽人们对他们这么热情过，她单手拎着藤筐，随意往地上一放，道：“知道了。”
“贝，多找一点，不然到时候不够分！”
狼贝不耐烦，“再啰嗦，不找了。”
“嘿！找，怎么不找！”兽人们立马讨好笑着，一溜烟散了。
入睡前，狼兽人们还抽动鼻子，使劲儿闻着山洞里残留的味道。有的甚至凑在那罐子前，就差把鼻子贴上去。
狼岩拎着兽人后颈，甩开。
“睡觉去。”
一看是狼王来了，兽人乖乖巧巧挪开，进草窝，闭眼躺平。
林楸刚洗了个澡，长发在火堆前烤得半干，才到狼岩草窝里坐着去。
他将兽皮放好，靠坐在草窝边缘。身上的长袖长裤换做了平时睡觉穿的老头衫跟短裤。
麻布洗得旧了，隐隐有些透，领口宽大，肤色一片白皙。衣裳薄，稍稍一动，便勾勒出腰腹曲线。
林楸全然不知，一心一意跟狼毛线较着劲儿。
狼岩掀开他搭在腿上的兽皮，挨着坐下来。
林楸手上毛线弄得乱七八糟，稍稍用力，线又断了。
他气得直接将东西往狼岩身上一放，拉高兽皮，背对着狼岩躺下。
没见过他这么气过。
狼岩失笑，仔细收好，放在外面。
“不会就不弄。”
林楸翻个身，跟河里刚捞起的鱼似的，极有劲儿。
狼岩腿叫他蹬了一下，脚心拧着皮，有点疼。
他无奈躺下，将林楸揽在怀里，轻轻拍着他后背，哄着：“楸会做的事多，不差这一个。”
林楸声音冷硬：“不做了。”
还跟自己较劲儿呢。
狼岩想笑，又怕惹恼了他。唇贴着林楸的软发，翘了翘。
“不做就不做，今天又开罐子了？”
“嗯。”
“他们求酿酒都求到我这里来了。”
林楸闻言，翻个身，趴在他身上。松松垮垮的背心随着动作卷上去一截，腰腹贴着，跟靠着搓衣板似的，林楸忍不住手贴在上面搓了搓。
狼岩瞬间变了眸色，喉结滚动，只吸着一口气，闭眼贴在他颈侧。
“葡萄酒看着很成功。”
“那就好。”
林楸摸着他喉咙，疑惑：“怎么哑了？”
狼岩将他从身上放下来，身体稍稍后退，低声道：“困了，快睡。”
林楸往前凑凑，忽然觉得抵得慌。他顺手一摸，两人同时僵住。
狼岩急喘了下，勾住他微嫩的掌心，与他十指相扣。
山洞内只有一捧火堆，很暗。
林楸眼尾薄红，立马明白是怎么回事。
林楸仰起头，凑近狼岩，小小声道：“我、我帮你……”
温热的气息喷洒在耳上，狼岩呼吸又滞了滞。他瞧着林楸不设防的眼神，再三压制，还是忍不住狠狠亲了他一下。
脑袋砸在林楸肩上，他将人抱得紧紧的。
“乖，睡觉。”
林楸：“王……”
狼岩低头，鼻尖挨着他鼻尖，四目相对，林楸见到了那深重的欲望。
他一个激灵，不敢再说。
狼岩闷声不吭，只将他搂得紧紧的。
兽人也不是那么随便，跟伴侣亲密是很隐私的事，绝对不会在现在这个环境里发生。
确定了伴侣的雄兽人往往会自己开辟一个小山洞，将山洞里布置一番，窝要够大，兽皮要够软。然后准备好吃的喝的，再将自己的伴侣接过去。
狼岩自然也在这么做。
不过他是狼王，身上事多，如今黑羽兽人又在部落，怎么都不方便。
他计划着等着黑羽兽人走了，再跟楸搬出去。
林楸养成习惯，每晚固定这个时候睡。
他被抱着，翻身不得。趴得久了，脸颊贴着狼岩胸口，像藏进了遮风挡雨的窝里，渐渐睡着了。
狼岩搭在林楸腰后的手掌上移，贴着自家伴侣的脸。
小小的，他一个巴掌能盖住。
指腹碾了下薄薄的面皮儿，留下一道红痕，狼岩手一顿，规规矩矩放回到林楸腰后。
腰也窄，他忍不住丈量了下，堪堪有他一掌长（他手大）。
一夜煎熬，索性白日他得守在狼山，不用去捕猎，睡不着也不碍事。
只哈欠多了，老祭司看他一眼，扔了包草药来。
狼岩过来跟他商量支部落回来的事，顺手接住，有些不解。
老祭司老神在在的道：“才长那么点肉，别太过了。”
狼岩将草药包往旁边一放，看都不看，一本正经道：“支部落的事，祭司怎么想的？”
老祭司见他不领情，哼了声，又立马把草药收回。
别看这么点草药，可不好找。
狼兽人虽然不需要，但以往集市开着时，这草药卖得不是一般的好。
“这事要先问过狼赤。现在狼山靠着鱼是比以前好点，但捕到的猎物可不多。我们本就不是专门吃鱼的兽人，这么久过去，你瞧瞧，鱼也没原来那么受欢迎……”
“再说尾巴草虽然能种，收获也提升了，但总的来看还是不算多。”
“支部落的兽人可是跟狼山的兽人相当，他们来了，跟着吃鱼吃个半年，一年、两年之后呢？”
“猎物的事始终没有解决。”
狼岩点头，这也是他所想的。
“楸说养红鸟跟咩咩兽，如果成功……”
老祭司道：“只盼着他能成功，我叫部落的兽人都上了心，楸要什么，他们就做什么。”
“要是能连其他野兽一起养……”
狼岩：“只有咩咩兽兽群大，其他野兽一下抓来四头都难。”
祭司叹气，“也是。”
狼岩：“就先不急，该教给支部落的已经教了，他们再撑一段时间。要是楸能成功，可以跟赤叔商量，叫他们回来。”
老祭司也同意。
“楸现在把红鸟跟咩咩兽养熟了，还是太少，有空多抓一点回来。”
狼岩：“嗯。”

狼岩安排得很快，第二天就把狼金小队留下，叫他们去林子里抓红鸟去。
至于咩咩兽，他打算等黑羽兽人走了，自己去抓。
林楸见小狼往林子里乱窜，一只倒霉催的红鸟正好被他们追出来，还没飞起来就一爪子勾住。
没了一大片毛，还叫小狼嘟囔着嫌弃：“毛长得太不结实。”
它藏在林子里的窝也被小狼一锅端，里头正好还有几个蛋。小狼屁颠屁颠给林楸送来，舔着唇，看着是想让林楸给开小灶。
林楸先用火照了照，里头小红鸟都成型了。
小狼吃不着，满腔怨念，继续去林子里捣乱。
鸟蛋就此留下，红鸟也被剪了翅膀单独扣在背篓底下。
小狼在外跑了一上午，带回来四只大红鸟，还有一群十几只小红鸟。林楸那扩建过的红鸟圈里，算上前一批孵化长大的红鸟，成年红鸟已经将近二十只。
更别说雨季后红鸟又开始了孵蛋，要是成功长大，雪季后将翻倍。
鸟圈又热闹起来，公红鸟打架，母红鸟带崽。
林楸看着，又不得不把几只公红鸟分开。他抓着进出林子撒欢儿的小狼问：“你们不去捕猎，怎么专门抓红鸟？”
“王说的嗷。”狼金理直气壮道。
可不是他们偷懒。
*
狼山山顶，有一个嵌入山体的大石头。石头面平，极宽，能并排躺下十几个狼兽人。
祭司以往找不到晒草药的地儿，会把草药拿上来放在这儿晒。
狼岩坐在大石头上，望着山下，底下情形一览无余。
林楸来了，他就弯腰，双手将他一提，搂坐在腿上。
林楸忙圈住他脖子。
狼岩嗅嗅他身上的香味，下巴搁在他肩膀。
“我打算先看红鸟能不能养过冬季再扩大养殖规模，现在抓这么多，万一养死了……”林楸找到狼岩，说了这事儿。
“小狼没事做，叫他们打发时间，不然在部落吵得慌。”狼岩并未着急将他跟祭司商量的事告诉林楸，怕给他压力。
红鸟跟咩咩兽能养出来最好，要是养不出来，他们再想别的办法。
狼山下都是兽人，也就山上安生。
狼岩许久没跟林楸单独相处，搂着他没叫人走的意思。便将他抱着，吸猫一样，鼻尖抵着林楸脖子，时不时嗅一嗅。
颈侧肌肤格外细腻，贴够了，就忍不住上嘴叼。
林楸躲不开，翻身坐正了，与他面对面，手挡住在他嘴上。
狼岩深眸泛起柔光。
他额头抵着林楸，拉下他的手拢在掌心，道：“我在半山腰做了个窝，等黑羽兽人走了，我们就搬上来。”
林楸面红，“山下住不得？”
狼岩托着他后颈，叫他看看住不住得。
第一次真正意义上的亲吻，狼王也很生疏。两片唇贴在一起，呼吸渐渐灼热。
林楸本来面红，看他贴这么久没动，忍不住微启唇，舌尖勾了他一下。
狼王便无师自通，勾着那软舌，蛮力使在这处，恨不能将他整个吞吃下去。
握住手腕的大掌钻入衣摆，紧掐住腰后，重重在皮肤上碾压。后颈也被拢住，呼吸被夺去，渐渐喘不来气儿，林楸轻哼着，红着眼挣扎。
阳光温暖，天幕澄蓝。
白云悠悠而过，一方云影落在这山顶，似要将亲密的二人藏起。
林楸就坐在狼岩怀里，被高大健硕的身子遮掩，像狼王守着珍宝，旁人觊觎不得。
狼岩后背刺疼，理智回归，稍稍松开。
林楸眼角挂着水，扫他一眼，眼波流转引得狼岩又忍不住追上去。
急迫的动作轻了，懂了怎么让伴侣舒服，变得温柔如水。
林楸也渐渐沉溺，双臂搭在狼岩肩上，绵软的身体依赖着对方，舒展着身体。
舒服了，便轻轻哼声。不舒服，便扯一下狼岩的头发。
狼岩伺候着自家伴侣，缠绵亲吻，吞食着那口中香甜，似蜜一样，怎么都不够。
亲到累了，唇角牵出一丝银丝。
林楸趴在狼岩怀里，像刚从温泉水里出来，浑身暖洋洋的。
林楸面颊红透，眼中泪盈盈的。
他动了动，狼岩忍不住低头，叼住他后颈。
林楸不躲，侧头在狼岩肩膀擦掉眼泪，还问：“什么时候搬山洞？”他声音懒懒的，忍不住将硌屁股的东西往下压了压。
狼岩闷哼，在他颈上磨了磨牙，拿他没办法。
“黑羽兽人……”
“不能早一点吗？”
狼岩这才明白他的意思，笑着亲亲他脸，“不急。”
林楸眉眼含春，上辈子许是压抑久了，这会儿惯是个会享受的。狼岩面前他最是赖皮。
他仰起头，润红的手指碰了碰狼岩下巴，说：“那你再亲亲。”
狼岩指腹压着他微肿的唇，嗓音微哑，“不疼？”
林楸哼哼：“舒服……唔。”
林楸迎上去，紧紧贴着伴侣的胸口，眉眼舒展，只觉没有比这个更令他喜欢的事了。
上辈子孤独压抑那么多年，早该……
也不该，那地方，没有王这般令他喜爱的伴侣了。
林楸吻着笑起来，眼中亮晶晶的。
狼岩见他分神，忍不住轻掐了下他腰间。林楸一挪，报复似的。他圈紧狼王的腰，借着狼王臂力保持坐姿，瘫软在他怀里舒舒服服地享受着。
山上无人，林楸累了。
在狼岩怀里靠着，竟还睡了一觉。
狼岩守着狼山，林楸醒来时，发现自己藏在狼岩的肚腹处，半个身体掩在那黑亮的狼毛里。
林楸抓着狼毛坐起，晕乎乎的，一头及腰长发也乱糟糟的。
狼岩背上一重，林楸爬坐在他背上，又趴下来，还泛着懒。
狼岩动了动耳朵，温声道：“安叫吃肉汤了。”
林楸脸压在狼岩后颈，胡乱蹭了两下，还没完全清醒。
狼岩索性背起他，“抱紧。”
林楸习惯性搂住他脖子，收紧双腿。
黑狼慢慢往山下走，林楸打个哈欠，目光在山间逡巡。
王说布置了山洞。
什么时候布置的？他怎么一点也不知道。
想着，唇上不适，忍不住舔了舔。
紧绷绷的，亲了那么久，亲到他累困了，不知道是个什么样子。
管他呢。
林楸脑袋往狼毛里蹭，手臂收紧。
自家伴侣，名正言顺的。
不用自己费腿，林楸直接被背到山脚。兽人各自都领了自己的肉汤，就剩林楸跟狼岩。
狼安都给他们留着，肉汤放了会儿，温度正合适。
兽人们把矮墙占了，棚子地下还有几张长桌，林楸挨着狼岩，慢吞吞往嘴里塞鱼汤。
不止兽人，他也吃腻了。
林楸用筷子拨弄了下鱼肉，肉质确实好，细腻成丝儿，又有韧劲儿。可一天不落，吃得太多了……
“吃不下？”狼岩问。
林楸偏头，下巴往他肩膀上一蹭，“我在想，有没有其他吃的。”
狼岩目光落在林楸唇上，红了些，有点肿。
“疼不疼？”他声音低了低。
林楸愣了下，意识到他看什么，抿着唇，冲他笑得明媚。
“不疼。”
他攀着狼王肩，凑近了说：“等会儿还亲。”
狼岩喉结滚了滚，摸摸他头发，“嗯。这次收的尾巴草多，不喜欢鱼明天就做那个吃。”
林楸：“还留着雪季吃呢。”
狼岩：“磨出来还没吃过，尝一尝。”
林楸点头，慢吞吞将一碗鱼汤喝下。鱼肉实在不想吃，就被狼岩接过去，吃了干净。
怕他饿，狼岩又往藤筐里找了些他喜欢的果子，洗净了，放大叶片里给他捧着。
林楸看着想笑，拿起一个啃了口，“像带幼崽。”
狼岩手背碰了碰他的脸，“狼兽人要对伴侣好。”
林楸：“其他兽人就不会吗？”
狼岩摇头，“不知道，但很多兽人不止一个伴侣。”
林楸“哇”了声，将果子递给狼岩，他啃了口，发现是酸的。林楸举着手，笑眯眯等他啃完，扔了核，才又拿了个慢慢吃。
“在兽神大陆，雌性跟亚兽人少，兽人为了繁衍，会专门去抢其他部落的。”
林楸一惊，贴身挨着狼岩。
狼岩：“放心，咱们附近几个部落没有。”
林楸：“中央大陆很多？”
狼岩：“是常事。”
以往还差点抢到狼部落头上，不过被他们的兽人打得半残，直接将那整个部落驱逐了。
有了一次警告，便没兽人敢来了。
就四五个果子，林楸挑了两个甜的吃了，不酸不甜的他跟狼岩一人一半，酸的更是直接咬一口就塞狼王嘴里。
狼岩都给他收拾了。
*
午觉睡过了，林楸下午就去祭司山洞。
他现在在祭司这儿学得多了，来祭司这儿也不如以往那么频繁。
狼冰也没出去，身边跟着狼溶，后头还有个羽乐。
小狼在祭司山洞外的平台上晒草药。都是先前种在林子里，这段时间陆续采回来的。
林楸看了眼，问：“种的跟外面采的有没有区别？”
狼冰：“更好。”
狼溶：“我们也施过肥。”
狼溶现在记录植物记录起心得，知道施肥、除草、浇水这些都能影响植物生长，便尝试着也把这一套用到小狼种的草药上。
他还跟之前养尾巴草一样，用同种植物对照试验，虽养死了些，但长得好的更多。
他俩说，羽乐就站在一边，低头安安静静地翻动药材。
林楸看着两个小狼。
狼冰：“我们弄完就下去。”
林楸往祭司山洞走，瞧老兽人在捣鼓支部落那边带回来的草药。祭司见了林楸，干脆将他拉过来，让他整理。
林楸示意了下外面，祭司这里可存着狼山大半隐秘的东西，黑羽部落那小兽人在外面，难不成祭司想再收一个徒弟？
老祭司：“小狼的朋友，有分寸。”
那小兽人上来之后也没进山洞，只乖乖在外面呆着。
林楸：“听说过目不忘呢。”
老祭司哼声：“你不是？有那么个好脑子，偏偏不用。”
林楸：“您可别冤枉我，我不用，你现在敢叫我碰这些草药吗？”
小狼没一会儿就带着羽乐下去。
林楸往外面平台看了眼，等听不见声了才道：“黑羽部落打的主意，您肯定知道。”
祭司点点头：“狼冰漏出去的那些，够了。”
两个部落是邻居，既可以稍稍信赖，也需要防备。照着目前这关系，狼冰告诉羽乐一些头疼脑热用的寻常药材，不碍事。
正好，要是黑羽兽人懂事，也该知道跟他们好好相处，而不是暗地里觊觎。
他作为一个部落的祭司，自然希望部落好。
林楸：“祭司有数就行。”
……
西边林子房子修得很快，才几天，墙面已经砌好。
林楸在祭司山洞忙完，下山看见兽人们抱着个大陶罐在往墙上泼水。畜圈挨着以前泡麻草的那条小河，取水用水都方便。
干活时兽人们都不爱穿那麻布做的衣服，腰间就围着个破旧兽皮，上半身跟长腿裸.露，很有原始部落的风貌。
墙体建好，就该准备上梁封顶的事。
林楸进去转了转，这屋子建得小，只开了一扇小窗和一道进出的门。
头一次建砖房，兽人们全靠自己摸索。他们的建造经验也就那几个棚子。
林楸有意让他们先练手，以后只怕建得更多。
话又说回来，费了这么大劲儿只为红鸟跟咩咩兽度过雪季，林楸有些担心最后养不成。
他隐隐感觉到了兽人们对吃肉的迫切。
鱼吃多了并不能长肉，狩猎队抓捕的猎物又时有时无，吃鱼只能暂时解决饥饿。
林楸绞尽脑汁，现在这情况，要获取稳定的肉源，只有这一条路。
林楸眉头拧成结，肉不行，那其他的食物总可以。
“楸！”
林楸听到外头有兽人喊，轻轻呼出一口气，敛了所有忧色。
他应了声，没等出去，狼起就进来了。
中年兽人面上严肃，胳膊下夹块儿卷起来的树皮，手上拿着烧了一半的木棍，一股老学究的气质扑面而来。
就差脸上戴一副圆框眼镜儿。
“楸，赶紧看看在哪里盘炕。”一来就说事儿，半点没耽搁的意思。
林楸：“靠里，别对着门口。”
他俩商量几句，把盘炕的位置确定下来，又用炭笔画了图。
林楸道：“起叔，这窗框跟门框还得麻烦你。”
狼起：“行。”
老一辈就是干脆。
这边转完，林楸想到自家狼王。目光在狼山寻了一圈，一仰头，落在狼山山顶。
从山顶往下看，什么都看得清楚，往上看就不行了。
林楸想到自己想干什么，唇翘了下，没找上去。
还有些阳光，林楸索性进大山洞，将他跟狼岩的窝拆了，里面的干草拿出来晒一晒。
他原本的草窝就不要了，只将狼岩的窝往里挪一挪。
林楸忙忙碌碌，旁的兽人见了，也学着他拆掉窝来晒。
山洞里一时间草屑飞扬，小虫乱跑，乱糟糟的。狼安从织布的山洞出来休息会儿，一瞧，干脆指挥兽人将窝全移了，将里头仔仔细细打扫一番。
边边角角，连带幼崽窝那边，几个储物的地方也都把东西搬出来清理了一番。
林楸检查了下里头的兽皮，都还好。
狼安正想去祭司那拿点驱虫药，见状道：“楸，兽皮也晒晒。”
林楸道：“好。”
这么折腾，山洞今晚也不知道能不能住。
大的忙，幼崽也跑来帮忙。林楸把晒兽皮的活儿交给他们，狼生拍着胸口答应：“放心吧楸叔，我们会晒得香香的。”
林楸拍拍幼崽脑袋，摸了一手臭汗。
林楸进山洞帮着打扫，灰尘多，狼兽人止不住打喷嚏。
狼果都将幼崽抱出来，不往里面钻。
林楸干脆用做衣服的麻布边角料，弄了几个简单的口罩。兽人往口鼻上一戴，这下稍微舒坦了。
兽人的草窝并不是一年一搭。
草窝下有石头，有木棍，有些单身雄兽人不讲究，窝下木头腐朽塌了就直接往上加新的木头。反复如此，不知道几年没清理。
林楸一扫，全是虫子啃出来的木屑。
驱虫药每年不少用，但草窝底下用不到，久而久之，完全成了虫子窝。
狼安一看，冲着进来搬草窝的狼石叉腰骂道：“看你们不讲究，草窝底下都烂了还不换。这么多虫子，晚上睡着也不怕痒！”
“一个二个这么邋遢，还想找伴侣，做梦都没人要！”
狼石被骂得不敢动，眼神无辜。
他换了的啊……
“还愣着干什么，多叫几个空着的来搬！”
狼石脚下一拐，立马往外跑。他拉来狼木几个，不出意外，又叫狼安指着鼻子骂。
要说祭司操心兽人康健，狼王操心兽人饱腹与安危，狼安则常留在狼山，相当于狼山的大管家。
家中凡事他过问，兽人不敢不听。
狼木几个被骂得耳朵里嗡嗡响，像钻了虫子。
几个狼兽人幽怨地看着狼石，狼石当看不见，让干什么干什么。
狼安：“愣着干什么！赶紧动！这么多灰不铲出去，留着下肉汤吃吗？！”
林楸头一次见狼安发怒，离他远远的。
见兽人们乖得像鹌鹑，忍不住翘了翘嘴角，半点不觉得这事儿与他有关。
他不就是晒个自己的草窝，没干什么。
看看他们王的草窝底下就干干净净，关他什么事儿。
狼山闹腾一下午，狼岩在山顶都听见了。
他动了动耳朵，瞧着林楸出来，脸上蒙着个麻布，清润的眼中隐隐带笑，正幸灾乐祸呢。
瞧着那些小崽子在兽皮上跑跑跳跳，一身脏兮兮的，弄得到时候冬季都不好用兽皮。
他起身，下去帮忙。
山洞里光是清扫出来的木屑就有一背篓，里头还有小虫在爬，林楸单是看着就浑身痒痒。
见狼岩下来，他赶紧把他拉开。
“乱着呢，先别进去。”
“帮忙。”
“差不多了，用不着你。”
林楸说完，见幼崽看着这边，挨个儿奖励了一兜果子，让他们玩儿去。
狼岩跟着林楸把兽皮重新铺平，仔细清点一番，一共一百四十来张兽皮。
咩咩兽的多，看着也新一点。还有几种林楸没见过。
兽皮大多是很大一张，能从头盖到脚，跟林楸草窝里的差不多大。
林楸想到雪季，问：“这些够用吗？”
部落兽人有一百多个，一人一张的话，余下的就分不均匀了。
狼岩道：“挤一挤够用。”
林楸：“这都是以往攒下来的？”
狼岩：“嗯。攒了很久。”
原本猎物多时，兽皮鞣制有好有坏，坏了的兽人们直接扔掉就是。
后头不行了，猎物少，兽皮也少。
渐渐兽人们就开始琢磨怎么提高手艺，每一张兽皮都尽量留下来。
他说着，灰色的眸子有些沉郁。
可惜，那些手艺最好的老兽人在漫长的饥饿中去世了。
“王……”林楸抱紧他腰，仰头看他。
狼岩：“还要谢谢楸。”
林楸：“用什么谢？”
见他还真问起来了，狼岩没了难过，仔细琢磨起来。
林楸笑着，踮脚飞快亲了下他下巴，“我有想要的。”
“什么？”
“你呀。”
狼岩失笑，搂住自己伴侣，低头……
“嗷哟！！！”一群刚刚跑走的小崽子跟小笋一样立在旁边，手捂着眼睛，嘴角咧到耳根去了。
林楸一臊，动作却霸道。
他手臂勾住狼岩脖子，脸跟他贴着，对这群幼崽道：“哟什么哟，我的伴侣，亲不得？”
狼岩无奈，见他跟幼崽较真，怕他踮脚累了，手托着他身后，对狼生道：“狼金回来了没有？”
幼崽乖乖摇头。
林楸放下手，倚靠狼岩，哼声得意。
幼稚！
幼崽悄悄冲他吐舌头。
狼岩：“等他们回来，叫他们带着你们抓红鸟。也大了，该开始学捕猎了。”
幼崽没有不高兴，反倒齐齐挺起胸膛。
“知道了，王！我们一定好好学！”
幼崽跑了，林楸脚也累了。
他手松下来，搭在狼岩胸膛，靠着后腰上的胳膊支撑身体。
他望着那些小萝卜丁，就那小短腿，“能让他们进林子吗？”
狼岩：“附近不怕，也该学了。”
林楸并没觉得不合适，看看狼雪——这一窝最大的小白狼已经跟着祭司学草药很久了。
见他不是为自己刻意为难幼崽，林楸弯眼。
他们王可公正。
“对了！”林楸松开狼岩，抓着他手道，“我想到还有一种食物。”
“什么？”
“藕啊。”南部那么多湖沼，野藕遍布，要是挖出来，雪季岂不是又多一种食物。
而且这个时候吃藕正好，比先前挖的时候肯定更软糯，也更大。
狼岩：“我安排。”
林楸：“挖藕可不好挖，兽人们过那沼泽地都难……”说着，他目光发亮，落到了那一群还在狼山前干活的黑羽兽人身上。
黑羽兽人后背发凉。
狼岩看去，道：“可行。”

Lang Yan made arrangements quickly. The next day, he kept the Lang Jin squad behind and told them to go into the forest to catch red birds.

As for the bleat-beasts, he planned to catch them himself after the Black Feather beastmen left.

Lin Qiu saw the little wolves darting around in the forest. An unlucky red bird happened to be chased out by them, and before it could even take flight, it was hooked by a claw.

It lost a large patch of feathers, and the little wolf muttered in disgust: "These feathers grow too loosely."

Its nest hidden in the forest was also wiped out by the little wolves, and there happened to be a few eggs inside. The little wolf trotted over to deliver them to Lin Qiu, licking its lips, looking like it wanted Lin Qiu to cook them a special meal.

Lin Qiu first used a torch to check them; the little red birds inside had already formed.

The little wolf couldn't eat them and was full of resentment, so it went back into the forest to cause more trouble.

The bird eggs were kept, and the red birds were also clipped of their wings and kept separately under a basket.

The little wolves ran outside all morning and brought back four large red birds and a flock of over a dozen small ones. In the expanded red bird pen, counting the previous batch that had hatched and grown up, there were now nearly twenty adult red birds.

Not to mention that the red birds had started laying eggs again after the rainy season; if they successfully grew up, the number would double after the snowy season.

The bird pen became lively again, with male red birds fighting and females tending to their young.

Watching this, Lin Qiu had to separate a few of the male red birds. He grabbed a little wolf that was running in and out of the forest and asked, "Why are you specifically catching red birds instead of hunting?"

"The King told us to, aww," Lang Jin said righteously.

It wasn't that they were being lazy.

*

At the peak of Wolf Mountain, there was a large rock embedded into the mountain body. The surface was flat and extremely wide, enough for over a dozen wolf beastmen to lie side by side.

In the past, when the priest couldn't find a place to dry herbs, he would bring them up here to sun them.

Lang Yan sat on the large rock, looking down at the mountain; the situation below was in full view.

When Lin Qiu arrived, he bent down, lifted him up with both hands, and pulled him to sit on his lap.

Lin Qiu hurriedly wrapped his arms around his neck.

Lang Yan sniffed the fragrance on his body and rested his chin on his shoulder.

"I plan to see if the red birds can survive the winter before expanding the scale of farming. If we catch so many now and they all die..." Lin Qiu found Lang Yan and brought up this matter.

"The little wolves have nothing to do, so I told them to do that to pass the time; otherwise, it's too noisy in the tribe." Lang Yan didn't rush to tell Lin Qiu about what he had discussed with the priest, fearing it would put pressure on him.

It would be best if the red birds and bleat-beasts could be raised; if not, they would think of other ways.

Below Wolf Mountain were all beastmen, so only the mountain top was peaceful.

Lang Yan hadn't spent time alone with Lin Qiu for a long time, and he held him with no intention of letting him leave. He held him, sniffing like a cat, his nose tip pressed against Lin Qiu's neck, taking a whiff from time to time.

The skin on the side of his neck was exceptionally delicate; after pressing against it enough, he couldn't help but bite it.

Lin Qiu couldn't dodge, so he turned around to sit upright, facing him, and blocked his mouth with his hand.

A soft light flickered in Lang Yan's deep eyes.

He pressed his forehead against Lin Qiu's, pulled his hand down into his palm, and said, "I've made a nest halfway up the mountain. After the Black Feather beastmen leave, we'll move up there."

Lin Qiu blushed, "Can't we live down the mountain?"

Lang Yan supported the back of his neck, showing him whether they could live there or not.

For their first real kiss, the Wolf King was also very inexperienced. Their lips pressed together, and their breathing gradually became scorching.

Lin Qiu had been blushing, but seeing him stay pressed for so long without moving, he couldn't help but slightly part his lips, his tongue tip hooking his.

The Wolf King then learned instinctively, hooking that soft tongue, using brute force in this spot, wishing he could swallow him whole.

The large hand gripping his wrist slipped into his hem, tightly pinching his waist, grinding heavily against his skin. The back of his neck was also held, his breath stolen, and he gradually couldn't breathe. Lin Qiu whimpered softly, struggling with red eyes.

The sunlight was warm, and the sky was clear blue.

White clouds drifted by, and a patch of cloud shadow fell on the mountain top, as if to hide the intimate pair.

Lin Qiu sat in Lang Yan's arms, shielded by his tall, sturdy body, like the Wolf King guarding a treasure that no one else could covet.

Lang Yan felt a stinging pain in his back, his reason returned, and he loosened his grip slightly.

Lin Qiu had tears hanging at the corners of his eyes, glancing at him, the movement of his eyes causing Lang Yan to be unable to resist chasing after him again.

The urgent movements became lighter; he understood how to make his mate comfortable and became as gentle as water.

Lin Qiu also gradually drowned in it, resting his arms on Lang Yan's shoulders, his soft body relying on the other, stretching out.

When it felt good, he would hum softly. When it wasn't, he would tug at Lang Yan's hair.

Lang Yan served his mate, lingering in kisses, swallowing the sweetness in his mouth, like honey, never enough.

When they were tired from kissing, a thin silver thread trailed from the corner of their lips.

Lin Qiu lay in Lang Yan's arms, feeling as if he had just come out of a hot spring, his whole body warm.

Lin Qiu's cheeks were flushed, his eyes brimming with tears.

He moved, and Lang Yan couldn't help but lower his head and bite his nape.

Lin Qiu didn't dodge, turning his head to wipe his tears on Lang Yan's shoulder, and asked, "When are we moving to the cave?" His voice was lazy, and he couldn't help but push down on the thing poking his bottom.

Lang Yan groaned, grinding his teeth on his neck, having no way to deal with him.

"The Black Feather beastmen..."

"Can't it be a little earlier?"

Lang Yan finally understood what he meant, smiling and kissing his face, "No rush."

Lin Qiu's brows were filled with spring; perhaps he had been suppressed for too long in his past life, but now he was someone who knew how to enjoy himself. He was most shameless in front of Lang Yan.

He lifted his head, touched Lang Yan's chin with his moist, red fingers, and said, "Then kiss me again."

Lang Yan's thumb pressed against his slightly swollen lips, his voice slightly hoarse, "Does it hurt?"

Lin Qiu hummed: "It feels good... mm."

Lin Qiu leaned in, pressing tightly against his mate's chest, his brows relaxed, feeling that there was nothing he liked more than this.

Having been lonely and suppressed for so many years in his past life, he should have long ago...

Or perhaps not; in that place, there was no mate as beloved to him as the King.

Lin Qiu kissed him and laughed, his eyes sparkling.

Seeing him distracted, Lang Yan couldn't help but pinch his waist lightly. Lin Qiu shifted, as if in retaliation. He wrapped his arms tightly around the Wolf King's waist, using the Wolf King's arm strength to maintain his sitting posture, lying limp in his arms and enjoying himself comfortably.

There was no one on the mountain, and Lin Qiu was tired.

Leaning in Lang Yan's arms, he actually fell asleep.

Lang Yan guarded Wolf Mountain, and when Lin Qiu woke up, he found himself hidden at Lang Yan's belly, half his body covered in that black, shiny wolf fur.

Lin Qiu grabbed the wolf fur and sat up, dizzy, his waist-length hair a mess.

There was a weight on Lang Yan's back; Lin Qiu crawled onto his back and lay down again, still feeling lazy.

Lang Yan twitched his ears and said warmly, "An is calling for meat soup."

Lin Qiu pressed his face against Lang Yan's nape, rubbing it randomly, not yet fully awake.

Lang Yan simply carried him on his back, "Hold on tight."

Lin Qiu habitually wrapped his arms around his neck and tightened his legs.

The black wolf walked slowly down the mountain, Lin Qiu yawned, his gaze wandering across the mountain.

The King said he had prepared a cave.

When was it prepared? How come he didn't know at all?

Thinking about this, he felt discomfort on his lips and couldn't help but lick them.

They felt tight; after kissing for so long, until he was tired and sleepy, he wondered what they looked like.

Never mind.

Lin Qiu rubbed his head into the wolf fur, his arms tightening.

His own mate, fair and square.

Without having to use his own legs, Lin Qiu was carried directly to the foot of the mountain. The beastmen had all received their meat soup, leaving only Lin Qiu and Lang Yan.

Lang An had saved some for them; the meat soup had been sitting for a while, and the temperature was just right.

The beastmen occupied the low wall, and there were a few long tables under the shed. Lin Qiu sat next to Lang Yan, slowly stuffing fish soup into his mouth.

It wasn't just the beastmen; he was also tired of eating it.

Lin Qiu poked at the fish meat with his chopsticks; the texture was indeed good, delicate and stringy, yet chewy. But eating it every single day, he had eaten too much...

"Can't eat anymore?" Lang Yan asked.

Lin Qiu turned his head and rubbed his chin on his shoulder, "I'm wondering if there's anything else to eat."

Lang Yan's gaze fell on Lin Qiu's lips; they were a bit red and slightly swollen.

"Does it hurt?" His voice lowered.

Lin Qiu was stunned for a moment, realized what he was looking at, pursed his lips, and gave him a bright smile.

"It doesn't hurt."

He climbed onto the Wolf King's shoulder and leaned in to say, "Let's kiss again later."

Lang Yan's Adam's apple bobbed, and he touched his hair, "Mm. We collected a lot of tail-grass this time; if you don't like fish, we'll have that tomorrow."

Lin Qiu: "We're saving that for the snowy season."

Lang Yan: "We haven't tried it since grinding it; let's have a taste."

Lin Qiu nodded and slowly drank a bowl of fish soup. He really didn't want to eat the fish meat, so Lang Yan took it over and finished it.

Afraid he would be hungry, Lang Yan found some fruits he liked in the rattan basket, washed them, and held them for him on a large leaf.

Lin Qiu looked at him and wanted to laugh, picking one up and taking a bite, "It's like raising a cub."

Lang Yan touched his face with the back of his hand, "Wolf beastmen should be good to their mates."

Lin Qiu: "Wouldn't other beastmen?"

Lang Yan shook his head, "I don't know, but many beastmen have more than one mate."

Lin Qiu said "Wow," and handed the fruit to Lang Yan. He took a bite and found it was sour. Lin Qiu held his hand, smiling as he waited for him to finish, threw away the pit, and then took another one to eat slowly.

"In the Beast God Continent, females and sub-beastmen are rare. To reproduce, beastmen will specifically go and snatch them from other tribes."

Lin Qiu was startled and leaned closely against Lang Yan.

Lang Yan: "Don't worry, the few tribes near us don't do that."

Lin Qiu: "Are there many in the Central Continent?"

Lang Yan: "It's a common occurrence."

In the past, they almost snatched from the Wolf tribe, but they were beaten half-dead by their beastmen, and that entire tribe was directly driven away.

With that warning, no beastmen dared to come again.

There were only four or five fruits; Lin Qiu picked two sweet ones to eat, split the ones that were neither sour nor sweet with Lang Yan, and as for the sour ones, he just took a bite and stuffed them into the Wolf King's mouth.

Lang Yan took care of everything for him.

*

Having slept through his afternoon nap, Lin Qiu went to the priest's cave in the afternoon.

He was learning a lot from the priest now, so he didn't come to the priest's place as frequently as before.

Lang Bing wasn't out either, with Lang Rong by his side, and Yu Le behind them.

The little wolves were drying herbs on the platform outside the priest's cave. They were all things they had previously planted in the forest and had been picking up one after another during this time.

Lin Qiu took a look and asked, "Is there any difference between the ones planted and the ones picked outside?"

Lang Bing: "They're better."

Lang Rong: "We also applied fertilizer."

Lang Rong was now gaining experience in recording plants and knew that fertilizing, weeding, and watering all affected plant growth, so he tried applying this to the herbs the little wolves planted.

Just like when he raised tail-grass, he used the same plant for a control experiment; although some died, more grew well.

As the two of them talked, Yu Le stood to the side, head down, quietly turning the medicinal materials.

Lin Qiu looked at the two little wolves.

Lang Bing: "We'll go down once we're done."

Lin Qiu walked toward the priest's cave and saw the old beastman tinkering with the herbs brought back from the branch tribe. Seeing Lin Qiu, the priest simply pulled him over and had him organize them.

Lin Qiu gestured outside; the priest's place held most of the secrets of Wolf Mountain. With that little beastman from the Black Feather tribe outside, could it be that the priest wanted to take another apprentice?

Old Priest: "A friend of the little wolves, he has discretion."

After that little beastman came up, he didn't enter the cave, just stayed outside obediently.

Lin Qiu: "I heard he has a photographic memory."

Old Priest snorted: "Don't you? With such a good brain, you refuse to use it."

Lin Qiu: "Don't wrong me. If I don't use it, do you dare let me touch these herbs now?"

The little wolves took Yu Le down after a while.

Lin Qiu looked at the platform outside, and only when he couldn't hear any sound did he say: "You must know what the Black Feather tribe is planning."

The priest nodded: "What Lang Bing leaked is enough."
