chapters.source_text:
事实证明，狼兽人不适合干占人领地这事儿。
下不去狠手，是一大忌。
爪子山上，山洞中。
除去在山脚下看守绿眼兽人的狼兽人，支部落其他兽人全在这里了。
火堆烧得旺，兽人们捧着陶碗，先喝点尾巴草籽粥暖暖肚子。
这期间，山洞中安静得落针可闻。
狼藏闷头喝粥，头也不抬。狼星忙着照顾自己幼崽，缩在角落。只有狼晚抱着双臂，紧盯着兽人们。
这群去了绿眼部落回来的兽人大气不敢喘。
难得狼晚舍得做一顿尾巴草籽粥，兽人们也不像以前那样饿死鬼投胎一般，端起碗就吞。
大家一点一点抿着吃，这辈子没这么斯文过。
狼赤不在，他们干了一件大事儿。
现在便宜没占到，还多了个烫手山芋。
狼晚看着兽人们这怂样，心里憋着气道：“怎么着？都哑巴了？底下那些怎么安排倒是说啊。”
狼藏没什么底气道：“先前……不是商量过？”
狼星见狼晚眼里腾起一簇火苗，默默挪了挪身体，背对狼晚。
“阿爸……”
“嘘——”狼星捏住自家幼崽嘴筒子。
幼崽眨眨眼，嘴筒子不动，等着自家阿爸的手撤开。
身后，狼晚气笑了。
他道：“是商量过，可当时多少个？现在多少个？！”
不算弄死的绿眼兽人，现在的壮年雄兽人有近六十个，加上从绿眼部落带回来的成年兽人和幼崽，一共一百五十多个！
光幼崽就三十多个！
幼崽能干什么？吃白饭吗？！
狼藏也在心里默默算，算完，碗里的尾巴草籽粥都不觉得香了。
狼晚：“你带回来的，你管，反正我只管狼兽人吃喝！”
“星！”
狼星喂幼崽的手一抖。
“诶！”狼星笑着回头，眼皮不自然地抽动。
幼崽奇怪地看他阿爸一眼。
阿爸为什么怕阿晚叔？
狼晚：“你跟藏商量去，这事儿有你一份，别想跑！”
*
支部落这边大多是平原，尤其是兽人们搭木屋的地方，前面就是一片大湖，树也没多少，一点不挡风。
雪季的风刺骨，荡过湖面，掠过木屋，吹过扛着渔网、陶罐下山的狼兽人。
狼藏走在前。
他年纪大了，满头白发，步履艰难地走在雪地中，怎么看怎么可怜。
狼星埋头跟在后头，忍不住又是一叹。
以往都是狼晚负责兽人吃住的事。狼星是采集队队长，只管跟着狩猎队出去，找到一片地，采集能吃的植物就行了。
回到山洞，也就往地上一躺，等着吃。
现在狼晚把安排绿眼兽人的事交给他们，狼星想想就头疼。
“哎！”他又叹。
一个雪球噌的一下飞出来，狼星猛地低下头。
雪球擦过他脑门，正中狼藏背上。
狼晚暴躁的声音传了出来：“再叹一下，今晚别吃肉汤了！”
狼藏默默抖了下兽皮衣，瓮声瓮气道：“别惹他了，急呢，不知道怎么跟赤交代。”
狼星：“还要怎么交代？他们自己送上门来的，我们抓了，顺便占了他们的领地，不是好事儿？”
狼藏：“那你先说说，这些兽人怎么安排？”
狼星闭上了嘴巴。
这些绿眼兽人既然是留着干活的，那就不能让他们现在就死了。可熬过雪季，哪有这么容易？
首先，那木屋就住不得。
“爪子山没有其他山洞。”狼藏默念道。
狼星：“他们之前也住的树屋。”
可树屋跟树屋是不一样的。
狼藏烦躁地挠着头。
之前狼赤在，他只管跟着狼赤做事就行了，现在什么都靠他安排，一动脑子就浑身不舒坦。
“算了算了！让他们自己想办法吧。”
下了山，狼兽人们脸上被吹得麻木。
木屋之中，有些撑不住的绿眼兽人已经晕过去。
绿皎抱着自己的伴侣跟幼崽，也在晕厥的边缘。
门被推开，他才注意到狼兽人过来了。
狼藏把绿壬叫醒。
绿皎双臂护紧自己的伴侣和幼崽，虚弱又防备地看着狼兽人们。
狼星把几个木屋走完，回到这边。
他发现他们把绿眼兽人的伴侣给幼崽抓过来，这些雄兽人精神了一点，至少没有寻死觅活的了。
山脚下冷，狼星脸僵硬，看着就更冷漠。
他直接道：“你们部落已经被我们占领，今后你们必须为狼部落做事。同意就留下，不同意只能被驱逐出部落，你们自己选。”
绿壬抬眼，目光缓缓聚焦，看着狼星。
就在狼星以为他要骂几句，绿壬道：“做奴隶，一天能有多少食物？”
狼星：“没有。”
绿壬笑了声，看着自家这些都没力气再爬起来的族人。
找他们这样的当奴隶，狼兽人有病。
狼藏将陶罐和渔网放下，道：“能不能做事，还要等你们熬过雪季再说。木屋前面这片大湖里鱼很多，渔网给你们用，还有一个陶锅一个陶罐。”
绿壬靠着墙壁，不解地看着他们。
狼藏：“这片大湖里的鱼随你们捞，捞上来的鱼随你们处置。捞不上来，我们也不会提供食物。”
话说到这里，也表明了狼部落的态度。
山脚下太冷，没挡风的地方，狼兽人实在不想待在下面，放下东西就走了。
“族长。”
绿眼兽人以为会等来死亡，没想到狼部落会给他们工具。
比起之前想撞头寻死的绝望，现在伴侣幼崽都在身边的雄兽人生出了求生的勇气。
狼兽人走了，绿壬脊背无力弯下来，身体像被折成两半。
他胸口剧烈起伏，重重喘了一口气，才道：“试一试吧。”
绿月靠在伴侣胸口，呆呆看着怀中一直没睁眼的幼崽。
边上稍微有点精神的亚兽人道：“湖面上的冰那么厚，就算砸开了，那么深的湖，怎么捞鱼……”
白松一只眼睛充血，漂亮的脸被打得肿胀。昨晚他受了狼兽人特别的关注。
他道：“他们是想折磨我们。”
“试一试。”绿壬还是这样说。
旁边亚兽人握住自家伴侣的手，喃喃自语：“外面太冷了，会冻死。”
狼兽人允许他们在木屋跟大湖活动，绿壬强撑着身体，叫能走动的幼崽把兽人身上的绳子解下，又让只受了轻伤的雄兽人去把其他兽人叫过来。
木屋太冷，火又不敢烧得太旺，怕木屋烧起来。
亚兽人跟幼崽冻得瑟瑟发抖。
绿壬叫还精神着的兽人清点下能活动的兽人数量，然后让他们立刻在木屋附近挖雪屋出来。
挖好以后，绿壬又让兽人把木屋拆剩下的木头拿来生火。
“族长，咱们把狼兽人房子拆了，万一他们不喜欢……”
绿壬悄无声息，这次没再用他虚得听不清的声音回答。
兽人们吓得忙去探他的鼻息。
绿皎额头靠着自己伴侣的肩膀，眼睛睁不开，没什么力气道：“他们要是不允许，早就下来了。把火堆移过去，受伤的兽人转移进去。”
兽人们听到绿皎的话，像找到了主心骨。
“皎，食物……”
绿皎：“听狼兽人的。”
“可冰那么厚，我们挖开了也是一个小坑，怎么能捞起来鱼？”
“听狼兽人的……”绿皎意识又模糊了。
两个能主事的兽人都没了意识，兽人们饥寒交迫，又陷入迷茫之中。
阴云笼罩头顶，兽人找不到活路了。
“阿爸，好饿……”一声稚嫩的幼崽声音响起。
一动不动的兽人们看向说话的地方，是绿皎跟绿月的幼崽。
绿月精神一振，颤抖着手摸了摸幼崽的脑袋，一下回了神。
“阿爸在，阿父也回来了……你等等阿爸，等等阿爸……”
绿月此刻什么也不想，他踉跄起身，拿起放在一旁的渔网直接冲进雪中。
兽人愣住。
他们看着那个跑到湖面，找准一个位置，刨开雪，埋头就开始挖冰的亚兽人。
屋内，又一个亚兽人将昏睡的幼崽小心翼翼放在火堆旁，也跑了出去。
然后是幼崽的阿父，幼崽的阿叔……
越来越多的兽人闷头冲了出去。
想那么多干什么呢？
就算是冻死，只要能抓到一条鱼，让幼崽能喝点汤，那就没白费力气。
爪子山上。
狼晚站在洞口，看着湖面上共同刨冰的绿眼兽人们。
大多兽人的爪子其实都很锋利，那是他们的武器。冰面很厚，但耐不住兽人多，肯卖力气。
狼星捂着兽皮，站到狼晚旁边。
“晚，你说他们能捕到鱼吗？”
狼晚：“下雪的时候，不是最好抓鱼的吗？”
雪季没食物的时候，湖面上打个坑，鱼就会争先恐后往坑这边游过来。还不用下水，除了会受冻，比其他时候抓鱼安全得多。
其实有时只要多尝试，弄点食物垫垫肚子不难。
狼兽人不服输，不愿意等死，所以他们发现了雪季更好捞鱼这件事。绿眼部落同样有很多湖，但他们却总想着抢现成的食物。
狼晚：“留下这么多绿眼兽人，以后睡觉都别睡死了。还有，想想赤回来以后怎么跟他交代吧。”
狼星瞧着山下成功挖通冰面的绿眼兽人。
赤倒是能解决，可狼山那边要是知道他们留下这么多绿眼兽人，不知道会怎么想。
没准他们回狼山的事，都会因为这些绿眼兽人推迟。
*
“阿嚏！”
狼赤揣着手蹲在廊下，又打了个喷嚏。
狼金带着一溜小狼绕着他走，忍不住道：“啧啧，不知道支部落那边到底什么大事，搞得我赤叔脑浆都快打出来了。”
狼赤听见，抄起地上毛球朝着小狼扔过去。
狼金歪头躲开，哈哈笑着钻进大山洞中。
狼赤揉了揉鼻子，随意坐靠在墙角。等雪开始融化，他立马回支部落。
他倒要看看祭司说的是什么好事！
西边，红鸟房子里，林楸跟狼溶又收上来一批红鸟蛋。加上前两个月收上来那些，一共七十多个，够给兽人们做一顿好的了。
红鸟蛋一被抬到大山洞，惦记许久的狼西直接滑坐到藤筐边。
“楸！要帮忙吗？”
林楸：“来吧。”
红鸟蛋之前一直放在西边火炕屋，屋里暖和，红鸟蛋没有被冻上。
刚开始红鸟下的蛋少，部分还被狼溶拿去孵蛋，剩下的只能先紧着幼崽吃。
成年兽人们嘴馋，有不要脸的，幼崽吃煮蛋时，还专门坐在幼崽身边守着。
幼崽被看得烦了，也会分他们一点。
狼西就是那不要脸的其中一个。
林楸拿了两个大陶盆进来，看向守在桌边的狼莫跟狼西。
“蛋壳别打进去了。”
“嗷。”
林楸怕他们浪费，先拿了一个红鸟蛋示范。
“看清楚了？”
“清楚了。”两个狼兽人看得目不转睛。
林楸：“那你们忙。”
他要去跟今天负责做饭的兽人商量一下，晚上能不能蒸点干的尾巴草籽来吃。
今天菜谱也简单，一个野菜蛋花汤，一个蒸蛋，再炒一个熏肉蒜苗。
部落就剩最后一点蒜苗了，兽人们平时舍不得吃，但蒜苗已经蔫得不成样子，再不吃就得扔了。
菜的种类少，份量不能少，不然不够分。
林楸前脚离开，后脚小狼和幼崽也围到桌边凑热闹。
蛋壳脆，狼兽人不敢乱动，怕不小心磕破。
狼金蹲在凳子上，双手搭在桌面，盯着狼莫道：“莫，你会吗？”
狼莫：“简单，看着啊。”
他拿起一个蛋，学着林楸的样子小心翼翼往桌面上一碰。
诶？没破。
狼金露出一排白森森的牙，嘲讽地笑。
狼莫轻啧一声，力道稍重。
啪的一声——
蛋壳碎开，蛋黄蛋白流了一桌子。
几个围着桌子的狼顿时慌慌张张，拿盆的拿盆，挡兽人的挡兽人。狼莫手掌一搂，蛋液滚到盆中，毁尸灭迹。
“脏不脏！”
兽人静悄悄，一定在作妖。
狼安一巴掌拍在狼金脑门，嫌弃地抢了盆拎出去。
“洗手没有？”
狼莫龇牙。
狼安：“都滚去洗手！”
“那蛋——”
狼安将蛋液倒进陶碗，往灶下的火中一放，没多久，端出来直接扔给狼莫。
白得了一个烤蛋的狼莫嘴角咧到耳根子去了。
其他兽人跃跃欲试。
狼安警告道：“再弄脏一个，等会儿自己吃雪去！”
兽人怂唧唧地笑道：“不会，肯定不会。我们才没那么笨。”
山洞里的兽人帮着处理红鸟蛋，态度虔诚，生怕出错。
洞外，林楸开始准备晚饭。
他头上戴着兽皮帽，身上穿着兽皮衣、兽皮裤，脚下蹬着兽皮靴，手上戴着兽皮手套，脖子上还围了一圈兽皮条。
全身上下，只有上半张脸露了出来。
狼安看着他这样，噗嗤一笑。
林楸怨念道：“都是王让这么穿的。”
不这么穿，他就不让自己出来。
狼安笑着摆手道：“这样，你告诉我们怎么做，我们动手。”
林楸要做新菜，亚兽人们到齐了，都是出来观摩的。
林楸：“也行。”
炒菜跟蛋花汤兽人们都会，无非是一个蒸蛋还有蒸尾巴草籽。
狼霜去山洞拿尾巴草籽。
洞内脱过壳的尾巴草籽剩得不多，林楸要吃干的，得把剩下的全部倒出来。
狼霜一边心疼，一边嘴馋。
这汤汤水水的他们吃了大半年了，偶尔也想换换口味。
他下不去狠手，索性直接将装尾巴草的罐子一起带出去。
今晚蒸尾巴草籽征询了狼岩和老祭司的意见，负责做饭的亚兽人自然同意。至于其他兽人，巴不得多吃。
节约惯了的狼兽人一边心疼，一边往盆里倒尾巴草籽。
快一盆尾巴草籽，淘洗干净，往陶罐里加水，再上甑子。甑子似圆桶，底部有小洞，兽人做陶时顺带做的。
尾巴草籽就倒在甑子中，借着水蒸气蒸熟就行。
这边一好，山洞里负责打蛋的兽人也端着盆出来了。
林楸让亚兽人们将蛋分成两半，少的做蛋花汤，多的用来蒸蛋。
剩下四口锅，蛋花汤就得煮两锅。剩下的两口锅做蒸蛋一次做不完，要弄两次。
“蛋搅散，加点盐跟油，然后再加水。”
林楸指点，几个亚兽人照做。
等到蛋液上锅，几口锅里的水差不多都烧开了，灶台这边全是热腾腾的蒸汽，兽人们站在其中，宛若腾云驾雾。
林楸跺了跺冻得有些麻木的脚，凑近灶孔边烤火。
“现在做一顿饭都觉得冷。”
要不是廊道上挂了草帘，能挡风，外面都不能走人。
狼安闻着尾巴草籽的清香，笑道：“现在已经比以前好太多了。”
林楸搓着手，凑近火边烤。
他随口道：“以后还能更好。”
狼安眼里温柔，看着林楸，忍不住摸了摸他的头发。
“慢慢来吧，你跟王也别太累，还有我们呢。”
林楸笑着脑袋靠了一下狼安肩膀，“知道了，安叔~”
狼赤坐在廊道里看着，心里冒酸气。
他来狼山这么久，都没听到幼崽叫几声阿父。
*
晚上兽人们吃了一顿好的。
尾巴草籽饭清香软绵，蒸蛋滑嫩，熏肉炒蒜苗咸香十足。
兽人们学着林楸的样子，把炒菜盖在尾巴草籽饭上，混合着刨了满满一大口。再抿一口蒸蛋，咕咚一下，还没来得及感受蒸蛋就顺着喉管滑进肚子里。
吃到一半觉得口渴了，端起野菜蛋花汤喝上一口……
毛孔舒展，四肢百骸都是暖意。
究竟是谁说尾巴草籽难吃，野菜难吃的？他们怎么以前没想过这么搭配起来吃？
大伙儿闷头苦吃。
有些兽人吃得急了，大山洞里都是猪哼哼似的声音。
“嗝——”
兽人捂着肚子，吃得红光满面。
太舒服了，身体像要融化进草窝里，一时间仿佛被抽出了骨头，浑身绵软，一点都不想起来。
但火炕屋的位置有限，想睡得抢！
狼乔按耐住想就此睡下去的冲动，赶紧把碗筷洗了，直接跑到火炕屋去。
狼乔的狩猎三队成员们跟他心有灵犀，默不作声地爬起来，镇定地离开山洞，然后立马洗干净碗筷，跟上队长的步伐。
“嗝！”狼莫倒在草窝，翘起一条腿，脚尖打圈儿，悠哉悠哉地晃啊晃。
“莫，洗碗！”边上狼西喊。
狼莫微醺似的道：“急什么，躺会儿。”
狼西：“狼乔不在了。”
“狼乔不在关我……什么！”狼莫手忙脚乱爬起来，往山洞里扫了一眼，真不在了！
他抄起火堆边的陶锅倒了一点温水，然后捧着碗筷出去。
看到雪地里延伸出去、朝着西边方向的脚印，狼莫气得搓碗搓得咯吱响！
“又被他们抢先了！”
山洞内，林楸看着风风火火离开的狼莫，收回目光，有些苦恼地靠在狼岩身上。
“怎么都想去火炕屋。他们去那边，咩咩兽都没地方躺了。”
那边再收拾得干净，也有味道，何况跟着咩咩兽一起睡……也不怕身上长虫子。
狼岩倒很淡定，“把他们当守圈的，咩咩兽一有问题就知道，不正好？”
林楸：“只能这么想了。”
*
“诶！舒服——”
狼乔躺在温热的火炕上，彻底松了骨头。
脚边，狼云急匆匆进来，找准位置起跳。
狼乔：“火炕塌了我看你怎么跟楸交代！”
“嘿！哪有这么容易塌。”狼云懒声道。他侧躺朝里，顺便把手脚搭在一旁的咩咩兽身上。
他爪子在咩咩兽的肚子上拍了拍，“大白，你刚刚也吃草了？”
咩咩兽嘴巴嚼了两下，看着他，忽然低头咬狼云头发。
小白狼立马滚远，后背靠着狼乔。
狼乔躺着，一动不动，准备睡觉了。
狼云爪子搭在狼乔肚子上，拍了拍，狼乔一个激灵，抓着他的手甩掉。
“嘿嘿。”狼云搓了搓爪子，“还是咱们队长的肚子硬。”
狼乔：“摸你自己的去！恶不恶心！”
狼云：“不摸就不摸！我摸大白的。大白最近胖了不少，可好摸了。就是不让我搭腿了，这很不好……”
狼云又滚一圈，笑嘻嘻地挪到咩咩兽跟前。
狼乔眉头一皱，忽然坐起，拎着狼云后颈，将兽人带回来。
“你刚刚说什么？”
狼云仰躺着被他们队长一个手臂拖过去，一脸懵道：“我摸大白啊？难不成想让我摸你的？噢哟……变态！”
“你才变态！”狼乔给了他一爪子，眼里幽光闪烁。
“你刚刚说大白胖了？”
“对、对啊。”
雪季这么好吃好喝的，能不养点膘出来嘛。
何况还有他们暖炕，咩咩兽这日子，啧啧……不是他说，比他们兽人都过得好！
狼乔甩开他，靠近大白。
狩猎三队的兽人从一开始霸占咩咩兽的火炕屋，到现在已经有两个月，他们天天跟咩咩兽睡在一起，还给每一头咩咩兽取了名字。
他们跟咩咩兽熟悉到什么程度呢？
如果咩咩兽在他们睡觉的时候发动攻击，狼兽人能精准捏住咩咩兽角，闭着眼睛就知道是哪一头咩咩兽在作怪。
大白现在是这群咩咩兽的头领，是第二批到狼部落的咩咩兽。
现在大白的肚子大了？
真大还是假大，这很重要。
“去，把狼溶跟楸叫来。”
狼云翻个身，摊开肚皮，四肢弯曲，脖子歪着看向狼乔，“队长，我睡着了。”
狼乔一拳打过去。
“嗷呜！”痛呼声惊得屋里咩咩兽全都抬起头看来。
狼云捂着眼睛，火急火燎地跑出来。边跑边嚷嚷，恨不能狼山全部兽人都能听见。
“楸！队长打我！你要给我做主啊！”
chapters.translated_text:
Facts have proven that Wolf Orcs are not cut out for occupying other people's territories.

Being unable to be ruthless is a major taboo.

On Claw Mountain, inside the cave.

Except for the Wolf Orcs guarding the Green-Eyed Orcs at the foot of the mountain, all the other orcs of the branch tribe were here.

The fire was burning brightly, and the orcs held clay bowls, drinking tail-grass seed porridge to warm their stomachs.

During this time, the cave was so quiet you could hear a pin drop.

Lang Cang drank his porridge with his head down, not even looking up. Lang Xing was busy taking care of his cub, huddled in a corner. Only Lang Wan stood with his arms crossed, staring intently at the orcs.

The group of orcs who had just returned from the Green-Eyed tribe didn't dare to breathe loudly.

It was rare for Lang Wan to be willing to make a meal of tail-grass seed porridge, but the orcs didn't gulp it down like starving ghosts as they usually did.

Everyone sipped it little by little; they had never been so refined in their lives.

Lang Chi wasn't there, and they had done something huge.

Now, not only had they failed to gain any advantage, but they were also stuck with a hot potato.

Watching the cowardly behavior of the orcs, Lang Wan felt a surge of anger and said, "Well? Are you all mute? Say something about how to arrange those people down there."

Lang Cang said with little confidence, "Didn't we... discuss this earlier?"

Seeing a spark of fire ignite in Lang Wan's eyes, Lang Xing silently shifted his body, turning his back to Lang Wan.

"Dad..."

"Shh—" Lang Xing pinched his cub's snout shut.

The cub blinked, keeping its snout still, waiting for its father's hand to move away.

Behind him, Lang Wan was so angry he laughed.

He said, "We did discuss it, but how many were there then? And how many are there now?!"

Not counting the Green-Eyed Orcs that were killed, there were nearly sixty able-bodied male orcs now, and adding the adult orcs and cubs brought back from the Green-Eyed tribe, there were over one hundred and fifty in total!

There were over thirty cubs alone!

What can cubs do? Eat for free?!

Lang Cang also calculated silently in his heart, and after finishing, the tail-grass seed porridge in his bowl didn't taste good anymore.

Lang Wan: "You brought them back, you deal with them. Anyway, I'm only responsible for the Wolf Orcs' food and drink!"

"Xing!"

Lang Xing's hand, which was feeding the cub, trembled.

"Yeah!" Lang Xing turned back with a smile, his eyelids twitching unnaturally.

The cub looked at its father strangely.

Why is Dad afraid of Uncle Lang Wan?

Lang Wan: "Go discuss it with Cang. You have a part in this, don't even think about running away!"

*

The area around the branch tribe was mostly plains, especially where the orcs built their wooden houses; in front was a large lake, and there weren't many trees, so it didn't block the wind at all.

The wind of the snow season was bone-chilling, sweeping across the lake, passing the wooden houses, and blowing past the Wolf Orcs carrying fishing nets and clay pots down the mountain.

Lang Cang walked in front.

He was old, with a head full of white hair, walking with difficulty in the snow; he looked pitiful no matter how you looked at him.

Lang Xing followed behind with his head down, unable to help but sigh again.

In the past, Lang Wan was responsible for the orcs' food and housing. Lang Xing was the leader of the gathering team, only responsible for following the hunting team out, finding a patch of land, and gathering edible plants.

Returning to the cave, he would just lie on the ground and wait to be fed.

Now that Lang Wan had handed the arrangement of the Green-Eyed Orcs to them, Lang Xing got a headache just thinking about it.

"Sigh!" He sighed again.

A snowball flew out with a 'whoosh', and Lang Xing ducked violently.

The snowball grazed his forehead and hit Lang Cang squarely on the back.

Lang Wan's irritable voice came out: "One more sigh, and you won't get any meat soup tonight!"

Lang Cang silently shook his fur coat and said in a muffled voice, "Don't provoke him, he's anxious. He doesn't know how to explain it to Chi."

Lang Xing: "What else is there to explain? They delivered themselves to our door, we caught them, and incidentally occupied their territory. Isn't that a good thing?"

Lang Cang: "Then tell me first, how are these orcs to be arranged?"

Lang Xing shut his mouth.

Since these Green-Eyed Orcs were kept to work, they couldn't be allowed to die just yet. But surviving the snow season, how could it be so easy?

First of all, those wooden houses were uninhabitable.

"There are no other caves on Claw Mountain," Lang Cang muttered to himself.

Lang Xing: "They lived in tree houses before."

But a tree house is not the same as a tree house.

Lang Cang scratched his head in frustration.

Before, when Lang Chi was there, he only had to follow Lang Chi's lead. Now that he had to arrange everything himself, his whole body felt uncomfortable as soon as he used his brain.

"Forget it, forget it! Let them figure it out themselves."

After descending the mountain, the Wolf Orcs' faces were numb from the wind.

Inside the wooden houses, some of the Green-Eyed Orcs who couldn't hold on had already fainted.

Lu Jiao was holding his partner and cub, also on the verge of fainting.

Only when the door was pushed open did he notice the Wolf Orcs had come.

Lang Cang woke Lu Ren up.

Lu Jiao protected his partner and cub tightly with his arms, looking at the Wolf Orcs with weakness and defensiveness.

Lang Xing finished walking through the few wooden houses and returned to this side.

He discovered that by bringing the Green-Eyed Orcs' partners and cubs over, these male orcs had a bit more spirit; at least they weren't looking to die anymore.

It was cold at the foot of the mountain, and Lang Xing's face was stiff, making him look even more indifferent.

He said directly: "Your tribe has been occupied by us. From now on, you must work for the Wolf Tribe. If you agree, stay; if you don't, you will be driven out of the tribe. You choose."

Lu Ren raised his eyes, his gaze slowly focusing on Lang Xing.

Just when Lang Xing thought he was going to curse, Lu Ren said, "As slaves, how much food can we get a day?"

Lang Xing: "None."

Lu Ren laughed, looking at his tribesmen who didn't even have the strength to get up anymore.

To take people like them as slaves, the Wolf Orcs must be sick.

Lang Cang put down the clay pots and fishing nets and said, "Whether you can work or not will have to wait until you survive the snow season. There are many fish in the large lake in front of the wooden houses. You can use the fishing nets, and there is one clay pot and one clay jar."

Lu Ren leaned against the wall, looking at them in confusion.

Lang Cang: "You can catch as many fish as you want from this large lake, and you can do whatever you want with the fish you catch. If you can't catch any, we won't provide food."

Having said this, it also indicated the Wolf Tribe's attitude.

It was too cold at the foot of the mountain, and there was no shelter from the wind, so the Wolf Orcs really didn't want to stay there and left after putting down the things.

"Chief."

The Green-Eyed Orcs thought they would be waiting for death, but they didn't expect the Wolf Tribe to give them tools.

Compared to the despair of wanting to hit their heads and seek death before, the male orcs who now had their partners and cubs by their sides developed the courage to survive.

The Wolf Orcs left, and Lu Ren's spine bent weakly, his body looking as if it had been folded in two.

His chest heaved violently, and after taking a heavy breath, he said, "Let's try."

Lu Yue leaned against his partner's chest, staring blankly at the cub in his arms that hadn't opened its eyes yet.

A slightly more energetic sub-orc on the side said, "The ice on the lake is so thick, even if we break it, it's such a deep lake, how can we catch fish..."

Bai Song had one eye bloodshot, and his beautiful face was swollen from being beaten. Last night, he had received special attention from the Wolf Orcs.

He said, "They want to torture us."

"Try it," Lu Ren still said.

The sub-orc next to him held his partner's hand, muttering to himself, "It's too cold outside, we'll freeze to death."

The Wolf Orcs allowed them to move between the wooden houses and the large lake. Lu Ren forced himself up, told the cubs who could walk to untie the ropes on the orcs, and asked the male orcs who had only suffered minor injuries to call the other orcs over.

The wooden houses were too cold, and they didn't dare to make the fire too big for fear of burning the houses down.

The sub-orcs and cubs were shivering with cold.

Lu Ren told the orcs who still had energy to count how many orcs could move, and then told them to immediately dig snow houses near the wooden houses.

After digging them, Lu Ren told the orcs to take the wood left over from dismantling the wooden houses to make a fire.

"Chief, if we dismantle the Wolf Orcs' houses, what if they don't like it..."

Lu Ren was silent, and this time he didn't answer with his voice, which was too weak to be heard.

The orcs were frightened and hurriedly checked his breathing.

Lu Jiao leaned his forehead against his partner's shoulder, his eyes unable to open, and said weakly, "If they didn't allow it, they would have come down already. Move the fire over and transfer the injured orcs inside."

Hearing Lu Jiao's words, the orcs felt as if they had found their backbone.

"Jiao, food..."

Lu Jiao: "Listen to the Wolf Orcs."

"But the ice is so thick, even if we dig it open, it's just a small hole, how can we catch fish?"

"Listen to the Wolf Orcs..." Lu Jiao's consciousness blurred again.

With both orcs who could take charge losing consciousness, the orcs were hungry and cold, falling into confusion again.

Dark clouds hung over their heads, and the orcs couldn't find a way to live.

"Dad, so hungry..." A young cub's voice sounded.

The motionless orcs looked at where the voice came from; it was Lu Jiao and Lu Yue's cub.

Lu Yue's spirit lifted, and he touched the cub's head with trembling hands, coming back to his senses.

"Dad is here, Father is back too... You wait for Dad, wait for Dad..."

Lu Yue didn't think about anything else at this moment; he stumbled to his feet, picked up the fishing net placed to the side, and rushed directly into the snow.

The orcs were stunned.

They watched the sub-orc run to the lake, find a spot, clear away the snow, and bury his head in digging the ice.

Inside the house, another sub-orc carefully placed the sleeping cub by the fire and also ran out.

Then came the cub's father, the cub's uncle...

More and more orcs rushed out with their heads down.

Why think so much?

Even if they freeze to death, as long as they can catch one fish and let the cub have some soup, then the effort wasn't wasted.

On Claw Mountain.

Lang Wan stood at the cave entrance, watching the Green-Eyed Orcs digging the ice together on the lake.

Most orcs' claws are actually very sharp; that is their weapon. The ice is thick, but it can't withstand so many orcs willing to put in the effort.

Lang Xing covered himself with animal skin and stood next to Lang Wan.

"Wan, do you think they can catch fish?"

Lang Wan: "Isn't the snow season the best time to catch fish?"

When there is no food in the snow season, if you make a hole in the lake, the fish will scramble to swim toward the hole. You don't even need to go into the water; besides being cold, it's much safer than catching fish at other times.

In fact, sometimes as long as you try more, it's not hard to get some food to pad your stomach.

Wolf Orcs don't admit defeat and aren't willing to wait for death, so they discovered that it's easier to catch fish in the snow season. The Green-Eyed tribe also had many lakes, but they always thought about grabbing ready-made food.

Lang Wan: "Leaving so many Green-Eyed Orcs behind, don't sleep too soundly from now on. Also, think about how to explain it to Chi when he comes back."

Lang Xing looked at the Green-Eyed Orcs who had successfully dug through the ice at the foot of the mountain.

Chi could be dealt with, but if the Wolf Mountain side knew they had left so many Green-Eyed Orcs behind, he didn't know what they would think.

Perhaps their return to Wolf Mountain would be delayed because of these Green-Eyed Orcs.

*

"Achoo!"

Lang Chi squatted under the corridor with his hands tucked in, sneezing again.

Lang Jin led a line of little wolves around him and couldn't help but say, "Tsk tsk, I don't know what big thing is happening at the branch tribe, making my Uncle Chi's brains almost beat out."

Hearing this, Lang Chi picked up a fur ball from the ground and threw it at the little wolf.

Lang Jin tilted his head to dodge, laughing as he dived into the big cave.

Lang Chi rubbed his nose and sat casually in the corner. As soon as the snow started to melt, he would return to the branch tribe immediately.

He wanted to see what good thing the priest was talking about!

In the west, in the Red Bird house, Lin Qiu and Lang Rong collected another batch of Red Bird eggs. Adding those collected in the past two months, there were over seventy in total, enough to make a good meal for the orcs.

As soon as the Red Bird eggs were carried to the big cave, Lang Xi, who had been thinking about them for a long time, slid down to the side of the rattan basket.

"Qiu! Do you need help?"

Lin Qiu: "Come on."

The Red Bird eggs had been kept in the west heated-brick room; it was warm in the room, so the eggs didn't freeze.

At first, the Red Birds laid few eggs, and some were taken by Lang Rong for incubation, so the rest could only be prioritized for the cubs to eat.

The adult orcs were greedy, and there were shameless ones who would sit next to the cubs and guard them while they ate boiled eggs.

When the cubs got annoyed by being watched, they would share some with them.

Lang Xi was one of those shameless ones.

Lin Qiu brought in two large clay basins and looked at Lang Mo and Lang Xi, who were guarding the table.

"Don't get the eggshells in."

"Awoo."

Lin Qiu was afraid they would waste it, so he took a Red Bird egg to demonstrate first.

"See clearly?"

"Clearly." The two Wolf Orcs watched intently.

Lin Qiu: "Then you get to work."

He had to go discuss with the orc responsible for cooking today whether they could steam some dry tail-grass seeds to eat tonight.

Today's menu was also simple: a wild vegetable egg drop soup, a steamed egg, and a stir-fried smoked meat with garlic sprouts.

The tribe only had a little bit of garlic sprouts left; the orcs usually couldn't bear to eat them, but the sprouts were already wilted beyond recognition, and if they didn't eat them, they would have to be thrown away.

The variety of dishes was small, so the portion couldn't be small, otherwise, it wouldn't be enough to go around.

As soon as Lin Qiu left, the little wolves and cubs gathered around the table to join in the fun.

The eggshells were brittle, and the Wolf Orcs didn't dare to move around, afraid of accidentally cracking them.

Lang Jin squatted on the stool, hands on the table, staring at Lang Mo, "Mo, can you do it?"

Lang Mo: "Simple, watch."

He picked up an egg and, imitating Lin Qiu, carefully tapped it on the table.

Eh? It didn't break.

Lang Jin revealed a row of white teeth and laughed mockingly.

Lang Mo clicked his tongue lightly and used a bit more force.

With a 'pop'—

The eggshell shattered, and the yolk and white flowed all over the table.

The few wolves around the table panicked; some grabbed basins, some blocked the orcs. Lang Mo scooped with his palm, and the egg liquid rolled into the basin, destroying the evidence.

"So dirty!"

The orcs were quiet; they must be up to no good.

Lang An slapped Lang Jin on the forehead, grabbed the basin in disgust, and carried it out.

"Did you wash your hands?"

Lang Mo bared his teeth.

Lang An: "All of you, go wash your hands!"

"That egg—"

Lang An poured the egg liquid into a clay bowl, placed it in the fire under the stove, and before long, brought it out and threw it directly to Lang Mo.

Lang Mo, who had gained a roasted egg for nothing, grinned from ear to ear.

The other orcs were eager to try.

Lang An warned: "If you dirty another one, go eat snow later!"

The orcs laughed timidly: "No, definitely not. We aren't that stupid."

The orcs in the cave helped process the Red Bird eggs, their attitude pious, for fear of making a mistake.

Outside the cave, Lin Qiu began to prepare dinner.

He wore a fur hat, a fur coat, fur pants, fur boots on his feet, fur gloves on his hands, and a fur strip wrapped around his neck.

From head to toe, only the upper half of his face was exposed.

Lang An looked at him like this and burst into laughter.

Lin Qiu said with resentment: "The King made me wear it like this."

If he didn't wear it like this, he wouldn't let him come out.

Lang An waved his hand with a smile and said: "Like this, you tell us how to do it, and we'll do it."

Lin Qiu was going to make a new dish, and the sub-orcs were all there to watch.

Lin Qiu: "That works too."

The orcs all knew how to stir-fry and make egg drop soup; it was just a matter of steaming eggs and steaming tail-grass seeds.

Lang Shuang went to the cave to get the tail-grass seeds.

There weren't many shelled tail-grass seeds left in the cave, and if Lin Qiu wanted to eat them dry, he would have to pour out all that was left.

Lang Shuang felt heartache while also being greedy.

They had been eating this soup for more than half a year, and occasionally they wanted to change their taste.

He couldn't be ruthless, so he simply brought the jar containing the tail-grass seeds out together.

Steaming tail-grass seeds tonight had been consulted with Lang Yan and the old priest, and the sub-orcs responsible for cooking naturally agreed. As for the other orcs, they couldn't wait to eat more.

The Wolf Orcs, who were used to being frugal, felt heartache while pouring the tail-grass seeds into the basin.

Nearly a basin of tail-grass seeds, washed clean, added water to the clay pot, and then put into the steamer. The steamer was like a round bucket with small holes at the bottom, which the orcs made while making pottery.

The tail-grass seeds were poured into the steamer, and they just needed to be steamed with water vapor.

As soon as this was ready, the orcs responsible for beating the eggs in the cave also came out with the basin.

Lin Qiu asked the sub-orcs to divide the eggs into two halves; the smaller portion was for egg drop soup, and the larger portion was for steaming eggs.

With four pots left, the egg drop soup had to be cooked in two pots. The remaining two pots couldn't finish steaming the eggs at once, so it had to be done twice.

"Stir the eggs, add some salt and oil, and then add water."

Lin Qiu instructed, and the sub-orcs followed.

By the time the egg liquid was on the stove, the water in the pots was almost boiling, and the stove area was full of steaming steam; the orcs stood in it as if they were riding the clouds.

Lin Qiu stomped his feet, which were numb from the cold, and leaned close to the stove to warm himself.

"It feels cold just making a meal now."

If it weren't for the grass curtains hanging on the corridor to block the wind, no one could walk outside.

Lang An smelled the fresh fragrance of the tail-grass seeds and smiled: "It's already much better than before."

Lin Qiu rubbed his hands and leaned close to the fire to warm them.

He said casually: "It can get even better in the future."

Lang An's eyes were gentle as he looked at Lin Qiu, unable to help but touch his hair.

"Take it slow, don't let you and the King get too tired, there's still us."

Lin Qiu smiled and leaned his head against Lang An's shoulder, "I know, Uncle An~"

Lang Chi sat in the corridor watching, feeling sour in his heart.

He had been at Wolf Mountain for so long and hadn't heard the cub call him father a few times.

*

In the evening, the orcs had a good meal.

The tail-grass seed rice was fragrant and soft, the steamed eggs were smooth and tender, and the smoked meat stir-fried with garlic sprouts was salty and delicious.

The orcs imitated Lin Qiu, covering the tail-grass seed rice with the stir-fry, mixing it, and taking a big mouthful. Then they sipped the steamed egg, and with a gulp, it slid down their throats into their stomachs before they could even feel it.

Halfway through, feeling thirsty, they picked up the wild vegetable egg drop soup and took a sip...

Their pores relaxed, and their whole bodies felt warm.

Who said tail-grass seeds were hard to eat and wild vegetables were hard to eat? Why hadn't they thought of combining them like this before?

Everyone ate with their heads down.

Some orcs ate too fast, and the big cave was filled with pig-like grunting sounds.

"Hiccup—"

The orcs covered their stomachs, their faces glowing red from the meal.

It was so comfortable, their bodies felt like they were melting into the grass nests, and for a moment, it felt as if their bones had been removed; they were soft all over and didn't want to get up at all.

But the space in the heated-brick room was limited, so you had to grab it if you wanted to sleep!

Lang Qiao suppressed the urge to just sleep there, quickly washed the bowls and chopsticks, and ran straight to the heated-brick room.

The members of Lang Qiao's Hunting Team Three had a tacit understanding with him; they got up silently, left the cave calmly, and then immediately washed their bowls and chopsticks, following the captain's pace.

"Hiccup!" Lang Mo fell into the grass nest, raised one leg, circled his toes, and swayed leisurely.

"Mo, wash the bowls!" Lang Xi shouted from the side.

Lang Mo said as if slightly tipsy: "What's the rush, lie down for a while."

Lang Xi: "Lang Qiao is gone."

"Lang Qiao is gone, what does that have to do with... what!" Lang Mo scrambled up in a panic, scanned the cave, and he was really gone!

He grabbed a clay pot by the fire, poured a little warm water, and then carried the bowls and chopsticks out.

Seeing the footprints extending out into the snow toward the west, Lang Mo was so angry he scrubbed the bowls with a creaking sound!

"They beat us to it again!"

Inside the cave, Lin Qiu watched Lang Mo leave in a hurry, withdrew his gaze, and leaned against Lang Yan with some distress.

"Why does everyone want to go to the heated-brick room? If they go there, the咩咩 beasts won't have anywhere to lie down."

No matter how clean it's kept, it still has a smell, not to mention sleeping with the咩咩 beasts... and they aren't afraid of getting bugs on them.

Lang Yan was very calm, "Treat them as guards for the pen; if there's a problem with the咩咩 beasts, they'll know, isn't that just right?"

Lin Qiu: "I can only think that way."

*

"Yeah! Comfortable—"

Lang Qiao lay on the warm heated brick, his bones completely relaxed.

At his feet, Lang Yun rushed in and jumped to his spot.

Lang Qiao: "If the heated brick collapses, let's see how you explain it to Qiu!"

"Hey! It's not that easy to collapse." Lang Yun said lazily. He lay on his side facing inward, incidentally resting his hands and feet on the咩咩 beast next to him.

He patted the咩咩 beast's stomach with his claws, "Dabai, did you just eat grass too?"

The咩咩 beast chewed twice, looked at him, and suddenly lowered its head to bite Lang Yun's hair.

The little white wolf immediately rolled away, his back against Lang Qiao.

Lang Qiao lay there, motionless, preparing to sleep.

Lang Yun rested his claws on Lang Qiao's stomach and patted it; Lang Qiao gave a start and grabbed his hand to shake it off.

"Hehe." Lang Yun rubbed his claws, "Our captain's stomach is still the hardest."

Lang Qiao: "Go touch your own! Isn't that disgusting!"

Lang Yun: "If I don't touch it, I won't! I'll touch Dabai's. Dabai has gained a lot of weight recently, it's so nice to touch. It's just that it won't let me rest my legs on it, this is very bad..."

Lang Yun rolled again, smiling and moving in front of the咩咩 beast.

Lang Qiao frowned, suddenly sat up, grabbed Lang Yun by the back of his neck, and brought the orc back.

"What did you just say?"

Lang Yun was dragged over by their captain with one arm while lying on his back, looking confused: "I'm touching Dabai? Do you want me to touch yours? Oh my... pervert!"

"You're the pervert!" Lang Qiao gave him a claw, a dark light flickering in his eyes.

"You just said Dabai is fat?"

"Ye-yeah."

With such good food and drink in the snow season, how could it not gain some fat?

Not to mention they have a heated brick; this life of the咩咩 beast, tsk tsk... it's not for him to say, but it's better than them orcs!

Lang Qiao shook him off and approached Dabai.

The orcs of Hunting Team Three had been occupying the咩咩 beast's heated-brick room for two months since the beginning; they slept with the咩咩 beasts every day and had given each咩咩 beast a name.

To what extent were they familiar with the咩咩 beasts?

If a咩咩 beast attacked while they were sleeping, the Wolf Orcs could accurately pinch the咩咩 beast's horn, knowing which咩咩 beast was causing trouble with their eyes closed.

Dabai was now the leader of this group of咩咩 beasts and was the second batch of咩咩 beasts to arrive at the Wolf Tribe.

Now Dabai's stomach was big?

Whether it was really big or fake big, this was very important.

"Go, call Lang Rong and Qiu."

Lang Yun turned over, spread his belly, bent his limbs, and tilted his neck to look at Lang Qiao, "Captain, I'm asleep."

Lang Qiao punched him.

"Awoo!" The painful cry startled all the咩咩 beasts in the room, and they all raised their heads to look.

Lang Yun covered his eyes and ran out in a hurry. Running while shouting, wishing all the orcs on Wolf Mountain could hear.

"Qiu! Captain hit me! You have to stand up for me!"

"Lang Qiao hit me! He hit my eye until it swelled up! King! Qiu! You must uphold justice for me!!!"

Lang Yun rushed into the cave, rolled directly onto the ground, and began to throw a tantrum while covering his eye.

After rolling for a long time, no beastman paid him any mind.

Lang Huo, who was closest to him, twitched his ears impatiently, pulled a wooden stick from under his grass nest, and threw it at Lang Yun.

"Ow!" Lang Yun cried out in pain.

"You're too noisy!" Lang Huo stared at him coldly.

Lang Yun covered his mouth.

Lin Qiu sat up from the grass nest and asked, "What did you do?"

Lang Yun: "Da Bai ate too much, its belly seems to have gotten bigger, the captain asked me to call you and Lang Rong over, I didn't want to come, so he hit me..."

Lin Qiu stood up with a start, Lang Yan followed closely behind, and the two beastmen hurried out of the cave.

Lang Yun sat on the ground, watching Lang An and the priest also walk out, and he looked up and said: "An, Da Bai is fine, it just ate too much."

He slept with Da Bai every day, so he knew Da Bai's body best.

It ate well and was perfectly fine!

The old priest tapped his shoulder with his wooden staff, "Don't block the way."

"Oh..." Lang Yun moved to the side, then watched as most of the beastmen in the cave came out.

He scratched his head, "No, it's really fine! Hey! I was howling because Lang Qiao hit me, not because of the sheep-beast..."

"Idiot!" A mocking voice came from beside him.

Lang Yun looked over; it was Lang Huo again.

He didn't dare to curse back; he couldn't beat him...

Lang Huo stood up, "The sheep-beast might have cubs."

"Ah?"

"I didn't! It's not mine!"

Lang Huo stumbled, nearly falling over the edge of the grass nest. He clenched his fists until they creaked; how could there be such a stupid wolf!

*

When Lin Qiu arrived at the sheep-beast house, Lang Rong had already gone ahead.

He and Lang Qiao were squatting next to a larger sheep-beast, carefully observing its belly.

"Rong, Qiao."

"Qiu!" Lang Rong stood up and said, looking a bit excited, "Da Bai doesn't look like it just got fat..."

Lin Qiu: "It's really pregnant!"

Lang Rong: "I thought Da Bai had just gained weight at first, but it doesn't feel like it when I touch it."

"Let me see." The priest was carried in on Lang Mo's back and placed directly by the heated bed.

Lang Rong held Da Bai's head, blocking its line of sight with his body.

The priest only glanced at the sheep-beast's belly, then placed his palm on it. After a while, he confirmed: "It has cubs."

Lin Qiu immediately stood up and said: "Let's check the other sheep-beasts."

It was almost dark, the room was already dim, and the wolf beastmen from the big cave had blocked the doors and windows, so there wasn't a sliver of light inside.

They had been too busy and forgotten; Lin Qiu quickly lit the oil lamp and asked Lang Qiao and the others to bring the sheep-beasts over one by one.

Da Bai's belly was obvious, and when touched by hand, one could even feel the cubs moving inside.

The other sheep-beasts' bellies were not as obvious. Lin Qiu couldn't tell with the naked eye, so he observed their nipples, but couldn't see anything after looking back and forth.

He tentatively held the sheep-beast's belly and touched it gently, when suddenly, his palm brushed against something hard.

Lin Qiu thought he had touched it wrong, so he probed back and forth again.

"Qiu? Is there anything?" Lang Qiao couldn't help but ask in a low voice.

Lin Qiu smoothed the sheep-beast's back fur, not daring to be certain. He said: "Drive this one to the side, and bring another sheep-beast over."

Lin Qiu repeated the action, finished touching all the sheep-beasts, and looking at the few sheep-beasts driven to one side, he was basically certain.

But he still didn't dare to say it.

"Priest, you take a look again."

The old priest looked at the four separated sheep-beasts, first with his eyes, then by placing one hand on the sheep-beast's belly.

This didn't allow him to feel much.

The old priest gave his wooden staff to Lang Bing, then, like Lin Qiu, spread both hands and placed them on the sheep-beast's belly.

He paused, "There are indeed cubs."

The old beastman was calm, checked the other two, and confirmed: "That's right, they are all carrying cubs."

Lang Rong: "Priest, how did you tell?"

Lin Qiu asked: "Rong, has their appetite changed?"

The little wolf hurriedly checked his records. He didn't know until he looked; compared to previous records, the food intake of these separated sheep-beasts was significantly higher than before.

"Yes! It's increased!"

Lin Qiu: "That's it then."

Pregnant female beasts will have an increased appetite.

Lin Qiu took the little wolf's records to look through, while Lang Rong stared blankly at the priest, wanting to know how he had figured it out.

He and Lang Qiao and the others lived almost with the sheep-beasts, and apart from noticing Da Bai was a bit fatter, they hadn't discovered anything else.

The old priest said: "Try touching it like Qiu just did, spread your hands like you're holding a cub, don't use too much force."

Lang Rong coaxed the lying-down sheep-beast to stand up, had Lang Qiao help hold its head, and cautiously imitated Lin Qiu's movements.

"There is!" He was startled.

"What is it?" Lang Qiao asked curiously.

Lang Rong: "A hard thing."

Lang Qiao: "Let me try."

Lang Rong moved aside and stood by, watching the sheep-beast's belly. Although the change in the belly wasn't obvious, one could feel the difference if touched carefully.

Lang Rong turned around and tried with the other sheep-beasts.

It was different; the bellies of the pregnant sheep-beasts were easy to feel. That hard thing inside should be the cubs that hadn't grown up yet.

All the sheep-beasts were in the room, so not many beastmen could fit in.

Lang An and Lang Yan had already finished tentatively touching the sheep-beasts' bellies, and both beastmen were stunned.

"King, do all four have cubs?"

Lang Yan nodded.

"An, does that mean one sheep-beast has two cubs, and we'll have eight more cubs after the snow season!"

"Wow! Can we eat two sheep-beasts now then!"

The room was warm, and the beastmen who couldn't get in gathered at the door and windows, their eyes brighter than the oil lamps.

Lang Chi stood at the door, looking at the room full of live sheep-beasts.

And this was during the snow season!

All beastmen knew that it was almost impossible to eat live prey during the snow season.

Let alone the fact that the sheep-beasts now had cubs...

Lang Chi's hands trembled slightly.

Lang An scolded: "What kind of daydream are you having!"

Lang An stood next to Lin Qiu, looking at Lin Qiu's face under the oil lamp.

He was thinking deeper.

The red birds were small; Qiu had raised them, and they could lay eggs. The beastmen were just happy about having a little more meat in the future.

But if the sheep-beasts could successfully reproduce in their breeding environment and be raised to a certain scale, they might not even need to go out hunting in the future; just by farming the sheep-beasts, they would be able to fill their bellies.

Sheep-beasts were medium-sized and were their main targets for hunting during the rainy season.

Red birds were like a side dish, then sheep-beasts were the staple food!

Just thinking about being able to eat their fill without hunting gave Lang An goosebumps.

Such days, he feared, only the Beast God had experienced.

The beastmen didn't dare to be negligent and checked a few more times. Only when the sheep-beasts became impatient and butted them with their horns did the beastmen wake up from their dazed state.

The beastmen outside also seemed not to feel the cold, staring at the sheep-beasts and swallowing hard.

"Alright, don't disturb them." The priest drove the people away and walked out leaning on his cane.

The beastmen outside were blocking the door and were reluctant to leave.

The old priest raised his wooden staff to poke the beastmen, "Blocking the way, move! Hurry back to the cave, aren't you cold staying outside?"

Lang Chou, who was poked, said honestly: "Not cold, Priest."

"Yeah, not cold..."

The beastmen touched their own faces; it wasn't cold in the front, but it was cold on their backs.

Everyone was puzzled at first, then their eyes lit up, staring at the heated bed that the sheep-beasts were slowly crawling all over!

"I want to go in!"

"I'm sleeping on this side!"

"No, this is our spot!"

Lang Qiao saw the beastmen squeezing in and immediately rolled onto the heated bed. He had slept in this nest for two months; he couldn't give it up!

The room was in chaos, and even the priest couldn't get out.

Lang Yan frowned, walked to the door, and waved his hand—

"Ow!"

A group of beastmen at the door covered their heads and started yelling.

Seeing this, Lin Qiu pursed his lips and turned his head to smile.

Lang Yan: "What are you squeezing for?"

"King! Look at how long Lang Qiao and the others have been sleeping here, we want to sleep here too!"

"Yes, King, tell Qiao and the others to go back to the cave, it's our turn!"

Lin Qiu also looked at their King.

Lang Yan turned back, and Lang Qiao had already curled up in the pile of sheep-beasts, saying righteously: "We've slept with the sheep-beasts for a long time, they are already familiar with us, and we are familiar with them. Can you tell if the sheep-beasts' bellies have grown or not?"

"Exactly, exactly!" Lang Yun echoed from outside the door, squeezing in.

The beastman in front slapped him on the face and pushed him back.

They couldn't get those who were already inside out, but couldn't they stop those who hadn't entered yet?

"Captain! Look at them!" Lang Yun grabbed the beastman's hand and howled.

"King, this isn't fair!" The beastmen blocking the window also tried to climb in.

Lang An stood by with his arms crossed, looking on with disdain.

The old priest simply sat down on the heated bed, placing his palms on the surface, and felt comfortable too.

He was old, and sometimes he felt cold sleeping in a grass nest alone; this bed was quite good, warm.

Lin Qiu saw the beastmen at a stalemate and walked up to the cold-faced Wolf King beside them.

"King, I'm sleepy."

Lang Yan held Lin Qiu's hand, looking at the shouting beastmen, his head aching.

"Alright! After the snow season, the tribe will build more houses, and they will be distributed to beastmen with partners first."

"Ow!!"

"Ah?" The beastmen were happy halfway, then looked dejected.

"King, what about those of us without partners?"

Lang Yan said coldly: "More houses for raising sheep-beasts will be built, anyway, if you don't mind, just make do with the sheep-beasts for now."

"Ow!" The beastmen were happy.

Although there were no independent houses, they knew that the tribe needed more beastmen and cubs, so prioritizing beastmen with partners was normal.

"King! Our tribe doesn't have that many sub-beastmen and female beastmen! What about those who want to find partners?"

"Yeah, what about that?" Lin Qiu looked at Lang Yan.

There were many single beastmen in the tribe of appropriate age, but there weren't many sub-beastmen and female beastmen to begin with, making it hard for beastmen to find partners.

Lang Yan: "I'll think about it."

"I don't want to find a Black Feather beastman!"

"I don't want a White Sparrow either!"

"King, aren't there any other wolf beastmen?"

Lin Qiu also racked his brains, but apart from knowing the neighbors around the Wolf Tribe, he knew nothing about other tribes, so how would he know about any other wolf beastmen?

Lang Yan: "I'll think."

The beastmen nodded obediently; if the King thought about it, he would definitely come up with a solution.

Which beastman didn't want to find a partner? They wanted to be assigned houses too.

Now the beastmen stopped blocking the door, and the priest, who had been sitting in the room for a while, was helped out by Lang Bing.

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan lagged behind, giving a few instructions to Lang Qiao and the others to be careful when sleeping so as not to crush the sheep-beasts, before leaving with Lang Yan.

Once out of the room with the heated bed and back outside, Lin Qiu felt the weather was even colder.

He buried his head and walked forward quickly.

Lang Yan always stood beside him, blocking the wind for him.

Upon entering the big cave, the beastmen were required to wash their hands clean.

Lang Chi didn't go straight back to where they slept but followed them into the big cave. Seeing that Lang Chi had something to say, Lang Yan went straight to sit at the table by the fire.

Seeing this, the old priest came over leaning on his cane.

Lang Chi sat down, his hands gripping his knees tightened, and he couldn't help but say: "King, Priest, I just wanted to ask... at this rate, can the branch tribe come back?"

Having stayed at Wolf Mountain for more than two months, Lang Chi had personally experienced the extent to which Wolf Mountain had developed.

Although the branch tribe was supported by Wolf Mountain, and the branch tribe occasionally sent supplies that weren't available here, the two sides were ultimately different.

Whenever Lang Chi thought about how the beastmen of the branch tribe were satisfied with just holding dried fish to eat, while he himself could choose from a variety of foods here at Wolf Mountain, he couldn't swallow his food.

They were one tribe.

Lang Chi had always believed so.

Although he was currently leading the branch tribe, he wanted the Wolf Tribe to be whole again, to be restored to the scale of beastmen it had in its heyday, more than any other beastman.

Lang Chi hoped that Lang Yan could now be like the old Wolf King, leading the entire Wolf Tribe, not just a tribe with only half the beastmen.

The leaders of the tribes were discussing major matters.

The beastmen in the cave quieted down. Lang Ye and the members of his squad were also sitting not far away, full of anticipation.

Everyone listened carefully, their hearts surging at the thought of the tribe becoming one. They didn't dare to speak, but the sound of claws scratching the grass nests rang out one after another.

Lang Yan looked at the beastmen with graying temples and eyes full of hope, and the excessive explanation stopped in his mouth.

Finally, he said: "Uncle Chi, by the snow season next year at the latest."

The Wolf King's voice was deep; it was a promise and a guarantee.

Lang Chi's hand trembled, and he gripped his knees tightly.

He could barely control the joy in his heart, yet he forcibly endured it, his teeth even chattering slightly.

"Good... good! Next snow season, next snow season..."

The beastman gritted his teeth, his eyes turning red instantly.

He couldn't form complete sentences, and by the end, he was choking with emotion.

Having lived for more than half his life and been the leader of the branch tribe for over a dozen years, Lang Chi restrained himself with all his might so as not to lose his composure in front of the young Wolf King and the juniors.

The young beastmen were different; Lang Ye jumped up and cheered, the little wolves crawled around in the cave, and Lang Mo opened his arms to hug Lang Xi tightly, raising his neck and howling...

The big cave was filled with wild howling.

The cubs who had already fallen asleep behind the corner were startled awake by the beastmen.

Lang Guo was so angry he ran out and started scolding: "What are you yelling for? Can't we sleep anymore?! The cubs have all been woken up, if you have the ability, you come and coax them!"

Lang Guo had been watching the cubs and hadn't followed them out, so he didn't know about the sheep-beasts having cubs.

After a round of scolding, the beastmen didn't stop, but instead rushed over and picked up the woken cubs, spinning around in circles.

Lang Guo: "...Are you sick!"

"Ow?" The cubs who hadn't transformed into human form were held by the adult beastmen, their claws against the beastmen's faces, their eyes wet and filled with confusion.

The beastmen held the cubs high and said: "It's no big deal, just that those uncles and grandpas of yours from the branch tribe are coming back! From now on, our Wolf Tribe beastmen will be together, and we won't be afraid of anyone!"

Lang Guo's exploding anger was instantly extinguished.

Lang Guo: "The branch tribe is coming back?"

Lang Ye ran to his side, opened his arms, and spun Lang Guo around in a big circle by his waist.

"Guo! You wait for me to come back!"

Lang Guo was startled, grabbed Lang Ye's fur clothes with both hands, and subconsciously looked at the other beastmen.

Seeing Lin Qiu supporting his chin and watching them with a smile, he hurriedly patted Lang Ye's arm and said in a low, urgent voice: "Put me down!"

Lang Ye realized he had lost his composure and, as if holding a piece of pottery fresh out of the kiln, carefully put Lang Guo down.

He wiped his hands on his fur clothes and stood in front of Lang Guo, looking cool and handsome.

Lang Guo: "Go play by yourself."

After saying that, Lang Guo sat down beside Lin Qiu with a calm demeanor.

Lin Qiu: "When the houses are built, I'll definitely assign one to you two."

Lang Guo rolled his eyes, "I'm not sharing a nest with him."

Lin Qiu smiled without a word.

Although Lang Guo disliked Lang Ye, his body didn't reject his closeness; as an observer, Lin Qiu could still see a thing or two.

*

The cave was lively for a long time, and even the rabbit beastmen came to ask.

The wolf beastmen grabbed them to play for a while, but the rabbit beastmen couldn't handle the excitement and quickly slipped away.

The cubs were treated as toys by the wolf beastmen, passed from one beastman to another, until their heads were spinning, they were walking unsteadily, and they lay on the ground whimpering.

Seeing this, Lang Guo glared fiercely at the adult beastmen and told them to put the cubs back in the grass nests.

It was getting late, so Lang Guo went back to the grass nest to coax the cubs to sleep.

Lang Ye, who had been secretly watching him, saw him disappear around the corner and couldn't help but move forward a few steps, then retreated.

He sat up straight, looking at the King and the others, his claws scratching the ground unconsciously.

They were coming back!

Near the wooden table outside the cave, Lang Chi had adjusted himself; he was solemn, with joy on his face, and looked at Lang Yan: "Then I will wait for the notification from Wolf Mountain with the branch tribe."

Lang Yan: "Good."

Lang Chi smiled, then saw his own cub sitting next to Lang Yan, his lips moved, but in the end, he said nothing.

His cub was capable now.

He was very gratified that he could do things for the tribe.

After he left Wolf Mountain after the snow season, his cub definitely wouldn't go with him. Staying at Wolf Mountain was also good; they would be reunited soon.

Lang Chi and Lang Ye and the others left the big cave to go to their cave to sleep.

The priest sat on the stool and didn't leave, his weathered eyes looking at Lang Yan, saying: "King, the red birds and sheep-beasts have only been raised for less than half a year..."

Things weren't certain yet; he had originally discussed waiting and seeing with Lang Yan.

It wasn't that he didn't want the branch tribe to come back, but once the farming matter didn't meet their expectations, if those hundred or so beastmen from the branch tribe returned, everyone would have to go hungry together.

Lang Yan: "Priest, they can't hold out for too long over there."

When Lang Huo came back, he had said that they couldn't find any prey over there.

If they came back, it couldn't be worse than it was now.

The hand of the old priest holding his cane stiffened slightly. After a long time, he sighed: "You are the King of the Wolf Tribe, as long as you have thought it through... the beastmen of the branch tribe, indeed, should come back."

*

"Are the beastmen who left the Wolf Tribe really coming back?" In the cave where the Black Feather beastmen lived, Yu Shan sat in a grass nest and asked Yu Le, who had returned with the ointment.

Yu Le nodded and said in a low voice: "That's what the wolf beastmen said."

The little beastman had lost so much weight because of his grandfather's affair that his cheeks were slightly sunken, his chin was just a layer of skin, looking exceptionally sharp, and his eyes were abnormally large.

He squatted in front of Yu Shan and skillfully removed the linen cloth from his wound to reapply the medicine.

Yu Shan's gaze fell, looking at the top of Yu Le's head.

The little beastman's hair used to be dry and yellow, but not as sparse as it was now. He subconsciously smoothed the little beastman's hair, but saw quite a few strands caught between his fingers.

Yu Shan was startled, and when Yu Le looked over, he clenched his fist and hid his hand in the grass nest.

It was his negligence.

If Yu Qian were here, he would definitely have noticed the change in Yu Le.

Yu Shan moved his lips, finally sighed in his heart, and just gently patted Yu Le's shoulder: "Are you used to it here?"

"Used to it, Lang Bing and the others are very good to me." Yu Le didn't look up, diligently applying medicine to Yu Shan's wound.

Yu Shan's throat felt blocked, fearing he would bring up the little beastman's sad affairs again, he could only restrain himself: "As long as you're used to it, learn seriously from Lang Bing, but don't force yourself if you're tired, rest when you should."

Yu Le tore off another piece of linen, then looked up at Yu Shan and smiled.

He still smiled shyly, but the corners of his eyes drooped, not looking very happy.

He said: "Uncle Shan, I will learn well, don't worry."

Yu Shan rubbed the hair in his hand and couldn't help but say: "I mean, don't get tired."

Yu Le lowered his head, the corners of his mouth that he had barely managed to lift straightened, and he said obediently: "I know, Uncle Shan."

Yu Shan: "As long as you know."

He couldn't say much else.

If only his partner were here. Yu Qian was a sub-beastman, softer in heart, and would know how to comfort the little beastman.

Yu Le was only fourteen; they had hoped the little beastman would become strong, but now, they didn't want to see him like this.

No matter how well he endured, if his body was hurt, that was not what they wanted to see.

"Uncle Shan, isn't it good that they are coming back?"

Yu Shan's drifting thoughts were pulled back by Yu Le's words. He paused and said: "It's a good thing."

But for the Black Feather beastmen, it might not be.

With more of the Wolf Tribe's own beastmen, where would they be needed to work in the future? If the Black Feather beastmen wanted to exchange things with the Wolf Tribe, what would they use to exchange?

Yu Le felt that Yu Shan's mood was a bit low. He squatted by the grass nest, a small ball, a head shorter than a normal thirteen or fourteen-year-old little beastman.

He couldn't help but ask: "Uncle Shan, aren't you happy?"

Yu Shan: "No."

"Yes, I can feel it." Yu Le looked at him with big eyes, and Yu Shan felt as if he had been seen through.

Yu Shan: "You are still young..."

"I'm not young anymore." Yu Le said with some urgency, "I am... I am the tribe's priest, although I can't do what a priest should do yet, I will learn well. I want to know about the tribe's affairs too."

Yu Shan looked at him.

Yu Le tightened his grip on the medicine jar, not retreating.

Yu Shan didn't want to force him, but without him noticing, the little beastman had already forced himself to grow up.

It was just the day the old patriarch left, just those few days when the little beastman was sick, that he had grown up.

Yu Shan felt a faint prick of pain in his heart, his breathing even trembling.

He gripped those soft strands of hair tightly, and under such clean and firm eyes, he didn't use the adult beastman's way to fool the little beastman again.

He laid it out and said to Yu Le: "It's just not certain whether the Wolf Tribe will still be willing to exchange things with us after the beastmen of their branch tribe return."

They had nothing to offer for exchange; they had no prey, no animal skins. Could it be that once they repaid the Wolf Tribe's kindness, the two sides would stop interacting?

Thinking about the previous interactions, weren't they all because they needed to exchange things?

Yu Le: "The Wolf King said that the beastmen of the branch tribe won't be back until the snow season."

In the grass nest at the very back of the cave, Yu Hua was woken up by the buzzing conversation. He opened his eyes and saw Yu Shan's miserable look, and couldn't help but sneer.

"Don't always think about relying on exchanging with the Wolf Tribe for everything, otherwise you're finished."

"What do you know." Yu Shan said.

Yu Hua: "Yes, yes, you know a lot, you are the patriarch."

"Uncle Shan, Uncle Hua, don't argue." Yu Le said in a low voice, sandwiched between them.

Yu Hua: "This isn't called arguing."

Yu Shan looked at the anxious little beastman in front of him, suppressed the worry in his heart, and smiled gently: "Right, I'm not arguing with Uncle Hua, we just talk like this."

Having fought for so many years, they couldn't change their way of speaking for a while.

Compared to before, this was considered gentle now.

Yu Le looked at the two beastmen, confirmed they weren't red-faced, and then took the ointment to change the medicine for the other beastmen.

"It's useless for you to think so much now, you'd better think about what to do when the Wilderness Tribe sends beastmen next time."

Yu Hua's words made Yu Shan's face even heavier.

Seeing this, Yu Hua laughed in anger.

He couldn't stand Yu Shan's dead look, as if he had a few big stones in his heart every day! It was as if only he was worried about the tribe's affairs, as if no one else had considered the tribe!

Yu Hua: "Otherwise, let's just defect to the Wolf Tribe."

Yu Shan: "You think too beautifully, burdened with the Wilderness Tribe, and don't even look at whether the Wolf Tribe likes you or not."

Yu Hua: "Oh... it seems you haven't thought about it. So what if I think beautifully? It's still more comfortable than you looking like a pot bottom every day."

Yu Le: "Uncle Hua, Uncle Shan..."

Yu Hua waved his hand, "Not arguing, not arguing, this is just normal talking."

This little beastman too, he used to be timid and didn't dare to say two words, how did he change so much after the old beastman left, and even started managing them.

Yu Shan curled up in the nest and ignored Yu Hua, he had to think carefully about how to get through this hurdle.

*

A month later, the Black Feather beastmen's wounds had healed.

After the priest checked and confirmed that the beastmen were fine, Yu Shan and the others planned to return to the tribe.

This time when they left, they would take Yu Hua with them, leaving only Yu Le here to continue following Lang Bing to learn how to identify herbs.

Before leaving, Yu Shan went to say goodbye to the wolf beastmen.

It was morning, and the beastmen had just finished eating wild vegetable egg drop soup and dried salted fish, and were still lazily sitting under the corridor and hadn't left.

Yu Shan came over with eight Black Feather beastmen.

Yu Hua followed slowly behind, leaning on a cane made by Lang Qi.

The floor of the corridor was raised a bit, and Yu Hua had trouble getting up with his cane, so the wolf beastmen at the entrance reached out to help him.

Yu Hua spread his arms, letting two wolf beastmen support his arms and put him up. After thanking them, Yu Hua continued to walk inside with his cane.

Inside the corridor, the line of Black Feather beastmen had already stopped.

"Yan." Yu Shan said.

Lang Yan nodded, signaling them to sit.

Lin Qiu woke up late and hadn't finished his breakfast yet. Lang Yan sat beside him, guarding him, and incidentally finished the dried salted fish his partner couldn't finish.

Lin Qiu glanced at the Black Feather beastmen and put down his chopsticks. Seeing that he had eaten enough, Lang Yan moved the bowl and chopsticks aside.

The little wolf ran over happily, diligently holding the bowl and chopsticks to wash them.

Tomorrow morning he wanted to eat boiled red bird eggs!

The little wolf who didn't grab the job looked on sourly, having lost an opportunity to eat boiled eggs!

The tribe's red bird eggs were limited, the cubs ate them, and the little wolves had to eat them too. There was no way, Lang An had come up with this idea.

Lin Qiu knew they were leaving and instructed: "The priest said that you can fly now, but the location of the wounds must be protected and cannot be exposed to the cold."

Yu Shan: "Qiu, we know."

Yu Shan looked at Lang Yan again and said: "After the snow season, the twenty curved-horn beasts we promised will be sent over one after another. The beastmen who will work for you will also come, you just arrange them."

Lang Yan nodded.

"Then we're leaving, thank you for these days..."

"Wait." Lang Yan looked at the sturdier Black Feather man in front of him and said, "There is one more thing, I would like to ask for your help."

Yu Hua held his cane, and when he heard Lang Yan say he wanted to ask their beastmen to help train the wolf beastmen, he thought for a moment and curled his lips.

The Wolf King really knew how to take advantage.

Knowing what they were saying now, the Black Feather beastmen wouldn't refuse.

Yu Shan thought for a while and really agreed.

"The snow season is the freest, training is best at this time." Lang Yan said.

The wolf beastmen heard this, their eyes bulging, their faces full of confusion.

Training?

What training?

Yu Shan intended to leave the two Black Feather beastmen who had been taking care of the patients at Wolf Mountain, and Lang Yan added: "It's best if they are good at fighting."

Yu Shan stared at Lang Yan, silent for a moment.

Lang Yan: "I think Yu Lie is good, but he is one beastman, a bit too few."

Yu Shan: "..."

He really wanted to roll his eyes at the Wolf King; why didn't he ask for dozens of Black Feather beastmen in one breath?

Yu Shan: "When I go back, I will arrange ten more beastmen to come over."

Lang Yan was barely satisfied, his hand under the table gently touching Lin Qiu.

Lin Qiu understood and took out the herbs that the tribe had prepared in advance and placed them on the table.

"This is the medicine that can be used during the snow season, there is the ointment that you applied to the wounds to help healing before, and there are also pills to drive away the cold, you can also eat some before you go back."

The corners of Yu Hua's mouth, which were turned down, slowly recovered.

Still had a conscience.

Yu Shan took it, feeling a bit more balanced, and said: "I will carefully select the beastmen."

Lang Yan stood up, his gaze swept through the beastmen, and not seeing who he wanted to see, he tilted his chin at Lang Shi and said: "Shi, call the White Sparrow beastman out."

Yu Shan's body stiffened, and the next moment, he heard Lang Yan say: "It will also trouble you to send the White Sparrow beastman back."

Yu Hua's mouth turned into a hook.

Sure enough, there was no free benefit.

"Go back?" There was a trace of confusion in Que Erbai's bean-like eyes.

Yu Hua: "You've been cheating food and drink in the Wolf Tribe for so long that you've forgotten your own tribe."

Que Erbai realized belatedly that they were still in the Wolf Tribe.

He stretched his wings embarrassedly, looked down at his feet... and found that his round belly was blocking his claws.

He burped, and a smell of egg soup and dried salted fish came out.

Que Erbai hurriedly put down his wings to cover his belly, his face under the feathers blushing.

It seemed, it was time to go back.
