“狼乔打我！把我眼睛打肿了！王！楸！你们要为我做主啊！！！”
狼云冲进山洞，直接往地上一滚，捂着眼睛开始耍赖。
滚了半天，没兽人理他。
靠他最近的狼火不耐烦地动了动耳朵，抽出草窝底下的木棍冲着狼云砸过去。
“嗷！”狼云痛呼。
“吵死了！”狼火冷飕飕盯着他。
狼云捂嘴。
林楸从草窝里坐起来，问：“你干什么了？”
狼云：“大白吃多了，肚子好像变大了，队长让我叫你和狼溶过去，我不想来，他就打我……”
林楸噌地一下站起来，狼岩紧随其后，两个兽人匆匆离开山洞。
狼云坐在地上，看着狼安跟祭司也走了出来，他仰头道：“安，大白没事，就是吃多了。”
他天天抱着大白睡觉，大白的身体他最知道。
吃嘛嘛香，一点没事！
老祭司抓着木杖往他肩膀上敲了一下，“别挡路。”
“哦……”狼云往旁边挪了挪，然后看着洞内兽人出来大半。
他挠了挠头，“不是，真没事！诶！我嚎的是狼乔打我，不是咩咩兽……”
“蠢蛋！”旁边落下一声嘲讽。
狼云一看，又是狼火。
他不敢骂回去，打不过……
狼火起身，“咩咩兽可能有崽了。”
“啊？”
“我没有！不是我的！”
狼火一个踉跄，差点栽在草窝边。他拳头捏着咯吱响，怎么会有这么蠢的狼！
*
林楸到了咩咩兽屋时，狼溶已经先过去了。
他跟狼乔蹲在体型较大的一头咩咩兽旁边，小心翼翼看着咩咩兽的肚子。
“溶，乔。”
“楸！”狼溶站起来道，他有些激动，“大白看着不像是胖了……”
林楸：“真怀崽了！”
狼溶：“我开始也以为大白长肉了，但摸着不像。”
“我看看。”祭司被狼莫背着进来，直接放到火炕边。
狼溶抱住大白的脑袋，身体挡住它视线。
祭司只看了眼咩咩兽肚子，又掌心贴上去，过了会儿，他肯定道：“有崽了。”
林楸顿时站起来道：“再看看其他咩咩兽。”
天快黑尽了，屋里本来就暗，大山洞过来的狼兽人又把门跟窗户堵了，里头不见一点光。
也是忙忘了，林楸赶紧把油灯点亮，让狼乔他们把咩咩兽一头一头抓过来。
大白的肚子明显，手摸上去，甚至能摸到里面幼崽在动。
其他咩咩兽肚子就不明显了，林楸肉眼看不太出来，又观察咩咩兽乳头，看来看去也没看出个什么。
他试探着抱着咩咩兽肚子轻轻摸，忽的，手心擦过一点硬硬的东西。
林楸以为摸错了，又来回试探着摸了摸。
“楸？有吗？”狼乔忍不住放轻声音问。
林楸顺了顺咩咩兽的背毛，没敢确定，他道：“这个赶到一边，再赶一头咩咩兽过来。”
林楸重复动作，将所有咩咩兽摸完，看着被赶到一处的几头咩咩兽，基本上已经确定。
但他还不敢说。
“祭司，你再看看。”
老祭司看着分出来的四头咩咩兽，先用眼睛看，再单手贴着咩咩兽肚子。
这样并不能感受出什么。
老祭司把木杖给狼冰，再像林楸那样双手张开贴着咩咩兽肚子。
他一顿，“是有幼崽了。”
老兽人镇定，又检查了另外两头，确定道：“没错，都是带崽的。”
狼溶：“祭司，你们怎么看的？”
林楸问：“溶，他们食量有没有变化？”
小狼赶紧翻看他的记录，不看不知道，对比以前的记录，被分出来的这几头咩咩兽的采食量明显比以前多了。
“有！多了！”
林楸：“这就对了。”
怀崽的母兽食量会增大。
林楸拿过小狼的记录翻看，狼溶呆呆看着祭司，想知道怎么看出来的。
他跟狼乔他们几乎跟咩咩兽住在一起，除了发现大白胖了一点，其他什么都没发现。
老祭司道：“你像楸刚刚那样摸着试一试，手像抱幼崽一样张开，不要太用力。”
狼溶哄着趴下的咩咩兽站起来，让狼乔帮忙抓住它脑袋，谨慎地学着刚刚林楸的动作。
“有！”他一惊。
“有什么？”狼乔也好奇问。
狼溶：“一个硬硬的东西。”
狼乔：“我试试。”
狼溶让开，站在一旁看着咩咩兽的肚子。肚子上的变化虽不明显，但细细一摸就能感觉到不同。
狼溶转过身，又找了另外的咩咩兽试。
不一样，怀崽的咩咩兽肚子很容易摸出来。那硬硬的东西里面应该就是还没长大的幼崽。
屋里咩咩兽都在，挤不进来几个兽人。
狼安跟狼岩已经各自试探着摸完了咩咩兽的肚子，两个兽人都是一怔。
“王，四头都有崽啊？”
狼岩颔首。
“安，是不是一头咩咩兽有两个幼崽，然后我们雪季后就能多八只幼崽！”
“哇！那我们是不是可以现在吃两头咩咩兽！”
屋子里暖和，兽人进不去的就聚在门口跟窗户，眼睛比油灯还亮。
狼赤立在门口，看着一屋子的活的咩咩兽。
这还是在雪季！
兽人都知道，在雪季几乎不可能吃到活着的猎物。
更何况现在咩咩兽还有崽了……
狼赤手有些颤抖。
狼安斥道：“做什么美梦呢！”
狼安站在林楸旁边，看着油灯下林楸的脸。
他想得更深。
红鸟体型小，楸把红鸟养大了，也能生蛋了，兽人们只是高兴以后多添了一点肉。
但咩咩兽如果能在他们饲养的环境中成功繁衍，养到一定规模，以后他们甚至不用外出捕猎，只圈养着咩咩兽就能够填饱肚子。
咩咩兽体型中等，是他们雨季捕猎的主要对象。
红鸟相当于配菜，那咩咩兽就是主食！
只要一想到不用捕猎就能吃饱，狼安身上起了一层鸡皮疙瘩。
那样的日子，怕是只有兽神才体会过。
兽人们不敢疏忽，来来回回又检查了几遍。直把咩咩兽弄得不耐烦了，用角撞他们，兽人才从这晕乎乎的状态中醒神。
外面的兽人也像不知道冷似的，看着咩咩兽，狠狠咽了咽口水。
“行了，别打扰它们了。”祭司赶人，自己也杵着拐往外走。
外面兽人堵在门口，都不舍得离开。
老祭司抬起木杖戳兽人，“挡路了，让开！赶紧回山洞，待在外面不冷？”
被戳中的狼丑实诚道：“不冷，祭司。”
“对啊，不冷诶……”
兽人们摸摸自己的脸，前面不冷，后背冷。
大伙儿先是古怪，随后眼睛一亮，盯着那慢慢爬满咩咩兽的火炕！
“我要进去！”
“我睡这边！”
“不行，这是我们的位置！”
狼乔看兽人往里挤，立即往火炕上一滚。他睡了两个月的窝，不能让！
屋里一团乱，祭司都出不去了。
狼岩皱眉，走到门口，手一扬——
“嗷！”
门口一片兽人捂住头开始叫。
林楸见状，抿着唇别开头笑。
狼岩：“挤什么？”
“王！你看狼乔他们都在这边睡了多久了，我们也想睡！”
“对，王，你让乔他们回山洞去，该轮到我们了！”
林楸也看着他们王。
狼岩回头，狼乔已经缩进去咩咩兽堆里，理直气壮道：“我们跟咩咩兽睡得久，它们已经熟悉我们，我们也熟悉它们了。你们看得出咩咩兽肚子大没大吗？”
“就是就是！”门外狼云应着，往里挤。
前头兽人一巴掌拍在他脸上，将他往后推。
已经进去的他们弄不出来，还没进去的还挡不住吗？
“队长！你看他们！”狼云抓着兽人手嗷嗷叫。
“王，这样不公平！”堵窗的兽人也试图翻进来。
狼安抱臂在一旁看着，眼神嫌弃。
老祭司索性在炕上坐下，手掌贴着炕面，也觉得舒服。
他年纪大了，一个兽人睡草窝里有时候总觉得冷飕飕的，这炕挺好，暖和。
林楸看兽人僵持，走上前，挨着他们冷脸的狼王。
“王，我困了。”
狼岩握住林楸的手，看着张嘴叫唤的兽人们，脑仁疼。
“行了！等雪季过后，部落里会再修些房子出来，到时候先分配给有伴侣的兽人。”
“嗷！！”
“啊？”兽人开心到一半，又丧眉搭眼。
“王，那我们没有伴侣的怎么办？”
狼岩冷漠道：“还会再建几个养咩咩兽的屋子，反正你们不嫌弃，先跟着咩咩兽将就着。”
“嗷！”兽人开心了。
虽然没有独立的屋子，但想也知道，部落需要更多的兽人，需要幼崽，优先有伴侣的兽人很正常。
“王！咱们部落没那么多亚兽人跟雌性兽人啊！那想找伴侣的怎么办？”
“对啊，怎么办？”林楸看着狼岩。
部落年龄合适却单身的兽人不少，可亚兽人跟雌性兽人本就不多，兽人想找伴侣都难。
狼岩：“附近邻居……”
“我才不找黑羽兽人！”
“也不找白雀！”
“王，就没有狼兽人了吗？”
林楸也绞尽脑汁想，但他除了知道狼部落周围一圈的邻居，对其他部落一点不了解，哪里知道什么其他狼兽人。
狼岩：“我想想。”
兽人们乖乖点头，王想想那就一定想得出办法来。
哪个兽人不想找伴侣？他们也想分房子呢。
这下兽人不堵门了，屋里坐了一会儿的祭司被狼冰搀扶着出去。
林楸跟狼岩落在后面，叮嘱了几句狼乔他们睡觉的时候小心点，别把咩咩兽压到，随后才跟狼岩离开。
出了烧炕的屋子，再到外面，林楸一下觉得这天儿更冷了。
他埋头飞快往前走。
狼岩始终站在他旁边，为他挡着风。
进到大山洞，兽人们被要求着洗干净手。
狼赤没直接回他们睡觉的地方，也跟着进了大山洞。狼岩看他有事，径直去火堆旁的桌子边坐下。
老祭司见状，杵着拐过来。
狼赤坐定，抓着膝盖的手紧了紧，忍不住道：“王，祭司，我就是想问问……照着这样下去，支部落是不是可以回来了？”
在狼山待了两个多月，狼赤切身体会到狼山发展到了什么程度。
虽然支部落有狼山接济，支部落也偶尔会送些这边没有的物资过来，但两边到底还是不一样的。
狼赤只要一想到现在支部落的兽人只抱着鱼干就吃得满足，而自己却捧着狼山这边各式各样的食物还能选着吃，就有些食不下咽。
他们是一个部落。
狼赤从来都是这么认为的。
他虽然现在带领着支部落，但他比任何一个兽人都想让狼部落恢复完整，恢复到鼎盛时期的兽人规模。
狼赤希望现在狼岩也能像老狼王一样，带领的是整个狼部落，而不是只有一半兽人的部落。
几个部落的领头兽人说着大事。
山洞的兽人们安静下来。狼夜也和小队的成员们坐在不远处，满脸期待。
大家认认真真听，想到部落合二为一，心中澎湃。他们不敢说话，但爪子抓草窝的声音接连不断地响起。
狼岩看着两鬓斑白，满目希冀的兽人，过多的解释止在口中。
最后，他道：“赤叔，最迟明年雪季。”
狼王的声音沉沉，是承诺，也是保证。
狼赤手一颤，紧扣住自己膝盖。
他几乎控制不住内心的喜悦，又强行忍耐着，牙齿都在隐隐打颤。
“好……好！明年雪季，明年雪季……”
兽人咬着牙，眼眶一下就红了。
他话不成句，说到后头已经哽咽。
活了大半辈子的兽人了，也当了支部落十几年的领头兽人，狼赤极力克制，才没在年轻狼王跟一众小辈面前失态。
年轻兽人们就不一样了，狼夜直接跳起来欢呼，小狼在山洞里乱爬，狼莫张开手紧紧抱住狼西，扬起脖子嗷呜嗷呜嚎……
大山洞里一片鬼叫声。
拐角后头本来已经睡着的幼崽被兽人一吓，醒了。
狼果气得跑出去，张嘴就骂：“叫什么呢？还睡不睡了？！幼崽都被吵醒了，有本事你们来哄啊！”
狼果刚刚守着幼崽，没跟着出去，还不知道咩咩兽有崽的事儿。
骂了一通，兽人不消停，反倒冲过来抄起被叫醒的幼崽乱转圈圈。
狼果：“……有病！”
“嗷？”还没变人形的幼崽被成年兽人抱着，爪子抵着兽人脸，眼里湿漉漉的，还有些疑惑。
兽人高高举起幼崽，道：“没什么大事，就你那些支部落的阿叔阿爷们要回来了！以后咱们狼部落兽人聚齐，谁都不怕了！”
狼果炸开的怒火一下被摁灭。
狼果：“支部落要回来？”
狼夜一下跑到他身侧，手臂一张，掐着狼果的腰转了一大圈。
“果！你等我回来！”
狼果吓了一跳，双手揪住狼夜肩膀的兽皮衣，下意识去看其他兽人。
见林楸手撑着下巴，微笑看着这边，他忙拍着狼夜的胳膊，小声又急切道：“你放我下去！”
狼夜察觉失态，像捧着刚出窑的陶器一样，小心将狼果放下。
他手在兽皮衣上擦了擦，冷帅俊气地站在狼果面前。
狼果：“自己玩儿去。”
说完，狼果一派镇定地去林楸身边坐下。
林楸：“等房子修好了，指定给你俩分一个。”
狼果白眼一翻，“我才不跟他一个窝。”
林楸笑而不语。
狼果虽然嫌弃狼夜，但身体并不排斥他的亲近，林楸作为旁观者，还是看得出来一点东西的。
*
洞内热闹了好一阵，连兔兽人都过来询问。
狼兽人又抓着他们玩儿了好一会儿，兔兽人承受不住这热闹，赶紧溜了。
幼崽被狼兽人当玩具，从一个兽人手中转到另一个兽人手中，最后脑袋晕晕，走路摇摇晃晃，趴地上哼唧。
狼果见状，狠狠瞪了一眼成年兽人们，叫他们把幼崽放回草窝里去。
时间不早，狼果回草窝，去哄睡幼崽。
一直悄悄注意他的狼夜看着他消失的拐角，忍不住往前挪了几步，又退了回来。
他端坐好，看着王他们，爪子无意识抓了抓地面。
他们要回来了！
靠近洞外的木桌旁边，狼赤已经调整好，他态度郑重，脸上带着喜悦，看着狼岩道：“那我就跟支部落，等着狼山的通知。”
狼岩：“好。”
狼赤笑开，又看见自己幼崽挨着狼岩坐着，唇动了动，最终什么都没说。
他的幼崽能耐了。
能为部落做事，他很欣慰。
等雪季后他离开狼山，幼崽也肯定不会跟他走的。留在狼山也挺好，他们很快会团聚。
狼赤跟狼夜他们离开大山洞，去他们那边山洞睡觉。
祭司坐在凳子上没走，沧桑的眼睛看着狼岩，道：“王，红鸟跟咩咩兽只养了半年不到……”
事情还没确定，他原本跟狼岩商量的是再等等看。
不是不想让支部落回来，而是一旦养殖的事没有达到他们的预期，支部落那百多个兽人回来了大家就要一起挨饿。
狼岩：“祭司，那边熬不了太久。”
狼火回来时说过，那边找不出猎物了。
他们回来，再差也差不到哪里去。
老祭司握住拐杖的手微僵，许久，他叹息道：“你是狼兽人族的王，你想清楚就好……支部落的兽人，确实也该回来了。”
*
“狼部落分出去的兽人真的要回来了？”黑羽兽人居住的山洞，羽山坐在草窝中，看着抱着药膏回来的羽乐问道。
羽乐点头，小声道：“狼兽人是这么说的。”
小兽人因为他阿爷的事瘦得脱了形，两颊微微凹陷，下巴只挂着一层皮，看着格外尖，一双眼睛也大得不正常。
他蹲在羽山跟前，熟练地给他拆了伤口上的麻布，重新上药。
羽山目光垂落，看着羽乐头顶。
小兽人的头发以前也是枯黄，但不像现在这样稀稀拉拉。他手下意识顺了顺小兽人的头发，却看见指缝中勾下来不少发丝。
羽山一怔，在羽乐看来时，握紧拳头将手藏在草窝。
是他疏忽了。
要是羽千在这里，肯定能注意到羽乐的变化。
羽山动了动嘴唇，最后心中一叹，只轻轻拍了拍羽乐的肩膀道：“在这边习不习惯？”
“习惯的，狼冰他们对我很好。”羽乐头也不抬，认真给羽山的伤上药。
羽山喉咙堵了下，怕又把小兽人的伤心事翻出来，只能克制道：“习惯就好，跟狼冰要认真学，但是累了也别逞强，该歇的时候歇一歇。”
羽乐重新扯了一截麻布，然后抬起头看着羽山笑起来。
他笑得还是腼腆，可眼尾耷下来的，不见得有多高兴。
他道：“阿山叔，我会好好学的，你放心。”
羽山搓着手上的头发，忍不住道：“我的意思是，别累着。”
羽乐低下头，勉强提起来的唇角抿直了，乖乖道：“我知道的，阿山叔。”
羽山：“知道就好。”
别的，他也不好多说。
要是他的伴侣在这里就好了。羽千是亚兽人，心里柔软些，知道怎么安慰小兽人。
羽乐也才十四岁，以前他们希望小兽人坚强起来，可现在，反倒不愿意看见他这个样。
忍得再好，可身体伤了，那才不是他们愿意看见的。
“阿山叔，他们回来不好吗？”
羽山飘远的思绪被羽乐一句话拉回来，他顿了顿，道：“是好事。”
但对黑羽兽人来说，不一定。
狼部落自己的兽人多了，以后干活哪里还用得着他们。要是黑羽兽人想跟狼部落交换点东西，又该用什么交换呢？
羽乐感觉到羽山情绪有些低落，他蹲在草窝边，小小的一团，比正常的十三四岁的小兽人个子要小一头。
他忍不住问：“阿山叔，你不高兴吗？”
羽山：“没有。”
“有，我感觉得到。”羽乐大眼睛看着他，羽山觉得自己仿佛被看尽了。
羽山：“你还小……”
“我不小了。”羽乐有些急迫道，“我是……我是部落的祭司，虽然现在还不能做到祭司该做的事，但我会好好学的。部落的事情，我也想知道。”
羽山与他对视。
羽乐抓紧了手中的药罐子，没有退缩。
羽山不愿意逼迫他，但他没注意到的时候，小兽人已经强制拉拔着自己长大。
不过是老族长走的那一天，不过是小兽人生病那几天，他就长大了。
羽山心中隐隐刺疼，呼吸都颤了。
他抓紧了那点柔软的头发丝，在这样干净又坚定的目光下，没再用成年兽人那一套糊弄小兽人。
他摊开来，跟羽乐道：“只是不确定，他们支部落的兽人回来之后，狼部落还愿不愿意跟我们交换东西。”
他们没什么拿得出手的交换物品，要猎物没有猎物，要兽皮没有兽皮，难不成还完了狼部落的恩情，两边就不来往了？
想想前头几次往来，不都是因为要交换东西。
羽乐：“狼王说，支部落的兽人要雪季才能回来呢。”
山洞最里头的草窝里，羽哗被嗡嗡的说话声吵醒。他睁眼就看着羽山那愁苦样，忍不住轻嗤了声。
“别总想着什么都靠着跟狼部落交换，不然你完了。”
“你懂什么。”羽山道。
羽哗：“是是是，你懂得多，你是族长。”
“阿山叔，阿哗叔，你们别吵。”羽乐夹在他俩中间，小声道。
羽哗：“这不叫吵架。”
羽山看着跟前着急的小兽人，压下心底的担忧，温和笑道：“对，我没跟你阿哗叔吵，我们说话就这样。”
斗了那么多年，说话的方式一时间也改不过来。
比起以前，现在这样算温和的了。
羽乐看了看两个兽人，确认他们没红脸，这才拿了药膏，去给其他兽人换药。
“你现在想那么多没用，还是先想想下次原野部落派兽人来怎么办吧。”
羽哗一句话，让羽山脸色更加沉重。
羽哗见状，直接气笑了。
就羽山这个天天心里像装着几块大石头的死样子，他最看不惯！好像只有他操心部落的事一样，当谁没为部落考虑过似的！
羽哗：“要不然咱们直接投奔狼部落算了。”
羽山：“你想得倒美，摊上个原野部落，也不看看人家狼部落看不看得上你。”
羽哗：“哦……看来你不是没想过。我想得美怎么了？总比你一天脸黑得跟锅底一样看着舒坦一点儿。”
羽乐：“阿哗叔，阿山叔……”
羽哗摆摆手，“不吵不吵，这不正常说话嘛。”
这小兽人也是，以前怯生生的，话都不敢说两句，怎么老兽人一走就大变样，还管起他们来了。
羽山往窝里缩了缩，不再理会羽哗，他得好好想想，到底该怎么度过这一关。
*
一个月后，黑羽兽人的伤好了。
祭司检查过后，确定兽人没问题，羽山他们就打算回部落了。
这次离开，他们要把羽哗也带走，只留羽乐在这边继续跟着狼冰学习认识草药。
走之前，羽山去跟狼兽人告别。
正是早上，兽人们刚吃过野菜蛋花汤和咸鱼干，这会儿还懒着坐在廊下没走。
羽山带着八个黑羽兽人走来。
羽哗杵着狼起做的拐杖，慢悠悠地跟在后头。
廊道地面抬高了些，羽哗杵着拐不好上去，入口处的狼兽人伸手扶他。
羽哗手臂一摊，任由两个狼兽人架着他胳膊把他放上去。道了谢，羽哗再杵着拐继续往里走。
廊道里头，一行黑羽兽人已经停下。
“岩。”羽山道。
狼岩颔首，示意他们坐。
林楸醒得晚，这会儿还没吃完早饭。狼岩坐在他旁边守着，顺带解决自己伴侣吃不完的咸鱼干。
林楸看了黑羽兽人一眼，放下筷子，狼岩见他吃得差不多了，才顺手将碗筷挪到一边。
小狼屁颠屁颠跑来，殷勤抱着碗筷去洗了。
明早上他要吃煮红鸟蛋！
没抢到活儿的小狼酸溜溜地看着，痛失了一个吃煮蛋的机会！
部落红鸟蛋有限，幼崽吃，小狼也要吃。没办法，狼安才想出来这么个主意。
林楸知道他们要走，交代道：“祭司说了，你们现在可以飞行，但伤口的位置必须保护好，不能受寒。”
羽山：“楸，我们知道。”
羽山又看向狼岩道：“雪季之后，我们承诺的二十头弯角兽会陆续送过来。给你们干活的兽人也会过来，你们只管安排。”
狼岩点头。
“那我们就走了，谢谢你们这些天……”
“等等。”狼岩看着面前养结实了些的黑皮大汉道，“还有个事，想请你们帮忙。”
羽哗抱着自己的拐，当听到狼岩说想请他们的兽人帮忙给狼兽人训练时，稍稍一想，他撇撇嘴。
狼王还真会占便宜。
明知道他们现在说什么，黑羽兽人都不会拒绝。
羽山想了会儿，果真就答应了。
“雪季最空闲，这个时候训练最好。”狼岩道。
狼部落的兽人听到这话，鼓着两眼珠子，满脸迷茫。
训练？
什么训练？
羽山打算将在狼山照看病患的两个黑羽兽人留下来，狼岩又道：“最好是能打的。”
羽山盯着狼岩，沉默片刻。
狼岩：“我看羽猎不错，不过他一个兽人有点少。”
羽山：“……”
他很想对着狼王翻白眼，怎么不一口气直接要他个几十个黑羽兽人呢？
羽山：“等我回去，再安排十个兽人过来。”
狼岩勉强满意，落在桌下的手轻轻碰了下林楸。
林楸了然，将身侧放着的部落提前准备好的草药拿出来，放在桌面。
“这个是雪季能用到的药，有之前你们敷在伤口上帮助愈合的药膏，也有驱寒的药丸，你们回去之前也可以吃点。”
羽哗下撇的嘴角慢慢恢复。
还算有良心。
羽山接过，心里平衡了点道：“我会好好挑选兽人的。”
狼岩起身，视线往兽人当中一扫，没见到想见的，他对狼石抬了抬下巴道：“石，叫白雀兽人出来。”
羽山身体僵硬，下一瞬，果然听见狼岩道：“还要麻烦你们，把白雀兽人送回去。”
羽哗嘴角直接撇成弯钩。
果然，就没白得的好处。
“回去？”雀二白豆豆眼里带着一丝茫然。
羽哗：“在狼部落骗吃骗喝久了，自己部落都忘了。”
雀二白后知后觉他们还在狼部落。
他不好意思抻了抻翅膀，低头看脚……结果发现自己圆鼓鼓的肚子挡住了爪子。
他打了个饱嗝，一股蛋汤和咸鱼干的味道涌了出来。
雀二白又忙放下翅膀捂住肚子，羽毛下的脸绯红。
好像是、是该回去了。

chapters.translated_text:
It hadn't snowed for a few days. From the corridor to the livestock pens on the west side and in front of the caves where the orcs lived, the orcs had worn down several paths where the accumulated snow was mixed with mud and grime.

The snow blanket was still thick; whenever the Black Feather orcs stretched their wings, they sent flurries of snow flying.

Before leaving, they surrounded Yu Le, their dark, greenish-black feathers gleaming with a cold light, forming a wall to shield the little orc from the wind and snow.

Looking at the youngest cub in the tribe, the Black Feather orcs couldn't help but give instructions:

"Even though the Wolf King is a bit stingy, the other wolf orcs are alright. If you run into any trouble, don't keep it to yourself. Find Lang Yu or Lang Hong; just don't let yourself be mistreated."

"If you miss the tribe, don't try to run back on your own. It's too cold outside; you'll freeze."

"The Wolf Tribe has good food, so eat as much as you can and keep your body healthy. Otherwise, how will you have the energy to learn those brain-draining things?"

"If you can't keep up with the learning..."

"I can keep up." Yu Le looked at his uncles with reddened eyes. "I know everything, and I will take good care of myself. Don't rush to fly back when you return, if..."

"We know what we're doing."

"Also, don't be timid when you're with Lang Bing and the others. Even though our tribe is a bit smaller than theirs, when it comes to fighting..."

"Enough! Stop nagging!" Yu Hua couldn't help but urge them.

One of his claws was planted on the ground, while the other side, where he lacked a claw, was wrapped in several layers of animal hide.

The other Black Feather orcs were a bit afraid of Yu Hua, so they didn't dare say anything more upon seeing this.

Yu Hua spread his wings to gather the little orc in and said directly: "In short, just one thing: don't let yourself be mistreated, and don't overwork yourself. Your other uncles will come over in a few days, don't be afraid!"

Yu Le’s cheek bumped into the warm feathers under Yu Hua’s wing. He froze for a moment, then, seeing the orc’s caring gaze, he sniffled and said in a muffled voice, "I know, Uncle Yu Hua."

"Alright, that’s it, we’re leaving."

Nearly ten Black Feather orcs spread their wings and flew away from Wolf Mountain. The snow on the ground was swept up by their massive wings, surging toward the sky and blurring the orcs' vision.

Yu Le stood in place for a while, then turned his head and saw Lang Bing standing under the corridor, waving at him.

Yu Le immediately ran over, exhaling a puff of hot air.

"Bing."

Lang Bing: "We haven't started identifying today's medicinal herbs yet."

"Okay." Yu Le’s voice was a bit tense.

Bing was great at everything, but he was very strict when teaching him about herbs; Yu Le was still a bit afraid of Lang Bing during those times.

He followed behind Lang Bing, watching the orc’s swaying white hair tips. The sadness of parting dissipated, leaving only the urgency and nervousness of learning.

There was nothing exciting to watch outside anymore, so the wolf orcs also stood up one after another and surrounded Lang Yan.

"King, what training were you talking about just now?"

Lang Yan swept a glance over the orcs and stood up; the group of surrounding wolf orcs immediately backed away.

Lin Qiu curled his lips into a smile and followed behind Lang Yan as he left.

The orcs cleared a path, then followed them like tails.

"Qiu, do you know what kind of training it is?"

"It’s just letting you spar with the orcs of the Feather Tribe. The King said you can't beat those with wings."

"Who says we can't beat those with wings!"

Lin Qiu covered his ears, his brain buzzing from the orcs' shocked roar. He said helplessly, "I didn't say it, your King did."

Lang Yan pulled Lin Qiu in front of him, stood at the entrance of the large cave, and turned back.

A group of wolf orcs blocked the corridor, looking indignant. "King! We..."

Lang Yan’s eyes were like ice, and he said coldly, "Too noisy!"

Instantly, the orcs fell silent, as if terrified.

Lang Yan: "Don't think that just because you have loud voices you can fight. How come you couldn't even catch a single hair when you faced the Snow Eagle orcs before?"

"Th-that was because we weren't prepared..." the orc said weakly.

Lang Yan: "When other orcs kill you, will they wait for you to be prepared?"

The Wolf King’s gaze was sharp; one look felt like being throttled by the throat. Everyone dared not argue further and lowered their heads obediently, listening to the Wolf King’s reprimand.

"Who taught you to underestimate the enemy before the fight even starts? Just because you’ve been well-fed for a while, you think you’re so capable!"

"Especially you!" Lang Yan stared at Lang Shun.

"Back in the valley, if it hadn't been for that shout from Lang Huo, your eyeballs would have already been gouged out by the Snow Eagle orcs."

Lang Shun quietly nudged the orcs in front of him, constantly trying to hide behind them.

Lang Yan: "Train well after the Black Feather orcs arrive. Before the snow season ends, in these two-plus months, if you still can't handle those with wings, then cut open your backs and install a pair of wings!"

"Hiss—"

The group of wolf orcs buried their heads deep in fear, not daring to look at their King again.

Lin Qiu silently lightened his steps and left.

Not to mention those wolf orcs facing Lang Yan directly, even he was intimidated by that aura; his shoulder blades even felt a phantom pain.

Their King was so ruthless.

The orcs behaved themselves; they only dared to move after Lang Yan had walked far into the cave.

The wolf orcs inside the cave lay in their grass nests, covering their ears with their paws, eyes squeezed shut, trying their best to minimize their presence.

Sure enough, the King was still the King. The reason they felt the King was gentler lately was because Qiu was by his side.

The large cave was quiet.

When Lang Yan moved, the orcs gripped their grass nests tightly, their nerves taut.

Lin Qiu wasn't used to it either, so he left Lang Yan and went to find Lang Qi.

The tribe had finished eating the shelled tail-grass seeds and needed to shell more. The small stone mill Lang Qi had made earlier came in handy.

After finishing his morning patrol, the idle Lang Mu was grabbed by Lang Qi to pull the stone mill in his beast form.

Lang An and a few other sub-orcs stood guard, occasionally sweeping the tail-grass seeds that rolled to the edge of the mill back into the center, unwilling to waste even a bit.

Seeing Lin Qiu approach, Lang Qi immediately said, "Qiu, the tools you mentioned are done."

The cave on Lang Qi’s side was slightly smaller, and he had asked the Rabbit orcs to help expand it, changing it into a shape with a wide belly and a narrow mouth.

The wood that had been piled up in the cave was moved by Lang Qi to a small cave nearby, leaving the space much emptier.

Now, the innermost part was occupied by orcs busy shelling tail-grass seeds, while Lang Qi sat near the outside, working.

Lin Qiu went in and closed the door.

A pit had been dug inside the cave to burn a fire, and a large gap was left at the top of the door for ventilation.

Lin Qiu watched as Lang Qi brought over all the finished tools, took them, and said, "You made these so fast?"

Lang Qi: "Lang Mu and the others helped."

Lang Mu, who was pulling the stone mill, snorted a puff of hot air from his nose.

For those few pieces of wood, his paws had almost been torn.

The tools were miscellaneous, seven or eight different kinds.

The most eye-catching was the bow, with its smooth lines, looking like a one-to-one replica of the bow Lin Qiu had seen on the back of the White Sparrow orcs before.

He plucked the bowstring, but couldn't pull it easily.

Lang Qi pulled an arrow from the quiver and handed it to Lin Qiu, saying, "You’re using too little strength. To shoot and kill an adult curved-horn beast, it won't work if it's too light."

Lang Qi had "consulted" Que Erbai; the White Sparrow orcs weren't naturally very strong and couldn't use bows that were too heavy. Plus, they mostly carried them on their backs while flying, so the bows and arrows emphasized agility.

Lang Qi had made a few according to the habits of the White Sparrow orcs, but when he tried one himself, it snapped the moment he pulled it.

The one in Lin Qiu’s hand was the version he had finalized after working tirelessly for half a month.

The bow looked beautiful, but whether it could be used was another matter.

However, he had gained some insight: this thing varied with different orcs' strength and habits. To be handy and achieve maximum effect, it was best to customize them.

Of course, that was his thought as a craftsman.

If they didn't pursue extreme results, they could just modify them slightly according to the wolf orcs' habits; that would be good enough.

This was a good thing; once the orcs got used to it, the power would be unimaginable.

The other tools Lin Qiu asked him to make were very simple for Lang Qi, but this bow and arrow had quite a lot of nuance. It was also thanks to the White Sparrow orcs; otherwise, he wouldn't have been able to make it in such a short time.

Lin Qiu nocked an arrow and pulled the bow, walked to the door, and aimed at the riverbank.

He released the string, and with a sharp whistling sound, the arrow landed seventy or eighty meters away.

Lin Qiu shook his hand, "That was quite strenuous."

He hadn't pulled the bowstring to its limit; if he had, it should have gone over a hundred meters.

Just as Lin Qiu was about to try again, he suddenly felt many gazes on him.

He turned his head to scan; under the corridor, in the caves behind, and in the Rabbit orcs' cave to the west, there were heads poking out everywhere.

"Qiu! What did you just throw out?" Lang Mo couldn't squeeze out of the corridor, so he jumped out directly from the wall by pushing aside the grass curtain.

The orcs came to their senses and all ran toward Lin Qiu.

Lin Qiu raised his hand and said, "Everyone go to the large cave, I’ll bring the things over."

It was too cold outside, and Lang Qi’s cave couldn't fit so many orcs.

Tu Ai grabbed the fur on his belly with both paws and said urgently, "Chief, we want to go see too."

Tu Kui: "Let's go."

Just now, they only heard a sound in the cave, a "buzz," and Tu Kui’s fur stood straight up from his back to his ears.

He didn't know what Lin Qiu had come up with again.

Lang An and the others stopped grinding tail-grass seeds, and the Rabbit orcs were no longer afraid to enter the wolf orcs' cave; everyone gathered in the large cave.

Before going in, Lin Qiu looked at Lang Yan, who was standing in front of the orcs.

He trotted a few steps and placed the bow and arrow in his hands.

"King, you try it."

Lang Yan took it and instinctively checked the temperature on Lin Qiu’s face.

Feeling the skin exposed to the air was icy cold, Lang Yan looked at the object in his hand, immediately stepped forward twice, and without waiting for Lin Qiu’s guidance, aimed at the spot where the arrow had just landed.

Lang Yan narrowed his eyes, his arm muscles tensed, and the bowstring was pulled to the limit, emitting a creaking sound of unbearable strain.

He suddenly released it, the buzzing sound deafening; Lin Qiu even felt as if a sharp sword had swept past his cheek.

The wind it brought made his face sting.

When he steadied his gaze, the arrow released by Lang Yan was stuck straight into the ground right next to the one he had shot earlier.

After trying it, Lang Yan immediately grabbed the bow with one hand and pulled Lin Qiu with the other, walking quickly into the cave.

The other orcs stared blankly into the distance.

From Lang Qi’s cave to the location of those two arrows was only half the distance from the corridor to there. In other words, this thing allowed them to shoot and kill prey from over a hundred meters away!

In the future, they wouldn't need to get close to the prey to hunt!

Lang Chi was stunned; he took a deep breath and ran straight to the two arrowheads.

This was right on the path the orcs took to the west. Lang Chi pulled out the two arrows. One arrow had penetrated half a finger deep and fell off with a touch; the other arrowhead had gone deep into the frozen soil, with half the shaft embedded, and it took some effort to pull it out.

The orcs were dumbfounded.

Once they reacted, the orcs turned around abruptly, rushed into the cave, and shouted:

"King! I want to try!"

"King! I know how to counter the Feather Tribe now!"

"Nonsense!"

"King! I want one too!"

Listening to the chattering noise comparable to a vegetable market, Lin Qiu thought silently: For the time being, his orcs wouldn't be able to break the habit of shouting at every little thing.

Lang Yan didn't speak.

The bow was placed on the table.

Lin Qiu was pulled by him to sit by the fire, warming himself, and hearing the orcs' voices surging like a flood, he couldn't help but tilt his head and press his ear against Lang Yan’s shoulder.

Lang Qi squeezed into the cave and placed the remaining tools on the table.

As soon as he turned around, he was surrounded and couldn't get out.

Gazes as piercing as sunlight fell on him; the orcs were restless, couldn't help but paw at him, and asked all at once:

"Qi, why is this stone so round?"

"Uncle Qi, I want that thing the King has too."

"Grandpa Qi, I’ll help you, help me make one too. No, no, I want two!"

"Uncle Qi..."

Lang Qi stood like a pillar among the orcs. He was a man of few words, and no matter how much the orcs asked, they couldn't get anything out of him.

The King didn't make the call on this, so no matter how much they wanted it, they couldn't do it.

Lang Qi said: "Let me have some peace..."

The orcs, who were fantasizing about being majestic with bows and arrows one day, couldn't hear him at all. They surrounded Lang Qi and made a ruckus for a long time, only realizing belatedly that not a single person in charge was paying attention to them.

After a while, the large cave finally quieted down.

Lin Qiu’s body warmed up. He touched his face, which was still stinging, and went to the side of the grass nest to apply some ointment to prevent frostbite.

As soon as he left, Lang Yan stood up to fiddle with the tools.

The orcs were silent, consciously gathering to form a circle. Lang Yan stood in the center, facing a circle of fiery gazes, calmly observing the tools.

First were the arrows made of stone and wood.

There weren't many arrows, five in total. The two that had just been shot were picked up by Lang Chi, and one of the arrowheads was slightly cracked.

Lang Yan rubbed the arrowhead with his thumb.

The arrowhead was made by striking stone flakes and was very thin. The bow Lang Qi made had a range of about fifty paces, and Lang Yan had only used this arrow once, and the stone flake had cracked.

Lang Yan looked at Lang Qi and said, "Try a few more types of stone, preferably ones that are abundant. Other orcs who have nothing to do, go help Qi."

The arrowheads relied entirely on manual crafting, which was time-consuming and laborious, and the demand would only increase in the future. It would be a waste of time for Lang Qi to spend all his energy on this alone.

Lang Qi nodded, "I also tried using bone, but it wasn't as good as stone."

Lang Qi put down the arrow and picked up the longbow again.

He weighed the bow. It looked beautiful, but Lang Yan had a premonition that the wolf orcs would break it after pulling it a few times.

The wood was too brittle; although it was wrapped with animal sinew, it was still lacking something.

Lang Yan picked up the spear again. There wasn't much to say about this one; the orcs also wrapped sharpened stones around wooden sticks when hunting, and the one in his hand was just a more refined version.

Lang Yan tried them one by one, offering suggestions where he could.

Lang Qi listened and took notes, already starting to think.

Clanging sounds rang out from time to time, and a few marks were added to the stone wall in the distance.

The wolf orcs were envious, the Rabbit orcs were curious, and Lang Chi and the orcs from the branch tribes were already speechless at the endless stream of good things coming from Wolf Mountain.

Lang Yan examined every tool in detail before handing them over to the orcs to try for themselves.

Lin Qiu came over after wiping his face; Lang Yan had already left the circle, and the orcs were scrambling to fiddle with the tools.

Lin Qiu was afraid of being accidentally injured, so he retreated to the corner, making room for the orcs.

Lang Yan followed him a few steps, picked up the ointment Lin Qiu had used, scooped out a bit, took his partner’s hand, and lowered his eyes to apply it carefully.

Lin Qiu hooked his fingers with Lang Yan’s; his fingertips were a bit slippery from the ointment.

"King, have you finished looking?"

"Yes."

"How is it? Is it easy to use?"

"It’s easy to use."

Lin Qiu folded his hands in his palm, being rubbed by the large, calloused hands. Even when the ointment had soaked into his skin and his hands were red, he didn't see Lang Yan stop.

Only then did Lin Qiu realize that he was far from as calm as he appeared on the surface.

The orcs were busy studying the tools, and no one noticed them. Lin Qiu leaned closer to Lang Yan, watching his eyelashes droop, casting a shadow under his eyes.

Lin Qiu leaned in closer, trying to see his eyes clearly, while asking, "What are you thinking about?"

The pupils under Lang Yan’s long lashes were deep black.

Lin Qiu was only looked at once, and his heart tightened suddenly. He subconsciously pursed his dry lips, "King..."

With a weight on the back of his neck, Lang Yan blocked him in front of him, lowered his head, and bit his lip hard.

"It hurts!"

Lang Yan stroked the back of his neck as if to soothe him, while his other arm circled his waist and held him tight.

"A-Qiu." Lang Yan’s nose rubbed against Lin Qiu’s cheek and the side of his neck; the scorching breath stimulated his skin, and Lin Qiu nervously gripped Lang Yan’s arm, his cheeks flushing a light red.

"King... you, you calm down."

There were so many orcs here.

Lang Yan restrainedly bit the tip of his nose, smelled the faint scent of medicinal herbs, and buried his head in Lin Qiu’s neck again. Taking advantage of his partner’s relaxation, he suddenly opened his mouth and took a mouthful of soft flesh, grinding it.

His emotions were fluctuating violently; he couldn't help but bite harder, then, as if his reason returned, it turned into a light nibble. Light nibbling wasn't satisfying, so he couldn't help but increase the pressure.

Lin Qiu was nervous about the many orcs in front, and at the same time, his legs were turning to jelly from what he was doing.

Lang Yan’s nose was pressed tightly against the side of his neck, and after taking many deep breaths, he finally released his lips and teeth, and then licked the side of Lin Qiu’s neck pityingly.

Lin Qiu’s waist went limp, and he couldn't stand at all.

Lang Yan’s arm held him tightly, not letting him lose his composure.

"You! Those tools could be thought of just by thinking about them, not to mention that the bow and arrow were made by Lang Qi under the guidance of the White Sparrow orcs, and I didn't even participate, you..." Lin Qiu couldn't help but pinch Lang Yan’s cheek hard; he was worthy of being the Wolf King, still able to maintain a cold and stern face at a time like this.

"Stop messing with me!" Lin Qiu said fiercely.

Little did he know that his eyes were filled with water, and there was no deterrent power at all.

Lang Yan lowered his head, his nose touching his burning face.

Lin Qiu looked at his scorching eyes and couldn't help but tilt his head; his crimson ears were exposed in front of Lang Yan, his mind a mess.

He didn't know how long he had been standing in the corner; Lin Qiu’s legs were sore, so he sat directly on the edge of the grass nest.

Lang Yan accompanied him, grabbing his hands, kneading from the fingertips to the roots, and even kneading the palms. Lin Qiu couldn't help but pull back, but Lang Yan held on tight and wouldn't let go.

He thought he wasn't clingy.

Lin Qiu sobered up a little, touched the tooth mark on the side of his neck, and quickly pulled the fur scarf to cover it.

Seeing Lang Yan looking over, Lin Qiu pushed against his chest, pushing him a little further away.

Lang Yan looked at the slender white fingers on his chest, as if he saw a fat, fluffy beast.

Lin Qiu immediately withdrew his hand and looked at the orcs who had run out of the cave to test the bows and arrows, trying to divert his attention.

"Are those things suitable? If not, hurry up and let Uncle Qi change them."

Lang Yan was still looking at his face, which looked lustrous after applying the ointment.

Lin Qiu glared at him and turned his head away, his rosy earlobes exposed again.

Lang Yan raised his hand and pinched them.

Lin Qiu shivered, his whole body tingling.

Lang Yan, however, said solemnly: "The bows and arrows need to be modified, striving to equip the three hunting teams before the snow season ends. For spears and such, let the orcs choose for themselves, whichever they find handy."

Lin Qiu tilted his head; his earlobes were rubbed red by him.

How could he be like this, talking about business while his hands were still restless.

The tooth mark hidden under the fur collar on the side of his neck also deepened in color. Lang Yan’s gaze slid from his partner’s smooth jawline to the delicate skin of his neck, lingering on the tooth mark.

After a long while, he let go of the earlobe that looked like a round shell, as if he had rubbed it too hard, and it was bleeding red.

His partner’s skin was thin, and he was afraid of rubbing it raw. If it weren't for being in the large cave, he should have used his lips and teeth to bite it, which could have lasted longer... He turned to grab Lin Qiu’s hand instead.

He said: "With these things, the tribe will be safer."

The predicament of food shortages hadn't been solved, and if the Wolf Tribe’s food gradually increased, they would be a target. These things could not only be used for hunting but also for protecting the tribe.

Lin Qiu touched his burning earlobes and looked at him suspiciously.

Was he talking about business or playing with him?

This fake serious look really made people’s teeth itch.

Lang Yan raised his eyes and inadvertently moved closer to Lin Qiu again.

"Sleep in the small cave tonight, okay?"

He knew it!

Lin Qiu braced his shoulders and suddenly leaned over to bite his ear.

The shoulder under his palm stiffened, and Lin Qiu increased the force, but the muscles under his palm slowly relaxed, and his waist was once again controlled by Lang Yan.

Lin Qiu quickly let go, removed Lang Yan’s hand, and sat up straight.

He glanced at the tooth mark on Lang Yan’s ear and raised his eyebrows in a good mood.

The sub-orc’s earlobes were bright red, his eyes bright and teeth white, his cold gaze containing triumph, looking very proud and beautiful.

Lang Yan’s Adam’s apple rolled as he gazed deeply at his partner.

*

The Black Feather orcs split into two groups; Yu Shan flew directly to the Black Feather tribe with the recovered wounded, while the other two orcs who had come to take care of the wounded sent the three White Sparrow orcs back.

The Black Feather orcs had never been to the White Sparrow territory, so looking at the maze-like stone forest in front of them, they asked about the location of Que Erbai’s nest, which was tucked away in his back feathers.

Que Erbai: "The highest patch of stone forest."

Que Erbai originally didn't want to tell the two Black Feather orcs where they lived, but people had kindly sent them back, and in this snowy weather, he couldn't just have them return immediately.

What if they froze to death on the way back? If the Black Feather orcs came knocking, would they fight or run?

The Black Feather orcs were very eye-catching flying in the sky; as soon as they flew into the stone forest, the White Sparrow orcs discovered them.

"Chief! Chief! Black Feather orcs have flown to our tribe!"

"Chief, let’s run!!!" A shrill scream followed immediately.

The White Sparrow Chief slapped the frantic Que Shisanbai into the nest with one wing.

He took a deep breath, looked at Que Shi'erbai peering at the entrance of the cave, and said, "Move aside, it’s probably your Uncle Erbai who’s back."

As soon as he finished speaking, a cold wind rushed toward the cave.

The two Black Feather orcs landed, and three snow-ball-like orcs rolled off their backs.

"Uncle Erbai!"

Que Erbai’s beak chattered, "Qu-quick, cold, co-cold..."

The little white sparrows hurriedly stepped forward and moved them to the fire. They also looked at the Black Feather orcs folding their wings at the entrance, hopping aside to make room by the fire for them to warm up.

It was only because it was the snow season that the Black Feather orcs had sent their own orcs back; normally, they wouldn't let orcs enter the tribe so casually.

The two Black Feather orcs were also frozen stiff; if they hadn't taken the medicine given by the Wolf Tribe in advance and wrapped themselves in thick enough animal hides, they would have frozen solid by now.

The five Feather Tribe orcs shivered by the fire, while the other White Sparrow orcs huddled in their nests, their round eyes fixed on them.

Que Erbai: "Wh-what are you staring at, bo-boil the medicinal herbs!"

The white sparrows lay on the edge of the nest, "Boil what?"

Que Erbai sniffled, freezing and breaking down, "In the animal hide pouch!"

How could these little orcs of his be so stupid! They weren't clever at all like the little wolves in the Wolf Tribe.

After the medicinal herbs were boiled, the five Feather Tribe orcs drank them, and after a while, they lay on the ground to recover.

There was some distance from the Wolf Tribe to the White Sparrow tribe; the White Sparrow orcs had to fly for nearly two days, and the Black Feather orcs also had to fly for a whole day.

They didn't dare to fly continuously, traveling intermittently for fear of freezing to death on the way without anyone knowing.

Now that they had finally arrived, the two Black Feather orcs didn't want to go out again at all.

They were hungry and sleepy, so they just looked at the White Sparrow Chief. The meaning was very clear: they wanted food and they wanted to sleep.

What else could Que Dabai do?

He could only let the little white sparrows bring food to entertain the guests.

The food stored by the White Sparrow tribe was mostly small wild beasts; the largest were seventy or eighty-pound sharp-horn beasts, and there were many small ones, no matter if it was red birds, round-nose beasts, long worms, squeak-beasts... as long as it was meat, the White Sparrow orcs wouldn't let it go.

The two Black Feather orcs looked at the squeak-beasts placed in front of them, which had been roasted with their fur on and were still whole...

Both pairs of eyes stared at the White Sparrow Chief.

No, you’re feeding the guests this?

So stingy!

The White Sparrow Chief coughed twice and said, "Ad-add another long worm."

It was a big long worm, cut into pieces and placed in front of the two orcs. Although it was also poorly roasted, it was meat after all.

The two orcs’ wings were sore from the journey, so they couldn't care less. They buried their heads and finished eating, then lay down in the nest arranged by the White Sparrow Chief. Soon, snoring echoed through the stone forest.

The two orcs were arranged in a separate cave, right on the stone pillar next door.

Without the two Black Feather orcs whose size was very oppressive, the White Sparrow Chief jumped directly into Que Erbai’s nest. His claws inadvertently brushed against his belly, and the soft, bouncy sensation made the White Sparrow Chief trance-like, and he used his claws to step on it again.

"Que Erbai, it seems you’ve had a good life in the Wolf Tribe, you’ve even gotten fat!"

Que Erbai took a deep breath, "Why don't you try it again?"

The White Sparrow Chief swiped at him with a wing—

"Why don't you just stay there forever? Don't come back."

Que Erbai kicked his claws twice, turned over, and muttered, "I want to, but the Wolf Tribe won't take me."

The White Sparrow Chief scratched his wings, "Don't sleep yet, tell me about the Wolf Tribe."

Que Erbai and the others had been gone for a month, and the White Sparrow tribe knew nothing except that the Snow Eagle orcs had all been killed by the Black Feather orcs.

How did the Black Feather orcs send Que Erbai and the others back?

Could it be that the Black Feather orcs had been staying in the Wolf Tribe all along?

Since when did their two tribes have such a good relationship?

"Que Erbai, Erbai..."

"Sleepy! Talk, talk after I wake up."

Que Erbai hid in the animal hide under the gazes of dozens of the tribe’s orcs, his round belly rising and falling.

Looking at the exceptionally round shape under the animal hide, one could tell he must have eaten well this month!

The White Sparrow Chief felt sour in his stomach.

Truly, silly birds have silly luck.
