"Uncle Erbai, what was that?" Two little white sparrows stared at his messy feathers and asked.

Que Erbai said angrily: "It must be those wicked beastmen who just came to the west!"

Que Erbai's angry voice might have been a bit loud. The wolf beastmen not far away looked up and discovered three white sparrows in the air, each clutching a huge animal skin bag with their claws.

The prey was all scared away, what were they catching!

Lang Yan watched the white sparrows until they discovered him, then he waved at them.

The White Sparrow beastmen landed embarrassedly, shook their wings, and stood on the high animal skin bags.

"Wolf King, s-sorry, we just bumped into a bird."

Lang Yan looked at their animal skins.

Que Erbai puffed up his pure white feathers and said hurriedly: "These are the herbs we dried, we want to come and trade with your priest for some medicine that can be used in the rainy season."

Lang Yan signaled for the other wolf beastmen to help carry them, then led the few white sparrows back to meet up with the gathering team.

Que Erbai looked at the Wolf King, then suddenly jumped onto the back of Lang Huo, who was following beside him.

Lang Huo glanced at him and swept his tail.

The few white sparrows hurriedly flew to Lang Yun, who was further aside.

Lang Yun bared his teeth.

The white sparrows shivered.

Considering that they were the same color as him, Lang Yun resisted the urge to throw them out.

Que Erbai explained cautiously: "W-we flew for a long time, our wings can't fly anymore."

Lang Yan: "Who did you say you bumped into just now?"

"Who else could it be, it must be the Feather tribe from that Black Bear tribe that just came to the west!"

"Do you know anything about their situation?"

"I know a little." Que Erbai didn't hide anything, opened his mouth, and spilled everything about that tribe in the southwest.

"Their tribe came half a month ago. We secretly observed them; it's a tribe with all kinds of beastmen mixed together. The chief is a black bear beastman, and under him are two Big Cat tribe members and two Grey-winged tribe members, all of whom are people who can speak in the tribe."

"But their tribe seems to look down on our tribe; anyway, they don't associate with us. Of course, we don't want to associate with them either!"

Que Erbai puffed out his chest, tilted his head, and said.

"Are they on good terms with the Black Feather beastmen?"

"I heard they ran to the Black Feather tribe when they first settled down, and then were kicked out."

The White Sparrow tribe was slightly weaker compared to other beastman tribes, so they were very vigilant against strange beastmen.

Just like when Yu Hua and the others moved to the valley before, the White Sparrow beastmen monitored them for a long time, and this time was no exception.

"Is there a lot of prey in the valley?"

"Average." Speaking of this, the White Sparrow beastmen suspected they had stolen prey from other tribes. He whispered: "Those beastmen were quite thin when they first came, but now in such a short time, they seem to have gotten a little fatter. I don't know where they found the prey..."

Que Erbai said this sourly.

Two little white sparrows squatted on his left and right, their goose-yellow claws quietly grabbing the wolf fur underneath to steady themselves, and they also nodded sourly.

Lang Yan glanced at them from the corner of his eye and said: "I have a favor to ask of you."

"Tell me, Wolf King!" Que Erbai laughed inwardly.

If the Wolf King could ask them for a favor, didn't that mean he owed them a debt of gratitude? Maybe they could even go to their tribe to live for a few months in the future.

"Help us keep a closer eye on them."

雀二白自然满口答应下来。
他们是来换草药的，也就顺带跟着狼兽人一起回狼山。
等到狩猎队与采集队汇合，狼贝先一步道：“王，刚刚有兽人盯着我们。”
林楸：“应该是上次的兽人。”
“我知道了。”狼岩手掌贴着林楸后背，带着他起来道，“先回。”
狼云凑到他们跟前来，面上不爽道：“刚刚他们来见王了，不过没抓住，飞得太快了。”
这么一闹，附近的猎物也跑了，今天看样子是抓不到了。
兽人们只得回去。
好在部落里还有黑羽兽人送来的两头弯角兽，不至于饿肚子。
回到部落，已经是晚上。
狼安他们等了很久没见兽人们回来，就把部落里的弯角兽宰了一头。兽人们到狼山，锅里的肉汤还温着，能直接吃。
兽人没抓到猎物是寻常事，大伙儿吃了肉汤就洗漱睡觉。
雀二白他们也自个儿找了之前睡觉的山洞，肚皮一翻，缩起两个爪子，呼呼大睡起来。
小山洞上，洞口透出昏黄橘光。
林楸忙着收拾采集回来的染布的材料。狼岩坐在他旁边，两人对着木桌把林楸采集到的树叶、果实分类。
“怎么想起把布染色？”
“太显眼了。”
狼岩手一顿，没想到这一处。
那麻布颜色白，兽人穿在身上走在林子里就是活靶子。
林楸：“之后麻布会越来越多，所以提早做准备。”
林楸没那闲心弄些五颜六色的布出来，他想染的布越接近林木的颜色越好。
“我后面几天就不出去了，留在部落先试试。”
狼岩：“好。”
林楸还有些担忧，他将分好的东西用小兽皮兜分装，放进筐里，道：“万一黑熊部落的兽人又来怎么办？”
林楸虽然没跟那个部落的兽人近距离接触过，但凭他们跑到自家部落领地，躲在暗处两次窥探，就可以断定那部落的兽人多半不是个好的。
林楸很不喜欢。
狼岩：“不怕他们。”
成年兽人有保全自己的能力，狼岩也尽量让他们成队一起走。
今天他试着动过手，那两个兽人不敢直面他们，跑得倒是快。
从雀二白口中得知，那也是个小部落。
他们对狼部落有觊觎，但只要兽人不落单，应当没事。
后头几天，外出狩猎采集的兽人们果然没再遇到黑熊部落的兽人。抓捕猎物的情况还是老样子，一半时间能捕到，一半时间空手而归，不过也都是后话了。
第二天，雀二白用草药跟祭司交换了雨季用的药后已经走了，那兽皮袋看着一大袋，里头都是晒干的草药。
重量不算重，所以它们能抓着飞过来。
草药换的药粉也不多，原因是狼部落确实已经开始出现缺少部分草药的情况。
老祭司看着还算稳得住，但其实心里也慢慢有些急了。
晴日愈发的热，廊下挂着的鱼干换了一批又一批，间或还挂着些肉干，都是黑羽兽人偶尔送来的弯角兽肉做的。
狼莫他们一边巡逻，一边开始了建房子。
每天吃过早饭后，部落都是敲敲打打的声音。
日子晴好，兽人休息的时候，才愿意将身上的兽皮裙换做麻布短裤。寻常忙着捕猎干活，都舍不得糟蹋。
狼起那边的大石碾跟农具也做好了，他便一边处理做弓箭要用的材料，一边又做织机。
忙忙碌碌中，另三头咩咩兽陆续产仔，另外雪季后才交配的咩咩兽的肚子也慢慢大了起来。
更值得高兴的是，部落现在攒到五头尖角兽了。
日子在往好的方向走，离雨季只剩一个多月的时候，狼岩依旧让狼火带队，前往支部落。
离雨季越近，气温升高，兽人们也愈发烦躁。
狼莫小队一边烧砖，一边建房，不知不觉，东边两座并排的小屋已经建了起来。
最后封顶，晾一晾，就可以让有伴侣的兽人住进去。
狼山一切安好，附近部落也在为雨季准备着。
而远在东部大陆之外，中央大陆上，原野部落又开始接收新一年的兽人供奉。
两层石屋前，前来供奉的兽人络绎不绝。
门前喧嚣，大祭司云渡依旧端坐屋内，为每一个供奉过后的兽人提供草药，又或者给他们治疗疾病。
而石屋后头，偌大的祭祀广场上却安静极了。
狐弦看着眼前的两个兽人，一个是银狐狐吉，一个是灰翅兽人灰迅。
两个都是狐弦信任的兽人。
“族长，第二批雪鹰兽人也死了。”狐吉低声道。
他们是第三批被派过去的兽人，不过只有他们两个，且在雪鹰兽人走后没多久就出发了。
他们是被派去打探消息的。
狐弦：“狼部落就没帮忙？”
“帮了。”
狐弦眸光泛冷。
他一个视线扫过去，如同一股寒气冲击而来，狐吉跟灰迅脑袋垂得更低。
“继续。”
狐吉道：“第一批雪鹰兽人是在黑羽部落南部山谷停留休息，不想遇见了同样离开部落的一队雪鹰兽人。他们晚上发动攻击，雪鹰兽人没有准备……”
“第二批雪鹰兽人直奔黑羽部落，同样是晚上，但黑羽兽人拼死抵抗，还有一小队狼兽人在附近采集盐，所以帮了他们。”
狐弦早猜测过黑羽兽人不再过来交换盐，应该是找到了其他的盐，没想到就在狼部落。
狐吉说完，灰迅才道：“那边只有三个部落，狼部落挨着黑羽部落，南边有个白雀部落。”
“狼部落就是从中央大陆过去的那一支，不过老狼王已经死了，现在是老狼王的幼崽狼岩继任。”
“那边食物不够，十几年前，狼部落分成两个部落。他们分别有一百多个兽人，各个兽人看着身体还算强壮，能打的狩猎队兽人有六十多个，幼崽只有十几个……”
要是狼兽人在这儿，听到灰迅事无巨细地将他们的情况汇报给狐弦，怕是得惊出一身冷汗。
狐弦端坐，银发披散，一动不动如一尊玉佛。
狐吉跟灰翅将那边所有情况都说完了，但是他们的族长似乎冻住了，没有反应。
一旁的狐小尾悄悄看了看自家族长，对着两个兽人悄悄挥手。
狐吉跟灰翅低头，轻手轻脚地离开。
良久，狐弦看向狐小尾，眼如冰凌，清透却冷冽。
“你说，他们是不是故意跟我们作对？”
狐小尾一个激灵，什么都不敢说。
他们族长很讨厌狼兽人，他也讨厌。
以前狼部落还在中央大陆的时候，两边几乎不怎么来往。狼兽人讨厌他们自私自利，他们讨厌狼兽人没食物还装大方。
反正只要一对上，总忍不住刺上几句，或者打架。
现在狼部落沦落到那个地步，按理说他们应该高兴。
可狼部落坏了他们的事！
狐弦也没想让狐小尾回答他，只是随口一问。
过了会儿，狐小尾看自家族长面上没有再显露出情绪，凭狐小尾对自己族长的了解，他这是记恨上了。
于是，他小心问：“族长，我们要怎么做？”
狐弦：“太远了……”
已经死了两批雪鹰兽人，部落兽人虽多，但能打的几乎都是后头加入进来的。他作为原野部落的族长，不能再叫兽人们寒心，虽说这事只有少数兽人知道。
“等着吧。”
照着狼部落现在的发展，总有一天，他们会再一次正面对上。
“那黑羽兽人那边？”
狐弦眸光清清淡淡扫来。
狐小尾立即住口。
一败再败，虽然死了雪鹰兽人可惜，但这也是部落的耻辱。
*
狼山。
羽猎带着兽人，又一次送弯角兽过来。
弯角兽不好捕捉，数量也少，他们铆足劲儿去抓，甚至都跑出了部落，这也才是送来的第五头。
离部落被袭击也过去一段时间，羽猎慢慢调整好，敢直面自家小兽人了。
弯角兽送来的时候还是晚上，他们抓的是活的，就因为从狼部落这里知道兽血也可以吃。虽然猎物最后不是进他们的口，但黑羽兽人也舍不得浪费。
他们把弯角兽驱赶过来，就被狼兽人接手。
狼安邀他们吃饭，羽猎跟他们熟了，自然也不推辞。
羽涯几个小兽人刚忙完地里施肥的活，一身臭烘烘的，见自家兽人来，都忘了洗，直直地跑去廊下。
狼安立即道：“小崽子！想鸟粪伴着肉汤吃！”
羽猎听着笑起来，他主动走出来，然后被羽涯他们簇拥着往溪边去。
“阿猎叔，部落还好吗？”
“好着呢。”
羽涯扑通一下跳进东边的溪水里，这条清溪离地里近，兽人们吃饭取水不从这一条溪中取，不怕被嫌弃。
天气暖和了，溪水洗着反倒舒服。
小兽人们坐在里面的石头上，一边往身上泼水，一边狐疑地看着他。
“不是说原野部落那边……”
羽猎看着他们，想着继续瞒过去，可一直看着他的小兽人却注意到他眼中一闪而过的痛色。
“阿猎叔！你别骗我们！”
溪水忽然被羽猎他们踩得哗啦响，湿漉漉的小兽人爬上岸，站在羽猎跟前，眼眶发红。
“是不是他们早就来来过了？”
羽猎轻叹一声，早晚都要知道的，只是越晚知道对他们越好。
“结果呢？我阿爸他们好吗？”羽涯急得恨不得动手扒开他羽猎叔的嘴巴。
羽猎坐在岸边青草上，拍了拍旁边，动作有些迟缓。小兽人们看见，按耐住焦急，也跟着坐下来。
他们听着羽猎将部落的事说了一遍，知道情况后，恨不能当时自己在场。
可再怎么愤怒，羽涯却只是看着羽猎，忽然哽咽道：“我就知道……你们骗我们。”
他一直觉得部落让他们过来跟阿千叔他们交换哪里不对劲儿，可他一时又想不出来。
他们每天在这边忙忙碌碌，干完活到头就睡，也没空去想。
谁知道……就是成年兽人们瞒着他们。
“你别怪我们。”羽猎揉了揉几个小崽子的脑袋道，“你们阿山叔不想让黑羽部落全部覆灭，不得不做最坏的打算。你们是部落的希望。”
几个小兽人当中最大的就是羽涯，今年应该十六了，还是个没成年的兽人呢。
羽猎看着崽子们抱着他哭，哭笑不得，只能安抚着。
没有办法，谁叫他们一开始没有认清原野部落的真面目，与虎谋皮，反将自己拉入陷阱。
好在崽子们比以前坚强了，发泄了会儿就不哭了。不然再难过下去，羽猎还真不知道怎么安慰才好。
不过等羽涯他们平复，松开自己。
羽猎闻着自己身上的味儿，脸黑了黑，不得不下水跟他们一起洗澡。
天黑了，今晚的夜空格外漂亮，群星璀璨，月如玉轮。
羽猎跟着狼兽人们一起喝肉汤，正好是他们抓来的弯角兽。
换以前，一年他们也能吃个几回弯角兽，可今年甚至明年，抓到的弯角兽都得往这边送来，那就只能蹭狼兽人的了。
狼兽人、黑羽兽人、兔兽人同桌，一时之间看着竟然很和谐。
羽猎见狼岩和林楸那边桌子空下来，他端着碗过去，有事情跟他们说。
林楸跟狼岩同时抬眸看来。
羽猎瞧着这一对默契的伴侣，心里划过一丝与狼兽人同样的酸意。
“狼王，楸。”
林楸：“坐下说吧。”
羽猎收敛心神，在他俩面前坐下，直截了当道：“我们部落南边迁徙过来一个小部落，不知道狼王听说没有？”
“黑熊部落。”
“是叫这个名字，但整个部落就一个黑熊兽人。”
“这个部落的兽人看着不安分，他们几次晚上悄悄出现在我们部落，还当我们不知道……我看他们居住的山谷猎物也不多，但兽人却越来越胖，不知道从哪里偷的猎物。”
“也来了我们部落的。”林楸道。
羽猎：“你们也多注意，我总感觉他们不怀好意。”
狼岩：“知道，谢谢。”
羽猎笑说：“我们才该谢谢你们。”
要不是狼乔他们帮忙，黑羽部落怕连欠下狼部落的弯角兽都无力偿还了。
羽猎在狼部落睡了一觉，第二天带着兽人回部落。
狼部落的狩猎采集队也离开……
一时间，部落只剩下四十多个兽人，其中还包括黑羽兽人和十几个幼崽。
今天下雨，明明昨晚那么多星星，可这雨却从半夜下到今天早上也没停。
林楸刚跟幼崽晨练完。
狼果陪他打，两个成年兽人连带十几个幼崽都是脏兮兮的。
两个兽人又只能给幼崽洗一洗，休息一会儿，才开始今天的事儿。
林楸把放能染色植物的藤筐拿了下来，几块碎布盖在上面，狼果翻了翻，问：“这是做什么？”
“染布。”
“染布？”
然后狼果就看见林楸把兽皮兜里的植物倒出来锤烂，然后加水过滤，再把布放进去……
没多久，麻布开始变了颜色。
狼果懂了。
就跟吃果子时剥皮剥多了手指会变成果子一样的颜色似的，楸这是给布变色。
“我知道什么果子能弄出好看的颜色。”
林楸却摇了摇头，“不要好看，要穿上不显眼。”
“那算了。”狼果一下没了兴趣。
植物染色容易氧化或者褪色，需要明矾之类的固色剂。祭司那有各种药材，明矾石提取的明矾好像也有，但量不多。
林楸不确定现在还有没有剩的，他转头就去找祭司要。
林楸在廊下忙碌，其余兽人也各自有事。
天气晴朗，幼崽捧着一把刚从地里抓来的虫子，兴致勃勃地跑去喂红鸟。
最近好多红鸟孵蛋，都破壳了好几窝了。
不仅狼溶看红鸟看得勤，幼崽也每天抓虫过来喂。
喂完红鸟，幼崽就钻林子里玩儿。
狼冰他们在林中种了不少药材，天慢慢变热，草药却生机勃勃。
狼冰正带着羽乐跟狼雪实地讲解一些草药的生长习性，方便以后采药。
幼崽跟在狼冰后头听了一会儿，脑袋发晕，甩着脑袋就远离了他们。
幼崽在林子里探索，试图再抓点虫子回去。
不远处，忽然响起红鸟的叫声，幼崽们捧着虫子本打算回狼山前的，立即止住了脚步。
狼生蹲下，藏在灌木丛后头，盯着红鸟叫的方向。
其他幼崽见样学样，小蘑菇似的，都蹲在狼生后头。
“阿生，是不是围栏里的红鸟跑出来了？”狼圆细声细气道。
这边林子里几乎没有红鸟，有也被他们抓去养着了。他们在林子里天天跑，这么久了也才听到这一次红鸟叫。
狼生：“我们看看去。”
狼冰抽空看了眼，道：“别跑远了！”
“我们知道！”
狼生才不会乱跑呢。
狼生带头，悄悄往前。狼圆拽着他衣摆，也学着探头探脑看。
红鸟叫声似乎就在近处，其他幼崽动作没他快，眼睁睁看着狼生先一步蹿出灌木丛，狼圆抓着他衣摆也被带着钻过去。
可红鸟没看见，只瞬间，狼生感觉眼前略过一道黑影。
狼圆甚至都还没站稳。
再回神，视线却不断升高，眨眼间就是一朵一朵茂密树冠。
狼圆吓得失声。
狼生大喊：“冰！”
腰间的爪子抓得极紧，狼生疼得眼里冒泪花。狼生几乎瞬间知道他们被抓了。
他挣扎着，余光看见狼圆脸煞白，扑腾着一口咬在了兽人爪子上。
兽人吃疼，往下掉了几分。
可他速度依旧很快，眨眼就消失在狼山前。
狼生试图扑过去抱着狼圆，又张牙舞爪地往他另一条腿上咬去。
可这次没得逞，羽族兽人狠狠一甩爪子，两个幼崽被震得晕了过去。
底下的幼崽呆愣。
他们钻出灌木丛，看着空荡荡的地方散落着到处乱爬的虫子；闻着陌生的气息；听着伴随着耳边那道已经从很远处传来的呼喊声——
幼崽惊恐地边跑边喊：“救！救命！”
“救命！阿生阿圆被抓走了！”
几乎在兽人掠过林子发出响动的瞬间，狼冰察觉到不对。
他立刻冲了出去，羽乐紧跟而上，哥他们再快，却也只看见一个逐渐消失在天边的黑点。
羽乐直接变做兽人冲上去。
狼冰脑子空白，在底下跟着追。
羽涯看到天空羽乐的那一瞬间，急得骂了一声，同样飞了出去。
“羽涯！”
成年黑羽兽人急切喊道。
他们比幼崽更理智一些，立马分了两个兽人追去，余下两个看着狼兽人道：“我们去通知其他兽人！”
就这么一会儿，两个幼崽，不见了！
狼嚎声急切又高亢，不停在狼山回荡。
听到声音的兽人们立刻作出安排，狼石带领一队兽人追了出去，剩下一半护卫队守在狼山。其他兽人马上带着幼崽退回部落，不许出来。
大山洞，狼冰被叫了回来，面上沉冷宛如结冰，手却不停发颤。
“这么快，只能是……那两个灰翅兽人。”
林楸握紧他的手。
“没事，一定没事……”他喃喃自语，不知道是安慰狼冰，还是安慰自己。
去找大部队的两个黑羽兽人边飞边呼喊。
而比黑羽兽人速度几乎快上四五倍的灰左看着爪子上的两个幼崽，径直奔向南边，直至离他们居住的山谷更远的地方，滑翔而下。
这里靠近一处湖泊，靠湖一岸，倾斜生长着几颗歪脖子树。
树上筑了巢，有不少灰白色羽毛，一看就是灰翅兽人常来的地方。
灰右飞回来时，灰左已经停在巢中等他了。
他瞧见巢中躺着的幼崽，眼睛一亮。
“到手了。”
“刚好两个，你一个，我一个。”
“不，还有一个。”灰右将豹乌也扔进巢中。
灰左嫌弃道：“他肯定没我这两个好。”
灰右笑：“也是幼崽。”
灰左拎起两个幼崽看了看，忽然将狼生扔给他。
“我要你那个。”
“有就不错了。”
狼生被扔过去那一瞬间，醒了过来。他不敢睁眼，保持着软绵绵的状态，先嗅一嗅味道。
发现狼圆还在，他闭着眼睛，逼着自己不许哭，极力思考王教的那些东西。
“就在这儿？”
“怕什么，熊沉他们又不在。”
“后头没兽人追你？”
灰左轻嗤一声，对自己的飞行速度有绝对的信心。
“他们就是现在出现在这里，也抓不到我。”
灰右跟他相视一笑。
再盯着幼崽，他激动得身体微颤，眼中迸射出极致贪婪的幽光。
湖面涟漪四起，绿水中倒影着两个灰色的身影，利爪冲着幼崽撕扯去。
chapters.translated_text:
Que Erbai naturally agreed without hesitation.

They had come to trade herbs, so they would just accompany the wolf-beasts back to Wolf Mountain on their way.

Once the hunting party reunited with the gathering party, Lang Bei spoke up first: "King, some beasts were watching us earlier."

Lin Qiu: "It should be the same beasts from last time."

"I understand." Lang Yan placed his palm against Lin Qiu's back, helping him up as he said, "Let's head back first."

Lang Yun hurried over to them, looking annoyed: "They came to see the King earlier, but we couldn't catch them; they flew too fast."

With such a commotion, the nearby prey had also fled, and it looked like they wouldn't be catching anything today.

The beastmen had no choice but to head back.

Fortunately, there were still two curved-horn beasts sent by the Black Feather beastmen in the tribe, so they wouldn't go hungry.

By the time they returned to the tribe, it was already evening.

Lang An and the others had waited a long time without seeing the beastmen return, so they had slaughtered one of the curved-horn beasts in the tribe. By the time the beastmen reached Wolf Mountain, the meat soup in the pot was still warm and ready to eat.

It was common for beastmen not to catch prey, so everyone ate the soup and then washed up to sleep.

Que Erbai and his companions also found the cave where they had slept before, flipped onto their bellies, tucked in their two claws, and fell fast asleep.

In the small cave, a dim orange light shone from the entrance.

Lin Qiu was busy sorting the materials he had gathered for dyeing cloth. Lang Yan sat beside him, and the two of them sat at the wooden table, categorizing the leaves and fruits Lin Qiu had collected.

"What made you think of dyeing the cloth?"

"It's too conspicuous."

Lang Yan’s hand paused; he hadn't thought of that.

The linen was white, making any beastman wearing it in the forest a living target.

Lin Qiu: "There will be more and more linen later, so I'm preparing in advance."

Lin Qiu didn't have the leisure to make colorful cloth; he wanted to dye the fabric as close to the color of the forest as possible.

"I won't be going out for the next few days; I'll stay in the tribe and try it out first."

Lang Yan: "Good."

Lin Qiu was still a bit worried. He packed the sorted items into small animal-skin pouches and put them into a basket, saying: "What if the beasts from the Black Bear tribe come again?"

Although Lin Qiu had never had close contact with the beasts from that tribe, the fact that they had run into their territory and lurked in the shadows to spy twice was enough to conclude that the beasts of that tribe were likely no good.

Lin Qiu really didn't like it.

Lang Yan: "Don't be afraid of them."

Adult beastmen had the ability to protect themselves, and Lang Yan also tried to have them travel in groups.

He had tried to fight them today; those two beasts didn't dare to face them directly and ran away quite fast.

From what he learned from Que Erbai, it was also a small tribe.

They coveted the Wolf tribe, but as long as the beastmen didn't wander off alone, they should be fine.

In the following days, the beastmen who went out hunting and gathering indeed didn't encounter any beasts from the Black Bear tribe again. The situation with catching prey remained the same—half the time they caught something, and half the time they returned empty-handed, but that was a story for another time.

The next day, Que Erbai had already left after trading herbs with the priest for medicine for the rainy season; the animal-skin bag looked large, but it was filled with dried herbs.

It wasn't very heavy, so they were able to grab it and fly over.

The amount of medicine powder traded for the herbs wasn't much, because the Wolf tribe had indeed begun to experience shortages of certain herbs.

The old priest looked composed, but in reality, he was slowly becoming anxious.

The sunny days were getting hotter, and the dried fish hanging under the corridor were replaced batch after batch, occasionally accompanied by some dried meat, all made from the curved-horn beast meat occasionally sent by the Black Feather beastmen.

Lang Mo and the others began building houses while patrolling.

Every day after breakfast, the tribe was filled with the sounds of hammering and building.

The weather was fine, but the beastmen only wanted to change their animal-skin skirts for linen shorts when they were resting. They were reluctant to ruin them while busy hunting and working.

The large stone mill and farm tools on Lang Qi’s side were also finished, so he worked on making bows and arrows while also building a loom.

Amidst the busyness, the other three bleating beasts gave birth one after another, and the bellies of the bleating beasts that had mated after the snow season were also slowly growing.

What was even more worth celebrating was that the tribe now had five sharp-horned beasts.

Days were moving in a good direction, and with only a little over a month left until the rainy season, Lang Yan still had Lang Huo lead a team to visit the branch tribe.

The closer it got to the rainy season, the higher the temperature rose, and the beastmen became increasingly irritable.

Lang Mo’s team was burning bricks while building houses, and before they knew it, two small houses side-by-side had been built on the east side.

Once the roofs were sealed and aired out, they could let the beastmen with partners move in.

Everything was well at Wolf Mountain, and the nearby tribes were also preparing for the rainy season.

Far away, beyond the Eastern Continent, on the Central Continent, the Wilderness tribe began receiving the new year's tribute from the beastmen.

In front of the two-story stone house, the beastmen coming to offer tribute were endless.

The area in front of the door was noisy, but the High Priest Yun Du still sat calmly inside the house, providing herbs to every beastman after their offering, or treating their illnesses.

Behind the stone house, however, the large sacrificial square was extremely quiet.

Hu Xian looked at the two beastmen in front of him: one was the Silver Fox Hu Ji, and the other was the Gray-Winged beastman Hui Xun.

Both were beastmen Hu Xian trusted.

"Chief, the second batch of Snow Eagle beastmen has also died," Hu Ji whispered.

They were the third batch of beastmen sent over, but there were only two of them, and they had set off shortly after the Snow Eagle beastmen left.

They had been sent to gather information.

Hu Xian: "Didn't the Wolf tribe help?"

"They did."

Hu Xian’s eyes turned cold.

He swept a glance over, and it felt like a wave of cold air hit them; Hu Ji and Hui Xun lowered their heads even further.

"Continue."

Hu Ji said: "The first batch of Snow Eagle beastmen stopped to rest in a valley south of the Black Feather tribe, but they unexpectedly encountered a group of Snow Eagle beastmen who had also left their tribe. They launched an attack at night, and the Snow Eagle beastmen were unprepared..."

"The second batch of Snow Eagle beastmen headed straight for the Black Feather tribe, also at night, but the Black Feather beastmen fought to the death, and there was a small team of wolf-beasts nearby gathering salt, so they helped them."

Hu Xian had long guessed that the Black Feather beastmen no longer came to trade for salt because they must have found another source; he hadn't expected it to be at the Wolf tribe.

After Hu Ji finished speaking, Hui Xun added: "There are only three tribes over there; the Wolf tribe is next to the Black Feather tribe, and there is a White Sparrow tribe to the south."

"The Wolf tribe is the branch that moved over from the Central Continent, but the old Wolf King is already dead, and now the old Wolf King’s cub, Lang Yan, has succeeded him."

"There isn't enough food over there. More than ten years ago, the Wolf tribe split into two tribes. They each have over a hundred beastmen; every beastman looks quite strong, and there are over sixty beastmen in the hunting party capable of fighting, but only a dozen or so cubs..."

If the wolf-beasts were here and heard Hui Xun reporting their situation to Hu Xian in such detail, they would likely break out in a cold sweat.

Hu Xian sat upright, his silver hair draped over his shoulders, motionless like a jade Buddha.

Hu Ji and Hui Xun had finished saying everything about the situation over there, but their Chief seemed frozen, showing no reaction.

Hu Xiaowei, who was standing to the side, quietly looked at his Chief and secretly waved at the two beastmen.

Hu Ji and Hui Xun lowered their heads and left on tiptoe.

After a long while, Hu Xian looked at Hu Xiaowei, his eyes like icicles, clear yet cold.

"Tell me, do you think they are deliberately going against us?"

Hu Xiaowei gave a start and dared not say anything.

Their Chief hated the wolf-beasts, and he hated them too.

Back when the Wolf tribe was still on the Central Continent, the two sides barely interacted. The wolf-beasts hated them for being selfish, and they hated the wolf-beasts for pretending to be generous when they had no food.

Anyway, whenever they met, they couldn't help but sting each other with words or start a fight.

Now that the Wolf tribe had fallen to that state, logically, they should be happy.

But the Wolf tribe had ruined their plans!

Hu Xian didn't expect Hu Xiaowei to answer him; it was just a casual question.

After a while, Hu Xiaowei saw that his Chief’s face no longer showed any emotion. Based on his understanding of his Chief, he was holding a grudge.

So, he asked carefully: "Chief, what should we do?"

Hu Xian: "It's too far..."

Two batches of Snow Eagle beastmen had already died. Although there were many beastmen in the tribe, most of those capable of fighting had joined later. As the Chief of the Wilderness tribe, he couldn't let the beastmen lose heart, even though only a few knew about this.

"Wait."

Based on the current development of the Wolf tribe, one day, they would face each other head-on again.

"And what about the Black Feather beastmen?"

Hu Xian swept a clear, indifferent gaze over.

Hu Xiaowei immediately stopped talking.

Losing again and again—although it was a pity that the Snow Eagle beastmen had died, it was also a disgrace to the tribe.

*

Wolf Mountain.

Yu Lie brought the beastmen to deliver curved-horn beasts once again.

Curved-horn beasts were hard to catch and few in number; they had put all their effort into catching them, even running outside their tribe, and this was only the fifth one they had delivered.

Some time had passed since their tribe was attacked, and Yu Lie had slowly adjusted and dared to face his own little beastmen again.

It was still evening when the curved-horn beasts were delivered. They had caught them alive because they learned from the Wolf tribe that beast blood could also be eaten. Although the prey wouldn't end up in their own mouths, the Black Feather beastmen couldn't bear to waste it.

They drove the curved-horn beasts over, and the wolf-beasts took over.

Lang An invited them to eat, and since Yu Lie was familiar with them, he naturally didn't refuse.

Yu Ya and the other little beastmen had just finished fertilizing the fields and were smelly; seeing their own beastmen arrive, they forgot to wash and ran straight to the corridor.

Lang An immediately said: "Little brats! Do you want to eat meat soup seasoned with bird droppings?"

Yu Lie laughed when he heard this. He took the initiative to walk out and was then surrounded by Yu Ya and the others as they headed toward the creek.

"Uncle Yu Lie, is the tribe okay?"

"It's doing just fine."

Yu Ya jumped into the creek on the east side with a splash. This clear creek was close to the fields, and since the beastmen didn't get their drinking water from this specific creek, they didn't have to worry about being disliked.

The weather was getting warmer, so washing in the creek was actually comfortable.

The little beastmen sat on the stones inside, splashing water on themselves while looking at him suspiciously.

"Isn't it said that the Wilderness tribe..."

Yu Lie looked at them, intending to keep hiding it, but the little beastmen who had been watching him noticed the flash of pain in his eyes.

"Uncle Yu Lie! Don't lie to us!"

The creek water was suddenly splashed loudly by Yu Lie and the others. The wet little beastmen climbed onto the bank, stood in front of Yu Lie, their eyes turning red.

"Did they already come?"

Yu Lie sighed softly; they would know sooner or later, but the later they knew, the better it was for them.

"What was the result? Are my Dad and the others okay?" Yu Ya was so anxious he wanted to pry open his Uncle Yu Lie’s mouth.

Yu Lie sat on the green grass by the bank and patted the spot next to him, his movements somewhat sluggish. Seeing this, the little beastmen suppressed their anxiety and sat down as well.

They listened as Yu Lie recounted what had happened to the tribe, and after learning the situation, they wished they had been there at the time.

But no matter how angry they were, Yu Ya just looked at Yu Lie and suddenly choked up: "I knew it... you were lying to us."

He had always felt that something was wrong with the tribe sending them over to trade with Uncle A-Qian and the others, but he couldn't figure it out.

They were busy here every day, working until they collapsed to sleep, and had no time to think.

Who knew... it was just the adult beastmen hiding it from them.

"Don't blame us." Yu Lie rubbed the heads of the little cubs and said, "Your Uncle A-Shan didn't want the Black Feather tribe to be completely wiped out, so he had to make the worst-case preparations. You are the hope of the tribe."

Among the little beastmen, the oldest was Yu Ya, who should be sixteen this year, still an underage beastman.

Yu Lie watched the cubs hugging him and crying, feeling both amused and frustrated, and could only comfort them.

There was no help for it; who told them they hadn't recognized the true face of the Wilderness tribe at the beginning, trying to bargain with a tiger, only to trap themselves.

Fortunately, the cubs were stronger than before and stopped crying after venting for a while. Otherwise, if they kept being sad, Yu Lie really wouldn't know how to comfort them.

However, after Yu Ya and the others calmed down and let go of him.

Yu Lie smelled the odor on himself, his face darkened, and he had no choice but to get into the water to wash with them.

It was dark, and the night sky tonight was exceptionally beautiful, with bright stars and a moon like a jade wheel.

Yu Lie drank meat soup with the wolf-beasts, which happened to be the curved-horn beast they had caught.

In the past, they could eat curved-horn beast a few times a year, but this year and even next year, the curved-horn beasts they caught had to be sent here, so they could only sponge off the wolf-beasts.

Wolf-beasts, Black Feather beastmen, and rabbit-beasts sat at the same table, looking surprisingly harmonious for a moment.

Seeing that the table where Lang Yan and Lin Qiu were sitting had cleared, Yu Lie carried his bowl over; he had something to tell them.

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan looked up at the same time.

Yu Lie looked at this taciturn couple, and a trace of the same sourness he felt toward the wolf-beasts crossed his heart.

"Wolf King, Qiu."

Lin Qiu: "Sit down and talk."

Yu Lie composed himself, sat down in front of them, and said straightforwardly: "A small tribe migrated to the south of our tribe. I don't know if the Wolf King has heard of it?"

"The Black Bear tribe."

"That is the name, but there is only one black bear beastman in the whole tribe."

"The beasts of this tribe look restless; they have appeared quietly in our tribe several times at night, thinking we didn't know... I see that there isn't much prey in the valley where they live, but the beasts are getting fatter and fatter. I don't know where they stole the prey from."

"They came to our tribe too," Lin Qiu said.

Yu Lie: "You should also be careful; I always feel they have ill intentions."

Lang Yan: "Understood, thank you."

Yu Lie smiled and said: "We should be the ones thanking you."

If it weren't for Lang Qiao and the others helping, the Black Feather tribe might not even have been able to repay the curved-horn beasts they owed the Wolf tribe.

Yu Lie slept at the Wolf tribe for one night and took the beastmen back to his tribe the next day.

The Wolf tribe’s hunting and gathering team also left...

For a time, there were only forty-some beastmen left in the tribe, including the Black Feather beastmen and a dozen or so cubs.

It was raining today. Even though there were so many stars last night, the rain had been falling from midnight until this morning without stopping.

Lin Qiu had just finished morning exercises with the cubs.

Lang Guo had accompanied him, and both adult beastmen, along with the dozen or so cubs, were covered in dirt.

The two beastmen could only wash the cubs, rest for a while, and then start today's tasks.

Lin Qiu took down the rattan basket containing the dyeing plants, with a few pieces of scrap cloth covering it. Lang Guo flipped through it and asked: "What is this for?"

"Dyeing cloth."

"Dyeing cloth?"

Then Lang Guo watched as Lin Qiu poured the plants out of the animal-skin pouch, pounded them to a pulp, added water to filter it, and then put the cloth inside...

Before long, the linen began to change color.

Lang Guo understood.

Just like how your fingers turn the same color as the fruit when you peel too many of them, Qiu was changing the color of the cloth.

"I know which fruits can make pretty colors."

Lin Qiu shook his head, "I don't want pretty; I want it to be inconspicuous when worn."

"Then forget it." Lang Guo lost interest immediately.

Plant dyeing easily oxidizes or fades, requiring a mordant like alum. The priest had various medicinal herbs, and it seemed there was alum extracted from alum stone, but not much.

Lin Qiu wasn't sure if there was any left, so he turned to go ask the priest for some.

Lin Qiu was busy under the corridor, and the other beastmen had their own things to do.

The weather was clear, and a cub held a handful of insects just caught from the ground, running excitedly to feed the red birds.

Recently, many red birds were hatching eggs, and several nests had already broken their shells.

Not only did Lang Rong watch the red birds diligently, but the cubs also brought insects to feed them every day.

After feeding the red birds, the cubs went into the forest to play.

Lang Bing and the others had planted many medicinal herbs in the forest. As the weather slowly got hotter, the herbs were growing vigorously.

Lang Bing was taking Yu Le and Lang Xue to explain the growth habits of some herbs on-site, to make it easier to gather them in the future.

The cubs followed behind Lang Bing for a while, feeling dizzy, and shook their heads as they moved away from them.

The cubs explored the forest, trying to catch more insects to bring back.

Not far away, the call of a red bird suddenly rang out, and the cubs, who had been planning to return to Wolf Mountain with their handfuls of insects, immediately stopped in their tracks.

Lang Sheng squatted down, hiding behind a bush, staring in the direction of the red bird's call.

The other cubs followed suit, squatting behind Lang Sheng like little mushrooms.

"A-Sheng, did the red birds in the enclosure get out?" Lang Yuan asked in a thin, reedy voice.

There were almost no red birds in this forest; any that were there had been caught by them to raise. They ran in the forest every day, and it had been so long since they had heard a red bird call.

Lang Sheng: "Let's go take a look."

Lang Bing took a moment to look over and said: "Don't run too far!"

"We know!"

Lang Sheng wouldn't run around aimlessly.

Lang Sheng took the lead, moving quietly forward. Lang Yuan tugged at his hem, also learning to peek around.

The red bird's call seemed to be nearby. The other cubs weren't as fast as him, watching helplessly as Lang Sheng darted out of the bushes first, with Lang Yuan being dragged along by his hem.

But no red bird was seen; in just an instant, Lang Sheng felt a black shadow pass before his eyes.

Lang Yuan hadn't even stood steady yet.

When they regained their senses, their vision was rising continuously, and in the blink of an eye, they were among the dense, lush treetops.

Lang Yuan was so scared he lost his voice.

Lang Sheng shouted: "Bing!"

The claws around his waist gripped extremely tight, and Lang Sheng’s eyes welled up with tears from the pain. Lang Sheng knew almost instantly that they had been snatched.

He struggled, catching a glimpse of Lang Yuan’s face, which had turned deathly pale, and bit down hard on the beastman’s claw.

The beastman felt the pain and dropped a bit.

But his speed remained very fast, and in the blink of an eye, he disappeared from in front of Wolf Mountain.

Lang Sheng tried to pounce over to hold Lang Yuan, and clawed and bit at the beastman’s other leg.

But he didn't succeed this time; the Feather-tribe beastman swung his claws fiercely, and the two cubs were knocked unconscious.

The cubs below were stunned.

They crawled out of the bushes, looking at the empty space where insects were scattered everywhere, smelling an unfamiliar scent, and listening to the shouting that was already coming from far away—

The cubs ran in terror, shouting: "Help! Help!"

"Help! A-Sheng and A-Yuan have been snatched away!"

Almost the moment the beastman rushed through the forest and made a noise, Lang Bing sensed something was wrong.

He immediately rushed out, Yu Le followed closely, but even as fast as they were, they only saw a black dot gradually disappearing into the horizon.

Yu Le transformed into a beastman and rushed up.

Lang Bing’s mind went blank as he followed and chased from below.

The moment Yu Ya saw Yu Le in the sky, he cursed in anxiety and flew out as well.

"Yu Ya!"

The adult Black Feather beastmen shouted urgently.

They were more rational than the cubs and immediately split into two beastmen to pursue, while the remaining two looked at the wolf-beasts and said: "We'll go notify the other beastmen!"

In just this short time, two cubs were gone!

The wolf howls were urgent and high-pitched, echoing continuously over Wolf Mountain.

The beastmen who heard the sound immediately made arrangements. Lang Shi led a team of beastmen to pursue, while the remaining half of the guard team stayed to protect Wolf Mountain. The other beastmen immediately took the cubs back into the tribe and were forbidden from coming out.

In the large cave, Lang Bing was called back, his face as cold as ice, but his hands wouldn't stop trembling.

"So fast, it can only be... those two Gray-Winged beastmen."

Lin Qiu gripped his hands tightly.

"It's okay, they'll be okay..." he muttered to himself, not knowing if he was comforting Lang Bing or himself.

The two Black Feather beastmen who went to find the main force shouted as they flew.

And Hui Zuo, whose speed was almost four or five times faster than the Black Feather beastmen, looked at the two cubs in his claws and headed straight south, gliding down only when they were far away from the valley where they lived.

This place was near a lake, and on the shore, several crooked trees grew at an angle.

Nests were built in the trees, and there were many gray-white feathers, clearly a place the Gray-Winged beastmen frequented.

When Hui You flew back, Hui Zuo was already waiting in the nest.

He saw the cubs lying in the nest, and his eyes lit up.

"Got them."

"Just two, one for you, one for me."

"No, there's one more." Hui You threw Bao Wu into the nest as well.

Hui Zuo said disdainfully: "He definitely isn't as good as these two of mine."

Hui You laughed: "They're cubs, too."

Hui Zuo picked up the two cubs to look at them, then suddenly threw Lang Sheng to him.

"I want yours."

"Be glad you have any at all."

The moment Lang Sheng was thrown over, he woke up. He didn't dare open his eyes, maintaining a limp state, and sniffed the air first.

Finding that Lang Yuan was still there, he kept his eyes closed, forcing himself not to cry, and tried his best to think about the things the King had taught them.

"Right here?"

"What are you afraid of? Xiong Chen and the others aren't here."

"No beasts chasing you from behind?"

Hui Zuo scoffed, having absolute confidence in his flying speed.

"Even if they appeared here right now, they wouldn't be able to catch me."

Hui You and he looked at each other and smiled.

Staring at the cubs again, he trembled with excitement, his eyes flashing with extreme, greedy light.

Ripples spread across the lake, reflecting two gray figures in the green water, their sharp claws tearing toward the cubs.
chapters.title: 第147章

chapters.translated_text:
"They're gone?"

"Ha, they're gone."

Xiong Chen led the orcs out from the forest on the west side; every one of the orcs had a robust, powerful physique.

Their naked, predatory gazes pierced through the corridor and swept over the cave entrance. The orcs laughed, their teeth yellowed, their faces like those of evil ghosts.

The moment Lin Qiu saw them, he immediately understood.

They were targeting Wolf Mountain.

The cubs were shielded into the deepest part of the cave, and the sub-orcs guarded the entrance. Lang Mo looked at the strange orcs charging toward the cave and determined almost instantly: they were rogue orcs!

At Lang Mo’s command, the squad members charged straight out.

Lin Qiu faced the tribe’s first real slaughter.

His face was pale, but his gaze was extremely calm. His eyes followed his own orcs closely as eight giant wolves rushed out of the corridor, cutting the rogue orcs off.

Claws clashed; the bear orcs were even larger in size than the wolf orcs.

When the two sides collided, it sounded like a muffled thunderclap. Dust billowed as Lang Mo and Xiong Chen fought; the two orcs rolled and slammed into the corridor pillars, which groaned under the unbearable weight.

Bang—

Lin Qiu looked over anxiously. Lang Xi was being pinned down by a large cat orc, who opened his mouth and tore a chunk of meat directly from Lang Xi’s leg.

Lin Qiu immediately moved to rush out, but Lang An blocked him, pushing him back.

Lin Qiu stumbled backward, his body brushing against a shivering rabbit orc. Lin Qiu thought they were afraid and wanted to offer some comfort, but Tu Kui suddenly grabbed his hand, his voice urgent: "Qiu, they are rogue orcs! They eat orcs; our tribe was attacked by them."

Lin Qiu looked up sharply at the scene outside the cave.

The large cat orc’s mouth was full of blood, and he was already chewing the piece of meat he had just torn from Lang Xi’s leg—

"They are here for us!"

It wasn't about stored food.

Then what about Lang Sheng and the others...

In the blink of an eye, more than ten orcs broke through Lang Mo’s defense and charged straight to the cave entrance. Lang An, Lang Qi, and the young wolves met them, and the orcs began to slaughter each other at the threshold.

A foul, fishy wind blew in, and Lin Qiu felt a chill run through his entire body.

He didn't even have time to think about what might happen to the captured cubs, quickly instructing: "Kui, you guys go inside! Guo, take the cubs and don't come out!"

Lin Qiu turned and joined the battle.

The sub-orcs stood their ground at the entrance, refusing to let the rogue orcs take another step into the cave.

Lin Qiu had never felt as if his whole being was being torn apart like this—those were two cubs!

He stared fixedly at the rogue orcs trying to enter the cave, his chest filled with overwhelming rage. Every time he swiped his claws, he hooked and tore away bloody skin and flesh.

He used to say that tearing prey with one's mouth was so dirty.

But this time, he bit down again and again, as if he didn't care about his own life... His back was torn open by sharp claws, his black wolf fur hiding his wounds. Every time he lunged and bit, blood splattered onto his fur and fell onto the once-clean corridor.

Although the rogue orcs were twice as numerous, the wolf orcs were no pushovers.

Everything in Lin Qiu’s vision was blood-red, with only one thought—

Faster, faster.

He was teetering on the edge, and out of the corner of his eye, he saw Lang Qi’s front leg being bitten. He lunged forward, only to be slammed into the ground by an orc, his body aching as if it had been crushed.

Inside the cave, the rabbit orcs’ eyes were red. The terror in their bodies left them limp, and even if they wanted to help, they couldn't move a step.

Lang Guo watched Lang An and the others get injured, burning with anxiety.

He wanted to go over, but behind him were the tribe’s cubs.

Lang Guo gritted his teeth, stared at the dozen or so rabbit orcs in front of him, and suddenly said: "Kui, you watch the cubs."

Tu Kui shook his head vigorously, clutching his own cub to his chest, repeating: "Revenge, revenge... must have revenge!"

Tu Kui shoved Tu Luo to Lang Guo, his eyes red, and charged out.

The other rabbit orcs looked up, seeing the rogue orcs nearly at the entrance and the wolf orcs fighting in a pool of blood...

The moment they saw that large cat orc, their eyes turned bloodshot.

It was him!

It was him who led the rogue orcs and ate their clansmen!

Not knowing where the courage came from, Tu Ai felt a surge of strength, his heart filled only with the desire to kill the orc to vent his hatred.

In an instant, more than ten rabbit clansmen joined in.

Tu Ai and Tu Kui charged straight at the large cat orc. They grabbed the orc’s ears and bit down hard on his neck.

The orc felt the pain and with a single wave of his hand, flipped Tu Kui off his back.

But Tu Ai bit down hard on the flesh of his nape, refusing to let go no matter how the orc tore at him.

The orc beat him heavily, even embedding his claws into his body. Tu Ai vomited blood, but bit down even harder.

Lang Yu, who was a few orcs away, saw that he was about to be beaten to death, rushed over, and took the opportunity to slash the orc’s exposed neck.

Yet, the rabbit orc still wouldn't let go.

"Tu Ai!"

"Uncle A-You, Dad, Little Brother..."

Tears hung in the corners of Tu Ai’s eyes as Lang Yu forcibly pried his mouth open and threw him to the back.

There was no wind today, and soft white clouds were still scattered across the sky. But in front of Wolf Mountain, the air was thick with the smell of blood. The stoves were overturned, pottery pots shattered, tables and chairs smashed to pieces... The rising dust shrouded the fighting orcs.

As Lang Mo and Lang Xi slammed the black bear orc away.

Xiong Chen’s spine slammed heavily against a corridor pillar.

Lang Mo roared: "Move!"

Bang—

The corridor collapsed. Xiong Chen’s spine was completely broken as he tried to crawl up, and he spat out large mouthfuls of blood.

None of the guard squad members glanced at him; his own companions even stepped on his body to climb out. Before they could even rejoice, their throats felt a sharp pain—

The orc opened his eyes in disbelief, watching with his own eyes as his life was reaped by Lang Mo.

The guard squad finished off the orcs blocking them and quickly headed toward the cave entrance.

Wolf orcs, especially the males, were unmatched by most orcs on the Beast God Continent in both strength and speed.

Except for the cat and bear orcs who could hold them back, the other orcs couldn't beat them at all.

Even the wolf tribe sub-orcs, despite the difference in numbers, could hold them off for a while.

With the sub-orcs blocking them from entering, the orcs of Lang Mo’s squad acted like demons, beginning to reap their lives in return.

The surrounded rogue orcs didn't last a breath before their throats were pierced. The wolf orcs slaughtered them like prey, blood spraying across the entire corridor.

The remaining rogue orcs saw the situation was dire and scattered to flee.

The wolf orcs didn't intend to let a single one go.

The leopard orc who had been hiding on the edge of the fight and striking from the shadows ran the fastest. Just as he was about to reach the forest, an arrow shot out from the trees, heading straight for his eye.

Pop—the eyeball burst.

The orc clutched his eye in agonizing pain, howling as he rolled on the ground.

Lang Rong, Lang Chuan, and Lang Tao, the three young wolves who had been chasing him, paused, their claws swiping in unison across the orc’s neck, silencing the noisy screams.

Their eyes were cold. They looked up and saw three White Sparrow orcs rushing out of the forest in a panic.

"It's bad, it's bad... where is the Wolf King?" The White Sparrow, meeting their gaze, puffed up into a ball in fear.

"He's not here." Lang Rong turned back, looking at the devastated Wolf Mountain.

Seeing this, the White Sparrow orc, his wings exhausted from flying for so long, dropped straight to the ground.

Oh no!

The Wolf King had ordered them to monitor the Black Bear tribe, and they had rushed over as soon as they noticed something wrong. But the journey was long, and the Great Marsh was full of water; they couldn't fly across in one go and had to detour around the forest.

They were still too late!

They hadn't expected these orcs to actually run to the Wolf tribe!

*

Far away in the southeast, the hunting team was still catching prey.

When the Black Feather orcs came to find them, the wolf orcs were initially confused, but the next moment, they were all in a panic.

"The cubs were taken, and Lang Shi led a small squad to chase after them. The ones who took them were the Feather tribe, they fly very fast..."

The orcs abandoned their prey and ran with all their might, following the Black Feather orcs. When they reached the Great Marsh, Lang Yan suddenly said: "Qiao! You guys go back."

"Yes!" Lang Qiao didn't hesitate and left with his team.

The other orcs didn't stop for a second, sprinting rapidly toward the southwest.

The Black Feather orc flying in mid-air searched everywhere, when suddenly a small orc flew back to report: "Uncle, they flew toward the south of the valley!"

Lang Yan remembered the Black Bear tribe, his eyes fierce.

"You, take five orcs to the valley. The rest, follow the Black Feather orcs!"

All the wolf orcs obeyed Lang Yan’s command without a single question. They moved rapidly through the forest, even kicking up a fierce wind.

While detouring around the Great Marsh, Lang Yan looked at the calm water.

He should have listened to Qiu!

Wolf orcs couldn't fly directly like the Black Feather orcs, and the detour around the marsh had delayed them. Leaving the tribal territory from the southwest, the orcs split into two teams. At this moment, another small Black Feather orc returned to report the direction.

And in a place very, very far from Wolf Mountain.

Yu Le’s wings were exhausted and trembling, but he was still struggling to fly forward.

Yu Ya caught up, and seeing him struggling, flew underneath him, as if carrying him on his back.

Yu Le: "You hurry and keep up."

Before leaving Wolf Mountain, several Black Feather orcs had been chasing that Gray Wing orc. But halfway there, another Gray Wing orc appeared from nowhere.

The small orcs dispersed immediately, and the two adult Black Feather orcs who followed were so angry they had to split up to chase them.

The small orcs had an explosive burst of energy from somewhere, and the adult Black Feather orcs almost lost them.

To ensure the wolf orcs could determine the location, they would fly for a while, and the adult orcs would arrange for a small orc to return with a message.

The wolf orcs relied on their positioning to keep moving forward, but even so, when they saw Yu Le and Yu Ya collapsed on the ground in exhaustion, Lang Yan’s legs almost gave out.

It was already late at night.

The lake reflected the moonlight, ripples spreading out.

The wolf orcs quickly climbed the large trees by the lake, only to find a bit of cub fur.

Gray, exceptionally smooth and bright.

Smelling the familiar scent of the cubs, along with the murky, foul odor on the Gray Wing orc, the male orc checking the nest suddenly fell down.

"Lang Hu!"

Lang Hu was trembling, his eyes instantly turning red.

"Cubs, cubs..."

His cubs.

There was such a strong smell of blood here; it was fresh blood, it was the cubs' blood...

Lang Yan looked at the wolf-tooth necklace in his hand; it was the one Qiu had strung for Lang Sheng. He took a deep breath, suppressing all his emotions.

He quickly climbed up the tree to search the nest, his hand touching blood. His hand trembled, and he carefully sniffed it at the tip of his nose.

The orcs watched blankly, their eyes red, pacing anxiously. They wanted to find the orcs immediately and kill them.

But a moment later, Lang Yan rushed down and immediately ordered: "Search the area, find any trace of the Gray Wing orcs."

Daring to touch their cubs—he would make them wish they were dead!

*

The Valley.

Lang You and his five orcs arrived in the first half of the night.

They hid their scent and searched the area, but found no trace of their cubs, not even the scent of other male orcs.

The orcs crept closer and suddenly broke into the cave, only to see three sub-orcs and one cub tied up inside.

And in their midst, a pile of picked-clean white bones.

Those, those were clearly orcs!

Lang You’s heart tightened. He rushed up, grabbed one of the sub-orcs, and asked: "Where are our cubs?!"

The sub-orc cowered, staring at him blankly, muttering something under his breath.

"Don't, don't... don't eat me, don't eat me..."

Lang You let him go, nearly stumbling.

They were rogue orcs!

Rogue orcs that ate other orcs!

Then their cubs... A intense chill rose up Lang You’s back.

Instantly, he ran out of the cave, leaving one orc to stand guard.

They searched the entire valley inside and out again; there were no other orcs, no cubs, but they found another pile of white bones in the back mountain!

There were Snow Eagle orcs, and other orcs too.

Without exception, they were all... orcs.

Lang You closed his eyes tightly.

"Captain."

"Immediately, keep looking for the cubs!"

There weren't many orcs in this tribe. Lang Mo and Lang An were at Wolf Mountain, and Lang Qiao had returned; they couldn't make it back in time. They could only expand the search area and keep looking for the cubs.

The orcs nodded and quickly followed in the direction of Lang Yan.

As for the orcs in the cave, they didn't take them or pay much attention to them, just blocked the entrance.

*

Wolf Mountain.

When Lang Qiao returned, he only had time to deliver a finishing blow to the orcs who hadn't died yet.

The orcs guarding Wolf Mountain were all injured to some degree. Lang Qiao’s team stayed behind to help clean up Wolf Mountain and, following the priest’s arrangements, provided treatment.

Lin Qiu lay in the grass nest, fainting the moment his adrenaline faded.

He was still too weak. Even after training with Lang Yan, it was too difficult to face rogue orcs who had plundered countless tribes.

Lang An and the others had their wounds bandaged and were now guarding Lin Qiu along with the cubs and the stunned rabbit orcs.

Lang Guo sat beside his nest, pulling at his hair in frustration.

If he had known, he should have let Qiu guard the cubs while he fought.

The old priest said in a tired voice: "Stop pulling your hair. Qiu is fine; he just needs to rest."

Qiu had many wounds, the worst being on his back, where sharp claws had embedded and nearly torn off a layer of skin. If the claws had been any deeper, he might never have been able to stand again.

Plus, with the excessive blood loss, it was normal for him to faint.

Wolf Mountain calmed down, but Lang Qiao and his team didn't dare leave.

He immediately arranged for orcs to search the vicinity of Wolf Mountain to see if there were any hidden rogue orcs left.

Meanwhile, far away in the valley, Lang Bing and Lang Shi, who had set out from Wolf Mountain, finally arrived.

They were exhausted, but fortunately, the Black Feather orcs came to inform them that the King had ordered them to guard the valley and wait for the Black Bear tribe orcs.

If they dared to return, leave none alive.

But they waited for a long time, from night until day, and even dragged the orcs from next door out for interrogation, but didn't get any useful information.

The orcs were worried about the cubs on one hand and Wolf Mountain on the other.

The scent of their companions remaining in the valley told them that wolf orcs had been there, which meant some had already chased ahead of them—a meager comfort.

Waiting and waiting, watching the sun rise and set, the longer it took, the more panicked they became.

Further south of the valley, Lang Yan and his orcs had been searching for the cubs for two days. Even the nearest White Sparrow orcs had heard the news and come to help, but they still found nothing.

The orcs’ eyes were bloodshot, yet they couldn't feel the hunger in their stomachs.

Another day passed, and the wolf orcs returned to the lake.

Lang Hu was becoming mentally unstable.

Lang Bei looked at her partner; in just three days, his temples had turned gray, as if he had aged significantly.

"King, let's go back." Lang Bei finally said wearily.

Lang Sheng was their cub, and they had already delayed for so long. Only by having the parents speak could the other orcs feel less guilty about giving up the search.

There was more than one cub in the tribe, and more than one orc; they were part of the hunting and gathering team and had their own responsibilities.

The White Sparrow orcs landed on a dead tree, staring blankly at the giant bird nest above. Below the nest, sunlight spilled down, the lake water clear, the white bones visible in the water.

Que Twelve-Bai dove into the water, eyes wide, observing the orc bones.

Lang Yan noticed and immediately approached, but in the water plants near the shore, he picked up a feather.

Under the sunlight, the feather was emerald green, bright as a gemstone.

And Que Two-Bai immediately shot out of the water, saying: "The bones inside are not from these past few days. The meat on them was long ago eaten clean by small fish."

Lang Yan: "Return to the tribe!"

At this time, Wolf Mountain.

Lin Qiu lay in the grass nest, carried out by several orcs to bask in the sun. He squinted at the group of exceptionally beautiful... peacocks?

There was also a white one.

"Qiu!" said the white-feathered orc.

Instantly, a flood of memories surged forth, and Lin Qiu was speechless.

Being deceived, being pampered and praised, eloping with an orc, running away with food...

Lin Qiu suddenly hid his head.

Bai Song looked at Lin Qiu, who was very different from before, and called out subconsciously. The next moment, he felt a gaze filled with intense hostility fall upon him. Bai Song shivered, his reason suddenly returning, and he silently hid behind his captain.

Lu Ren coughed twice, feeling relieved as he watched the two wolf cub orcs they had brought back rush toward the opposite side.

"Cubs... how did you bring them back?" the wolf orc asked.

The story went back to the battle during the snow season.

At that time, the Green Eye tribe had been driven out by the branch tribe because of the snow season incident, so they kept heading north, walked for a long time, and finally chose to settle there.

That lake was also included in their territory.

The lake water was clear, and they had intended to use it as a water source, but they didn't expect to see two Gray Wing orcs coming over not long after. Judging by their appearance, they came often.

Even though the Green Eye orcs had been heavily injured by the branch tribe’s wolf orcs, they were also of the Feather tribe and numerous, so they could beat the two Gray Wing orcs.

Besides, they couldn't easily give up the place they had found after so much hardship.

Just as they were ready to take action, who could have expected that the next time the others came, they would directly snatch three cubs.

"How could there be three cubs?" Lin Qiu couldn't help but ask.

Lang Sheng and Lang Yuan huddled against him, suddenly cowering.

Lang Sheng said: "That cub called them Uncle, and said Xiong Chen was his father."

Lin Qiu was stunned.

Even their own tribe’s cubs were being targeted...

Lang Guo sat beside Lin Qiu and said: "Rogue orcs usually don't have cubs, and usually don't have a tribe."

They wouldn't settle in one place for long, so cubs were a burden to them.

Even if they had them... Lang Guo frowned, thinking of that possibility, and had to suppress the feeling of disgust.

As for not having a tribe, it was because the rogue orc teams that didn't look small were mostly formed halfway; they were all outlaws, so how could they dare to trust each other.

The Green Eye orcs had indeed saved the cubs by chance.

At this moment, the Gray Wing orcs had also been captured by the Green Eye orcs and were now lying on the ground, half-dead.

The old priest, as the orc currently in charge of the tribe, said: "Thank you for bringing the cubs back; the Wolf tribe will be grateful to you. But the tribe is not convenient right now; wait until the Wolf King returns..."

"Old Priest."

The wolf orcs looked across.

Lu Ren smiled bitterly: "We came here this time not for anything else, but to be like the Rabbit tribe."

"Don't even think about it!" Lang Mo bristled as if he had been stepped on.

"Considering we brought the cubs back, give us a chance..."

"Then go tell the King!"

*

When Lang Yan returned with the hunting and gathering team, Lang Shi and the others had also brought back the sub-orcs and cubs from the valley.

The orcs were travel-worn. In just a few days, their eyes were unfocused, and they were shrouded in immense anger and helplessness.

The cubs hadn't been found, and they didn't know how to face their clansmen...

"King!"

Lang Yan froze, standing in place, watching the cubs laughing and rushing toward him with their arms open. But halfway there, they were grabbed by Lang Bei and Lang Hu, who had suddenly rushed out.

"Dad, Mom! Put me down!"

The cubs laughed, being tickled by their own parents.

Lang Yuan had already rushed to Lang Yan, obediently pulling his hand and affectionately pressing her cheek against the back of his hand.

Lang Yan picked her up.

The other orcs behind stood blankly, some rubbing their eyes hard, thinking they were hallucinating from not eating for days.

"How did you get back?" Lang Yan asked, trying to soften his voice, but it remained extremely tense.

Fortunately, the cubs weren't afraid, snuggling against him and saying in a milky voice: "Uncle A-Yue saved us."

Lang Yan looked at the Green Eye orcs in front of the mountain, and there was nothing he didn't understand.

He noticed one with white hair, paused for a moment, and immediately entered the cave.

Usually, his partner would have run out to greet him with a smile. But he had been standing outside for a while and hadn't seen him; Lang Yan felt a bad premonition.

Sure enough, upon entering the cave, he saw Lin Qiu lying in the grass nest.

Lang Yan quickened his pace and rushed to his side.

"King..." Lin Qiu smiled at him.

Lang Yan pulled away the animal skin blanket covering him. When he saw the scars all over his body, a surge of violent emotion welled up in his heart.

Lin Qiu grabbed his hand.

"King, I'm fine. The priest said I'll be better after lying down for a few days."

"There are guests outside; they've been waiting for you for a day, you go first... mmph."

Lin Qiu’s lip was bitten hard by Lang Yan.

Tears welled up in his eyes, purely from the pain.

Lang Yan: "Wait here properly."

Lang Yuan covered her eyes with her hands, grinning.

Lang Yan pulled the animal skin blanket back to cover Lin Qiu with extreme gentleness and placed the cub beside the grass nest where he was lying. He said to the cub: "Watch your Uncle Qiu, don't let him move."

"Okay!" the cub replied seriously.

The orcs were back. They hadn't eaten for days, and only when they stopped did they feel famished.

They didn't mind the dried fish in the cave anymore, grabbing them and gnawing away.

Lang An couldn't bear to watch and wanted to make meat soup, but was held down by Lang Bei.

"We'll do it."

Lang An’s hand was injured, the wound not shallow, so it shouldn't get wet.

The orcs gnawed on dried fish to fill their stomachs while making meat soup. Lang Yan greeted the Green Eye orcs and led them directly to a newly built cabin on the other side.
chapters.title: 第148章
chapters.source_text:
“走了？”
“哈，走了。”
熊沉带着兽人从西边林子里走出来，兽人各个身躯雄健。
赤裸裸的目光穿过长廊，扫过山洞口，兽人笑起来，牙齿泛黄，面如恶鬼。
林楸看到他们那一瞬，立刻明白过来。
他们是冲着狼山来的。
幼崽被护到山洞最里侧，亚兽人守在山洞洞口。狼莫看着冲着山洞而来的陌生兽人，几乎一眼断定，他们是流浪兽人！
狼莫一声令下，小队成员直接冲了出去。
林楸直面部落的第一次厮杀。
他脸色苍白，目光却冷静至极。他视线紧紧追随在自家兽人身上，八头巨狼直接冲出廊道，将兽人隔绝在外。
利爪交锋，熊兽人的体型甚至比狼兽人更大。
两相碰撞，如闷雷声炸响。灰尘腾腾，狼莫与熊沉拼杀，两个兽人翻身撞在廊柱上，廊柱甚至发出不堪重负的吱呀声。
砰的一下——
林楸急急看去，狼西被大猫兽人压制，那兽人张开口直接从狼西腿上撕扯下来一块肉。
林楸顿时要冲出去，狼安却将他往里一挡。
林楸趔趄后退，身体擦过瑟瑟发抖兔兽人，林楸以为他们怕，正想安抚几句。可兔葵忽然抓住他的手，声音急促道：“楸，是流浪兽人！他们要吃兽人，我们的部落就是被他们袭击的。”
林楸猛地抬头，看向洞外。
那大猫兽人满口鲜血，刚刚从狼西腿上撕咬下来的那一块肉已经被他咀嚼着吃——
“他们是冲着我们来的！”
不是储存的食物。
那狼生他们……
眨眼间，十多个兽人突破狼莫他们的防守，直接冲到洞口。狼安、狼起还有小狼迎接上去，兽人们在洞口厮杀。
含着腥臭的风袭来，林楸遍体生寒。
他甚至顾不得去想被抓走的小兽人会怎么样，急速交代道：“葵，你们进里面去，果，带着幼崽不许出来！”
林楸转头，加入了战斗中。
亚兽人们死守洞口，不能让流浪兽人往洞中进一步。
林楸从未有过这样整个人如同被撕扯的时候，那可是两个幼崽啊！
他死死盯着试图进洞的流浪兽人，滔天的怒火充斥胸腔，每一次下爪都勾扯出带血的皮肉。
他以前说用嘴撕咬猎物，多脏。
可这次他咬了一下又一下，不要命似的……背脊被利爪撕破，黑色的狼毛藏住满身的伤口，每扑咬一次，狼毛上飞溅出血点，洒落在曾经干净的廊道上。
流浪兽人虽然比他们多一倍，但狼兽人不是吃素的。
林楸眼前一片血红，只有一个念头——
快点，再快点。
他摇摇欲坠，余光看见狼起被咬住前腿，径直扑过去，却被兽人撞得砸在地上，浑身如同被碾碎一般疼痛难忍。
山洞里，兔兽人们红着眼，身体的恐惧让他们浑身绵软，想帮忙也挪不动任何步子。
狼果看着狼安他们受伤，心急如焚。
他想过去，可身后是部落的幼崽。
狼果咬咬牙，盯着面前十几个兔兽人，忽然道：“葵，你看着幼崽。”
兔葵使劲摇头，他死死将自己的幼崽压在怀中，反复道：“报仇，报仇……要报仇！”
兔葵将兔萝塞给狼果，红着眼睛，一下冲了出去。
其他兔兽人猛地抬头，看着已经快要进入洞口的流浪兽人，看着浴血奋战的狼兽人……
他们看清那大猫兽人一刹那，双目赤红。
就是他！
就是他带着流浪兽人，吃了他们的族人！
不知哪来的勇气，兔艾浑身迸发出一股劲儿，心中只有杀了兽人泄恨的念头。
瞬间，十多个兔族人加入。
兔艾兔葵直接冲着大猫兽人去，他们抓住兽人耳朵，重重冲着他脖颈咬去。
兽人吃疼，仅仅是一挥手，便把背上的兔葵掀翻。
兔艾却死死咬住他后颈的肉，无论兽人怎么撕扯都不松口。
兽人直接极重地捶打他身上，甚至利爪嵌入他身体，兔艾呕血，咬得更狠。
隔了几个兽人的狼雨眼看他快被打死了，一下子冲过来，顺势趁机割破兽人仰起的脖子。
可这兔兽人还是不松口。
“兔艾！”
“阿尤叔，阿爸，阿弟……”
兔艾眼角挂着泪，被狼雨强制掰开嘴，扔到后面去。
今日无风，柔软的白云依旧朵朵散在空中。狼山前却充斥着血腥味，灶台被推翻，陶锅破碎，桌子凳子砸的稀烂……腾起的灰尘笼罩住这片厮杀的兽人。
随着狼莫跟狼西猛地将黑熊兽人一甩。
熊沉脊背重重砸在廊柱上。
狼莫暴喝：“让开。”
砰的一声——
连廊坍塌，试图爬起来的熊沉脊背被彻底砸断，口中吐出大口大口的鲜血。
护卫小队没有任何兽人看他一眼，他同行的同伴甚至踩着他的身体爬出来。还没来得及高兴，瞬间，喉咙一疼——
兽人睁大眼睛难以置信亲眼看着自己就被狼莫收割了性命。
护卫小队解决了拦住他们的兽人，迅速往山洞口去。
狼兽人，尤其是雄性狼兽人，无论是力量还是速度，都是兽神大陆大多数兽人比不上的。
除了大猫跟熊兽人能让他们受制，其余兽人打不过他们半分。
即便是狼族亚兽人，数量差异下，也能抵挡他们一会儿。
亚兽人将他们拦在外，狼莫小队的兽人如煞神一般，开始反向收割他们的性命。
被包围的流浪兽人用不了一息，喉咙被刺破。狼兽人如同宰杀猎物一般把他们弄死，鲜血迸射了整个廊道。
其余流浪兽人见势不对，四散要逃。
狼兽人们一个也不打算放过。
一直躲在厮杀边缘处下黑手的豹兽人跑得最快，眼看要跑到林中，忽的，林子里射出来一只箭，直冲兽人的眼睛。
啪的一下，眼球爆裂开。
兽人捂住眼睛疼得撕心裂肺，惊嚎着满地打滚。
追过来的狼溶、狼川、狼滔三个小狼脚步一顿，爪子齐齐对准兽人脖子一划，聒噪的声音消失。
他们眼神冷漠，抬头，就见三个白雀兽人急匆匆撞出林子。
“不好了不好了……狼王呢？”白雀对上他们的视线，吓得一下炸成球。
“不在。”狼溶回头，看着一片狼藉的狼山。
白雀兽人见状，飞行许久翅膀已是无力，直直地掉在地上。
坏了！
狼王让他们监视黑熊部落，他们发现不对劲就赶过来。可路途遥远，这个时候的大泽全是水，他们一口气飞不过来，只能从林子那边绕。
还是晚了！
没想到这些兽人竟然跑到狼部落来了！
*
远在东南部，狩猎队的兽人们还在抓捕猎物。
黑羽兽人找来时，狼兽人们还正奇怪，可是下一瞬，全慌了神。
“幼崽被抓走了，狼石带了一小队的兽人追了过去。抓他们的是羽族，飞得很快……”
兽人们扔下猎物用尽全力跟着黑羽兽人跑，待跑到大泽，狼岩忽然道：“乔！你们回去。”
“是！”狼乔没有犹豫，带着队伍就离开。
其余兽人没有丝毫停留，急速往西南方向奔袭。
飞行半空的黑羽兽人四处寻找，半空中突然飞回来一个小兽人报信，“阿叔，他们飞往山谷南部去了！”
狼岩想起那黑熊部落，眼神狠戾。
“游，你带五个兽人去山谷。其他兽人，跟着黑羽兽人！”
狼兽人们全部听从狼岩的指挥，没有一个提出疑问。他们快速在林中穿梭，甚至带起烈烈的风声。
绕行大泽时，狼岩看着那悠悠水面。
他早该听楸的话！
狼兽人不能像黑羽兽人一样直飞，绕过大泽耽搁了一点时间。从西南方向离开部落领地，兽人分两队，此时，又有一个黑羽小兽人回来，告知方位。
而在已经距离狼山很远很远的地方。
羽乐翅膀脱力，发着抖，还在奋力往前飞。
羽涯追上来，看他强撑的样子，直接飞到他身.下去，像背着他一般。
羽乐：“你快点跟上去。”
离开狼山前，几个黑羽兽人追击着那个灰翅兽人。可半途，又不知道哪里又出来一个灰翅兽人。
小兽人当即分散，跟来的两个成年黑羽兽人被气得不得不也分开追着他们。
小兽人不知道哪里来的爆发力，成年黑羽兽人甚至都差点跟丢。
为了让狼兽人确定方位，他们飞行一段时间，成年兽人就安排一个小兽人回去报信。
狼兽人们就靠着他们的定位不断往前，可即便再快再快，当看到精疲力竭倒在地上的羽乐和羽涯时，狼岩差点腿一软。
早已经是后半夜了。
湖水映着月光，圈圈波纹散开。
狼兽人迅速爬上湖边的大树，却捡到一点幼崽的绒毛。
灰色的，格外滑亮。
闻着那熟悉的幼崽味道，还有那灰翅兽人身上浑浊的臭味，查看巢中情况的雄兽人忽然摔了下来。
“狼呼！”
狼呼发着抖，顷刻红了眼眶。
“幼崽、幼崽……”
他的幼崽。
这里有好浓烈的血腥味，是新鲜的血，是幼崽的血……
狼岩看着他手中的狼牙项链，那还是楸给狼生串的。他深吸一口气，所有情绪被强压下。
他迅速爬上树翻找窝中，摸到一手血，他手一颤，凑在鼻尖小心闻了闻。
兽人们傻傻看着，各个双眼通红，焦躁踱步，他们想立刻把兽人找出来弄死。
可片刻，狼岩急速冲下来，立刻下令道：“搜索附近，查找一切灰翅兽人的踪迹。”
敢动他们的幼崽，他要让他们生不如死！
*
山谷。
狼游带着五个兽人是上半夜到的。
他们隐匿气息，先搜寻了一遍，却没发现附近有他们幼崽的气息，甚至其他雄兽人的气息都没有。
兽人们悄悄靠近，忽然闯进山洞，却见山洞里绑着三个亚兽人，还有一个幼崽。
而他们中间，放着一堆被啃食干净的白骨。
那、那分明是兽人！
狼游心口一紧，冲上去，抓着其中一个亚兽人就问：“我们的幼崽呢？！”
亚兽人瑟缩，呆呆看着他，嘴里细细念叨着什么。
“不要、不要……不要吃我，不要吃我……”
狼游松开他，几近踉跄。
是流浪兽人！
是会吃兽人的流浪兽人！
那他们的幼崽……狼游后背猛地升起一股强烈的寒意。
霎时，他跑出山洞，留下一个在这里看守。
他们里里外外重新把整个山谷翻找完，没有其他兽人，也没有幼崽，却又在后山看见一堆白骨！
有雪鹰兽人的，也有其他兽人的。
无一例外，都是……兽人。
狼游狠狠闭了闭眼。
“队长。”
“立刻，继续找幼崽！”
这个部落兽人不多，狼山那边狼莫狼安他们在，狼乔也赶回去了，他们此刻回去也赶不上。只能扩大范围，继续找幼崽。
兽人们点头，迅速追着狼岩的方向去。
至于山洞里的兽人，他们并没带上，也没多管，只把洞口堵上了。
*
狼山。
狼乔赶回来时，只来得及给没死的兽人补一爪子。
守着狼山的兽人或多或少受了伤，狼乔小队留下来，帮着收拾狼山，再听着祭司安排，给他们治疗。
林楸趴在草窝里，卸了劲儿的一瞬间就晕了过去。
他还是太弱了，就算跟着狼岩训练过，对上抢劫了不知多少部落的流浪兽人也太吃力。
狼安他们的伤口已经包扎好了，这会儿跟幼崽都守着林楸，还有被弄晕的兔兽人们。
狼果坐在他草窝旁边，懊恼地抓着头发。
早知道该让楸守着幼崽，他去打。
老祭司声音疲累道：“别扯自己头发了，楸没事，养养就好了。”
楸身上伤口多，最重的就在后背上，被利爪嵌入几乎撕下来一层皮。爪子再深一点，他这辈子可能就站不起来了。
再加上流血过多，晕过去也正常。
狼山平静下来，狼乔他们却不敢离开。
他直接安排兽人搜寻狼山附近，看看是否还有藏起来的流浪兽人。
而远在山谷，这时候，从狼山出发的狼冰跟狼石才赶到。
他们跑不动了，幸好有黑羽兽人过来通知，王让他们守在山谷，等着黑熊部落的兽人。
如果他们敢回来，一个不留。
可他们等了很久，从晚上等到白天，又把隔壁的兽人拎出来审问，也没得到任何有用的消息。
兽人们一边担心幼崽，一边担心狼山那边。
山谷残留的同伴的气息让他们知道有狼兽人来过，这说明有兽人已经追到自己前头去了，勉强算个安慰。
等啊等，看着日出日落，时间越久，他们越心慌。
山谷更南边的位置，狼岩带着兽人寻找幼崽，已经过去了两天。甚至离这边最近的白雀兽人听到消息也过来帮他们找，依旧都一无所获。
兽人们眼睛熬红了，肚里的饥饿感却像感觉不到。
又一个白日，狼兽人们回到了湖旁。
狼呼有些精神恍惚了。
狼贝看着自己的伴侣，短短三天，对方鬓角斑白，好似一下老了许多。
“王，回吧。”狼贝终于疲惫道。
狼生是他们的幼崽，他们已经耽搁许久，由做父母的开口，才好让兽人们少些愧疚地放弃寻找。
部落不止一个幼崽，也不止一个兽人，他们是狩猎采集队的，也有自己的责任。
白雀兽人们停在枯树上，直愣愣看着树上的巨大鸟巢。鸟巢下端，阳光倾洒，湖水透亮，水中那白骨清晰可见。
雀十二白一头扎进水中，瞪大眼睛观察那些兽人骨头。
狼岩注意到，也立即靠近，却在近岸旁的水草中，捡起来一片羽毛。
阳光下，羽毛碧绿，亮如宝石。
而雀二白立刻蹿出水面，道：“里面的骨头都不是这两天的。上面肉早被小鱼啃食得光秃秃的。”
狼岩：“回部落！”
此时，狼山。
林楸趴在草窝，被几个兽人抬出去晒太阳。他眯着眼睛看着阳光下羽毛格外漂亮的一群……孔雀？
还有个白色的。
“楸！”那白色羽毛的兽人道。
瞬间，一股记忆涌现出来，林楸讷讷无言。
被哄骗，被捧着夸奖，跟兽人私奔，带着食物逃跑……
林楸倏地将脑袋藏起来。
白松看着与从前极不一样的林楸下意识叫他，下一瞬，他感觉到面前一阵强烈敌意的视线落在他身上。白松一抖，理智骤然回归，默默往自家队长身后藏了藏。
绿壬闷咳两声，看着他们带回来的两个狼兽人幼崽冲向对面，心里松了一口气。
“幼崽……怎么是你们带回来的？”狼兽人问。
事情还要从雪季那场战斗后说起。
那会儿，绿眼部落因为雪季那事儿被支部落驱逐，便一直北上，走了许久，最后选择在那边定居。
那片湖也被他们划入了领地范围。
那湖水清透，他们本来打算当做水源地的，没曾想没过多久就看见两个灰翅兽人过来，看他们的样子，还是经常过去。
绿眼兽人就算被支部落的狼兽人重伤，但同为羽族，数量又多，他们也打得过两个灰翅兽人。
而且他们历尽艰辛找到的地方怎么能轻易相让。
等他们准备好动手，谁能料到，对方再过来时直接就抓了三个幼崽。
“怎么会有三个幼崽？”林楸忍不住问。
狼生跟狼圆挨着他，忽然瑟缩一下。
狼生道：“那个幼崽喊他们阿叔，说熊沉是他阿父。”
林楸错愕。
自己部落的幼崽都动手……
狼果坐在林楸旁边，却是道：“流浪兽人一般不会有幼崽，也一般不会有部落。”
他们并不会在一个地方长久地定居，所以幼崽是他们的累赘。
就算有……狼果皱了皱眉，想到那种可能性，不得不强忍下那股恶心。
至于不会有部落，那是因为看起来不算小的流浪兽人队伍多是半道结队，他们都是亡命之徒，哪里敢相互信任。
绿眼兽人确实是碰巧救了幼崽。
此刻，灰翅兽人也被绿眼兽人抓来了，现在半死不活地躺在地上。
老祭司作为现在部落还能主事的兽人，道：“谢谢你们把幼崽送来，狼部落会感谢你们。不过现在部落不方便，等狼王回来……”
“老祭司。”
狼兽人们看着对面。
绿壬苦笑道：“我们这次过来，不为别的，是想跟兔部落一样。”
“想都别想！”狼莫如同被踩了一爪子，炸毛道。
“看在我们把幼崽送回来的份儿上，给我们一个机会……”
“那你跟王去说吧！”
*
狼岩带着狩猎采集队回来时，狼石他们顺手也把山谷那边的亚兽人跟幼崽带回来了。
兽人们风尘仆仆，才几天时间，各个双目涣散，浑身笼罩在巨大的愤怒与无措中。
幼崽没找回来，他们不知道该怎么面对族人……
“王！”
狼岩一怔，站在原地，看着幼崽笑着冲他张开手扑过来。可半途，被忽然冲出去的狼贝跟狼呼抓住。
“阿父阿母！放我下来啊！”
幼崽笑着，被自己亲兽人摸着浑身痒痒。
狼圆早已经冲到狼岩跟前，乖巧地去拉他的手，依恋地将脸颊贴着他手背。
狼岩将她抱起来。
后头的其他兽人直愣愣地傻站着，还有狠狠揉眼睛的，以为是几天没吃饭出现了幻觉。
“怎么回来的？”狼岩尽量放柔和了声音问，可声音紧绷得厉害。
好在幼崽不怕，乖乖贴着他，奶声奶气道：“阿月叔救了我们。”
狼岩看着山前的绿眼兽人，还有什么不明白的。
他注意到其中一个白发的，目光顿了下，立即进山洞去。
换做往常，他的伴侣此刻会笑着跑出来迎接他。可他在外面站了有一会儿了还不见人，狼岩心道不好。
果不其然，进了山洞，就看见趴在草窝里的林楸。
狼岩加快步子冲到他前面。
“王……”林楸冲着他笑。
狼岩却一把拉开他身上盖着的兽皮毯，当看到他满身的伤痕，心头顿时涌起一股暴虐情绪。
林楸抓住他手。
“王，我没事，祭司说躺几天就好了。”
“外面还有客人，他们已经等了你一天了，你先去……唔。”
林楸唇角被狼岩狠狠咬了一口。
他眼里溢出些泪花，完全是疼的。
狼岩：“好好等着。”
狼圆双手捂住眼睛，咧开小嘴笑。
狼岩用极轻的力道将兽皮毯拉回来给林楸盖好，又将幼崽放在他躺着的草窝边，他跟幼崽道：“看着你阿楸叔，让他不许动。”
“好！”幼崽严肃应下。
兽人们回来了，他们几天没吃饭，一停下来，才觉得饿得发慌。
山洞里放着的鱼干也不嫌弃了，抱着就啃。
狼安看不过眼，要去做肉汤，结果被狼贝按住。
“我们来。”
狼安伤了手，伤口不浅，不宜沾水。
兽人们一边咬着鱼干垫肚子，一边做肉汤。狼岩则招呼绿眼兽人直接去另一边新建的小屋中。

chapters.translated_text:
The small huts had just been built and hadn't been assigned to the orcs yet.

They were empty inside, but warm and dry.

The leaders of both sides went inside. Green Ren looked at the hut built entirely of red stone and marveled in his heart, but he didn't dare to ask directly.

Both sides sat down.

"Chief of the Green Eye tribe, Green Ren."

"Lang Yan."

Green Ren looked at the cold and stern Wolf King in front of him, gathered his thoughts, and first recounted how they had saved the cubs.

"After we saved the cubs, we sent them straight back. Don't worry, except for the other cub that didn't survive, the two of them are fine."

"What do you want?"

Green Ren gave a bitter smile and said, "We want to be like the Rabbit tribe. I don't know if the Wolf King would agree?"

They knew that this was Wolf Mountain, a place that sent a large amount of food to branch tribes every year.

They also knew their request was excessive, but the Green Eye orcs were truly at their wits' end.

Because of the battle with the branch tribe during the snow season, the male orcs of the Green Eye tribe with any fighting strength had been thoroughly beaten. Although those who survived made it through the snow season, some were left with disabilities.

Although he was still the chief of the Green Eye tribe, he was riddled with illness and no longer had the ability to continue leading the tribe to survive.

As for the other orcs, there were few who could take charge of the tribe.

Besides the situation of the tribe, what was more serious was that they had traveled north all the way, passing through so many places, and still hadn't seen much prey.

At that moment, Green Ren knew that they couldn't survive by hunting alone.

There were already too few wild beasts outside... so few that seeing a herd of a dozen or so beasts was enough to surprise them.

But after the surprise came endless panic.

With so little prey, not even enough for their own orcs, how could they feed the tribe?

Only the Wolf tribe, only Wolf Mountain, gave him a glimmer of hope.

Lang Yan: "What if we don't agree?"

Green Ren couldn't even manage a bitter smile now.

He lowered his head, as if his neck bone had snapped, his head hanging limply.

"Then... we can only wait for death."

As he spoke, he began to cough hoarsely, but this time, no matter what, he couldn't stop.

The Green Eye orcs guarding outside were so anxious they wanted to rush in, but the Wolf orcs standing opposite them were watching like tigers eyeing their prey.

They hung their heads in dejection.

The chief was right; the Wolf orcs were not easy to talk to.

Even if they had saved the Wolf orcs' cubs, the fact remained that they had previously deceived Lang Qiu and stood against the branch tribe; after all, they had even tried to rob them right to their faces.

Lang Yan: "Whether you wait for death or not has nothing to do with us."

Green Ren covered his mouth, his face turning red from the effort, before he finally suppressed the cough.

He took a few deep breaths and said, "Then we won't disturb you any further."

Lang Yan: "The Wolf tribe will provide food as a token of gratitude, but we cannot agree to anything else."

The meat soup was soon ready. Seeing them come out, Lang Mo said, "King, let's let them have a meal. They haven't eaten all day yesterday; I'm afraid they won't make it back."

"Dad, I'm so hungry." Green Yue lowered her head dejectedly and rubbed the cub's head.

Green Jiao gently held her partner's hand, "It's okay, we'll think of other ways."

Lang Yan agreed to let them have a meal, then strode toward the large cave.

Lang Mo hurriedly told the orcs to get bowls, distributed some to the Green Eye orcs, and the rest was for their own orcs to eat.

The meat and mushroom soup was smooth, tender, and fresh. The Green Eye orcs, who had never eaten such good things, didn't care about the heat and devoured it greedily.

The Wolf orcs, who had been hungry for days, also got a good share, and some orcs thoughtfully ladled some out to take into the large cave for the injured orcs.

Everyone ate heartily, even finishing the soup at the bottom of the bowls.

After eating, Green Ren felt that his body had never felt as comfortable as it did now since the snow season began. He looked at the Wolf tribe's huts, the Wolf tribe's pottery pots, the Wolf tribe... suddenly, he felt dizzy.

Just as vigilance rose in Green Ren's heart, *thump*, he collapsed onto the table, losing consciousness instantly.

Immediately after, all the Green Eye orcs were knocked out.

Lang Mo chuckled happily and kicked Bai Song, "That'll teach you to deceive orcs!"

While dragging Bai Song toward the cave entrance, he shouted, "Qiu! Look, I've knocked out your old flame..."

Lang Yan's gaze pierced through, staring at Lang Mo.

Lang Mo was so scared he loosened his grip, and Bai Song slammed onto the ground, lying at the cave entrance.

"Wait." Lin Qiu said.

Lang Yan's eyes were fierce.

Lin Qiu suddenly grabbed Lang Yan's wrist and shook his head, "You, what did you put in it?"

"Circle-grass! Eat one and you'll see circles, then fall asleep!"

"You..."

Lin Qiu's head tilted, and he was caught in time by Lang Yan before he passed out.

At the same time, all the orcs who had eaten the meat soup collapsed in a heap.

Lang Mo rubbed his head, his feet wobbling.

Eh? Wait a minute, why does it feel like he's also...

Lang Mo tripped over his own feet and fell to the ground, his eyelids drooping.

Instantly, all the orcs in the cave were fast asleep, even the cubs on the backs of the adult orcs were sleeping with their chubby bellies rising and falling.

And the Wolf orcs, Rabbit orcs, Black Feather orcs, Green Eye orcs outside the cave, as well as the two Grey Wing orcs brought back and those sub-orcs and cubs, all fell into a deep sleep as well.

For a time, Wolf Mountain was so quiet that only the snoring of the orcs could be heard.

Dust floated in the sunlight, gradually returning to calm.

The sunlight was dazzling; no one knew how much time had passed.

The moment Lang Yan opened his eyes, he grabbed a green-skinned fruit from the table and threw it at Lang Mo, who was lying in the cave.

"Ouch!" Lang Mo climbed up, and before his eyes were even open, he said aggressively, "Who hit me!"

Then he saw their Wolf King with a grim look in his eyes.

Lang Yan was worried about the injuries on Lin Qiu's body and didn't know if this grass had any effect on him. He called Lin Qiu several times and tried to find the priest, but couldn't wake anyone up.

Lang Yan stared at Lang Mo again, his gaze like a knife, shimmering with cold light, as if he could kill the orc.

Lang Mo turned and ran, waking up his own orcs one by one as he went.

Fortunately, the Wolf orcs often ate Circle-grass, so they had some drug resistance; a few slaps were enough to wake them up.

Now, the Green Eye orcs couldn't leave today and would have to sleep in their tribe...

The Wolf orcs woke up one after another.

At first, they suspected they hadn't slept in a long time and were just tired. Then, seeing the swelling on Lang Mo's forehead, their memories stopped at him dragging the Green Eye orcs and proudly talking to the King in the cave...

They stared at Lang Mo, their expressions changed, and then they immediately pounced on him and gave him a beating!

Lang Bei was annoyed; her perfectly good pot of soup, when did this bad thing throw the Circle-grass in!

Thinking this, she gave Lang Mo another slap.

Lang Mo: "Woo—"

"Shut up!"

"Aw." Lang Mo curled up into a corner quietly.

Wasn't he doing this to vent for Qiu and the branch tribe? Was he wrong?!

The Green Eye orcs shouldn't have eaten Circle-grass before, so they would probably sleep until tomorrow.

The orcs were helpless and could only drag them to an abandoned cave.

It was better that they were asleep; no need to be on guard all the time.

As for the orcs they brought back, the Grey Wing orcs were unconscious from their own severe injuries, while the sub-orcs and cubs were given some meat soup, but not much, and they gradually woke up.

Once awake, it was easier to ask questions.

It was already afternoon, and the sunset dyed half the sky red.

Lang Yan told the orcs to drag them outside. The sub-orcs closed their eyes, avoiding the sunlight, as if they weren't used to it.

Lang Yan looked at each orc one by one; they were all sub-orcs of different races.

Deer tribe, Sheep tribe, and Feather tribe, there were three in total.

The cub wasn't their cub either; it didn't look like any of the orcs, and the race was different—it was a Cloud Leopard cub.

"Are you the partners of those stray orcs?"

The sub-orcs cowered and squeezed backward.

The cub was sandwiched in the middle, squeezed until it couldn't breathe, and didn't move like a puppet.

"King, their brains seem to have some problems." Lang Shi sat next to Lang Yan, his chest muscles huge, which was very intimidating to other orcs.

"Go call Bing over."

Before long, Lang Bing came over.

Lang Yan signaled for him to examine the sub-orcs.

Lang Bing was full of cold air, still not having recovered from the lingering fear of the cubs being lost.

He indifferently poked at the few orcs and then said: "Starved too severely, and scared many times, their mental state is not right. There are also many injuries on their bodies."

Given the state of the few sub-orcs, it was certain that nothing could be asked now.

Lang Yan could only say: "Lock them in a separate cave and see if they can be cured first."

"King! One of the Grey Wing orcs is dead!" Lang Jin ran over hurriedly with a few little wolves.

"The other one woke up?"

"No, but he was injured too severely by the Green Eye orcs, and it's unknown if he can wake up."

Lang Yan stood up and went to the Black Cave in the back mountain where the Grey Wing orcs were being held.

The little wolves wanted to go in, but Lang Yan looked at them and said: "Call your uncle to come and deal with the dead one first."

"Oh." Lang Jin originally wanted to see what the King planned to do, but could only leave reluctantly.

Soon, Lang Shi arrived.

The entrance to the Black Cave was low and the inside was very deep, so it always looked pitch black.

Suddenly, a hoarse cry of pain came from inside, as if the pain was extreme, the words intermittent. Lang Shi looked at the dark cave, feeling his scalp tingle.

"Uncle."

Lang Shi placed his palm on the little wolves' heads and pushed them back.

"Don't come over, go back to the front mountain."

"Uh..." The cry of pain stopped abruptly, followed by a creaking sound like bones rubbing together, extremely subtle, but chilling to hear.

The little wolves turned and ran, busy rubbing their arms, feeling a chill all over.

What on earth was the King doing?

Lang Shi kept guarding the cave entrance, standing still like a stone statue as he heard the orc's voice inside.

When Lang Yan finally came out, he raised his eyes, and the lingering ferocity in them made Lang Shi's body stiffen.

"King." Lang Shi lowered his head.

"Where are the things brought back from the valley?"

"Thrown outside the Red Bird enclosure."

"Deal with the orc inside, move it further away."

"Yes!"

Lang Yan didn't do it himself; he just woke the orc up to ask some questions.

When Lang Shi went in, through the dim light, he saw the Grey Wing orc slumped on the ground.

He was still in the same state as when he arrived, but when Lang Shi picked him up, he saw that his claws seemed to have been crushed to powder, mixed with dirt and stuck to the sand and stones on the ground.

His pupils were dilated, and blood was flowing from the corners of his mouth.

Lang Shi squatted down and pried his mouth open to see that he had bitten off the root of his tongue himself.

"You got off easy."

*

Front mountain.

As soon as Lang Yan appeared, the little wolves immediately gathered around.

They wanted to get close but were scared back by the coldness on him. Clearly, Lang Yan had the same expression as before, but his aura was just different.

Lang Yan scanned the little wolves and said: "Not sleepy?"

The little wolves had been looking for the cubs with them and hadn't slept for several days either. They had just slept for a little while and woken up, and now they all had dark circles under their eyes hanging down to their mouths.

Lang Jin: "Not in a hurry, hehe."

Lang Yan didn't bother with them and went straight to the Red Bird enclosure to find the things Lang Shi had scavenged from the valley.

Just one animal skin bag.

It was pitch black outside, and the greasy dirt had changed the color of the skin. Lang Yan frowned and picked up the bag.

"King! There are so many bugs on the skin bag!" A little wolf suddenly screamed.

Lang Yan flicked his hand, and the skin fell.

The little wolves immediately found some sticks, pried open the skin bag, and picked out the things inside.

Messy animal skins, a few moldy stick-like things, some bone needles, bone knives, and a small package wrapped in a small skin pouch.

Lang Jin poked it with a stick.

"Oh my!"

It was all bugs!

Dense swarms of bugs crawled out from the skin pouch.

"King?"

"Open it."

Lang Jin used the stick to scoop up the rope on the skin pouch, shook it, and then quickly opened it.

When he saw the charred, blocky thing inside, he was even more suspicious.

"Meat chunk?"

"Doesn't look like it." Leopard Xiu behind Lang Jin said quietly.

He squatted down and suddenly smelled a sweet fragrance.

Leopard Xiu suddenly remembered the sweet stones their priest had once obtained from other places, which had the same smell, though that one was lighter in color.

He tentatively pinched a piece, wanting to taste it.

Lang Jin immediately pressed his wrist with the stick, "Aren't you afraid of eating yourself to death!"

Lang Yan watched as the shaken-off bugs still scrambled to get back onto it. He folded a large leaf, wrapped the thing up, and took it to show the priest.

"King? What about these things?"

"Tell your uncle to throw them far away."

"Uncle Lang Shi! The King told you to throw things away!" The little wolf shouted and hurriedly followed Lang Yan.

Lang Shi had already run some distance, but hearing the little wolf's howl, he sighed and replied: "Send it to me!"

Lang Jin wanted to pretend he didn't hear.

"Jin, send it over, I'm waiting!"

Since he had been named, Lang Jin reluctantly turned back.

"Always making us run errands!"
