The cubs sighed and said like little adults, "Finished, it's tiring..."

Lin Qiu patted the cubs' shoulders, "Keep at it."

He looked at his hands and got another handful of dust.

The cubs entered the house one after another, all smelling like little wolves. Lin Qiu immediately withdrew from the canteen, washed his hands clean, and joined Lang Mu and the others in tidying up the dried fish.

On the other side of the square, large leaves were spread on the ground, and various wild vegetables were also drying on them.

Lin Qiu collected from both ends.

These dried fish and vegetables weren't fully dried yet, so they couldn't be piled together at night.

The empty cave was utilized; the beastmen took the wooden racks inside, hung the dried fish at night, and spread out the wild vegetables.

After sealing the door and placing medicinal herbs to repel bugs and squeaking beasts at the entrance, the beastmen went down the mountain.

The sky was a dark crow-blue; standing on Lang Mountain and looking down, the mountain ranges were majestic and rolling, with lush trees.

Not many birds could be seen in the sky; the migratory birds heading to the southern lands had also hurried on their way, flying over the sky above Lang Mountain.

The wind was biting.

Lin Qiu touched his arms; he couldn't wear the vest anymore, he had to change into long-sleeved animal skin clothes.

The last bit of light sank below the horizon, and in the distance, there was endless darkness.

Only the large cave and the canteen on Lang Mountain lit up with a little light, as faint as fireflies in the night.

Lin Qiu looked at the dim light coming through the window and still felt it was a bit too dark.

The tribe used a lot of oil, and the waste oil that could be used for oil lamps was scarce.

The little oil the beastmen ate was animal fat; prey was scarce, so animal fat was even more limited.

They could extract some plant oil.

For example, the walnuts they had on hand, and the peanuts the beastmen planned to plant next year.

Lin Qiu thought bit by bit, his eyes as bright as stars.

"Qiu, let's go down." The beastmen checked the doors of the caves, blocked them with stones, and called for Lin Qiu to go down the mountain.

Lin Qiu walked at the back, thinking of as many oil-bearing plants as possible, but after searching through everything he had learned from the priest, there was nothing else besides the fire tree.

Fire tree branches were flammable; they were actually pine trees.

Pine trees?

Lin Qiu looked up, but the surroundings were pitch black.

His waist tightened, and Lin Qiu was carried down the last two steps. He hurriedly rested his hands on the beastman's shoulders; seeing it was Lang Yan, he raised the corners of his mouth.

"King, you're back."

"What are you thinking about, looking at the sky?"

Lin Qiu's feet touched the ground; Lang Mu and the others who were walking in front had already dashed to the canteen. It was just the two of them here.

Lin Qiu said: "Are the fire trees bearing fruit now?"

"Yeah, they are."

The further north they went, the more fire trees there were. They had even encountered wild beasts that had been hit on the head by fire tree fruits, which they had caught and eaten.

"Are there many fruits?"

"You can have as many as you want."

Within the territory of Lang Mountain, the area north of the Black Feather tribe was full of them.

Lin Qiu pondered.

Making pine nut oil?

No, that's not right; pine trees themselves were rich in oil, and pine oil had extremely wide uses. Pine oil could be used for lighting... this was ready-made plant oil!

And pine oil candles had a long history, and the method was very simple.

The more Lin Qiu thought, the clearer his thoughts became; he was so immersed in his ideas that he didn't even notice Lang Yan had brought him to the entrance of the canteen.

"Lift your feet."

Lin Qiu paused; in the faint light, his eyes were even brighter.

"King, let's get pine oil."

"Okay."

He didn't even ask what pine oil was, agreeing directly.

"We need the fire tree fruits too."

This year's snowy season would have one more type of nut—pine nuts.

Lang Yan saw him standing still, so he directly circled Lin Qiu, picked him up, and went into the house. Without the cold wind, Lin Qiu realized belatedly that his face felt a bit uncomfortable.

Lang Yan held his hand and took him to warm up by the fire.

"Fire tree fruits aren't easy to pick," Lang Mo said, gnawing on the walnuts the gathering team had brought back today.

They had eaten fire tree fruits; they were quite delicious.

But those fruits grew at the very tips of the trees, which were extremely tall; if the beastmen climbed up and were even slightly careless, they would fall to their deaths.

And they were all busy storing food before the snowy season; those fire tree fruits were small and not enough to fill their stomachs.

Lin Qiu: "We can't waste them."

Lin Qiu hadn't looked at the trees before and had forgotten about this treasure.

One fire tree might have few fruits, but there were thousands of them; that would be enough for the beastmen to be full from snacking on pine nuts.

Lang Yan: "Ask if the White Sparrows are willing to help."

"Aren't the Black Feather beastmen closer?" Lin Qiu asked.

"They are big and eat a lot. The White Sparrows can only roast dried fish now; we'll trade dried fish for them to pick the fruits."

"Good idea," Lang Mo laughed, "Too bad they left at noon today."

Lang Yan: "The beastmen going to hunt in the south next year will make a trip, and I'll have Lang Huo send a message over."

第174章
chapters.source_text:
支部落的兽人回来有几天了，狼山的伙食恢复了以往水平。
狩猎队回来晚了，今晚吃的昨天剩下的半扇尖角兽肉。
莲藕要抓紧吃，晚间还是老样子，莲藕炖汤，再加了一个烘的藕饼。
兽人们吃饱喝足，拎着牙刷牙粉去洗漱。
兽人把自个儿收拾干净，打个饱嗝，拍了拍肚子，这才回去睡觉。
现在的日子虽然累，但是一天比一天有盼头。
明天他们依旧要早起，要踏着朝露，继续寻找野菜和猎物。
不多时，油灯灭了。
狼山最后一丝光亮也消失在夜色中。
次日。
天一亮，林楸下了山直奔食堂。
今天一早，放在角落的五个大盆上的盖子不知道被兽人揭开多少次。狼安看着这会儿林楸又来，笑了声道：“怎么样，成了吗？”
林楸：“成了，水清了。”
亚兽人们围过来，帮着把几个盖子都揭开。
狼安：“今天有太阳，正好可以晒。”
林楸：“安，找个大缸来。”
狼安去找大缸，狼潭把盖子收好，放在从连廊搬到食堂的架子上去。
余下兽人，两两一组抬着盆，等狼安拿着洗干净的大缸来，往里倒。
“楸，部落里没空的水缸了，这是食堂装水的那个。”狼安道。
“我叫了狼莫再烧些。”
上面的一层水再静置一晚，没准明天还能再得一点藕粉，一点都不能浪费。
说着话，盆中表层的清水注入水缸，越往下倒，下层的水带着少许藕粉，慢慢有些浑浊了。
倒完，亚兽人们看着盆底剩下的白色东西，用手戳了戳，留下个指印。
“这就是藕粉？”
“就是这个。”林楸点头。
五个盆倒完，剩下的藕粉有多有少，加在一起正好装了兽人们吃饭的碗一碗。
林楸扯了布，铺在藤筛上。
一块一块的藕粉放上去，几个亚兽人围着，忍不住道：“两筐藕，就出了这么点。”
“昨晚那藕饼也不好吃，没味儿了。”
亚兽人们觉得这样做有点浪费食物。
林楸什么也没说，干脆拿了个碗，弄了点藕粉，当着亚兽人们的面用开水一冲。
明明就一勺子，可就那么搅拌搅拌，水变得黏糊糊的。
水有多少，这黏糊糊的东西差不多就有多少。
“尝尝？”林楸道。
狼安接了过去，拎起那勺子一看，透明状的东西挂在勺子上，拉出了丝。
他抿了一口，淡淡的，没什么味道。
其他亚兽人也尝了尝，越吃脸色越奇怪。
“这跟藕完全不一样了。”
“谁能想到是藕做的。”
“但是确实像楸说的，一勺能泡出来不少。可还是没藕好吃。”
大伙儿鲜少吃过这种口感的食物，粘粘的，味道有些寡淡。
林楸：“要是加点甜草汁，加点果酱……”
狼安：“这个可以！”
果酱部落里有现成的，采集队摘回来的果子吃不完，兽人们除了做果干，就是做果酱。
狼安往里添了些，再端出来，那模样看着就不同了。
亚兽人们再一吃，眼睛一亮，立马喜欢上了。
“就跟吃冰沙一个样。”
“吃法挺多，最主要的是这个东西吃起来方便，保存也方便。只要保持干燥，放多长时间都没问题。”
亚兽人们听着也不自觉点头。
是这样的，他们就怕这好不容易挖来的藕坏了，这些天想尽办法地吃。
“不过藕粉产量确实小，莲藕要是够多，咱们就多做点。少了就算了，大家知道这个法子就好。”林楸道。
狼安见兽人们还是一副肉疼的模样，笑说：“看看狼火他们能挖多少吧。”
藕粉就这么摊晒着，兽人们各自忙去。
林楸怕这好不容易得来的藕粉沾了灰，又在藤筛上支了几根细树枝，罩上一层麻布。
狼山白日里四处都是叮叮当当的声音。
兽人们在砌墙，牲畜圈那边的房子已经开工，狼力家旁边三个小房子也在收尾。
林楸看着西边，烟又腾起了，不知道是在烧陶还是在烧砖。
林楸没过去，而是直接往大山洞走。
他从山洞里拿了个藤筐出来，手上绕着麻绳，直奔廊道东侧。
兔艾已经挖地窖挖了三天了。
林楸蹲在那窄小得仅供一个兽人下去的洞口，往里看，只看得见三米深的洞底下，堆着一堆刚刚刨出来的土。
林楸细听，里头还有速度极快的刨土声。
“艾？”
“嗷？”
“现在要不要搬土？”
兔艾蹦到洞口底下，他灰色毛毛上沾了不少泥土，尤其是腹部和腿上偏白一点的毛毛上，已经和泥混在一起，成了一缕一缕的。
他仰起头，长长的耳朵背到后头，冲着洞口道：“楸，你再叫个兽人下来装吧，我还要挖。”
说好的三天挖完，他今晚就算不睡觉也得挖好。
“那好，我去叫。”
林楸把筐放下，刚往后转身，一下对上身后狼果的脸。
他吓得后仰，狼果一把抓住他手臂，把他带回来。
“果！”林楸心有余悸。
狼果：“嗷。”
“你能不能不要总悄无声息出现在我后头？”
“我以为你知道。”狼果小声辩解。
哪个狼兽人这么不警惕，他都走到楸身边了，他还感觉不到？
林楸深吸一口气，“我不知道。”
“哦……”
“下次出声。”
“知道了……”
“幼崽训练完了？”
“完了。”
“行。”
洞中，狼果幽怨地拎着藤筐，仰头看着洞口蹲着的林楸。
“赶紧的，弄完吃饭。”林楸晃了晃套在藤筐上的绳子道。
狼果还以为楸关心幼崽，关心自己，原来是为了给他安排活儿。
泥土极重。
狼果一铲子一铲子装到藤筐里，再由林楸拉上去。
一次半筐，如此反复，林楸来来回回十多趟，地窖里的泥才运完。
运完之后，林楸甩了甩手，被兔艾叫下去看。
他踩着梯子，一点一点往下。
入口窄，林楸得缩着点才能进去。下去之后，里面就空旷了。
兔葵蹲在角落一边吭哧吭哧刨，一边道：“楸，你看大小可不可以了？”
地窖做了三间，正对洞口的空间最开阔，左右两边还分别有个十几平米的空间。
林楸站在里头，看着这堪比一座房子的地窖。
“你什么时候挖这么大的？”
林楸记得，他明明没运多少泥巴出去。
还有谁来帮忙了？
“今天啊。”兔艾道。
“三天，这么大？”
“大吗？”兔艾挠挠头，毛毛上扑簌掉泥巴，“我本来想挖更大的，但是葵怕塌了。”
狼果也在里头转悠，他看了看上面的洞口，道：“怪不得你们喜欢住在地里了，也挺宽敞。”
兔艾：“我们住的洞跟这个也不一样。”
他们的洞是很多个通道连接起来的，住的地方藏得最深，不像这个透过洞口就能看见窝。
“厉害厉害。”狼果佩服。
*
广场上。
幼崽们训练完，没力气疯玩儿。
成年兽人们都在干活，幼崽晃悠着，围了那放藕粉的筛子一圈，踮脚看着里面。
幼崽不高，正好脑袋探进小木棍支撑的麻布下的缝隙中。
“这是什么？”狼生两小手搭在藤筐上问。
“藕粉啊。”狼圆道。
狼生盯着那白白的东西，表面平滑，上面一个手指印晃着幼崽的眼睛了。
狼生两手抠了抠藤筐，“看着很好摸……”
其他幼崽点点头。
“好摸哦。”
……
傍晚了，林楸换了身衣服，从小山洞出来，打算收拾鱼干菜干。
鱼干菜干都是分批次晒的，有些可以收进山洞存着了，这几天新挂的还得继续晒。
林楸抱着塞满了菜干的罐子，往山洞走。
路过那放在角落里的藕粉，正想看看晒得怎么样，掀开上 面支着挡沙子的麻布一瞧——
藕粉上坑坑洼洼全是手指印，密密麻麻。仅这样也就算了，可他白色的藕粉沾满了泥，黑黢黢的，像蜂窝煤一样。
看那指印大小，不是幼崽搞的是谁？！
“狼生！”
林楸一喊，四面八方的兽人们精神一振。
广场西边，正在上房梁的狼莫狼西瞬间停下手中动作，支棱着脑袋看来。
狼山上，狼石带着护卫队停下，也瞧着林楸。
山脚下一排山洞里，做木工活、织布、织渔网的兽人全部探头出来看。
只见林楸站在那放在凳子上的藤筛旁边，怒火冲天，目光带火似的，冲着几处扫来。
被瞧见的兽人下意识缩回脑袋。
楸还是头一次这个样。
不知道小狼崽子又干了什么坏事？
跟在狼石后头的狼木也往里撤了一步，问狼石道：“队长，要下去吗？”
狼石快步往后山跑，“你想去你去。”
狼木一顿，随即火烧屁股一样，赶紧追上去。
幼崽自己做的事，自己承担后果。
幼崽们这会儿缩在兔兽人的山洞，围着兔芫，欢快地啃着祭司刚刚给他们的果子。
被点名的狼生耳朵一动，腮帮子鼓着，满脸的果子汁水。
“我好像听见楸楸叫我了。”
狼圆斯斯文文咬着果肉，脸上干净，手上的果汁却直往地下滴。
“我也听见了。”
“那、那我们出去吗？”
狼生有些心虚，但他脑子里现在只有吃的，一时还没想明白自己心虚什么。
狼花跟狼雾互相靠着，外面又喊了一声，两个幼崽齐齐一颤。
狼雾：“阿生，楸叔在生气。”
狼生：“楸楸为什么生气？”
狼雾：“我们摸了、摸了……那个白白的。”
狼生一下坐直。
他想起来了！
他腮帮子飞快嚼动两下，把果肉咽下去，手臂往脸上一擦，急得爬起来，团团转道：“那、那怎么办？”
他想起来了，他的小黑手把楸的藕粉戳黑了。
实在是那东西太好玩儿，等他们戳完，才看到那一片狼藉。
狼圆小心翼翼缩着爪爪，听着外面的叫喊，不敢动。
他还是第一次感觉到楸这么生气。
“要不然，认错……”他声音软软道。
狼生：“可是藕粉黑黑的，不能吃了，我们肯定要挨罚。”
想起以前阿叔们挨罚的样子，幼崽恐惧地往墙角贴。
“怎、怎么办啊？”狼雾抓着狼花衣袖，往他身后躲。
“藏起来吗？”狼花也紧张地看着狼生。
那藕粉他们每个幼崽都动了手的，每一个都跑不掉。狼生急得搓手，手上又黏腻，弄得又往衣服上擦。
狼生噔噔噔跑到洞口，悄悄隔着门缝往外看了一眼，楸不在广场上了。
他小声道：“快走。”
林楸喊了一会儿，幼崽没出来。
狼安看他走进食堂，要从这边去大山洞里找，忍不住咬着后槽牙道：“他们不出来，这是心虚呢。”
狼兽人是纵着幼崽，但也有底线。
食物是用来吃的，不是用来玩儿的。现在才开始吃饱一点，幼崽就这么糟蹋东西，该收拾！
广场边，墙头。
狼莫蹲在架子上砌墙，幸灾乐祸道：“这群小崽子惨咯。”
狼阔抬眼，正好看到幼崽们鬼鬼祟祟从兔葵他们山洞出来，贴着墙，撒腿就往西边跑。
狼阔盯着幼崽。
狼生注意到，吓得趔趄，忙眼泪汪汪冲着他瘪嘴。
狼阔在支部落，多少年没见过这个年纪的幼崽了。他默默转过头，当没看见。
幼崽一溜烟消失在西边。
林楸找完大山洞，看了地窖，跑到东边看了，西边的各个山洞也看了，连幼崽影子都没见到。
“莫！看到幼崽没有！”
“刚刚不还在兔葵他们山洞？”
“没有。”
“嗷，藏起来了呗。”
找幼崽多简单，狼莫给他支主意：“你闻闻味儿，幼崽身上一股小崽子味儿。那么多凑在一起，想不知道藏在哪儿都难。”
林楸一顿，忘了，狼兽人还有这个技巧。
那他瞎找一通，还以为幼崽丢了，吓了自己一跳算什么？
幼崽味儿确实明显，还是训练完的幼崽。林楸跟他们在一块儿都嫌臭，现在这味道嘛……
林楸仰头，看向狼山。
他一步步往山上走，直走到自己的小山洞门口。
早上走的时候，洞口的门是虚掩着的，他怎么不知道这门什么时候从里面给关上了。
那臭烘烘的小崽子味儿快溢出来了。
林楸敲门。
里头幼崽看着门口影子，瑟缩一下。
狼圆抓着狼生的手，小声道：“怎么办啊……”
楸找到他们了。
狼生捂住狼圆嘴巴，“嘘——”
“别嘘了，我都听到了。”林楸又敲了两下门，道，“再不出来，是我把门卸了请你们出来，还是……”
“出来了！出来了嘛！”狼生吓得忙跑去把门打开。
林楸视线一扫，十六个狼崽，加一个兔崽，刚好。
兔萝不在，跟他阿爸找柴去了。
“说说吧。”林楸抱臂，看着为首的狼生道。
狼生飞快瞄他一眼，抓着衣摆，小声道：“可、可以下去说吗？”
山洞里都是楸和王的味道，前面林楸还堵着门口，看不清楚表情，更可怕了。
林楸往旁边一让，道：“那就请吧。”
*
“狼生！”
食堂，狼安暴喝，刚下山到食堂寻求狼安庇护的幼崽直面更恐怖的威压，吓得一个个嘴巴一瘪，张嘴就哭了出来。
林楸无奈看了一眼安。
十多个幼崽张嘴嚎哭，那声音要把耳膜震破。
明明是幼崽的错，但此刻幼崽哭得撕心裂肺，仿佛受了天大的委屈。
狼安：“闭嘴！”
“嗷呜嗷呜呜呜呜……错了，错了！”狼生带头，抓着狼安衣摆嚎啕大哭。
在场的亚兽人有一个算一个，全被幼崽扯住了裤腿。
林楸看着倚在自己腿上，瘪着嘴，无声掉着眼泪的狼圆。
幼崽哭得脸都红了。
可这事儿不能就这么算了。
“算了呜……是错了，错了。”狼生两手捂着眼睛道。
林楸盯着狼生，这小家伙一边哭一边张开指缝，在观察成年兽人的脸色。
林楸搂着狼圆，什么话都没说，只拍着幼崽后背，先让他缓过来。
好一会儿，嚎得嗓子累了的狼生坚持不住了。
“错了……呜……”林楸看着他开始干嚎，嚎两下，看一眼同伴，然后四周幼崽的哭声就会大一些。
他还以为幼崽真被吓到了，原来是假哭。
林楸抓着狼圆肩膀，看着他湿漉漉的眼睛。
幼崽眼睛一眨，落下两颗透明珍珠。
狼圆抓着他的手，想再次趴进他怀里。
林楸不松手，一直看着他眼睛，轻声道：“阿圆为什么要哭？我说什么了？”
狼圆睫毛抖动，缓缓低下头，盯着自己脚一声不吭。
林楸看着他头顶的发旋。
“圆告诉我，是哪个幼崽出的主意？”
狼圆抿着小嘴巴，眼眶一红，这下是真害怕了。
泪水啪嗒啪嗒成串似的往下掉。
林楸叹了口气，重新抱着他，低声道：“本来我生气，是觉得幼崽弄脏了藕粉，不珍惜食物。”
“可是我现在更气，幼崽做错了事情，不敢承担不说，还想了歪主意要蒙混过去。”
林楸感觉自己的衣服被狼圆抓得越来越紧，幼崽抽噎，小脸埋在他肩膀哭得快停不下来。
“对、对不起呜……”
林楸摸摸幼崽后颈。
幼崽哭得狠了，身上都汗湿了。
他拍着幼崽后背，道：“圆哪里错了？”
“嗷呜！”忽的，对面传出来一声痛嚎。
狼安也看出幼崽假哭了，他正逮着小崽子揍。一手抓着狼生，幼崽跑也跑不掉。
“小狼崽子！从哪里学的骗兽人了？！”
“嗷！疼，呜……疼！”
狼生直躲，被狼安抓着胳膊，像圆规一样绕着他转。
林楸想上前，狼圆猛地抱紧他脖子，林楸差点窒息。
“楸，我们不该弄脏藕粉，不该跑，不该假哭骗楸，不打，不打好不好……”
幼崽缩在一起，这下是真心实意地哭了。
食堂门口，光影一暗。
狼岩进了屋，看到一群臭烘烘的幼崽正在挨打，“这是怎么了？”
狼安手一松，狼生忙连滚带爬藏进幼崽堆里。
他狠狠吸了一下鼻涕泡，肿着两眼睛，对着他们王道：“王，错了，不该摸藕粉，不该藏起来，不该假哭。”
狼岩一听，含笑的眼神变得平静。
幼崽们低下头，乖乖站起来，走到狼岩面前。连趴在林楸怀里的狼圆也起身，回到幼崽堆里。
狼安看了眼，气道：“越长大，还会耍心眼了！”
他说完，就去做饭了。
狼岩回来了，意味着狩猎采集队也回来了，得赶紧忙活晚饭。
狼岩在林楸身边坐下，看着这一群幼崽。
“狼生。”
幼崽深深地低下头，拽着裤腿，往前慢慢走了一步。
“你说。”
狼王面前，幼崽不嚎了，也不跑了，就这么乖乖站着，把自己做的坏事全部说完。
还包括谁带头戳藕粉的，谁带头跑的，谁出的假哭这个主意。
“刚刚点到名字的幼崽站出来。”
狼生搅着手指，又默默往前一步。
他是带头跑的。
狼圆也站，他是最先戳藕粉的。
狼花上前一步，他是出主意哭的。
狼岩平静看着他们，道：“你们还记得饿肚子是什么滋味吗？”
“知道。”
“很饿很饿。”
“没有力气。”
“肚子很痛。”
幼崽小声回答，嘴巴紧抿着，脑袋越来越低，声音里都含着哭腔。
林楸本来是看着幼崽的，却忽然闻到一股血腥味。
他顺着味道寻找，突然看见狼岩手背上硕大的一道口子，皮肉翻卷，应该用水冲过，肉有些发白。
林楸目光一颤，顾不得幼崽，匆匆起身去拿药。
林楸一走，狼岩声音再度冷下。
“你们年纪小，我允许你们犯几次错。但浪费食物，一次都不行。”
“狼生。”
“王呜……”狼生肩膀一哆嗦。
他正要为自己开脱，忽然看着狼岩受伤的手，眼眶一红。
幼崽快速抹了下眼睛，哭声也小了下去。
“王，我错了。”
“错了的话我听过不少次了，既然知道是错，为什么要犯？”狼岩的话对幼崽来说近乎尖锐。
“王……”幼崽又抹了一把眼泪，看着他渗血的手背，哭得无声。
狼岩抬起他的脑袋，直视着他的眼睛，声音也缓和下来：“要想当小队长，就要有小队长的样子，他们都听你的，那你就必须以身作则。”
“浪费食物的事……”
“你惩罚我吧……肯定不会有下次！”狼生保证。
幼崽们也跟着他保证。
“那哄骗阿叔们……”
狼花：“王，我去道歉。”
“我、我们也道歉。”
在狼岩平静的说话声中，幼崽们情绪稳定下来。
狼岩见他们真的认识到错误，摆摆手，示意他们完成刚刚说的话。
幼崽跑了，可飞快又回来。
他们跟在林楸身后，看着他拿着药粉，蹲在狼岩身边托起他的手。
幼崽啜泣，乖乖围了他们一圈。
林楸正要冲洗伤口，狼岩手挡住，看向幼崽们道：“做你们该做的事。”
幼崽抹眼泪。
狼生带头起来，一步三回头，带着幼崽们离开。
林楸：“他们关心你。”
狼岩低头，额头抵着林楸肩膀，才显露出几分疲惫，“你也关心我。”
林楸飞快把他的伤口上药包扎，抓着他手腕，放在自己后腰。自己抱着他脖子，跪趴在他怀里。
“嗯，我也关心你。”林楸摸摸狼岩的后颈道。
狼岩蹭蹭他的脸，“没事，小伤。”
“怎么弄的？”
“猎物挣脱，不小心划到了。”
林楸只抱了他一下，将他松开。
狼岩刚刚包扎好的手却按住他的背，不让他起来。
“好了。”林楸摸摸他颈侧。
狼岩：“再抱一下。”
“有、有安叔他们……”
“他们没看。”
林楸才不信。
不过他重新跪趴回去，下巴贴着狼岩肩膀，听着远处幼崽们磕磕绊绊的道歉声，弯了弯唇角。
“王打算怎么罚他们？”
狼岩没直接回答，而是鼻尖埋在林楸长发上，低声问：“藕粉脏了怎么办？”
林楸：“只能重新洗几遍了。”
“那就让他们洗。”
chapters.translated_text:
The branch tribe's beastmen had been back for a few days, and the food quality on Wolf Mountain had returned to its usual standard.

The hunting team returned late, so tonight they ate the leftover half-carcass of sharp-horned beast meat from yesterday.

The lotus roots needed to be eaten quickly, so dinner was the same as usual: lotus root stewed in soup, plus a baked lotus root cake.

After eating and drinking their fill, the beastmen picked up their toothbrushes and tooth powder to wash up.

The beastmen cleaned themselves up, let out a satisfying burp, patted their bellies, and only then went back to sleep.

Although life right now was tiring, each day held more hope than the last.

Tomorrow they would still have to wake up early, step through the morning dew, and continue searching for wild vegetables and prey.

Before long, the oil lamps went out.

The last glimmer of light on Wolf Mountain also vanished into the night.

The next day.

As soon as dawn broke, Lin Qiu went down the mountain straight to the cafeteria.

Early this morning, the lids on the five large basins in the corner had been lifted by the beastmen countless times. Seeing Lin Qiu coming over again right now, Lang An smiled and asked, "Well, did it work?"

Lin Qiu: "It worked, the water cleared up."

The demi-beastmen gathered around and helped lift off all the lids.

Lang An: "There's sun today, so we can dry it right away."

Lin Qiu: "An, find a large vat."

Lang An went to look for a large vat, while Lang Tan put the lids away and placed them on the shelf that had been moved from the covered walkway into the cafeteria.

The remaining beastmen carried the basins in pairs, waiting for Lang An to bring the clean large vat so they could pour the contents in.

"Qiu, there are no empty water vats left in the tribe; this is the one the cafeteria uses to hold water," Lang An said.

"I've already asked Lang Mo to boil some more."

If the top layer of water was left to settle for another night, maybe they could get a bit more lotus root starch tomorrow; not a single bit could be wasted.

As they spoke, the clear water from the top layer in the basin was poured into the vat. The further down they poured, the more the lower layer of water, carrying a small amount of lotus root starch, gradually became somewhat turbid.

After pouring, the demi-beastmen looked at the white substance left at the bottom of the basin and poked it with their fingers, leaving a fingerprint.

"Is this lotus root starch?"

"This is it," Lin Qiu nodded.

After pouring from all five basins, the remaining lotus root starch varied in amount, but combined, it filled exactly one of the bowls the beastmen used for eating.

Lin Qiu tore a piece of cloth and spread it over the rattan sieve.

Piece by piece, the lotus root starch was placed on top. Several demi-beastmen gathered around and couldn't help saying, "Two baskets of lotus roots only yielded this little bit."

"The lotus root cakes from last night weren't very good either; they lost their flavor."

The demi-beastmen felt that doing it this way was a bit wasteful of food.

Lin Qiu didn't say anything, and simply grabbed a bowl, scooped up a bit of lotus root starch, and poured boiling water over it right in front of the demi-beastmen.

It was clearly just a spoonful, but after stirring and stirring like that, the water became thick and pasty.

However much water there was, this thick, pasty stuff was just about the same amount.

"Want to taste it?" Lin Qiu said.

Lang An took it, lifted the spoon to look, and saw a transparent substance clinging to the spoon, pulling out strings.

He took a small sip; it was mild and didn't have much taste.

The other demi-beastmen also tasted it, and the more they ate, the stranger their expressions became.

"This is completely different from lotus roots."

"Who would have thought it's made from lotus roots."

"But just as Qiu said, a spoonful can make quite a lot. Still, it's not as good to eat as lotus roots."

Everyone rarely ate food with this kind of texture; it was sticky and the flavor was somewhat bland.

Lin Qiu: "If you add a little sweet grass juice, some fruit jam..."

Lang An: "That can work!"

There was readily available fruit jam in the tribe; the fruits picked by the gathering team couldn't all be eaten, so aside from making dried fruit, the beastmen made fruit jam.

Lang An added some in, and when he brought it back out, it looked completely different.

When the demi-beastmen tasted it again, their eyes lit up and they instantly fell in love with it.

"It's just like eating shaved ice."

"There are quite a few ways to eat it, but the most important thing is that this stuff is convenient to eat and easy to store. As long as it's kept dry, it'll be fine for however long you leave it."

Hearing this, the demi-beastmen nodded involuntarily.

That was true; they had been worried that the lotus roots they had worked so hard to dig up would go bad, and had been trying every possible way to eat them these past few days.

"However, the yield of lotus root starch is indeed small. If we have enough lotus roots, we'll make more. If there aren't many, forget it—it's good enough that everyone knows the method," Lin Qiu said.

Seeing that the demi-beastmen still had pained expressions as if they were losing meat, Lang An laughed and said, "Let's see how much Lang Huo and the others can dig up."

The lotus root starch was left spread out to dry, and the beastmen went off to their respective tasks.

Fearing that the hard-earned lotus root starch would get dusty, Lin Qiu propped up a few thin branches on the rattan sieve and covered it with a layer of linen cloth.

During the day, the sounds of clanking and banging echoed everywhere on Wolf Mountain.

The beastmen were building walls; the houses over by the livestock enclosure had already broken ground, and the three small houses next to Lang Li's home were also nearing completion.

Looking toward the west, Lin Qiu saw smoke rising again, wondering if they were firing pottery or bricks.

Lin Qiu didn't go over there, instead walking directly toward the large cave.

He took a rattan basket out of the cave, wrapped hemp rope around his hands, and headed straight for the east side of the corridor.

Tu Ai had been digging the cellar for three days.

Lin Qiu squatted at the entrance, which was narrow enough for only one beastman to go down, and looked inside. He could only see that at the bottom of the three-meter-deep cave, a pile of newly excavated soil was heaped up.

Lin Qiu listened closely and heard the sound of earth being dug away at a very rapid speed from down below.

"Ai?"

"Awooh?"

"Do we need to move the dirt now?"

Tu Ai hopped up to the bottom of the entrance. His gray fur was stained with quite a bit of mud, especially the slightly whiter fur on his belly and legs, which had mixed with the mud and clumped into strands.

He raised his head, laid his long ears back toward the back, and said to the entrance, "Qiu, call another beastman down to load it; I still have to dig."

He had promised to finish digging in three days, so even if he didn't sleep tonight, he had to get it done.

"Alright then, I'll go call someone."

Lin Qiu put down the basket and just as he turned around, he bumped right into Lang Guo's face behind him.

Startled, he leaned back, and Lang Guo grabbed his arm, pulling him back.

"Guo!" Lin Qiu's heart was still fluttering with lingering fear.

Lang Guo: "Awooh."

"Can you stop always appearing behind me without a sound?"

"I thought you knew," Lang Guo whispered in defense.

What kind of wolf beastman was so unvigilant that he couldn't even sense it when he walked right up to Qiu's side?

Lin Qiu took a deep breath. "I didn't know."

"Oh..."

"Make a sound next time."

"Got it..."

"Are you done training the cubs?"

"Done."

"Fine."

Inside the pit, Lang Guo aggrievedly picked up the rattan basket and looked up at Lin Qiu squatting at the opening.

"Hurry up, we'll eat after we're done," Lin Qiu said, shaking the rope attached to the rattan basket.

Lang Guo had thought Qiu was showing concern for the cubs and for him, but it turned out to be just to assign him work.

The soil was extremely heavy.

Lang Guo shoveled the dirt into the rattan basket shovel by shovel, and Lin Qiu hauled it up.

Half a basket at a time, repeating the process over and over, Lin Qiu made more than a dozen trips back and forth before the mud in the cellar was completely hauled out.

After finishing, Lin Qiu shook his hands and was called down by Tu Ai to take a look.

He stepped on the ladder, descending little by little.

The entrance was narrow, so Lin Qiu had to hunch over a bit to get inside. Once down there, the space inside was surprisingly vast.

Tu Kui was squatting in a corner, digging away with a huff and a puff while saying, "Qiu, look and see if the size is okay?"

The cellar had been made into three rooms. The space directly facing the entrance was the most spacious, and there were also spaces of over a dozen square meters on both the left and right sides.

Lin Qiu stood inside, looking at this cellar that rivaled a house in size.

"When did you dig out something this big?"

Lin Qiu clearly remembered that he hadn't hauled out all that much mud.

Who else had come to help?

"Today," Tu Ai said.

"Three days, and it's this big?"

"Is it big?" Tu Ai scratched his head, sending a flurry of dirt falling from his fur. "I originally wanted to dig it even bigger, but Kui was afraid it would cave in."

Lang Guo was also wandering around inside. He looked up at the entrance hole above and said, "No wonder you guys like living underground; it's quite spacious."

Tu Ai: "The caves we live in are different from this."

Their caves were connected by many passageways, and the living quarters were hidden the deepest, unlike this one where you could see the nest right through the entrance hole.

"Awesome, truly awesome," Lang Guo praised admiringly.

*

On the plaza.

After finishing their training, the cubs didn't have the energy to run wild.

The adult beastmen were all busy working, while the cubs wandered around, surrounding the sieve holding the lotus root starch, standing on tiptoe to look inside.

The cubs weren't tall, so their heads just poked right into the gaps beneath the linen cloth supported by small wooden sticks.

"What is this?" Lang Sheng asked, resting his two little hands on the rattan frame.

"Lotus root starch," Lang Yuan said.

Lang Sheng stared at the white thing. Its surface was smooth, and a single fingerprint on it caught the young cub's eye.

Lang Sheng scratched the rattan frame with both hands. "It looks really nice to touch..."

The other cubs nodded.

"So nice to touch."

...

By evening, Lin Qiu had changed his clothes and emerged from the small cave, planning to tidy up the dried fish and dried vegetables.

The dried fish and vegetables were sun-dried in batches; some could be put away into the cave for storage, while the ones newly hung up these past few days still needed to continue drying.

Holding a jar stuffed full of dried vegetables, Lin Qiu walked toward the cave.

Passing by the lotus root starch placed in the corner, he wanted to check how well it had dried and lifted the linen cloth propped up to block the sand—

The lotus root starch was pitted all over with dense, countless fingerprints. As if that wasn't enough, his white lotus root starch was covered in mud, pitch black, looking just like honeycomb briquettes.

Judging by the size of those fingerprints, if it wasn't the cubs, who else could it be?!

"Lang Sheng!"

As soon as Lin Qiu shouted, the beastmen in all directions perked up.

On the west side of the plaza, Lang Mo and Lang Xi, who were laying roof beams, instantly stopped what they were doing and craned their necks to look over.

Up on Wolf Mountain, Lang Shi stopped with his guard team and also gazed at Lin Qiu.

In the row of caves at the foot of the mountain, the beastmen doing woodwork, weaving cloth, and making fishing nets all poked their heads out to watch.

They saw Lin Qiu standing beside the rattan sieve placed on a stool, blazing with anger, his eyes shooting fiery glances as he swept them across several spots.

The beastmen who caught his eye instinctively shrank their heads back.

This was the first time Qiu had ever been like this.

Wondering what bad thing the wolf cubs had gotten into this time.

Lang Mu, who was following behind Lang Shi, also stepped back a bit and asked Lang Shi, "Captain, should we go down?"

Lang Shi hurried off toward the back mountain. "If you want to go, you go."

Lang Mu paused, then hurried to catch up as if his backside were on fire.

The cubs did what they did, so they had to bear the consequences themselves.

Right now, the cubs were huddled in the Tu beastmen's cave, surrounding Tu Yuan and happily munching on the fruits the priest had just given them.

Lang Sheng, the one whose name was called, twitched his ears, his cheeks bulging, and his face covered in fruit juice.

"I think I just heard Qiuli call me."

Lang Yuan was daintily biting into the fruit flesh, his face clean, but the juice from his hands was dripping straight down to the ground.

"I heard it too."

"Th-then do we go out?"

Lang Sheng felt a bit guilty, but right now his brain was filled only with food, and he couldn't quite figure out what he was feeling guilty about just yet.

Lang Hua and Lang Wu leaned against each other. When another shout came from outside, both cubs shivered in unison.

Lang Wu: "A-sheng, Uncle Qiu is angry."

Lang Sheng: "Why is Qiuli angry?"

Lang Wu: "We touched... we touched that white stuff."

Lang Sheng sat straight up with a start.

He remembered!

He chewed his cheeks rapidly, swallowed the fruit flesh, wiped his arm across his face, and scrambled up anxiously, pacing in circles as he said, "Th-then what do we do?"

He remembered now; his little black hands had poked Qiu's lotus root starch black.

The thing had simply been too fun to play with, and by the time they finished poking it, they saw the utter mess they had made.

Lang Yuan cautiously tucked in his paws, listening to the shouts outside, too scared to move.

This was the first time he had ever felt Qiu this angry.

"Or, we apologize..." he said softly.

Lang Sheng: "But the lotus root starch is all black and can't be eaten anymore; we're definitely going to be punished."

Remembering what punishment looked like for the uncles in the past, the cubs pressed themselves in terror against the corner of the wall.

"Wh-what should we do?" Lang Wu grabbed Lang Hua's sleeve, hiding behind him.

"Should we hide?" Lang Hua also looked anxiously at Lang Sheng.

Every single one of those cubs had touched that lotus root starch, and none of them could escape. Lang Sheng wrung his hands anxiously, but his hands were sticky again, so he wiped them on his clothes once more.

Lang Sheng scampered over to the cave entrance, quietly peeked outside through a crack in the door, and saw that Qiu was no longer in the plaza.

He whispered, "Let's go, quick."

After Lin Qiu shouted for a while, the cubs didn't come out.

Seeing him walk into the cafeteria intending to go through to the large cave to look for them, Lang An couldn't help gritting his teeth and saying, "They're not coming out because they have a guilty conscience."

Wolf beastmen spoiled their cubs, but they also had their bottom line.

Food was meant for eating, not for playing with. They had only just started eating their fill recently, and the cubs were already wasting things like this; they needed a good scolding and spanking!

By the edge of the plaza, atop the wall.

Lang Mo was squatting on the frame building a wall, gloating maliciously, "Those little pups are in for a miserable time."

Lang Kuo raised his eyes and happened to see the cubs sneaking out of Tu Kui and the others' cave, hugging the wall and running like the wind toward the west.

Lang Kuo stared at the cubs.

Noticing him, Lang Sheng was so startled he stumbled, and hastily made a tearful, pouty face at him.

Lang Kuo had been in the branch tribe; how many years had it been since he'd seen cubs this age? He silently looked away, pretending he hadn't seen anything.

The cubs vanished into the west in a flash.

After searching the large cave, checking the cellar, looking on the east side, and checking all the caves on the west side, Lin Qiu couldn't even find a shadow of the cubs.

"Mo! Did you see the cubs?"

"Werent they just in Tu Kui and the others' cave?"

"No."

"Awooh, they went and hid, didn't they."

Finding cubs was simple enough. Lang Mo offered him an idea: "Just sniff for their scent; the cubs have a distinct little-pup smell. With so many of them huddled together, it's hard not to know where they're hiding."

Lin Qiu paused. He had forgotten that wolf beastmen had this skill.

So what was the point of him running around blindly and scaring himself half to death thinking the cubs were lost?

The cub scent was indeed obvious, especially since they were cubs who had just finished training. Lin Qiu usually found it stinky even when hanging out with them, but now that smell...

Lin Qiu raised his head and looked up toward Wolf Mountain.

He walked up the mountain step by step, heading straight for the entrance of his own small cave.

When he left in the morning, the door to the cave had been left ajar; how come he didn't know when this door had been bolted shut from the inside?

That stinky little-pup smell was practically overflowing.

Lin Qiu knocked on the door.

Inside, the cubs shrank back at the sight of the shadow by the door.

Lang Yuan clutched Lang Sheng's hand and said softly, "What do we do..."

Qiu had found them.

Lang Sheng covered Lang Yuan's mouth. "Shh—"

"Don't shh me, I heard it all." Lin Qiu knocked twice more on the door and said, "Are you coming out on your own, or should I take the door off its hinges and invite you out, or..."

"We're coming out! We're coming out!" Scared stiff, Lang Sheng hurried over to open the door.

Lin Qiu swept his gaze across them: sixteen wolf pups plus one rabbit pup, exactly right.

Tu Luo wasn't there; he had gone to find firewood with his dad.

"Explain yourselves." Lin Qiu crossed his arms, looking at Lang Sheng, who was at the front.

Lang Sheng cast a quick glance at him, clutched the hem of his clothes, and said softly, "Can... can we go down and talk?"

The cave was filled with the scents of Qiu and the King, and earlier Lin Qiu had been blocking the doorway where his expression couldn't be clearly seen, which made it even scarier.

Lin Qiu stepped aside to make room and said, "Be my guest, then."

*

"Lang Sheng!"

In the cafeteria, Lang An let out a furious roar. The cubs who had just come down the mountain to seek Lang An's protection were met with an even more terrifying oppressive aura, terrifying them until their mouths drooped and they burst into tears right on the spot.

Lin Qiu cast a helpless look at An.

Over a dozen cubs opened their mouths and howled, a sound loud enough to shatter eardrums.

Clearly it was the cubs' fault, but right now the cubs were crying so heart-rendingly that it seemed as though they were suffering the greatest grievance in the world.

Lang An: "Shut up!"

"Awooh-awooh-wuuuwuuu... We were wrong, we were wrong!" Led by Lang Sheng, they clutched Lang An's trouser legs and wailed loudly.

Every single demi-beastman present had their pants grabbed by a cub.

Lin Qiu looked at Lang Yuan, who was leaning against his leg with drooping lips, shedding silent tears.

The cubs were crying so hard their faces turned red.

But this matter couldn't just be let go like this.

"Forget it wuuu... We were wrong, we were wrong." Lang Sheng covered his eyes with both hands and said.

Lin Qiu stared at Lang Sheng. This little fellow was crying while opening up gaps between his fingers to observe the adult beastmen's expressions.

Lin Qiu pulled Lang Yuan into his arms, didn't say a word, and simply patted the cub's back to let him calm down first.

After a good while, Lang Sheng, whose throat was tired from howling, couldn't keep it up anymore.

"We were wrong... wuuu..." Lin Qiu watched as he began to fake-howl, howling twice, looking at a companion, and then causing the surrounding cubs' crying to grow louder.

He had thought the cubs were truly terrified, but it turned out to be fake crying.

Lin Qiu grabbed Lang Yuan's shoulders, looking into his wet eyes.

The cub blinked his eyes, letting two transparent pearls fall.

Lang Yuan grabbed his hand, wanting to bury his face back into his embrace.

Lin Qiu didn't let go, kept looking into his eyes, and said softly, "Why is Yuan crying? What did I say?"

Lang Yuan's eyelashes trembled, and he slowly lowered his head, staring at his own feet without a sound.

Lin Qiu watched the crown of his head.

"Yuan, tell me, which cub came up with the idea?"

Lang Yuan pressed his little lips together and his eye rims turned red; now he was truly scared.

Tears fell in strings, patter, patter.

Lin Qiu sighed, held him close again, and said in a low voice, "At first I was angry because the cubs ruined the lotus root starch and didn't cherish food."

"But now I'm even angrier that after doing something wrong, you not only didn't dare to take responsibility, but you even came up with a crooked idea to try and gloss it over."

Lin Qiu felt his clothes being gripped tighter and tighter by Lang Yuan as the cub sobbed, burying his small face in his shoulder, almost unable to stop crying.

"I-I'm sorry wuuu..."

Lin Qiu stroked the back of the cub's neck.

The cub had cried so hard he was drenched in sweat.

Patting the cub's back, he said, "Where was Yuan wrong?"

"Awooh!" Suddenly, a painful howl came from across the room.

Lang An had also seen through the cubs' fake crying and was currently catching a little pup to discipline him. He grabbed Lang Sheng with one hand so the cub couldn't run away.

"Little wolf pup! Where did you learn to lie to beastmen?!"

"Awooh! It hurts, wuuu... it hurts!"

Lang Sheng dodged frantically, but held by the arm, he was spun around Lang An like a pair of compasses.

Lin Qiu wanted to step forward, but Lang Yuan tightly hugged his neck, almost suffocating Lin Qiu.

"Qiu, we shouldn't have dirtied the lotus root starch, we shouldn't have run away, we shouldn't have lied to Qiu with fake crying, please don't hit us, don't hit us okay..."

The cubs huddled together, and this time they were crying sincerely.

At the cafeteria entrance, the light and shadow darkened.

Lang Yan walked into the room and saw a group of stinky cubs being disciplined. "What's going on here?"

Lang An loosened his grip, and Lang Sheng scrambled in a flurry to hide back among the pile of cubs.

Sniffling hard with swollen eyes, he said to their King, "Wang, we were wrong; we shouldn't have touched the lotus root starch, we shouldn't have hidden, and we shouldn't have fake-cried."

Upon hearing this, Lang Yan's smiling expression turned calm.

The cubs lowered their heads, stood up obediently, and walked over to Lang Yan. Even Lang Yuan, who had been burying himself in Lin Qiu's arms, got up and returned to the group of cubs.

Lang An glanced at them and said angrily, "The older they get, the better they are at playing tricks!"

Having said that, he went off to cook.

Lang Yan was back, which meant the hunting and gathering team was back too, so he had to hurry and get dinner ready.

Lang Yan sat down beside Lin Qiu and looked at this group of cubs.

"Lang Sheng."

The cub deeply lowered his head, tugged at his trousers, and slowly took a step forward.

"You speak."

In front of the Wolf King, the cub stopped howling and stopped running. He just stood there obediently and recounted all the bad things they had done.

This included who started poking the lotus root starch, who led the run, and who came up with the idea of fake crying.

"The cubs whose names were just called, step out."

Twiddling his fingers, Lang Sheng silently took another step forward.

He was the one who led the running away.

Lang Yuan stepped forward too; he was the one who poked the lotus root starch first.

Lang Hua stepped forward; he was the one who came up with the idea to cry.

Looking at them calmly, Lang Yan said, "Do you still remember what it feels like to go hungry?"

"We know."

"Very, very hungry."

"No strength."

"Our bellies hurt a lot."

The cubs answered softly, pressing their lips tightly together, their heads hanging lower and lower, their voices laden with a crying tone.

Lin Qiu had been watching the cubs, but suddenly caught a whiff of a bloody smell.

Tracing the scent, he suddenly saw a massive gash on the back of Lang Yan's hand, the skin and flesh rolled outward. It should have been rinsed with water, as the flesh looked somewhat whitened.

Lin Qiu's gaze trembled. Forgetting about the cubs, he hurriedly got up to fetch medicine.

The moment Lin Qiu left, Lang Yan's voice turned cold again.

"You are young, and I allow you to make a few mistakes. But wasting food—not even once."

"Lang Sheng."

"Wang wuuu..." Lang Sheng's shoulders trembled.

Just as he was about to make excuses for himself, he happened to look at Lang Yan's injured hand, and his eye rims turned red.

The cub quickly wiped his eyes, and his crying grew softer.

"Wang, I was wrong."

"I've heard 'I was wrong' many times. Since you knew it was wrong, why did you do it?" Lang Yan's words were practically sharp to the cubs.

"Wang..." The cub wiped his tears once more, looking at the back of Lang Yan's hand which was seeping blood, and cried silently.

Lang Yan lifted his head, looked straight into his eyes, and softened his tone. "If you want to be a little captain, you have to act like one. They all listen to you, so you must lead by example."

"As for the matter of wasting food..."

"Punish me... there definitely won't a next time!" Lang Sheng promised.

The cubs chimed in with their own promises as well.

"And about tricking the uncles..."

Lang Hua: "Wang, I'll go apologize."

"W-we'll apologize too."

Under Lang Yan's calm words, the cubs' emotions stabilized.

Seeing that they truly recognized their mistake, Lang Yan waved his hand, signaling them to fulfill what they had just promised.

The cubs scurried off, but quickly came back.

Following behind Lin Qiu, they watched as he took the medicinal powder and squatted down beside Lang Yan to support his hand.

The cubs sniffled and obediently formed a circle around them.

Just as Lin Qiu was about to wash the wound, Lang Yan blocked his hand, looked at the cubs, and said, "Do what you're supposed to do."

The cubs wiped their tears.

Led by Lang Sheng, they got up and, looking back every few steps, left with the other cubs.

Lin Qiu: "They care about you."

Lowering his head and resting his forehead against Lin Qiu's shoulder, Lang Yan finally revealed a trace of exhaustion. "You care about me too."

Lin Qiu swiftly applied medicine and bandaged his wound, then grabbed his wrist and placed it around his own lower back, wrapping his arms around Lang Yan's neck as he knelt and leaned into his embrace.

"Yeah, I care about you too," Lin Qiu said, stroking the back of Lang Yan's neck.

Lang Yan rubbed against his cheek. "It's nothing, just a small wound."

"How did you get it?"

"The prey broke free and accidentally scratched me."

Lin Qiu only held him for a moment before letting go.

However, Lang Yan used his newly bandaged hand to press against Lin Qiu's back, not letting him get up.

"It's done," Lin Qiu stroked the side of his neck.

Lang Yan: "Hold me a little longer."

"A-An and the others are..."

"They aren't looking."

Lin Qiu didn't believe that for a second.

Still, he knelt back down, pressing his chin against Lang Yan's shoulder. Listening to the halting sounds of the cubs' apologies in the distance, the corners of his lips curved upward.

"How does the King plan to punish them?"

Instead of answering directly, Lang Yan buried the tip of his nose in Lin Qiu's long hair and asked in a low voice, "What should we do since the lotus root starch is dirty?"

Lin Qiu: "We can only wash it a few more times."

"Then make them wash it."

chapters.title: 第175章
chapters.source_text:
天黑了，狼山前炊烟升腾，熟悉的骨头汤味远远飘散开来。
昏黑的食堂里，林楸正捡了采集队带回来的火树油，单独占了一口陶锅，准备做蜡烛。
要先把凝固的火树油加热熔化，再灌入提前掏空的藤条管子里。
狼岩帮着烧火，目光追着林楸，时不时再看一眼旁边。
狼岩边上，幼崽们也在吭哧吭哧干活。
他们跟前放了几个小盆，每个盆里都装着清水。
幼崽被亚兽人挽起袖子，蹲在盆边，把一坨一坨的藕粉放进去，搅拌得散开了，再倒到另一个盆里。
盆底最后留下来的，就是他们弄上去的泥沙。
幼崽忙得头也不抬，不想跟围了他们一圈的成年兽人们搭话。
偏偏成年兽人们嘴欠，就喜欢逗幼崽。
狼火刚拉了不少藕回来，这会儿抱臂倚在灶台，看着幼崽故意长叹一口气，道：“我听说部落做了藕粉，怎么连个影子都没见到？是安不想让我们吃吗？”
狼安瞥他一眼，不吭声。
狼云也蹲下，看着身旁胖墩墩的幼崽，配合他们队长笑眯眯问：“看我们小狼崽子，大晚上的还在给部落做事呢，真勤快。”
狼生瘪瘪嘴，侧了侧身子，不跟他们讲话。
狼火：“幼崽这是怎么了？”
狼云：“眼睛都是肿的，在哪儿受委屈了？”
“火叔！”狼生抬头，大声叫道。
狼火挑眉，“小声点，你火叔还年轻，听得见。”
“对不起！”
“对不起干什么？难道你们不是受委屈，是做错事了？”
狼生瘪嘴，瓮声瓮气道：“是做错了，我们不该弄脏藕粉，不然火叔回来就能吃到了。”
幼崽矮小，看得见两个阿叔的腿上都是疙瘩。
红红的，看着好痒好痒。
他们不禁看了看自己的小腿，干干净净的，什么都没有。
他们知道，莲藕是从大泽里面挖出来的。大泽里的泥很脏，会烂腿的……
幼崽越想，脑袋垂得更低。
轻轻的道歉声响了一声又一声，狼火闷笑，反倒不好再逗这些小崽子们了。
他站直，甩着两条长腿慢慢走到幼崽身边，挨个狠狠揉了一把脑袋，揉得幼崽东倒西歪。
等幼崽睁着一双大眼睛，歉疚地看来，狼火笑道：“多大点事儿，别一个个像天塌了一样。”
狼生吸了吸鼻子，仰头道：“火叔……”
狼火着重拍了下狼生脑袋，道：“赶紧的，下次回来你火叔必须得把这藕粉吃上。”
狼生不感动了。
他哼唧两声，又默默埋头苦干。
狼岩注意着这边，瞧着幼崽憋红的脸，慢慢把柴放入灶膛。
“行了，不加柴了。”
火树油融化，林楸往桌上摆了一排的空心藤条。
这种藤条中间是软的，筷子往里一塞，就能把中心掏空。
林楸把这个当模具，里头放适合当灯芯的草茎，再把熔化的火树油倒进去。
今天兽人们头一次捡这东西，没多少，林楸一共做了十一根蜡烛。
“油凝固就可以用了。”林楸对围观的兽人们道。
狼晚几个坐在旁边，看着那一截一截的笔直藤条道：“楸又弄出来个新东西。”
狼星：“这不挺好。”
狼晚：“是好，但感觉也挺简单，我们以前怎么就没想到？”
狼地跟他们凑在一块，笑了两声，“咱年纪大了，脑子笨呗。”
“你脑子笨，我可不笨。”狼赤默默道。
他们与林楸隔着一桌。
狼赤瞧着被年轻兽人围着的幼崽，心里自豪。
他聪明，他的伴侣也聪明，所以生出来的幼崽才会这么厉害。
狼赤得意地翘尾巴。
狼晚几个兽人见了，撇撇嘴，心里嫌弃。
嫌弃的同时，还有那么一点点的羡慕。
他们是没有幼崽的。
其实也有过……曾经还在中央大陆，狼部落的兽人近千个，可几十年间，兽人们死的死，伤的伤，其中就包括他们的至亲至爱。
那痛彻心扉的滋味，一旦念起，就是深深的绝望。
所以他们选择遗忘，蒙蔽自己，不敢动一点念头。
就这么过着吧，目前看来，部落暂且还需要他们这些老家伙。
火树油蜡烛还需要凝固，但兽人们乐得守着，林楸便随便他们，自个儿挤出了包围圈。
外面，狼岩还坐在那灶后头。
林楸赶他去休息，他也不走。
林楸蹲下，借着灶前的火光，托着他被包扎好的那只手细看。几层麻布透出点血色，混着药粉的褐色，一点也不好看。
“这只手别动了。”
“没动。”狼岩道。
“明天还去捕猎吗？”
“去。”
林楸不语，抿唇看着他。
火光橘黄，暖融融地映在林楸脸上，能看清那浅浅的绒毛。
不过林楸的眼神可不温柔。
狼岩借着灶台的遮挡，低下头，一惯有些泛冷的眸光变得温柔。
他勾了勾林楸手指，小声道：“小伤，没事的，明早上起来就能好得差不多。”
林楸：“伤在手背。”
那就是爪子上。
来回奔跑那么久，还要追捕猎物，这伤口就算明早愈合了那也得裂开！
狼岩摩挲着他的手指，林楸看他都这样了，手还动，反手抓着给他固定住。
他蹲在狼岩身侧，手臂撑着他的腿，仰头看他。
“你之前都可以不去，明天也别去了。”
狼岩还想说什么，可林楸一双明澈的眸子就这么盯着他。
狼岩闷声笑了下，妥协地低下头，靠住自家伴侣额头。
“好，不去就是。”
“这还差不多。”林楸小声道。
*
等守着幼崽把藕粉弄完，林楸把装满泥沙的水拿出去倒了。
狼岩跟了出来。
林楸本来想带狼岩看看兔艾挖的地窖，但天黑尽了，这会儿也不好下去。
“挖好了就把该放的放进去。”狼岩道。
“就等你一句话呢。”
黑暗中，狼岩看着林楸，忽然摸了下他的脸，“你一句话也可以。”
林楸笑起来，抓着他手指握住，回了食堂。
“兽人们今天捡了很多核桃。火树汁少，要更多的话，还要等等。”
“刚割了树？”
“嗯。”
火树大批量取油，得割皮，就跟橡树收割橡胶一样。
兽人们捡的那一个一个的，都是火树伤了析出来的火树油，是凝固了的，量也不多。
“葵他们也捡了几筐核桃，我们剥了晒成干核桃，留着雪季吃？”
“可以。”
“火树果呢？”
“明天白雀应该就会过来。”
“行。”
兽人们今早上走的时候，墙角还放着几个大盆。这会儿就剩一个盆和一个大水缸了。
狼夜一回来就去小屋里躺着，这会儿闻到肉汤味过来，站在那盆边，揭开盖子看。
这怎么还跟早上不一样了呢？
“楸，不是说今天就能吃了吗？”
“又不能吃了？”
“为什么？”
林楸示意他看那群缩在角落的幼崽。
狼生：“是我们弄脏了。”
“哦，脏了就脏了……也能吃。”狼夜话落，被旁边狼果给了一肘子。
他捂着胸口，疼得五官一挤。
果下死手。
狼果：“闭上你的嘴，地上趴着，自个儿休息。”
幼崽是做错了，但这些成年兽人问了一遍又一遍，没完没了了？
狼夜不说话了，自己找空地趴下。
林楸：“明天应该能吃，不出意外的话。”
幼崽站出来，道：“明天我们守着！”
这一次，他们一定好好看着藕粉，一根毛都不能有！
他们再也不乱动食物了！
天气冷，这个时候树上成熟的果子最多。兽人们带回来的嫩叶菜少了，块根变得多了。
这东西好保存，兽人们现在吃藕，这些块根就存着雪季吃。
林楸去采集队放野菜的角落看了看。
这边摆着十个大藤筐，不是兽人们采集的那种筐子，大藤筐更大更深，放三个幼崽下去都能蹲得下。
这边有两筐果子、两筐块根、三筐野菜还有三筐的核桃。
葵他们带回来的核桃也都倒在这筐子里了。
这些都是采集队和兔葵他们一天的成果。
先前那些都放在山洞里，现在光线暗，等明天天亮，再来收拾。
晚饭后，各自睡觉去。
第二天一早，兽人们吃过早饭继续出去忙活。
廊道边，山洞里的姜和块根一筐一筐被搬了过来。
姜有十来筐，块根是最近一个多月兽人们挖回来的，大家从口粮里剩下来，一点一点攒到如今的二十六筐。
狼安带着亚兽人们把东西运到地窖口，兽人们在藤筐上套着绳子，一筐一筐往下放。
林楸和狼果在底下接着，再抬着往里放。
狼岩也在底下，偶尔搭把手，不过没动几下就被林楸赶到一边去站着。
“楸，放进去一点，后头还有萝卜要放。”狼安在上面说道。
“好！”
藤筐里的东西都是兽人们舍不得吃的。
这点东西看着多，可两百多个兽人，一顿就能吃完两筐的块根。这东西比野菜野果难找，挖又耗时，兽人们都舍不得吃。
林楸和狼果把地窖里的东西规整好，分类存放，然后才爬出地窖。
亚兽人们径直离开，狼果去找幼崽。
林楸留在后头，看着狼岩单臂抓着梯子爬上来，伸手拉了他一把，赶紧把洞口封上。
“叫你不要跟着下去。”
“我帮忙。”
“不是有果在。”
林楸往食堂走，狼岩跟在他身后，相差一步。
林楸说完，没听到狼岩吭声。他忽然停下，转头，脸颊被轻轻捏了一下。
林楸看着那双含笑的灰眸，心里那一点闷气儿散了。
他瞪了狼岩一眼，捏着他的手看了看，“等会儿帮你换药。”
狼岩又捏捏自家伴侣鼓起的脸颊。
真可爱。
生气也可爱。
林楸赶紧抓下他的手，“不要动手动脚。”
*
等回到食堂，幼崽们已经等着了，狼果也无聊地蹲在幼崽旁边，一点没个成年兽人样。
林楸走到门口，守着盆边的幼崽抬头看来。
“楸楸！”
林楸：“沉淀好了？”
狼生小心翼翼揭开盖子，“跟昨天早上的一样。”
“那拿盆来倒吧，顺带把大缸里沉淀的那一点倒出来。”
幼崽听令，立马起身忙活起来。
陶盆重，但幼崽小小年纪就展现出不一般的力气，肚大的陶盆他们抱得稳稳当当。
林楸帮忙倒水，再指挥他们去拿藤筛和布。
藤筛大，拿不起来就几个幼崽一个抓一边，顶在头上往昨天晒藕粉的地方去。
还有幼崽主动搬凳子，找小木棍。
林楸看在眼里，欣慰不已。
唇边一痒，林楸低头发现狼岩又动手。
他飞快抓住他手指，用力一咬，然后再松开。林楸警告道：“安分点。”
狼岩看着自己指节上的牙印，唇角一翘。
好凶啊。
等藕粉再次晒好，幼崽就坐在屋檐下，眼也不眨地守着。一只虫子飞近了，都得摇着扇子扇得人家在空中打个旋儿。
食堂里，狼安倚在窗口看了眼，道：“一群小傻子。”
林楸笑：“也不傻，聪明着呢。”
“都是些小聪明。”
现在刚吃过早饭，不用忙做饭的事情，亚兽人们便分成几批，有的织布，有的织渔网，有的晒菜干肉干。
剩下的就跟着狼安，把兽人们这几天采集的核桃搬出来，大伙儿坐在一起，把外皮去了。
野核桃的皮厚，核也小。
兽人们见识过这果浆的厉害，他们之前就剥了两个核桃，现在手指黢黑，洗都洗不掉。
讲究些的，就用叶片裹着，另一只手拿刀剥。
不讲究的，比方说半道加入的幼崽，用爪子掰不开就上嘴啃。
“诶？”林楸托着幼崽下巴道，“这可不能上嘴咬。”
幼崽看看成年兽人们。
他们有刀，爪子也更锋利，幼崽什么都没有。
林楸：“放石头上砸也行。”
幼崽眼睛一亮。
这个办法好。
正忙着，广场上空又传来扇翅膀的声音。
幼崽们一听，赶紧跑出去，双手张开，护在那藕粉旁边。
林楸：“羽猎他们又来了。”
“哟！不欢迎我来啊？”
听听这声音就是了。
“阿猎叔，你别把灰弄到我们的藕粉里面了。”
“藕粉？藕还能做粉？”
羽猎说着话，从窗户探头看向食堂里。见兽人都在，笑呵呵地绕道，从门那边进来。
正要说话，一看到兽人堆里放着的核桃，大喝一声道：“这个吃不得！也摸不得！”
兽人们冲着他展示一下自己黑黢黢的手，“已经摸了。”
狼安叼着一瓣核桃肉，囫囵道：“也吃了。”
“哎！你们找黑手果子干什么？”
“这个，你们叫黑手果子？”林楸拿着核桃问他。
“对啊，你看你们的手多黑。”
这取名还真是别致。
“你们那边也有？”
“有啊，南边多了去了。”
羽猎说着，在兽人堆里坐下。
他顺手捡起一个，看看表皮完整的核桃果，再看看剥出来的光溜溜的核桃，“你们不吃外面这个？”
“不吃。”
“里面这个能吃？”
亚兽人们看着他，不说话。
羽猎一笑，一拍大腿道：“懂了，谢谢啊。”
雪季这不是又多了一样吃的！
林楸：“客气。你来是……”
“哦，没什么。就是族长过来让我问问你们，雪季之前要不要把羽乐接回去？还有，剩下的猎物，我们怕是得明年再给你们了。”
部落现在也忙着囤过雪季的食物，实在没多的了。
狼岩：“羽乐的事你问祭司，猎物的事明年给也可以。”
羽猎笑得有些傻，一口牙露出来，后头的大牙都能看得清楚。
这乐得有些不正常了。
他一蹦而起，欢快道：“那我去找祭司！”
“他来就为了问话？”狼安觉得有点奇怪。
“顺带碰碰运气。”狼岩道。
亚兽人们没明白。
林楸滚了滚手中的核桃，“这不就碰到了吗？”
部落雪季又多了一样吃的呢。
核桃富含油脂，一个一个看着虽然小，但多找一些何尝不能垫肚子。
“那怎么没听他问藕粉怎么做？”
“或许他觉得制作藕粉的手艺狼部落不会外传？”
一点小东西，倒是无所谓。
就算羽猎直接问了，狼兽人也不会隐瞒。
兽人们继续剥壳，幼崽砸了一会儿就不想砸了，干脆把兽人们剥了的核桃收集起来，拿去广场上晒。
“楸，你说的那火树果……”
“火树果怎么了？”
兽人们一回头，看着羽猎又从廊道那边回来了。
“火树果能吃。”狼兽人直接道。
羽猎一脸“居然还有你们不知道的吃的”的表情，道：“当然能吃，就是不好剥壳。”
狼安：“你们摘了的？”
“摘了。食物就这么多，不能放过一点。雪季窝在山洞里磕火树果也比傻呆呆蹲在窝里熬日子强。”
“你们存多少了？”
“两个山洞吧。”
“多少？！”狼莫回来喝水，站在那窗口，抱着陶碗往嘴里灌。听到羽猎的话，声音都破了。
就那么小的火树果，能存两个山洞！
那他们以前浪费了多少吃的？
羽猎：“两个山洞啊。”
他说完，看了一圈体格健壮的狼兽人们，谨慎道：“你们还是别去摘了，火树果喜欢长在树尖上，那上面的树枝很细，容易摔下来。”
“我们……算了！你们要的话，我回去一趟，让涯他们过来帮忙。”
反正承诺了给他们做一年的活儿，这不还没做完吗？
狼兽人也是心急，干嘛要让小兽人回去，还得再来一趟。
“不用。”
“为什么？你们不想要，那给我们，我们自己去摘。”
“不是……”林楸看着狼岩，这能说吗？
狼岩：“我们请了白雀兽人帮忙。”
“哦哦，白雀……白雀？什么叫请白雀帮忙！你们还跟他们交换了？！”
“对，用鱼干交换。”
“你们……”羽猎目光在这群狼兽人身上转来转去，最后比了个大拇指。
一群财大气粗的！
他们承诺的一年给他们干活，就管饭就行了，这他们都不要，居然专门请白雀过来帮忙，还交换？！
林楸看不得他那看傻子一样的眼神。
虽然隐晦，但他们还真不是傻子。
林楸道：“叫他们赶紧回去，那不是想着你们部落兽人不够，怎么着，还回去错了？”
羽猎一愣，反应过来。
他摸摸鼻子，笑道：“没错没错，那不……你们亏了嘛。”
他替狼兽人心疼他们交换出去的食物，虽然不是他自己的，但也心疼。
“这样，我还是叫涯他们过来……”
“羽猎！你不准跟我们抢！”
一只炸毛白雀直接从窗户弹射进来。
林楸偏头，白雀直直撞在了羽猎脑袋上。
他两个小爪子抓得紧，像个毛绒发卡挂在羽猎头发上。
羽猎龇牙道：“……雀二白，你下来！”
雀二白没动，他转头，翅膀理一理羽毛，冲着这一圈狼兽人们挨个点点头，笑得和蔼道：“是狼王叫我们来的吧，狼王放心，我们保证做好。”
狼岩：“管饭，另外一个兽人五条鱼干。”
“好好好，可以可以！需要我们现在就开始吗？”
羽猎一把将他抓下来，“谄媚！”
雀二白躺在他手里，翻个白眼道：“你懂个屁！”
食物面前，面子算什么？
再说了，什么是面子？
鸟能有什么面子？
林楸笑道：“你们带了多少兽人？”
话落，几个白雀从刚刚雀二白弹射过来的窗台冒头，整整齐齐的，像一个个糯米汤圆。
“加上我，十个。”雀二白翅膀拍拍胸口道。
一个兽人一天五条鱼干，十个兽人一天就是五十条鱼干！干一天活得到的鱼干，就够他们这十个兽人雪季吃五天了。
林楸看向狼安，“安，能行吗？”
五十条鱼干呢。
狼安：“没问题。”
暂且不说部落现在已经存了好几个山洞的鱼干，就说兽人们每天不断地在水里捞的鱼，一天就不止五十条。
林楸：“那好，你们休息休息……”
“我们不用休息！”
林楸：“……也行，那就从下午就开始干活吧。”
“可以。”雀二白干脆道，他蹬了蹬羽猎的手，“喂！小子！你还要抓到什么时候？！”
羽猎把他放下，看了林楸一眼，扭扭捏捏道：“我们其实也可以。”
林楸：“你们忙完了？”
羽猎闭嘴。
没有，他们还差得远呢。
一天一个兽人五条鱼干，对他们来说不怎么划算，毕竟黑羽兽人的胃口更大些。
“那慢走，不送？”
羽猎看了看这一堆核桃，正了正心态，立即道：“那我也回去了，雪季之前我们不会再过来，你们要是有事，就叫狼兽人来一趟。”
林楸点头。
羽猎饭也不蹭了，急急忙忙飞走。
他要去告诉族人，这沾了手就黑的果子不是有毒，也能吃！
chapters.translated_text:
Night fell, and smoke rose from the cooking fires in front of Wolf Mountain, carrying the familiar scent of bone broth far into the distance.

In the dim cafeteria, Lin Qiu was collecting the fire-tree oil brought back by the gathering team, using a separate pottery pot to prepare candles.

First, the solidified fire-tree oil had to be melted, then poured into pre-hollowed rattan tubes.

Lang Yan helped tend the fire, his gaze following Lin Qiu, occasionally glancing to the side.

Beside Lang Yan, the cubs were also working hard.

They had several small basins in front of them, each filled with clear water.

With their sleeves rolled up by the sub-beasts, the cubs squatted by the basins, placing lumps of lotus root starch into the water, stirring until it dissolved, and then pouring it into another basin.

What remained at the bottom of the basin was the mud and sand they had cleaned off.

The cubs were too busy to even look up, not wanting to talk to the adult beasts surrounding them.

Yet, the adult beasts had itchy mouths and loved to tease the cubs.

Lang Huo had just brought back a large amount of lotus roots and was now leaning against the stove with his arms crossed, watching the cubs and sighing deliberately: "I heard the tribe made lotus root starch, so why haven't I even seen a shadow of it? Is it that An doesn't want us to eat it?"

Lang An glanced at him but remained silent.

Lang Yun also squatted down, looking at the chubby cub beside him, and joined his captain with a smile: "Look at our little wolf cubs, working for the tribe late at night. How diligent."

Lang Sheng pouted and turned to the side, refusing to talk to them.

Lang Huo: "What's wrong with the cubs?"

Lang Yun: "Their eyes are swollen. Where were they wronged?"

"Uncle Huo!" Lang Sheng looked up and shouted loudly.

Lang Huo raised an eyebrow, "Keep it down, your Uncle Huo is still young and can hear you."

"Sorry!"

"What are you sorry for? Did you do something wrong instead of being wronged?"

Lang Sheng pouted and said in a muffled voice: "We did do something wrong. We shouldn't have dirtied the lotus root starch, otherwise Uncle Huo would have been able to eat it when he returned."

The cubs were short, and they could see the bumps on their two uncles' legs.

They were red and looked so, so itchy.

They couldn't help but look at their own calves, which were clean and had nothing on them.

They knew the lotus roots were dug out of the Great Marsh. The mud in the Great Marsh was very dirty and would rot your legs...

The more the cubs thought about it, the lower their heads hung.

Soft apologies sounded one after another, and Lang Huo chuckled, finding it hard to tease these little ones anymore.

He stood up straight, swung his long legs, walked slowly to the cubs, and gave each of them a rough rub on the head, making them sway.

When the cubs looked up with wide, apologetic eyes, Lang Huo laughed: "It's no big deal, don't look like the sky is falling."

Lang Sheng sniffled and looked up: "Uncle Huo..."

Lang Huo patted Lang Sheng's head emphatically and said: "Hurry up, next time I come back, your Uncle Huo must be able to eat this lotus root starch."

Lang Sheng was no longer touched.

He grunted twice and silently buried his head back into his work.

Lang Yan kept an eye on them, watching the cubs' flushed faces, and slowly added firewood into the stove.

"Alright, no more firewood."

The fire-tree oil melted, and Lin Qiu lined up the hollow rattan tubes on the table.

The center of this rattan was soft; if you pushed a chopstick into it, you could hollow it out.

Lin Qiu used this as a mold, placed a grass stem suitable for a wick inside, and poured the melted fire-tree oil in.

Today was the first time the beasts had gathered this, so there wasn't much; Lin Qiu made a total of eleven candles.

"They can be used once the oil solidifies," Lin Qiu told the watching beasts.

Lang Wan and the others sat nearby, looking at the straight rattan sections and said: "Qiu has come up with something new again."

Lang Xing: "Isn't this great?"

Lang Wan: "It is great, but it feels quite simple. Why didn't we think of it before?"

Lang Di joined them and laughed twice, "We're old, our brains are slow."

"Your brain is slow, but I'm not," Lang Chi said silently.

They were separated from Lin Qiu by a table.

Lang Chi looked at the cubs surrounded by the young beasts and felt proud.

He was smart, and his partner was smart, which is why the cubs they had were so capable.

Lang Chi wagged his tail proudly.

Lang Wan and the other beasts saw this, curled their lips, and felt disdain.

While feeling disdain, there was also a tiny bit of envy.

They had no cubs.

Actually, they had... back in the Central Continent, the Wolf Tribe had nearly a thousand beasts, but over the decades, many died or were injured, including their closest loved ones.

That heart-wrenching feeling, once remembered, was deep despair.

So they chose to forget, to blind themselves, not daring to have even a single thought.

Let's just live like this; for now, the tribe still needs these old guys.

The fire-tree oil candles still needed to solidify, but the beasts were happy to wait, so Lin Qiu let them be and squeezed out of the circle.

Outside, Lang Yan was still sitting behind the stove.

Lin Qiu told him to go rest, but he wouldn't move.

Lin Qiu squatted down, and by the light of the stove, carefully examined his bandaged hand. The layers of linen showed some bloodstains, mixed with the brown of the medicinal powder; it didn't look good at all.

"Don't move this hand anymore."

"I'm not moving it," Lang Yan said.

"Are you still going hunting tomorrow?"

"Yes."

Lin Qiu didn't speak, pursing his lips as he looked at him.

The firelight was orange and warm, reflecting on Lin Qiu's face, making the fine fuzz visible.

However, Lin Qiu's eyes were not gentle.

Lang Yan lowered his head, shielded by the stove, his usually cold gaze turning gentle.

He hooked Lin Qiu's finger and whispered: "It's a small injury, it's fine. It should be mostly healed by tomorrow morning."

Lin Qiu: "The injury is on the back of your hand."

That meant it was on his paw.

Running back and forth for so long and chasing prey, even if this wound healed by tomorrow morning, it would just split open again!

Lang Yan rubbed his fingers, and seeing him still moving his hand, Lin Qiu grabbed it and held it steady.

He squatted beside Lang Yan, resting his arms on his legs, and looked up at him.

"You didn't have to go before, don't go tomorrow either."

Lang Yan wanted to say something, but Lin Qiu's clear, bright eyes were staring right at him.

Lang Yan chuckled softly, compromised, and lowered his head to rest against his partner's forehead.

"Alright, I won't go."

"That's more like it," Lin Qiu whispered.

*

After watching the cubs finish the lotus root starch, Lin Qiu took the water filled with mud and sand outside to pour it away.

Lang Yan followed him out.

Lin Qiu originally wanted to take Lang Yan to see the cellar Tu Ai dug, but it was completely dark, so it wasn't a good time to go down.

"Once it's dug, put in what needs to be stored," Lang Yan said.

"I was just waiting for you to say that."

In the darkness, Lang Yan looked at Lin Qiu and suddenly touched his face, "You can say it too."

Lin Qiu laughed, grabbed his finger, held it, and returned to the cafeteria.

"The beasts picked a lot of walnuts today. There isn't much fire-tree sap, so we'll have to wait for more."

"Did you just cut the trees?"

"Yeah."

To get fire-tree oil in large quantities, you have to cut the bark, just like harvesting rubber from oak trees.

The ones the beasts picked one by one were the fire-tree oil that had seeped out from injuries on the trees; it was already solidified, and the quantity wasn't large.

"Kui and the others also picked a few baskets of walnuts. Should we peel them and dry them into dried walnuts to eat during the snow season?"

"That works."

"What about the fire-tree fruit?"

"Bai Que should be coming over tomorrow."

"Okay."

When the beasts left this morning, there were several large basins in the corner. Now there was only one basin and a large water vat left.

Lang Ye went to lie down in the small hut as soon as he returned, but now, smelling the meat broth, he came over and stood by the basin, lifting the lid to look.

Why was it different from this morning?

"Qiu, didn't you say we could eat it today?"

"Can we not eat it again?"

"Why?"

Lin Qiu gestured for him to look at the cubs huddled in the corner.

Lang Sheng: "We dirtied it."

"Oh, so it's dirty... it's still edible." As soon as Lang Ye finished speaking, he was elbowed by Lang Guo next to him.

He clutched his chest, his facial features contorting in pain.

Guo didn't hold back.

Lang Guo: "Shut your mouth, lie down on the ground, and rest."

The cubs did something wrong, but these adult beasts kept asking over and over again—was there no end to it?

Lang Ye stopped talking and found an empty spot to lie down.

Lin Qiu: "It should be edible tomorrow, if nothing goes wrong."

The cubs stood up and said: "We'll guard it tomorrow!"

This time, they would definitely watch the lotus root starch carefully; not even a single hair would get in!

They would never mess with the food again!

The weather was cold, and this was when the fruits on the trees were most mature. The tender leafy vegetables the beasts brought back were fewer, and root vegetables were becoming more common.

These things were easy to store, so the beasts were eating lotus roots now, and these root vegetables would be saved for the snow season.

Lin Qiu went to check the corner where the gathering team kept the wild vegetables.

There were ten large rattan baskets here—not the kind of baskets the beasts used for gathering; these were larger and deeper, enough for three cubs to squat inside.

There were two baskets of fruit, two baskets of root vegetables, three baskets of wild vegetables, and three baskets of walnuts.

The walnuts Kui and the others brought back were also poured into these baskets.

These were the results of a day's work for the gathering team and Tu Kui's group.

The previous ones were all kept in the cave, but it was dark now, so they would tidy them up tomorrow when it was light.

After dinner, everyone went to sleep.

The next morning, the beasts ate breakfast and continued to go out to work.

By the corridor, the ginger and root vegetables in the cave were moved over, basket by basket.

There were about ten baskets of ginger, and the root vegetables were what the beasts had dug up over the last month or so. Everyone saved them from their rations, bit by bit, until they had twenty-six baskets now.

Lang An led the sub-beasts to transport the items to the cellar entrance, and the beasts put ropes on the rattan baskets and lowered them one by one.

Lin Qiu and Lang Guo were at the bottom to receive them and then carry them inside.

Lang Yan was also at the bottom, occasionally helping out, but after a few moves, he was shooed away by Lin Qiu to stand aside.

"Qiu, put it further in, there are still radishes to put in later," Lang An said from above.

"Okay!"

The things in the rattan baskets were what the beasts were reluctant to eat.

These things looked like a lot, but with over two hundred beasts, they could finish two baskets of root vegetables in one meal. These were harder to find than wild vegetables and fruits, and digging them was time-consuming, so the beasts were reluctant to eat them.

Lin Qiu and Lang Guo organized the items in the cellar, storing them by category, and then climbed out.

The sub-beasts left directly, and Lang Guo went to find the cubs.

Lin Qiu stayed behind, watching Lang Yan climb up with one arm grabbing the ladder, reached out to give him a hand, and quickly sealed the entrance.

"I told you not to go down."

"I was helping."

"Wasn't Guo there?"

Lin Qiu walked toward the cafeteria, Lang Yan following him, one step behind.

After Lin Qiu finished speaking, he didn't hear Lang Yan respond. He suddenly stopped, turned around, and his cheek was gently pinched.

Lin Qiu looked at those smiling gray eyes, and the little bit of stuffiness in his heart dissipated.

He glared at Lang Yan and looked at his hand, "I'll change your dressing in a bit."

Lang Yan pinched his partner's puffed-up cheek again.

So cute.

Even angry, he was cute.

Lin Qiu quickly grabbed his hand, "Don't be handsy."

*

When they returned to the cafeteria, the cubs were already waiting, and Lang Guo was also squatting boredly beside the cubs, not looking like an adult beast at all.

Lin Qiu walked to the door, and the cubs guarding the basin looked up.

"Qiuqiu!"

Lin Qiu: "Has it settled?"

Lang Sheng carefully lifted the lid, "It's the same as yesterday morning."

"Then bring the basin over to pour it, and by the way, pour out the bit that settled in the large vat."

The cubs obeyed and immediately got up to work.

The pottery basin was heavy, but the cubs showed unusual strength for their young age, holding the large-bellied pottery basin steadily.

Lin Qiu helped pour the water and directed them to get the rattan sieve and cloth.

The rattan sieve was large, so if they couldn't lift it, a few cubs would grab each side and carry it on their heads to where the lotus root starch was being dried yesterday.

Other cubs took the initiative to move stools and find small wooden sticks.

Lin Qiu saw this and felt very gratified.

Feeling an itch on his lip, Lin Qiu looked down and found Lang Yan was being handsy again.

He quickly grabbed his finger, bit it hard, and then let go. Lin Qiu warned: "Behave yourself."

Lang Yan looked at the tooth marks on his knuckle, his lips curling up.

So fierce.

When the lotus root starch was dried again, the cubs sat under the eaves, guarding it without blinking. If a bug flew near, they would wave a fan to make it spin in the air.

In the cafeteria, Lang An leaned against the window and glanced over, saying: "A bunch of little fools."

Lin Qiu laughed: "Not fools, they're smart."

"Just little bits of cleverness."

Now that they had just finished breakfast and didn't need to worry about cooking, the sub-beasts divided into several groups—some weaving cloth, some weaving fishing nets, and some drying vegetables and meat.

The rest followed Lang An, moving out the walnuts the beasts had gathered over the past few days, and everyone sat together to remove the outer skins.

Wild walnuts had thick skins and small kernels.

The beasts had seen how powerful the fruit pulp was; they had peeled two walnuts earlier, and now their fingers were pitch black and wouldn't wash clean.

Those who were particular would wrap them in leaves and use a knife in the other hand to peel them.

Those who weren't, like the cubs who joined halfway, would just use their mouths to gnaw if they couldn't pry them open with their claws.

"Eh?" Lin Qiu held the cub's chin and said, "You can't bite these with your mouth."

The cubs looked at the adult beasts.

They had knives, and their claws were sharper; the cubs had nothing.

Lin Qiu: "It's fine to put them on a stone and smash them."

The cubs' eyes lit up.

That was a good method.

While they were busy, the sound of flapping wings came from above the plaza again.

As soon as the cubs heard it, they ran out, arms spread wide, guarding the lotus root starch.

Lin Qiu: "Yu Lie and the others are here again."

"Yo! Not welcoming me?"

Just listen to that voice.

"Uncle Lie, don't get dust into our lotus root starch."

"Lotus root starch? Lotus roots can be made into starch?"

As Yu Lie spoke, he poked his head through the window into the cafeteria. Seeing that the beasts were all there, he laughed and walked around to enter through the door.

Just as he was about to speak, he saw the walnuts piled among the beasts and shouted: "You can't eat these! And you can't touch them!"

The beasts showed him their pitch-black hands, "We already touched them."

Lang An was chewing on a piece of walnut kernel and said vaguely: "And we already ate them."

"Hey! Why are you looking for 'black-hand fruit'?"

"This, you call it 'black-hand fruit'?" Lin Qiu asked him, holding a walnut.

"Yeah, look how black your hands are."

That was a truly unique name.

"Do you have them on your side too?"

"Yeah, there are tons in the south."

Yu Lie said, sitting down among the beasts.

He picked one up, looked at the walnut with the intact skin, then at the smooth walnut kernel peeled out, "You don't eat the outside part?"

"No."

"The inside part is edible?"

The sub-beasts looked at him without speaking.

Yu Lie smiled, slapped his thigh, and said: "Got it, thanks."

That was one more thing to eat for the snow season!

Lin Qiu: "You're welcome. You came to..."

"Oh, nothing. Just the patriarch asked me to ask you if you want to take Yu Le back before the snow season? Also, we're afraid we'll have to give you the rest of the prey next year."

The tribe was also busy hoarding food for the snow season and really didn't have any extra.

Lang Yan: "Ask the priest about Yu Le's matter; giving the prey next year is fine."

Yu Lie smiled a bit foolishly, revealing a mouthful of teeth, even the molars in the back were clearly visible.

This joy was a bit abnormal.

He jumped up and said happily: "Then I'll go find the priest!"

"Did he come just to ask that?" Lang An felt it was a bit strange.

"Trying his luck," Lang Yan said.

The sub-beasts didn't understand.

Lin Qiu rolled the walnut in his hand, "Didn't he just find some?"

The tribe had one more thing to eat for the snow season.

Walnuts were rich in oil; although they looked small one by one, if they found more, they could definitely fill their stomachs.

"Then why didn't I hear him ask how to make lotus root starch?"

"Perhaps he thinks the craft of making lotus root starch is something the Wolf Tribe won't share?"

It was just a small thing, so it didn't really matter.

Even if Yu Lie had asked directly, the wolf beasts wouldn't have hidden it.

The beasts continued to peel the shells. The cubs didn't want to smash them after a while, so they simply collected the walnuts the beasts had peeled and took them to the plaza to dry.

"Qiu, that fire-tree fruit you mentioned..."

"What about the fire-tree fruit?"

The beasts turned back and saw Yu Lie had returned from the corridor.

"Fire-tree fruit is edible," the wolf beast said directly.

Yu Lie had an expression of "there's actually food you don't know about," and said: "Of course it's edible, it's just hard to peel."

Lang An: "Did you pick them?"

"Picked them. There's only so much food, we can't let any go. Huddled in a cave during the snow season cracking fire-tree fruit is better than just sitting there blankly waiting out the days."

"How much have you stored?"

"Two caves worth."

"How much?!" Lang Mo came back to drink water, stood by the window, and poured water into his mouth from a pottery bowl. Hearing Yu Lie's words, his voice cracked.

Those tiny fire-tree fruits, and they could store two caves worth!

How much food had they wasted before?

Yu Lie: "Two caves worth."

After he finished, he looked around at the sturdy wolf beasts and said cautiously: "You guys better not go pick them; fire-tree fruit likes to grow on the tips of the trees, and the branches up there are very thin, easy to fall from."

"We... forget it! If you want them, I'll go back and let Ya and the others come over to help."

Anyway, they promised to do a year's worth of work for them, and they hadn't finished yet, right?

The wolf beasts were also impatient; why make the little beast go back and have to come again?

"No need."

"Why? If you don't want them, then give them to us, we'll go pick them ourselves."

"It's not..." Lin Qiu looked at Lang Yan, could he say this?

Lang Yan: "We hired the Bai Que beasts to help."

"Oh, oh, Bai Que... Bai Que? What do you mean hired the Bai Que to help! You even traded with them?!"

"Yes, traded with dried fish."

"You guys..." Yu Lie's gaze shifted back and forth among the wolf beasts, and finally, he gave a thumbs up.

A bunch of rich and generous people!

They promised to work for them for a year just for food, and they didn't even want that, but actually hired Bai Que to help and traded with them?!

Lin Qiu couldn't stand his look of "looking at fools."

Although subtle, they really weren't fools.

Lin Qiu said: "Tell them to hurry back. Wasn't it because we thought your tribe didn't have enough beasts? What's wrong, did we do something wrong by going back?"

Yu Lie was stunned and realized.

He rubbed his nose and laughed: "No, no, it's just... you guys lost out."

He felt bad for the wolf beasts for the food they traded away, although it wasn't his own, he still felt bad.

"How about this, I'll still call Ya and the others over..."

"Yu Lie! You're not allowed to compete with us!"

A bristling Bai Que shot directly in from the window.

Lin Qiu tilted his head, and the Bai Que hit Yu Lie's head straight on.

His two little claws gripped tightly, hanging on Yu Lie's hair like a furry hair clip.

Yu Lie bared his teeth: "...Que Erbai, get down!"

Que Erbai didn't move. He turned his head, preened his feathers with his wings, nodded at the circle of wolf beasts one by one, and smiled kindly: "The Wolf King called us, right? Don't worry, Wolf King, we guarantee we'll do a good job."

Lang Yan: "Food provided, plus five dried fish per beast."

"Good, good, good, that works! Do you need us to start now?"

Yu Lie grabbed him down, "Sycophant!"

Que Erbai lay in his hand, rolled his eyes and said: "You don't know anything!"

In the face of food, what is face?

Besides, what is face?

What face can a bird have?

Lin Qiu laughed: "How many beasts did you bring?"

As soon as he finished, several Bai Que popped up from the window sill where Que Erbai had just shot from, neat and tidy, like little glutinous rice balls.

"Including me, ten," Que Erbai said, patting his chest with his wings.

One beast gets five dried fish a day, ten beasts is fifty dried fish a day! The dried fish earned from one day's work was enough for these ten beasts to eat for five days during the snow season.

Lin Qiu looked at Lang An, "An, is that okay?"

Fifty dried fish.

Lang An: "No problem."

Not to mention that the tribe already had several caves full of dried fish, just the fish the beasts caught in the water every day was more than fifty.

Lin Qiu: "That's good, you guys rest for a bit..."

"We don't need to rest!"

Lin Qiu: "...That's fine, then start working this afternoon."

"Okay," Que Erbai said decisively. He kicked Yu Lie's hand, "Hey! Kid! How long are you going to keep grabbing me?!"

Yu Lie put him down, looked at Lin Qiu, and said coyly: "We can actually do it too."

Lin Qiu: "Are you done with your work?"

Yu Lie shut his mouth.

No, they were still far from it.

Five dried fish per beast per day wasn't very cost-effective for them, after all, the Black Feather beasts had bigger appetites.

"Then walk slowly, we won't see you out?"

Yu Lie looked at the pile of walnuts, adjusted his mindset, and immediately said: "Then I'm going back too. We won't come over again before the snow season. If you have anything, just send a wolf beast over."

Lin Qiu nodded.

Yu Lie didn't even stay for a meal and flew away in a hurry.

He had to tell his tribe that this fruit that turned your hands black wasn't poisonous and was actually edible!
