叮铃哐啷——
午间，兔葵带着族人们捡完木柴回来，往靠近山壁的角落一倒，卸了货，去溪边洗手。
走在广场上，兔兽人们看着新晒的核桃，蹲下来看了看。
“好少啊。”兔艾道。
他们捡的时候感觉挺多的，重得他们都快背不动了，可剥了外面那一层，这一堆看着只能装一个大藤筐。
“后山已经没有了。”兔葵道，“下午我们再走远一点。”
“西边兽人去得少，族长，我们去西边？”
“可以。”
这个点儿，兽人都收工回来吃午饭。
狼莫正甩着手，穿过广场，往食堂这边走。
他看见兔葵他们，下巴一抬，露出个痞里痞气的笑，“葵！回来了！”
兔葵站直身体，冲着他点点头，赶紧招呼兽人们去洗手。
回到食堂，就听狼莫和楸讨论起雪季木柴的事。
兔葵一顿，坐到他们身边去。
“柴不好砍，植物自然枯死的速度比不上咱们用的速度，附近的柴都被捡得差不多了……”
兔葵点点头。
是这样的，他们把狼山东南西北半天能往返的位置走遍了，目前捡回来的柴只够放一个山洞。
“那尾巴草秆呢？那么多。”
“那个不禁烧。”
部落里兽人都忙，那尾巴草秆收回来还一直堆在广场角落呢。狼莫不提，林楸都差点忘了。
“尾巴草秆要垒成草垛，发火时用得到。后头就不用再额外割干草了。”
狼莫：“草垛？”
林楸：“晚上有空就一起做，做了你就知道了。”
说回干柴，林楸问过兔葵，得知直接能捡的木柴确实不多。
余下的都是倒下的大树，能掰断的树枝他们都掰断了，其他的要带回来就得砍断。
可兽人们工具不行，砍个木柴费时费力，所以大家宁愿多走走路，找些能直接带回来的。
林楸：“还是要粗一点的木柴。”
兔葵应下，“我们下午就把那些扛回来。”
林楸点头，“能带回来的先带回来，带回来后再砍也行。莫，今年还是要烧木炭。”
去年木炭看似烧了几炉子，实则半个雪季没用到就用完了。
咩咩兽跟红鸟那边火炕要烧柴，每天做饭要烧柴，兽人取暖要烧柴，二十四小时不间断，一山洞柴其实烧不了多久，尤其是到了雪季，一点不耐用。
狼莫一听，半身趴在桌子上，长长地“嗷”了一声。
“忙不过来？”
“什么忙不过来？”狼赤端着碗拿着筷子过来，他把陶碗往林楸跟前一放，在他对面坐下，道，“阿父可以帮忙。”
林楸看着跟前的碗筷，有些疑惑。
狼岩落后狼赤一步，在林楸身边坐下，也放下碗。
“赤叔说我手不方便，帮我端。”
“什么叫帮你，我帮自己幼崽。”
林楸抿了抿唇，看着眼前熟悉又不熟悉的一张脸，道：“谢谢……阿父。”
狼赤嘴巴一咧，要笑，可这么多兽人看着呢，他嘴角一绷，道：“什么事难倒你们了，我们这些老家伙可以帮忙。”
“烧炭。”狼莫道。
木炭狼赤知道，去年雪季他在狼山待过，用过这东西。
木炭是木头烧出来的，黑漆漆的，比木头耐用。烧得好了，还没有烟雾。
“兽人不够？”
“也不是。”狼莫道。
“磨磨唧唧，到底什么事，能不能一口气说完？”狼赤道。
狼莫：“也没什么事，就是我们目前要烧陶、烧砖、烧瓦、建房，还多了一个烧炭。”
“多大点事，我们做。”
前一批从支部落回来的兽人们各自有了事做，比如说狼潭，他原本是支部落采集队的，以前跟着狼星干活，现在回来之后就跟着狼安做些织布、做饭的活儿。
比方说狼狡，他带着老年兽人们，跟着狼起做木工活。
还有狼阔、狼夜，都有专门的事情做。
可他们后一批回来的兽人手头没个固定的活儿，一般是哪一边有需要就去哪一边。
狼赤细想了一下，这样不行。
没个具体的安排，兽人们总乱跑，活儿虽然做了，但有时候做得慢。
“我们后头这些兽人六十多个，现在都跟着狼莫烧砖建房子，不如分一点出来专门负责这个柴的事？”
“你看兔葵他们也不是专门干这个的，地里还得他们守着，这个时候有空，不如叫他们跟着采集队出去多找点种子回来，培育培育新的野菜，没准还能再弄出一个尾巴草来？”
当然，这只是理想的情况。
但这么好的种植人才，不能被束缚在找柴这事儿上。
专人专岗，狼部落的各项事业才能进步。
林楸一听，看了狼赤一眼。
老登……他阿父眼光还是长远些。
狼赤看他们都没意见，在支部落当惯了族长，他也就安排起来：
“这样，狼晚带二十个狼兽人帮狼莫这边建房子，狼星带二十个兽人帮忙挖泥烧砖烧陶。剩下兽人我带着，跟我一起烧炭。烧炭集中快雪季前半个月烧，这段时间我们抓紧把外面的干柴搬回来。”
一通说完，想起狼岩还在这儿，他一顿，略显僵硬地补了一句：“……怎么样？”
狼岩点头。
林楸嘴角一弯，“可以。”
狼莫松了口气，点头如捣蒜，“可以可以。”
他这边还留四十个兽人，够了。
“那我们……”兔葵犹豫地看着几个兽人。
“随便你们干什么。走了走了，吃饭！”狼莫笑嘻嘻地抓起兔葵就走。
兔葵被迫跟了两步，回头看林楸。
林楸对他浅笑道：“葵，我觉得我阿父的提议不错，你仔细想想。”
“好。”兔葵也笑起来。
比起捡柴，他确实更喜欢种植。
兽人各有去处，饭后，大家休息一会儿，就按照分派的活儿各自忙去了。
狼赤带队，和那些选完愿意去建房子、烧砖后剩下的兽人一起，拿了石斧，身上挂着粗粗的蛮草绳离开。
十个白雀兽人脚上抓着兽皮袋，也都出发了。
兔葵他们则不跟着去了。
他们等着林楸休息好了，都围上来。
林楸翻着摊晒的核桃，就被兔葵堵了。
他疑惑看着兔兽人们，连兔芫这个小不点也在。
林楸看了一圈，忽然笑了起来。
狼兽人从小的到大的都有围着兽人的习惯，兔葵他们什么时候也把这个学过去了？
“楸，你说我们种什么好？”
能吃的植物太多了，兔葵一时间不知道怎么下手。
林楸：“我们部落自己种出来的植物还是太少了。”
“少？”
林楸点头。
“就比方说菜，你们没来之前，狼兽人也就种点香草，没什么正经菜。其实菜这东西，口感不同，不同兽人喜欢的也不同，不嫌种类多。”
“比如说长痒痒根，你们可以试试能不能种，野外的我们自己挖都难挖，要是自己种成规模，像萝卜那样长得整整齐齐……”
兔兽人们听着，眼睛越来越亮。
“同理，不只是菜，还有兽人们爱吃的果子，还有他们种植的草药，都可以研究研究。”
“种类很多，趁着现在各种植物成熟，你们可以多搜集些种子回来，到时候看看自己喜欢哪些，试着种。反正狼兽人是不嫌菜多的。”
狼莫：“嫌……”
狼岩就站在一旁，一个眼神，狼莫闭嘴。
他默默绕行过他们，去窗台那边取水。
林楸跟兔兽人们讨论得认真，没听见。
狼岩看林楸说得口干，倒了水放在他手里，接过他的话道：“部落会慢慢发展，往远处想，要是部落以后有个上千兽人，仅靠采集填饱肚子……”
林楸：“那远远不够。”
狼岩点点头。
所以最后还是得靠养殖，靠种植。
等他们养殖稳定了，一定会试着养殖更多的动物，同样，种植也不能拘泥于尾巴草这几样植物。
说到这，兔兽人们就彻底明白了。
这事不是让他们打发时间的，这是任务，是责任，也是压力。以后部落真发展到了那个样子，要是他们的菜还是那几样……
兔艾想想，不禁打了个哆嗦。
不行，是太少了！
林楸喝完水，喉咙也润了，他道：“种植的事情你们比我们清楚，总而言之，我们能自己种植的植物肯定是越多越好。”
“好！我们会好好做的。”兔葵静静看着林楸和狼眼，承诺道。
林楸笑道：“不用这么严肃，尽力而为。”
兔艾：“我们绝对尽力。”
事情说明白了，剩下的事情就交给兔葵去安排。
兔兽人一走，林楸便沿着河边四处转转。
河面上多了一艘小船，小船飘荡着，兽人站在上面，抛下渔网。
渔网如同张开的手，探入水中，抓取鱼儿。
要不是那小船摇晃得厉害，兽人“哎哟哎哟”直叫唤，兴许还有几分悠闲的意味。
走着走着，林楸忽然停下脚步。
狼岩手腕一紧，被自家伴侣拉着，匆匆往山洞走。
“怎么了？”
“忘了给你换药。”
每天事多，这一通耽搁，都从早上到下午了。
大山洞。
天气冷了，祭司窝在山洞的时间也长了。
老兽人成天坐在他的草窝里，也不去山上那单独的山洞。他一边教着狼雪、狼冰，再做着些药膏药粉，偶尔给部落的兽人看个病。
林楸进去，老兽人慢悠悠看来。
“稀客。”
林楸：“稠客。”
狼岩轻声一笑，被林楸按在凳子上。
他看着林楸自己从祭司那里找了药瓶，拿了干净的布，随后往他身边一坐。
“手。”
狼岩把手递过去。
林楸一看，捏了下他修长的手指，“换一个。”
狼岩弯唇，换上自己受伤的手。
祭司瞥了眼，把幼崽的脑袋转过来。
狼雪又看了一眼林楸，眼巴巴的。
老祭司手上的细棍子点了点幼崽手背，道：“专心点。”
林楸取下狼岩手上的布。
兽人的伤口恢复速度确实要快些，昨天看着还狰狞的伤口，用了药，过了一晚看起来就没那么可怖了。
林楸给狼岩重新换上药粉，一边包扎一边道：“白雀他们说就在北边先找火树果，等会儿我们去看看？”
狼岩：“好。”
林楸余光注意到频繁看来的幼崽，声音低了下来：“要不带上雪？”
幼崽成天跟着祭司窝在山洞，小小年纪，别把自己学傻了。
狼岩看了眼祭司那边，一老一小都看过来，一个满脸嫌弃一个面露期待。
狼岩：“祭司？”
老祭司道：“你看看你俩一进来，幼崽这个样子还学不学得进去。”
林楸给狼岩手上的布打个结，笑着回头道：“劳逸结合嘛。”
*
白雀兽人在北边摘火树果，离狼山不远。
狼岩和林楸往北边走了一段。狼雪被狼岩抱着，欢喜地一路上脑袋转个不停。
林楸：“没出来过？”
狼雪：“王不让我们出来。”
林楸看了眼狼岩，忍不住挨近他，下巴蹭过他肩头，道：“咱们只带雪出来，其他幼崽会不会闹？”
狼岩无奈看向自己伴侣。
是谁刚刚偷偷抱着幼崽跑出来的？这会儿想起来会有这事了？
林楸：“那咱们等会儿悄悄回？”
“不行了。”狼岩道。
“为什么？”
“你看后头。”
不远处，火树顶端的树枝在晃动。白雀们把兽皮袋挂在树枝上，正在枝头忙碌。
林楸和狼岩没停在树下，离白雀那边还有点距离。
林楸听了狼岩的话，往后一瞧，安安静静的，草丛树木后都没动静。
林楸嗅了嗅，眉头一皱。
小狼崽子味儿。
林楸眉心一跳，道：“遭了。”
狼岩：“别躲了，出来。”
树后没动静。
狼岩：“狼生，带幼崽出来。”
树后幼崽探头，一个叠一个，黑的、灰的、白的小狼冲着狼岩和林楸，咧嘴露出一个讨好的笑。
看他俩没生气，幼崽乖乖跑出来。
狼生带头，走到林楸跟前，再往他们中间一看，狼雪安安静静坐在王胳膊上，低头看着他。
幼崽忍了忍，没忍住，大声控诉道：“楸楸你怎么只带雪出来玩儿！”
“你偏心！”
“楸……你是不是因为我们弄坏了藕粉不喜欢我们了？”狼花抓上林楸衣摆，有些落寞道。
林楸听幼崽越说越离谱，赶紧捂了他们的嘴。
他蹲下来，认真道：“不要胡说，我绝对没有因为你们弄坏了藕粉不喜欢你们。”
“你们已经认错，也改了，那就是好狼崽。”
“那你为什么不带我们……”狼圆挤到他怀里，抱着他脖子，说着说着，自个儿眼眶就红了。
林楸无措，看向狼岩。
狼岩也被幼崽围着，缠着闹呢。
林楸叹气，额头抵着幼崽单薄的肩膀，道：“我错了……我不该悄悄带走狼雪，不该落下你们，幼崽能不能原谅我？”
狼圆小手摸着林楸的脸。
他抽噎一下，红着眼眶和鼻子，可怜兮兮道：“那我原谅你了。”
林楸抹掉幼崽的眼泪，有些心疼，“这么容易就原谅我了？”
狼圆依赖地靠着他，“嗯”了一声。
林楸和狼岩自知理亏，只能把幼崽聚集到一起，没让他们靠近摘火树果的地方。
火树很高，长了不知道多少年，笔直而上。
树顶上，几个白雀兽人在上面忙碌，像几朵白白的绒朵一样。
雀二白看到林楸和狼岩，飞了下来，落在树枝上。
鹅黄的爪子抓得树枝紧紧的，豆豆眼看来，有些为难地在翅膀上蹭了蹭脑袋。
“楸，我们拿不回去，带的兽皮袋少了。”
“你们只管摘，我们拉板车过来。”
“好。”雀二白飞走前，又看看围绕在他们身边的幼崽，道，“我们要往下面扔果子，你们带幼崽离远一点。”
林楸：“好。”
林楸先赶紧捡了些地上的火树果，一个幼崽塞上一个，给他们玩儿，随后带他们离开这一片地方。
近雪季了，树林里阴冷。
风小，站着没一会儿，却觉那一股冷气往衣服缝隙里钻。
林楸带着幼崽四处转转，找些能吃的果子。
幼崽们跟出来郊游似的，各个乐乐呵呵，见到一只飞虫都新奇。
林楸和狼岩一直跟在后头。
林楸看幼崽这样，道：“王，幼崽几岁能被允许离开狼山？”
“有自保能力之后。”
“十五十六？”
“每个幼崽不一样，我记得狼金是十三。”
当时小狼队还没成熟，狼金就喜欢跟着狩猎队去外面跑了。
但出去也不是玩儿，是实打实的训练捕猎技能。而且就算出去，小狼也不允许离开成年兽人身边。
也是今年，狼金的小狼狩猎队才开始单独行动，负责给大泽那边干活的兽人捕捉猎物。
林楸看着眼前这些还没他腰高的幼崽，手托在黏在他身边的狼雪下巴处，轻轻挠了挠。
“我是不是该给你们弄些玩具出来？”
狼雪倚着他，眯着眼睛，仰起头让他挠得更舒服些。
“玩具是什么？”
“玩具就是用来玩儿的东西……比如说你们的狼毛球。”
陪着幼崽遛了一圈，林楸和狼岩把他们带了回去。
之后他俩又带了两辆板车来。
部落里大部分板车被狼火拉到大泽去了，留下两辆应急，现在正好有用。
白雀们摘果子摘得快，抓着果子只管往下扔。
兽形太慢，他们就用人形。
树顶上有点动静就摇摇晃晃，林楸和狼岩在这片已被摘得差不多的地里捡着火树果。
林楸拿起一个，比了比自己的手。
球果墨绿，足足有他手掌长，里头的火树子儿，也就是松子儿个头也不小。
还不到半天时间，摘下来的火树果就装满了一辆板车。
林楸和狼岩在这边忙了会儿，临近天黑，才和白雀兽人一起拉着板车，心满意足地离开。
晚间，兽人们收工回来。
广场上的东西早被收拾一空，幼崽守了一天的藕粉被收在食堂的架子上放着，地上晒的核桃也被装进藤筐，明天再继续晒。
快要吃饭了，兽人们聚集在食堂。
室内暗，只有一盏油灯亮着。
林楸把昨天做的火树油蜡烛拿了出来。细长的藤条管子摆在桌子上，长短、大小都差不多。
兽人们一瞧，走了过来，几下占据了附近的桌子凳子。
林楸还没打开，就看他们眼巴巴地守着了。
他一笑，道：“这又不是什么食物。”
“但是个新鲜东西。”狼安也在，他也好奇楸说的这个什么叫蜡烛的东西。
林楸也不卖关子，他直接把藤条打开。
藤条在灌装火树油之前，已经被他破成两半，只需要轻轻一掰，就露出里面颜色发暗的火树油蜡烛。
这蜡烛没有常见的蜡烛颜色白润，味道带着天然的火树油的味道。
林楸将它点燃，往桌面倾斜。
凝固的火树油遇热熔化，滴落几滴，林楸将蜡烛放上去，稍稍压了一下，片刻，蜡烛便稳稳地固定在桌面上。
狼安用手碰了下，没倒。
火树的味道随着蜡烛的燃烧蔓延开来，兽人们看得新奇。
“这个香。”狼莫道。
他开口，火苗被他吹得晃动。
边上狼西捂住他的嘴，盯着火苗看了一会儿，才放开。
“比油灯亮一点。”
林楸就着光，把其他几个蜡烛都剥了出来，兽人们也动手帮忙。
他往灶上点了两个，食堂内的光线霎时明亮了起来。
兽人们低呼，立即道：“楸，再多做些。”
林楸：“没油。”
“快了。”狼贝道。
他们采集队今天去看了割了火树树皮的地方，底下放的破烂陶碗已经装了一个底了。
明天他们就可以拿罐子去收。
白雀兽人也在，他们忙碌了半天，带回来整整两车的火树果，现在就堆在筐里。
他们也守着桌子，看着桌面的蜡烛，豆豆眼里都是亮光。
“这个东西好。”雀二白道，“要是集市还在，还可以拿去交换。”
“交换？”林楸看向他。
雀二白点头，“集市上什么都可以用来交换，只要兽人们互相看得上。我以前还看见有兽人用我们这边的火树枝跟南边的兽人交换东西。”
火种对兽人来说是很重要的东西，每个部落都有保存火种的传统。
有关火的一切材料，在集市上其实也很好交换。
这个蜡烛，小小一根，晚上能照明，也能用来引燃干草，对兽人们来说是个好东西。
反正换做是他，在集市上遇到了，他是愿意交换的。
不过……嘿嘿，他已经知道了这个是怎么做的，那他们自己也可以做。
林楸看着桌上燃烧的蜡烛，慢慢道：“可以多做点。”
兽人们点头。
他们都想要！
次日，兽人们继续忙着晒藕粉、晒核桃，晒各种鱼干肉干。
昨天带回来的火树果也摊开在广场上，兽人们坐在凳子上，把里面的火树子打出来。
“楸！咱们再做点藕粉出来吧。”
天气冷了，狼火他们送回来的莲藕也越来越多。大伙儿快吃腻了，每天消耗的莲藕也有限。
狼安怕大雪一下来，这些堆在山洞的莲藕就会被冻坏。
林楸自然没有不应的。
这事儿也不用他操心，狼安自己就安排好了。
伴随着叮叮当当的敲击声，还有砍木头的声音，广场对面三个房子已经建好；咩咩兽和红鸟圈里，扩建的火炕房也拔地而起。
两月时间，转眼而过。
雪季来临。
一夜之间，天地洁白一片。
雪从昨晚开始下，到了今天早上才勉强小了下来。
地面的雪有半指深，兽人们猫在大山洞、食堂还有几个有火炕的屋子里，不愿意出去。
寒风瑟瑟，结实的砖瓦房子里，确实温暖如春。
白雀兽人早在半月前就走了，他们带走了几大包筐的鱼干，还是狼火他们用板车给送到大泽那边的。
白雀一走，兽人们紧赶慢赶，把该烧的木炭烧好，该晒完的藕粉晒完，随后进入猫冬的日子。
雪季头一天，兽人们睡了个饱。
大伙儿醒来时，见外面天光明亮，开门一看，才知道是下雪了。
雪季头一天，勉强不算太冷。
抗冻的兽人们就往身上套一件兽皮马甲，不抗冻的，就把全套兽皮衣兽皮裤兽皮靴穿上。
幼崽被要求外出必须维持兽形。
他们匆匆跑过廊道，跑进食堂里，脑袋拱开门就被热气烘了一脸。
他们抖一抖毛，一滚地变做人形，小手捂住光屁股，急吼吼地把衣服穿上，然后凑到灶台边去。
狼安把他们赶到边上，道：“去拿碗，今早上咱们试试藕粉。”
藕粉做得多，做好也有一阵子了，一直放在山洞里没动。
今天算是部落大部分兽人头一次吃。
大伙儿全进了食堂，灶上烧着火，里头没有火炕也一点不冷。
食堂大，桌椅摆放得多，兽人们都能找到位置。
他们看着狼安示范，也学着把碗里倒上热水，搅和搅和——
“咦？”
“怎么变了？”
林楸抿上一点有些烫嘴的藕粉，里头加了果干和蜂蜜，微甜，滋味一点不差。
果干是部落攒下来的，蜂蜜……是豹休带小狼找的，找回来当天就被收拾一通，蜂蜜也被没收。
林楸很久没吃过藕粉了，一时间还有些怀念。
他听到兽人们惊奇的声音，弯了弯眼，舒服地挨着身旁的狼岩，放松了姿态慢慢吃。
“明年可以多做些。”狼岩道。
藕粉不比肉干扎实，胜在快，很适合外出带着。
林楸：“今年莲藕被狼火他们挖得多，明年不种，怕是没今年这产量。”
“种。”狼岩道。
“那我们什么时候去赤山部落？”
chapters.translated_text:
Clang, clatter—

At noon, Tu Kui and the tribespeople returned after gathering firewood. They dumped their haul in a corner near the cliff wall and went to the stream to wash their hands.

Walking through the plaza, the rabbit-beastmen noticed the newly dried walnuts and squatted down to take a look.

"There are so few," Tu Ai said.

It had felt like a lot when they were gathering them—so heavy they could barely carry them—but after peeling off the outer husks, the pile looked like it would only fill one large wicker basket.

"There aren't any left on the back mountain," Tu Kui said. "We'll go a bit further this afternoon."

"The beastmen rarely go to the west side. Chief, shall we go west?"

"That works."

At this hour, the beastmen were finishing their work and returning for lunch.

Lang Mo was shaking his hands as he crossed the plaza, heading toward the cafeteria.

Seeing Tu Kui and the others, he lifted his chin and flashed a roguish grin. "Kui! You're back!"

Tu Kui straightened up, nodded at him, and hurried to tell the beastmen to go wash their hands.

Back in the cafeteria, he heard Lang Mo and Lin Qiu discussing firewood for the snow season.

Tu Kui paused and sat down beside them.

"Firewood is hard to chop. The natural death rate of plants can't keep up with our consumption, and the wood nearby has mostly been picked clean..."

Tu Kui nodded.

It was true. They had scoured every area within a half-day's round trip to the southeast, south, west, and north of Wolf Mountain, and the firewood they had gathered so far was only enough to fill one cave.

"What about the cattail stalks? There are so many of those."

"Those don't burn for long."

The beastmen in the tribe were busy, and those cattail stalks had been sitting in a corner of the plaza ever since they were brought back. If Lang Mo hadn't mentioned them, Lin Qiu would have almost forgotten.

"The cattail stalks should be stacked into haystacks; they'll be useful when starting fires. We won't need to cut extra dry grass later."

Lang Mo: "Haystacks?"

Lin Qiu: "We'll make them together when we have time in the evening. You'll understand once we do."

Returning to the topic of firewood, Lin Qiu asked Tu Kui and learned that there really wasn't much wood left that could be picked up directly.

The rest were fallen trees; they had already broken off all the branches they could, and the rest would need to be chopped to be brought back.

But the beastmen lacked good tools, and chopping wood was time-consuming and exhausting, so everyone preferred to walk further to find wood they could carry back directly.

Lin Qiu: "We still need thicker firewood."

Tu Kui agreed, "We'll carry those back this afternoon."

Lin Qiu nodded. "Bring back what you can first; we can chop it after it's here. Mo, we still need to make charcoal this year."

Last year, they had burned a few kilns of charcoal, but it hadn't even lasted half the snow season.

The fire pits for the Meimei beasts and the red birds needed wood, cooking needed wood, and the beastmen needed wood for warmth—it was a 24-hour cycle. A cave full of wood didn't last long, especially in the snow season; it wasn't efficient at all.

Upon hearing this, Lang Mo slumped over the table and let out a long "Awoo."

"Too busy to handle it?"

"What's too busy?" Lang Chi walked over with a bowl and chopsticks. He placed the earthenware bowl in front of Lin Qiu, sat opposite him, and said, "Father can help."

Lin Qiu looked at the bowl and chopsticks in front of him, feeling a bit confused.

Lang Yan followed a step behind Lang Chi and sat down beside Lin Qiu, also setting down his bowl.

"Uncle Chi said my hand is inconvenient, so he's helping me carry it."

"What do you mean 'helping you'? I'm helping my own cub."

Lin Qiu pursed his lips, looking at a face that was both familiar and unfamiliar, and said, "Thank you... Father."

Lang Chi's mouth twitched, wanting to smile, but with so many beastmen watching, he tightened his lips and said, "What's got you all stumped? We old guys can help."

"Making charcoal," Lang Mo said.

Lang Chi knew about charcoal; he had stayed at Wolf Mountain last snow season and had used it.

Charcoal was burned from wood, pitch-black, and more durable than wood. If burned well, it didn't even produce smoke.

"Not enough beastmen?"

"That's not it," Lang Mo said.

"Stop dawdling. What is it exactly? Can't you say it all at once?" Lang Chi said.

Lang Mo: "It's nothing much, just that we currently have to fire pottery, bake bricks, fire tiles, build houses, and now we've added charcoal making."

"Is that all? We'll do it."

The beastmen who had returned from the branch tribe in the previous batch each had their own tasks. For example, Lang Tan, who used to be in the gathering team at the branch tribe and worked under Lang Xing, was now doing weaving and cooking under Lang An.

For instance, Lang Jiao was leading the elderly beastmen to do carpentry work under Lang Qi.

Then there were Lang Kuo and Lang Ye, who also had specific tasks.

But the beastmen who returned in the later batch didn't have fixed jobs; they usually went wherever they were needed.

Lang Chi thought about it carefully; this wouldn't do.

Without specific arrangements, the beastmen were always running around. Although the work got done, it was sometimes slow.

"There are over sixty of us in the later batch, and we're all helping Lang Mo build houses and bake bricks. Why not split some off to be responsible for this firewood business?"

"Look at Tu Kui and the others; they aren't meant for this either. They still have to look after the fields. Since they have time now, why not have them go out with the gathering team to find more seeds, cultivate new wild vegetables, and maybe even find something else like the cattail?"

Of course, this was the ideal scenario.

But such talented planters couldn't be tied down to gathering firewood.

Only with specialized roles could the Wolf Tribe's various endeavors progress.

Lin Qiu heard this and glanced at Lang Chi.

Old guy... his father still had foresight.

Seeing that no one had any objections, Lang Chi, accustomed to being a chief in the branch tribe, began to arrange things:

"Here's how it is: Lang Wan will take twenty wolf-beastmen to help Lang Mo build houses, and Lang Xing will take twenty beastmen to help dig mud to bake bricks and fire pottery. I'll take the remaining beastmen to make charcoal. We'll concentrate on making charcoal in the half-month before the snow season. During this time, we'll hurry to bring back all the dry firewood from outside."

After finishing, he remembered Lang Yan was still there. He paused and added, somewhat stiffly, "...How about that?"

Lang Yan nodded.

Lin Qiu curled his lips, "That works."

Lang Mo breathed a sigh of relief and nodded vigorously, "Yes, yes, that works."

He still had forty beastmen left, which was enough.

"Then what about us..." Tu Kui looked hesitantly at the few beastmen.

"Do whatever you want. Let's go, let's go, time to eat!" Lang Mo grabbed Tu Kui and walked off.

Tu Kui was forced to take a few steps before looking back at Lin Qiu.

Lin Qiu smiled at him, "Kui, I think my father's suggestion is good. Think about it carefully."

"Okay." Tu Kui smiled too.

Compared to gathering firewood, he really did prefer planting.

The beastmen went their separate ways. After the meal, everyone rested for a while before heading off to their assigned tasks.

Lang Chi led his team, along with the remaining beastmen who were willing to build houses and bake bricks, took stone axes, and left with thick wild grass ropes hanging on them.

The ten White Sparrow beastmen also set off with animal skin bags in their talons.

Tu Kui and his group didn't follow.

They waited for Lin Qiu to finish resting and then gathered around him.

Lin Qiu was flipping through the drying walnuts when he was blocked by Tu Kui.

He looked at the rabbit-beastmen in confusion, even little Tu Yan was there.

Lin Qiu looked around and suddenly started laughing.

The wolf-beastmen had a habit of surrounding the beastmen from a young age; when did Tu Kui and the others learn that?

"Qiu, what do you think we should plant?"

There were too many edible plants, and Tu Kui didn't know where to start.

Lin Qiu: "The plants our tribe grows ourselves are still too few."

"Too few?"

Lin Qiu nodded.

"Take vegetables, for example. Before you came, the wolf-beastmen only grew some herbs; there weren't any proper vegetables. Actually, vegetables have different textures, and different beastmen like different things. You can never have too many varieties."

"For instance, the itchy-root; you could try to see if it can be planted. It's hard for us to dig them up in the wild, but if we grow them on a scale, and they grow as neatly as radishes..."

The rabbit-beastmen listened, their eyes growing brighter.

"Likewise, not just vegetables, but also the fruits the beastmen love, and the medicinal herbs they use—all of these can be studied."

"There are many varieties. While various plants are maturing now, you can collect more seeds, see which ones you like, and try planting them. Anyway, the wolf-beastmen won't complain about having too many vegetables."

Lang Mo: "We would..."

Lang Yan stood to the side and gave a look; Lang Mo shut his mouth.

He silently bypassed them to get water from the windowsill.

Lin Qiu was discussing seriously with the rabbit-beastmen and didn't hear him.

Seeing Lin Qiu's throat was dry from talking, Lang Yan poured water and placed it in his hand, taking over the conversation: "The tribe will develop slowly. Think further ahead—if the tribe has thousands of beastmen in the future, relying solely on gathering to fill our stomachs..."

Lin Qiu: "That would be far from enough."

Lang Yan nodded.

So, in the end, they had to rely on animal husbandry and planting.

Once their animal husbandry was stable, they would definitely try to raise more animals. Similarly, planting couldn't be limited to just a few plants like the cattail.

When it came to this, the rabbit-beastmen finally understood.

This wasn't just to pass the time; it was a task, a responsibility, and a pressure. If the tribe really developed to that point and their vegetables were still just those few kinds...

Tu Ai thought about it and couldn't help but shiver.

No, that's too few!

Lin Qiu finished his water, his throat moistened, and he said, "You know more about planting than we do. In short, the more plants we can grow ourselves, the better."

"Okay! We will do our best." Tu Kui looked quietly at Lin Qiu and Lang Yan, promising.

Lin Qiu smiled, "No need to be so serious, just do your best."

Tu Ai: "We will definitely do our best."

With the matter explained, the rest was left to Tu Kui to arrange.

Once the rabbit-beastmen left, Lin Qiu strolled along the riverbank.

A small boat floated on the river, and a beastman stood on it, casting a fishing net.

The net was like an open hand, reaching into the water to catch fish.

If it weren't for the boat rocking violently and the beastman crying out "Ouch, ouch," there might have been a sense of leisure to it.

As he walked, Lin Qiu suddenly stopped.

Lang Yan's wrist tightened as he was pulled by his mate, hurrying toward the cave.

"What's wrong?"

"Forgot to change your dressing."

There were so many things to do every day; with all the delays, it had gone from morning to afternoon.

The large cave.

The weather was getting cold, and the priest spent more time in the cave.

The old beastman sat in his grass nest all day, not going to the separate cave on the mountain. He taught Lang Xue and Lang Bing while making ointments and powders, occasionally treating the tribe's beastmen.

As Lin Qiu entered, the old beastman looked over slowly.

"Rare guest."

Lin Qiu: "Frequent guest."

Lang Yan chuckled softly as Lin Qiu pressed him onto a stool.

He watched Lin Qiu find the medicine bottle from the priest, take a clean cloth, and then sit down beside him.

"Hand."

Lang Yan handed over his hand.

Lin Qiu looked at it, squeezed his slender fingers, and said, "The other one."

Lang Yan curled his lips and switched to his injured hand.

The priest glanced over and turned the cub's head back.

Lang Xue looked at Lin Qiu again, eyes full of longing.

The old priest tapped the cub's hand with a thin stick, saying, "Focus."

Lin Qiu removed the cloth from Lang Yan's hand.

Beastmen's wounds did indeed heal faster; the wound that looked gruesome yesterday already looked less terrifying after one night of medicine.

Lin Qiu reapplied the powder to Lang Yan's hand, bandaging it as he said, "The White Sparrows said they'd find fire-tree fruits in the north first. Shall we go take a look later?"

Lang Yan: "Okay."

Lin Qiu noticed the cub looking over frequently and lowered his voice: "Should we take Xue?"

The cub spent all day huddled in the cave with the priest; at such a young age, he shouldn't be made dull.

Lang Yan looked toward the priest; the old and the young both looked over, one with a look of annoyance and the other with anticipation.

Lang Yan: "Priest?"

The old priest said, "Look at you two; the moment you walk in, the cub can't focus on his studies anymore."

Lin Qiu tied a knot in the bandage on Lang Yan's hand, turned back with a smile, and said, "Work and rest should be balanced."

*

The White Sparrow beastmen were picking fire-tree fruits in the north, not far from Wolf Mountain.

Lang Yan and Lin Qiu walked a distance to the north. Lang Xue was carried by Lang Yan, his head turning constantly with joy.

Lin Qiu: "Haven't been out before?"

Lang Xue: "The King won't let us out."

Lin Qiu glanced at Lang Yan, couldn't help but lean closer, rubbing his chin against his shoulder, and said, "If we only take Xue out, will the other cubs make a fuss?"

Lang Yan looked helplessly at his mate.

Who was the one who just snuck out with the cub? Thinking about it now?

Lin Qiu: "Then shall we sneak back later?"

"Too late," Lang Yan said.

"Why?"

"Look behind you."

Not far away, the branches at the top of the fire tree were shaking. The White Sparrows had hung their animal skin bags on the branches and were busy at work.

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan hadn't stopped under the tree; they were still some distance away from the White Sparrows.

Lin Qiu listened to Lang Yan and looked back; it was quiet, with no movement behind the bushes or trees.

Lin Qiu sniffed and frowned.

The scent of wolf cubs.

Lin Qiu's heart skipped a beat, and he said, "Oh no."

Lang Yan: "Stop hiding, come out."

No movement behind the tree.

Lang Yan: "Lang Sheng, bring the cubs out."

The cubs peeked out from behind the tree, one stacked on top of another—black, gray, and white little wolves—grinning at Lang Yan and Lin Qiu with ingratiating smiles.

Seeing they weren't angry, the cubs ran out obediently.

Lang Sheng led the way to Lin Qiu, then looked between them; Lang Xue was sitting quietly on the King's arm, looking down at him.

The cub couldn't hold it in and loudly accused, "Qiuqiu, why did you only take Xue out to play!"

"You're biased!"

"Qiu... do you not like us anymore because we ruined the lotus root powder?" Lang Hua grabbed Lin Qiu's hem, looking a bit dejected.

Lin Qiu heard the cubs getting more and more ridiculous and quickly covered their mouths.

He squatted down and said seriously, "Don't talk nonsense. I absolutely do not dislike you because you ruined the lotus root powder."

"You've already admitted your mistake and corrected it, so you're good wolf cubs."

"Then why didn't you take us..." Lang Yuan squeezed into his arms, hugging his neck, and as he spoke, his eyes turned red.

Lin Qiu was at a loss and looked at Lang Yan.

Lang Yan was also surrounded and pestered by cubs.

Lin Qiu sighed, resting his forehead against the cub's thin shoulder, and said, "I was wrong... I shouldn't have snuck away with Lang Xue and left you behind. Can the cubs forgive me?"

Lang Yuan touched Lin Qiu's face with his small hand.

He sobbed, his eyes and nose red, and said pitifully, "Then I forgive you."

Lin Qiu wiped away the cub's tears, feeling a pang of heartache. "You forgave me so easily?"

Lang Yuan leaned on him dependently and said, "Mm."

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan knew they were in the wrong and could only gather the cubs together, keeping them away from where the fire-tree fruits were being picked.

The fire tree was very tall, having grown for who knows how many years, straight up.

At the top of the tree, several White Sparrow beastmen were busy, looking like white fluff.

Que Erbai saw Lin Qiu and Lang Yan and flew down, landing on a branch.

His yellow claws gripped the branch tightly, and his beady eyes looked over, rubbing his head against his wing in embarrassment.

"Qiu, we can't carry it back; we didn't bring enough animal skin bags."

"Just keep picking; we'll bring the carts over."

"Okay." Before flying away, Que Erbai looked at the cubs surrounding them and said, "We're going to throw fruits down, keep the cubs away."

Lin Qiu: "Okay."

Lin Qiu quickly picked up some fire-tree fruits from the ground, gave one to each cub to play with, and then led them away from the area.

It was nearing the snow season, and the forest was cold and gloomy.

The wind was light, but after standing for a while, he felt the cold air creeping into the gaps in his clothes.

Lin Qiu took the cubs around to look for other edible fruits.

The cubs were like they were on an outing, all happy and cheerful, finding even a flying insect novel.

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan followed behind.

Seeing the cubs like this, Lin Qiu said, "King, at what age are cubs allowed to leave Wolf Mountain?"

"After they have the ability to protect themselves."

"Fifteen or sixteen?"

"Every cub is different. I remember Lang Jin was thirteen."

At that time, the little wolf team wasn't mature yet, but Lang Jin liked to follow the hunting team outside.

But going out wasn't for play; it was real training in hunting skills. And even if they went out, the little wolves weren't allowed to leave the side of the adult beastmen.

It was only this year that Lang Jin's little wolf hunting team began to act independently, responsible for catching prey for the beastmen working in Daze.

Lin Qiu looked at these cubs who weren't even as tall as his waist, placed his hand under Lang Xue's chin, and scratched gently.

"Should I make some toys for you?"

Lang Xue leaned against him, squinting his eyes and lifting his head to let him scratch more comfortably.

"What's a toy?"

"A toy is something used for playing... like your wolf fur balls."

After walking around with the cubs, Lin Qiu and Lang Yan brought them back.

Afterward, the two of them brought two carts.

Most of the tribe's carts had been taken to Daze by Lang Huo, leaving two for emergencies, which were just right for use now.

The White Sparrows picked fruits quickly, just throwing them down.

Their beast forms were too slow, so they used their human forms.

The top of the tree swayed with any movement, and Lin Qiu and Lang Yan picked up the fire-tree fruits in the area that had already been mostly cleared.

Lin Qiu picked one up and compared it to his hand.

The cone was dark green, a full palm's length, and the fire-tree seeds inside—the pine nuts—were also quite large.

In less than half a day, the fire-tree fruits picked filled a cart.

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan worked there for a while, and as it neared dark, they finally left, satisfied, pulling the carts along with the White Sparrow beastmen.

In the evening, the beastmen returned from work.

The things in the plaza had long been cleared away; the lotus root powder the cubs had guarded all day was stored on the shelves in the cafeteria, and the walnuts drying on the ground were put into wicker baskets to be dried again tomorrow.

As it was time to eat, the beastmen gathered in the cafeteria.

It was dark inside, with only one oil lamp lit.

Lin Qiu took out the fire-tree oil candles he had made yesterday. Slender rattan tubes were laid on the table, all similar in length and size.

Seeing this, the beastmen walked over and quickly occupied the nearby tables and stools.

Before Lin Qiu even opened them, he saw them watching eagerly.

He smiled and said, "This isn't food."

"But it's a new thing." Lang An was also there, curious about what Lin Qiu called a candle.

Lin Qiu didn't keep them in suspense and opened the rattan.

Before filling them with fire-tree oil, the rattan had been split in two; he just had to gently pry it open to reveal the dark-colored fire-tree oil candle inside.

This candle wasn't the white, smooth color of common candles, and it smelled of the natural fire-tree oil.

Lin Qiu lit it and tilted it toward the tabletop.

The solidified fire-tree oil melted from the heat, dripping a few drops. Lin Qiu placed the candle on top and pressed it slightly; in a moment, the candle was firmly fixed to the table.

Lang An touched it with his hand, and it didn't fall.

The scent of the fire tree spread as the candle burned, and the beastmen watched in wonder.

"This smells good," Lang Mo said.

As he spoke, the flame flickered from his breath.

Lang Xi beside him covered his mouth, staring at the flame for a while before letting go.

"It's brighter than the oil lamp."

Lin Qiu used the light to peel the other candles, and the beastmen helped.

He lit two on the stove, and the cafeteria instantly brightened.

The beastmen gasped and immediately said, "Qiu, make more."

Lin Qiu: "No oil."

"Soon," Lang Bei said.

Their gathering team had checked the place where they cut the fire-tree bark today, and the broken earthenware bowls placed underneath already had a layer of oil in them.

Tomorrow they could take jars to collect it.

The White Sparrow beastmen were also there; they had been busy all day and brought back two full carts of fire-tree fruits, now piled in baskets.

They also guarded the table, looking at the candle, their beady eyes shining.

"This thing is good," Que Erbai said. "If the market were still open, we could take it to trade."

"Trade?" Lin Qiu looked at him.

Que Erbai nodded. "Anything can be traded at the market as long as the beastmen like it. I once saw beastmen using our fire-tree branches to trade with beastmen from the south."

Fire was a very important thing for beastmen, and every tribe had a tradition of preserving fire.

All materials related to fire were actually easy to trade at the market.

This candle, small as it was, could provide light at night and could also be used to ignite dry grass; it was a good thing for beastmen.

Anyway, if it were him, he would be willing to trade for it if he encountered it at the market.

However... hehe, he already knew how it was made, so they could make it themselves.

Lin Qiu looked at the burning candle on the table and said slowly, "We can make more."

The beastmen nodded.

They all wanted some!

The next day, the beastmen continued to be busy drying lotus root powder, walnuts, and various dried fish and meat.

The fire-tree fruits brought back yesterday were also spread out in the plaza, and the beastmen sat on stools, shelling the fire-tree seeds inside.

"Qiu! Let's make more lotus root powder."

The weather was getting cold, and the lotus roots sent back by Lang Huo and the others were increasing. Everyone was getting tired of eating them, and the daily consumption was limited.

Lang An was afraid that once the heavy snow fell, the lotus roots piled in the cave would freeze and rot.

Lin Qiu naturally didn't refuse.

He didn't need to worry about this; Lang An had already arranged it.

Accompanied by the clanging sounds and the sound of chopping wood, three houses across the plaza were completed; in the Meimei beast and red bird enclosures, expanded heated brick bed rooms also rose from the ground.

Two months passed in the blink of an eye.

The snow season arrived.

Overnight, the world turned white.

The snow had started falling last night and only slowed down by this morning.

The snow on the ground was half a finger deep, and the beastmen huddled in the large cave, the cafeteria, and the few rooms with heated beds, unwilling to go out.

The cold wind blew, but inside the sturdy brick and tile houses, it was indeed as warm as spring.

The White Sparrow beastmen had left half a month ago, taking away several large bags of dried fish, which Lang Huo and the others had delivered to Daze by cart.

Once the White Sparrows left, the beastmen hurried to finish burning the charcoal and drying the lotus root powder, then entered the days of hibernating.

On the first day of the snow season, the beastmen slept well.

When everyone woke up, they saw the sky was bright outside, and upon opening the door, they realized it had snowed.

The first day of the snow season wasn't too cold.

The cold-resistant beastmen put on an animal skin vest, while those who weren't put on full sets of animal skin clothes, pants, and boots.

Cubs were required to maintain their beast form when going outside.

They ran hurriedly through the corridor and into the cafeteria, their heads pushing open the door, and were hit in the face by the heat.

They shook their fur, rolled on the ground to change into human form, covered their bare bottoms with their small hands, hurriedly put on their clothes, and then gathered around the stove.

Lang An shooed them to the side and said, "Go get bowls; this morning we'll try the lotus root powder."

A lot of lotus root powder had been made, and it had been a while since it was finished; it had been sitting in the cave untouched.

Today was the first time most of the tribe's beastmen would eat it.

Everyone entered the cafeteria; the fire was burning on the stove, and even without a heated bed, it wasn't cold inside.

The cafeteria was large, with many tables and chairs, so all the beastmen could find a seat.

They watched Lang An demonstrate and learned to pour hot water into their bowls and stir—

"Eh?"

"Why did it change?"

Lin Qiu sipped a bit of the slightly hot lotus root powder, which had dried fruit and honey added; it was slightly sweet, and the taste was excellent.

The dried fruit was saved by the tribe, and the honey... was found by Bao Xiu and the little wolves; they were scolded for it the day they brought it back, and the honey was confiscated.

Lin Qiu hadn't eaten lotus root powder for a long time and felt a bit nostalgic.

Hearing the beastmen's surprised voices, he curled his eyes, leaned comfortably against Lang Yan, and relaxed to eat slowly.

"We can make more next year," Lang Yan said.

Lotus root powder wasn't as filling as dried meat, but it was quick and very suitable for carrying when going out.

Lin Qiu: "Lang Huo and the others dug up a lot of lotus roots this year. If we don't plant them next year, I'm afraid we won't have this year's yield."

"Plant them," Lang Yan said.

"Then when are we going to the Chishan Tribe?"
chapters.title: 第176章

chapters.source_text:
“你们去赤山部落干什么？”狼赤放下碗，狼晚、狼星听到这话，也都坐了过来。
林楸听他这意思，像是知道赤山部落。
“这附近就这么一个狼部落，我们想去看看，顺带去南边交换些草药回来。阿、阿父……你们知道赤山部落？”
“听说过。”
当年他们为了找猎物多的地方，四处跑，或多或少知道一些这些大一点的部落的情况。
但他们也只知道赤山部落的狼王是雌性兽人，还是红狼兽人。
以红狼兽人孤僻的性子，他们过去还不一定能见到。
林楸：“这不是部落里兽人们催嘛……”
狼晚：“他们催什么？”
“没伴侣啊。”
狼星一笑，见众兽人看来，笑容收敛，淡淡道：“找伴侣凭本事，哪里还用你们操心。”
“兽人们就是想凭本事，可也得有狼兽人啊。”
狼晚点头，“楸说得对。今年没新生的幼崽吧？”
林楸摇摇头。
“那……怀了幼崽的兽人？”
林楸也摇头。
隔壁桌，狼力夫夫俩听到狼晚他们的问话，默默低下头。
狼鱼看了眼自己肚子，面露哀伤。
狼力抓住他的手，扣得紧紧的，关切地看着他。
“没事，不担心。”
狼赤这边并没注意到狼力夫夫俩，听着林楸的回答，狼赤几个面色顿时凝重了起来。
“那确实该去。”
“不过亚兽人和雌性兽人本来就少，也别抱太大希望。实在不行，让他们看看能不能找其他种族的兽人？”狼晚道。
他自己说完这话，自己都不信。
狼兽人挑剔，眼里就看得见狼兽人。
这么多年了，他们部落就没一个兽人找其他种族的兽人做伴侣。
狼星单手撑脸，瞧着自个儿幼崽已经混在狼山这边的幼崽堆里，随口道：“也别瞎着急，部落这日子好了，今年没有不代表明年没有。”
狼藏在附近没找到座位，他捧着碗，站在狼赤三个后头，默默点头。
“那你们打算什么时候去？”狼赤问。
林楸看向狼岩。
这事儿不小，得王做主。
狼岩道：“正好跟你们商量商量。”
“按照兔葵他们说的，赤山部落在他们部落附近。他们从部落过来走了两个月，我们过去，脚程快一点，带着东西也要一个月。”
“来回就是两个月。”狼赤捧着吃干净的碗，皱眉道。
狼岩点头。
这一来一回，路上的时间确实是太长了。
“岩，你怎么打算的？”狼晚问。
狼岩：“要去就早点去，我想雪季过后准备一段时间的食物就走，赶在雨季回来。”
适合外出的时间段就两个，一个是雪季后，一个是雨季后。
雪季后，部落需要耕地播种，稍微轻松一些。可雨季后就必须储存食物，一点都耽搁不得。
狼赤几个听完，也赞同。
“楸呢，楸跟着去吗？”狼星忽然问。
林楸：“要去的。我认识草药，要交换草药除了我去，就是狼冰。”
狼星：“那还是你去合适一些。”
小狼没成年，兽人们出远门，一般尽量不会带小狼。
外面飘着雪，木窗半开。
兽人们暂且没什么事情，便把去赤山的事情先细细地商量一遍。
确定好去的时间，还有去的兽人，以及要带的用来交换的东西。
他们没避着其他兽人。
听着他们商量的事，慢慢围过来听的兽人越来越多。
狼安也端了碗，站在一旁道：“去还是年轻力壮的兽人去，最好多点兽人。外面不太平，出去还是安全最重要。”
林楸：“多了也不行。”
兽人们看向林楸。
林楸叹道：“食物不够，兽人一多，每天都是消耗。我们难不成要带几十筐鱼干走？”
“哎！放在以前，哪里用得着愁这些。说在就走，饿了路上打猎就行。”狼赤闷声道。
狼岩：“去一个小队吧，选二十来个兽人就行。趁着雪季，起叔和狡叔这边把弓箭做好，兽人们也多个防身的武器。”
去一个小队？
几个小队的队长一听，立马凑过来。
林楸扫了他们一眼，问：“都想去？”
几个小队长点头。
他们都是年轻的兽人，有狼火、狼乔、狼夜，狼莫也跟着凑热闹。
狼岩这次不打算单独挑选兽人。
出门在外，一个小队的兽人长期同吃同住，还一同捕猎，遇到危险也更默契一些。
林楸看出他这意思，提议道：“那抽签？”
狼安：“我来看着。”
说着端着碗就离开，准备抽签的东西去了。
那边确定着人选，狼岩和林楸这边继续商讨着要带些什么东西去交换。
“陶器……雪季前叫莫他们多烧了的。”林楸看向狼莫。
狼莫手一挥，豪气道：“大的小的都有，随便选。”
林楸失笑道：“陶要带，但不能带多了，这个重而且容易碎。”
狼赤几个点点头。
林楸见他们都看着自己，便继续道：“兽皮……这个是部落交换物品最通用的东西，以防万一，我们还是带上一点好。”
“部落好像没多的。”
狼晚几个对部落的物资熟悉，兽人们连狼毛都用来做衣服了，兽皮更是没剩几张。
“南边热一点。”狼岩提醒。
林楸：“那不带这个？”
“可以带也可以不带，到时候看你们还拿不拿得到。”狼赤直接道。
“也行。”林楸说完，见兽人还是看着自己。
他一笑，“怎么全是我在说？”
狼岩：“没事，继续。”
林楸：“那还有祭司做的一点药。除此之外我打算多做些蜡烛……蜡烛有了，顺带做些火柴？”
“火柴？”
狼晚心道：又一个新东西。
林楸：“就是可以生火的东西，路上我们要吃要喝，带上这个方便。”
“那你做，有需要的我们帮忙。”
“还有布呢？布带不带？”
话落，兽人们一致摇头。
狼晚：“这东西少，部落还不够分。而且东西稀奇，容易招兽人眼，被盯上就不好了。”
狼星：“有陶和蜡烛就不错了，祭司的药膏药粉也很好交换东西。”
他们也有点经验，遇到那些没有祭司的部落，一点草药就能换很多东西。
狼晚：“还有盐。”
商量来商量去，兽人们还是一致认为，东西在精不在多。
最后便定下，主要用来交换的东西就是陶器、盐、祭司的药粉药膏、蜡烛和火柴。
当然，兽人们还没看到火柴是个什么样子。
这个跟蜡烛配套，应当好交换。
“这么多年头一次走这么远，谨慎点好，也别想着把东西带全了。等以后部落各样东西多了，再拿出去交换也不迟。”狼晚看着林楸还纠结的样子，提点了一句。
林楸思绪断开，看着狼晚仿佛洞察一切的眼神，微微弯眼，点头应下。
对，头一次出去，最重要的是谨慎。
过早暴露他们的东西，对狼部落反而有害无利。
他想着路途遥远，尽可能地多交换一些东西回来，不然浪费时间，但忘了兽神大陆危机重重……
头一次，是探路。
成功的话，以后想怎么交换都成，不急于这一时。
这边商量完，狼安那边的抽签也出了结果。
五个年轻兽人队伍抽签，狼游、狼火、狼乔、狼夜四个狩猎队，加上一个凑热闹的狼莫护卫队小队，最后的结果……
狼火捏着手里的树叶，得意洋洋。
林楸看看他那黑红的头发，唇角一翘，随口道：“缘分，没准儿还能遇到狼火的亲戚。”
兽人们看着他那带红色的头发笑起来。
“可不是。”
今天的早餐吃得快，兽人们洗干净碗筷，各自找暖和的地方蹲着。
狼起、狼狡手头还有做弓箭的活儿，吃完就去山洞忙活开了。
这头一天，兽人们还有些闲不住，坐了会儿，就自己找事做。
林楸和狼岩没动，他俩坐在窗边，看着外面扑簌而下的雪花。
林楸探手出去，接了几片。
一收回手，雪还没化，掌心被狼岩抹了一下。
林楸斜着眼看他。
狼岩低声笑了一下，拉着他去背风的地方坐下。
林楸跟在他后头，踩着他的步调，慢悠悠道：“葵他们去不去？还有那三个亚兽人，狼石的干儿子？”
“我们需要兽人带路。兔兽人去一两个就行了，那几个亚兽人，只把鹿叶带着。”
林楸点点头，“那就这么着。”
*
狼山后山，黑山洞。
山洞口搭了棚子，四面挡风，专门给守山洞的兽人安排的。
今天轮到狼顺和另一个兽人轮值，他裹得严严实实的，和同伴蹲在洞口。
同伴往火堆里添柴，叹道：“他们到底什么时候走？”
天天放两个兽人守在这里，还不如让他们去捕猎。
狼顺抓着木棍往地上戳了不少洞，冷得瑟缩道：“王不是说要去赤山部落？肯定会把他们一起带走的。”
“那要什么时候？”
“谁知道呢。”
早上部落商量去赤山部落的事儿的时候他俩不在，所以没听见。
这会儿无聊得往地上戳戳戳，只盼着再快一点。
那三个亚兽人依旧被关在黑山洞。
山洞阴冷，狼兽人用石头封堵了洞口大半，留下半臂长的空间，方便里面透气。
他们除了一日送两餐食物来，也给山洞里的兽人提供了木柴。
此时，洞中。
三个亚兽人刚刚吃过早饭。
他们当然没有狼兽人辛辛苦苦制作的藕粉，每个兽人只有一条鱼干，一碗热水。
比起以前狼兽人吃什么他们吃什么，现在天天吃这鱼，吃得亚兽人都想吐。
可不吃只能饿死。
山洞里这会儿还弥漫着一股鱼腥味。
鹿叶抱着膝盖，蹲在火堆旁，静静地看着火焰燃烧着，将吃剩的鱼骨头烧为灰烬。
他们已经被关在山洞里几个月了，之前狼兽人不怎么管他们，晚上还可以出去，现在就算解决生理问题，都有兽人跟着。
鹿叶已经受够了这样的日子。
山洞能跟他说上话的兽人只有羊族的兽人羊止。那个红雀兽人，成日里一声不吭，早傻了。
山洞冷，三个兽人一如既往，像刚刚孵化出来的雏鸟一样紧紧挨着。
鹿鸣知道外头有狼兽人守着，他还是道：“我们什么时候能回去？”
羊止：“你还想着回去吗？”
“为什么不？”
鹿叶长得很漂亮，双眼圆润，看起来无辜又无害。
他在从前的部落很受欢迎，不然为什么会成为族长的伴侣，还有了三个幼崽。
可羊止，神态怯弱，皮肤暗黄难看。
鹿叶每每看见他，都忍不住越过他，看向他旁边的雀溪。
他是他在那个流浪部落里见过的来来去去这么多兽人当中，最好看的，也是性子最好的亚兽人。
本来他没傻的。
在山谷的时候，他都还是好的。
雀溪很照顾同行的亚兽人和幼崽，他沉静、温柔，比起自己，熊沉其实更信赖雀溪。
连分派食物的活，也是交给雀溪的。
但是熊沉他们决定偷袭狼部落的前一天，兽人们决定吃饱后大干一场。
他们没猎物，至于怎么吃饱……
鹿叶闭上眼，紧紧压住发颤的手。
是雀溪自己不识趣，扰了熊沉他们的兴致，被推着撞到了脑子。也是幸运，他没看到那惨烈的景象，等他醒过来时，只剩下森森白骨。
那时候，他们都吓傻了。
可像狼兽人说的，他们听过也见过兽人吃兽人，没那么胆小。在狼部落的日子太安稳了，又有兽人给他们治病，所以他和羊止慢慢清醒过来。
但雀溪醒不过来了。
他撞坏了脑子。
就算这次没撞坏，但鹿叶也知道，他看似沉静的表象中，早已经崩溃。
他跟得这群流浪兽人最久，见到的罪恶最多。
“我要回部落，我要回部落……”鹿叶神经质地抽动了下脖子，睁开眼，眼神清明。
“我要回部落。”他坚定道。
羊止没说话了。
他双手抱膝，低着头，像要将自己藏起来。
鹿叶还有部落回去，他却没有了。
鹿叶当初要他一起哄骗狼兽人的时候承诺过，到时候他离开，会带着自己一起走。可现在暴露了，之前的话便也不作数。
他走或是留下，都由不了鹿叶做决定。
羊止眼神迷茫。
他不知道自己还能去哪里，好像也没地方可以去。
……
食堂。
林楸和狼岩找了个暖和的地方，刚坐下，幼崽巴巴地靠拢过来。
林楸揉了揉幼崽脑袋，正要继续说话，就看狼力狼夫夫俩走了过来。
他们是狼果的邻居，部落目前唯二分到房子的伴侣。
而那三个雪季前刚刚建好的房子，目前还没分配，晾得差不多也该抽签了。
林楸看狼鱼的眼眶有些红，像有什么话说。
他拍了拍狼生后背，让他带着幼崽去其他地方玩儿去。
幼崽离开，林楸便示意他们坐过来。
“是不是遇到什么难处了？”林楸关切问。
狼鱼摇头，忽然掩面抽泣。
林楸心惊，面色都冷了下来，一副护犊子样。
“遇到什么事了？”
狼力抱着自己伴侣，同样哑了声音，低下头道：“王、楸，你们把房子收回去吧。”
狼岩：“房子分了就分了，哪有收回去的道理。”
“可是幼崽……”狼力摇头，声音像从喉咙里挤出来的，格外压抑，“我跟鱼，不敢再要幼崽了。”
林楸顿时明白过来。
应该是早上那会儿他们说话，提到幼崽的事，吓到这夫夫俩了。
他放松下来，轻声道：“不要咱们就不要。像王说的，房子分了就分了，哪有收回去的道理。”
狼力护着伴侣，抬起头，“可是我们……”
林楸：“幼崽的事我们尊重每一个兽人的意愿，不强求。这房子建起来，本意也是改善一下兽人们的居住环境，就算你们现在不要房子，以后建多了，兽人也是要一家分一个的。”
狼岩：“别想太多。”
林楸点头，“安心住着，这房子也是为了方便……”
“方便你们交配。”
林楸看到狼果出现的那一刻，心里就有不好的预感。果然，这兽人嘴里就没什么不敢说的。
林楸捂脸，默默往狼岩身后坐了坐。
他隔着狼岩肩膀，看着对面都老夫老妻了的狼力和狼鱼红了脸。他没忍住，脑袋磕在狼岩后背，无声笑了起来。
这家伙！
也算另辟蹊径，安慰了两个兽人。
狼果见他们不说话，偏还把恨不得藏起来的林楸揪出来，大大咧咧道：“楸，我说错了吗？”
“没错没错，你没错。”林楸脑袋都抬不起来。
祖宗，快别说了！
狼鱼也是这个想法。
他红着脸，匆匆说了句：“那、那王，我们没事了。”然后就拉着自己伴侣跑了。
林楸还当每个狼兽人都像狼果一样把交配挂在嘴边，看来也有害羞的。
狼果一屁股往林楸和狼岩跟前一坐。
“楸，什么时候能喝酒？”
“你就为了这事儿过来？”
“什么叫就为了这事儿？这是大事！”
林楸看他瞪大两眼控诉，想起他为了这事儿都催了他好多次了。
林楸手指轻轻刮了下狼岩腰侧。
狼岩腰腹处的肌肉猛地收紧，他手往后，握住自家伴侣的手。
“王，我把酒分了？”
狼岩喉间溢出一声“嗯”，有点哑。林楸歪头看了一眼他的脸色，好好的，没生病。
狼果一听，高兴得一蹦而起。
“我自己的罐子我准备好了！”
林楸双手撑着狼岩肩膀起身。
狼岩手把着他后腰，护着他起来。
他手指轻轻往林楸后腰上一刮，林楸猛地连带他的手一起按住，惊得看向他。
狼岩眼中含笑道：“别分太多。”
林楸磨了磨牙。
小心眼！
“王！我听见了！”狼果只听到狼岩说话，没注意到后头他俩的小动作。
狼岩淡淡道：“听见了就听见了。”
听说林楸要分酒，兽人们立即放下手中的事情，全部往山洞里涌。
片刻，大山洞被堵得水泄不通。
老祭司躺在草窝里困觉，顺带听着狼冰在一旁教狼雪和羽乐。
兽人一进来，他眼皮下的眼珠动了动，然后睁开眼，缓慢坐起来。
他看向狼冰。
狼冰道：“楸要分酒。”
他抿了抿唇，没成年的兽人不能喝，狼冰算算自己的年纪，眼底落寞一闪。
还差一年。
兽人们等了一年了，总算能喝到这东西了。
大伙儿一时间太过热情，挤得林楸快贴在墙上去了。
狼岩往兽人当中一站，冷眸一扫，兽人顷刻间乖乖后退。
林楸总算能喘口气。
他道：“罐子找莫要，自己收拾干净，里面不能沾水。”
“莫！”兽人转头，盯着莫嚷嚷。
兽人各个中气十足，声音如雷声震耳。
狼莫掏了掏耳朵，道：“在放陶罐的山洞，你们自己去拿。先说好，陶罐烧出来就没洗过。”
不过……
嘿嘿，狼莫从背后把自己的陶罐拿出来。
他的洗过，洗得干干净净，还晾干了。
“楸！先倒我的。”
“狼莫！”狼西震惊地看着他，如同遭受了背叛。
狼莫摆摆手，面上满是得意道：“快去啊，慢了没有了哦~”
林楸听他这怪声怪气的话，都忍不住踢了他一脚。
“你别乱说，肯定是够的。”
不够每个兽人就匀一匀，反正量得一样，不然他们一定得打起来。
兽人跑得飞快，山洞里只剩下空中打转的狼毛。
林楸瞧着狼西和狼果两个。
再看看他们手中一样大小的罐子。
“洗干净了？”
“嗯哼。”
“没水？”
两个兽人摇头。
“还是你俩奸诈。”
狼果哼笑，“我当你是在夸我。”
狼莫点点头，“说我聪明呢，我知道。”
“咳！”
一声苍老的咳嗽声从背后响起。
林楸一看，老祭司不知什么时候已经端坐在桌旁。
林楸：“您老年纪大了。”
老祭司：“说好的每个兽人一罐。”
“那我们？！”狼金冲进来，双眼亮晶晶。他身后还有一伙小狼，都急吼吼的，脚背上都是雪。
怕是刚刚从外面撒欢儿回来。
林楸冷漠道：“没成年，想都不要想。”
“嗷——”
林楸一戳狼岩的腰，没戳到，手指被他捏在掌心。
狼岩：“闭嘴，吵得很。”
小狼：“呜呜呜呜……就不可以分给我们，等我们成年了再喝吗？”
林楸一顿。
“可以？！”小狼欣喜。
林楸微笑：“不可以。我只是想到了一个东西。”
他或许可以试着放几坛，弄个五年陈酿，十年陈酿，没准味道会更好。
“楸！我们来了！！！”
兽人们跑得地面似乎都在震动。
林楸面前扑来一阵风，他眯了眯眼，看着勤勤恳恳擦拭陶罐的狼莫和狼果。
“擦好了？”
“马上！”
“好了！”
林楸看着急得跺脚的兽人们，唇角翘了翘，道：“那来吧，分酒。”
他承诺的，一个兽人一罐，说到做到。
