离开西边兽圈，林楸一直在想一件事。
狼岩与他并排走在雪地中，勾着林楸的手，看着脚下的路，也不说话。
“王。”
“嗯？”
“之前说的，要奖励兽人，你想好了吗？”
林楸觉得像小狼这样做事做得好的兽人，嘴上夸两句，不如给点奖励来得实际。
狼岩：“看他们自己想要什么吧，要求合理，都可以满足。”
部落现在没什么好东西，食物、布、兽皮……都要节省着用。
在狼岩看来，狼部落每个兽人做事，做得好是理所应当，做得不好，反倒需要惩罚。
他们是一体的。
心也是齐的，反倒没那么多计较。
何况，楸说的做得好？怎样算做得好？
狩猎队做得不好吗？采集队做得不好吗？狼莫他们烧砖建房，狼起他们做弓箭做农具，不也做得好？
狼岩将这话给林楸一说，林楸道：“总要有个标准。”
狼岩看他。
林楸晃了晃被他握住的手，道：“我们提前把标准制定好，管理起来就不会手忙脚乱的。以后就算我们不在，兽人们自己也不会乱。”
狼岩：“好。”
雪地上的脚印一步一步向着食堂蔓延，被扫帚一扫，露出被踩实的路。
小狼抓着扫帚在外面疯玩，林楸躲着扫帚扬起的雪沫子，和狼岩一起钻进食堂。
一脚踏进去，听得咔嚓一声脆响。
林楸寻着声音看去，狼安他们正把雪季前晒的火树子儿拿出来。
一个兽人抓一把，大伙儿一边忙着手头的事，一边闲聊，手上有空，顺带还抓了几粒火树子儿扔嘴里。
牙齿一磕，嘴巴动一动，就吐出壳来。
林楸笑起来。
原来在吃松子儿。
兽人们头一次吃，只觉油香油香的。那点肉虽然比指甲盖还小，但越吃越来劲儿，好像会上瘾似的。
见林楸回来，狼安给他们每人塞了一把。
他道：“我发现这个闲着没事的时候吃着最舒服。”
林楸：“看来安叔也成了老吃家了。”
狼安笑起来，“老吃家……我喜欢这个说法。”
他又拎着兽皮袋继续给兽人分。
部落攒的火树子儿多，白雀兽人在这边忙了十多天，每天至少四车的火树果带回来。
兽人们把火树子儿打掉，烘干之后，用罐子装起来，居然堆了满满一个山洞。
闲暇时候，狼安就把这个拿出来，给兽人们分一分。
“咔嚓——”兽人牙尖，没开口的火树子儿用力一咬，就破开了。
里边的肉落进嘴里，壳吐在筐里，没一会儿就吃完一小把。
狼晚几个围在一起，一边做渔网，一边磕火树子儿。
“我们早该把这果子打下来的。”狼藏道。
这肉看着少，但果子多啊，积攒一些，也能吃很久。
狼星冷声道：“我看你是忘了以前摘这果子掉下来摔死的兽人。”
狼藏想起那惨烈的画面，一个激灵，没有再说下去。
狼晚叹道：“以前为了一口吃的，死的兽人还少了？不提这个。”
狼赤指节粗大的手也勾着渔网，另一只手灵巧地使着梭子。
他道：“东西是好东西，能垫垫肚子，但不管用。”
“只有现在，才是最好的。”
狼晚看着挨着狼岩小声说话的林楸，脸上牵出一抹笑，“是，现在才是最好的。”
种植、养殖……他们想种多少植物就种多少，想养多少动物也能尽力实现。
以往每天傻望着林子，期盼有动物出现，望得兽人都呆了，也没见林子里多出几头猎物。
现在就很好，靠他们自己一双手，也能填饱肚子。
“楸他们要去南边，你不跟着去？”狼晚转头问狼赤。
“我去干什么？”
“你放心？”
“王在，有什么不放心的。”狼赤说着，手停了下来。他扔了一颗火树子儿进嘴里，一磕，瓮声瓮气道，“楸早成年了，不是什么都要我护着的幼崽了。”
幼崽变好了，但也长大了。
何况他都有伴侣了，自己还操什么心。
狼晚哼声。
嘴上这么说，他心里怎么想他还不知道？
无非是楸跟狼赤不亲。
比起赤，狼晚看着，岩都比他来得重要些。
火树子、核桃，兽人们当零嘴吃。雪季依旧是一天两顿，但中间这么掺着吃些，居然没怎么饿。
兽人们立马把火树子儿和核桃当个宝，已经商量着，明年再多找些。
*
几次大雪后，外面彻底封冻。
树如同冰做的，晶莹剔透。积雪到了兽人们腰间，泼水成冰，大伙儿每天起来都得先检查一遍房顶。
林楸也和狼岩搬到了下面的大山洞。
部落里的火树油用得差不多了，狼贝带着兽人们做了数百根蜡烛出来。
除开蜡烛，兽人们做的火柴也积攒了不少，都一一堆放在干燥的山洞。
雪季过半，兽人们吃好喝好，非但没瘦，各个都还长了些肉。
大伙儿每天早晚两顿主食，中间吃上些果干和坚果，看着不多，但嘴巴没停过。
林楸身上也长了点肉，因着雪季不怎么运动，肉没扎得紧，摸起来软软的。
草窝里，林楸刚躺下，被狼岩往怀里团了团。
他感觉到肚皮上痒痒，熟练地扣住狼岩的手，抓到脸颊边，脑袋压着。
也不知道他身上是多好摸，自家伴侣每天晚上都要像揉面一样抱着他搓一搓。
在这大山洞里，林楸原本还羞，现在都脱敏了。
昏昏欲睡时，林楸感觉到脖子被蹭了蹭，有些凉。
林楸只皱了皱眉，就放任自己沉入梦乡。
今年雪季好像过得格外的快，明天起来，还要把之前染色的麻布拿出来给兽人们做衣服。
那颜色专门弄得灰扑扑的，到时候出门，不那么显眼，也算有个换洗的。
再睁眼，天就亮了。
林楸梦里他们已经出发前往南部，路都走了一半了，睁眼却发现自己还在草窝里。
他揉了揉脑袋，坐了起来。
颈侧有什么东西晃动，林楸随手一抓，那小东西落在手掌。
兽脂一般，乳白色的。
白中泛绿，像雪地里冒出的一簇小草，生机勃勃。
是一块玉。
林楸摸着玉石表面，应当是打磨过很多次，比起林楸见过的兽人们身上戴着的玉饰，要光洁一些，但依旧透着一股朴素的味道。
林楸稍稍一想，便知道是狼岩给他戴上的。
他天天跟在自己后头，也不知道是什么时候弄出来的。
时候不算早，山洞里的兽人不是在睡觉，就是在做事打发时间。有编藤筐的，有织渔网的，还有织布的，做衣服的……
林楸看到狼潭手上灰扑扑的布，目光一顿。
他赶紧穿上兽皮衣，眼前一暗，一抬头，狼岩就站在草窝边。
林楸站起来，示意他看自己颈上的东西。
狼岩：“好看。”
林楸拨弄了下那打磨得只有硬币大小的小东西，圆润饱满，中间打孔，像平安扣。
不过是粗糙且原始版的平安扣。
“谢谢王。”
狼岩手一捞，抬臂就把他从草窝里捞出来。
林楸赶紧把脚塞进兽皮靴里，脸有些红。
“那麻布……”林楸轻轻拽了拽狼岩衣摆。
狼岩握住他的手，在他耳边低声道：“你昨晚说的，做衣服。”
“我说了吗？”
林楸昨晚睡得迷迷糊糊的，完全没印象了。
狼岩：“说了。”
林楸看着那几卷布，都是放在林子里不起眼的颜色。被狼果形容丑，但林楸觉得挺实用。
“这个透气，我想着到时候去南边，兽人们也带上些。但是晚叔说不好拿出来，怕招其他兽人惦记。”
林楸仰头看着狼岩，想找他拿主意。
眼巴巴的。
又刚刚睡醒，脸侧还贴着发丝。
狼岩顺了顺他的头发，指腹压过他下巴上的软肉，捏了捏，道：“可以带，赶路的时候穿，有部落的地方就换。”
那东西颜色太灰，像块穿了多年、薄得快破洞的兽皮，没有狼果他们染的那些红的紫的布条打眼。
“先去吃饭，衣服有潭叔他们在做。”狼岩托着林楸后背，将他往洞口带。
林楸问他：“今早吃的什么？”
“尾巴草籽粥，安放了肉丁和蘑菇丁，味道很不错。”
他俩说着，离开山洞。
狼潭回头看了一眼，手上的骨针在身边放着的石头上擦一擦，嘴角翘着，继续低头缝衣服。
天冷，兽人们都起得晚。
林楸进食堂吃早饭的时候，桌边也坐着不少兽人。
林楸看着狼岩也端着一碗，问他：“你也没吃？”
“嗯。”
林楸：“不用等我的。”
狼岩：“想等。”
林楸看着他，一时间不知道说什么好。
狼岩捏捏他脸，“快吃，冷了。”
尾巴草籽脱了壳，混着肉粒煮成粥，颜色金黄，味道鲜香。粥上凝固着一层米油，抿一下就沾在唇上。
再喝一大口，入口就是混着肉丁蘑菇丁的粥。
味道恰恰好，蘑菇鲜，肉也香。
“安今天是遇到什么好事了？”
“王说你们要去南边了。我想着趁着还剩的这点时间，赶紧给你们补一补，能有什么好事？”狼安就在屋里，听了林楸这话，有些忧愁道。
自从到了狼山之后，他们多少年没出远门了。
现在距离林楸离开狼山的日子越近，不仅狼安担心，连带着起先心态还算放松的狼晚狼星他们也都担心起来。
路途遥远，虽然兽人也会带干粮，但那干粮也吃不到两个月去。
兽人们还得自个儿半路上找补给。
狼安是走过远路的，知道半路上找食多困难。
他都怕兽人们饿得回不来。
林楸看他愁得脸都皱巴巴的，笑道：“别担心，不会有事的。”
狼安哪里听得进去。
他摆摆手道：“快点吃，多吃点，现在抓紧长胖一点，挨饿也能挨得久一些。”
林楸弯眼，“谢谢安叔。”
无论兽人们再怎么愁，离开的日子一天天逼近。
转眼，积雪融化，薄薄的雪壳子下能看见刚刚冒出的新绿。
狼岩赶着兽人们最后一点空闲时间，将大家聚集起来，再次开了个大会。
这次是全体兽人都参加。
正是上午，食堂里坐满了兽人。
大伙儿盘腿坐在草席上，幼崽也被成年兽人带过来，乖乖在他们前面坐了一排。
对面，狼岩、林楸与他们相对而坐。
一个雪季过去，兽人们的精神都很好。面红色润，精神抖擞，看着能一口气抓十头猎物回来。
狼岩见状，心里稳了稳。
他道：“雪季后一个月，我要和狼火小队离开。我们走了，部落这边的事情不能荒废。”
兽人们点点脑袋。
幼崽看看两边，也点点脑袋。
狼岩看了眼林楸，林楸冲他一笑，便道：“头一件事，是大泽那边的事。淤泥还要继续挖，但今年也要修整一下浅滩，从大泽另外的地方挖些藕苗出来种下。”
涉及到种植的事，兔葵抬起头来，听得认真。
“去年那边挖出来的田，也可以试着种些菜，看看能不能种得出来。具体种什么，葵决定。”
兔葵点头，“楸，我知道了。”
林楸继续道：“除此之外，我们还需要把从大泽到狼山之间的路再拓宽一点，修得更平整些。我们需要在那边建房子。”
狼莫一听到房子，忙道：“楸，那边不是有棚子？”
林楸：“棚子使用寿命有限，长远来看，还是建房子方便些。”
现在大泽那边的事情不比狼山少，兽人们长期住在那边，以后又要在大泽耕种、养鱼，有个遮风挡雨的房子更好。
狼莫：“那要建多少房子？”
林楸：“你们能建多少？”
砖瓦有限，狼莫就想快一点也快不起来。
狼莫嘿嘿一笑，“好吧，我们尽量。”
林楸摇摇头，“要有安排，狼山这边的房子得保证按照计划建设，那边也最好在雨季之前，建造足够至少两个小队居住的房子。”
房子不求多，可以建得大些，让兽人们先住大通铺。
狼莫：“那得运好多砖过去。”
“不如直接过去找地方建窑。”狼阔这时候出声道。
林楸：“这个可以考虑。”
“还有，两边都建个大澡堂出来，不然雪季都没洗澡的地方。澡堂外建大灶，连通室内，做火墙，弄个雪季洗澡也不冷的地方。”
狼莫一听，头都大了。
火墙他知道，之前建火炕的时候楸提过一嘴，狼起肯定是知道怎么做的。
问题是，两边跑好累啊。
林楸看他这苦哈哈的样子，叹道：“你现在算建筑队的负责兽人，要学会安排事情，别总自己东一榔头西一锄头。这样，在我们走之前，你把事情捋顺，兽人如何分配也想好，到时候我们再细说。”
“嗷……”狼莫往后一倒，只觉棘手。
狼岩道：“做不了，有兽人能做。”
“能！能做！”狼莫忙坐起来，双手放在膝盖上，态度端正。
“阔，这事你俩共同负责。”
狼阔颔首。
狼莫幽怨地看了一眼狼岩。
狼岩道：“你脑子不行。”
“嗷。”狼莫哼唧。他不敢嚎了，怕嚎到最后王直接把他踢出建筑队。
“那这个修路？”狼乔提到。
“归于建筑队去做，莫……”
狼莫赶紧道：“知道了知道了，我好好想想安排。”
除了这两件事，还有最重要的种植事宜。
雪季后还有一个月的时间林楸他们才走，可以守着兽人们把今年的土地翻耕出来，哪一块地种什么也可以确定好。
具体种植的时候，就需要兔葵还有狼安多看着点儿了。
商量到最后，兽人们对明年的事情有了大概了解，做的时候也会心里有数。
事情说完，大伙儿讨论着离开。
幼崽蹦蹦跳跳也走了。
面前一空，狼岩和林楸正打算走，却看到豹休走上前来。
“狼王、楸。”
林楸几乎没见过这小黑豹单独过来找他们，这样肯定有事。
“我打算雪季过后，就去找我们祭司。”
林楸跟狼岩同时皱眉。
林楸：“你一个兽人？”
豹休点头，“我自己去。之前说好的，成年后我就走。过了雪季，我就成年了。”
“你……”林楸看着他已经下定决心，有些心惊。
“外面那么危险，你单独行动，要是遇到事怎么办？而且你们祭司是在中央大陆不见的，这么远，你怎么过去？”
林楸以为小兽人可能不好意思住狼山了。
但他在狼山也做事，兽人们管他吃喝，跟交换劳动没什么两样。
他希望他还是再考虑考虑，至少不要冒险。
豹休却道：“这些我都知道。”
“你知道你还……”
“我要去，荣祭司还在等我。”
林楸不知道怎么劝，他抓住狼岩的手。
狼岩反握住，指腹压了压他手背，目光却是看着眼前的小兽人。
“你想好了？”
豹休点头。
狼岩：“你一个兽人出去，随时会没命。”
豹休：“我想好了的，狼王，也做好了这个准备。但没找到祭司前，我不会让自己死的。”
“好。”
“王！”林楸攥紧狼岩的手。
他俩知不知道，这意味着什么？
豹休极大可能就是去送死的！
豹休看着林楸，诚恳道：“谢谢楸当初救了我，也谢谢狼部落收留了我。但是我不能总待在这里过安稳日子，我想去找我们祭司。”
“我一定会找到他，把他救出来的。”
林楸别开眼。
他不能理解。
狼岩：“我们知道了。”
豹休笑了笑，他刚来的时候皮贴着骨头，眼睛耳朵都圆滚滚的，看着有些憨。
但他不傻，也不莽撞。
此刻他的眼中也是深深的执着。
这是他求生的信念，是他活下来的目的。
小兽人走了，林楸手掌按压心口，只觉得闷得慌。
“他还没成年。”
过了雪季，那也才刚成年。
林楸从安稳的世界来，见识到了兽世的残酷，对外面保持着十二分的警惕。
他救起来的小兽人，说实话，他宁愿他一直待在狼部落。也好过看着他去送死。
狼岩看着小兽人坚毅的背影，握着林楸的手，缓缓道：“每个兽人的追求不一样，他当初能活下来，不就是靠着这点念想。”
“可是……”
“他有自己的选择。”
换做是他，他也一样。
“换做是你，怎么做？”
林楸几乎瞬间有了答案。
他无力地将脑袋往狼岩肩膀上一靠，深深吐出一口气。
草丛上，最后一片薄薄的雪化开。
那天早上，很早，远方才露出一点鱼肚白。豹休身上挂着兽皮兜，过来跟狼岩和林楸道别。
他是悄悄走的，除了林楸和狼岩知道，连小狼都没有告诉。
天光大亮时，小狼急匆匆的呼喊声传来。
狼金跑着跑着，撞到林楸和狼岩面前。
“王！楸！休不见了！”
林楸看着眼前急得脸红的小狼，道：“他走了。”
“走了？走哪儿去？”
“去找他们部落的祭司了。”
“那他为什么不跟我说一声！”小狼破了音，下意识转头跑去找。
没跑几步，狼岩道：“回来！”
“王！他一个兽人，怎么能去……”
“回来。”狼岩重复。
小狼停下步子，低着头，静静站立在原地。
林楸上前，便看见小狼的眼眶红了。
“他都不跟我说……我们还是不是玩儿得最好的伙伴了！”
林楸拍了拍他肩膀，轻声道：“他有自己的选择。有缘的话，兴许你们还会再见面的。”
无缘的话……
没有消息，就是最好的消息。
多的话林楸没说，他和狼岩只看着小狼抹了把眼睛，落寞地掉头离开。
林楸心里也堵得慌。
他抓了抓狼岩的手，用了力，捏得狼岩的手发红。
“就不能让他以后跟我们一起去中央大陆？”
反正他要去捡石头的。
狼岩看他说胡话，手掌贴着林楸，把他拥在怀里。
“他在狼部落过了这么久，看到学到的东西，足够他不饿肚子。”
林楸往他肩膀上咬了一口，赶紧站好，拉开一点距离。
“但愿吧。”
豹休走了，除了小狼，其他兽人们起先还没注意。
只负责打饭的狼安隐约感觉不对劲，想了想，才知道哪里不对了。
他问了一句：“那小黑豹呢？今天怎么不来吃？”
“他走了。”狼金垂头，替他道。
“去哪儿了？”
“去他该去的地方。”
林楸看着小狼平静说出这话，略显诧异，他还以为小狼要气很久呢。
这是想通了？
狼金察觉到林楸的眼神，咬牙道：“他没错，换我，我也必须这么做。”
“可是他连说都不跟我说一声，还把不把我当伙伴！”
听这话，还是有点怨的。
林楸笑起来，被小狼的态度冲散了些忧愁。
小狼都明白的道理，他怎么不明白。
“他或许……舍不得吧。”
日子安稳的狼山，有吃有喝，还有一同打猎的伙伴。这不就是现在兽神大陆上的兽人们所追求的吗？
那个看着憨厚老实，傻里傻气的小豹子能说走就走，林楸还有点佩服他的。
愿他一路顺利，得偿所愿吧。
chapters.title: 第179章
chapters.translated_text:
Leaving the western animal pen, Lin Qiu had been thinking about one thing.

Lang Yan walked side-by-side with him in the snow, holding Lin Qiu’s hand, watching the path beneath their feet without saying a word.

"Wang."

"Hmm?"

"About what we said before, rewarding the beastmen—have you thought it over?"

Lin Qiu felt that for beastmen who worked hard like Xiao Lang, verbal praise wasn't as practical as giving some rewards.

Lang Yan: "Let's see what they want themselves. As long as the request is reasonable, it can be satisfied."

The tribe didn't have many good things right now; food, cloth, and animal skins all had to be used sparingly.

In Lang Yan's view, it was only natural for every beastman in the Wolf Tribe to do their work well; if they didn't, they would need to be punished instead.

They were one entity.

Their hearts were united, so there wasn't much to haggle over.

Besides, what did Qiu mean by "doing well"? How was "doing well" defined?

Didn't the hunting team do well? Didn't the gathering team do well? Didn't Lang Mo and the others do well building brick houses, or Lang Qi and the others making bows and farm tools?

When Lang Yan said this to Lin Qiu, Lin Qiu replied, "There must be a standard."

Lang Yan looked at him.

Lin Qiu shook the hand he was holding and said, "If we set the standards in advance, we won't be in a panic when managing things. Even if we aren't around in the future, the beastmen won't be in chaos."

Lang Yan: "Okay."

The footprints on the snow stretched toward the cafeteria step by step, revealing the packed path where the broom had swept.

Xiao Lang was playing wildly outside with a broom, and Lin Qiu dodged the snow spray kicked up by the broom as he and Lang Yan ducked into the cafeteria.

As soon as he stepped inside, he heard a crisp "crack."

Lin Qiu followed the sound and saw Lang An and the others taking out the fire-tree seeds they had dried before the snow season.

A beastman grabbed a handful; everyone was chatting while busy with their tasks, and when their hands were free, they would toss a few fire-tree seeds into their mouths.

With a bite of their teeth and a movement of their mouths, they would spit out the shells.

Lin Qiu laughed.

So they were eating pine nuts.

It was the first time the beastmen had eaten them, and they found them oily and fragrant. Although the meat was smaller than a fingernail, the more they ate, the more they wanted to, as if it were addictive.

Seeing Lin Qiu return, Lang An stuffed a handful into each of their hands.

He said, "I found that this is the most comfortable thing to eat when you have nothing to do."

Lin Qiu: "It seems Uncle An has become an old connoisseur."

Lang An laughed, "An old connoisseur... I like that saying."

He then picked up the animal skin bag to continue distributing them to the beastmen.

The tribe had saved up many fire-tree seeds; the White Sparrow beastmen had been busy there for over ten days, bringing back at least four cartloads of fire-tree fruit every day.

The beastmen knocked the seeds off, dried them, and stored them in jars, filling an entire cave.

In their spare time, Lang An would take them out and distribute them to the beastmen.

"Crack—" With sharp teeth, the beastmen would bite down hard on the unopened seeds, breaking them.

The meat inside would fall into their mouths, the shells were spat into a basket, and a small handful would be gone in no time.

Lang Wan and a few others sat together, cracking fire-tree seeds while making fishing nets.

"We should have knocked these fruits down sooner," said Lang Cang.

The meat looked small, but there were so many fruits; if they saved up some, they could eat for a long time.

Lang Xing said coldly, "I think you've forgotten the beastmen who fell to their deaths picking these fruits before."

Lang Cang remembered that tragic scene and shuddered, not saying anything more.

Lang Wan sighed, "How many beastmen died for a bite of food in the past? Let's not mention that."

Lang Chi, with his thick-knuckled hands, was also working on a fishing net, his other hand skillfully using the shuttle.

He said, "The stuff is good, it can fill your stomach, but it's not very useful."

"Only now is the best time."

Lang Wan looked at Lin Qiu, who was whispering to Lang Yan, and a smile appeared on his face, "Yes, now is the best time."

Planting, animal husbandry... they could plant as many plants as they wanted and try their best to raise as many animals as they wished.

In the past, they would stare blankly at the forest every day, hoping for animals to appear, until the beastmen became dull, yet they never saw many more prey in the forest.

Now it's great; relying on their own hands, they can fill their stomachs.

"Qiu and the others are going to the south, aren't you going with them?" Lang Wan turned to ask Lang Chi.

"Why would I go?"

"Are you not worried?"

"With the King there, what is there to worry about?" Lang Chi said, his hand stopping. He tossed a fire-tree seed into his mouth, bit it, and said in a muffled voice, "Qiu has long been an adult; he's not a cub that needs my protection for everything."

The cub had grown up and become better.

Besides, he had a partner now, so why should he worry?

Lang Wan snorted.

He said that, but did he think he didn't know what he was thinking?

It was nothing more than Qiu not being close to Lang Chi.

Compared to Chi, Lang Wan could see that even Yan was more important to him.

Fire-tree seeds and walnuts were eaten by the beastmen as snacks. They still ate two meals a day during the snow season, but with these mixed in, they actually didn't feel very hungry.

The beastmen immediately treated the fire-tree seeds and walnuts as treasures and were already discussing finding more next year.

*

After several heavy snowfalls, the outside was completely frozen.

The trees looked like they were made of ice, crystal clear. The snow reached the beastmen's waists, and water splashed turned to ice; everyone had to check the roof first thing every morning.

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan had also moved to the large cave below.

The tribe's fire-tree oil was almost used up, so Lang Bei led the beastmen to make hundreds of candles.

Besides candles, the matches the beastmen made had also accumulated quite a bit, all piled up in a dry cave.

Halfway through the snow season, the beastmen ate and drank well; not only did they not lose weight, but everyone even gained some flesh.

Everyone ate two main meals a day, with dried fruits and nuts in between; it didn't look like much, but their mouths never stopped.

Lin Qiu also gained a little weight, and because he didn't exercise much during the snow season, the flesh wasn't firm and felt soft to the touch.

In the grass nest, Lin Qiu had just lain down when he was bundled into Lang Yan's arms.

He felt an itch on his belly and skillfully caught Lang Yan's hand, pulling it to his cheek and pressing his head against it.

He didn't know why his body was so pleasant to touch, but his partner would hold him and knead him like dough every night.

In this large cave, Lin Qiu had originally been shy, but now he was desensitized.

As he was drifting off to sleep, Lin Qiu felt his neck being rubbed, and it felt a bit cold.

Lin Qiu just frowned and let himself sink into a dream.

This year's snow season seemed to pass exceptionally quickly; tomorrow, he would have to take out the dyed linen cloth to make clothes for the beastmen.

The colors were specially made to be gray and dusty, so they wouldn't be so conspicuous when going out, and it would count as a change of clothes.

When he opened his eyes again, it was dawn.

In his dream, they had already set off for the south and were halfway there, but when he opened his eyes, he found he was still in the grass nest.

He rubbed his head and sat up.

Something was swaying by his neck; Lin Qiu grabbed it, and the small object landed in his palm.

It was like animal fat, milky white.

White with a hint of green, like a cluster of grass sprouting in the snow, full of vitality.

It was a piece of jade.

Lin Qiu touched the surface of the jade; it must have been polished many times. Compared to the jade ornaments he had seen on other beastmen, it was smoother, but it still retained a simple, rustic feel.

After a moment of thought, Lin Qiu knew it was Lang Yan who had put it on him.

He followed him around every day, and he didn't know when he had made it.

It wasn't very early; the beastmen in the cave were either sleeping or doing things to pass the time. Some were weaving rattan baskets, some were weaving fishing nets, and others were weaving cloth or making clothes...

Lin Qiu saw the gray cloth in Lang Tan's hands, and his gaze paused.

He quickly put on his animal skin clothes, and as the light dimmed, he looked up to see Lang Yan standing by the grass nest.

Lin Qiu stood up and gestured for him to look at the object on his neck.

Lang Yan: "It looks good."

Lin Qiu fiddled with the small object, which had been polished to the size of a coin; it was round and full, with a hole in the middle, like a "peace buckle."

Though it was a rough and primitive version of a peace buckle.

"Thank you, Wang."

Lang Yan reached out, lifted his arm, and scooped him out of the grass nest.

Lin Qiu quickly shoved his feet into his animal skin boots, his face a little red.

"That linen cloth..." Lin Qiu gently tugged at Lang Yan's hem.

Lang Yan held his hand and whispered in his ear, "You said last night, to make clothes."

"Did I say that?"

Lin Qiu had been groggy last night and had no memory of it at all.

Lang Yan: "You did."

Lin Qiu looked at the rolls of cloth, all in colors that were inconspicuous in the forest. Lang Guo described them as ugly, but Lin Qiu thought they were quite practical.

"This is breathable, and I was thinking that when we go to the south, the beastmen can take some. But Uncle Wan said it's not good to take it out, for fear of attracting the attention of other beastmen."

Lin Qiu looked up at Lang Yan, wanting his advice.

He looked at him expectantly.

He had just woken up, and strands of hair were still stuck to his cheek.

Lang Yan smoothed his hair, pressed his fingertips against the soft flesh of his chin, pinched it, and said, "You can take it, wear it while traveling, and change when you reach a place with a tribe."

The color was too gray, like an animal skin that had been worn for years and was thin enough to have holes, not as eye-catching as the red and purple cloth strips that Lang Guo and the others had dyed.

"Go eat first; Uncle Tan and the others are making the clothes." Lang Yan supported Lin Qiu's back and led him toward the cave entrance.

Lin Qiu asked him, "What are we eating this morning?"

"Tail-grass seed porridge, An added diced meat and mushrooms, it tastes very good."

As they talked, they left the cave.

Lang Tan looked back, wiped the bone needle in his hand on a stone beside him, smiled, and continued to lower his head to sew the clothes.

It was cold, so the beastmen all got up late.

When Lin Qiu entered the cafeteria for breakfast, there were quite a few beastmen sitting at the tables.

Lin Qiu saw Lang Yan also holding a bowl and asked him, "You haven't eaten either?"

"Hmm."

Lin Qiu: "You don't have to wait for me."

Lang Yan: "I wanted to wait."

Lin Qiu looked at him, not knowing what to say for a moment.

Lang Yan pinched his face, "Eat quickly, it'll get cold."

The tail-grass seeds were husked and boiled with diced meat into a porridge, golden in color and fresh in taste. A layer of rice oil had solidified on top of the porridge, sticking to his lips with a sip.

He took another big gulp, and the porridge mixed with diced meat and mushrooms entered his mouth.

The taste was just right; the mushrooms were fresh, and the meat was fragrant.

"Did An encounter any good news today?"

"The King said you are going to the south. I was thinking of taking advantage of the little time left to nourish you, what good news could there be?" Lang An was in the room, and hearing Lin Qiu's words, he said with some worry.

Since arriving at Wolf Mountain, how many years had it been since they went on a long journey?

Now that the day of Lin Qiu's departure from Wolf Mountain was getting closer, not only was Lang An worried, but even Lang Wan and Lang Xing, who had been relatively relaxed at first, were starting to worry.

The journey was long; although the beastmen would bring dry rations, those wouldn't last two months.

The beastmen would have to find supplies on the road themselves.

Lang An had traveled long distances and knew how difficult it was to find food on the road.

He was afraid the beastmen would be too hungry to return.

Seeing him so worried that his face was wrinkled, Lin Qiu smiled and said, "Don't worry, nothing will happen."

Lang An couldn't listen to that.

He waved his hand and said, "Eat quickly, eat more, get a little fatter now so you can endure hunger longer."

Lin Qiu's eyes curved, "Thank you, Uncle An."

No matter how worried the beastmen were, the day of departure drew closer day by day.

In the blink of an eye, the snow melted, and the new green could be seen under the thin crust of snow.

Lang Yan took advantage of the beastmen's last bit of free time to gather everyone for another big meeting.

This time, all the beastmen participated.

It was morning, and the cafeteria was full of beastmen.

Everyone sat cross-legged on straw mats, and the cubs were brought over by the adult beastmen, sitting in a row in front of them obediently.

Opposite them, Lang Yan and Lin Qiu sat facing them.

After a snow season, the beastmen were in high spirits. Their faces were ruddy, and they looked like they could catch ten prey in one go.

Seeing this, Lang Yan felt more at ease.

He said, "A month after the snow season, I will leave with the Lang Huo team. When we are gone, the affairs of the tribe cannot be neglected."

The beastmen nodded.

The cubs looked at both sides and also nodded.

Lang Yan looked at Lin Qiu, who smiled at him and said, "The first thing is the matter of the Great Marsh. The silt still needs to be dug, but this year we also need to tidy up the shallows and dig some lotus root seedlings from other parts of the Great Marsh to plant."

Regarding planting, Tu Kui looked up and listened carefully.

"The fields dug out there last year can also be used to try planting some vegetables to see if they will grow. Kui will decide exactly what to plant."

Tu Kui nodded, "Qiu, I understand."

Lin Qiu continued, "In addition, we need to widen the road between the Great Marsh and Wolf Mountain and make it smoother. We need to build houses there."

As soon as Lang Mo heard about houses, he hurriedly said, "Qiu, aren't there sheds there?"

Lin Qiu: "The sheds have a limited lifespan; in the long run, it's more convenient to build houses."

Now that there were as many things to do in the Great Marsh as on Wolf Mountain, it would be better for the beastmen to have a house to shelter from the wind and rain, as they would be living there long-term to farm and fish.

Lang Mo: "Then how many houses should we build?"

Lin Qiu: "How many can you build?"

Bricks and tiles were limited, so Lang Mo couldn't speed up even if he wanted to.

Lang Mo chuckled, "Alright, we'll try our best."

Lin Qiu shook his head, "There must be a plan. The houses on Wolf Mountain must be built according to the plan, and it's best to build enough houses for at least two teams to live in there before the rainy season."

They didn't need many houses; they could be built larger so the beastmen could live in a dormitory-style setup first.

Lang Mo: "That will require transporting a lot of bricks."

"Why not just go over there and find a place to build a kiln?" Lang Kuo spoke up at this moment.

Lin Qiu: "That can be considered."

"Also, build a large bathhouse on both sides, otherwise there's nowhere to bathe during the snow season. Build a large stove outside the bathhouse, connect it to the interior, make a fire wall, and create a place where it's not cold to bathe during the snow season."

Lang Mo's head spun when he heard this.

He knew about fire walls; Qiu had mentioned it when they built the heated beds, and Lang Qi definitely knew how to do it.

The problem was that running back and forth between the two sides was so tiring.

Lin Qiu looked at his miserable expression and sighed, "You are now the beastman in charge of the construction team; you must learn to arrange things and not just do things haphazardly. How about this: before we leave, you straighten things out and think about how to distribute the beastmen, and we'll discuss it in detail then."

"Awoo..." Lang Mo fell backward, feeling it was a thorny issue.

Lang Yan said, "If you can't do it, there are other beastmen who can."

"I can! I can do it!" Lang Mo hurriedly sat up, put his hands on his knees, and adopted a proper attitude.

"Kuo, you two will be jointly responsible for this."

Lang Kuo nodded.

Lang Mo gave Lang Yan a resentful look.

Lang Yan said, "Your brain isn't working."

"Awoo." Lang Mo whined. He didn't dare to howl anymore, fearing that if he did, the King would kick him out of the construction team.

"Then what about repairing the road?" Lang Qiao mentioned.

"It belongs to the construction team, Mo..."

Lang Mo hurriedly said, "I know, I know, I'll think about the arrangements properly."

Besides these two things, there was the most important matter of planting.

Lin Qiu and the others wouldn't leave for another month after the snow season, so they could watch the beastmen plow the land for this year and determine what to plant in each plot.

For the actual planting, Tu Kui and Lang An would need to keep a closer eye on things.

By the end of the discussion, the beastmen had a general understanding of next year's affairs and would know what to do.

After the matters were settled, everyone discussed and left.

The cubs also hopped away.

With the space in front of them empty, Lang Yan and Lin Qiu were about to leave when they saw Bao Xiu walk up.

"Wolf King, Qiu."

Lin Qiu had almost never seen this little black panther come to find them alone; there must be something going on.

"I plan to go find our priest after the snow season."

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan frowned at the same time.

Lin Qiu: "You, a single beastman?"

Bao Xiu nodded, "I'll go by myself. We agreed before that I would leave after I became an adult. After the snow season, I will be an adult."

"You..." Lin Qiu looked at him, seeing he had made up his mind, and felt a bit startled.

"The outside is so dangerous; what will you do if you encounter trouble alone? And your priest disappeared in the Central Continent; it's so far away, how will you get there?"

Lin Qiu thought the little beastman might be embarrassed to stay on Wolf Mountain.

But he also worked on Wolf Mountain, and the beastmen provided him with food and drink, which was no different from exchanging labor.

He hoped he would reconsider, at least not take the risk.

Bao Xiu said, "I know all that."

"You know, and yet you still..."

"I have to go; Priest Rong is still waiting for me."

Lin Qiu didn't know how to persuade him; he grabbed Lang Yan's hand.

Lang Yan held it back, pressing his fingertips against the back of his hand, but his gaze was fixed on the little beastman in front of him.

"Have you thought it through?"

Bao Xiu nodded.

Lang Yan: "If you go out as a single beastman, you could lose your life at any time."

Bao Xiu: "I've thought it through, Wolf King, and I'm prepared for that. But before I find the priest, I won't let myself die."

"Okay."

"Wang!" Lin Qiu gripped Lang Yan's hand tightly.

Did they know what this meant?

It was highly likely that Bao Xiu was going to his death!

Bao Xiu looked at Lin Qiu and said sincerely, "Thank you, Qiu, for saving me back then, and thank you, Wolf Tribe, for taking me in. But I can't just stay here and live a stable life forever; I want to find our priest."

"I will definitely find him and save him."

Lin Qiu looked away.

He couldn't understand it.

Lang Yan: "We understand."

Bao Xiu smiled. When he first arrived, his skin was stuck to his bones, and his eyes and ears were round, making him look a bit silly.

But he wasn't stupid, nor was he reckless.

At this moment, there was a deep persistence in his eyes.

This was his belief in survival, his purpose for living.

The little beastman left, and Lin Qiu pressed his palm to his heart, feeling stifled.

"He hasn't even reached adulthood yet."

After the snow season, he would only just be an adult.

Lin Qiu came from a stable world and had seen the cruelty of the beast world, maintaining twelve-fold vigilance toward the outside.

To be honest, he would rather the little beastman he saved stay on Wolf Tribe forever than watch him go to his death.

Lang Yan watched the little beastman's determined back, holding Lin Qiu's hand, and said slowly, "Every beastman has different pursuits; didn't he survive back then by relying on this thought?"

"But..."

"He has his own choices."

If it were him, he would do the same.

"If it were you, what would you do?"

Lin Qiu had the answer almost instantly.

He leaned his head helplessly on Lang Yan's shoulder and let out a deep breath.

On the grass, the last thin layer of snow melted away.

That morning, very early, the sky was just beginning to turn white. Bao Xiu had an animal skin bag slung over his shoulder and came to say goodbye to Lang Yan and Lin Qiu.

He left quietly; except for Lin Qiu and Lang Yan, he hadn't even told Xiao Lang.

When the sky was fully bright, Xiao Lang's hurried shouts came.

Lang Jin ran and bumped into Lin Qiu and Lang Yan.

"Wang! Qiu! Xiu is gone!"

Lin Qiu looked at the little wolf, whose face was red with anxiety, and said, "He left."

"Left? Where did he go?"

"To find the priest of their tribe."

"Then why didn't he tell me!" Xiao Lang's voice cracked, and he instinctively turned to run and look for him.

Before he could run a few steps, Lang Yan said, "Come back!"

"Wang! He's a single beastman, how can he go..."

"Come back," Lang Yan repeated.

Xiao Lang stopped, hung his head, and stood quietly in place.

Lin Qiu stepped forward and saw that Xiao Lang's eyes were red.

"He didn't even tell me... are we not the best friends anymore!"

Lin Qiu patted his shoulder and said softly, "He has his own choices. If fate allows, perhaps you will meet again."

If there was no fate...

No news was the best news.

Lin Qiu didn't say anything more; he and Lang Yan just watched Xiao Lang wipe his eyes and turn away in loneliness.

Lin Qiu felt stifled in his heart too.

He grabbed Lang Yan's hand and used force, squeezing it until it turned red.

"Can't we let him go with us to the Central Continent later?"

He was going to pick up stones anyway.

Lang Yan saw he was talking nonsense and pressed his palm against Lin Qiu, pulling him into his arms.

"He has lived on Wolf Tribe for so long; what he has seen and learned is enough to keep him from going hungry."

Lin Qiu took a bite of his shoulder, then quickly stood up straight and pulled away a little.

"I hope so."

Bao Xiu was gone; except for Xiao Lang, the other beastmen didn't notice at first.

Lang An, who was only responsible for serving food, vaguely felt something was wrong, and after thinking about it, he realized what it was.

He asked, "Where is that little black panther? Why isn't he here to eat today?"

"He left," Lang Jin said, hanging his head for him.

"Where did he go?"

"To where he should go."

Lin Qiu looked at Xiao Lang saying this calmly and was slightly surprised; he thought Xiao Lang would be angry for a long time.

Had he figured it out?

Lang Jin noticed Lin Qiu's gaze and gritted his teeth, "He wasn't wrong; if it were me, I would have to do the same."

"But he didn't even tell me, does he not consider me a partner anymore!"

Hearing this, there was still some resentment.

Lin Qiu laughed, and the sorrow was dispelled a little by Xiao Lang's attitude.

How could he not understand the truth that even Xiao Lang understood?

"He perhaps... couldn't bear to."

Wolf Mountain, with its stable life, food, drink, and partners to hunt with—wasn't this what the beastmen on the Beast God Continent were pursuing now?

Lin Qiu admired the little panther, who looked honest and silly, for being able to leave just like that.

May his journey be smooth, and may he get what he wishes for.

出了山洞，两人往山下走。
狼岩脚步极轻，下了山，他跟着林楸一起到了他的火堆旁。
他把山药放下，看着林楸。
“那件事对祭司的打击太大，我阿父在的时候，常常说就是因为他刚继任祭司的时候发生的这一件事，所以性子也有些变了。”
林楸：“我明白，也理解。”
他不跟祭司争执，因为怎么说都是空话。
“我有一个办法。”林楸抬头，看着跟前威严却又包容的狼王。
狼岩扫了眼草地，坐下来。
“说说。”
林楸：“把当年那一次吃过的所有痒痒根找出来，再烤一次，抓些猎物来让它们一一试。这是最快也最能辨别到底哪种痒痒根有毒的方法。”
“如果不确定，就多试几次。”
狼岩看着林楸。
他眼中映着着火苗，坚定自信。
狼岩扫过那地上有他高的痒痒根，只一株就这么多。
如果能吃，那就跟部落种的尾巴草一样，算是有了一个稳定的食物来源。
这很值得。
狼岩抬眼，林楸依然安静地看着他。
他点头，“好，我让兽人们找来试试。”
不过这事儿一定要说通祭司。
当年找的那些痒痒根，事后祭司定好好研究过。这就不用告诉林楸了，狼岩自己去说。
一切都是为了部落。
该说的话说完，狼岩望着远处火焰高涨的篝火堆，再看林楸独立在一旁的小火堆。
亚兽人脊背绷着的，影子落在地上，孤零零的。
他道：“以后去篝火边吧，那边热闹。”
林楸手里一紧，刚捏着的青皮果子滚到地上。
“我挺习惯这样。”他道。
狼岩捡起果子给他放篮子里，提醒：“这个酸。”
林楸：“我做菜吃。这个总能吃？”
狼岩：“嗯。”
没多说什么，狼岩离开了这边。
林楸看着一旁努力了大半天才挖出来的山药，轻轻一叹，到底没有进嘴。
既然狼岩答应了试验一遍，那这山药就留着到时候用。
吃过晚饭，兽人们头一晚没有直接进去山洞。
看狼安他们编的鱼笼，又听说楸用这个抓了很多鱼，难得起了兴趣，要跟着去放笼子。
林楸没跟去，只默默做了自己晚饭。
吃过，随后去溪边洗漱。
身边脚步声越来越近，林楸用清水捧着洗了脸，侧头看去。
狼冰止步，好奇地看着他。
林楸：“有事？”
狼冰摇头，“你吃了痒痒根了？”
林楸：“没有。”
“哦。”狼冰捏了下手指，直接离开了。
没吃就好。
*
部落里的兽皮绳没有那么多，今日狼安领着兽人们编出来的鱼笼已经用尽了部落的兽皮绳。
余下的兽皮动不得，都是过冬要用的。
每日新打回来的猎物，毛皮好的都留下鞣制了过冬，像弯角兽这样皮毛短的，他们一般也直接吃了。
不过之前林楸鞣制出的兽皮角兽人们看了，现在有点兽皮都被兽人们抢了去。
弯角兽的兽皮大，鞣制后可以裁剪多少条兽皮裙了。
还不硌屁股。
所以一时间，部落连做兽皮绳的材料都没有了。
这事儿狼安打算跟狼岩说一声，暂且先用藤蔓替代着。
*
鱼笼哗啦一下被兽人们抛下水，兽人们跟玩儿似的，比谁扔得远。
一不小心兽皮绳滑出了手，落得远远的。
眼看就要随着里面的石头沉下去，兽人一个扑腾下水，把绳子捡了回来。
浑身湿漉漉的，一甩，弄得附近几个兽人身上都是。
岸边闹哄哄，夜晚的狼山从未有过这么热闹。
狼山上，老兽人捏着木杖，立在山洞外的平台上，远远看着岸边哄闹的兽人们。
狼冰爬上山，道：“他没吃。”
老祭司：“你去睡觉吧。”
狼冰低下头，“……我觉得楸说得对。”
老祭司摆摆手，狼冰止住话，下了山去。
老兽人眼睛浑浊，依稀有水光。
那一场意外，即便过了几十年了他依旧记得清清楚楚。
要不是他不够谨慎，就松懈了那么一点……
一切都是他这个祭司当得不称职。
现在楸给部落带来的这些，鞣制兽皮，制作鱼笼还有制作食物的方式，种植除草……一样一样都是好的。
部落与以往不同了，连兽人们也多了丝活气儿。
今晚狼岩来跟他说了，法子确实可行，他已经老了，不敢再冒险。他可以饿死，反正没几年的活头。
但他们还年轻，他们不行。
老祭司看着溪水边每次吃完晚饭还要清理嘴巴跟脸颊的林楸，他与兽人们格外不同。
或许，他就是占卜里那一丝丝渺茫的希望。
该试着信任他。
老祭司下了决定。
*
第二天一早，林楸依旧在自己的草窝里醒来。
他抱着兽皮毯子，看着干干净净的手，总算消化了对狼岩的不尊重。
山洞外，今天似乎格外热闹。
林楸看外面天还早，兽人们似乎还没离开。他穿好草鞋出去，兽人们当即喊道：“出来了出来了！”
“楸，快点，咱们去捞鱼笼。”狼莫催促，脚下走来走去，压死了一片草。
林楸看一片闪亮的狼眼睛看来，还包括狩猎队跟采集队的。
林楸：“你们专门等我？”
兽人们齐齐点头。
“你教我们做的笼子。”狼安笑盈盈道。
见识了昨天两个鱼笼的收获，他今天更加期待。
林楸展颜，“那走。”
亚兽人情绪总不怎么外露，一下笑开，清泠泠的，像雪季后刚刚开化流淌的清溪，格外的清甜。
兽人们都愣了下，傻呆呆地跟着林楸走。
狼岩坐在一旁，看着林楸脸上一闪而逝的笑容，眼下的青黑都淡了些。
算了，他睡得好就行。
兽人们齐刷刷地去了岸边，连老祭司也被兽人给背了下来。
“两个一组，慢慢拉。”狼岩话落，兽人们争先恐后抢位置。
腿不软了，头不疼了，肚子也不饿了。
一个个脸上兴奋得眼中冒红光，一派朝气蓬勃的景象。
老祭司看在眼里，慢慢地扫了眼岸边站得笔直的林楸。
“起！”
兽人一同使劲儿。
“嗷呜嗷呜！我们这个好重！”
“嗷！我们这个更重。”
林楸：“……”
有没有可能，水里的空笼子也重。
笼子破水而出，里面的鱼受惊，甩着尾巴打得笼子噼啪响动。
兽人们紧盯着绳子，生怕断了。
只扬着眉，不敢出声，飞快将笼子往岸上拉。
一共八个笼子。
“有！”
“有鱼！”
“我们这也有！好多好多好多鱼！”
即便昨天看过起笼子的兽人，今天同样被惊住了。
兽人们怕鱼跳回河里，抓着笼子往岸边跑了几十步，都隔得很远了，才抓着笼子一倒——
鱼虾混杂，螃蟹挥舞着钳制飞快躲闪。
兽人扑过去就抓，有抱着大鱼憨笑的，有抓着大虾下意识往嘴巴里塞的，还有桀桀笑着跟个恶霸似的追螃蟹的。
林楸惊讶河里的渔业资源。
他料想八个笼子，五个笼子能捕到鱼已经很不错，但笼子没一个空的。
老祭司抓着木杖，身子微微颤抖。
狼岩看着那铺满河岸的渔获，再看一旁镇定的林楸，眼里有欣赏，可怀疑却越来越深。
他认识到的楸不是当初支部落的兽人描述的楸，也不是狼楸刚到部落的时候歇斯底里的模样。
这期间他跟祭司并没有去西边的山洞，他这样的变化，中间一定是发生了什么。
狼岩见一旁傻兮兮拉着兽人手，围着渔获跳圈的狼莫，暂且压下心中的疑问。
无疑，若每天能保证捞到鱼，且还不费兽人，这是个极好的事情。
之后捕猎，兽人们压力能小一些。
兽人这边热热闹闹，狼岩直接下令让兽人们吃点鱼再出发。
林楸被兽人们围着，看着一个个麦色的脸上带着感激的笑，目光真挚，笑容淳朴，叫林楸看着也轻松。
他不习惯身边太多人，笑了下，想从兽人们后头离开。
谁知狼安抓住他，温声道：“一起吗？你可以教教我们怎么做鱼。”
“对！楸做的鱼闻着好香，我做梦都想吃。”一个黑狼兽人倒退着走在林楸前面，咧着嘴巴憨笑。
“楸做的肉丸子也好吃！”灰狼兽人撞开黑狼兽人，眼眸星星亮。
狼安见林楸有些不自在，将围拢过来的兽人挡开一些。
“还不快去杀鱼，你们还要捕猎。”
兽人兴奋的脑子这才清醒了些，屁颠屁颠去杀鱼。
狼安道：“他们没恶意，这是示好呢。”
林楸点头，“我知道。”
直到狩猎队的兽人离开前，林楸都被狼兽人围着，大家七嘴八舌，听得他脑袋嗡嗡响。
习惯了独身一人，光是回答兽人们的问题都让他下意识绷了脸，声音有些僵硬。
好在狼安陪着，时不时挡一下兽人，林楸才有喘息的机会。
他们太热情了，他很不习惯。
远处，趁着乱，狼岩叫走了狼莫。
“王？”
狼岩跟狼莫往西边走，直到进了曾经关着林楸的山洞，狼岩才道：“楸变了。”
“对啊，变得可好了。”狼莫想着待会儿能吃到楸指点过的烤鱼，咽了咽口水。
狼岩：“他在出山洞之前，有什么异常？”
chapters.translated_text:
Leaving the cave, the two walked down the mountain.

Lang Yan’s footsteps were extremely light; after descending, he followed Lin Qiu to his campfire.

He set down the yams and looked at Lin Qiu.

"That incident was too great a blow to the Priest. When my father was alive, he often said that it was because of this very event, which happened just as he succeeded to the position of Priest, that his temperament changed somewhat."

Lin Qiu: "I understand, and I sympathize."

He didn't argue with the Priest, because words alone were empty.

"I have a way." Lin Qiu looked up at the majestic yet tolerant Wolf King before him.

Lang Yan scanned the grass and sat down.

"Tell me."

Lin Qiu: "Find all the 'itch-roots' eaten back then, roast them again, and catch some prey to test them one by one. This is the fastest and most reliable way to determine which kind of itch-root is poisonous."

"If you're not sure, just test it a few more times."

Lang Yan looked at Lin Qiu.

The flames reflected in his eyes, steady and confident.

Lang Yan swept his gaze over the itch-roots on the ground that were as tall as him; there were so many from just one plant.

If they could be eaten, then just like the tail-grass grown by the tribe, it would count as a stable food source.

This was worth it.

Lang Yan looked up; Lin Qiu was still watching him quietly.

He nodded, "Alright, I will have the beastmen find some and test them."

However, this matter must be explained to the Priest.

The Priest must have studied those itch-roots thoroughly after the incident back then. There was no need to tell Lin Qiu this; Lang Yan would handle the conversation himself.

Everything was for the sake of the tribe.

With the necessary words spoken, Lang Yan looked at the roaring bonfire in the distance, then back at the small, isolated campfire Lin Qiu kept to himself.

The sub-beastman’s back was tense, his shadow cast upon the ground, looking lonely.

He said: "Come to the bonfire in the future; it’s lively over there."

Lin Qiu’s hand tightened, and the green-skinned fruit he had just been holding rolled onto the ground.

"I’m quite used to this," he said.

Lang Yan picked up the fruit and put it in the basket, reminding him: "This is sour."

Lin Qiu: "I’ll cook it. This is edible, right?"

Lang Yan: "Yes."

Without saying anything more, Lang Yan left.

Lin Qiu looked at the yams he had spent most of the day digging up, sighed softly, and ultimately didn't eat them.

Since Lang Yan had agreed to run the tests, he would save these yams for that time.

After dinner, the beastmen didn't go straight into the cave for the first night.

Seeing the fish traps Lang An and the others had woven, and hearing that Qiu had caught many fish with them, they became unusually interested and wanted to follow along to set the traps.

Lin Qiu didn't follow, simply making his own dinner in silence.

After eating, he went to the stream to wash up.

Footsteps approached, and Lin Qiu, who was cupping clear water to wash his face, turned his head to look.

Lang Bing stopped, looking at him with curiosity.

Lin Qiu: "Is something the matter?"

Lang Bing shook his head, "Did you eat the itch-root?"

Lin Qiu: "No."

"Oh." Lang Bing twiddled his fingers and walked away.

It was good that he hadn't eaten it.

*

There weren't that many animal-hide ropes in the tribe; the fish traps Lang An and the beastmen had woven today had used up all the tribe's spare hide ropes.

The remaining hides couldn't be touched; they were all needed for the winter.

For the prey brought back daily, those with good fur were kept for tanning to last the winter, while those with short fur, like the curved-horn beasts, were usually just eaten.

However, after the beastmen saw the hides Lin Qiu had tanned, the few available hides had been snatched up by the beastmen.

The curved-horn beast’s hide was large; after tanning, it could be cut into many hide skirts.

And it didn't chafe the backside.

So, for a time, the tribe didn't even have materials left to make hide ropes.

Lang An planned to tell Lang Yan about this and use vines as a temporary substitute.

*

The fish traps were tossed into the water with a splash; the beastmen acted like they were playing, competing to see who could throw the farthest.

One accidentally let the hide rope slip from his hand, and it landed far away.

Seeing it about to sink along with the stones inside, the beastman dove into the water and retrieved the rope.

Soaking wet, he shook himself off, splashing the nearby beastmen.

The shore was noisy; the night at Wolf Mountain had never been this lively.

On the mountain, the old beastman gripped his wooden staff, standing on the platform outside the cave, watching the boisterous beastmen on the shore from afar.

Lang Bing climbed up the mountain and said: "He didn't eat it."

The old Priest: "Go to sleep."

Lang Bing lowered his head, "...I think Qiu is right."

The old Priest waved his hand, and Lang Bing stopped speaking and headed down the mountain.

The old beastman’s eyes were cloudy, with a faint glimmer of moisture.

Even after decades, he still remembered that accident clearly.

If he hadn't been careless, if he had just relaxed for that one moment...

Everything was because he was an incompetent Priest.

Now, what Qiu had brought to the tribe—tanning hides, making fish traps, new ways of preparing food, weeding crops... every single thing was good.

The tribe was different from before; even the beastmen had gained a bit of vitality.

Lang Yan had come to tell him tonight that the method was indeed feasible. He was old and dared not take risks anymore. He could starve; he didn't have many years left anyway.

But they were still young; they couldn't afford to fail.

The old Priest looked at Lin Qiu, who was cleaning his mouth and cheeks by the stream after dinner; he was remarkably different from the other beastmen.

Perhaps he was that faint glimmer of hope from the divination.

He should try to trust him.

The old Priest made his decision.

*

The next morning, Lin Qiu woke up in his grass nest as usual.

He hugged his fur blanket, looking at his clean hands, finally having processed his lack of respect toward Lang Yan.

Outside the cave, it seemed unusually lively today.

Lin Qiu saw it was still early and the beastmen hadn't left yet. He put on his grass sandals and went out; the beastmen immediately shouted: "He’s out, he’s out!"

"Qiu, hurry, let’s go retrieve the fish traps." Lang Mo urged, pacing back and forth, trampling a patch of grass.

Lin Qiu saw a patch of shining wolf eyes looking at him, including those from the hunting and gathering teams.

Lin Qiu: "You were waiting for me?"

The beastmen nodded in unison.

"The traps you taught us to make," Lang An said with a smile.

Having witnessed the harvest from the two traps yesterday, he was even more expectant today.

Lin Qiu smiled, "Then let's go."

Sub-beastmen usually didn't show much emotion, but when he smiled, it was clear and cool, like a fresh stream flowing after the snow season, exceptionally sweet.

The beastmen were all stunned for a moment, then followed Lin Qiu blankly.

Lang Yan sat to the side, watching the fleeting smile on Lin Qiu’s face; the dark circles under his own eyes seemed to fade a little.

Never mind, as long as he slept well.

The beastmen went to the shore in a group, and even the old Priest was carried down by a beastman.

"Two to a group, pull slowly." As soon as Lang Yan finished speaking, the beastmen scrambled for positions.

Their legs weren't weak, their heads didn't ache, and their stomachs weren't hungry.

Each face was excited with glowing eyes, a scene full of vigor.

The old Priest watched, slowly sweeping his gaze over Lin Qiu, who stood straight on the shore.

"Heave!"

The beastmen pulled together.

"Awoo awoo! Ours is so heavy!"

"Awoo! Ours is even heavier."

Lin Qiu: "..."

Is it possible that the empty traps in the water are also heavy?

The traps broke the surface, the fish inside startled, their tails slapping the traps with a clattering sound.

The beastmen stared intently at the ropes, fearing they would snap.

With raised eyebrows and bated breath, they quickly pulled the traps onto the shore.

There were eight traps in total.

"Got one!"

"There's fish!"

"We have some too! So many, so many fish!"

Even the beastmen who had seen the traps retrieved yesterday were stunned today.

Fearing the fish would jump back into the river, the beastmen ran dozens of steps away from the shore, and only when they were far enough did they dump the traps—

Fish and shrimp were mixed together, and crabs waved their claws, scurrying away.

The beastmen pounced to catch them; some hugged big fish and giggled, some grabbed big shrimp and subconsciously stuffed them into their mouths, and others laughed like bullies while chasing crabs.

Lin Qiu was surprised by the fishery resources in the river.

He had expected that out of eight traps, five catching fish would be quite good, but not a single trap was empty.

The old Priest gripped his wooden staff, his body trembling slightly.

Lang Yan looked at the catch covering the riverbank, then at the calm Lin Qiu beside him; there was admiration in his eyes, but his suspicion grew deeper.

The Qiu he knew was not the Qiu described by the beastmen of the branch tribe, nor was he the hysterical version of Lang Qiu when he first arrived at the tribe.

During this time, he and the Priest hadn't gone to the western cave; something must have happened to cause such a change.

Seeing Lang Mo foolishly holding a beastman's hand and dancing around the catch, Lang Yan temporarily suppressed his doubts.

Undoubtedly, if they could guarantee catching fish every day without exhausting the beastmen, this was an excellent thing.

Future hunting would be less stressful for the beastmen.

With the beastmen in high spirits, Lang Yan ordered them to eat some fish before setting off.

Surrounded by beastmen, Lin Qiu looked at their wheat-colored faces filled with grateful smiles, their gazes sincere and their expressions simple, which made Lin Qiu feel at ease.

He wasn't used to having so many people around, so he smiled and tried to slip away from behind them.

Who knew Lang An would grab him, saying gently: "Together? You can teach us how to cook fish."

"Right! The fish Qiu makes smells so good, I dream about eating it." A black wolf beastman walked backward in front of Lin Qiu, grinning foolishly.

"The meat balls Qiu makes are delicious too!" A gray wolf beastman shoved the black wolf beastman aside, his eyes sparkling.

Seeing Lin Qiu was uncomfortable, Lang An blocked the crowding beastmen.

"Hurry up and clean the fish, you still have to go hunting."

The beastmen’s excited brains finally cleared a bit, and they went off to clean the fish.

Lang An said: "They don't mean any harm; this is their way of showing goodwill."

Lin Qiu nodded, "I know."

Until the hunting team left, Lin Qiu was surrounded by wolf beastmen, everyone talking at once, making his head buzz.

Accustomed to being alone, just answering the beastmen's questions made him subconsciously tense his face, his voice somewhat stiff.

Fortunately, Lang An accompanied him, blocking the beastmen from time to time, giving Lin Qiu a chance to breathe.

They were too enthusiastic; he wasn't used to it at all.

In the distance, taking advantage of the chaos, Lang Yan called Lang Mo away.

"King?"

Lang Yan and Lang Mo walked west, and only after entering the cave where Lin Qiu had once been kept did Lang Yan say: "Qiu has changed."

"Yeah, he’s changed for the better." Lang Mo thought about the roasted fish he would eat later, guided by Qiu, and swallowed his saliva.

Lang Yan: "Before he left the cave, was there anything unusual?"
chapters.title: 第18章

chapters.source_text:
河面解冻，万物复苏。
一月后，天气稍微暖和一些，兽人们收拾好东西，准备出发前往南部。
晨雾如白练，缠绕着密林。新生的芽点嫩绿，沾了露珠，碧翠晶莹。
天还没亮，狼山前各个屋子、山洞里已经亮起微光。
食堂的烟囱里冒出青烟。
部落里剩的不多的尾巴草籽被狼安直接蒸了，弄成扎扎实实的干饭。
肉也是大块大块手把肉，没有汤汤水水，直接拿着就啃。
唯一的配菜，就是林楸雪季前腌制的酸萝卜，放在现在有些酸了，狼安用油炒过，滋味却更胜一筹。
早饭好了，即将出发的兽人们也陆陆续续出来。
如往常一样，兽人们排队，递上碗。
当看到碗里一大勺尾巴草籽饭，加上四五块连骨头带肉的把子肉，以及那半勺炒酸萝卜时，林楸只觉得喉咙有些堵。
这大清早的，能咽得下去吗？
“安，别把部落里的存粮吃完了。”
“你放心，我们饿不着。”
说着，狼安又给他添了一块肉。
肉是新鲜肉，今早上狼石他们赶着天没亮就起来杀的咩咩兽。
但林楸不像兽人们那么好胃口，他吃不完，分了些给狼岩。
“赶路很累。”狼岩道。
林楸：“所以你要多吃，我跑不动还得靠你。”
狼岩眼里带了一丝笑，说：“好。”
这一顿没什么花样，但对兽人们来说，却是吃得最饱的一顿。
吃完，兽人们便捎上要带走的货物和干粮，在广场上集合。
同行的，还有去大泽干活的兽人们。
依旧是狼雨狼虹过去负责做饭，小狼去捕猎，狼潭小队过去负责采集。
这次狼阔带队，过去建房子。
兽人聚齐，该出发了。
林楸看着守在一旁的兽人们，扬声道：“老祭司、安叔、晚叔、星叔……阿父，我们走了。”
老祭司点头。
亚兽人阿叔们关切道：“好，路上小心点，饿了就停下，遇到危险就躲，别受伤。”
“你们放心，我知道。”
狼赤看着自己幼崽，千言万语化作一句话：“我等你们回来。”
“走了！”林楸笑着，冲着他们摆手。
队伍转弯，冲着南边而去。
大部队在大泽分开，由狼岩带领的兽人们继续南行。队伍一共只有二十六个兽人，包括狩猎二队的二十二个兽人，加上狼岩、林楸、兔艾和鹿叶。
狩猎二队每个兽人都配齐了弓箭，箭镞充足。
连林楸走之前都在苦练，也背了一把弓箭。
离开大泽，他们往西，穿过向南延伸的山脉，随后经过白雀部落的领地，继续南行。
每个兽人都保持着兽形。
他们带的东西不算少，每个兽人背上挂着两个藤筐，有些藤筐上还各横放着一个兽皮袋。
里面有火柴、蜡烛、陶器、盐、药粉药膏、衣物、干粮，还有一些用于应急的兽皮、草药和雨具……
但凡林楸能想到的东西，都带上了。
东西不算轻，兽人们脚程不快也不慢。经过白雀部落时，雀十二白带着队伍从树冠探头。
过了一个雪季，小白雀瘦了，但羽毛依旧蓬松。
十多个白雀蹲在树冠上，像树上开出的白花。
雀十二白在狼兽人往这边走时就察觉到了，立刻举起弓箭瞄准。
可当看到是狼兽人，他立即飞身下来。
“狼王，楸？你们去哪儿？”
兽人们见部落的主人来了，干脆停下来，搭灶做饭。
今晚上他们要在这边过上一夜。
林楸盘腿坐下，招来小白雀。
“今晚借你们的地方休息一下。”
雀十二白点点头，豆豆眼还看着他们。
林楸看兽人们各司其职，搭灶的，洗锅的，掏鱼干菜干的，不用他操心……他这才收回目光，跟雀十二白道：“我们打算去南边走一趟。”
雀十二白看着队伍里就一个兔艾，还有那个陌生的被蒙着眼睛的亚兽人。
他道：“是跟之前的流浪部落有关吗？”
林楸：“是，也不是。我们主要去看看有没有部落可以交换一些东西。”
雀十二白点点头。
“那、我们能跟你们一起去吗？”
“你们？”林楸没有预料到他会这么问。
狼岩把事情安排好了，这时候走过来，道：“你们族长呢？这是他的想法？”
“我叫雀十三白去叫他了。”
狼岩在林楸身边盘腿坐下，他看着才他巴掌大的白雀，道：“你们跟着去干什么？”
雀十三白：“族长之前念叨过南边的甜砖呢。”
等到白雀族长急匆匆地带着队伍过来，林楸看着雀二白身上背着的兽皮袋，愣了愣。
“你们不会真要跟我们去吧？”
白雀族长冲着他俩友好一笑。
陶锅里的食物好了，兽人们分来吃。林楸礼貌询问了下白雀兽人们，他们摇头拒绝了。
林楸和狼岩吃着，白雀族长就道：“狼王，能不能让我们的兽人跟你们去一趟？你放心，食物我们自己负责。回来之后，我们会给你们报酬。之前借渔网，还欠两袋草药，这次多加两袋。”
狼岩：“路远，很危险。”
“你放心，我们有自保能力。而且我们会飞，有些你们不方便做的事，还可以叫他们帮忙。”
“就为了甜石？”
白雀族长摇头。
狼兽人对他们坦白，他们也没什么好隐瞒的。
“部落已经很久没跟外面的部落来往了，正好借着这次机会，跟你们出去看看，顺带瞧瞧能不能交换些对我们部落有用的东西回来。”
以往大集市还在的时候，他们白雀兽人几乎没有缺席。
很多东西，包括消息，都是在大集市上获取的。
他们部落恰好还有不少兽皮和鱼干，让白雀们带着，能交换什么就交换回来。
“你们打算去多少？”
白雀族长一听狼岩这话，就知道有戏。
他估摸着狼部落这一队兽人的数量，最后道：“十个。”
怕自己说得多了，他连忙解释：“不为别的，我们的兽人力气小些，十个刚好能把那点兽皮和鱼干带走。”
总不能这一趟还要狼兽人帮着他们背东西吧。
狼岩：“明早出发。”
“好！”白雀族长立马让雀二白带队，又从雀十二白的狩猎队选九个兽人出来。
被点到名字的雀十二白愣在原地，豆豆眼也不转了。
“族长，我走了，部落狩猎……”
“狩什么猎，一把火烧个精光，今年多半还得吃鱼。”雀二白道。
白雀族长把他拉到一边，严肃道：“你们必须去，这是一个很好的机会。”
白雀族长有意培养小白雀，可他们部落实在太弱小。
放在以前食物充足的时候，外面也还算安稳，小的还能跟着大的出去转转，就比如他和雀二白小时候还经常跟着上一任族长到处跑。
可现在，世道乱了。
能跟着狼部落出去是天大的好事。就算他们什么也不做，只要跟在他们身边，那就是一个保障。
“出去之后，多学多看，那点东西能交换什么你自己拿主意。除此之外，多了解一下我们南边有什么部落，看看人家的部落是个什么样子。”
雀十二白看着族长认真的样子，慢慢回过神来。
“族长，我知道了。”
“知道就好。现在赶紧回去，想想要带什么东西，收拾好了就过来。”
“明早我们也在这边吃一顿，然后让你二白叔带着，跟着他们走。”
次日，天亮，兽人们收拾东西，吃过早饭后出发。
在这停留一晚，多了十个白雀兽人，队伍一下扩展到三十六个兽人。
看着不算少了，但保持兽形的十个白雀并不起眼。
他们爪子抓着兽皮袋，跟着往前飞。确实也没让狼兽人们帮忙。
再两日，过了南边绿眼部落曾经的领地，便已经彻底离开兽人们熟悉的地方。
前方一切都是未知。
队伍往南边又走了两日，四周依旧是山火烧过的痕迹。
树丛很深，枝叶都被烧没了，只剩光秃秃的树干立在那里，表面焦黑。
晚上行走的时候，这些树干犹如鬼影，有些瘆人。
草长得很快，山火燃烧的灰烬成了滋养生命的肥料。灌木重新抽芽，翠绿叶片簇拥着豆大的小白花。
“南边应该有很多小部落……”兔艾是过来当向导的，可一路走来，这地方早已不是熟悉的模样。
林楸走在队伍前，挨着狼岩。
他听着兔艾的话，同时顿步。
兽人们随着他停下，顺着他的目光看去。
林楸还没看清，眼睛被捂住。
兽人们噤声，脚步凌乱一瞬，纷纷挤着林楸，加快步子继续走。
离了这一段，狼岩才把手放下来。
“刚刚那是什么？”林楸问。
“骨头。”狼岩道。
清风拂过，这一片灰烬格外厚的土地露出它原来的一点模样。
那清新干净的小白花下，是晒毁的木屋，漆黑的尸骨……重重叠叠，形态扭曲。
这里曾经有个部落，但山火来临之前，他们没能跑得掉。
穿过这片被山火烧过的土地，狼兽人们用了五天。
五天之后，隔着一座山，兽人们看到山下绵延开来的翠绿，树冠上新抽出来的嫩芽或深或浅，山花烂漫，生机勃勃，才缓过神来。
那片灰黑的林子太过压抑，兔艾说的那些部落位置都没错，因为不止一个部落没能跑得掉。
这几天，他们吃的全是带出来的干粮。
此时，是他们出来的第七天。
从狼山到白雀部落两天，穿越山火焚烧过的森林，用了五天。
这五天，他们连一个有兽人存活的小部落都没发现。
天快黑了，兽人们需要在这一处矮山停留。
雀二白组织小白雀们查探附近的情况。
林楸带着狼云准备食物，其余狼兽人一半留守，一半去附近寻找看有没有猎物。
林楸没急着生火，因为不知道附近有没有兽人部落，怕暴露行踪。
他们先挖灶，搭锅，然后从附近的溪流取水。
兽人们停留的地方就在水源地附近，还能在溪水旁边找到些新鲜的野菜。
狼火看着林楸在摘，叫上留守的兽人们去帮忙。
他们一路上都在消耗食物，也在搜集食物。像遇到了这种野菜多的地方，便会趁着停留的这一阵，赶紧采集。
一顿吃不完，他们会留着下一顿吃。
这样一边消耗一边补充，干粮还剩下一些。
不一会儿，雀十二白回来了。
小白雀个头小，巴掌大，落在地面，鹅黄色的爪爪跳了两步，立在林楸跟前。
他看林楸在忙，没注意到他，雀十二白又跳了跳。
单看白雀那模样和姿态，很乖。但那豆豆眼里非常冷静，看着是要说正事。
林楸还没注意到他，小白雀爪子点了一下林楸。
“嗯？”
雀十二白立即往后跳两步，一板一眼道：“附近没有部落，但有兽人踪迹。山后头的植物被采集过，看着是两三天前采集的。”
林楸：“再探。”
小白雀一点头，一下飞走。
“诶！”林楸探手。
“楸？”狼火问。
林楸懊恼，笑道：“我刚刚就是顺口。”
小白雀那样子，很像个密探。
狼火：“没事，他们方便，让他们去看看也行。”
“那这火还烧吗？”狼云捂着肚子，手上还抓着一把他刚刚啃过的野菜问。
林楸：“等一等，你也……不至于这样。”
狼火：“别管他，野菜上的虫吃进肚子里，然后钻破肚皮……”
“嗷嗷嗷嗷！队长！你别吓我！”狼云立刻把野菜扔了。
林楸听着笑起来。
狼火一看，心里松了口气。
这一路走来，楸有点压抑。尤其是踩到兽人骨头之后……
能笑就没事。
林楸不确定附近的兽人是好是坏。
他们晚上要在这里过夜，现在天还没黑，要是那边有威胁，他们晚上再生火就是。
狼岩带着捕猎的队伍也没走远，翻到山前，嗅到陌生兽人的味道，便带队回来了。
“王，附近有兽人踪迹。”林楸道。
狼岩点头：“应该是个食草部落。”
“是黑羊部落。”雀十二白回来得很快，爪子上还抓着一撮微微卷曲的黑色绒毛，“他们在山前半天路程内，应该是个兽人不过百的小部落。”
狼岩看了眼那绒毛，“是这个味道。”
狼云凑过去，嗅了嗅，皱着鼻子远离。
“臭臭的，焦糊味。”
“那做饭吗？”林楸问。
“做吧。”
他们是路过的，不是来攻击别人部落的，不用过分隐藏。而且就算被发现了，狼兽人也不怕。
炊烟腾起，没多久，就被小山以南的黑羊部落注意到了。
“族长！北边有烟！”
小河蜿蜒，穿过密林，在林中打了一个弯，随后直接拐向正南边。
黑羊部落三面环河，只留南边的出口。
部落地势平坦，树丛繁茂。中心的空地上，分布着大大小小的棚子。
棚子是用木棍撑起来的，上面铺着些破旧的兽皮、干草。棚子很低，兽人进去需要弯腰。
羊卷是部落里负责放哨的兽人，他察觉到北边的异样，赶紧跑来找族长。
他跑到散乱的棚子中，直奔中心那一个，脑袋一低，掀开草帘钻了进去。
棚子里黑沉，最先感觉到的是一股霉臭味。像打湿的兽皮闷在不通风的环境中许久，还带着一股腐气，呛得兽人都有些辣眼睛。
但黑羊部落的兽人们早已经习惯了。
棚子低矮，站在里面也直不起身。
羊卷适应了会儿，看到靠里侧的草堆上，有黑影撑着坐了起来，动作迟缓。
他快步上前，搀扶着兽人起来。
“又是山火？”黑羊族长声音嘶哑。
“不是，像是陌生兽人。”
他们亲历过山火，山火的烟不是那样的。
黑羊族长道：“派几个族人悄悄去看看，咳……”
羊卷忙端起一旁木头上放着的果壳碗，里面有水，赶紧给族长喝。
黑羊族长喘了口气，继续用哑得难以吐字的声音道：“别惊动他们，看完赶紧回来。”
“好，那叫羊烬去。”
黑羊族长点点头，示意他赶紧去办。
*
“王，附近有兽人。”林楸再不够敏锐，也感觉到了雀十二白的提醒。
他小爪子尖，戳在腿上，还有点疼。
林楸低头，与雀十二白对上视线。
小白雀见他明白了，收回爪爪，往旁边跳了跳。他对着同伴，翅膀微微一张，雀二十悄悄退出兽人中间，藏在树上，静静盯着那个黑漆漆的兽人。
狼兽人们早发现了，不过都没表现出来。
狼岩背对那视线，捏住林楸的手道：“应该是附近部落的。不用担心，只是来探查消息的。”
“好。”林楸有些紧张，不过面上看着没什么变化，依旧搅拌着鱼汤。
羊烬看到是狼兽人，瞳孔一缩，不敢多停留，极力压低呼吸和动作，立马回程。
雀十二白站起来，看向狼岩。
雀二白跳了跳，站到他面前。
你不应该看我吗？
我才是带队的！
狼岩瞥了两个白雀一眼，道：“去吧。注意安全。”
雀十二白转头跟上藏在树林里的雀二十。
雀二十是白雀当中速度最快的那一批，雀十二白与他一起，一直慢慢跟在那黑羊兽人后头，直到看到他们居住的地方。
天黑了，夜色是对白雀最好的保护。
他们站在树冠上，往下看。
这个部落燃起了篝火，兽人从那低矮的棚子进进出出。
这确实是个小部落，全是黑羊兽人，兽人数量低于五十个。
“他们的族长一直待在棚子里，我们没看见。部落当中很多烧焦的东西，附近生活痕迹不重，应该是之前从山火中逃出来的部落。”
“他们看着身体很一般，没有威胁。”
岂止一般，简直比白雀还弱。
那黑羊兽人腰间围着草裙，要不然就是皮毛斑秃的兽皮裙，兽皮裙下的两条腿极细，像狼兽人吃饭用的筷子。
一看日子就不好过。
狼岩：“火，晚上安排兽人轮流守夜。”
狼火点头。
狼兽人并不会看轻任何一个部落，对他们而言，那是陌生兽人，更是缺乏食物的兽人，不能掉以轻心。
晚上吃的野菜肉汤，肉是从部落里带来的肉干。
也就那么四五捆，一路上兽人们多吃鱼干，肉干省着吃，目前这是第三顿。
填饱肚子，大家抓紧时间休息。
出门在外，风餐露宿，条件好不到哪里去。
林楸把树底下一块地清理干净，然后铺上大叶片，再是厚厚的干草，又把塞了驱虫草药的药包放在干草上。
部落草药越用越少，现在驱虫药粉都要省着用了。
兽人们都有驱虫的药包，大伙儿看林楸怎么做，也学着他做。
干草铺好，林楸把唯一带出来的一块兽皮卷打开。
狼岩趴上去，林楸往他身边一躺，手脚塞入他毛毛里，脑袋埋在他颈侧。
兽人们几乎都用兽形睡觉。
也没那么多讲究，他们直接往干草上一躺，软软的，也挺舒服。
林楸身上裹着兽皮，额头抵着狼岩脖子，蜷缩在他肚皮上很快熟睡。
除了上半夜守夜的兽人，包括白雀在内，也都赶紧睡觉。
兔艾的草窝挨在狼火不远处，四周都是狼兽人，让他很有安全感。
而他对面，是鹿叶。
亚兽人从狼山被带出来后，眼睛就一直蒙着布。
这是防止他记得去狼部落的路线。
兽人也随手给他丢了些干草，鹿叶蜷缩在上面，安安静静的，瞧着挺安分。
这一路走来，他几乎没有说过话。
狼兽人们也暂时用不到他，指路的都是兔艾。
兔艾看着他，渐渐的，有了困意。
他合上眼，慢慢睡去。
另一边，黑羊部落的兽人们在羊烬带回来消息之后，一晚上没睡。
兽人们防备着，有些甚至还商量着要不要搬走。
最后族长让他们别动，暂且看看。
这一看，看到了第二天早上。
狼兽人绕行过他们部落，没有来打扰，也没有攻击他们的意思。
黑羊兽人松了一口气，可当隔着灌木丛，悄悄看到他们背上那鼓鼓囊囊的兽皮袋，兽人忍不住道：“族长，他们是不是去南边交换东西的？”
东部大陆靠北边的兽人几乎都知道北边的狼部落是个大部落，只这么一队兽人过来，不可能是迁徙。
“族长，说不定他们有草药。”
族人们从山火中跑出来，有些嗓子哑了，有些眼睛瞎了，还有很多被烧伤的。
有些族人明明都跑出来了，可却因为被烧伤，出来没多久身体开始发烫，最后死去。
能活下来的，大多伤轻，但也有兽人的伤反反复复不好。
他们没有祭司，狼部落有。
狼兽人这次出来交换，说不定会交换药。
“族长！要不我们去问问？”羊卷有些急，他是负责放哨的，他看得出狼兽人行进的速度很快，再不去来不及了。
羊烬却道：“我们有什么能跟他们交换？”
chapters.title: 第180章
chapters.translated_text:
The river ice thawed, and all things began to recover.

A month later, the weather grew slightly warmer, and the beastmen packed their belongings, preparing to set off for the south.

The morning mist was like a white silk ribbon, winding through the dense forest. The newly sprouted buds were tender and green, glistening with dew, crystal clear and emerald.

Before dawn, faint lights were already glowing in the houses and caves in front of Wolf Mountain.

Thin smoke rose from the chimneys of the canteen.

The remaining tail-grass seeds in the tribe were steamed directly by Lang An, turned into solid, hearty meals.

The meat was also served in large, hand-held chunks; there was no soup or broth, just grabbed and gnawed on.

The only side dish was the pickled radishes Lin Qiu had made before the snow season. They had become a bit sour by now, so Lang An stir-fried them with oil, making the taste even better.

Breakfast was ready, and the beastmen who were about to depart came out one after another.

As usual, the beastmen lined up and handed over their bowls.

Seeing the large scoop of tail-grass seed rice in his bowl, topped with four or five pieces of bone-in meat, and that half-scoop of stir-fried pickled radishes, Lin Qiu felt a lump in his throat.

Could he really swallow all this so early in the morning?

"An, don't use up all the tribe's stored food."

"Don't worry, we won't go hungry."

As he spoke, Lang An added another piece of meat to his bowl.

The meat was fresh; Lang Shi and the others had gotten up before dawn to slaughter the bleat-beast.

But Lin Qiu didn't have as big an appetite as the beastmen, so he couldn't finish it and shared some with Lang Yan.

"The journey is tiring," Lang Yan said.

Lin Qiu replied: "That's why you need to eat more; I'll have to rely on you if I can't run anymore."

A hint of a smile appeared in Lang Yan's eyes as he said, "Okay."

This meal had no fancy tricks, but for the beastmen, it was the most filling one they had eaten.

After eating, the beastmen carried the goods and dry rations they were taking with them and gathered in the plaza.

Also accompanying them were the beastmen going to work at the Great Marsh.

It was still Lang Yu and Lang Hong going over to be in charge of cooking, Xiao Lang to hunt, and Lang Tan's squad to be responsible for gathering.

This time, Lang Kuo led the squad to build houses.

The beastmen were assembled, and it was time to set off.

Lin Qiu looked at the beastmen standing guard on the side and said loudly: "Old Priest, Uncle An, Uncle Wan, Uncle Xing... Father, we are leaving."

The Old Priest nodded.

The beastman uncles said with concern: "Alright, be careful on the road. Stop if you're hungry, hide if you encounter danger, and don't get hurt."

"Don't worry, I know."

Lang Chi looked at his cub, his thousand words turning into one sentence: "I'll wait for you to come back."

"We're off!" Lin Qiu smiled and waved at them.

The team turned and headed south.

The main force split up at the Great Marsh, and the beastmen led by Lang Yan continued south. The team consisted of only twenty-six beastmen in total, including the twenty-two beastmen of the second hunting squad, plus Lang Yan, Lin Qiu, Tu Ai, and Lu Ye.

Every beastman in the second hunting squad was equipped with bows and arrows, with plenty of arrowheads.

Even Lin Qiu had been practicing hard before leaving and also carried a bow and arrows on his back.

Leaving the Great Marsh, they headed west, crossed the mountain range extending southward, then passed through the territory of the White Sparrow tribe, and continued south.

Every beastman maintained their beast form.

They weren't carrying a small amount of items; each beastman had two rattan baskets hanging on their back, and some even had a beast-skin bag placed horizontally across each basket.

Inside were matches, candles, pottery, salt, medicinal powders and ointments, clothing, dry rations, and some emergency beast skins, herbs, and rain gear...

Everything Lin Qiu could think of, they brought along.

The items weren't light, so the beastmen's pace was neither fast nor slow. When they passed the White Sparrow tribe, Que Shierbai poked his head out from the canopy with his team.

After a snow season, the little white sparrow was thinner, but his feathers were still fluffy.

More than a dozen white sparrows crouched on the canopy, looking like white flowers blooming on the tree.

Que Shierbai had noticed the wolf-beastmen when they were walking this way and immediately raised his bow and arrow to aim.

But when he saw it was the wolf-beastmen, he immediately flew down.

"Wolf King, Qiu? Where are you going?"

Seeing that the masters of the tribe had arrived, the beastmen simply stopped and set up a stove to cook.

They were going to spend the night here this evening.

Lin Qiu sat down cross-legged and beckoned the little white sparrow over.

"Borrowing your place to rest for a while tonight."

Que Shierbai nodded, his bean-like eyes still watching them.

Lin Qiu watched the beastmen performing their duties—setting up the stove, washing the pots, taking out dried fish and dried vegetables—without him needing to worry... Only then did he withdraw his gaze and say to Que Shierbai: "We plan to take a trip to the south."

Que Shierbai looked at the team, seeing only one rabbit-beastman, Tu Ai, and that strange beastman whose eyes were covered.

He asked: "Is it related to the previous wandering tribe?"

Lin Qiu: "Yes, and no. We are mainly going to see if there are any tribes to exchange some things with."

Que Shierbai nodded.

"Then, can we go with you?"

"You?" Lin Qiu hadn't expected him to ask that.

Lang Yan had finished arranging things and walked over at this moment, saying: "Where is your chieftain? Is this his idea?"

"I asked Que Shisanbai to go call him."

Lang Yan sat cross-legged beside Lin Qiu, looking at the white sparrow that was only the size of his palm, and said: "What are you going for?"

Que Shisanbai: "The chieftain was talking about the sweet bricks from the south before."

When the White Sparrow chieftain hurried over with his team, Lin Qiu looked at the beast-skin bag on Que Erbai's back and was stunned.

"You guys aren't really coming with us, are you?"

The White Sparrow chieftain gave them a friendly smile.

The food in the clay pot was ready, and the beastmen shared it. Lin Qiu politely asked the White Sparrow beastmen, but they shook their heads and refused.

As Lin Qiu and Lang Yan ate, the White Sparrow chieftain said: "Wolf King, can you let our beastmen go with you? Don't worry, we will be responsible for our own food. After we return, we will give you a reward. We still owe you two bags of herbs for borrowing the fishing nets, and we'll add two more this time."

Lang Yan: "The road is long and very dangerous."

"Don't worry, we have the ability to protect ourselves. And we can fly; for some things that are inconvenient for you to do, you can call them to help."

"Just for the sweet stones?"

The White Sparrow chieftain shook his head.

The wolf-beastmen were frank with them, so they had nothing to hide either.

"The tribe hasn't had contact with outside tribes for a long time. We're just taking this opportunity to go out with you and see if we can exchange for things useful to our tribe."

Back when the Great Market still existed, the White Sparrow beastmen almost never missed it.

Many things, including news, were obtained at the Great Market.

Their tribe happened to have quite a lot of beast skins and dried fish, so they would let the white sparrows carry them and exchange for whatever they could.

"How many do you plan to take?"

When the White Sparrow chieftain heard Lang Yan's words, he knew there was a chance.

He estimated the number of beastmen in the Wolf tribe's team and finally said: "Ten."

Afraid he had said too many, he quickly explained: "For no other reason, our beastmen have less strength, and ten is just right to carry those beast skins and dried fish."

They couldn't have the wolf-beastmen help them carry their things on this trip.

Lang Yan: "Leave tomorrow morning."

"Okay!" The White Sparrow chieftain immediately had Que Erbai lead the team and selected nine more beastmen from Que Shierbai's hunting squad.

Que Shierbai, who had been called by name, stood frozen on the spot, his bean-like eyes unmoving.

"Chieftain, if I leave, the tribe's hunting..."

"What hunting? A fire burned everything to the ground; we'll probably have to eat fish this year anyway," Que Erbai said.

The White Sparrow chieftain pulled him aside and said seriously: "You must go; this is a very good opportunity."

The White Sparrow chieftain intended to cultivate the little white sparrows, but their tribe was truly too weak.

In the past, when food was plentiful and the outside world was relatively stable, the young ones could follow the older ones out to look around—just like he and Que Erbai often followed the previous chieftain everywhere when they were young.

But now, the world was in chaos.

Being able to follow the Wolf tribe out was a huge blessing. Even if they did nothing, just being by their side was a guarantee.

"After you go out, learn more and see more. You decide what to exchange for with those things. Besides that, learn more about what tribes are in the south and see what other people's tribes look like."

Que Shierbai looked at the chieftain's serious expression and slowly came back to his senses.

"Chieftain, I understand."

"Good if you understand. Now hurry back, think about what to bring, and come over once you've packed."

"We'll have a meal here tomorrow morning, and then let your Uncle Erbai lead you to follow them."

The next day, at dawn, the beastmen packed their things and set off after breakfast.

Staying here for one night, with ten more White Sparrow beastmen, the team expanded to thirty-six beastmen.

It didn't look like a small number, but the ten white sparrows maintaining their beast forms were not very conspicuous.

They grabbed the beast-skin bags with their claws and flew forward. Indeed, they didn't let the wolf-beastmen help.

Two days later, after passing the former territory of the Green-Eyed tribe in the south, they had completely left the places the beastmen were familiar with.

Everything ahead was unknown.

The team walked south for another two days, and the surroundings still bore the marks of the mountain fire.

The thickets were deep, the branches and leaves had been burned away, leaving only bare tree trunks standing there, their surfaces charred black.

When walking at night, these tree trunks looked like ghosts, somewhat chilling.

The grass grew quickly, and the ashes from the mountain fire became fertilizer nourishing life. Shrubs sprouted again, with emerald green leaves clustered around bean-sized white flowers.

"There should be many small tribes in the south..." Tu Ai was here to act as a guide, but walking along the way, this place was no longer the familiar sight he knew.

Lin Qiu walked at the front of the team, next to Lang Yan.

He heard Tu Ai's words and paused at the same time.

The beastmen stopped with him and looked in the direction of his gaze.

Before Lin Qiu could see clearly, his eyes were covered.

The beastmen fell silent, their footsteps messy for a moment, and they crowded around Lin Qiu, quickening their pace to continue walking.

After leaving this section, Lang Yan took his hand away.

"What was that just now?" Lin Qiu asked.

"Bones," Lang Yan said.

A breeze blew, and this piece of land with exceptionally thick ashes revealed a bit of its original appearance.

Under those fresh and clean little white flowers were destroyed wooden houses, pitch-black skeletons... piled up, twisted in shape.

There had once been a tribe here, but before the mountain fire arrived, they hadn't been able to escape.

It took the wolf-beastmen five days to pass through this land burned by the mountain fire.

Five days later, across a mountain, the beastmen saw the emerald green stretching out below the mountain, the new buds on the tree crowns either deep or light, the mountain flowers blooming, full of vitality, and only then did they recover.

That gray-black forest was too oppressive; the locations of the tribes Tu Ai mentioned were all correct, because more than one tribe hadn't been able to escape.

These past few days, they had eaten nothing but the dry rations they brought.

At this moment, it was their seventh day out.

It took two days from Wolf Mountain to the White Sparrow tribe, and five days to cross the forest burned by the mountain fire.

In these five days, they hadn't even discovered a single small tribe with surviving beastmen.

It was getting dark, and the beastmen needed to stay at this low mountain.

Que Erbai organized the little white sparrows to scout the situation nearby.

Lin Qiu took Lang Yun to prepare food, while the remaining wolf-beastmen stayed behind, and half went to the vicinity to see if there was any prey.

Lin Qiu didn't rush to light a fire because he didn't know if there were any beastman tribes nearby and was afraid of exposing their tracks.

They first dug a stove, set up a pot, and then took water from a nearby stream.

The place where the beastmen stayed was near the water source, and they could find some fresh wild vegetables by the stream.

Lang Huo saw Lin Qiu picking them and called the remaining beastmen to help.

They were consuming food along the way and also collecting food. Like when they encountered a place with many wild vegetables, they would take advantage of the stop to collect them quickly.

If they couldn't finish it in one meal, they would save it for the next.

By consuming and replenishing like this, some dry rations remained.

Before long, Que Shierbai returned.

The little white sparrow was small, the size of a palm, and landed on the ground. His goose-yellow claws jumped twice, standing in front of Lin Qiu.

He saw Lin Qiu was busy and hadn't noticed him, so Que Shierbai jumped again.

Just looking at the white sparrow's appearance and posture, he was very obedient. But those bean-like eyes were very calm, looking like he had serious business to discuss.

Lin Qiu hadn't noticed him yet, so the little white sparrow tapped Lin Qiu with his claw.

"Hmm?"

Que Shierbai immediately jumped back two steps and said in a matter-of-fact tone: "There are no tribes nearby, but there are traces of beastmen. The plants behind the mountain have been gathered, and it looks like they were gathered two or three days ago."

Lin Qiu: "Scout again."

The little white sparrow nodded and flew away.

"Hey!" Lin Qiu reached out.

"Qiu?" Lang Huo asked.

Lin Qiu felt annoyed and smiled: "I just said it off the cuff."

The little white sparrow's appearance was very much like a secret agent.

Lang Huo: "It's fine, they are convenient, letting them go take a look is also fine."

"Then should we light this fire?" Lang Yun asked, holding his stomach and holding a handful of wild vegetables he had just gnawed on.

Lin Qiu: "Wait a bit, you... don't have to be like that."

Lang Huo: "Don't mind him, the insects on the wild vegetables get eaten into the stomach, and then drill through the belly..."

"Awoooo! Captain! Don't scare me!" Lang Yun immediately threw the wild vegetables away.

Lin Qiu laughed as he listened.

Lang Huo saw this and felt relieved.

Along the way, Qiu had been a bit oppressed. Especially after stepping on the beastman bones...

As long as he could laugh, he was fine.

Lin Qiu wasn't sure if the nearby beastmen were good or bad.

They were going to spend the night here, and it wasn't dark yet; if there was a threat over there, they could just light the fire at night.

Lang Yan, who had taken the hunting team, hadn't gone far either; he turned to the front of the mountain, smelled the scent of strange beastmen, and led the team back.

"King, there are traces of beastmen nearby," Lin Qiu said.

Lang Yan nodded: "It should be a herbivore tribe."

"It's the Black Sheep tribe," Que Shierbai returned very quickly, with a tuft of slightly curly black fluff in his claws, "They are within half a day's journey in front of the mountain, and it should be a small tribe with fewer than a hundred beastmen."

Lang Yan looked at the fluff, "It's this scent."

Lang Yun leaned over, sniffed, wrinkled his nose, and moved away.

"Smelly, a burnt smell."

"Then should we cook?" Lin Qiu asked.

"Cook."

They were passing through, not here to attack other tribes, so they didn't need to hide excessively. And even if they were discovered, the wolf-beastmen weren't afraid.

The cooking smoke rose, and it wasn't long before it was noticed by the Black Sheep tribe south of the small mountain.

"Chieftain! There's smoke to the north!"

A small river wound through the dense forest, made a turn in the woods, and then turned directly to the south.

The Black Sheep tribe was surrounded by the river on three sides, leaving only an exit to the south.

The tribe's terrain was flat, and the bushes were lush. In the central open space, sheds of various sizes were distributed.

The sheds were supported by wooden sticks, covered with some worn-out beast skins and hay. The sheds were very low, and beastmen needed to bend over to enter.

Yang Juan was the beastman responsible for keeping watch in the tribe. He noticed the anomaly to the north and hurried to find the chieftain.

He ran into the scattered sheds, headed straight for the one in the center, lowered his head, lifted the grass curtain, and drilled in.

The shed was dark, and the first thing he felt was a musty odor. It was like damp beast skins left in an unventilated environment for a long time, also carrying a stench of decay, which was so pungent it made the beastman's eyes sting.

But the beastmen of the Black Sheep tribe were already used to it.

The shed was low, and one couldn't stand up straight inside.

Yang Juan adapted for a while and saw a black shadow sitting up on the grass pile on the inner side, moving slowly.

He stepped forward quickly and helped the beastman up.

"Is it the mountain fire again?" The Black Sheep chieftain's voice was hoarse.

"No, it looks like strange beastmen."

They had experienced the mountain fire, and the smoke from the mountain fire wasn't like that.

The Black Sheep chieftain said: "Send a few tribesmen to take a look quietly, cough..."

Yang Juan hurriedly picked up the fruit-shell bowl placed on the wood on the side, which contained water, and quickly gave it to the chieftain to drink.

The Black Sheep chieftain caught his breath and continued in a voice so hoarse it was hard to articulate: "Don't alert them, come back quickly after looking."

"Okay, then I'll call Yang Jin."

The Black Sheep chieftain nodded, signaling him to go do it quickly.

*

"King, there are beastmen nearby." Lin Qiu, even if not sharp enough, felt Que Shierbai's warning.

His small claws were sharp, poking his leg, and it even hurt a little.

Lin Qiu lowered his head and met Que Shierbai's gaze.

The little white sparrow saw that he understood, withdrew his claws, and jumped to the side. He spread his wings slightly toward his companion, and Que Ershi quietly withdrew from among the beastmen, hid in a tree, and stared quietly at that pitch-black beastman.

The wolf-beastmen had already discovered it, but none of them showed it.

Lang Yan turned his back to that gaze and squeezed Lin Qiu's hand, saying: "They should be from a nearby tribe. Don't worry, they are just here to scout for information."

"Okay." Lin Qiu was a bit nervous, but he didn't look any different on the surface, still stirring the fish soup.

Yang Jin saw that it was wolf-beastmen, his pupils shrank, he didn't dare to stay long, tried his best to lower his breathing and movements, and immediately returned.

Que Shierbai stood up and looked at Lang Yan.

Que Erbai jumped and stood in front of him.

Shouldn't you be looking at me?

I'm the one leading the team!

Lang Yan glanced at the two white sparrows and said: "Go. Be careful."

Que Shierbai turned and followed Que Ershi, who was hiding in the woods.

Que Ershi was among the fastest of the white sparrows. Que Shierbai and he followed the Black Sheep beastman slowly until they saw the place where they lived.

It was dark, and the night was the best protection for the white sparrows.

They stood on the canopy and looked down.

This tribe had lit a bonfire, and beastmen were going in and out of those low sheds.

This was indeed a small tribe, all Black Sheep beastmen, with fewer than fifty beastmen.

"Their chieftain has been staying in the shed, we didn't see him. There are many charred things in the tribe, and there are not many traces of life nearby; it should be a tribe that escaped from the mountain fire before."

"They look very average, no threat."

More than average, they were even weaker than the White Sparrows.

That Black Sheep beastman was wearing a grass skirt around his waist, or else a skirt made of patchy beast skin. The two legs under the beast-skin skirt were extremely thin, like the chopsticks wolf-beastmen used to eat.

One look and you could tell their days were not easy.

Lang Yan: "Huo, arrange for beastmen to take turns keeping watch at night."

Lang Huo nodded.

The wolf-beastmen didn't look down on any tribe; to them, those were strange beastmen, and even more so, beastmen lacking food, so they couldn't let their guard down.

The dinner was wild vegetable and meat soup; the meat was dried meat brought from the tribe.

There were only four or five bundles, and along the way, the beastmen ate more dried fish, saving the dried meat; this was the third meal so far.

After filling their stomachs, everyone seized the time to rest.

Away from home, sleeping in the open, the conditions weren't much better.

Lin Qiu cleaned a piece of ground under a tree, then spread large leaves, followed by thick hay, and placed the medicine bag stuffed with insect-repellent herbs on the hay.

The tribe's herbs were being used up, and now the insect-repellent powder had to be used sparingly.

The beastmen all had insect-repellent bags, and everyone watched how Lin Qiu did it and learned to do the same.

After the hay was spread, Lin Qiu opened the only piece of beast skin he had brought out.

Lang Yan lay on it, Lin Qiu lay down beside him, tucked his hands and feet into his fur, and buried his head in the side of his neck.

Almost all the beastmen slept in their beast forms.

There weren't many formalities either; they just lay down on the hay, which was soft and quite comfortable.

Lin Qiu was wrapped in beast skin, his forehead against Lang Yan's neck, curled up on his belly, and fell into a deep sleep quickly.

Except for the beastmen on watch for the first half of the night, everyone, including the white sparrows, also hurried to sleep.

Tu Ai's grass nest was not far from Lang Huo, and he was surrounded by wolf-beastmen, which made him feel very safe.

And opposite him was Lu Ye.

Since the beastman was taken from Wolf Mountain, his eyes had been covered with cloth.

This was to prevent him from remembering the route to the Wolf tribe.

The beastmen also casually threw some hay for him, and Lu Ye curled up on it, quiet and looking quite well-behaved.

Along the way, he had almost never spoken.

The wolf-beastmen didn't need him for the time being; Tu Ai was the one pointing the way.

Tu Ai looked at him, and gradually, he felt sleepy.

He closed his eyes and slowly fell asleep.

On the other side, the beastmen of the Black Sheep tribe didn't sleep all night after Yang Jin brought back the news.

The beastmen were on guard, and some even discussed whether to move away.

Finally, the chieftain told them not to move and to wait and see for now.

This waiting and seeing lasted until the next morning.

The wolf-beastmen bypassed their tribe, didn't come to disturb them, and didn't have any intention of attacking them.

The Black Sheep beastmen breathed a sigh of relief, but when they secretly saw the bulging beast-skin bags on their backs through the bushes, a beastman couldn't help but say: "Chieftain, are they going to the south to exchange things?"

Beastmen in the north of the Eastern Continent almost all knew that the Wolf tribe in the north was a large tribe; with only this team of beastmen coming over, it couldn't be a migration.

"Chieftain, maybe they have herbs."

The tribesmen had run out from the mountain fire; some had hoarse throats, some were blind, and many were burned.

Some tribesmen had clearly run out, but because they were burned, their bodies started to heat up shortly after coming out, and they finally died.

Most of those who survived had light injuries, but there were also beastmen whose injuries kept recurring and wouldn't heal.

They didn't have a priest, but the Wolf tribe did.

The wolf-beastmen were out to exchange this time, so maybe they would exchange medicine.

"Chieftain! Why don't we go ask?" Yang Juan was a bit anxious; he was responsible for keeping watch, and he could see that the wolf-beastmen were moving very fast, so it would be too late if they didn't go now.

Yang Jin, however, said: "What do we have to exchange with them?"

chapters.title: 第181章
chapters.source_text:
狼部落。
狼岩和林楸带队离开后，部落由祭司和狼赤接管。
兽人们起初还有些不习惯，遇到事情张嘴就是：“楸！你来看看……”
说完了，半天没看到兽人，才拍了下脑袋，想起来他们已经出发去南边了。
部落的事情按部就班地进行着，狼山那边，狼莫分了一批会建窑的兽人跟着狼阔去了大泽，剩下的兽人抓紧时间继续烧砖烧瓦，打地基，建房子。
除此之外，兽人们从大泽和狼山两边同时开始修路。
按照楸所说的，路要拓宽，起码够两辆板车并排行走。路要尽量平整，坑坑洼洼的地方也得填上。
这是个大工程，支部落回来的兽人都投入进来，大伙儿轮流修路建房。
另一边，地里也是不少活儿。
兔葵从每天睁眼就开始忙，要继续开垦荒地，要施肥改土，要育苗播种，忙得脚不沾地。
今年不仅是尾巴草又要扩种，他还得试着播种去年雪季前找回来的那些野菜种子。还有花生、牧草……一堆的事儿。
而大泽这边，兽人们也忙。
狼阔带队在这边选址建窑，铺路修路，后续还要建房。
白雀回来了。
继续帮他们挖淤泥，小狼队和狼潭的采集队负责兽人们吃喝，还得分一半兽人去挖藕种，往浅滩中移栽……
春日晴好，农人正忙，换成是兽人，那也一样。
*
南部。
已经走了很远的狼兽人们继续往前。
他们打算先去赤山部落，便先跟着兔艾找他们以前的领地——绿湖。
这会儿，兽人才离开黑羊部落的领地附近。
林子里的路不好走，雪季过后，草木疯长，杂草都到了狼兽人胸口高。
草叶边缘有锯齿，灌木上也长着尖刺，这边野兽少，兽人活动也少，没什么现成的兽道可以走，只能他们自己踩出一条路。
好在狼兽人们毛厚，才没挨上一下，不过被刮去多少毛就不知道了。
大伙儿天天钻林子，毛毛里不是枯枝就是草叶，加上又要换毛了，一堆一堆毛搅缠在一起，着实狼狈。
正是下午，兽人们打算白天赶赶路，早点绕过黑羊部落的领地。
走到现在，忽听得林子里一阵溪水淌流声，没一会儿，就看到眼前一条长溪横亘而过。
林楸和狼岩停下，兽人们也停下。
大伙儿看着那溪水，又悄悄往后瞥了一眼，装作什么都不知道。
他们踩着明显用石头堆成的路，一步一步到达溪水对岸。
再次钻入密林，兔艾蹲在林楸背着的藤筐里，爪子扒着藤筐边缘，冲着林楸小声道：“他还跟着我们呢。”
林楸毛耳朵动了动，低声回：“这里应该还是他们领地边缘。”
兔艾长耳朵一甩，耷在藤筐边，随着林楸的步子一摇一晃。
“天黑之前应该能离开黑羊部落附近。”
林楸身边是狼岩。
他身上也背着东西，挨得林楸很近。
前面有草，狼岩便身体往前一些，先一步把草踩倒。林楸一心跟兔艾说着话，没有发现。
“之前黑羊部落不是在这个位置，是在山火烧过的那片林子里。他们原本应该有百多个兽人，黑羊族长在南边小部落当中也说得上话的。”
“这边小部落之间互相有来往？”
“嗯。”兔艾肯定道。
“小部落跟大部落不一样，大家都难吃饱，有时候没食物了，你借我，我借你，或者大家组队一起去找，比单独行动要安全一点。”
有时候遇上凶猛一点的野兽，或者是流浪兽人，兽人多才能打得过。
“那黑羊部落有祭司吗？”
兔艾摇头，两耳朵甩到后背，也跟着他脑袋轻轻摇。
狼云就落后他们一步，盯着藤筐里的兔艾，看着他那对耳朵，眼睛转悠。
他磨了磨牙，很想扑上去咬住。
想着还没干，被狼火一爪子打在鼻子上。
狼云疼得嗷的一声，清醒了。
队伍往前，又走了半天。
他们终于钻出林子，到了一片树木稀疏的空地上。
大伙儿照旧先检查附近情况，确认安全，纷纷放下东西趴下来。
林楸走了一天，也累得往地上一坐，藤筐里的兔艾跳出来，藏在深草里变成人形，穿好兽皮裙出来。
他两条细长的腿灵活而有劲儿，步子轻盈，是兽人当中最轻松的。
“我去捡柴。”
说着，他跑进林子。
狼火点了两个狼兽人跟上，以防万一。
狼云屁颠屁颠站起来，跟着去了。
休息一会儿，兽人们纷纷爬起来，开始为晚饭做准备。
白雀们放下自己的东西，去河边抓鱼。
这河就是包围黑羊部落，直往南流淌的那条河。
小河不大，两三米宽。
河里水草摇曳，肉眼可见的鱼虾趴在水草上。
林楸听到啪啪几声，水花溅起。侧头一看，白雀们已经冲出水中，爪子和鸟喙上各抓着一条鱼。
鱼不大，两三指宽。
白雀们把鱼往岸上一扔，毛一抖，身上又变成干爽的。
就算已经过了雪季，但这会儿水里依旧冷，要是生病了，这路上可没多少草药用。
在白雀还要继续钻进水中时，林楸忙道：“有渔网！”
雀二白：“水草多，渔网不好用。”
“那就藤筐。”
