林楸和狼岩问完羊止，结伴往山上走。
走至半山腰，林楸停下，看着那个又往雀溪那屋钻的羊止。
“雀溪应该不会答应。”
“说不定。”
狼岩牵住林楸的手，十指紧扣，又拉着他往山上走。
沿着台阶一步步上到山顶，高高的哨塔上站立的兽人冲着他们打招呼。
狼岩颔首，兽人又收回目光，兢兢业业放哨。
狼岩掐着林楸腰一举，放在山顶的大石头上。
林楸的长发飘动，拂过狼岩脸侧，有些凉，泛着淡淡的草木清香。
待他坐好，狼岩手撑着石面一跳，坐在林楸身边。
狼山的景色此刻一览无余。
林楸瞧着山下鳞次栉比的房屋，开阔的农田，饲养牲畜的红鸟圈和咩咩兽圈……
“咱们部落变化太快了。”
“从你来狼山算起，也有五六年了。”
“这么多年了啊……”
林楸望着狼山前那条蜿蜒而去的大河，大河一直没变过。他忙着埋头做事，好似也忘了这日子竟也过去这么久了。
“想回去吗？”狼岩看着他微微恍惚的侧脸，问道。
“不想。”
狼岩理着他被吹乱的长发，唇角微微翘着。
他们都知道狼岩问的是回哪儿去，狼岩问出来，是笃定他不会走。林楸毫不犹豫的回答，也印证了他的话。
林楸笑了起来，他侧身盘腿坐在大石头上，拍了拍狼岩的腿。
“王，去雀溪部落的事，我们商量商量。”
“好。”
这次去红雀部落，肯定不像上一次去东部大陆那么轻松。
他们要去的是西部大陆南端，中间还需要经过中央大陆。中央大陆，那可是兽人聚居的地方，只是不知道现在那边部落还多不多。
“王，你去过中央大陆南部吗？”
“没有。”狼岩与林楸盘腿对坐，抓着他一只手把玩。他从掌根捏到指尖，又揉一揉指缝间的软肉，跟幼崽找到个喜欢的玩具似的，也不知道一只手有什么好玩儿的。
林楸看着唇角翘起，挪了挪，与他并排坐着，身子倾靠在他肩膀，懒了姿态。
“从我们这边过去，要横穿整个中央大陆南部，咱们去一趟大概要多久？”
“一年半年都有可能。”
当初狼部落从中央大陆中部出来，走到东部大陆边缘，差不多用了半年的时间。
他们是整个部落迁徙，走得慢一些。再一个是不熟悉路线，走哪边全靠祭司和狼王决定，没有目标地点，只有祭司算出来的大概方位。
这一路上走走停停，他们还试图在其他地方定居过，所以算下来时间会长一些。
他们去西部大陆南边则不同。
有雀溪认路，去的队伍肯定没有迁徙队伍那么大，也没有幼崽和老兽人，速度应该会快不少。
“那一来一回就得一年或两年？”
狼岩侧脸蹭过林楸头发，道：“要不然，你留在部落？”
“你想都别想！”林楸道。
这一趟走得远，狼岩必定是要跟着的。
如果这条路走通了，就可以让去过的兽人领队过去交换东西，好比他们现在跟黑熊部落那样。
路途虽远，但就凭那水稻和西部大陆的草药，就该走这一趟。
狼岩看他愁得拧眉，笑着握住他腕子，道：“我说不准，一年也好，两年也好，要走一趟才知道。”
以前有大集市在的时候，出远门对兽人们来说是很寻常的事情。只后头大集市没了，日子艰难，外面流浪兽人也多了起来，出去走一趟确实比以前更加危险。
狼岩越想，手圈着林楸手腕比量大小，忍不住道：“楸不去，好不好？”
“不好。”
“危险。”
“别把我当幼崽，我这几年也不是白练的。”
狼岩闷声笑，下巴蹭着自己伴侣的头发，只感觉格外的顺滑。
也罢，他会护好他。
“那这次，让哪些兽人去？”
林楸说着，看了一眼雀溪那屋，羊止还没出来。
狼岩：“这次太远，看兽人的意愿。不过我打算让黑羽兽人和兔兽人都跟着去。具体是谁，今晚让他们一起商量决定。”
“好。”
这一来一回是太远了，有些兽人胆儿小；有些顾家，不乐意走这么远，这事晚上再看。
广场前的几个大灶还在烧着，雾气腾腾。
一袋一袋挖回来的岩盐被倒在里面煮，最后制出来的盐雪白透亮。
林楸看着兽人们把制好的盐装袋里扛到仓库里去，道：“那拿出去交换的东西打算拿哪些？”
“上次那些就可以。”
“布呢、酒呢？安他们做的酱菜也可以，咱们从其他部落交换来的兽皮也行啊。”
林楸说完，见狼岩看着他，灰眸带着浅浅的笑，还笑得有些揶揄：“楸是想把狼部落搬空？”
林楸手握拳，敲了一下他手心。
狼岩捏住他的手，又把他手指弄开，带着茧子的指腹按压在他掌心。
一下又一下，他手都红了。
林楸：“部落现在能交换的东西多，但这次走得远，咱们尽量带些价值大的东西。”
“好，听你的。”
“我等会儿去仓库盘点一下，咱们部落这几年也攒了一些好东西，放在山洞久了坏了也可惜。”
“可以。”
暖风和煦，夹杂着草木花香。
林楸下意识捕捉这风里的味道，嗅到花粉，呛得他打了个喷嚏。
瞧着狼岩在笑，他揉了揉鼻子，道：“习惯了辨别气味，都不能好好感受这景色了。”
“那就离树林远一点。”
“下山吧，看看雀溪去。”
他们还等着他养好伤，带他们去红雀部落。羊止在里面那么久，可别耽搁了他休养。
山上修了阶梯，下山路比以前好走许多。
不过路窄，狼岩走在前，林楸跟在他身后。
一前一后也不过相隔一个台阶。
林楸手搭上狼岩肩膀，刚要开口，狼岩双手往后一捞，就把他背在背上。
“诶？”
狼岩：“怎么了？”
林楸：“不是，你让我下来。”
“不是让背？”
林楸飞快看了眼山下煮盐的兽人。
制盐的兽人认认真真做着自己的事，倒没看见。林楸正松了一口气，想起山上还有个哨塔，抬头一看，正好与放哨的兽人对上视线。
哨塔上的兽人镇定移开眼，一副认真样子继续看着远方。
林楸双手攀在狼岩肩膀上，红晕一下从脖子蔓延到脸上。
“快放我下来！”
狼岩停步，微微松手。确保林楸站稳了，才回身看他。
见他面颊透红，低笑一声，捏了捏林楸的脸。
林楸飞快拿下他的手，暗暗咬牙道：“不许笑。”
狼岩：“没笑。”
“没笑你眼睛和嘴角弯着干什么？”
不能再逗了，再逗要炸毛了。
“要不要去看看西边的兽人部落？”
“去什么？”
“西边。”
话题一下转得太快，林楸看狼岩一本正经的样子，恼也不是，不恼也不是。
他一下撒开手，走到前面去，几下跑下了山。
狼岩：“慢点。”
林楸不理他，长发飞扬，两步并作一步，跑得更快了。
林楸下山，直奔食堂。
他取了一壶热水，拎着就往雀溪那屋去。
推开门，雀溪躺在炕上，似睡着了。
羊止坐在他旁边，嘴里轻声念着什么话。林楸进来把他吓了一跳，兽人直接从凳子上跌坐下来。
林楸：“他睡着了？”
羊止看了眼雀溪，佝背缩肩，双手交叠在一起，不安地抠了抠。
“没、没睡。”
似乎印证他的话，羊止说完，雀溪就睁开了眼。
林楸：“商量好了吗？这段时间需不需要羊止的照顾？”
羊止嘴巴微微张大，声音堵在喉咙。
雀溪没在林楸面前让羊止难堪，他声音沙哑道：“我就是摔了一跤，不用麻烦止照顾。现在已经好多了，止，你就回大泽去吧。”
“不、不……我陪着你，我守着你。”羊止慌张地站起来，一下扑到炕上，去拉雀溪的手。
雀溪没动，而是直直看着他那双泪眼，道：“你守着我……欠下的那些活儿怎么办？如果你愿意帮我，就帮我把我的那一份儿也做了。”
羊止手一松，虚虚握住雀溪的手，不敢看身后的林楸。
他也不说话，似等着林楸开口。
林楸唇角抬了抬，眼中没有一点笑意，“可以先欠着。”
羊止手一下收紧。
雀溪吃疼，手颤了一下，却抽不回来。
林楸：“不过之后可能要做两份活儿交换。”
羊止低下头，一动不动。
雀溪看着羊止道：“赶紧去大泽吧，不然越欠越多。我的那一份儿……”
“也可以先欠着，等你好了，我们一起做。”羊止抢先一步道。
他声音很轻很细，泛着潮气，像灰暗雨天林子里嘶鸣的蛇吐信声。
林楸捏了捏眉心。
真是油盐不进。
他把水放下，道：“雀溪需要休息。”
“我就在这里陪着他，我不会吵到他的。”
还没吵到？
雀溪脸白成什么样了。
雀溪：“我不用。”
羊止：“你伤还没好，需要兽人守着。”
“我说了，我不用。”
“你不知道自己摔得多严重，当时流了好多的血，要不是我求羽千把你带过来找狼祭司，你……”
“你好吵。”狼果不知道什么时候进来的，他手臂往林楸肩膀上一搭，见屋里几个兽人都看来，嫌弃地啧啧两声。
也不知道是嫌弃谁？
羊止最后被狼果拎了出去。
“这种兽人，你说话他听吗？”
林楸勾了凳子一坐，道：“没遇到过这样的兽人。”
“就说你笨呢，动手不就解决了。”
林楸被他说得笑了起来，“这方面我是不如你。”
狼果被他哄开心了，哼声道：“你性子软，就不像个狼兽人。”
“像什么兽人？”
“哪个都不像。连兔葵他们都不是泥捏的，你可能以前傻久了，这个还得练练。”
林楸以前确实多跟文明人打交道，冷着脸就能避免不少麻烦事，是以，还是头一回见到这样的。
“多谢提点。”
“不谢不谢。什么时候把他送走？”说的就是刚刚那个羊止。
林楸：“明天狼金他们回大泽，让他跟着一起。”
林楸给雀溪喝了点水，让他休息，和狼果带上门出去。
瞧见蹲在河边的羊止，林楸道：“以前也不知道他是这个性子。”
“狼部落有几个知道？”
之前鹿叶在的时候，他在三个被救回来的亚兽人中也不显眼。
后头鹿叶走了，他俩被送去大泽，那边有吃的有喝的，羊止带着傻了的雀溪，又不怎么跟狼兽人扎堆，有话也只拉着雀溪说，谁能发现他是这么个性子。
“算了，不说他了。糟心得很。去红雀部落的事怎么说，有安排了吗？”
“今晚商量，你想去？”
“我走得开吗？就好奇。”
“现在不带幼崽？”
“都睡了，我出来放放风。”
“那行，跟着我去点点部落的家底儿。”
这几年兽人们种的地越来越多，跟他们交换过的部落也陆续找上门来跟他们继续做交换。
部落攒了不少家当，都被妥帖存放在山洞中和兽人们新建的仓库中。
其中兽皮、草药、蔗糖、蜂蜜、布、酒、铁器、陶器……都有不少，全是可以拿出去交换的。
林楸得一一清点数量，看能拿出去的有多少，再来评估到时候带哪些。
林楸正忙的时候，狼金他们睡了个好觉起来，就往西边去。
狼金双臂攀在红鸟圈的围栏上，看着里面给红鸟喂食的狼溶道：“溶，狮部落要交换红鸟，你帮我抓一抓。”
“多少？”
“七十只。”
狼溶直起身，“他们今年要这么多？”
“我也说多。”
“他们有那么多东西换？不换盐了？”
“换啊。他们带了不少兽皮和草药过来。”
“现在猎物这么少，哪里来这么多……”
“这你就不知道了吧。他们已经把交换小红鸟的生意做到了南边，那些更小的部落从他们那里拿小红鸟。”
小部落物资不丰，交换红鸟一次性只要五只十只，狼部落不会让黑羽兽人单独去送。
走这么一趟耽搁部落里的活儿不说，还换不回多少东西。
路途遥远，小部落哪敢跑这么远，从离他们近的狮部落手里拿确实是个好办法。
“你什么时候走？”
“明天一早。”
“好，我明早给你装好。你们送还是……”
“让羽涯他们送。”
狼溶放下心，这群狼兽人就是莽夫，虽然现在修了路，但他们只顾速度不顾平稳，要是把他的红鸟颠出问题，他就白下那么大功夫孵化红鸟蛋了。
*
今晚狩猎采集队回来得早，吃饭的时间也早。
太阳刚落山，黑羽部落那边的天空还是一片淡淡的橘红，像刚刚成熟的橘子透出来的颜色，浅淡、干净，没有雨季晚霞那般热烈。
兽人们吃过饭后，一部分找自己幼崽玩儿；一部分端着盆，肩膀上搭了帕子，去澡堂洗澡；还有些散在狼山前，说着话，打闹着，你追我赶，嬉闹的声音响彻狼山。
林楸也准备去洗澡。
部落这澡堂子也修了两三年了，兽人以前习惯了随便找个溪沟或者水潭洗澡，洗得也不勤。
等澡堂用管子引了水，那水一拧就开，还是直接从头上淋下来，都不用拎水进去了，兽人们渐渐开始去澡堂里洗。
澡堂北边一个，南边一个。一个澡堂有五十个隔间，隔间面积稍大，能容纳一个成年狼兽人保持兽形在里面洗澡。
澡堂里放了洗毛毛的香粉，香膏，都是林楸带着狼冰和羽乐做出来的。
兽人们活动量大，天天在外面摸爬滚打，到处都是灰尘泥泞，时间久了身上的味儿就重。
再一混入洗得香香的兽人中间，不用林楸说，那些邋遢一点的兽人们就会灰溜溜地去洗澡，这澡堂的利用率也更高了。
没算白建。
林楸去里面洗完澡洗完头出来，顺带也把衣服搓了，晾在自家屋前牵出来的晾衣绳上。
他散着头发，发尾滴着水。
麻布做的帕子不怎么吸水，林楸现在的头发又长又多，能擦到这样已经弄得他手酸。
干脆就这么散着，出去吹一吹，还要干得快些。
走出门，便看见狼岩也回来了。
“王，晚上那事？”
“天黑了就说。”
“大泽那边呢？”
“让小狼们明天回去的时候说一声，要有想去的，可以去就去。”
林楸：“好。我出去走走，顺带看看雀溪。”
狼岩手臂一勾，圈着林楸的腰往回带。
林楸后退几步，后背贴着他前胸，无奈回头。
眼前忽然一暗，林楸唇上被咬了一口。
他还没来得及反应就被放开，狼岩也迈着长腿进了屋。
林楸抿了下泛疼的唇，上面多了一个牙印。
看来现在还提不得雀溪了。
*
雀溪那边，狼冰回来了，又在给他看伤口。
羽乐和狼雪守在他身边，不知听他说着什么，还听得挺认真。
林楸站在门口看了看，这会儿雀溪精神好点了，看见他还笑着打个招呼。
林楸就不打算进去了，看他没事，就往广场上走。
狼生这群小崽子不知道从什么地方钻出来，笑嘻嘻地抱着他的腿。
林楸闻到幼崽身上汗水干了的酸臭味，皱了皱鼻子道：“今天跑哪儿去了，一天没看见你们。”
“我们去墙上了。”
如今城墙修得长，上面还算宽，视野也宽阔，幼崽喜欢在上面跑。
林楸手指抵着臭烘烘的幼崽脑袋，慢慢推远。
“洗澡没？”
“嗷！”幼崽炸毛，“楸，你又嫌弃我们！”
林楸弯唇，揪了一下幼崽气鼓鼓的脸，“你们臭，还不让我嫌弃了？”
“不嫌弃！”
“嫌弃。”
一个个的都六七岁、七八岁了，是大崽子了，还跟小时候似的。
林楸垂眸，又对上狼果家的小崽子狼久。
幼崽一头软发都湿透了。
“阿生，带他们去洗澡。”
“洗完澡楸跟我们玩儿。”
“你们要玩儿什么？”
“踢球！”
“那不又臭了。”
“那……”
“别这啊那的了，赶紧去洗，洗完你们王有事要说，到时候兽人们都到了，只差你们这几个小的。”
“嗷！小的们，走！”狼生振臂一挥，幼崽跟他跑来。
林楸听着这一声称呼，曲指敲了敲狼生脑袋。
“不许乱学。”
小的们这称呼林楸就说了一次，这小崽就记住了。
“嗷嗷嗷嗷嗷嗷！”狼生高呼。
其余幼崽紧随而上，也“嗷呜嗷呜”地应声。
林楸揉了揉耳朵，一脸头疼地往食堂走。
闹的慌。
*
时间一到，狼山的兽人们聚齐了。
食堂里顿时坐满了兽人，还差点塞不下。
雀溪和羊止不在，雀溪现在是不方便，一挪动就头晕，羊止不敢来，这边兽人太多，他胆儿小，何况他也不适合来。
“都到齐了？”狼岩问。
“狼山这边的兽人除了幼崽都到齐了。”
狼生带同伴坐在中间，还有模有样地点一点数量，然后道：“大幼崽到齐了，还有小幼崽……”
“他们太小，暂且不参加了。”旁边狼果捏住幼崽嘴巴道。
“这次商量的是去西部大陆的事。去西部大陆，少说一年才能回来，这次不直接点哪些兽人去，想去的兽人站起来，不想去的坐着。”
话落，狼冰毫不犹豫地站起来。
祭司看见他，气得敲了敲拐杖。
狼冰别开头，倔强地也不看老祭司。
没几个兽人站起来，坐着的也多，还有一些要站也不站好，半蹲着……
林楸无奈，“几个意思？”
狼莫就是那个半蹲着的，他问：“王，为什么不指定？我们可以去，也可以不去。”
兽人们点点头，路远又怎么样，反正他们听王的。王叫他们去他们就去，王不让他们去，他们就不去。
狼岩：“考虑到有些兽人不愿意离开狼山这么久，也给想出去见识见识的兽人一个机会。不管留在狼山还是跟着一起去，都是为狼部落做事，不分好坏。所以，想去的站好。”
兽人们面面相觑。
狼乔抬起手道：“王，我们能自己先商量商量吗？”
“可以。”
话落，整个食堂里全是说话声，嗡嗡嗡的，像几百个蚊子在屋里飞。
兽人们找伴侣、找同伴，凑在一起，叽叽喳喳说个不停。
林楸揉了揉耳朵，对上跟前围坐了一排的幼崽们的视线。
他们个个都变了兽形，都是黑白灰几个颜色，现在还没出窝的小幼崽里才有红狼兽人。
他们看着比两三个月的小狗崽大不少，狼耳尖尖，尾巴像鸡毛掸子落在身后。
幼崽认认真真参会，后腿蹲坐，前腿笔直，大爪子落在身前。
“楸，我们能去吗？”
“不能。”
狼生耳朵耷拉下来，“我们什么时候能出去啊？”
林楸看了眼身侧的狼岩，示意他们问他们自己的王。
“王……”幼崽前爪搭在桌上，露了半个脑袋，一双眼睛湿漉漉的，祈求地看着他们的王。
狼岩不为所动，反倒是说：“还小，墙那边也少去。”
幼崽整个身体软下来，脑袋搭在前腿上趴着，听着周围阿叔们的议论声，眼里满是羡慕。
林楸看在眼里，放在桌下的手指点了点狼岩膝盖，小声道：“大泽他们总可以去？”
幼崽耳朵动动，期待地看来。
狼岩：“留在狼山最安全。”
幼崽脑袋往爪子上一埋，浑身写着不高兴。
嗷嗷嗷嗷嗷！
好气！
chapters.title: 第214章

chapters.translated_text:
"Have you finished discussing?"

As Lang Yan finished speaking, the beastmen sat back down neatly, and then quite a few more stood up one after another.

Lin Qiu took a quick look: the couple Lang Huo and Lang Ying, Lang Qiao, Lang Qing, Lang Jin, Lang Bing, and Lang Rong, along with some members of the hunting and gathering teams, had all stood up.

Not a single beastman from the Black Feather tribe stood up, and the rabbit beastmen remained still as well.

Lang Yan first looked at the number of wolf beastmen; excluding the two hunting team leaders, one future gathering team leader, and the Wolf King, the remaining beastmen, including Lang Jin and the other two, totaled forty-four.

This number was neither too many nor too few, falling exactly within Lang Yan's psychological expectations.

Since they were traveling far and carrying many supplies, they couldn't afford to have too few beastmen.

"Then we'll split into two teams, led by the two captains."

"King! Can we go too?" Lang Jin raised his hand high, revealing his silly, grinning face from among the group of beastmen.

Lang Yan: "Hmm."

They were all adults now, so they naturally couldn't be treated like young wolf cubs anymore. It was the perfect time for them to follow along and see what the outside world was like.

Half of the beastmen from Lang Jin's cub team and Lang Bing's gathering team had stood up, totaling fifteen. This number was also acceptable; any more, and he feared they would lack experience if the team encountered danger, becoming a liability instead.

"Shan, Kui, your two tribes should also select a team of beastmen to follow."

The Black Feather beastmen didn't stand up because they weren't sure if the wolf beastmen actually wanted them to come along.

Once Yu Shan heard this, he was naturally willing and appointed Yu Lie to lead the team.

"Uncle A-Shan, we want to go too," said Yu Ya and the others.

"Go ahead. You aren't cubs anymore; you should go out and see the world. Don't run around, don't cause trouble, and stick close to your Uncle Yu Lie."

"We promise!" Yu Ya grinned, showing all his teeth, and hooked arms with Lang Jin and the others, laughing foolishly together.

Yu Lie: "Yan, how many Black Feather beastmen do you need?"

Lang Yan: "About ten or so."

Yu Ya and his group already accounted for six, so Yu Lie picked six more sturdy and capable Black Feather beastmen, and that was about enough.

"Qiu, what are we going for?" asked Tu Kui.

They had to travel so far; they couldn't outrun the Black Feather or wolf beastmen, nor could they carry heavy loads. What if they held everyone back?

Lin Qiu: "In case we encounter plants you recognize, and we miss them..."

"That won't do! But we can't send a whole team of beastmen for that, so should Tu Ai go instead?"

Tu Ai stood up without hesitation.

To him, going out was no different from staying in the tribe. With Black Feather and wolf beastmen by his side, he wasn't worried about encountering danger.

Lin Qiu: "Just Tu Ai? Are there any others who want to go?"

The rabbit beastmen looked at their patriarch.

Tu Kui said: "If you want to go, then go."

The rabbit beastmen were a bit more timid, unlike Tu Ai who had already been out once and had experience. After Tu Kui spoke, only two more rabbit beastmen slowly stood up.

One was Tu Lin, the other Tu Cao; both had previously been part of the gathering team.

"Qiu, is three okay?"

Lin Qiu nodded.

Counting the previous ones, Lin Qiu said to Lang Yan: "Sixty-four in total, is that okay?"

"Sixty-six."

"Hmm?"

"Including the two of us."

Lin Qiu's eyes curved, "Alright, then sixty-six in total. If anyone from Daze wants to go, we can add them." The journey was long; as long as the number of beastmen was under a hundred, it was fine.

Lang Yan looked at Lang Bing, "Have you discussed it with the priest?"

Lang Bing: "He agreed."

Lin Qiu looked at the old priest; he was currently furious, not even looking at Lang Bing, grinding his teeth. It was unclear how they had reached an agreement.

The number of beastmen going to the Western Continent this time was double those who had gone to the southern part of the Eastern Continent. Excluding those from Daze who might want to join, there were over sixty beastmen, which made the issue of food and drink on the road even more significant.

Next, the beastmen discussed what items to take for trade.

When it came to trading, the first thing the beastmen mentioned was salt.

Lang Mo had too much on his hands and didn't plan to go. Hearing the beastmen mention salt, he said: "That place isn't by the sea, why bring salt?"

Lang Guo: "It's not like we'll arrive directly at the Western Continent. Won't we trade if we encounter other beastmen tribes on the way?"

Lang Mo's face turned red. He slapped Lang Xi, who was beside him, and said fiercely: "We won't trade? No brains!"

Lang Xi: "That was your own..."

Lang Mo covered his mouth with his hand.

"We must bring plenty of salt," said Lang Chi.

This item was a hard currency on the Beast God Continent. No matter when or where, as long as they encountered a tribe, they would be willing to trade for it.

Even when the great market still existed, one had to arrive early to trade for good salt, using plenty of dried meat.

"Then let's just take all the salt we've produced this time," said Lang Shuang, who was in charge of salt production.

"How much is there?" Lin Qiu and Lang Yan asked simultaneously.

Lang Shuang: "We haven't finished boiling it all, but there are about forty bags in the cave."

"That's a bit low," said Lang Wan. "With so many beastmen eating salt on the road for such a long time, the consumption will be significant."

"Another forty bags or so should be enough," added Lang Xing.

The beastmen nodded one after another.

"Bringing more is never wrong; salt can be traded anywhere."

"I'll take some beastmen to dig for more tomorrow," Lang Yan said.

Eighty animal-skin bags of salt was quite a lot. Wolf beastmen were strong; one beastman could carry four bags and still manage other items.

The old priest said: "There isn't much medicinal powder or ointment left. The tribes we meet on the road will have their own essentials, and there aren't many extra packs to trade. We can only take our herbs to trade for herbs from other tribes."

Lin Qiu nodded; they certainly had plenty of their own herbs, but they lacked medicinal materials from other regions.

Trading herbs for herbs was more convenient than trading with other supplies.

"How much can we take out?" Lang Yan asked.

Lang Bing said: "Fifty animal-skin bags is no problem."

The priest's old cave was almost filled with herbs, all accumulated over the past few years. Some were collected by Lang Bing and his team, and others were harvested from their own planting.

The herbs were all processed and ready for use, and a bag was much lighter than salt, so the beastmen could carry them without much effort.

"That works," Lang Yan said.

"What about pottery?" a beastman sitting in the back shouted.

"That's heavy and breaks easily, let's take less," said Lang Mo.

"What about alcohol?" another beastman nearby shouted.

"No, absolutely not!"

The beastman who had just shouted was tackled and restrained by others, unable to make a sound.

Lang Guo listened to the unanimous opposition from all the beastmen and smiled, looking at Lin Qiu with a smug expression.

Lin Qiu said deliberately: "Our tribe has already filled at least three caves with alcohol, right?"

"No! Qiu, alcohol is heavy and breaks easily!"

"Yes, yes, and it smells strong, which easily attracts bad beastmen."

"We don't have enough to drink ourselves!"

This last sentence was the real reason.

Lin Qiu looked at Lang Yan, "Should we take it?"

Lang Yan: "No. An, tell the beastmen to drink less."

"King! We already drink very little!" Otherwise, why would there be so much saved up!

Lang Yan: "It's best not to drink at all."

The beastmen immediately shouted at the top of their lungs: "Next, what else should we think of?"

"What about candles and matches?"

"Take a little of those, just enough for our own use. Beastmen outside are barely getting enough to eat; they won't be willing to trade for these."

"Well said, just bring a few more matches."

"Right, let's do that!"

"What about animal skins? And cloth. Our tribe has enough skins now, and the extra ones are just sitting there. Cloth is breathable; the beastmen in the south should like it more."

Their trip was heading south, where it was hotter than Wolf Mountain, so this cloth would definitely be easy to trade.

Lin Qiu: "I checked, we have over fifty large animal skins and about two hundred small ones. There are about twenty rolls of cloth."

"Forget the cloth, keep it for our own use," Lang Yan said.

Beastmen's clothes wear out quickly; this amount of cloth wouldn't be enough.

"As for the skins, keep the large ones and take half of the small ones," Lang Yan said.

"King, aren't we taking them all?"

"We'll be out for a long time, and we need to save space for our own things. Changes of clothes, rain gear, and animal-skin blankets."

The animal-skin blankets the beastmen used for sleeping were usually one large skin or several small ones stitched together, large enough to wrap them from head to toe.

Since the journey was long, they couldn't just bring a few skin skirts and some rain gear like they did when going to the southern part of the Eastern Continent; they had to be prepared for long-term camping.

In the back, the beastmen listed everything the tribe had, from sickles and hoes to large iron pots.

They discussed until the moon reached the treetops and finally reached a conclusion.

"Mainly salt and herbs; we'll take some of the miscellaneous items like pottery, skins, matches, and fishing nets. The beastmen must prepare their own things: ten bags each of dried vegetables, dried meat, dried fish, and tail-grass seeds."

The tribe's dry rations were consumed and replenished simultaneously, so they could just take them directly from the cave.

The journey was long, and this certainly wouldn't be enough. But Lang Yan's plan was for these to be for emergencies; they would try to find food themselves as much as possible and only use these if absolutely necessary.

Otherwise, if they relied entirely on foraging, they would starve to death.

With over sixty beastmen, the items for trade plus their rations were about all they could carry; any more and they wouldn't be able to bear the weight.

After the discussion, the beastmen left the canteen one after another.

The beastmen going on the trip were jumping and excited. The cubs were dejected, sighing with every step, which left the adult beastmen feeling both amused and helpless.

Some beastmen felt the meeting hadn't been enough and kept talking: "I think our pickled vegetables and sauces are great. They have salt, so we could trade for a lot of things. They definitely haven't seen these before."

"Iron knives are even better..."

"That's impossible! We don't even have enough for ourselves."

*

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan were the last to leave. They slowly exited the canteen, closed the door, and returned to their small cabin.

The cabin had two rooms; beastmen didn't have the concept of a living room, so one room was for sleeping and the other for storage.

Sometimes when the beastmen missed their cubs, they would bring them back to sleep in the other room.

Beastmen had sensitive noses, and they couldn't eliminate the smell of the toilets, so they were built further away, near the planting area.

The cabin door was made of wood and couldn't be locked from the outside; they would have to wait until Lang Mo and the others made a lock.

Pushing the door open, Lin Qiu lit a candle.

The room wasn't large, and the heated brick bed took up half the space.

At this time, the bed wasn't being heated. Now, it was covered with straw mats woven from tail-grass stalks, with a layer of animal skins on top, making it neither too hard nor too soft—quite comfortable.

The beastmen treated the house as a place to sleep and rest; they were active outside during the day and liked to gather with their companions in their free time, rarely staying cooped up indoors.

In the small houses scattered across Wolf Mountain, one light after another flickered on. The faint, dim, and soft light connected into a patch, making the quiet night seem a bit more lively.

"I'm going to the west tomorrow."

"I'm going too."

Lang Yan pulled Lin Qiu into his arms, buried his face in his hair, and gave a low response.

*

Early the next morning, after eating, Lang Yan prepared to lead the team to dig for salt, with Lin Qiu accompanying him.

Before the team had even gathered, Lang Jin and the others were already impatiently taking out the red birds they were to bring to Daze.

The red birds were kept in specially woven large cages. The cages were flatter than the rattan baskets the beastmen usually used, with a wider base; one cage could hold thirty to fifty small red birds.

Lang Rong and his companions had caught a total of one hundred small red birds.

Since Shi Ye wouldn't need them all, the extras would be kept at Daze, and more beastmen would likely come to trade for them later.

Yu Ya was urged by Lang Jin to finish his meal and send him the red birds.

"This trip will take at least three days to return, Qiu! Don't leave without us!" Yu Ya shouted to Lin Qiu, who was waiting to depart on the other side.

Lin Qiu: "Don't worry, Que Xi hasn't recovered yet, there's no rush."

Yu Ya nodded, and without a moment's hesitation, he and his companions grabbed the cages and flew into the sky.

Lang Jin arranged for his companions to pull the carts reloaded with supplies and shouted at Yang Zhi, who was still standing in the corner of the square.

"Zhi! Let's go!"

Yang Zhi trembled, lowered his head, and walked with slow, heavy steps, as if his feet were stuck in mud.

Lang Jin, who was waiting for him, crossed his arms and sat on the edge of the cart.

The cart swayed, and the companions pulling it looked at Yu Ya, who was already flying far away in the sky, feeling restless.

"Hurry up, hurry up!"

Lang Jin grabbed the fur on his companion's back and said: "Don't be in such a rush."

"I'm in a hurry to get back so I can leave with Qiu and the others, you tell me if I should be in a hurry?"

Lang Jin glanced at the slow-moving beastman behind him and gave a light scoff.

"Hurry, indeed."

"Why wouldn't I be?"

But some beastmen just didn't want to leave.

No matter how much he dragged his feet, Yang Zhi still had to go.

Lang Jin led the team out, the cart wheels rolling as they headed south.

Lin Qiu watched Yang Zhi's figure disappear into the forest, then looked back at the square; he didn't see Que Xi.

He hadn't come to see Yang Zhi off; it seemed the bond was truly exhausted.

After this parting, they would likely never see each other again.

"Qiu, let's go."

Lin Qiu hooked his hand into the one Lang Yan extended and said: "Let's go."

Lang Yan didn't bring many beastmen, just Lang Mo and a few others.

Over the past two years, the road to the west had been paved, and the beastmen pulled the carts forward, the wind blowing through their black or gray wolf fur, looking majestic. Their massive wolf forms would suddenly dart out from the forest; any timid creature that encountered them would be scared senseless.

Lin Qiu ran alongside Lang Yan. After running half the distance, he suddenly heard a faint sound ahead.

Lin Qiu looked at Lang Yan: "There are beastmen."

"Who?"

Testing him?

The wolf ears on top of Lin Qiu's head twitched as he listened carefully. After a while, the beastmen ran up, and Lin Qiu said: "Lang Ye."

Lang Yan gave a muffled laugh.

Lin Qiu bumped his head against him, "Who could guess that?"

"It's not about guessing, it's about observation."

"I can't do it." He didn't have such keen insight yet. Being able to tell that beastmen were coming and how many there were was already quite impressive.

"King!" Lang Ye stopped and stood opposite them, "The beastmen from that tribe in the west want to see you."

Lang Ye had come back specifically to find Lang Yan, never expecting to run into them on the road.

Lang Yan: "You made contact?"

"They tried to enter the tribe yesterday, but we blocked them."

"Let's go."

Yu Shan had tolerated this group of beastmen remaining at the Black Feather tribe only because they were so destitute that he felt pity for them.

They had come fleeing for their lives, sallow and thin, like stick insects without flesh, their limbs so thin that only a layer of skin was visible.

The beastmen had camped at the foot of the Black Feather tribe's mountain last night and planned to continue forward into the Wolf tribe early this morning.

However, they had been stopped outside by Lang Ye.

The beastmen were staying in an open area in the forest. After stopping, they had gone to find food nearby. But they were too weak, so naturally, they hadn't found any prey and weren't full, their eyes still glowing with hunger.

When Lang Yan and Lin Qiu found them, the beastmen, who were lying or sitting, took a moment to look up.

"This is our King," Lang Ye said.

Upon hearing this, the beastmen acted as if they were stunned, remaining blank and motionless.

Lang Yan: "Do you have business with me?"

"Wolf King, you... are you really the Wolf King?"

Among the group of beastmen, one finally reacted.

It was a middle-aged cat beastman. He stood up, his legs weak like willow branches swaying in the wind, his form unsteady as if a strong gust could knock him to the ground.

The beastman's face was full of weariness, his skin wrinkled and etched by the hardships of life.

He seemed almost delirious, crying and laughing at Lang Yan.

Lang Yan: "Yes, speak."

Lin Qiu looked out; beastmen who looked like refugees were sitting everywhere on the ground.

They had reached this place on their last breath, and now that their mental support was gone, they were like creatures whose spines had been removed, all collapsing into a heap.

The middle-aged beastman wasn't intimidated by Lang Yan's cold attitude; his hands trembled, desperate to be taken in, too consumed by his plight to feel fear.

"We are... we are refugees from the Central Continent, we want to join the Wolf tribe."

Lang Yan: "The Wolf tribe does not need more beastmen right now."

The middle-aged beastman froze, his expression of mixed tears and laughter stiffening on his face.

"I... we can do anything for you, anything!"

Lang Yan remained unmoved.

"We don't need it."

The beastmen sitting on the ground looked over slowly, their eyes numb and hollow.

They hadn't expected at all that after struggling so hard to find this place, the Wolf tribe would have no intention of taking them in.

Those... those beastmen who told them to go to the Wolf tribe, those who said the Eastern Continent was a place to find a way to live... were they lying to them!

In a few breaths, the middle-aged beastman's expression shifted, and finally, unable to hold on any longer, he collapsed heavily to the ground.

Lang Yan: "This is the territory of the Black Feather tribe; you had better leave quickly."

"Leave..."

"Leave... where else can we go!"

The sound of the beastmen sobbing came, their cries weak and powerless.

Lang Yan: "You can find a place without a tribe to settle down."

This entire tribe of beastmen lay limp on the ground, like puppets without souls.

Lin Qiu had seen this scene several times; the previous beastmen who came from the Central Continent were much the same.

"Lang Ye."

"Yeah!"

"Watch them leave..." he said, then added, "Give them a fishing net."

"Awoo." Lang Ye looked at the beastmen who were too weak to stand and sighed, "Get up, hurry and go."

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan walked up the small hill where the salt-digging cave was located and stopped to look back. The dense forest was silent, and the beastmen didn't move.

Lin Qiu: "Who exactly leaked the location of our tribe?"

"I don't know," Lang Yan sighed, holding Lin Qiu's hand and squeezing it, "But judging by the current situation, more and more tribes will come in the future."

"That's not good news."

The Wolf tribe wasn't entirely stable right now, and Lin Qiu and Lang Yan were planning to leave. Their tribe had so many good things; if the tribes gathering outside coveted them and conspired to raid their tribe, it would be a thorny issue.

"Let the beastmen keep an eye on them for now; we'll know whether they're good or bad eventually."

The middle-aged beastman was named Mao Shu, of the Fishing Cat clan.

They weren't afraid of water like other cat clans. Because they were good at water and could catch prey in it, their lives had been quite good in the past.

But the trouble started when they listened to the High Priest and eagerly sent their tribe's prey to the Wilderness tribe. Year after year, no matter how good they were at catching fish, the lake their tribe relied on was almost fished out.

Mao Shu had been the patriarch of the Fishing Cat tribe, and for the sake of his people, he decided to migrate.

But on the road, they were met with retaliation from the Wilderness tribe.

Those beastmen came aggressively, and one swipe of their claws could kill them.

Even though they were just moving to find another place to survive, the beastmen of the Wilderness tribe claimed they were insincere in their offerings to the Beast God and, without letting them explain, began to harvest the lives of his people.

Mao Shu escaped death with the few remaining tribesmen, hiding along the way, and encountered other beastmen fleeing north from the south, also because they were being hunted by the Wilderness tribe.

They said that some beastmen told them to go to the Eastern Continent to find the Wolf tribe; the Wolf tribe could help them live.

This wasn't nonsense; it was the result of a divination by a priest in the south.

Mao Shu had no choice; the beastmen from the Wilderness tribe behind them hadn't given up and wanted to exterminate them, so he could only lead the remaining tribesmen to follow them.

On this road, they encountered other beastmen who had also escaped from the Wilderness tribe. Among these beastmen, there were even some he had seen when he was offering to the Beast God at the Wilderness tribe.

"Wooo..."

In front, the beastmen walked with heavy steps, crying as they walked. The crying was suppressed and powerless.

Mao Shu listened, his hands weak as he wiped his eyes.

They had suffered so much on this journey, escaping several pursuits; the number of beastmen accompanying them decreased and then increased, and they didn't dare to stop.

Everyone was thinking that once they reached the Eastern Continent and found the Wolf tribe, they would have some food to eat.

But upon arriving, they found that everything was different from what they had imagined.

Completely different.

The Wolf King was cold, and the wolf beastmen wouldn't allow them to step into the Wolf tribe.

The situation in the Eastern Continent was the same as in the Central Continent—no prey, no food...

The crying spread from one to another, and the beastmen felt so exhausted that they had no strength left; one trip, and they let themselves faint.

"Tsk." Lang Ye casually picked up a fainted young beastman and threatened the other listless beastmen, "If you dawdle again, be careful, or I'll throw you into the forest to feed the wild beasts."

Mao Shu stumbled, head hanging, supporting his crumbling companions as they continued to walk south.

They didn't know where the wolf beastmen were driving them to, nor did they know if they could survive.

Perhaps that beastman had lied to them.

Tricked them into coming to be slaves for the Wolf tribe.

At this moment, they only felt tired—so tired they couldn't lift their feet, unable to even feel if they were hungry.

The world in front of them was dizzying under the sun, and more and more beastmen fell.

The wolf beastmen sighed and skillfully picked them up one by one.

That Wilderness tribe really deserved to die!

Even if they wanted offerings, they should have considered whether the tribes giving them could support themselves. At the very least, they should have asked for offerings once every other year to let them catch their breath, instead of forcing them to flee everywhere!

And to hunt them down—they were truly full of themselves; they would be better off using that energy to catch more prey.

Lang Ye drove the beastmen out of the Black Feather tribe and headed south, stopping at the nearest river.

He grabbed the beastman who could still manage things and brought him to the riverside. Seeing the beastman looking half-dead, he said irritably: "Watch."

He tossed a fishing net, pulled it in, and threw it in front of the beastman.

"Fishing net, use it like this. Borrowing it to you, return it later."

*Slap*—

Mao Shu was slapped in the face by a flopping fish.

He was stunned, staring fixedly at the flopping fish in front of him.

Lang Ye thought he had really lost his mind and was about to slap him, but unexpectedly, he suddenly lunged forward, grabbed a fish, and shoved it directly into his mouth.

Seeing this, the other beastmen crawled over using their hands and feet, as if using their last bit of strength, pouncing on the fish.

They grabbed and tore at them, eating them raw, their faces covered in blood.

Lang Ye watched, his lips pressed thin, not knowing what to feel.

He had seen this situation many times; every tribe of beastmen lured here by some unlucky beastman had to go through this.

Hopefully, they could recover their vitality soon, just like the other tribes.

There was nothing more they could do to help.
