“商量好了没有？”
狼岩话落，兽人们干脆利落地坐回身，又陆陆续续站起来不少兽人。
林楸打眼一扫，狼火、狼影夫夫俩，狼乔、狼清、狼金、狼冰和狼溶，还有狩猎采集队的一部分队员们都站起来了。
黑羽兽人这边没一个兽人站起来，兔兽人同样没动静。
狼岩先看了眼狼兽人的数量，刨除两个狩猎队队长，一个未来的采集队队长，一个狼王，余下的兽人算上狼金他们三个一块儿，一共有四十四个。
这个数目不多不少，正好在狼岩心理预期范围内。
这次走得远，带的东西多，兽人少了不行。
“那就分两队，两个队长带队。”
“王！我们也能去吗？”狼金高高举起手，从兽人堆里露出他那张笑得傻兮兮的脸。
狼岩：“嗯。”
都成年了，自然不能还当没成年的小狼看待。他们也正适合跟着出去，多看看外面是什么样的。
狼金的小狼队和狼冰的采集队都站起来半数的兽人，拢共十五个。这个数量也可以，多了怕队伍遇险时他们没多少经验，反倒危险。
“山、葵，你们两个部落也选一队兽人跟着。”
黑羽兽人们没站起来，就是拿不定狼兽人到底要不要他们跟着去。
羽山一听，自然乐意，便点了羽猎带队。
“阿山叔，我们也想去。”羽涯几个道。
“去吧。都不是幼崽了，该出去看看。别乱跑，也别捣乱，跟紧你们羽猎叔。”
“保证做到！”羽涯高兴得呲着个大牙，跟狼金他们勾肩搭背，一起傻乐呵。
羽猎：“岩，要几个黑羽兽人？”
狼岩：“十来个。”
光是羽涯他们就六个了，羽猎又挑了六个健壮能打的黑羽兽人，便差不多了。
“楸，我们去干什么？”兔葵问。
要走这么远，他们既跑不过黑羽兽人和狼兽人，又背不了重物，拖了后腿怎么办。
林楸：“万一遇到了你们认识的植物，我们错过了……”
“那可不行！但这也去不了一队兽人，要不然还是兔艾去？”
兔艾站起来，没有迟疑。
对他来说，出去跟留在部落没什么两样。身边跟着黑羽兽人和狼兽人，遇到危险他也不担心。
林楸：“就兔艾一个吗？有没有其他想跟着出去的？”
兔兽人们看向自家族长。
兔葵道：“想去就去。”
兔兽人们胆子小些，不像兔艾已经出去走过一趟，有经验。兔葵说完，慢慢只又站起来两个兔兽人。
一个兔林，一个兔草，两个兽人都是之前跟着采集队的。
“楸，三个行吗？”
林楸颔首。
算上先前那些，林楸跟狼岩道：“一共六十四个，可以吗？”
“六十六。”
“嗯？”
“加上我们两个。”
林楸弯眼，“行，那就一共六十六个。大泽那边有想去的，再加。”这一趟路途遥远，只要兽人数量低于一百都差不多。
狼岩看了眼狼冰，“跟祭司商量好了？”
狼冰：“他同意了。”
林楸看向老祭司，他正气着呢，看也不看狼冰，咬牙切齿的，也不知道他们怎么商量的。
这次去的西部大陆的兽人比之前去东部大陆南部的兽人多了一倍，不算大泽那边想去的就有六十多个兽人，路上要考虑的吃喝问题就更大了。
紧接着，兽人们商量要带去交换的东西。
说到交换，兽人们头一个提起盐。
狼莫手上事儿多，没打算去，他听到兽人说盐，道：“那边不是靠海，带什么盐？”
狼果：“我们又不是直接就到了西部大陆，路上遇到兽人部落就不交换了？”
狼莫脸一红，一爪子拍在身边狼西身上，凶巴巴道：“就不交换了吗？没脑子！”
狼西：“这话是你自己唔……”
狼莫手动捂嘴。
“盐要多带。”狼赤道。
这东西在兽神大陆上是硬通货，无论什么时候，在什么地方，只要遇到了部落，他们都愿意交换的。
就算以前大集市还在，交换好盐也得提前到，用多多的肉干换。
“那干脆这次制的盐一起带走算了。”负责这次制盐的狼霜道。
“有多少？”林楸和狼岩同时问。
狼霜：“还没煮完，但山洞里差不多有四十袋了。”
“少了点。”狼晚道，“你们一路上这么多兽人要吃盐，来回这么久，消耗的盐不少。”
“再多个四十袋差不多。”狼星也道。
兽人们都纷纷点头。
“多带点准没错，盐去哪里都可以交换。”
“明天我带兽人再去挖点。”狼岩道。
八十个兽皮袋的盐不少，狼兽人力气大，一个兽人能背四袋，还能带不少东西。
老祭司道：“药粉药膏不多，你们路上必备的部落有，多的能拿出去交换的没几包。只能把我们这边的草药带出去交换其他部落的草药。”
林楸点头，自家存的草药确实多，少的都是其他产地的药材。
用草药换草药，比用物资交换方便些。
“能拿多少出来？”狼岩问。
狼冰道：“五十个兽皮袋没问题。”
祭司以前那山洞几乎被草药堆满了，这些草药都是这几年积攒下来的。有狼冰带着兽人采集回来的，也有他们种植后收获的。
草药都是处理过的，直接能用，一袋又比盐轻许多，兽人们背着不费什么力气。
“可以。”狼岩道。
“陶器呢？”后头坐着的兽人吼了一嗓子。
“这个重，也容易碎，少带些吧。”狼莫道。
“酒呢？”跟着，边上又有兽人吼了一嗓子。
“不带不带！”
刚刚吼那一嗓子的兽人被其他兽人压着收拾，唔唔叫不出声。
狼果听着全部兽人反对的声音，笑眯眯的，得意地看着林楸。
林楸故意道：“咱们部落的酒已经放了不下三个山洞了吧？”
“不行！楸，酒重，也容易碎！”
“对对对，味道还大，容易吸引坏兽人。”
“我们不够喝！”
最后这句话才是真的。
林楸看向狼岩，“带不？”
狼岩：“不带。安平时少让兽人们喝。”
“王！我们已经很少喝了！”不然那些酒为什么能攒这么多！
狼岩：“最好不喝。”
兽人立即扯着嗓子道：“下一个，想想还有什么？”
“蜡烛、火柴呢？”
“这个少带点吧，我们自己能用就行。外面兽人们吃饱都难，也不乐意拿东西换这些。”
“说得不错，多带点火柴就是了。”
“对，就这样！”
“那兽皮呢？还有布。咱们部落现在兽皮够用，多的放着也是放着。布透气，南边的兽人应该更喜欢。”
他们这一趟就是往南边走，那边比狼山热些，这布肯定好交换。
林楸：“我看了，部落大兽皮有五十多张，小兽皮两百来张。布有个二十卷。”
“布算了，留着自己用。”狼岩道。
兽人们的衣服坏得快，这点布也不够用。
“兽皮的话，大兽皮留下，小兽皮带一半。”狼岩道。
“王，不带完啊？”
“出去得久，还要留一点位置带自己的东西。换洗的衣服、雨具、兽皮毯。”
兽人们睡觉用的兽皮毯一般都是一张大兽皮，要不然就是几张小兽皮拼接成的大兽皮，那兽皮毯能把他们从头裹到脚。
路途遥远，就不能像去东部大陆南边那样，只带几条兽皮裙和一点雨具就行了，他们得做好长期露宿的准备。
后头，兽人们又把部落有的东西全部点出来，什么镰刀、锄头、大铁锅都来了。
商量到月上梢头，总算有了个结果。
“主要就是盐、草药，陶器、兽皮、火柴、渔网这些杂七杂八的东西都带一些。兽人们自己的东西都要准备好，菜干、肉干、鱼干还有尾巴草籽都准备各自十袋。”
部落这些干粮都一边消耗一边补充，直接从山洞里取就行了。
路途远，这些肯定是不够的。但狼岩打算的是，这些拿来应急，他们尽量能自己找食物就自己找食物，实在没有才动这些。
不然全靠外面找食，他们得饿死。
兽人六十几个，带去交换的东西加上兽人们的干粮就差不多了，再多的就背不动了。
商量完，兽人们陆陆续续出了食堂。
要出去的兽人蹦蹦跳跳，兴奋不已。幼崽垂头丧气，走一步叹一声，惹得成年兽人们哭笑不得。
还有兽人觉得这会开得意犹未尽，还在继续说：“我就觉得我们的腌菜酱菜做得好，又有盐，能换不少东西回来。他们肯定没见过这个。”
“铁刀才好……”
“那不可能！这东西我们自己都不够用。”
*
林楸和狼岩落在最后，他们慢慢离开食堂，带上门，回自己小屋。
小屋两间房，兽人们没有客厅的概念，便是一间房睡觉，一间房放杂物。
有时候兽人惦记幼崽了，就把幼崽接回来睡另一间。
兽人们鼻子灵，厕所还做不到没臭味，便建得远些，挨着地种植那边。
小屋门是木头做的，外面也关不了，只能等狼莫他们把锁做出来才成。
推门进屋，林楸把蜡烛点上。
屋子不大，火炕就占了一半位置。
这个时候火炕早没烧了，现在炕上铺着尾巴草秆编的草垫子，再上面一层放的兽皮，睡上去不硬不软，还算舒服。
兽人们把屋子就当个睡觉和休息的地方，平日里多在外面活动，空闲时候也喜欢和同伴扎堆，少有窝在屋里的时候。
遍布狼山的小房子里，一盏一盏灯亮起。光线微弱，昏黄又柔和地串成一片，让这静谧的夜色都热闹了些。
“明天我去一趟西边。”
“我也去。”
狼岩把林楸往怀里搂了搂，脸埋在他头发上，低低地应了一声。
*
第二天一早，吃过饭后，狼岩准备带着队伍去挖盐，林楸同行。
这边队伍还没聚齐，狼金他们已经迫不及待地把要带去大泽的红鸟拿出来。
红鸟装在专门编的大笼子里，笼子比兽人们寻常用的藤筐扁一些，底部编得更宽，一个笼子能放三五十只小红鸟。
狼溶带着同伴一共抓了一百只小红鸟。
狮也那边要不完，多的就放在大泽那边养着，后续应该还会有兽人过来交换。
羽涯被狼金催促着吃完饭，给他送红鸟。
“这一趟快也要三天才回得来，楸！你们别先走了啊！”羽涯冲着对面等着出发的林楸喊道。
林楸：“放心，雀溪还没好，不着急。”
羽涯点点头，没半点犹豫，和同伴抓着笼子就飞到天上去。
狼金则安排同伴拉上重新装了物资的板车，冲着那个还站在广场角落的羊止吆喝一声。
“止！走了！”
羊止被吓得一颤，低下头，脚像陷入泥沼，一步步走得又缓又重。
等着他的狼金双手抱臂，坐在板车边缘。
板车一晃一晃的，拉着车的同伴看着天上已经飞远了的羽涯蠢蠢欲动。
“快点、快点啊！”
狼金一把薅住同伴背上的毛，道：“你别着急。”
“我还急着回来，到时候跟楸他们一起走，你说你急不急？”
狼金余光瞥着后头慢吞吞的兽人，轻嗤一笑。
“急啊。”
“怎么不急。”
可就是某些兽人不想走啊。
再怎么磨蹭，羊止还是得走。
狼金带着队伍出发，车轮滚滚，一直往南。
林楸看着羊止的身影消失在林间，又看看广场这边，没见到雀溪的身影。
他没来送羊止，看来是真耗尽了情分。
这一别，以后怕是再也见不到了。
“楸，走了。”
林楸勾住狼岩伸过来的手，道：“走吧。”
狼岩带的兽人不多，就狼莫几个。
这两年西边的路也修好了，兽人们拉着板车只管往前跑，风吹动黑色或灰色的狼毛，威风凛凛。巨大的狼身一下从林间蹿出去，但凡胆小的遇见了就得吓晕过去。
林楸与狼岩并行，一口气跑了半程路，忽听到前面传来的细微动静。
林楸看了眼狼岩，“有兽人。”
“谁？”
考他？
林楸头顶的狼耳动了动，细细辨认，半晌，兽人跑到了跟前，林楸道：“狼夜。”
狼岩闷声一笑。
林楸一脑袋给他撞去，“这谁猜的出来？”
“不是靠猜，靠观察。”
“我不行。”他还没有这么敏锐的洞察力。能知道前面有兽人过来，有几个兽人，就已经非常了不起了。
“王！”狼夜停下，站在对面，“西边那个部落的兽人想见你。”
狼夜这一趟就是单独回来找狼岩的，哪曾想会在路上碰到。
狼岩：“联系上了？”
“他们昨天试图进入部落，被我们挡住了。”
“走吧。”
羽山能容忍这群兽人还留在黑羽部落，就是因为他们太过落魄，心生怜悯。
他们是逃命过来的，面黄肌瘦，像没有肉的竹节虫似的，手脚细长得只能看见一层皮。
兽人们昨晚在黑羽部落山脚下落脚，今日一早，便打算继续前行，进入狼部落。
不过他们被狼夜拦在了外面。
兽人们在林间一处开阔地停留，停下之后，自己去附近找了食物。不过他们太弱，自然没找到什么猎物，也没吃饱，此时依旧眼冒绿光。
狼岩和林楸找到他们时，或躺或坐的兽人们慢了一息才抬头看来。
“这是我们王。”狼夜道。
兽人们听罢，却像傻了一样，依旧呆呆的，一动不动。
狼岩：“你们找我有事？”
“狼王，你、你真是狼王？”
兽人堆里，总算有一个反应过来。
是个中年猫族兽人，他站起来，腿上虚软，像被风吹着的柳条，身形摇晃，仿佛风一大就能一头栽在地上。
兽人满脸沧桑，皮肤皱巴巴的，满是风霜凿刻过的模样。
他仿若疯癫，对着狼岩又哭又笑。
狼岩：“是，说事。”
林楸放眼望去，地上四处坐着看起来像难民一样的兽人。
他们撑着最后一气到达了这里，精神支柱消失，此刻如同被抽走了脊骨，全部瘫成一片。
中年兽人没被狼岩冷漠的态度吓到，他颤抖着手，一心渴求着被收留，哪里顾得上害怕。
“我们是、是从中央大陆逃难来的，想要归属狼部落。”
狼岩：“狼部落现在不需要兽人加入。”
中年兽人一愣，似哭似笑的表情僵在脸上。
“我、我们可以给你们做任何事，任何事！”
狼岩不为所动。
“我们不需要。”
坐在地上的兽人们缓缓看来，眼神麻木又空洞。
他们半分没有预料到，辛辛苦苦找过来，狼部落居然没有收留他们的打算。
那、那些告诉他们往狼部落走的兽人，那些说东部大陆可以寻求活路的兽人……他们难不成是在骗他们！
几个呼吸间，中年兽人神色变幻，最后彻底撑不住，重重摔坐在地上。
狼岩：“这边是黑羽部落的领地，你们最好赶紧离开。”
“离开……”
“离开……我们又能去哪里！”
兽人低泣声传来，连哭声都是那么无力。
狼岩：“你们可以自己找没有部落的地方定居。”
这一整个部落的兽人瘫软在地，像木偶一样没了魂。
这样的景象林楸也见了好几次了，先前那些个从中央大陆来的兽人都跟他们大差不差。
“狼夜。”
“诶！”
“看着他们离开……”说着，又道，“给他们一张渔网。”
“嗷。”狼夜看着腿软得站不起来的兽人，叹了一声，“起来，赶紧走吧。”
林楸跟狼岩走上挖盐的那个山洞所在的小山包，停下来往回看。密林丛丛，兽人们没有动静。
林楸：“到底是谁把我们部落的位置泄露出去的？”
“不知道。”狼岩叹息，握住林楸的手捏了捏，“但以目前的情况来看，以后过来的部落会越来越多。”
“这不是一个好消息。”
狼部落现在这边也不安稳，林楸和狼岩又打算出去，他们部落那么多好东西，要是外面聚集的这些部落觊觎，联合起来偷袭他们部落，也是个棘手的事。
“先让兽人盯着吧，是好是坏总能知道的。”
中年兽人名唤猫数，渔猫一族。
他们不像其他猫族那样怕水。也因为会水，能抓水里的猎物，所以以前的日子过得还不错。
可坏就坏在他们当初听信了大祭司的话，眼巴巴地把自家部落的猎物送到原野部落去，这样一年又一年，他们再是能抓鱼，部落那湖也快被他们捞尽了。
猫数本就是渔猫部落的族长，为了族人，他决定迁徙。
可就在迁徙的路上，他们遭到了原野部落的报复。
那些兽人来势汹汹，一爪子就能把他们拍死。
明明他们只是换个地方生存，原野部落的兽人却说他们供奉兽神不诚心，不由他们解释，便直接开始收割他族人的性命。
猫数带着所剩不多的族人死里逃生，一路躲藏着，又遇到了从南边同样因被原野部落的兽人抓捕而北逃的兽人。
他们说，有兽人告诉他们，往东部大陆找狼部落去，狼部落能让他们活。
这不是胡说，这是南边一个祭司占卜的结果。
猫数别无选择，后头的原野部落的兽人还没死心，要将他们赶尽杀绝，他只能带着所剩不多的族人跟着他们。
在这路上，他们又遇到了同样从原野部落手底下逃出来的其他兽人。这些兽人当中，甚至有他当初供奉兽神时看到的原野部落自己的兽人。
“呜……”
身前，兽人迈着沉重的步伐，边走边哭。哭声压抑又无力。
猫数听着，也虚软着手，擦了一把眼睛。
他们这一路上受了那么多苦，躲过了好几次追杀，同行的兽人减少了又增加，他们根本不敢停下。
大家心中就惦记着，等到了东部大陆，找到狼部落，跟着他们狼部落能有点食物吃。
可到了这里，才发现所有的一切跟他们想象的不一样。
完全不一样。
狼王冷漠，狼兽人不允许他们踏进狼部落。
东边大陆的情况也跟中央大陆一样，没有猎物，没有食物……
哭声一个传一个，兽人们只觉得自己累得没了力气，脚下一绊，就放任自己晕了过去。
“啧。”狼夜随手拎起一个晕过去的少年兽人，冲着其他无精打采的兽人威胁道，“再磨叽，小心我直接把你们扔林子里喂野兽。”
猫数踉跄着，垂着头，搀扶着摇摇欲坠的同伴，继续往南边走。
他们不知道狼兽人们要驱赶他们到哪里去，也不知道自己还能不能活下来。
或许那个兽人是骗他们的。
骗他们来给狼部落当奴隶。
他们此时此刻只觉得自己累，累得抬不起脚，感觉不到自己到底饿不饿。
眼前被太阳晒得晕晃晃的，倒下的兽人越来越多。
狼兽人们一叹，熟练地捡起一个又一个。
那原野部落真的该死！
就算是搞什么供奉，也多考虑考虑给他们供奉的部落能不能自己养活自己。再不济，隔一年供奉一次，让他们喘口气，也不至于弄得他们四处奔逃！
还追杀，真是吃饱了撑的，有那个力气不如多抓点猎物。
狼夜驱赶着兽人走出黑羽部落，一路往南，在南边最近的一条河边，停了下来。
他把部落能主事的兽人拎到河边，见兽人一副要死不活的样子，没好气道：“看着。”
他随手把渔网一抛，拉起来，随后往兽人身前一甩。
“渔网，这么用。借你们的，以后还。”
啪的一下——
猫数被活蹦乱跳的鱼扇了一下脸。
他愣了愣，定定看着身前那些活蹦乱跳的鱼。
狼夜以为他真傻了，刚要拍一下兽人，却不想他忽然趴下去，一把将鱼抓住，直接往嘴里塞。
其他兽人见状，手脚并用爬过来，像用尽了最后的力气，扑向那些鱼。
他们抓着撕咬，生啃，满脸的血。
狼夜看在眼里，唇角抿平，心里不知道是个什么滋味。
这样的情况他已经见过很多次了，每一个被那不知道哪个倒霉催兽人哄过来的兽人部落都得来这么一下。
但愿他们能像其他部落一样，早点恢复元气吧。
多的，他们也帮不了。
chapters.title: 第215章
第216章
chapters.source_text:
哭声混杂着吞咽声，兽人顶着一头乱糟糟的头发，满脸的血，很是狼狈。
猫数尝到了又腥又苦的味道，忽然松开手，被啃得血糊糊的鱼掉落在地上。
他愣愣看着那渔网，手颤颤巍巍地摸上去，再抓着往河里一甩，学着狼夜小心拉起来放在岸边。
渔网上缠绕住几条鱼，各个肥硕。
猫数看着看着，忽然张大嘴巴，无声地又笑又哭。
兽人们没说错，没有骗他们！
再回头，狼兽人们已经走了。
猫数抹了把眼睛，像注入了力气，道：“生火！咱们烤鱼！”
“队长，他们不会再进来吧？”狼夜同行的兽人问。
狼夜：“羽山他们在巡逻，渔网都给他们了，要是他们还往黑羽部落钻，那就是蠢了。”
“哎！也不知道后头还要来多少部落，咱们都快被他们包围了。”
“谁知道呢。”
*
火被兽人们艰难生起来了。
一网接着一网的鱼被捞起来，兽人们顾不得收拾，直接串了棍子架在火堆上烤。
鱼一熟，立即分发下去。
兽人们吃着没有任何味道的烤鱼，眼睛红肿着，泪水还在一点点往外溢。
他们这下是高兴。
高兴这么远的路没有白走，他们能活下来了。
每个兽人得了食物垫了肚子之后，猫数让开，让兽人们尝试着下网。
兽人沿着河边走，小心翼翼拿着那看着细实则结实不已的渔网，一网一网地往河里抛。
他们看着网上挂着的鱼，眼中光芒极盛，亮得惊人。
“这个……比族长下水抓得都多。”
“那个兽人没骗我们。”
兽人像久旱逢甘霖的苗子，虽然没吃到多少烤鱼，但重新焕发了活力。
“真好。”
跟着捡鱼的兽人也抹泪，低声道：“真好……”
倏地，对面传来响动。
兽人迅速退到一处，把渔网紧紧藏在身后，比刚刚面对狼部落的时候多了几分警惕。
“沙沙——”
灌丛里探出个白色脑袋。
是个白羊兽人。
两边互相打量着，兽人从灌丛出来，往后叫了一声，接着，越来越多的白羊兽人走出来。
他们保持着兽形，一行二十几个兽人，背着东西，看着是路过的。
“你们也是来投奔狼部落的？”
羊胜在他们身上闻到了狼兽人的味道。
猫数眼珠微微一动，道：“你们也是。”
为首的羊胜笑起来，眼睛盯着猫数的脸看了好一会儿，嘴皮子往上掀，露出一口白牙。
“我们见过。”
“什么时候？”
“去原野部落供奉兽神时。”
猫数绷着下颌，往前走了几步。
他也是强撑着，这一路赶来提心吊胆的，又吃不饱，又累。
羊胜领着同伴跨过小河，走到他们身边，自来熟地坐下。
看兽人们还站着，又见他们身后藏着的渔网，笑道：“坐下说说话，我们又不会抢你们的渔网。”
猫数抬手，兽人们撑着颤抖的腿，强撑着假装平静地坐在猫数身后。
两队兽人中间隔着火堆，依旧互相打量着。
羊胜看得出他们的戒备，不过他也无所谓。
他道：“我们是两年前来这边的，当时跟你们的情况差不多。那渔网狼部落也给了我们一个。”
猫数怔怔地看着他，说不出话。
羊胜：“看到我们背着的东西了吗？这是狼部落给我们的种子，让我们种的牧草。牧草是给他们养的咩咩兽吃的。我们现在要去狼部落和他们交换。”
“交换……”猫数身后，兽人低喃，“他们还能拿得出东西来交换？”
羊胜：“哈哈！你可别小瞧他们。你们要是有东西，可以跟他们换盐，换草药，还有陶器、兽皮、小红鸟，你们手里的渔网也可以换。”
羊胜的部落也是从南边来的。
现在他们部落的位置就在以前绿眼部落那边。羊胜带着自家兽人来交换，走这么一趟也走了好几天了，着实累。
但一想到这一趟能交换到不少物资，他们心里就满足得不得了。
逃难的日子过久了，还是安定下来的生活才是他们最想要的。
羊胜抻了抻自己四条腿，一脸舒坦。
猫数现在这个部落都是十几个部落的兽人混杂的，领头的是猫数，所以部落的名字还跟着叫渔猫部落。
渔猫部落的兽人们悄悄观察着这群白羊兽人。
一个个身体健康，身上的肉虽不算多，但也匀称，一点没有他们这样面黄肌瘦的样子。
再看那脸色，本就是白羊一族，皮白，白里又透着红，跟那枝头上刚刚成熟的果子似的，一看就吃得好。
他们才来两年，两年就能从渔猫部落兽人这种样子变成他们现在这种样子？
哪有这么多食物！
兽人们心中怀疑，但沉默着没有说话。
猫数同样这样想。
“狼部落……很大？”
不出意外的话，猫数也会带着族人在狼部落附近定居。
“大。”羊胜说到这个，脸上就是掩饰不住的羡慕，“这边北部的土地，大部分都是狼部落的领地。”
“他们兽人也多，有六七百，他们隔壁的黑羽部落现在也跟着他们做事。”说着，羊胜来了一句，“我也想跟着他们做事。”
猫数垂在膝上的手指动了动。
谁不想？
“他们……好吗？”
羊胜晃一晃耳朵，“好？”
他笑得高兴，嘴巴大张，一眼能看到舌根，也不知道有什么好乐呵的。
“他们在中央大陆的时候就帮了不少部落，现在虽然换了狼王，但其实跟以前没什么两样。”
“不过你要想和他们保持好关系，最好别想着占他们的便宜，狼兽人可不傻。”
“你们刚来，先找地方住下吧。狼部落的事，等你们以后就慢慢知道了。反正他们比那个原野部落好多了！”说到最后一句，羊胜冷笑，眼里暗光一闪，带着深深的恨意。
猫数：“谢谢。”
羊胜：“我就是走累了，带着族人们休息一会儿，跟你们说说闲话。行了，我们也走了，还要赶着回去干活呢。”
目前，狼部落种的牧草不少，但若关着咩咩兽饲养，那点牧草不够它们吃。
以防万一，狼部落就把牧草种子给周边部落，种植出来的牧草可以拿来和他们交换。
羊胜起身，后头的族人们也跟着起来。
猫数追问道：“你知道附近哪里有适合定居的地方吗？”
羊胜：“合适的啊……可不巧，先你们一步找来这边的兽人还不少，好的地方都有部落了。不过你们可以先往东边走走，那边是大河下游，靠着捕鱼也能活。领地的话……先养养身体，后续可以慢慢看。”
“谢谢！”猫数这下是真心实意地感谢。
羊胜笑起来，“走了走了。”
羊胜带着族人跑起来。他们驮着重物，脚步不算轻快，但周身洋溢着欢快的气息。
那是日子安定的兽人才有的。
“族长？”
猫数：“先在这里休息几天，准备好我们就出发。”
那么远的路他们都走过来了，现在有狼兽人给的工具，又有白羊兽人点拨，就算只吃鱼啃草，他们也能安定下来。
何况，这里已经是远离原野部落的地方，有这么多相同处境的兽人，他们能把日子过好，渔猫部落自然也能。
*
大泽。
羊蹄落在修好的路上，哒哒哒的响。
正在忙碌的狼雨从食堂窗口往外一瞧，看着那从西边路口冒出来的皮毛雪白的白羊兽人，道：“白羊部落来了。”
刚到大泽，这会儿正坐在食堂里吃饭的狼金头也不抬，道：“随便他们来不来，他们只要不交换太多小红鸟就好。”
“狼金说得不错，我们就是打算交换小红鸟。”羊胜在窗口探头，笑眯眯道。
他是个爱笑的兽人，年纪轻轻，下巴上却留着长长的白胡子。脸型窄瘦，跟他兽形似的，身形也高高瘦瘦，带着一股文气。
不过此时他下巴架在窗口，看着也不怎么斯文。
狼金冲着窗口那边抬了抬下巴，问：“你们换多少？上午狮部落带走了七十只，这边还剩三十只。”
羊胜：“嘿……我开玩笑的。”
小红鸟……他们才交换不起！
他带着兽人们绕过食堂，直奔广场。
大泽里，水网交错，田块整齐。兽人们正躬身在里面忙着扯草。
还有兽人撑着船，慢悠悠地破开水面，满载着从大泽南边带回来的莲藕苗子，往东边的藕田里过去。
羊胜卸下背上的东西，一边痴痴地看着。
那地里绿油油的嫩草一看就很好吃。
狼金出来，羊胜笑呵呵道：“让我们加入你们部落吧，我们也很会干活的。”
狼金面无表情：“不收。”
“哎呀，兔兽人和黑羽兽人你们都收了，我们部落兽人又不多，你们……”
“你到底是来交换东西，还是来交换自己的？”
“都可以都可以。当然了，让我们加入你们那就更好了。”
狼金双手抱臂，“别想。”
“想都不行，你这兽人也太霸道了。”
狼金轻啧一声，眉毛一竖，凶道：“你到底换不换？！”
“换！换！”羊胜笑呵呵的，转过头，同伴已经把带来的东西都打开了。
“这次是六十个兽皮袋的干牧草，今年头一批呢。还有你们要的草药，不过只有三个兽皮袋。”
“换什么？”狼金手往后一招，自家小队的兽人们出来检查东西。
羊胜一边往身上套兽皮裙，一边竖起一根手指晃了晃，“换盐，还要一个陶锅。”
他们倒是想要狼兽人们做饭的铁锅，不过这玩意儿实在太贵，他们也就刚来两年，没什么家底，平时能靠着种植牧草和采集一点草药跟狼部落换盐就很不错了。
就这陶锅，他们来这么久，还是头一次换呢。
狼金被他那光屁股蛋子辣了下眼睛，嫌弃道：“就不能去屋里换！”
“那多麻烦。”
狼金气得想把兽人一脚踹水里去。
他看向同伴。
狼兽人们拍拍手，道：“都可以，牧草晒得也干，草药里没杂草和泥巴。”
狼金：“那就老样子，五袋牧草一勺盐。”
牧草好得，加上种子是他们提供的，所以换盐没有肉干和草药换得多。
“行。”
“草药……”
“三袋草药，换两个中等陶锅。”
狼金斜着眼看他晃动的那两根手指。
怎么就这么欠呢？
看着都想给他掰断。
这可不是狮也他们上次带来那种一大筐草药，那一筐抵得过羊胜带来的两个兽皮袋的草药。
就他们也才两筐草药，换一张渔网和一个中等陶罐，羊胜开口就是两个陶罐，真当他们狼部落烧陶有那么好烧。
虽然现在一个陶窑能出个百八十件的，但算上前期挖泥巴，拉坯，还要阴干那么久，烧的时候还热得不行……反正狼金是不乐意干烧陶的活儿。
“狼金金……”
狼金被他给恶心坏了，连连后退两步，拉开跟他的距离。
“一个中等，一个小。”
“小的能管什么用，我们又不熬药。两个中等的！”
“不行，这是楸定下的。”
“哎呀，咱们都交换几次了，多熟悉了……”
“谁跟你熟悉。”
“那我们给你们干半天的活，抵剩下不够的。”
狼金无语。
差你们那点儿活儿？
“一大一小。”
“两个中等的。”
“爱要不要！”
“要！要！”
哎！
羊胜遗憾，要是他们成了狼部落的兽人该多好啊。
他幽怨地看了一眼狼金，真是不识货！
他们白羊一族心灵手巧，做什么活儿不能？
能收灰兔，就不能收他们！
早知道……早知道他们就早点过来了。
兽人们来狼部落交换，已经习惯在大泽这边。这边能换的东西也都准备得很齐全，交换完，兽人们就可以离开狼部落。
狼金作为这几年常驻狼部落的兽人，对这些往来的部落也很熟悉。
雪季后这段时间天气最好，来的兽人也多，所以狼金得在这边守着。
小半月之后，雀溪好彻底了，狼金得了消息，立即回了狼山。
临行前的最后一顿，狼安让兽人宰杀了五头咩咩兽。
加上兽人们捕猎抓到的一头弯角兽，大伙儿吃了个满嘴流油。
吃饱了，吃好了，那就得出发了。
今日是祭司算出来的好日子，天亮不久，天边先浮现出一抹红，接着红浪翻滚，一层一层在东边的天幕上铺开来，如一条火红的长龙。
此时是雪季结束的第三个月月初，地气上升，刚刚播种的庄稼破土而出，茁壮成长，那黑黝黝的土地被绿意覆盖。
春花凋谢，绿意蔓延开来，润眼极了。
林子里，西边那泛白的大道上，兽人队伍慢慢往前走着。
乍一眼只是几十个兽人的小队，可再往后看，树木高深的丛林间，密密麻麻的狼兽人、黑羽兽人还有兔兽人行走其中。
这眼看就要送到黑羽部落去了，小队的兽人们停下来，无奈看着后头。
“别送了。”
“对啊，你们要是舍不得，跟我们一起去。”
“闭嘴吧！”狼安一巴掌打在跟前的狼金脑门上。
他们这不是担心吗？
这一趟出去，不比上次去南边，这来回可是要近一年的时间。
恐怕还不止一年。
兽人们想想，此刻都想改了主意，让林楸和狼岩干脆不去了。
不就是草药，不就是什么水稻，他们不要了还不成嘛！
林楸：“阿叔们……回去吧，你们不走，我们今天是出不了部落了。”
狼赤：“楸……”
林楸听他声音都哆嗦了，脑袋往旁边狼岩毛毛里一栽。
“哎！”
狼岩轻轻蹭了蹭自己伴侣，再抬起头，灰眸冷肃地看着部落的兽人们。
“我不在，部落的事情赤叔和祭司商量着来，其他兽人保护好部落，不能放松任何警惕，也保护好自己。”
“王！我们知道嗷嗷嗷呜呜呜呜……”兽人说着忍不住，抹一把眼睛，呜呜咽咽直接哭了出来。那声音一拐三绕，听得狼岩头疼。
狼岩：“别跟了。走！”
兽人们咧开嘴，冲着后头来送的兽人们挥挥爪，随后转身，慢慢跑了起来。
狼赤他们追了几步，后头的兽人拉扯着前头几个上了年纪的阿叔们，道：“别跟了。”
“楸啊！”
“照顾好自己，别受伤！遇到事情能跑就跑！打不过回来告诉我们，再远我们都来帮你们！”
狼赤声音雄浑，惊得雀鸟飞出山林。
“知道了！”林楸回应的声音隔着重重树林传来，兽人们心里一酸，纷纷低下头去。
“楸走了，部落里有事怎么办……”
狼安转过身，一巴掌拍在没跟去的小狼脑门上。
“当我们是死的！”
“走了，回去了！”
“嗷……”
狼山西边，出发西部大陆的兽人们走在自己修的路上，三三两两并排。
打头的是狼火和狼影，他们的毛色一个黑得发红，一个红得发黑。跟在他们后头的是分给狼火的那个队伍，里头兽人有狼云、狼顺、狼丑，还有些亚兽人，亚兽人大多是赤山部落的兽人。
中间是狼乔，带着狼金他们三个，还有羽涯那五个，他们都是没有外出经验的兽人。
再往后，就是狼乔小队的兽人。
而林楸和狼岩则跟在队伍最后面。
这次走得远，兽人们背上没有空着的，连雀溪都带了些东西。不过他的兽形跟白雀一样，太小了，只爪子上抓着自己的包袱，跟着往前飞。
离了前来相送的大部队，兽人们才开始跑起来，速度不快不慢。前面狼火和狼影压着步调，要保证这一程跑下来，兽人们体力不会消耗太过，但也不能太慢。
今天晚上，他们会在黑羽部落歇脚。
雀溪的兽形也漂亮，红色渐变的羽毛在阳光下泛着光，小小一个，不过身形也是有点圆，像白雀一样。
他飞在林楸身边，看着前方蜿蜒到尽头的路。
走出这里，就代表着他们已经离开狼部落，进入黑羽部落。
“我们离开东部大陆会一直往西南走，到了南边，就往西走。”
林楸点头，身上的包裹随着他的奔跑也上下起伏。
“今晚就在黑羽部落休息。”
林楸还没来过黑羽部落腹地，他们越过这一片横在两个部落中间的高大山脉就花了半日，下了山，眼前便是一片平直的开阔地。
一眼望去，除了树还是树。
下了山，兽人们速度慢了一会儿，紧接着队伍速度又开始加快。
得益于这两年狼岩督促着兽人们训练，如今大伙儿的耐力比以往更甚。
穿过这哪哪儿看着都一样的林子，兽人们渐渐也从兴奋，变得疲累。
终于，太阳落山，前头兽人过来询问是否就在这里停下。
狼岩应声。
“王！黑羽部落里的猎物我们能抓不？”
狼岩忽然仰头。
兽人们下意识警惕，待看清天上靠近的是什么，眼神惊奇。
羽山带着送食的队伍落下，藤筐砸在地上，一股子肉香味。兽人围上来，嘿嘿笑着，“居然还有这待遇！”
“山叔，后头你们是不是也会给我们送食物？”羽涯围着那藤筐吞咽口水，期待地望向羽山。
羽山一翅膀给他扇过去。
“就这一次！”
还不是狼山的兽人担心他们，这些兽人一走，就让羽山送食物来了。他们几乎是踩着极限速度飞过来的，就怕送不到。
飞了快一天，就为了送一顿饭！
也就狼部落能干出这样的事。
当然，这烤肉肯定也凉了。
狼岩：“一起吃？”
羽山：“我们可不跟你们抢。”
他们辛辛苦苦送到这边来的，最后进了他们的嘴，那为什么还要送？他们脑子有病还是叫他们送的狼兽人脑子有病？
羽山毫不留恋，扔下食物就走了。
高空中，他的声音远远扩开来——
“吃完藤筐不带走就扔那儿，我们以后巡逻过来自己来拿。走了，路上小心点。”
“涯！你们几个跟紧狼兽人，别捣乱，平安回来！”
羽涯泪眼汪汪。
“知道了，阿山叔。”
羽涯五个黑羽兽人喊完，一屁股坐下。
林楸看着他们吸鼻子，笑道：“舍不得？”
“那就回去！”狼金手臂往人家肩膀上重重一搭，得意洋洋的。
也不知道他在得意个什么。
林楸去看羽山他们带来的食物，藤筐里装的都是烤肉。扎扎实实的肉，但也就三个藤筐。
林楸：“王，都吃完吗？”
兽人们期待地看向狼岩。
“省着点，吃一半，剩下的明早吃。”
“王……不够啊！”
“分队，该采集的采集，该找猎物的找猎物。”
“嗷嗷嗷！！！”
“闭嘴！”狼岩看着眼前这群兽人，尤其是叫得最欢的狼兽人，威胁道，“要是在外面你们敢这么嚎……”
兽人一下缩紧脖子，挪动屁股，背对过去。
鹌鹑一样，一声不吭。
chapters.translated_text:
Cries were mixed with the sounds of swallowing; the orc had messy hair and a face covered in blood, looking thoroughly disheveled.

Mao Shu tasted the fishy and bitter flavor, then suddenly let go, and the fish, gnawed into a bloody mess, fell to the ground.

He stared blankly at the fishing net, his hands trembling as he touched it, then grabbed it and swung it into the river, mimicking Lang Ye’s careful movements to pull it back up and place it on the bank.

Several fish were tangled in the net, each one plump and fat.

As Mao Shu watched, he suddenly opened his mouth wide, laughing and crying silently.

The orcs hadn't been wrong; they hadn't lied to them!

Looking back, the wolf orcs were already gone.

Mao Shu wiped his eyes, as if injected with new strength, and said, "Start a fire! We’re roasting fish!"

"Captain, they won't come back in, will they?" an orc accompanying Lang Ye asked.

Lang Ye replied, "Yu Shan and the others are patrolling, and we gave them the nets. If they still try to sneak into the Black Feather tribe, then they’re just stupid."

"Sigh! Who knows how many more tribes will come; we’re almost surrounded by them."

"Who knows."

*

The fire was started with great difficulty by the orcs.

Net after net of fish was hauled up; the orcs didn't bother cleaning them, simply skewering them on sticks and propping them over the fire.

As soon as the fish were cooked, they were immediately distributed.

The orcs ate the flavorless roasted fish, their eyes red and swollen, tears still spilling out bit by bit.

This time, they were tears of joy.

Happy that the long journey hadn't been in vain, and that they could survive.

After every orc had filled their stomach with food, Mao Shu stepped aside, letting the orcs try casting the nets themselves.

The orcs walked along the riverbank, carefully holding the thin yet incredibly sturdy fishing net, casting it into the river one throw after another.

Looking at the fish hanging in the net, their eyes shone with an intense, startling brilliance.

"This... catches more than the patriarch could by going into the water."

"That orc didn't lie to us."

The orcs were like seedlings meeting sweet rain after a long drought; though they hadn't eaten much roasted fish, they were revitalized.

"It's so good."

The orcs who were gathering fish also wiped their tears, whispering, "It's so good..."

Suddenly, a sound came from the opposite side.

The orcs quickly retreated to one spot, hiding the fishing nets tightly behind them, more vigilant than they had been when facing the Wolf tribe earlier.

"Rustle—"

A white head poked out from the bushes.

It was a White Sheep orc.

Both sides sized each other up; the orc stepped out of the bushes and called out behind him, and then, more and more White Sheep orcs emerged.

They remained in their beast forms, a group of twenty-some orcs carrying items, looking like travelers.

"Are you also here to join the Wolf tribe?"

Yang Sheng smelled the scent of wolf orcs on them.

Mao Shu’s pupils shifted slightly, and he said, "You are too."

Yang Sheng, the leader, laughed, staring at Mao Shu’s face for a long moment, his lips curling up to reveal a set of white teeth.

"We’ve met."

"When?"

"When we went to the Wild tribe to offer sacrifices to the Beast God."

Mao Shu tightened his jaw and took a few steps forward.

He was also barely holding on; the journey here had been filled with fear, and he was both hungry and exhausted.

Yang Sheng led his companions across the small river, walked up to them, and sat down with the ease of an old acquaintance.

Seeing the orcs still standing, and noticing the nets hidden behind them, he laughed, "Sit down and talk; we aren't going to steal your fishing nets."

Mao Shu raised a hand, and the orcs, supporting their trembling legs, forced themselves to sit behind Mao Shu, pretending to be calm.

The two groups of orcs sat with the fire between them, still sizing each other up.

Yang Sheng could see their wariness, but he didn't mind.

He said, "We came here two years ago; our situation was about the same as yours back then. The Wolf tribe gave us a fishing net, too."

Mao Shu stared at him blankly, unable to speak.

Yang Sheng continued, "See what we’re carrying? These are seeds the Wolf tribe gave us to grow pasture grass. The grass is for the 'Mieh-Mieh' beasts they raise. We’re going to the Wolf tribe now to trade with them."

"Trade..." an orc behind Mao Shu whispered, "They still have things to trade?"

Yang Sheng laughed, "Haha! Don't underestimate them. If you have things, you can trade with them for salt, herbs, pottery, animal skins, and Little Red Birds. You can even trade the fishing nets in your hands."

Yang Sheng’s tribe had also come from the south.

Their tribe was now located where the Green Eye tribe used to be. Yang Sheng had brought his orcs to trade, and the journey had already taken several days—it was truly tiring.

But thinking about how much they could trade for on this trip, they felt incredibly satisfied.

After living a life of fleeing for so long, a stable life was what they wanted most.

Yang Sheng stretched his four legs, looking completely at ease.

Mao Shu’s current tribe was a mix of orcs from over a dozen tribes, led by Mao Shu, so the tribe’s name remained the Fishing Cat tribe.

The orcs of the Fishing Cat tribe quietly observed this group of White Sheep orcs.

Each one was healthy; though they weren't very fleshy, they were well-proportioned, not at all as sallow and thin as they were.

Looking at their complexions—they were White Sheep orcs, naturally fair-skinned, and their skin had a rosy tint, like fruit just ripened on a branch; one look told you they were well-fed.

They had only been here two years; could they really go from looking like the Fishing Cat tribe orcs to looking like this in just two years?

Where would they get so much food!

The orcs were skeptical, but they remained silent.

Mao Shu felt the same way.

"Is the... Wolf tribe big?"

If all went well, Mao Shu would also settle his people near the Wolf tribe.

"Big." When Yang Sheng mentioned this, his face showed undisguised envy, "Most of the land in the north here belongs to the Wolf tribe."

"They have many orcs, six or seven hundred, and the Black Feather tribe next door now works with them too." Saying this, Yang Sheng added, "I want to work with them, too."

Mao Shu’s fingers, resting on his knees, twitched.

Who wouldn't?

"Are they... good?"

Yang Sheng flicked his ears, "Good?"

He laughed happily, his mouth wide open, revealing the back of his throat; it was hard to tell what was so amusing.

"They helped many tribes back in the Central Continent, and although the Wolf King has changed, it’s really no different from before."

"But if you want to keep a good relationship with them, you’d better not try to take advantage of them; the wolf orcs aren't stupid."

"Since you’ve just arrived, find a place to stay first. You’ll learn about the Wolf tribe slowly in the future. Anyway, they’re much better than that Wild tribe!" At the last sentence, Yang Sheng sneered, a dark glint of deep hatred flashing in his eyes.

Mao Shu: "Thank you."

Yang Sheng: "I was just tired from walking, so I brought my tribe to rest for a bit and chat with you. Alright, we’re off; we need to get back to work."

Currently, the Wolf tribe grew plenty of pasture grass, but if they kept the Mieh-Mieh beasts in pens, that bit of grass wasn't enough to feed them.

As a precaution, the Wolf tribe gave pasture seeds to surrounding tribes, and the grass grown could be traded with them.

Yang Sheng stood up, and his clansmen followed.

Mao Shu asked, "Do you know of any suitable places to settle nearby?"

Yang Sheng: "Suitable ones... unfortunately, quite a few orcs found their way here before you, and the good spots are already taken by tribes. But you can try heading east; that’s the lower reaches of the Great River, and you can survive by fishing. As for territory... focus on recovering your health first, and you can look around slowly later."

"Thank you!" Mao Shu was genuinely grateful this time.

Yang Sheng laughed, "Off we go."

Yang Sheng led his clansmen as they started running. They were carrying heavy loads, so their pace wasn't light, but they were filled with a joyful aura.

It was the aura only orcs with a stable life possessed.

"Patriarch?"

Mao Shu: "Let’s rest here for a few days, and we’ll set off once we’re prepared."

They had survived such a long journey; now with the tools given by the wolf orcs and the advice from the White Sheep orcs, even if they only ate fish and grass, they could settle down.

Besides, this was far away from the Wild tribe, and with so many orcs in the same situation, if they could live well, the Fishing Cat tribe naturally could too.

*

Daze.

Sheep hooves landed on the paved road with a rhythmic *da-da-da*.

Lang Yu, who was busy, looked out from the canteen window and saw the snow-white orcs emerging from the western road, saying, "The White Sheep tribe is here."

Lang Jin, who had just arrived at Daze and was sitting in the canteen eating, didn't even look up, saying, "Doesn't matter if they come or not, as long as they don't trade for too many Little Red Birds."

"Lang Jin is right, we are planning to trade for Little Red Birds." Yang Sheng poked his head in the window, smiling.

He was an orc who loved to laugh; though young, he had a long white beard on his chin. His face was narrow and thin, much like his beast form, and his build was tall and lean, carrying an air of refinement.

However, with his chin resting on the window frame, he didn't look very refined at the moment.

Lang Jin tilted his chin toward the window and asked, "How many are you trading for? The Lion tribe took seventy this morning, there are only thirty left."

Yang Sheng: "Heh... I was just joking."

Little Red Birds... they couldn't afford to trade for those!

He led his orcs around the canteen and headed straight for the square.

In Daze, water channels crisscrossed, and the fields were neat. Orcs were bent over, busy weeding.

Other orcs were poling boats, slowly breaking the water's surface, loaded with lotus root seedlings brought from the south of Daze, heading toward the lotus fields in the east.

Yang Sheng unloaded what he was carrying, watching everything with a dazed look.

The lush green grass in the fields looked delicious.

Lang Jin came out, and Yang Sheng said cheerfully, "Let us join your tribe; we’re very good at working, too."

Lang Jin was expressionless: "We aren't taking anyone."

"Oh come on, you took in the Rabbit orcs and the Black Feather orcs, and our tribe doesn't have many orcs, you..."

"Are you here to trade goods, or to trade yourself?"

"Either works. Of course, it would be even better if you let us join."

Lang Jin crossed his arms: "Don't even think about it."

"Not even thinking about it? You orcs are too overbearing."

Lang Jin gave a light *tsk*, raised his eyebrows, and said fiercely: "Are you trading or not?!"

"Trading! Trading!" Yang Sheng laughed, turning his head as his companions had already opened the goods they brought.

"This time it’s sixty animal-skin bags of dried pasture grass, the first batch of the year. And the herbs you wanted, though there are only three bags."

"What are you trading for?" Lang Jin gestured behind him, and his team's orcs came out to inspect the goods.

Yang Sheng, while pulling up his animal-skin skirt, held up a finger and shook it: "Trading for salt, and a pottery pot."

They would have liked the iron pots the wolf orcs used for cooking, but that stuff was too expensive. They had only been here two years and didn't have much wealth; being able to trade pasture grass and a few herbs for salt was already quite good.

Even for this pottery pot, it was their first time trading for one after being here so long.

Lang Jin’s eyes were seared by the sight of his bare buttocks, and he said with disgust: "Can't you go inside to trade!"

"That’s too much trouble."

Lang Jin was so angry he wanted to kick the orc into the water.

He looked at his companions.

The wolf orcs clapped their hands and said, "Everything is fine; the grass is dried well, and there’s no debris or mud in the herbs."

Lang Jin: "Same as usual, five bags of grass for one scoop of salt."

Pasture grass was easy to grow, and since they provided the seeds, the trade value for salt wasn't as high as for meat or herbs.

"Fine."

"Herbs..."

"Three bags of herbs for two medium pottery pots."

Lang Jin squinted at the two fingers he was waving.

Why was he so annoying?

It made him want to snap them off.

This wasn't the large basket of herbs that Shi Ye and the others brought last time; that one basket was worth two of the bags Yang Sheng brought.

They only had two bags of herbs, yet Yang Sheng was asking for two pots—did he think pottery was that easy to fire?

Although a kiln could produce a hundred or so pieces now, when you counted the time spent digging mud, shaping, drying for so long, and the sweltering heat during firing... anyway, Lang Jin didn't like the pottery work.

"Lang Jin-jin..."

Lang Jin was so disgusted he retreated two steps, putting distance between them.

"One medium, one small."

"What use is a small one? We aren't brewing medicine. Two medium ones!"

"No, that’s what Qiu decided."

"Oh, we’ve traded several times already, we’re so familiar..."

"I’m not familiar with you."

"Then we’ll work for you for half a day to make up the difference."

Lang Jin was speechless.

Do we need your labor?

"One large, one small."

"Two medium ones."

"Take it or leave it!"

"Take it! Take it!"

*Sigh!*

Yang Sheng felt regretful; if only they had become orcs of the Wolf tribe.

He gave Lang Jin a resentful look—he really didn't know quality!

Their White Sheep clan was clever and skilled; what work couldn't they do?

They could take in the Gray Rabbits, why couldn't they take them!

If they had known... if they had known, they would have come sooner.

Orcs coming to the Wolf tribe to trade had grown accustomed to Daze. Everything they needed was well-prepared here, and once the trade was done, they could leave.

Lang Jin, as an orc stationed at the Wolf tribe for years, was very familiar with these visiting tribes.

The weather was best in the time after the Snow Season, and many orcs came, so Lang Jin had to stay here.

Half a month later, Que Xi was fully recovered, and Lang Jin received the news and immediately returned to Wolf Mountain.

For the last meal before departure, Lang An had the orcs slaughter five Mieh-Mieh beasts.

Added to the curved-horn beast the orcs had hunted, everyone ate until their mouths were greasy.

Once full and satisfied, it was time to set off.

Today was the auspicious day calculated by the priest. Not long after dawn, a touch of red appeared on the horizon, then red waves rolled, spreading layer upon layer across the eastern sky like a long, fiery dragon.

It was the beginning of the third month after the Snow Season; the earth was warming, the newly sown crops were breaking through the soil, growing vigorously, and the dark earth was covered in green.

Spring flowers were fading, and the greenery was spreading, a sight that was extremely soothing to the eyes.

In the forest, on the white-tinted road to the west, the orc team slowly moved forward.

At first glance, it looked like a small team of dozens, but looking further back, dense crowds of wolf orcs, Black Feather orcs, and rabbit orcs were walking through the deep jungle.

Seeing they were about to reach the Black Feather tribe, the team of orcs stopped, looking back helplessly.

"Stop seeing us off."

"Yeah, if you can't bear to part, come with us."

"Shut up!" Lang An slapped Lang Jin on the forehead.

Weren't they just worried?

This trip wasn't like the last one to the south; the round trip would take nearly a year.

Probably even longer than a year.

The orcs thought about it and wanted to change their minds, letting Lin Qiu and Lang Yan just not go.

It was just herbs, just some rice—they didn't need it!

Lin Qiu: "Uncles... go back. If you don't leave, we won't be able to leave the tribe today."

Lang Chi: "Qiu..."

Lin Qiu heard his voice trembling and buried his head into Lang Yan’s fur.

"Sigh!"

Lang Yan gently rubbed his partner, then lifted his head, his gray eyes looking sternly at the tribe’s orcs.

"While I’m away, Uncle Chi and the priest will discuss tribe matters. The other orcs must protect the tribe, never relax your vigilance, and protect yourselves."

"King! We know, *aooo-wuuuu*..." the orcs couldn't help themselves, wiping their eyes and sobbing. The sound was so drawn-out it gave Lang Yan a headache.

Lang Yan: "Stop following. Go!"

The orcs grinned, waved their claws at the orcs seeing them off, then turned and began to run slowly.

Lang Chi and the others chased for a few steps, but the orcs behind pulled back the older uncles, saying, "Don't follow."

"Qiu!"

"Take care of yourselves, don't get hurt! If you encounter trouble, run if you can! If you can't beat them, come back and tell us; no matter how far, we’ll come to help you!"

Lang Chi’s voice was booming, startling birds out of the mountain forest.

"Got it!" Lin Qiu’s response came from across the dense forest, and the orcs felt a pang in their hearts, bowing their heads.

"Qiu is gone, what if something happens in the tribe..."

Lang An turned around and slapped a young wolf who hadn't followed on the forehead.

"Do you think we’re dead!"

"Let’s go, back we go!"

"Awoo..."

West of Wolf Mountain, the orcs heading to the Western Continent walked on the road they had built, side by side in twos and threes.

Leading were Lang Huo and Lang Ying, their fur colors one black-red and one red-black. Following them was the team assigned to Lang Huo, including orcs like Lang Yun, Lang Shun, Lang Chou, and some sub-orcs, most of whom were from the Red Mountain tribe.

In the middle was Lang Qiao, with Lang Jin and the other two, as well as the five from Yu Ya’s group; they were all orcs without experience traveling abroad.

Further back were the orcs of Lang Qiao’s team.

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan followed at the very end of the team.

This trip was long, so the orcs didn't have empty backs; even Que Xi brought some things. However, his beast form was like a white sparrow, too small, so he just gripped his bundle with his claws and flew along.

Once they left the main group that had seen them off, the orcs started running at a steady pace. Lang Huo and Lang Ying in front set the tempo, ensuring the orcs wouldn't exhaust their stamina too quickly, but also not moving too slowly.

Tonight, they would rest at the Black Feather tribe.

Que Xi’s beast form was also beautiful, his red gradient feathers shining in the sun, small and slightly round, just like a white sparrow.

He flew beside Lin Qiu, looking at the road winding into the distance.

Leaving here meant they had left the Wolf tribe and entered the Black Feather tribe.

"We will head southwest after leaving the Eastern Continent, and once we reach the south, we’ll head west."

Lin Qiu nodded, the pack on his back bobbing as he ran.

"We’ll rest at the Black Feather tribe tonight."

Lin Qiu hadn't been to the heart of the Black Feather tribe before; it had taken them half a day just to cross the high mountain range between the two tribes, and after descending, they were met with a flat, open expanse.

As far as the eye could see, it was nothing but trees.

After descending the mountain, the orcs slowed down for a moment, then the team’s speed began to increase again.

Thanks to Lang Yan urging the orcs to train over the past two years, everyone’s endurance was better than ever.

Passing through the forest that looked the same everywhere, the orcs gradually went from excited to exhausted.

Finally, the sun set, and the orcs in front came to ask if they should stop here.

Lang Yan agreed.

"King! Can we catch the prey in the Black Feather tribe?"

Lang Yan suddenly looked up.

The orcs were instinctively vigilant, but upon seeing who was approaching from the sky, their eyes widened in surprise.

Yu Shan led the food-delivery team down, and the rattan baskets hit the ground with a scent of roasted meat. The orcs surrounded them, grinning, "We actually have this treatment!"

"Uncle Shan, will you send us food later on too?" Yu Ya swallowed hard, looking at the rattan basket with anticipation toward Yu Shan.

Yu Shan swatted him with a wing.

"Just this once!"

It wasn't that the Wolf Mountain orcs were worried about them, but as soon as these orcs left, they had Yu Shan send food. They had flown at almost maximum speed, fearing they wouldn't make it in time.

Flying for nearly a day just to deliver one meal!

Only the Wolf tribe could do something like this.

Of course, the roasted meat was definitely cold by now.

Lang Yan: "Eat together?"

Yu Shan: "We aren't going to fight you for it."

They had worked so hard to deliver it here, only for it to end up in their mouths—why send it then? Were they crazy, or were the wolf orcs who asked them to send it crazy?

Yu Shan left without hesitation, dropping the food and flying off.

High in the sky, his voice spread far and wide—

"If you don't take the rattan baskets when you’re done, just leave them there; we’ll pick them up when we patrol by later. Off you go, be careful on the road."

"Ya! You guys stay close to the wolf orcs, don't cause trouble, and come back safely!"

Yu Ya’s eyes were filled with tears.

"Got it, Uncle Shan."

After the five Black Feather orcs finished shouting, they sat down with a thud.

Lin Qiu watched them sniffle and laughed: "Can't bear to part?"

"Then go back!" Lang Jin threw his arm heavily over someone’s shoulder, looking smug.

It was unclear what he was so smug about.

Lin Qiu looked at the food Yu Shan and the others had brought; the rattan baskets were filled with roasted meat. Solid, hearty meat, but only three baskets.

Lin Qiu: "King, should we eat it all?"

The orcs looked at Lang Yan with anticipation.

"Save some, eat half, and eat the rest tomorrow morning."

"King... that’s not enough!"

"Split into teams, gather what needs gathering, and hunt what needs hunting."

"Aooo!!!"

"Shut up!" Lang Yan looked at the group of orcs, especially the wolf orc who was howling the loudest, and threatened, "If you dare howl like this when we’re out there..."

The orcs immediately shrank their necks, shifted their bottoms, and turned their backs.

Like quails, they didn't make a sound.

chapters.source_text:
日暮昏黄，一群雀鸟结成群，在低空盘旋。
嗖的一声——
飞箭射了出去，留下一道残影。箭身嗡鸣，笔直地扎入树干，连带着穿透了那与树叶颜色一般无二的长蛇。
长蛇拼命挣扎，拧动着身体，不过几息，还是软塌塌地垂了下来。
丛林间，兽人脚步声轻快。
他踩着枯枝烂叶，几步靠近，一把抽出那箭矢，连带着上面挂着的长虫也一同取下，晃了晃，确认死透了，才随手扔进背后的藤筐中。
“楸！我们回来了！”
狼金领着这些年轻的狼兽人们和羽涯几个回来了。
十五个刚刚成年的狼兽人，加上五个黑羽兽人，刚好凑齐了二十个兽人小队。
他们各个身形高挑，脚步生风，或拿着长刀，或背着重弓，腰侧斜挎箭囊。裸着上半身，腰间围着兽皮，野人一样兴奋地从林子里钻出来。
这是他们离开狼山的第十天。
一群兽人穿过黑羽部落，一直往西南方向走，走到现在，也没遇到过一个部落。
没有兽人活动的地方便是蛇虫扎堆。
林楸飞快扫了一眼狼金背着的藤筐，透过孔洞，见那花花绿绿、一截一截的蛇身，鸡皮疙瘩都起来了。
林楸抓过狼岩的手横在眼前，道：“别拿到我面前来。”
狼金顿步，遗憾道：“多好看啊。”
“滚！”林楸咬牙道。
这群狼崽子就是讨打，知道他怕什么，专门抓这玩意儿往他跟前送。
林楸还记得刚走出来没几天，狼金带头捅了蛇窝，没弄死，全装在藤筐里，直直地往他面前一放。
林楸当场吓得头发都炸了。
结果这群小狼崽子还指着他笑，最后被林楸狠狠揍了一顿，揍得他们鼻青脸肿的，这会儿看着脸上还有点青色印记。
狼金看他那避之不及的样子，眼巴巴地看向他们的王。
他们那不是想让楸多看看，习惯习惯，不然楸不碰这东西，他们自己拿来做菜，都糟蹋了长虫的美味。
狼岩冷眼看着这群搞事的狼崽子和黑羽兽人崽子，“滚。”
狼金哼哼，不情不愿地离开。
“他们走了。”
林楸松开狼岩的手，打个寒颤。
想起那密密麻麻绞缠在一起的软体长蛇，林楸身上又起了一层鸡皮疙瘩，他打了个寒战，转头一口咬在狼岩肩膀上，恼道：“看看你家小狼做的好事！”
狼岩无辜被牵连，大手盖在林楸头上，轻轻揉了两下。
“我什么都没做……”
林楸深吸一口气，强压下脑子里那些有关蛇的画面。
不怪他怕这玩意儿，实在是阴影太重，小狼再来那一出，更是雪上加霜。
他这辈子都不可能摸那东西。
好半晌，林楸缓过来，才有心思做其他。
他把随身带着的兽皮卷拿出来。
他们已经走了十天，为了不走错，每次停下来林楸就要把雀溪叫过来对照一下。
林楸跟着他们走的路径，画了一份地图。有能飞到高空的黑羽兽人们协助，这份地图准确得不能再准确。
这会儿，他们停留在一个名叫双眼潭的地方。
双眼潭这名字是雀溪叫出来的，他自己为了记住这一路上的标志，自己给取的名字。
这一汪潭水落在悬垂的瀑布下端。形状似双眼，圆圆的，大小还差不多。
这地方凉爽，小瀑布飞溅，水汽氤氲。就是蛇虫多，林楸看着那水潭边不下三条蛇经过了。
这会儿，狼影和狼火带着他们那队兽人采集去了。狼金带着队伍刚回来，正蹲在水潭边处理带回来的猎物。
狼乔则和剩下的兽人留守，收拾出个空地，挖灶搭锅，开水都已经煮好两锅了。
林楸收回目光，手轻轻拨弄一下兽皮卷，硕大的一张兽皮摊开来。
上面用了两种颜色作画。
一种是长生草的汁液画的，只占据了小小的一角。旁的地方，都是用炭笔勾勒的图画，全是他们还没走过，但根据雀溪的描述画出来的路线。
林楸、狼岩、雀溪还有刚忙活完的狼冰跟狼溶都凑了过来。
几个兽人头碰头，看着林楸先拿着炭笔，在上面勾勒弯弯曲曲的路线。
就那么一小截，还没手指长。
画完就在尽头标注了一处瀑布和一汪深潭，并写了几个字。
“楸，写的什么？”
林楸：“双眼潭。”
兽人瞧着那奇奇怪怪的方块字，觉得眼晕。狼冰撑着下巴，道：“没出息！”
“你认识？”
“不认识。”
林楸没好气地笑了笑。
“一个个都是文盲。”
“文盲是什么？”
“就像你们这样的。”
林楸不是没考虑过教兽人们认字，但过去那几年间，兽人们先是吃不饱，没有余力，后头又是睁眼忙到闭眼，更加没空。
林楸看着这地图上还有大半没有走过的路线，眼神往几个兽人身上绕了绕，心里有了主意。
地图一合，狼冰狼溶赶紧跑了。
雀溪也不想吃白饭，他去给做饭的兽人帮忙。
林楸和狼岩身前一下就空了。
“王。”
狼岩应了一声，帮林楸收好兽皮卷，握住他手腕轻捏。他好像养成了这个习惯，有事没事就抓着他的手。
“想教他们学？”
林楸：“画地图都教了，以后拿着地图不认字怎么办？不过这个能教吗？”
林楸先前听狼岩说，祭司传下来的手札上才有那些文字，这怕是只有祭司能学的东西。
狼岩：“能教。”
林楸：“我看这一路上除了赶路也没什么事，要不每次停下来休息前，我把大家聚一个块儿一起教了？”
狼岩：“你有那个精力就行。”
林楸自信道：“不是什么难事。”
林楸是个说做就做的人，既然要教兽人识字，那就好好教。他当即重新拿了一张兽皮出来，准备起来。
水潭边，狼金抓着长虫，去头破肚，剥皮，把能药用的部分留出来装进罐子里，等狼冰之后处理。
他一手的血，鲜红血液顺着指缝一滴滴落进水中，一下散开，又被流动的水带走。
狼冰拎着小刀在旁边把蛇肉剁成一截一截的，狼溶再装入盆，再一次淘洗。
三个狼兽人蹲一排，忙着忙着，觉得后背有点凉。
他们回头看了看，沿着水潭边缘排了一溜的其他小狼们也跟着转头。
他们后面就是狼乔他们在烧水，再远一点的树荫下，林楸拿着兽皮写写画画，时不时跟他们王商量一句。
羽涯蹲在水边，左看右看，随手抄起身边的石块儿往水里一抛，纳闷道：“你们看什么呢？”
中间，狼乔也有些疑惑。
只有对面坐着的林楸缓缓看来，对他们露出一点笑容。
很友爱，很亲和，也很……
狼金一个激灵，快速回过头，搓了搓自己手臂。
“楸不会在想怎么收拾我们吧？”
狼金对危险预判极准。
狼冰：“不好说。”
狼溶：“很不好说。”
羽涯瞪着他那一双漆黑的大眼珠子。他成年后，营养充足加上跟着狼兽人训练，那臂膀结实得跟青蛙腿似的，越看越不聪明。
“你们做错什么了？”
狼金神神叨叨地摇摇头，“不好说，不好说……”
反正有不祥的预感。
*
这边林子没有兽人活动的迹象，可供采集的野菜野果也多。
狼火和狼影带着队伍出去，遇到能吃的只管薅。
一通忙活下来，带回来的东西杂七杂八的，什么都有。
出门在外，兽人吃得简单。
那些个菜干、肉干、尾巴草籽兽人们都省着吃，只把每日临时带回来的食物一锅乱炖，管他好吃不好吃，有点油水跟盐味儿就行。
兽人们吃过好的，再吃这个，一脸苦哈哈的，但又不得不吃。
他们每天到饭点儿就用那可怜巴巴的眼神看着林楸，林楸视而不见，赶路途中一停下，就一心忙着绘制地图，观察周围环境。
他上一次去南边没想到这事儿，现在路程太远，一时兴起就想起画地图。画着画着，想着自己以后恐怕很少再去红雀部落，便想着把路线完善清楚，制作一份完整的地图。
这个要是弄出来，以后兽人们再走这条路，哪怕没有去过的兽人带路，也能跟着地图走过去。
林楸想到了，狼岩也同样想到了。
所以他们两个每走一程，就坐下来忙活，丝毫没空管其他兽人。
吃完一锅乱炖，兽人们蹲水潭边洗漱。
有闲不住的，直接捏着鼻子往水里一跳，水花溅起一人高。蹲在岸边的兽人无一幸免。
“楸！唔唔——”
狼金游过去，捂住要告状的狼云的嘴巴，一个巧劲儿，也把他拽下水。
潭水深，林楸听到那一阵喊声，提醒道：“注意安全。”
狼金笑嘻嘻地冲他摆摆手，另一只手圈住狼云脖子，胳膊粗得跟大蟒似的，以绝对的力量压制他。
狼金虽比他小，但也是小狼狩猎队的队长，加上已经成年了，论武力，狼云还真打不过他。
兽人们在水潭撒欢儿似地玩儿，林楸看着那水潭，忽然向两个队长招招手。
“楸？”狼火和狼乔一前一后走过来。
林楸起身，绕着水潭走了一圈，拍了拍身侧一块大石头。
“帮个忙。刻几个字。”
狼乔：“我去拿工具。”
狼火一脚踩在那大石头上，脸颊往身边站立的狼影肩膀上贴，“刻什么？”
“双眼潭。”林楸道，“现在看得出这潭水长得像两眼睛，谁知道以后水枯了会怎么样，刻石头上保险些。”
狼影双手抱臂，眼里闪过一丝光芒。
“好主意。最好把整个大陆所有地方都画下来，标注好，以后要迁徙直接确定地方按照路线就走，省事儿。”
林楸默默无言。
“要不你来？”
狼影唇角一勾，一巴掌推开狼火的脑袋，另一只手臂搭在林楸肩膀上，“我来不了，但我可以给你帮忙。”
林楸：“那我得走遍整个兽神大陆。”
狼影点点头，“我陪你走。”
狼火站在狼影旁边，看他俩你来我往，聊得畅快，自己跟根儿树一样杵在这里，伴侣都不理他。
狼火叹气，一脑袋撞在狼影肩膀。
“得到了就不喜欢了吗？”想当初，他还是被狼影抢山洞里去的。
狼影看都没看他，顺手堵住他嘴巴。
“别说这话。”
“？”
“有点恶心。”
林楸笑了两声，从灶下抽了根没烧完的木条，往石头上写了几个字，让他们照刻，随后拍拍手，潇洒离开。
日落西山，伴随着叮叮当当的敲击声，星辰遍布整个天空，月光照得深潭流光如缎。
兽人们其实也都累了。
轮值守夜的兽人们一个蹲树上，一个坐在火堆旁，渐渐的，兽人们闲聊的声音变小，只余下绵长的呼吸声。
*
天光破晓，雾气氤氲。
林中几声鸟叫忽近忽远，像被雾气蒙了一层。
趴地上熟睡的兽人们被扰得飞快弹动了几下耳朵，不乐意地将整个脑袋直接埋在两个大爪子间。
林楸眉心微隆，感受清晨的凉意，习惯性地往自己伴侣毛毛里缩了缩，缓缓睁眼。
天才刚亮，林子深处还是昏黑一片。
兽人们趴在地上睡得四仰八叉，毛毛上都蓄起一层露水。一只拳头大的小鸟大着胆子从枝头跃下，落在狼云后背，缓缓试探靠近，张嘴叼了他一撮毛。
林楸瞧着那睡得无知无觉的兽人，唇角微弯，脑袋埋在狼岩颈侧的毛毛里蹭了蹭。
他们还要赶路，哪有睡懒觉的时候。
没多久，兽人们就陆陆续续爬起来，打着哈欠，蹲水潭边洗漱。
林楸捧了一把水洗脸，潭水冰凉，激得他睡意散得一干二净。
林楸取下肩膀上搭着的帕子，擦了擦脸，见雀溪走来，他道：“昨晚睡得怎么样？”
“挺好的。”
“那就好。”
刚从部落出来那几天，兽人们风餐露宿，也都适应，唯独雀溪不同。
他夜里睡不着，白天无精打采，短短几天，分明养好的身体看起来又跟摔伤那几天没什么两样。
路程还长，这样下去肯定不行。
好在他自己也知道，慢慢在调整。
雀溪伸手探入水中，看着不远处轰鸣的瀑布，陷入回忆中。
他轻声道：“再走一段时间，前面有一片大湖和一排很长的崖壁，那边住着不少羽族。”
林楸偏了偏头，听完他说的话，微微点头。
这些雀溪之前都说过，林楸也记着。
天慢慢亮起来，大家要继续赶路。
大伙儿草草吃过早饭，把昨天烧的热水灌入自己的水壶里，然后背上行李和货物，继续南行。
没什么兽人活动的林子里，藤蔓交错，灌木丛丛，高大的树木遮天蔽日，脚下根本没有路可言。
领头的狼火和狼影得找到好下脚的地方走，后头的兽人就踩着他们的脚步，跟着往前跑。
他们每个兽人背上都驮着东西，稍不注意，绑在背上的兽皮袋或藤筐就会勾住树枝、擦过碎石，降低兽人们的速度。
这路也不是一直都是平坦的，有时候翻山，有时候下坡，极消耗兽人们的体力。
他们从双眼潭离开，闷头走了一日，只午间停下来用水潭里的鱼和野菜煮了一锅乱炖，吃完又继续走。
等翻过这一片矮小群山，总算到了一处稍微平坦的地方。
羽猎从半空中降落，收拢翅膀，背上的兽皮袋顺着羽毛滑下。
“涯！走。”
羽涯和同伴快速放了东西跟上。
每到一个地方，他们需要先巡视一下附近，看一看有没有其他兽人和部落的存在。确认安全，又飞回来通知大家，兽人们这才放下行李，有序地挖灶搭锅，忙活起来。
他们这会儿停在一颗巨大的枯树旁，这树也不知道长了多少年，七八个兽人都难以合抱。
树中间已经空了，里面放着些干草，看着是有小兽或者兽人住过的痕迹，但味道已经浅得几乎闻不到。
林楸放了东西，没急着走。
他见天空阴沉沉的，把狼冰抓来，叫他看看之后这几天的天气。
狼冰跟那干旱天里龙王吐雨似的，爬上树顶，四处看了看，就吐出一个字：“雨。”
林楸：“几天？”
不下雨得走，下雨也得走，只是更难走了些。
狼冰：“看不出来。”
林楸瞧着还挂在树梢的兽人，招了招手道：“行了，下来吧。还是学艺不精，回去再跟祭司学学。”
狼冰滑下枯树，收拾自己今晚睡觉的地方去。
天快黑了，等会儿就看不清了。林楸叫了兔艾他们过来，把大树洞收拾出来。
这地方大，晚上里面睡几个兽人还是可以的。顺带还要砍些树枝，搭个遮雨的棚子。
他们现在有刀有斧，干这活儿游刃有余。
队伍里兔兽人少，就只有三个，兔艾领着兔林和兔草过来帮忙。收拾完山洞，兔艾道：“楸，我们去割点干草回来。”
“行，别走远了。”
“诶！”兔艾领着同伴离开。
兔艾他们都是灰兔兽人，变成兽形时，那一身毛发在林子里是很好的伪装。
他们一走，刚刚才出去捕猎的狼金急匆匆跑回来。
“楸！”
“我把兔艾吓晕了！”
林楸这会儿爬在树上，一刀下去，树枝直接掉落在地。狼金那一嗓子吓得他差点把手上的刀甩出去。
落在地上的树枝被狼岩捡起来，堆在一处。
他们两个同时看过去，见狼金臂弯里捧着一个灰色兔子。
他快速下树，道：“兔艾不是刚刚才出去？”
狼岩扫了一眼，嫌弃：“不是兔艾。”
兔艾听到那一声吼叫，吓得忙带着同伴回来，听到兽人对话，两眼一懵。
“谁叫我？”
狼金一愣。
他看了看自己抱着这个，再看看三个兔兽人。
“啊？”
他手一松，那灰兔兽人直直摔在地上，还弹了弹。
林楸：“……”
这瞎眼的狼崽子！
*
兔牙是小南山灰兔部落的兽人。
他们住的这个位置在东部大陆西南角，靠近中央大陆。附近就一群小山，东南西北也没什么大型部落。
灰兔部落这个名字对灰兔兽人一族来说很普遍。灰兔能生，能养，所以整个兽神大陆几乎都有他们同族兽人，部落的名字大多也按照他们的种族来取。
他们小南山这个灰兔部落只有六十来个兽人，是个小部落。
他们胆儿小，为了安全起见，兽人们居住在地下，最大的那个巢穴的位置正好就在大枯树底下。
这个时候，部落兽人们都去种植地干活儿去了，他们的种植地藏在小山之中，离这边还有点距离。
族长他们没回来，兔牙就带着小崽们藏在地下。他带着一群幼崽本来睡得好好的，哪知道巢穴上方忽然传来震动声。
小南山这边偏僻，路也不好走，这么些年几乎没来过兽人。
兔牙听到那动静，一猜就知道是个大体型的兽人部落，吓得他声都不敢出，当场开始转移自家幼崽。
他刚把幼崽藏好，又怕族人们回来正好撞见他们，只能忍住惧意，从距离巢穴最远的一个洞口出来，打算去通风报信。
哪曾想刚冒头，直直对上那个狼兽人笑眯眯的一双眼。
他一口气没上来，脑袋一歪，就直挺挺地倒了下去。
纯属是被吓的。
*
“你个蠢货！”
兔牙迷迷糊糊醒来时，隐约看到那个堵了他路的狼兽人。
他正在挨骂。
兔牙心口一紧，目光转动，看见围了他一圈的狼兽人，倒吸一口凉气，又要晕。
“交换吗？”
“啊、啊？交换……”兔牙晕晕乎乎，被兽人扶着坐起来。
他一看是自己阿爸，一下扑过去，脑袋埋在兽人怀中。
兔水颤抖着手，盖在自己幼崽背上，笑容略显僵硬地看着眼前的一众兽人。
他们是种地回来时，看到这群狼兽人和羽族兽人在他们部落上面扎营。
没等他们逃跑，早埋伏在周围的兽人就把他们包围了。
这会儿，同是灰兔兽人的兔艾坐在他们面前，安抚他们，好说歹说，兔水才确定他们真不是来偷袭的。
他们部落住的地方在地底下，出口离这一处远。是以，这地方没有他们的气味。
要不然他们还以为这群兽人们真发现了他们的巢在哪儿，要直接往下掘。
等兔艾安抚好这群灰兔兽人的情绪，天都黑了。
今晚照旧是一锅乱炖，兽人多，采集回来的东西也多。
看在他们进了人家地盘，又吓到人家幼崽这事儿上，狼兽人把食物给兔兽人们分了分。
味道虽然差点，但有盐有油。
狼冰听了吩咐，拎着一罐子食物过来，放在兔兽人们面前。
咚的一声——
把人家长耳朵都吓出来了。
狼冰：“当做是占了你们地方的报酬。”
兔兽人们不敢动，紧紧缩在一起。虽然明白了他们只是路过，但还是怕的。
“我们没有多的碗，你们自己看怎么分。”狼冰道。
说完，林楸也端着陶碗过来，他往兔艾旁边一坐，示意他也去吃饭。
兔水拍着幼崽后背，颤颤巍巍道：“谢、谢谢。你们说的交换……”
林楸：“不客气，应该的。交换的话……你们要想换什么？最好尽快，明天一早我们就得走了。”
“你们有什么？”
林楸看了眼他身边放着的陶罐，道：“你们先垫垫肚子再说。”
这群兔兽人脸白得吓人，林楸怕他们真厥过去。
兔水犹豫着，放开幼崽，点出两个族人去把山洞里的果壳拿出来。
食物分发下去，灰兔兽人们还挤挤挨挨坐在一堆，手里捧着果壳，看着那绿油油的汤，试探着喝了一口。
林楸眸光一闪，还是差点戒备心。
“盐！”兔水惊道。
他身后藏起来的一堆灰兔兽人也怔怔看着手上的果壳碗，难以置信。
盐多难得，他们亲眼看着这群兽人用黑漆漆的锅做了那么多食物，里面的盐却放得足足的。
那得放多少！
林楸点头，“我们有盐，也有陶器、兽皮和草药之类的，就看你们愿意交换什么。”
“换盐。”
林楸毫不意外。
“你们用什么交换？”
“豆子，行吗？”
chapters.translated_text:
The sun hung low in the twilight, and a flock of birds gathered, circling in the low sky.

*Whoosh—*

An arrow shot out, leaving a blurred trail. The shaft hummed as it pierced straight into a tree trunk, pinning a long snake that had been perfectly camouflaged against the leaves.

The snake struggled desperately, twisting its body, but within a few breaths, it hung limp.

In the jungle, the footsteps of the beastmen were light.

Stepping over withered branches and rotting leaves, he approached in a few strides, pulled out the arrow along with the snake hanging from it, shook it to confirm it was dead, and tossed it into the rattan basket on his back.

"Qiu! We're back!"

Lang Jin led the young wolf-beastmen and Yu Ya’s group back.

Fifteen newly matured wolf-beastmen, plus five Black Feather beastmen, made for a perfect squad of twenty.

They were all tall and lithe, moving with a brisk, wind-like pace, some carrying long blades, others with heavy bows slung over their backs and quivers at their waists. With bare upper bodies and animal skins wrapped around their waists, they burst out of the woods, as excited as wild men.

This was their tenth day since leaving Wolf Mountain.

The group of beastmen had passed through the Black Feather tribe and kept heading southwest, yet they hadn't encountered a single tribe since.

Places without beastmen activity were infested with snakes and insects.

Lin Qiu glanced quickly at the rattan basket on Lang Jin’s back. Through the holes, he saw the colorful, segmented snake bodies, and goosebumps broke out all over him.

Lin Qiu grabbed Lang Yan’s hand and held it in front of him, saying, "Don't bring that near me."

Lang Jin paused, saying regretfully, "But it looks so good."

"Get lost!" Lin Qiu gritted his teeth.

This pack of wolf pups was just asking for a beating; they knew what he was afraid of and specifically caught these things to bring to him.

Lin Qiu still remembered that only a few days after they set out, Lang Jin had led the others to raid a snake nest. They didn't kill them all, but stuffed them into the basket and placed it right in front of him.

Lin Qiu had been so scared his hair stood on end.

In the end, these little wolf pups just pointed at him and laughed, only to be soundly beaten by Lin Qiu until their faces were bruised—which, looking at them now, still showed faint marks.

Seeing his avoidant reaction, Lang Jin looked longingly at their King.

They just wanted Qiu to see more of them and get used to it; otherwise, if Qiu wouldn't touch them, they’d have to cook them themselves, which would be a waste of the snake's deliciousness.

Lang Yan looked coldly at the troublemaking wolf pups and the Black Feather beastman pups. "Get out."

Lang Jin grunted and left, looking reluctant.

"They're gone."

Lin Qiu released Lang Yan’s hand and shivered.

Thinking of those densely coiled, soft-bodied snakes, another layer of goosebumps rose on his skin. He shuddered, turned, and bit Lang Yan on the shoulder, annoyed, "Look at the good work your little wolves have done!"

Lang Yan, innocently implicated, placed a large hand on Lin Qiu’s head and rubbed it gently.

"I didn't do anything..."

Lin Qiu took a deep breath, forcing down the images of snakes in his mind.

It wasn't his fault he was afraid of these things; the trauma was just too deep, and the little wolves pulling that stunt only made it worse.

He would never touch that thing in his life.

After a long while, Lin Qiu calmed down and finally had the focus to do other things.

He took out the animal skin scroll he carried with him.

They had been walking for ten days, and to avoid going the wrong way, Lin Qiu called Que Xi over to check the path every time they stopped.

Lin Qiu had drawn a map based on the path they took. With the help of the Black Feather beastmen who could fly high, this map was as accurate as it could possibly be.

Right now, they were staying at a place called Twin Eye Pool.

The name "Twin Eye Pool" was coined by Que Xi, who named it himself to remember the landmarks along the way.

This pool sat at the base of a hanging waterfall. Its shape resembled two eyes—round and roughly the same size.

The place was cool, with the small waterfall splashing and mist swirling. The only downside was the abundance of snakes and insects; Lin Qiu had already seen at least three snakes pass by the edge of the pool.

At this moment, Lang Ying and Lang Huo had taken their squad out to forage. Lang Jin’s team had just returned and was squatting by the pool, preparing the prey they had brought back.

Lang Qiao and the remaining beastmen stayed behind to clear a space, dig a fire pit, and set up pots; two pots of water were already boiling.

Lin Qiu withdrew his gaze and gently smoothed out the animal skin scroll, spreading the large piece of hide open.

Two colors were used on it.

One was drawn with the juice of the Everlasting Grass, occupying only a small corner. The rest were sketches made with charcoal, all representing the routes they hadn't traveled yet but had drawn based on Que Xi’s descriptions.

Lin Qiu, Lang Yan, Que Xi, and the newly finished Lang Bing and Lang Rong all gathered around.

The beastmen put their heads together, watching as Lin Qiu first used a charcoal stick to trace the winding route on the skin.

It was just a small segment, not even as long as a finger.

After drawing it, he marked a waterfall and a deep pool at the end, writing a few characters.

"Qiu, what did you write?"

Lin Qiu: "Twin Eye Pool."

The beastmen looked at the strange square characters and felt dizzy. Lang Bing rested his chin on his hand and said, "Useless!"

"You recognize them?"

"Don't recognize them."

Lin Qiu laughed, annoyed.

"A bunch of illiterates."

"What's an illiterate?"

"Just like you lot."

It wasn't that Lin Qiu hadn't considered teaching the beastmen to read, but in the past few years, the beastmen were first struggling to eat, with no energy to spare, and later they were busy from dawn till dusk, leaving even less time.

Lin Qiu looked at the map with more than half the route still untraveled, his eyes sweeping over the beastmen, and an idea formed in his mind.

As soon as the map was folded, Lang Bing and Lang Rong hurried away.

Que Xi didn't want to be a freeloader, so he went to help the beastmen who were cooking.

The space in front of Lin Qiu and Lang Yan suddenly cleared.

"King."

Lang Yan responded, helped Lin Qiu put away the animal skin scroll, and held his wrist, squeezing it lightly. He seemed to have developed this habit of grabbing his hand whenever he had the chance.

"Want to teach them?"

Lin Qiu: "I've already taught them to draw maps; what if they can't read when they have the map later? But can this be taught?"

Lin Qiu had previously heard Lang Yan say that those characters were only found in the notes passed down by the priests, and he feared it might be something only priests could learn.

Lang Yan: "It can be taught."

Lin Qiu: "I see there's nothing to do on the road besides traveling. How about I gather everyone together to teach them before we stop to rest each time?"

Lang Yan: "As long as you have the energy for it."

Lin Qiu said confidently, "It's not a difficult task."

Lin Qiu was a man of action; since he wanted to teach the beastmen to read, he would do it properly. He immediately took out a new piece of animal skin and began to prepare.

By the pool, Lang Jin was grabbing snakes, removing their heads and guts, peeling their skin, and setting aside the medicinal parts to put in a jar for Lang Bing to process later.

His hands were covered in blood, and the bright red liquid dripped into the water through his fingers, dispersing instantly before being carried away by the current.

Lang Bing used a small knife to chop the snake meat into segments, and Lang Rong put them into a basin to wash them again.

The three wolf-beastmen squatted in a row, and as they worked, they felt a chill on their backs.

They turned to look, and the other little wolves lined up along the edge of the pool turned their heads as well.

Behind them, Lang Qiao and the others were boiling water, and further away under the shade of a tree, Lin Qiu was writing and drawing on the animal skin, occasionally discussing something with their King.

Yu Ya squatted by the water, looking left and right, then picked up a stone and threw it into the water, puzzled. "What are you all looking at?"

In the middle, Lang Qiao was also a bit confused.

Only Lin Qiu, sitting opposite, slowly looked over and gave them a slight smile.

It was very friendly, very amiable, and also...

Lang Jin shivered and quickly turned his head back, rubbing his arms.

"Qiu isn't thinking about how to deal with us, is he?"

Lang Jin had an extremely accurate premonition of danger.

Lang Bing: "Hard to say."

Lang Rong: "Very hard to say."

Yu Ya stared with his large, pitch-black eyes. After reaching adulthood, with sufficient nutrition and training with the wolf-beastmen, his arms were as sturdy as frog legs, and the more one looked, the less intelligent he seemed.

"What did you do wrong?"

Lang Jin shook his head mysteriously. "Hard to say, hard to say..."

In any case, he had an ominous feeling.

*

There were no signs of beastman activity in this forest, and there were plenty of wild vegetables and fruits to forage.

Lang Huo and Lang Ying led their team out, picking whatever they could eat.

After a busy session, the things they brought back were a mixed bag, containing a bit of everything.

Away from home, the beastmen ate simply.

They saved the dried vegetables, dried meat, and tail-grass seeds, only throwing whatever food they brought back that day into a pot for a chaotic stew. Whether it tasted good or not didn't matter, as long as it had some oil and salt.

The beastmen had eaten good food before, so eating this now made them look miserable, but they had no choice.

Every mealtime, they looked at Lin Qiu with those pitiful eyes, but Lin Qiu ignored them. Whenever they stopped on the road, he was focused on drawing the map and observing the surroundings.

He hadn't thought of this when he went south last time, but now that the journey was so long, he had a sudden urge to draw a map. As he drew, thinking he probably wouldn't go to the Red Sparrow tribe often in the future, he decided to perfect the route and create a complete map.

If this were finished, even if beastmen traveled this route later without a guide, they could follow the map.

Lin Qiu had thought of it, and Lang Yan had thought of it too.

So, every time they finished a leg of the journey, they sat down to work, having no time to worry about the other beastmen.

After finishing the stew, the beastmen squatted by the pool to wash up.

Some who couldn't sit still held their noses and jumped into the water, splashing it a person's height high. None of the beastmen squatting on the bank were spared.

"Qiu! Mmph—"

Lang Jin swam over, covered Lang Yun’s mouth as he was about to complain, and with a clever move, dragged him into the water too.

The pool was deep, and hearing the shouting, Lin Qiu reminded them, "Be careful."

Lang Jin waved at him with a grin, his other arm circling Lang Yun’s neck—his arm was as thick as a python, suppressing him with absolute strength.

Although Lang Jin was younger than him, he was the captain of the little wolf hunting team, and since he was already an adult, in terms of combat power, Lang Yun really couldn't beat him.

The beastmen were playing in the pool as if they were frolicking, and Lin Qiu, watching the pool, suddenly beckoned to the two captains.

"Qiu?" Lang Huo and Lang Qiao walked over one after the other.

Lin Qiu stood up, walked around the pool, and patted a large rock beside him.

"Need a favor. Carve a few characters."

Lang Qiao: "I'll go get the tools."

Lang Huo stepped on the large rock, leaning his cheek against Lang Ying’s shoulder. "Carve what?"

"Twin Eye Pool," Lin Qiu said. "It looks like two eyes now, but who knows what will happen when the water dries up? Carving it on the stone is safer."

Lang Ying crossed his arms, a glint of light flashing in his eyes.

"Good idea. It would be best to draw every place on the entire continent and mark it. Then, when we need to migrate in the future, we can just decide on a place and follow the route. It would save so much trouble."

Lin Qiu was speechless.

"Why don't you do it?"

Lang Ying curled his lips, pushed Lang Huo’s head away with one hand, and draped his other arm over Lin Qiu’s shoulder. "I can't do it, but I can help you."

Lin Qiu: "Then I'd have to travel across the entire Beast God Continent."

Lang Ying nodded. "I'll go with you."

Lang Huo stood next to Lang Ying, watching them chat happily while he stood there like a tree, ignored by his partner.

Lang Huo sighed and bumped his head against Lang Ying’s shoulder.

"Do you not like me now that you've got me?" He remembered that he had been the one snatched from a cave by Lang Ying.

Lang Ying didn't even look at him, casually covering his mouth.

"Don't say that."

"?"

"It's a bit disgusting."

Lin Qiu laughed twice, pulled an unburnt wooden stick from the fire, wrote a few characters on the stone, told them to carve it accordingly, and then clapped his hands and walked away gracefully.

As the sun set behind the mountains, accompanied by the clinking sounds of carving, stars filled the sky, and the moonlight made the deep pool shimmer like satin.

The beastmen were actually tired too.

The beastmen on night watch took turns, one squatting in a tree, another sitting by the fire. Gradually, the chatter of the beastmen faded, leaving only the sound of long, steady breathing.

*

Dawn broke, and mist swirled.

A few bird calls in the forest sounded near and far, as if veiled by the mist.

The beastmen sleeping on the ground twitched their ears, annoyed, and buried their heads between their large paws.

Lin Qiu’s brow furrowed slightly. Feeling the chill of the morning, he habitually snuggled into his partner’s fur and slowly opened his eyes.

It was just barely dawn, and the depths of the forest were still dark.

The beastmen were sprawled out on the ground, their fur covered in a layer of dew. A bird the size of a fist boldly hopped down from a branch, landed on Lang Yun’s back, tentatively approached, and plucked a tuft of his hair.

Lin Qiu looked at the oblivious beastman, his lips curling slightly, and he rubbed his head into the fur at Lang Yan’s neck.

They still had to travel; there was no time for sleeping in.

Before long, the beastmen got up one after another, yawning and squatting by the pool to wash up.

Lin Qiu cupped a handful of water to wash his face; the pool water was ice-cold, instantly banishing his sleepiness.

Lin Qiu took the cloth draped over his shoulder to wipe his face, and seeing Que Xi walk over, he said, "How did you sleep last night?"

"Pretty good."

"That's good."

In the first few days after leaving the tribe, the beastmen were used to sleeping in the open, but Que Xi was different.

He couldn't sleep at night and was listless during the day. In just a few days, his body, which had clearly been recovering, looked no different than it had during his injury.

The journey was still long; this wouldn't do.

Fortunately, he knew it too and was slowly adjusting.

Que Xi reached into the water, looking at the roaring waterfall in the distance, lost in memory.

He said softly, "After walking for a while longer, there is a large lake and a long stretch of cliffs ahead. Many Feathered beastmen live there."

Lin Qiu tilted his head, listened to what he said, and nodded slightly.

Que Xi had mentioned this before, and Lin Qiu remembered.

The sky gradually brightened, and everyone had to continue their journey.

They ate a hasty breakfast, poured the hot water they had boiled yesterday into their water skins, and then shouldered their luggage and goods to continue south.

In the forest with little beastman activity, vines were intertwined, bushes were dense, and tall trees blocked the sky; there was no path to speak of underfoot.

Lang Huo and Lang Ying, who were leading, had to find a good place to step, and the beastmen behind followed in their footsteps, running forward.

Each beastman carried things on their back; if they weren't careful, the animal skin bags or rattan baskets tied to their backs would snag on branches or scrape against rocks, slowing them down.

The road wasn't always flat; sometimes they climbed mountains, sometimes they went downhill, which was extremely exhausting for the beastmen.

They left Twin Eye Pool and walked head-down for a day, only stopping at noon to cook a stew with fish from the pool and wild vegetables, then continued walking after eating.

After crossing this range of low mountains, they finally reached a slightly flatter area.

Yu Lie descended from mid-air, folded his wings, and the animal skin bag on his back slid down along his feathers.

"Ya! Let's go."

Yu Ya and his companions quickly put down their things and followed.

Every time they reached a place, they needed to patrol the vicinity first to see if there were any other beastmen or tribes. After confirming it was safe, they would fly back to notify everyone, and only then would the beastmen put down their luggage, dig fire pits, and set up pots to get busy.

They were currently stopping beside a huge dead tree; it was unknown how many years it had grown, as even seven or eight beastmen couldn't wrap their arms around it.

The middle of the tree was already hollow, and there was some hay inside, looking like there were traces of small beasts or beastmen having lived there, but the scent was so faint it was almost undetectable.

Lin Qiu put down his things and didn't rush to leave.

Seeing the sky was overcast, he grabbed Lang Bing and told him to check the weather for the next few days.

Lang Bing climbed to the top of the tree, looked around, and spat out one word: "Rain."

Lin Qiu: "For how many days?"

They had to walk whether it rained or not, but it would be even harder if it rained.

Lang Bing: "Can't tell."

Lin Qiu looked at the beastman still hanging in the treetop and beckoned, saying, "Alright, come down. Your skills are still lacking; go back and learn more from the priest."

Lang Bing slid down the dead tree and went to tidy up his sleeping spot for the night.

It was getting dark, and soon they wouldn't be able to see clearly. Lin Qiu called Tu Ai and the others over to clean out the large tree hollow.

The place was large, and it could accommodate a few beastmen at night. They also needed to cut some branches to build a rain shelter.

They had knives and axes now, so they were well-equipped for this work.

There were few rabbit-beastmen in the team, only three, and Tu Ai led Tu Lin and Tu Cao over to help. After cleaning the cave, Tu Ai said, "Qiu, we're going to cut some hay."

"Alright, don't go too far."

"Okay!" Tu Ai led his companions away.

Tu Ai and the others were gray rabbit-beastmen, and when they turned into their beast forms, their fur was excellent camouflage in the forest.

As soon as they left, Lang Jin, who had just gone out to hunt, ran back in a hurry.

"Qiu!"

"I scared Tu Ai unconscious!"

Lin Qiu was climbing a tree at the time, and with one strike of his knife, a branch fell to the ground. Lang Jin’s shout almost made him drop the knife in his hand.

The branch that fell to the ground was picked up by Lang Yan and piled in one place.

Both of them looked over and saw Lang Jin holding a gray rabbit in his arms.

He quickly climbed down the tree and said, "Didn't Tu Ai just go out?"

Lang Yan glanced at it and said with disdain, "That's not Tu Ai."

Tu Ai heard the roar and hurried back with his companions, but hearing the beastmen’s conversation, he was bewildered.

"Who called me?"

Lang Jin was stunned.

He looked at the one he was holding, then at the three rabbit-beastmen.

"Huh?"

He loosened his grip, and the gray rabbit-beastman fell straight to the ground, bouncing once.

Lin Qiu: "..."

This blind wolf pup!

*

Tu Ya was a beastman from the Gray Rabbit tribe of Little South Mountain.

Their location was in the southwest corner of the Eastern Continent, near the Central Continent. There were only a group of small mountains nearby, and no large tribes to the east, west, north, or south.

The name "Gray Rabbit tribe" was very common for the gray rabbit-beastman race. Gray rabbits were prolific and good at raising young, so they had kin almost everywhere on the Beast God Continent, and most tribe names were based on their race.

Their Gray Rabbit tribe in Little South Mountain only had about sixty beastmen; it was a small tribe.

They were timid, and for safety, the beastmen lived underground; the location of their largest nest happened to be right under the large dead tree.

At this time, the tribe members had all gone to work in the planting fields, which were hidden in the small mountains, some distance away.

The chief and the others hadn't returned, so Tu Ya was hiding underground with the little ones. He had been sleeping soundly with a group of cubs when suddenly, vibrations came from above the nest.

Little South Mountain was remote, and the roads were hard to travel; for many years, almost no beastmen had come here.

Hearing the commotion, Tu Ya guessed it was a large beastman tribe, and he was so scared he didn't dare make a sound, immediately starting to move his cubs.

He had just finished hiding the cubs and was afraid the tribesmen would run into them upon returning, so he suppressed his fear and came out from the hole furthest from the nest, intending to send a warning.

Who would have thought that as soon as he popped his head out, he would run straight into the smiling eyes of that wolf-beastman.

He couldn't catch his breath, his head tilted, and he fell straight down.

It was purely out of fright.

*

"You idiot!"

When Tu Ya woke up groggily, he vaguely saw the wolf-beastman who had blocked his path.

He was being scolded.

Tu Ya’s heart tightened, and as his gaze shifted, he saw the wolf-beastmen surrounding him, and he gasped, ready to faint again.

"Trade?"

"Huh, huh? Trade..." Tu Ya was dizzy and was helped to sit up by a beastman.

When he saw it was his father, he lunged forward, burying his head in the beastman’s arms.

Tu Shui’s hands trembled as he placed them on his cub’s back, looking at the crowd of beastmen with a slightly stiff smile.

They had seen this group of wolf-beastmen and Feathered beastmen camping above their tribe when they returned from farming.

Before they could run away, the beastmen who had been lying in ambush around them surrounded them.

At this moment, Tu Ai, also a gray rabbit-beastman, sat in front of them, comforting them. After much talking, Tu Shui finally determined that they really weren't here to raid.

Their tribe lived underground, and the exit was far from this spot. That was why there was no scent of them here.

Otherwise, they would have thought these beastmen had really discovered where their nest was and were going to dig straight down.

By the time Tu Ai had calmed the gray rabbit-beastmen down, it was already dark.

Tonight was the usual chaotic stew; there were many beastmen, and they had brought back plenty of things.

Considering they had entered someone else's territory and scared their cubs, the wolf-beastmen shared some food with the rabbit-beastmen.

Although the taste was a bit lacking, it had salt and oil.

Lang Bing followed orders, carrying a jar of food over and placing it in front of the rabbit-beastmen.

*Thud—*

It scared the long ears right out of them.

Lang Bing: "As payment for occupying your space."

The rabbit-beastmen didn't dare move, huddling tightly together. Although they understood they were just passing through, they were still afraid.

"We don't have extra bowls; you figure out how to divide it yourselves," Lang Bing said.

After saying this, Lin Qiu also came over with a pottery bowl. He sat down next to Tu Ai and signaled for him to go eat.

Tu Shui patted his cub’s back and said tremblingly, "Th-thank you. About the trade you mentioned..."

Lin Qiu: "You're welcome, it's only right. As for the trade... what do you want to exchange? It's best to do it as soon as possible; we have to leave tomorrow morning."

"What do you have?"

Lin Qiu looked at the pottery jar beside him and said, "You should fill your stomachs first."

These rabbit-beastmen were deathly pale, and Lin Qiu was afraid they might actually pass out.

Tu Shui hesitated, let go of his cub, and signaled two tribesmen to bring out the fruit shells from the cave.

The food was distributed, and the gray rabbit-beastmen still sat huddled together, holding the fruit shells, looking at the greenish soup, and tentatively took a sip.

Lin Qiu’s eyes flashed; there was still a bit of wariness.

"Salt!" Tu Shui exclaimed in surprise.

The group of gray rabbit-beastmen hiding behind him also stared blankly at the fruit shell bowls in their hands, unable to believe it.

Salt was so precious; they had seen with their own eyes that these beastmen used black pots to make so much food, yet they had put plenty of salt in it.

How much must they have!

Lin Qiu nodded. "We have salt, as well as pottery, animal skins, and herbs, among other things. It just depends on what you are willing to trade."

"Trade for salt."

Lin Qiu wasn't surprised.

"What are you trading with?"

"Beans, is that okay?"
