chapters.source_text:
狼岩从水里出来，胸口上多了一圈牙印。牙印又被使劲儿搓揉，成了一团红晕，在饱满的肌肉上更显艳气。
林楸懒洋洋地躺在他手臂上，肩颈放松，微微发紧的后背也像被揉散了筋骨，舒服得一时间不想动弹。
他的长裤微微上滑，腿上零零散散分布着些指印。
林楸晃动双腿，侧眼看见狼岩胸口的牙印，又弯唇笑着，再胡乱给他搓揉了两下。
狼岩：“我好心让楸放松放松，你却咬我。”
林楸抬手捂住他嘴，拍了拍他胳膊，等他放松一些，从他身上跳下来。
他理直气壮道：“谁叫你故意引导我……”
“引导你什么？”狼岩手指勾了林楸衣摆，指腹擦过他腰窝，指下的腰腹倏然收紧。
下一刻，他的手被抓住，又挨了一口。
狼岩看着手背上的牙印，“又咬？刚刚白按那么久。”
林楸淡淡瞥来一眼，狼岩笑起来，亲昵地偏头碰了下林楸脑袋，抓过他的手捏着。
“不气。”
林楸轻哼，眉眼舒展，没了那股倦意。
回到山洞，兽人们已经把东西都收拾好了。
狼兽人能夜视，晚上赶路稍稍好一点，但前头被虫子坑了一把，林楸不得不重视起来。
他们来南边又换了不少驱虫的草药，他和狼冰把草药配好，做成药囊让兽人们挂在身上。
怕药囊不够，又磨了些驱虫的草药粉，直接扑在兽人们身上。
“阿嚏……阿嚏！”狼金张大了嘴，犬牙微露，打喷嚏的声音那叫一个响亮。
“拍我鼻子上了！”他控诉。
狼冰一巴掌拍在大狼脑门，溅起一层药粉，“老实点！”
狼金脑子被拍得跟敲梆子似的响。
狼溶在一旁笑，嘴角刚咧开，一股子带着浓烈气味的药粉落在脑袋上，他鼻子动了动……
狼冰顺手捏住他嘴筒子，“忍着。”
“呜……”
“呜也不行。”
兽人都变成了兽形，林楸和狼冰挨个儿给兽人拍药粉，等所有兽人拍完，他们再变成兽形，让兔艾几个捧着药粉往他们身上倒。
待所有兽人把行李和货物背上，前头的狼影狼火看着缓慢暗下来的天色，领路往西走。
队伍如同长蛇出动，一个接一个的兽人紧跟在后头。
天黑，他们走的速度不算太快。
一群巨狼穿梭在树林间，只有爪垫落在晒干的枯叶上的沙沙声。巨狼们竖起耳朵，垂着尾巴，目光盯着前方的同伴，没有一个掉队。
羽猎照旧安排黑羽兽人轮流在前面带路，他则时不时先飞远了去，查探路线和确认附近是否安全。
羽涯他们边看边学，羽猎说，等回来后，这活儿要交给他们来做。
队伍末尾，还是林楸和狼岩。
不过林楸背着的藤筐里多了三个兔兽人。
兔艾爪子搭在藤筐边缘，脑袋顶着筐上盖着的兽皮，身体随着林楸的慢跑一摇一晃。
他鼻子探出来，一耸一耸的，胡子轻颤，嗅闻着附近的味道。
“楸，我们可以下来自己跑的。”兔艾小声道。
林楸一个大跳，越过倒下的枯树，兔艾几个低呼一声，直接倒进藤筐里打个滚儿，团成了个球。
夜风擦过兽人的毛发，像刚掀开锅盖冒出来的蒸汽扑来，兽人感受不到一点凉爽。
林楸大喘了口气，低声道：“夜里赶路比白天费精力，休息的时候还得靠你们做饭。你们三个还没一袋盐重，安生坐着。”
夜晚赶路，一应的事情全都调整过。
最重要的做饭的事现在交给三个兔兽人负责，他们奔跑速度虽快，耐力却不行，兽人们轮流带着他们，也不费事儿，还能保证他们有力气做饭。
兔艾爬起来，爪子又搭上藤筐，一双长耳朵探出来，竖得高高的。
兔林和兔草见状，也跟他一样做。
不让他们跟着跑，那他们就负责警戒。
中央大陆和东部大陆以河为界，兽人们淌水走过波涛汹涌的界河，便正式踏入了中央大陆的范围。
进入这边之后，大伙儿愈发谨慎。
一路上，没有兽人再说话。
圆月高挂梢头，月色澄明。兽人们穿梭在林中，瞧见那兽人走出来的小道，警惕愈盛。
兽神大陆上的部落千千万，中央大陆要占一半。但这些年猎物减少，不少部落四处迁徙，他们多年没回来过，也不知道中央大陆具体情况如何。
单看刚进入中央大陆这边所看到的，便知这边小部落还是不少。那杂草矮浅的道路不是走个一次两次就能走出来的。
但不知道为什么，之前羽猎往这边查探过，这附近并没有什么兽人部落。
兽人们不敢掉以轻心，大伙儿静悄悄地往前赶了半夜的路，中途终于能休息了。
狼火和狼影又往前走了走，等找到一处水源地，队伍才停下来。
大伙儿卸下东西，往旁边一滚，摊开四个爪子如同一张刚刚烙好的面饼。
他们歪着脑袋，双目发直，长长的舌头从嘴角掉出来，耷拉着，急促地喘着粗气。
林楸从货物底下钻出来，已然从兽形变成人形。
他身上只穿了一条短裤便往地上一躺，再也不想动。
他满头大汗，睁眼看着兔艾几个已经开始捡柴生火，林楸哑声道：“不用太麻烦，随便吃点就行。”
兔艾：“煮一锅青菜肉干汤。”
“好……”
林楸趴了会儿，想起这边虫子多，又赶紧坐起来。
狼岩拿了水壶来，往林楸旁边一坐，看着他咕噜咕噜往嘴里灌水，一边给林楸打扇。
林楸一口气喝了半壶水，又交给狼岩，顺带抽走他手中的扇子。
狼岩仰头灌水，跟喝酒似的，那叫一个潇洒豪迈。
林楸扇着风，顺手摸了一把狼岩胸膛。滑滑的，湿湿的，胸肌下的心脏有力地跳动着，不快不慢，除了热得出了不少汗，倒是比他状态好许多。
狼岩喝完，把水壶往身侧一放，抽了帕子，把林楸手上的汗水擦干。
“水壶带少了。”狼岩声音润了些，擦完林楸手上的汗，又给他擦身上。
“水喝完了吗？我们再烧一点。”就这么一会儿，三个兔兽人用爪子刨出了两口灶。兔艾顶着一点泥土看来，寻求林楸和狼岩的意见。
“烧吧。”林楸道。
话落，兔艾抬起爪子往旁边指了指，兔林跟兔草两个蹦过去，立即埋头开挖。
林楸瞧着那飞溅的泥土，摇着扇子感慨道：“让兔艾他们负责做饭果然没错。”
瞧瞧这效率，一点不比其他兽人差。
烧水还是用陶锅，这本来是带出来交换的，但现在用了就用了，还是自己的兽人重要一些。
灶下木柴燃烧，火光朦胧。
兽人们趴在周围空地，一动不动，恢复着体力。
以前是白日赶路，中途停下还能出去采集捕猎，但既然兽人提醒了这边不安全，出于谨慎，狼岩并未安排兽人们夜里行动。
等着兔艾煮熟青菜肉干汤，兽人们补充了下能量，就把土灶埋了，背着东西继续赶路。
对狼金这些个第一次出远门的年轻兽人来说，夜里赶路没有白日里赶路好玩儿。
晚上到处都是漆黑一片，虽然他们能看见，但总没那花花绿绿的色彩吸引兽人。
上半夜相安无事，后半夜一群年轻狼兽人就耐不住性子了。
他们走着走着退到队伍后头来，一个个落在林楸身边。
林楸把他们当空气，只管往前跑，把队伍补齐。
“楸……”
林楸跟着狼岩的步调，低声道：“有事？”
“无聊。”
“那下次就不带你们出来了。”
“不……”狼金怨念地随脚一踢，一根木棒一样的东西被踢得飞了出去，一下砸在了前面狼乔的身上。
狼乔：“敌袭！”
兽人们瞬间停下，背对背围在一起。
狼金：“……”
“嘿嘿……嗷！”
狼岩收回爪子，幽冷的目光盯着这群小狼。
“是要反复提醒，我们是出来干什么的？”
狼金脊背上的毛一根根炸开，迅速回到原来的位置上去。其他年轻狼兽人夹着尾巴，紧随其后。
领头的狼影回头，道：“狼乔，什么情况？”
狼乔看到灰溜溜跑回来的小狼，冷笑一声，又给了他们一爪子。
“没事。”他往地上看了一眼，忽然四条腿飞快往后退开，“等等！有事！”
兽人们警惕起来，目光落在地面。
看清楚那“木棍”的形状，背后忽然窜上来一股凉意。
“王！兽人骨头。”
雨季闷热的夜里，当兽人们举着火把，撩开草丛，看到那散落一地的兽人骨架时，齐齐打了个寒战。
狼岩只看了一眼，立即道：“熄火，走。”
兽人们咽了咽口水，把火把弄灭，快速调整队形继续赶路。
他们跑得比上半夜更快了些。
林楸脑中全是那被草根和青苔缠绕的森森白骨。
他紧跟在狼岩身边，待跑过了这一片林子，跑到朝阳刺破云层落入树丛，队伍停下，林楸才默默往狼岩身前挪了挪，脑袋靠在他胸口。
狼岩正坐着休息，他摸了摸林楸后颈，“吓到了？”
林楸：“有一点。”
圆月、丛林、白骨……任谁忽然见到，也会心脏一紧，后背发凉。
“那些兽人，会不会是我们住的那个山洞的主人？”
“不知道。看那白骨的情况，那些兽人应该死去很久了……别害怕。”狼岩揉了揉自己伴侣的后脑勺。
林楸也不嫌他满身的汗了，靠了狼岩一会儿，压下那点恐惧，才坐直身体。
“接下来的路我们要更加小心。”林楸眉头微皱，一脸慎重道。
狼岩：“嗯。”
走了一夜，大伙儿都困了。
这处没有山洞，大家只能用树枝搭棚子，尽量多地挡住头顶的阳光和时不时下来的一阵雨。
吃过兔艾他们做的黑豆饭后，兔艾几个夜里睡过觉的兽人警戒四周，兽人们去棚子里睡觉。
睡到午间，精神气回来了些，大伙儿再出去找找食物。
午间的食物换兽人做，吃过午饭，兽人们被晒得又急匆匆地躲进棚子下，再睡一觉起来，晚间吃了饭后便又继续赶路。
如此一日接着一日，兽人们进入中央大陆已经走了十来天。
这期间他们遇到过几个小部落，本着蚊子腿再小也是肉的原则，狼岩让兽人们去跟他们做交换，结果连对方兽人的面都没见着。
一次是这样，七八次都是这样，大伙儿就觉得奇怪。
“以前他们这些小部落不跟大部落做交换吗？”
见朝阳出来，兽人们就知道快要休息了。
狼岩：“肯定要，不过不妨碍他们怕。”
“跟大部落交换可不是好交换的，他们这些小部落被压榨得最狠，可是又没办法不交换。”飞在半空的羽猎道。
雀溪飞不动了，他蹲在羽猎的背上，听到两个兽人对话，道：“这边可能不一样。”
“怎么个不一样？”
“这边的兽人要给原野部落上供呢。”
林楸一愣，没想到这一点。
“这边离原野部落多远？”
“看是什么兽人走这段路了，飞得快的羽族也就一两个月，靠四条腿跑的，三四个月、半年都是可能的。”雀溪道。
林楸：“那他们是不是应该没有可以交换的东西了？”
兽人们听到林楸这话沉默了。
好像……是这样的。
中央大陆的兽人要用那些好不容易攒下来的东西给自己部落交换盐之类的必需品，除此之外，还需要每年不断地给原野部落上供。
狼顺：“那咱们背这么多东西……”
“白、白背了？”狼云讷讷道。
兔艾搓搓脸，道：“应该不至于，小部落不行，大部落会不会好一点？”
雀溪蹲在羽猎后背，他目光远眺，瞧着这四周略微熟悉的地方，不确定道：“前头有个金猴部落，他们部落有七八百个兽人，应该可以吧。”
羽猎：“多远？”
“就那座山头。”雀溪指了指正西边那三座山。
一高两低，飞在半空中看，就跟一个山字一模一样。
金猴部落的兽人脾气好，算是中央大陆东南角最大也最好相处的部落。他们部落的兽人相当团结，堪比狼部落了。
当时熊沉本来盯上他们部落的，但被金猴部落的祭司先一步察觉，金猴部落先发动攻击，让本来有两三百兽人的流浪部落顿时少了一半兽人。
“王？先过去还是先休息？”前头狼火往后侧着个脖子问。
狼岩：“休息。”
那是个大部落，不知是敌是友，兽人们赶了一夜的路太过疲惫，以防万一，交换的事等休息好了再说。
兽人们原地修整，睡觉。
雨季天黑得晚，太阳落下时，天空还一片白。
兽人们赶着吃完晚饭，白日睡饱了一觉，这会儿精神抖擞地背上东西向着金猴部落前行。
“金猴部落的领地就是那三座山头。”
中央大陆的兽人部落多，兽人们的领地也小一些。
狼岩没急着让队伍靠近，而是让羽猎带着兔艾先走一趟。
羽猎是黑羽兽人，金猴部落肯定会有所防备。带上兔艾，显得无害一些。
这边，两个兽人过去传话。
他们刚到那半山腰，就看到一群金灿灿的金猴兽人穿梭在树丛中，手上举起石块、果子，眼看着要往这边砸过来。
兔艾忙道：“我们是过来交换的！”
羽猎低头，对上那个蹲在树叶间，一身金色长发的雄兽人，“我们就在山脚下等你们。”
羽猎这下不敢轻易说盐，太张扬了。
要是这附近再藏个原野部落的兽人，他们就是在给自己招来祸患。
羽猎跟兔艾传递完消息就离开，刚落地没多久，就听到那林子里树叶晃动的咯吱声。
“来了。”林楸看着远处山林，隐隐约约见到一群金色头发的兽人涌下来。
他们在山间如履平地，细长的树被他们当做秋千，抓着往下一摆一跳，便跃到相隔十几米的另一棵树上。
眨眼间，一群金猴兽人就到了他们跟前。
林楸见过四个小黑猴，再见金猴，发现他们长相并没什么区别。
不过小黑猴是一团黑，那毛毛短一些，金猴兽人则是一头金发，灿烂得仿若金子在发光，毛发也要长一些。
为首的金猴兽人头发微卷曲，皮肤白，眼睛也泛着淡金色。
他打量了他们一圈，道：“哪里来的狼部落？”
“东部大陆。”
猴灿目光看向狼影，再看向狼岩。
“两个狼王？”
“我们结伴出来交换的。听说这边不安全。”狼影道。
猴灿点头，“确实不安全，你们要换什么？”
听猴灿这话，像是来跟他们交换的兽人不少。
狼影：“草药、食物。”
“换多少？”
“看你有多少了。”
猴灿听到狼影这口气，笑了一声，道：“我们部落不换草药，食物倒是很多。不过都是各种各样的果子，看你们换不换。”
“什么果子？”
猴灿手往后招了招，立即有兽人抬出一个草筐来。
这筐子跟他们的藤筐不一样，是用一种看起来颇有韧性的干草编成的，又整齐又精致。
兽人们看了眼里面的果子，自发让开，直接看向林楸。
他们大多是没去过大集市的兽人，没见过这些果子，也不知道南边这些果子好不好吃。
在他们心中，林楸肯定是知道的。
猴灿看在眼里，双手抱臂，靠在树干上一脸随意地等着。
他们金猴部落会种植很多种果树，那三个山头的树几乎都是他们种出来的，每年每个时间段，几乎都有果子吃。
金猴部落的兽人不怎么挨饿。
这附近的兽人没有吃的，还会来他们部落交换，金猴兽人都习惯了。
这会儿看到是狼兽人、黑羽兽人和兔兽人混杂的队伍，再看那大包小包的东西，心里对他们的话也信了几分。
同样，也有点同情。
“你们东部大陆的食物还是少。”猴灿道。
林楸弯下腰，看着那草筐里不下十种的热带水果，眼睛晶亮，连连点头。
“嗯，我们的食物少。”
猴灿：“看在你们大老远找过来，这样，你们能交换五种果子，一种最多两筐。”
“这么多……”林楸一边听他说话，一边拿起一个香蕉，“可以尝尝吗？我们都没吃过。”
猴灿扬起下巴，“都试试吧，选自己喜欢的，别到时候又跑回来说我们骗你们换不好吃的。”
“谢谢。”
林楸已经记不清多久没吃过这些水果了。
香蕉、芒果、各种瓜类……与他们部落种的那些果子不同，这些果子个头大，长得又饱满。光是凑近那草筐，便闻到浓烈的果香味儿。
林楸挑出来些，给自家兽人分了分。
香蕉甜中带酸，是树熟，香蕉味极浓。口感也很绵软，不过……还是跟林楸以前吃过的不同，它有核，而且还不小。
他们这群狼兽人、黑羽兽人还有兔兽人就没到过大陆最南边，哪能吃过这么多果子，一时间，吃得都险些忘了他们是来跟人家交换的。
林楸吃完，擦了擦嘴，看了眼狼岩。
狼岩点头，“换。”
“五种，选好了？”猴灿问。
林楸他们本意是换些草药和这边有的一些粮食，比如说有灰兔部落那样的黑豆就再好不过了。
不过这些水果兽人们也没吃过，换来一些给大家尝尝也可以。他们还要赶路，一种水果换两筐正好合适，多了还不好带，也容易坏。
林楸和狼岩同意，又问了问兽人们想换的果子，便决定好了。
猴灿让兽人们回去准备果子，他看了看这群落魄的狼兽人，眼里露出一丝同情，也没打算跟他们浪费时间。
他找了个兽人来，把事情交给他就打算走了。
换这么点果子，还用不上他。
他作为金猴部落的族长，只是下来确认一下他们到底是好是坏，是否心存恶意。
“我们的果子一草筐要二十张兽皮，或者一筐肉干，你们用什么换？”被猴灿点出来的猴耀一本正经地问道。
林楸正在指挥兽人们把藤筐空出来，闻言，他道：“肉干不行……”
守在山脚的其他金猴兽人一副了然的样子。
“不过盐、陶罐、草药，还有些蜡烛、火柴和渔网之类的小东西你们看……”
“你说什么？”猴耀眨巴一下金色的眼，呆呆地看着林楸。
林楸：“盐、陶罐、草药……”
“族长！！！”
叫声嘹亮，回荡山间。
“你要死啊！叫什么叫！吓我一跳！”回音传来，猴灿慢吞吞挂在树枝上下山。
“他们要交换。”
“废话！”
“盐。”
咔嚓一声——
树枝折断，挂在树上的猴灿一下掉进树丛。不一会儿，他顶着一头树叶跑出来，道：“你刚刚说什么？”
“盐？”
“盐！”猴灿挡在族人身前，眯着眼，警惕地看着他们。
林楸笑容微敛。
这眼神，不对啊……
chapters.title: 第226章
chapters.translated_text:
Lang Yan emerged from the water, a ring of tooth marks blooming on his chest. The marks had been rubbed vigorously, turning into a flushed, reddish patch that looked even more alluring against his well-defined, muscular chest.

Lin Qiu lay lazily against his arm, his shoulders and neck relaxed. His back, which had been slightly tense, felt as if the muscles had been kneaded into softness, and he felt so comfortable that he didn't want to move for a moment.

His long trousers had slid up slightly, revealing scattered finger marks on his legs.

Lin Qiu wiggled his legs, caught sight of the tooth marks on Lang Yan’s chest out of the corner of his eye, and curled his lips into a smile, giving them another messy rub.

Lang Yan: "I was kind enough to let Qiu relax, yet you bite me."

Lin Qiu raised a hand to cover his mouth, patted his arm, and once Lang Yan loosened his grip, he jumped down from him.

He said righteously: "Who told you to deliberately lead me on..."

"Lead you on to what?" Lang Yan’s fingers hooked the hem of Lin Qiu’s shirt, his fingertips brushing against his waist dimple, causing the waist and abdomen beneath his touch to suddenly tighten.

The next moment, his hand was grabbed, and he received another bite.

Lang Yan looked at the tooth marks on the back of his hand: "Biting again? All that pressing just now was for nothing."

Lin Qiu cast a faint glance at him. Lang Yan laughed, affectionately tilted his head to bump against Lin Qiu’s, and grabbed his hand to knead it.

"Don't be angry."

Lin Qiu gave a light huff, his brows smoothing out, the weariness gone.

Back at the cave, the beastmen had already packed everything up.

Wolf-beastmen have night vision, making travel at night slightly easier, but after being tripped up by insects earlier, Lin Qiu had to take it seriously.

They had traded for quite a bit of insect-repellent herbs in the south. He and Lang Bing prepared the herbs and made sachets for the beastmen to hang on their bodies.

Fearing the sachets wouldn't be enough, they ground some more repellent herbs into powder and dusted it directly onto the beastmen.

"Achoo... Achoo!" Lang Jin opened his mouth wide, his canines slightly exposed, his sneezing sound incredibly loud.

"It got on my nose!" he accused.

Lang Bing slapped the big wolf on the forehead, sending a layer of powder flying: "Behave!"

Lang Jin’s head rang like a drum from the slap.

Lang Rong was laughing on the side, but just as his mouth spread into a grin, a puff of pungent herbal powder landed on his head. His nose twitched...

Lang Bing casually pinched his snout: "Hold it in."

"Wuu..."

"Wuu won't work either."

The beastmen transformed into their beast forms. Lin Qiu and Lang Bing went one by one to dust the beastmen with powder. Once all the beastmen were done, they transformed, letting Tu Ai and the others pour the powder onto them.

Once all the beastmen had their luggage and goods strapped on, Lang Ying and Lang Huo, looking at the slowly darkening sky, led the way to the west.

The team moved like a long snake, one beastman after another following closely behind.

It was dark, so they didn't travel too fast.

A group of giant wolves wove through the forest, with only the rustling sound of paw pads landing on dried, withered leaves. The giant wolves pricked up their ears, lowered their tails, and kept their eyes on the companions in front, with no one falling behind.

Yu Lie continued to arrange for the Black Feather beastmen to take turns leading the way, while he would occasionally fly ahead to scout the route and confirm if the surroundings were safe.

Yu Ya and the others watched and learned; Yu Lie said that after they returned, this job would be handed over to them.

At the end of the line were still Lin Qiu and Lang Yan.

However, the wicker basket on Lin Qiu’s back now contained three rabbit-beastmen.

Tu Ai rested his paws on the edge of the basket, his head against the animal skin covering it, his body swaying with Lin Qiu’s jogging.

His nose poked out, twitching, his whiskers trembling slightly as he sniffed the scents nearby.

"Qiu, we can get down and run ourselves," Tu Ai said softly.

Lin Qiu took a big leap over a fallen dead tree. Tu Ai and the others let out a small cry, tumbling into the basket and curling into a ball.

The night wind brushed past the beastmen’s fur like steam rising from a freshly opened pot; the beastmen didn't feel a hint of coolness.

Lin Qiu took a deep breath and said in a low voice: "Traveling at night is more energy-consuming than during the day, and we have to rely on you to cook when we rest. The three of you don't even weigh as much as a bag of salt, so just sit tight."

For night travel, everything had been adjusted.

The most important task of cooking was now assigned to the three rabbit-beastmen. Although they were fast runners, their endurance was poor. The beastmen took turns carrying them, which wasn't much trouble and ensured they had the energy to cook.

Tu Ai climbed up, rested his paws on the basket again, and a pair of long ears poked out, standing high.

Seeing this, Tu Lin and Tu Cao did the same.

If they weren't allowed to run, they would be responsible for keeping watch.

The Central Continent and the Eastern Continent were separated by a river. Once the beastmen waded across the turbulent boundary river, they officially stepped into the territory of the Central Continent.

After entering this side, everyone became even more cautious.

Along the way, no beastman spoke again.

The full moon hung high in the treetops, the moonlight clear and bright. The beastmen wove through the forest, their vigilance increasing as they spotted paths worn by beastmen.

There are thousands of tribes on the Beast God Continent, and the Central Continent accounts for half of them. But with prey decreasing over the years, many tribes have migrated, and they hadn't been back in years, so they didn't know the specific situation of the Central Continent.

Just looking at what they saw upon entering the Central Continent, it was clear that there were still quite a few small tribes here. Those paths with short, sparse grass weren't made by walking just once or twice.

But for some reason, when Yu Lie scouted this area before, there were no beastman tribes nearby.

The beastmen didn't dare to let their guard down. Everyone traveled quietly for half the night before finally being able to rest.

Lang Huo and Lang Ying went a bit further ahead, and only after finding a water source did the team stop.

Everyone unloaded their things and rolled onto the ground, spreading out their four paws like freshly baked flatbreads.

They tilted their heads, eyes glazed, long tongues lolling from the corners of their mouths, panting heavily.

Lin Qiu crawled out from under the goods, having already shifted from beast form to human form.

He was wearing only a pair of shorts and lay on the ground, not wanting to move anymore.

He was drenched in sweat. Opening his eyes to see Tu Ai and the others already starting to gather wood for a fire, Lin Qiu said hoarsely: "Don't go to too much trouble, just eat something simple."

Tu Ai: "Boiling a pot of vegetable and dried meat soup."

"Okay..."

Lin Qiu lay there for a while, then remembered there were many insects here and quickly sat up.

Lang Yan brought a water skin, sat down next to Lin Qiu, watched him gulp down water, and fanned him at the same time.

Lin Qiu drank half a skin of water in one go, handed it to Lang Yan, and took the fan from his hand.

Lang Yan tilted his head back and drank, like he was drinking wine—so dashing and heroic.

Lin Qiu fanned himself while casually touching Lang Yan’s chest. It was smooth and damp, and the heart beneath the pectoral muscles was beating strongly, neither fast nor slow. Despite being hot and sweaty, he was in much better shape than Lin Qiu.

After drinking, Lang Yan put the water skin aside, took a cloth, and wiped the sweat off Lin Qiu’s hands.

"We brought too little water." Lang Yan’s voice was softer. After wiping Lin Qiu’s hands, he wiped his body.

"Is the water finished? We'll boil some more." In just this short time, the three rabbit-beastmen had dug two stoves with their paws. Tu Ai looked over with a bit of dirt on his head, seeking advice from Lin Qiu and Lang Yan.

"Boil it," Lin Qiu said.

As soon as he spoke, Tu Ai pointed his paw to the side, and Tu Lin and Tu Cao hopped over and immediately buried their heads in digging.

Watching the flying mud, Lin Qiu shook his fan and remarked: "It was definitely the right choice to have Tu Ai and the others in charge of cooking."

Look at this efficiency—not a bit worse than the other beastmen.

They still used the pottery pot to boil water. It was originally brought for trade, but since they were using it, they might as well—their own beastmen were more important.

The firewood burned under the stove, the firelight hazy.

The beastmen lay on the surrounding open ground, motionless, recovering their strength.

Previously, they traveled during the day and could go out to forage or hunt during stops, but since the beastmen had warned that it wasn't safe here, out of caution, Lang Yan did not arrange for the beastmen to move at night.

Waiting for Tu Ai to finish the vegetable and dried meat soup, the beastmen replenished their energy, buried the earth stoves, and continued on their way with their luggage.

For young beastmen like Lang Jin who were traveling far for the first time, traveling at night wasn't as fun as traveling during the day.

At night, everything was pitch black; although they could see, it lacked the colorful sights that attracted the beastmen.

The first half of the night was uneventful, but in the second half, the group of young wolf-beastmen couldn't sit still.

As they walked, they retreated to the back of the team, one by one ending up beside Lin Qiu.

Lin Qiu treated them like air, just kept running forward to keep the team in formation.

"Qiu..."

Lin Qiu followed Lang Yan’s pace and said in a low voice: "Something up?"

"Bored."

"Then I won't bring you out next time."

"No..." Lang Jin kicked out in frustration. Something like a wooden stick was kicked flying and hit Lang Qiao in front.

Lang Qiao: "Enemy attack!"

The beastmen stopped instantly, surrounding each other back-to-back.

Lang Jin: "..."

"Hehe... Ow!"

Lang Yan retracted his claws, his cold, gloomy gaze fixed on this group of young wolves.

"Do I need to remind you again why we are out here?"

The fur on Lang Jin’s spine stood on end, and he quickly returned to his original position. The other young wolf-beastmen tucked their tails and followed closely behind.

The leader, Lang Ying, looked back and said: "Lang Qiao, what's the situation?"

Lang Qiao saw the young wolves scurrying back and sneered, giving them another swipe with his paw.

"Nothing." He looked at the ground, then suddenly his four legs scrambled backward: "Wait! Something is wrong!"

The beastmen became alert, their eyes fixed on the ground.

Upon seeing the shape of that "wooden stick," a chill suddenly crept up their backs.

"King! Beastman bones."

In the humid night of the rainy season, when the beastmen held up torches and pushed aside the grass to see the scattered beastman skeletons, they all shivered in unison.

Lang Yan took one look and immediately said: "Extinguish the fire, move."

The beastmen swallowed hard, put out the torches, and quickly adjusted their formation to continue their journey.

They ran faster than they had in the first half of the night.

Lin Qiu’s mind was filled with the ghastly white bones entangled by grass roots and moss.

He followed closely by Lang Yan’s side. After running past this patch of forest, until the morning sun pierced the clouds and fell into the trees and the team stopped, Lin Qiu silently moved in front of Lang Yan and leaned his head against his chest.

Lang Yan was sitting and resting. He stroked the back of Lin Qiu’s neck: "Scared?"

Lin Qiu: "A little."

The full moon, the jungle, the white bones... anyone would feel their heart tighten and their back turn cold if they saw that suddenly.

"Those beastmen, could they be the owners of the cave we lived in?"

"I don't know. Looking at the state of the bones, those beastmen must have died a long time ago... Don't be afraid." Lang Yan rubbed the back of his partner’s head.

Lin Qiu didn't mind his sweat anymore. He leaned on Lang Yan for a while, suppressed the fear, and then sat up straight.

"We need to be even more careful on the road ahead," Lin Qiu said with a frown, looking very serious.

Lang Yan: "Mm."

After walking all night, everyone was sleepy.

There were no caves here, so everyone had to use branches to build shelters to block as much of the overhead sun and the occasional rain as possible.

After eating the black bean rice made by Tu Ai and the others, the rabbit-beastmen who had slept at night kept watch, and the beastmen went into the shelters to sleep.

Sleeping until noon, their energy returned, and everyone went out to find food.

At noon, other beastmen took turns cooking. After lunch, the beastmen were scorched by the sun and hurriedly hid back under the shelters. After another nap, they ate dinner in the evening and continued their journey.

Day after day, the beastmen had been in the Central Continent for ten days.

During this time, they encountered several small tribes. Adhering to the principle that even a mosquito's leg is meat, Lang Yan let the beastmen go to trade with them, but they didn't even get to see the other beastmen's faces.

Once was like that, and seven or eight times were the same, so everyone found it strange.

"Didn't these small tribes trade with big tribes before?"

Seeing the morning sun come out, the beastmen knew it was almost time to rest.

Lang Yan: "They definitely did, but that doesn't stop them from being afraid."

"Trading with big tribes isn't a good deal. These small tribes are squeezed the hardest, but they have no choice but to trade," said Yu Lie, flying in mid-air.

Que Xi couldn't fly anymore; he was squatting on Yu Lie’s back. Hearing the two beastmen talk, he said: "It might be different here."

"How is it different?"

"The beastmen here have to pay tribute to the Yuanye tribe."

Lin Qiu was stunned; he hadn't expected this.

"How far is it from here to the Yuanye tribe?"

"It depends on what kind of beastman is walking this road. Fast-flying Feather-folk take a month or two, but for those on four legs, three, four months, or even half a year is possible," Que Xi said.

Lin Qiu: "Then shouldn't they have anything left to trade?"

The beastmen fell silent upon hearing Lin Qiu’s words.

It seemed... that was the case.

The beastmen of the Central Continent had to use the things they had painstakingly saved to trade for necessities like salt for their tribes, and in addition, they had to constantly pay tribute to the Yuanye tribe every year.

Lang Shun: "Then we carried all this stuff..."

"For nothing?" Lang Yun muttered.

Tu Ai rubbed his face and said: "It shouldn't be that bad. Small tribes might not work, but what about big tribes?"

Que Xi squatted on Yu Lie’s back, looking into the distance at the slightly familiar surroundings, and said uncertainly: "There is a Golden Monkey tribe ahead. Their tribe has seven or eight hundred beastmen; they should be okay."

Yu Lie: "How far?"

"Just that mountain range." Que Xi pointed to the three mountains to the due west.

One high and two low—looking at them from mid-air, they looked exactly like the character for "mountain" (山).

The Golden Monkey tribe beastmen had good tempers and were considered the largest and easiest to get along with in the southeast corner of the Central Continent. Their tribe was quite united, comparable to the Wolf tribe.

At that time, Xiong Chen had originally targeted their tribe, but the Golden Monkey tribe’s priest noticed it first. The Golden Monkey tribe launched an attack first, causing the wandering tribe, which originally had two or three hundred beastmen, to suddenly lose half of them.

"King? Should we go over first or rest first?" Lang Huo asked, turning his neck back from the front.

Lang Yan: "Rest."

That was a big tribe, and they didn't know if they were friends or foes. The beastmen were too exhausted from traveling all night, so just in case, they would talk about trading after they were well-rested.

The beastmen rested on the spot and slept.

In the rainy season, it got dark late. When the sun set, the sky was still bright.

The beastmen hurried to finish dinner. Having slept well during the day, they were now full of energy and carried their things toward the Golden Monkey tribe.

"The territory of the Golden Monkey tribe is those three mountains."

There were many beastman tribes in the Central Continent, so the beastmen’s territories were smaller.

Lang Yan didn't rush to let the team approach, but instead had Yu Lie take Tu Ai to go first.

Yu Lie was a Black Feather beastman, and the Golden Monkey tribe would definitely be on guard. Bringing Tu Ai made them appear more harmless.

Over here, two beastmen went over to pass the message.

Just as they reached the mountainside, they saw a group of golden-colored Golden Monkey beastmen moving through the trees, holding stones and fruits in their hands, looking like they were about to throw them over.

Tu Ai hurriedly said: "We are here to trade!"

Yu Lie looked down, meeting the eyes of a male beastman with long golden hair squatting among the leaves: "We will wait for you at the foot of the mountain."

Yu Lie didn't dare to mention salt easily now; it was too flashy.

If there were beastmen from the Yuanye tribe hiding nearby, they would be bringing disaster upon themselves.

Yu Lie and Tu Ai left after delivering the message. Not long after landing, they heard the creaking of leaves shaking in the forest.

"They're coming." Lin Qiu looked at the mountain forest in the distance and faintly saw a group of golden-haired beastmen pouring down.

They moved on the mountains as if on flat ground, using thin trees as swings, grabbing them to swing and jump, leaping to another tree more than ten meters away.

In the blink of an eye, a group of Golden Monkey beastmen was right in front of them.

Lin Qiu had seen the four little black monkeys, and seeing the golden monkeys, he found there was no difference in their appearance.

However, the little black monkeys were a ball of black with shorter fur, while the Golden Monkey beastmen had golden hair, as brilliant as gold, and their fur was also longer.

The leading Golden Monkey beastman had slightly curly hair, white skin, and eyes that shimmered with a pale gold.

He looked them over and said: "Where did this Wolf tribe come from?"

"The Eastern Continent."

Hou Can’s gaze turned to Lang Ying, then to Lang Yan.

"Two wolf kings?"

"We came out together to trade. We heard it's not safe here," Lang Ying said.

Hou Can nodded: "It is indeed not safe. What do you want to trade?"

Hearing Hou Can say this, it seemed like quite a few beastmen came to trade with them.

Lang Ying: "Herbs, food."

"How much to trade?"

"Depends on how much you have."

Hearing Lang Ying’s tone, Hou Can laughed and said: "Our tribe doesn't trade herbs, but we have plenty of food. However, it's all kinds of fruits; see if you want to trade for them."

"What kind of fruits?"

Hou Can waved his hand behind him, and immediately a beastman brought out a grass basket.

This basket was different from their wicker baskets; it was woven from a type of dried grass that looked quite resilient, neat and exquisite.

The beastmen looked at the fruits inside, spontaneously moved aside, and looked directly at Lin Qiu.

Most of them were beastmen who had never been to a big market; they hadn't seen these fruits and didn't know if these southern fruits were delicious.

In their hearts, Lin Qiu must know.

Hou Can saw this, crossed his arms, leaned against a tree trunk, and waited casually.

Their Golden Monkey tribe grew many kinds of fruit trees; the trees on those three mountains were almost all planted by them. Every year, at every time of year, there was almost always fruit to eat.

The Golden Monkey tribe beastmen didn't go hungry much.

Beastmen nearby who didn't have food would come to their tribe to trade, and the Golden Monkey beastmen were used to it.

Seeing that it was a mixed team of wolf-beastmen, Black Feather beastmen, and rabbit-beastmen, and looking at the big and small bags of things, he believed their words a little.

At the same time, he felt a bit of sympathy.

"Your Eastern Continent still has little food," Hou Can said.

Lin Qiu bent down, looking at the more than ten types of tropical fruits in the grass basket, his eyes bright, nodding repeatedly.

"Mm, we have little food."

Hou Can: "Seeing that you came all this way, how about this: you can trade for five types of fruit, at most two baskets of each."

"So many..." Lin Qiu listened to him while picking up a banana: "Can we taste them? We've never eaten these."

Hou Can raised his chin: "Try them all, choose what you like, don't come running back later saying we tricked you into trading for bad-tasting things."

"Thank you."

Lin Qiu couldn't remember how long it had been since he had eaten these fruits.

Bananas, mangoes, various melons... unlike the fruits grown in their tribe, these fruits were large and plump. Just getting close to the basket, one could smell the strong fruity fragrance.

Lin Qiu picked some out and distributed them to his beastmen.

The banana was sweet with a hint of tartness; it was tree-ripened, and the banana flavor was extremely rich. The texture was also soft, but... it was still different from what Lin Qiu had eaten before. It had seeds, and they weren't small.

This group of wolf-beastmen, Black Feather beastmen, and rabbit-beastmen had never been to the southernmost part of the continent, so how could they have eaten so many fruits? For a moment, they were so busy eating they almost forgot they were here to trade.

Lin Qiu finished eating, wiped his mouth, and looked at Lang Yan.

Lang Yan nodded: "Trade."

"Five types, have you chosen?" Hou Can asked.

Lin Qiu and the others originally intended to trade for some herbs and some grain available here, for example, black beans like the Gray Rabbit tribe had would be best.

However, the beastmen hadn't eaten these fruits either, so trading for some for everyone to taste was fine. They still had to travel, so two baskets of each fruit was just right—too much would be hard to carry and easy to spoil.

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan agreed, asked the beastmen what fruits they wanted to trade for, and made their decision.

Hou Can let the beastmen go back to prepare the fruit. He looked at this group of down-and-out wolf-beastmen, a trace of sympathy in his eyes, and didn't plan to waste time with them.

He found a beastman, handed the matter over to him, and planned to leave.

Trading for this little bit of fruit didn't require him.

As the chief of the Golden Monkey tribe, he only came down to confirm whether they were good or bad and whether they harbored any malice.

"Our fruit costs twenty animal skins per grass basket, or one basket of dried meat. What are you using to trade?" asked Hou Yao, who had been pointed out by Hou Can, with a serious face.

Lin Qiu was directing the beastmen to empty the wicker baskets. Hearing this, he said: "Dried meat won't work..."

The other Golden Monkey beastmen guarding the foot of the mountain looked as if they understood.

"But salt, pottery pots, herbs, and some small things like candles, matches, and fishing nets, see if you..."

"What did you say?" Hou Yao blinked his golden eyes, staring blankly at Lin Qiu.

Lin Qiu: "Salt, pottery pots, herbs..."

"CHIEF!!!"

The call was loud, echoing through the mountains.

"Are you dying?! Why are you yelling! You scared me!" An echo came back, and Hou Can slowly hung from a tree branch and came down the mountain.

"They want to trade."

"No kidding!"

"Salt."

*Snap*—

A branch broke, and Hou Can, who was hanging on the tree, fell into the bushes. A moment later, he ran out with a head full of leaves and said: "What did you just say?"

"Salt?"

"SALT!" Hou Can blocked his tribesmen, squinting his eyes and looking at them vigilantly.

Lin Qiu’s smile faded slightly.

This look... something is wrong.

"You have salt?"

The atmosphere turned tense in an instant; the two groups of beastmen separated, guarding against each other.

Lang Ying stood at the front of the group, still as calm as ever. He said, "Is it strange to have salt?"

"That's way too strange." Hou Can bared his teeth. Thinking of those frustrating matters, his eyes weren't even as bright as before.

"The salt in the Central Continent has all been collected by the Yuanye Tribe, and the places where salt is produced are guarded by their beastmen. If we want to eat salt here, we must have their permission. You dare to come here to trade for salt? Do you not want to live?"

Lang Ying: "We didn't know. We came from the Eastern Continent."

"That's right, Chief, they came from the Eastern Continent."

Hou Can pressed a palm against Hou Yao's face and pushed him away. "Forget about the salt."

"Huh?" Several young beastmen couldn't hide their surprise.

This was the first time a tribe had refused to trade salt with them.

"If the Yuanye Tribe finds out we traded salt with you, the Golden Monkey Tribe won't be far from destruction." There was a smile on Hou Can's face, but it was a bitter one.

"I advise you to leave quickly after you finish trading. The Central Continent is full of Yuanye Tribe beastmen everywhere. If you get targeted by them..."

"We've already been targeted," Lang Jin muttered.

"If you won't trade, then don't." Lang Ying said indifferently. "Pick something else."

Hou Can was choked up.

He had given a kind warning, and the beastmen didn't even care.

"We are in a hurry, don't dawdle. Pick." Lang Ying said.

Hou Can: "Forget about pottery too. The pottery in the Central Continent now all comes from the Yuanye Tribe."

Lang Ying was so angry he laughed.

"This tribe is shameless to this extent?"

If he remembered correctly, this tribe didn't know how to fire pottery before. The Qiushan Tribe, which knew how to fire pottery, had been wiped out.

Hou Can was amused by him; these words sounded truly satisfying.

He looked at this group of wolf beastmen and said with some nostalgia: "If only the Central Continent were still like it used to be."

Several large tribes kept each other in check, and they wouldn't do these things like forced buying and selling. He didn't know where those large tribes of the Central Continent had gone back then.

In the end, Hou Can chose animal skins.

It just so happened that the wolf beastmen had traded for quite a lot of animal skins from the tribes in the Eastern Continent, so trading them away made things easier for them.

Although animal skins were light, they took up a lot of space, and carrying them on the beastmen's backs felt like carrying a mountain.

After the trade, Lin Qiu remembered what Que Xi said about their tribe having a priest, and asked: "This is our first time here, can we trade with you for some medicinal pouches commonly used here?"

The wolf beastmen remembered the incident of being bitten by insects earlier and nodded hurriedly, looking at the Golden Monkey beastmen in front of them.

Who knew their expressions would change drastically? Without saying a word, they just waved their hands and entered the forest, never to be seen again.

Lin Qiu: "What's the situation?"

Lang Ying: "The beastman tribes of the Central Continent have been made so strange by that group of shameless beastmen."

"Forget it. Let's go quickly." Lang Huo distributed the fruits they had traded for to the team and went to the front to lead the way.

The beastmen bypassed the south side of the Golden Monkey Tribe. As they passed by, Lin Qiu glanced up at the mountain.

It was getting dark, and the vast mountain forest on the south side was all planted with bananas.

Most of the fruit couldn't be seen, but the banana trees grew in clusters and looked exceptionally sturdy.

The Golden Monkey Tribe beastmen must be very good at growing fruit; with their planting ability, their lives shouldn't be bad.

"The Yuanye Tribe chief's hands are really long," Lang Huo said.

Lang Ying sneered: "If they didn't do this, how could that group of beastmen who only sit and wait for meat to fall from the sky fill their stomachs?"

Behind them, Lang He said: "They have already reached Wolf Mountain."

"Then won't the other tribes in the Eastern Continent suffer next?" Lang Yun said.

Lang Huo: "Who knows."

They could only look after themselves; as for other tribes, whether they lived or died depended on themselves.

The team slowly walked past the edge of the Golden Monkey Tribe. In the forest on the mountain, on the tallest trees, the Golden Monkey beastmen looked like clusters of golden sunlight, making the whole tree look golden.

"They still didn't listen to the chief," Hou Yao said.

Hou Can: "They came from the Eastern Continent and haven't seen the power of the Yuanye Tribe, so of course they aren't afraid."

"Then should we remind them again?"

The trees were very high, and the beastmen squatted quietly on the trees, looking at the wolf beastman team below from afar. They looked like small moving insects, very, very small.

"No need." Hou Can thought of his own priest, his golden eyelashes drooping, and he turned to enter the depths of the mountain.

The night was deep, and the forest was filled with dense insect chirping.

"The Golden Monkey beastmen said there are Yuanye Tribe beastmen everywhere here, why haven't we met any?" Lang Yun said.

Lang He: "Was the one we met in the Eastern Continent fake?"

"That was just one time."

"How many more times do you want..."

"Ahhhhh—" A piercing scream came from the forest ahead. Instantly, all the beastmen stopped and huddled closely together.

Lang Yun was dazed, then received a claw from his partner.

"Talk less in the future."

Lang Yun buried his head in Lang He's neck, whimpering pitifully: "This is my fault too..."

Lin Qiu looked ahead.

It was now the second half of the night. The beastmen were heading straight west, and in a while, they should reach the place where the sound came from.

Lang Yan: "Put the things down and hide them."

"Yu Lie, go investigate. Lang Huo, Ying, take half the beastmen to the front to see."

Lang Yan arranged it quickly. The beastmen rustled as they put their things down and hid in the forest. Lang Yan and Lin Qiu followed the advancing Lang Huo squad.

The screaming continued. Lin Qiu listened; it sounded very much like the squealing of a pig being slaughtered.

He quickly followed at Lang Yan's side, catching up with the team in front.

When they got close to the screaming, all the beastmen stopped.

The sound disappeared.

Yu Lie, who had arrived first, retreated and squatted among the beastmen, saying in a very low voice: "Visually, they are all Gray-Winged beastmen, a small team of twenty to thirty. The one making the sound is a Gray-Pig beastman, now knocked unconscious."

Several leading wolf beastmen nodded.

"Alright, stop kicking! If you kick him to death, you go explain it to the chief!"

Hearing the sound from the forest where the firelight was shining, the beastmen immediately fell silent and slowed their breathing.

Lin Qiu and Lang Yan looked at each other and moved quietly. The two beastmen peeked through the bushes.

Behind the bushes was a cleared flat ground.

On the flat ground, several low sheds were built with branches and animal skins, and beastmen were walking inside. Outside the sheds, a fire was burning, and eleven Gray-Winged beastmen were sitting outside. On the ground lay a wild boar?

This must be the Gray-Pig beastman.

"This Gray-Pig beastman doesn't want to leave, how can we carry him? Just kill him..."

"Shut up!" The leading beastman scolded. Suddenly, he paused. He looked up and stared straight into the forest.

Lin Qiu quickly withdrew his gaze and held his breath.

He mobilized his five senses to the limit, hearing the beastman's slow footsteps moving forward, feeling the scent of the beastman carried in the wind...

"Captain?"

The leading beastman raised his hand. Suddenly, he leaped, spread his wings, and rushed toward this side.

Lang Ying, hanging on a tree, struck swiftly, grabbed his neck, and twisted it. With a soft click, the beastman was dead as could be.

In an instant, the dark forest fell into silence again.

"Captain? Captain!"

"Stop calling, are you in heat!" The animal skin covering the shed was lifted, and more than ten beastmen walked out one after another.

Lin Qiu looked at the limp beastman corpse beside him, moved his feet, and leaned closer to Lang Yan.

"The captain is gone."

Yu Lie stood on the tree and lowered his voice: "They have all come out."

As soon as he finished speaking, all the wolf beastmen rushed out, tacitly aiming at one Gray-Winged beastman each.

With just one palm, the wolf beastman hooked the wings of the Gray-Winged beastman trying to fly away, and with another slap, crushed the beastman's brain directly.

A moment later, the forest was quiet.

However, there was a flapping sound of wings behind them. The beastmen turned back quickly and saw Lin Qiu stepping on a beastman's back, pinching the beastman's neck, his face tense and his eyes cold.

The beastmen thought Lin Qiu wouldn't dare to take action.

"I'll do it." Lang Huo stepped forward.

Lin Qiu: "Wait, let's ask about the situation first."

The beastmen looked at the Yuanye Tribe beastmen dead on the ground, their hostility dissipated, and their eyes became clear.

Oh right, they seemed to have killed them too cleanly.

"Which tribe are you from?! You dare to lay hands on our Yuanye Tribe beastmen, you..."

Bang! The beastman's head hit the ground.

Lang Huo withdrew his claw and shook it. Seeing his companions looking at him, he said: "Don't worry, I controlled the force, didn't kill him."

After the beastmen cleared the area, the other beastmen who had hidden brought the goods over.

Everyone sat together, looking at the two Gray-Winged beastmen surrounded in the middle.

The Gray-Pig beastman was unconscious.

The Gray-Winged beastman was awake.

But now he didn't dare to shout anymore, instead looking at the group of sturdy, fierce-looking wolf beastmen, shrinking back in silence.

Lang Huo took out the knife he carried and pressed it against the beastman's neck, saying coldly: "Speak, how many beastmen are there in total? What are you doing here?"

"All, all here, they were all killed by you."

"Do you think we're stupid!"

Lang Huo slashed down with the knife. The beastman felt pain in his neck and realized that the thing in the other's hand was exceptionally sharp; it only needed a little more force—

"I'll say! I'll say!" He trembled in fear. "We have ten squads in total, coming from the Yuanye Tribe, responsible for searching south of the Yuanye Tribe, searching..."

"Searching for what!" Lang Huo pressed the knife down, watching the blood gushing from the cut, feeling satisfied.

This knife was useful.

He grinned, smiling so much that the Gray-Winged beastman felt a chill all over, thinking he had encountered some pervert.

He didn't dare to hide anything and spilled everything he knew without stopping for a moment.

Lang Huo gagged the beastman and dragged him away.

When he came back, he had a smell of blood on him, and that beastman had disappeared.

Lin Qiu extinguished the fire a bit, leaving only a faint glimmer of light.

The beastmen were solemn and silent.

Que Xi thought that although his tribe was in the Western Continent, it was also in the south. According to the speed of the Gray-Winged beastmen, it would only take a few months to get there from the Central Continent.

He was terrified and couldn't help but say: "Why are they catching so many priests?"

"To control the tribes?" Tu Ai recalled what the beastman had just said, and felt a chill in his heart.

"In that case, the priest of the White Feather Tribe and the priest of the Golden Monkey Tribe might have been caught by them."

"What do you mean might! It's exactly that!"

The beastmen's eyes gathered on the awake Gray-Pig beastman.

He sat up and scolded angrily: "The Yuanye Tribe chief wants to be the chief of all the tribes in the Central Continent. All the priests on our side have been caught by them. Even me... if I hadn't eaten enough and been heavy enough for them not to be able to carry me, and just happened to meet you..."

As he spoke, the Gray-Pig beastman wiped his eyes and cried.

Lin Qiu: "You are?"

"Priest of the Gray-Pig Tribe, Zhu Zhong."

A person as their name.

Lin Qiu looked at his big belly, as if he were carrying ten babies. These days, fat beastmen were rare, and a beastman who could eat until he was this fat could be considered rare.

"The Gray-Winged beastman just said the Yuanye Tribe sent ten squads of beastmen to the south of the Central Continent?"

Zhu Zhong: "Definitely more than ten squads."

"How so?"

"You wait for me."

Zhu Zhong darted into the shed and came out as a burly man. He had animal skin wrapped around his waist, carried an animal skin bag in his hand, threw it on the ground, and then clapped his hands and sat down.

The beastman's image didn't match the priest Lin Qiu had imagined.

It was his stereotype.

The beastman fiddled with the animal skin bag, and the other beastmen craned their necks to look. They thought it was some evidence that could prove the Yuanye Tribe sent beastmen to cause trouble in the south of the Central Continent, but the beastman untied the rope, held a corner of the animal skin bag, and poured it out with a clatter—

It was all roots of some huge plants?

"..."

"Do you eat bamboo shoots?"

Lin Qiu looked at the beastman's sincere eyes, "...Yes, thank you."

"You're welcome, there are more in the shed. These beastmen were afraid I would starve to death on the road, so they brought me quite a few bamboo shoots."

"Produced by your tribe?"

"Of course." Zhu Zhong skillfully broke the bamboo shoot skin and handed it to Lin Qiu.

The beastmen looked at the thing in Lin Qiu's hand called a bamboo shoot; it was shelled, white, and tender. It smelled fragrant, similar to the grass they ate.

Zhu Zhong shared the bamboo shoots with the beastmen, then hurriedly tore one open and took two bites himself.

Looking at his hurried appearance, it turned out he was hungry...

Lin Qiu: "Can you talk now?"

"Sp-speak to where?"

"They didn't just send one team to the south." Lin Qiu took a bite of the bamboo shoot; it was very crisp, a bit sweet, and not bitter at all.

Lin Qiu heard several crisp sounds, looked up, and saw that the other beastmen were also gnawing on them.

They didn't have much of an appetite now, but eating this made them feel refreshed and comfortable.

"Eh, right! Right!" Zhu Zhong finished a big fat bamboo shoot in two or three bites and peeled another one to continue gnawing.

He used his big belly as a dining plate. When his hands got tired, he put the bamboo shoot on his belly, and after chewing crunchily in his mouth, he took two more big bites.

He said while eating: "The Yuanye Tribe beastmen should be the most numerous in the entire Central Continent now, even the Northern, Eastern, and Western Continents don't have such large tribes with so many beastmen."

"How do you know?"

"I'm a priest."

"That's true, priests know more than we do." Lang Qiao chewed the bamboo shoot. "Your bamboo shoots are delicious."

"Right? I asked them to bring the most delicious kind of bamboo shoot." Zhu Zhong wiped his nose and continued, "Our tribe is a bit further south. A bit further past that are the tribes by the sea. We often see Yuanye Tribe beastmen active there."

"I asked the little cubs in the tribe to guard and count; there are at least five hundred Yuanye Tribe beastmen stationed there."

"Five hundred?!" The beastmen raised their heads, their cheeks still bulging.

"You heard right, it's five hundred. That tribe by the sea is the largest salt-producing tribe in the Central Continent. They controlled that place five years ago."

Zhu Zhong rubbed his belly, the anxious hunger disappeared, and he looked at the wolf beastmen with gratitude.

"Thank you for saving me, but there are indeed Yuanye Tribe beastmen everywhere here. Since I wasn't taken back by them, they will definitely send beastmen again. You'd better leave early."

Lin Qiu: "And you?"

"Me? I have to hurry back to the tribe. I'm afraid the little cubs in the tribe are ignorant and will get into a fight with the Yuanye Tribe beastmen. Although we have many tribesmen, we can't withstand their wave after wave of beastmen."

"This is disgusting." Lang Ying finished the last bite of the bamboo shoot and commented.

"Yes, especially disgusting." Zhu Zhong looked at Lang Ying as if he had found a soulmate.

"By the way, do you know where our tribe is? Do you want to come with me... forget it, don't come with us. Tell me where your tribe is, and as a thank you, I'll send you a few hundred bags of bamboo shoots."

He patted his chest, making a dull sound.

"Don't worry, our tribe doesn't have other food, but bamboo shoots are enough."

Hearing this, the beastmen looked at Lin Qiu and Lang Yan.

Lang Yan: "We came from the Eastern Continent."

"Eastern Continent?" Zhu Zhong shook his head. "That won't do, it's too far. The bamboo shoots won't be delicious by the time they are delivered."

"Looking at you, you are going west?"

"Yes."

"Then wait for a period of time, when the storm passes, come to our tribe to find me when you return. If I'm not there... find the chief Zhu Li, I'll tell him to dig them for you."

"Okay."

Hearing their king agree, the beastmen grinned.

They hadn't eaten this thing called bamboo shoots before, but it was refreshing and delicious in the rainy season, not greasy at all, a good thing.

They saved the beastman, so it was only right to accept what the other party gave.

The beastmen had no thoughts of being humble or polite.

"There are a few more bags of bamboo shoots in this shed. I'll take two bags for the road, and the rest are all yours. If you want to come to our Gray-Pig Tribe in the future, remember, just follow this, go straight south, and you'll arrive after passing a high cliff."

He looked at the Black-Winged beastmen among this group of beastmen and wasn't worried that they couldn't get down the high cliff.

"Then I'm leaving, thank you."

The beastman stood up, his belly round, his limbs sturdy, looking exceptionally fat. His speed was slow, and after carrying two bags of bamboo shoots, he stopped to catch his breath before continuing.

Lang Jin stood behind him and said enviously: "How good must their tribe's food be."

Lang Bing: "Let's go!"

They went into the beastman shed, rummaged through the things, took the other four bags of bamboo shoots, and continued their night journey.

The animal skin bag brushed against the leaves, making a slight rustling sound.

Not long after walking, the rustling sound suddenly became louder. Lin Qiu's nose tip felt wet. The beastmen hurriedly retreated to their previous position and drilled back into the shed.

It was actually raining!

"Are we still going?" Lang Ying squatted at the entrance of the shed, unable to stand the stuffy, smelly bird odor inside.

Lin Qiu: "Let's wait until the rain gets smaller."

The rain in the rainy season always came without warning. It rained for a while, and it got heavier.

Thunder rumbled, and lightning tore through the night sky.

Taking advantage of the rain, Lang Yan simply pointed to some beastmen to go out, take tools, and start digging holes.

"What are they doing?" Tu Kui asked, poking his head out from under the shed.

Lin Qiu: "Destroying the evidence."

"Boom—" A thunderclap exploded. Tu Ai was startled and shook, turning back to hug the other two companions.

Tu Lin and Tu Cao also hugged Tu Ai tightly.

Lin Qiu found it funny, "Scared?"

Tu Ai shook his head, "Not scared."

The wolf beastmen weren't scared, so what were they afraid of.

"Qiu." Lang Ying held a wild foxtail grass he didn't know where he pulled from and tapped his hand.

"Hmm?"

Lightning flashed across the sky. The three rabbit beastmen next to him had their ears tightly tucked behind their heads, but Lang Ying was still leisurely. He said: "You said they caught so many priests, is it really to control these tribes?"

"Is that High Priest so useless now?"

If one had to say who controlled these tribes the most severely on this continent, it was none other than that High Priest who used the name of the Beast God to make other tribes obediently hand over food.

It just so happened that the Beast God was an inviolable, supreme existence in the hearts of the beastmen, and the High Priest's lineage was indeed related to the beastmen who were once incarnations of the Beast God, so those tribes believed the High Priest's words deeply.

He had mentally controlled these tribes for so many years, how could he easily lose the belief of the beastmen.

If Lang Ying had to say, now that so many beastmen had left the Yuanye Tribe, it might be that they themselves were the ones pushing it from behind.

Because food was scarce, they might not be able to support so many beastmen.

"In the end, it might still be that there isn't enough food." Lin Qiu's voice mixed with the sound of rain, falling slowly.

Lang Ying's thoughts coincided with his.

Yes, that's it.

Whether it was the Yuanye Tribe mentally controlling these tribes or catching their priests, in the end, it was because the prey on the continent was decreasing year by year... busy back and forth just for that mouthful of food.

Like them, the tribe basically didn't lack food now, and they still traveled so far, wasn't it to save a few more types of edible food seeds, and incidentally trade for herbs.

The heavy rain covered the movements of the beastmen.

Everyone was tired from walking, so they took this opportunity to close their eyes and rest.

When Lang Yan and the others returned, the rain had eased. Everyone knocked down the shed they had stayed in, then carried the goods, covered themselves with straw raincoats, and continued their journey.

They had been out for quite a while. If it went on like this, they would probably return to the tribe after the snow season.

The road in the snow season was also hard to walk. At that time, they definitely couldn't travel like they could in the rainy season, so they might have to stop at some tribe.

...

The heavy rain poured down, and the thunder rumbled for half the night.

Yuanye Tribe, West District.

Lightning broke through the sky, and the whole sky was as bright as day.

Leopard Scar and his companions returned from their mission, soaked all over, and slowly returned to the West District like drowned rats.

At this time, it was reasonable to say that the beastmen of the tribe should be asleep, but there were many beastmen active in the West District.

The West District was where the core beastmen of the tribe lived, and Leopard Scar had only moved here a few months ago.

The sky was pitch black, and on the muddy path, a team of beastmen walked in front.

They looked like they had just returned too.

Leopard Scar lowered his eyes, raindrops sliding down his cheeks, which were deformed by scars, looking quite disheveled.

His companions were all very tired, walking with heavy steps, having no heart to talk, and returned to their rooms when they reached their place.

The team of beastmen in front was excited. Some beastmen jumped up and hung on their companions after walking a few steps, saying something.

Leopard Scar's ears moved. When he heard the beastmen's words clearly, it was like being hit on the head, making his head dizzy, and only buzzing remained in his ears.

"The priest of the White Feather Tribe is really easy to fool... with one coax, they emptied the family wealth of two tribes and left with us, hahaha..."

"The chief will definitely give us many rewards!"

"Keep it down! Don't attract other beastmen to covet it and compete with us for work!"

"Hmph! Who would compete? That ugly beastman next door with a face full of scars who can't speak?"

Leopard Scar stood quietly in the rain. When the beastmen looked over, he slowly looked back.

Lightning instantly illuminated the night sky, and also illuminated the dark eyes of the black leopard beastman. At that moment, the hatred that could no longer be hidden leaked out from those eyes.

"You dare to look at me with such eyes!"

Leopard Scar lowered his eyes, his hands at his sides already clenched until his knuckles clicked softly.

In an instant, he restrained all his sharpness, his gaze slowly swept over the few beastmen, secretly taking note, and turned to leave.

A squad was usually twenty beastmen.

Two were missing here.
