狼西跟狼莫在他身边帮忙，另外六个兽人也是两两一组，各自找山药藤去。
浅层土是松的，一刨就散了。越往下，越吃力。
啪的一声，林楸手上棍子断了。
狼莫爪子抓地，留下一抹深深的痕迹。他看着林楸挖的那处，跃跃欲试，“楸！你让开，我们来。”
不知道是不是激起了种族天赋，几个狼兽人都兴奋起来。
林楸让开，再紧实的泥土在狼爪子下也成了豆腐渣。
后头狼西帮着推开刨出来的土，两个狼兽人配合，都没他什么用处。
林楸索性背着背篓，四个地方走。
“楸！这边出来了！”总有浅的，兽人挖到就叫他。
林楸负责把山药移出来，而兽人继续换另外一个地儿亢奋地刨。
也不知道为什么亢奋，反正就是好奇，藤条下原来还藏着好多好多宝贝。
“楸！”
“来了。”
“楸！这里好多根！”
“楸！断了怎么办？”
“楸！”
林楸小心翼翼地将他那么高的完整的一根山药取下来，仰头看着地面道：“马上！”
兽人们沉浸式体验挖山药的快乐，中午吃的那点鱼攒下的体力，本来打算用来开窑的，现在全面对着山药藤刨得开心。
四队兽人分散，隔得不远，时不时“嗷呜嗷呜”的激动声传来。
林楸背篓早已经装不下了。
等到肚子开始咕咕叫了，眼前有些黑，抬头一看，都快天黑了。
“楸！”
外面有好多双绿眼睛，狼山的兽人们找来了。
林楸：“这边！”
话落，听得兽人脚步匆匆擦过地面的草，没一会儿，眼前清晰了。
林楸讶异，是狼岩。
“你们回来了。”
狼岩看他往背篓里塞长痒痒根，左右看了看，扯下一条树藤来，帮忙绑好剩下的。
八个兽人挖得都忘了开窑，山药成堆，起码三百斤。
这还只是兽人们饥饿状态挖出来的。
狼岩蹲下，将山药绑好，扛在肩上。
林楸跟在他身后，往昏黑的林子里唤了一身狼莫，得到“嗷”的一声回应。
待离开林子，看得清楚了，才见狼莫那八个兽人是被找来的狼兽人背出来的。
挖的时候还不觉得，现在爪子打颤。
“楸！开窑啊！”狼莫出了林子，才想起大事儿。
林楸看向狼岩。
狼岩：“天快黑了，要不明天。”
他离林楸近，感知很清楚。
林楸两个爪子漆黑，眼睛很亮。呼吸有些急，脚步像踩着泥沼里一样沉重。
他累了。
“嗷呜嗷呜嗷呜！王！不要，不要！我们都等了一天了！”刚刚还没力气的兽人，叫起来吵死了。
不知道这边什么事儿，狼山那边的兽人听到叫声也“嗷呜”两声回。
片刻，跟玩儿似的，狼嚎声此起彼伏。
“嗷呜！”
“嗷呜呜！！！”
狼岩皱眉，盯着狼莫。
兽人撇过头去，耳朵贴在脑门，怕！但就是要开窑！
林楸：“现在开吧。”
狼岩：“好。”
经过那几声狼嚎，兽人已经汇聚在窑前。林楸还背着山药，叫狼岩一手拎过去，先放回狼山。
林楸则洗了手，跟着他一起过去。
兽人们都来了，见狼岩跟林楸过来，自动让开路。刚刚还没力气的狼莫几个现在巴巴守在窑口，就等林楸指令。
林楸：“开吧，小心点就行。”
已经两天两夜了，应该不烫。

chapters.translated_text:
As the kiln was opened, a wave of heat still poured out from within. Lin Qiu was a bit tired, and climbing up to the kiln opening took some effort.

Lang Yan reached out his hand, looking at him.

Lin Qiu paused, then slowly placed his hand on top. The rough, warm palm felt so hot that he curled his fingers, feeling a bit unaccustomed to it.

The next moment, Lang Yan exerted a little force and pulled him up.

The beastmen squatted at the kiln opening, peering inside.

"Awoo! It worked, it worked!"

Lin Qiu also took a look and said, "We need to go down and move them up."

"King! I'll go!" Lang An stepped forward.

He was the one who put them in, so he should be the one to take them out. The male beastmen didn't know their own strength; if they accidentally crushed them... all the effort would be wasted.

The sub-beastman went down cautiously. A wave of heat was still baking the inside; even after two days, it hadn't fully dissipated.

One could imagine how hot it must have been when they were being fired.

Lang An moved the ones nearby first. He carefully supported the small pottery jars the beastmen had used for practice, holding them with both hands, confirming they weren't broken before handing them out.

Outside, the beastmen had already lined up.

From the hillside downwards, the line stretched out.

The pottery jars reached Lang Yan's hands first, as he was worried Lin Qiu might be too tired to have the strength.

They felt hard to the touch, even more refined in shape than the original pottery pots in the tribe. The color was reddish, the thickness was uniform, and in some places, one could faintly see the extremely subtle traces of the coil-building technique.

It was only the size of his palm, very delicate.

Lang Yan looked at Lin Qiu, his eyes gentle. He handed the jar over, and Lin Qiu took it, turning it around carefully. "It's a success."

The temperature was sufficient; it wasn't like the mud blocks that would crumble when squeezed after drying, it had successfully turned into pottery.

The beastmen watching from below let out a sigh of relief, a sound Lin Qiu could hear clearly.

Their eyes were burning with intensity, fixed on Lin Qiu's hands.

Such a small jar, what could it be used to hold?

Moving on, they were still the practice jars made by the beastmen.

Lang An didn't dare touch the large ones at first, picking up almost all the small jars and bowls inside; most of them were intact.

Then, the beastmen watched as a large jar slowly emerged from the kiln opening.

It was huge, even bigger than the Priest's!

Lang Yan lifted it up with both hands. Lin Qiu circled it once and met Lang Yan's gaze.

He smiled, like solid ice melting into water, like the first spring flower peeking out in the spring.

Exceptionally beautiful.

"No problem."

Lang Yan: "Good."

The pottery jars began to be passed down, and every beastman had a chance to touch them. Each one was more careful than they were with their own cubs. One who couldn't resist tapping on one had his paw grabbed by a companion and slapped hard.

The slapped beastman rubbed the back of his hand and gave a silly grin.

The jars were passed down to the flat ground at the bottom of the slope, placed together with all the other large and small pottery jars and bowls.

It was as high as a beastman's thigh; if a beastman curled up, they could fit entirely inside.

"Wow!"

"Awoo!"

The beastmen who hadn't managed to get the job of transporting them surrounded the jars, looking again and again, with several paws reaching out to touch them over and over.

The large pottery jar was delivered directly to the Priest.

He leaned on his wooden staff, getting very close to examine it inch by inch.

The fire had turned soft mud as hard as stone, mud kneaded into various shapes, subjected to the roasting of flames, and finally, these pottery jars that had stirred up the tribe were born.

He squinted his eyes, and for a moment, looking at Lin Qiu squatting on the slope, he didn't know what to say.

The beastmen watched the kiln opening as if it were spitting out treasures, letting out an "Awoo" from time to time, and when the treasures were passed to them, they would crowd around again.

Even if every one of them was similar, made of the same material, it didn't stop them from being excited.

In the eyes of the beastmen, these jars of all sizes meant food.

"Two curved-horn beasts."

"Four curved-horn beasts..."

"Wow! So many two curved-horn beasts."

Lang An's hands were sore from holding the jars, and all the contents of the two kilns were finally brought out. Each beastman hugged a jar and headed toward Wolf Mountain.

The beastmen hurriedly set up campfires, with the pottery jars surrounding the fires in three circles.

Lin Qiu was surrounded by the beastmen, sitting by the campfire this time, carefully calculating.

Including all the large and small mud blanks from this batch, a total of sixty were fired. Among them were twenty-four small practice jars, twelve pottery bowls, and twelve small pottery pots. Not counting the pottery chopsticks and spoons, about forty percent were completely intact.

The remaining ten or so large jars and pottery pots were fired in the two kilns. There were three intact large jars and four pottery pots.

For the first firing, it was already quite good.

But Lang Yan was not satisfied.

Lang Mo and Lang Shi grabbed Lin Qiu to review, determined to find out why so many had broken.

Just as Lang Yan was about to snap at them, Lin Qiu pressed his arm and went off with the beastmen with a smile.

He wasn't satisfied either.

It could be even better.

"Tell the beastmen to try cooking meat with the pots and jars first. Lang An and Lang Guo both know how. Be careful, the pots might still break."

After saying this, Lin Qiu returned to his own small campfire.

Seeing the beastmen eager to try, Lang Yan nodded slightly, and Lang An immediately led the beastmen to do it.

Because pottery pots were a rare item in the tribe, beastmen only got to eat porridge cooked in them often when they were cubs.

But the beastmen tried to recall, and after savoring the thought for a long time, they couldn't quite remember the taste.

They had long forgotten what the meat paste cooked in a pottery pot tasted like.

They only remembered the medicinal porridge cooked in the Priest's pottery pot—it was absolutely terrible!

But at this moment, the beastmen dug pits on the spot to make stoves, filling the pottery pots and jars with water.

They watched with their own eyes as Lang An and the others cut the fat from the prey and repeatedly fried it in a small pottery pot. The fat seeped out, and the fragrance was mouth-watering.

The beastmen were so tempted they moved closer, crouching in a circle around the pottery pot.

They were all beastmen who had just returned from hunting and gathering, their fur messy and their stomachs growling. But their eyes were like the sun that occasionally appeared during the rainy season, startlingly bright.

Lang An led Lang Yu, Lang Shuang, and the other six young sub-beastmen left in the tribe, circling the pottery pot.

Accidentally stepping on a beastman's paw while backing up, Lang An looked back and said, "Stay further away, there's no room to move."

The wolf beastmen silently backed up a little bit, continuing to guard the pot while drooling.

"An, when can we eat?"

Lang An: "It's just starting, we need to fry out some oil."

What the beastmen brought back today were curved-horn beasts; hunting for beastmen usually meant these few types.

The curved-horn beasts didn't have much fat; after processing all three of them, they finally rendered out three small pottery jars of oil.

Lang An kept two, and used the other jar to fry the meat.

As for the pots, they were used to stew the leftover meat and bones of the curved-horn beasts, enough for three full pots. The fourth pot was used to stir-fry the wild vegetables the beastmen had brought back, using the oil.

First, the oil was added, and after it was fragrant, the seasonings Lin Qiu had provided were added.

Qiu called them ginger and garlic.

A beastman sneezed, covering his nose with his paw. At first, he thought the smell was strange, but as the ginger and garlic sizzled, the aroma of the meat fat filled the entire area in front of Wolf Mountain.

The beastmen took a few deep breaths—

The area around the campfire suddenly erupted.

"An, is it ready yet?"

"An, it smells so good! I'm so hungry..."

Lang An knew the beastmen were hungry; he was hungry too. He pacified them while adding the sliced meat.

Lang An put in half of the meat slices from a pottery basin.

At this, the heat of the oil made the meat slices curl, and the sizzling sound was lively, like all the insects in the grasslands during the rainy season chirping at once.

The smell of the stir-fried meat surged out, and the stomachs of the nearby beastmen let out a long roar, then they rolled on the ground holding their bellies, "So hungry, so hungry, so hungry..."

"Awoo, awoo, awoo!!!" The beastmen's paws dug into the dirt, sending grass and soil flying. If Lang Yan hadn't been watching nearby, they would have stuck their heads right into the pots.

"An, when will it be ready?"

"An!!!"

Lang An was sweating from their questions.

"Almost, almost!" He waved the wooden spoon he had temporarily borrowed from Qiu, the muscles in his arm tensed, and he was stirring with all his might.

Stir-fried in hot oil, the meat slices were cooked through, and a sub-beastman brought over the washed wild vegetables.

Lang An dumped them into the meat slices.

The beastmen wailed.

"No—"

Lang An: "It's delicious."

"Woo... don't want to eat grass."

"My meat..."

It was impossible not to eat.

With so little meat for nearly a hundred beastmen, it wasn't even enough to pad their stomachs.

Lang An continued to wield the spoon, feeling for the first time that cooking was also hard work. In the past, the meat was just cut up and distributed, and the beastmen would roast it themselves.

He gritted his teeth and continued to stir.

Nearby, the three pots were bubbling, and the meat soup was boiling. The beastmen hadn't been very interested in the bones that didn't have much meat on them, but the fragrance was just as good.

Lang Yan glanced at the other campfire, where a few beastmen were frowning and discussing the pottery pots.

Lin Qiu looked up and met Lang Yan's gaze.

Suddenly remembering the yams they had dug up that afternoon, he beckoned to Lang Yan.

Lang Yan stood up and came over immediately.

Lin Qiu sat cross-legged in front of the fire and said, looking up, "The yams we brought back this afternoon, peel them, cut them into finger-long pieces, and stew them in the bone soup. It tastes very good, and the cubs can eat it too."

Lang Yan nodded.

"Use leaves to separate them, don't let your hands touch the juice, it will itch."

Lang Yan: "Good."

Lin Qiu was used to calling Lang Yan, and the beastmen, with their thick paw pads pressed against the ground, endured the heart-wrenching hunger, their attention briefly diverted.

"King, Qiu?"

"Why does Qiu go over as soon as he calls the King?"

"The King is this obedient?"

As soon as they met Lang Yan's gaze, the beastmen closed their eyes and covered their ears.

The King was clearly very fierce!

"An, peel the yams Qiu and the others dug up today, cut them into pieces, and throw them into the pottery pots. Don't let your hands touch the juice."

Lang An looked at Lang Yu, who nodded and immediately took a few sub-beastmen to do it.

"Yams?" Lang Bei, who was also watching the pottery pots, tilted his head, seeing Lang Yu and the beastmen approaching that pile of itchy roots nearby.

"King, should we gather those next time?"

Lang Yan: "Not for now, they are hard to dig."

The gathering team had to prioritize plants that met the tribe's needs first; digging yams took too much time. It was fine for idle beastmen to dig some, but the gathering team shouldn't bother.

Lang Bing, Lang Jin, and the other young beastmen were guarding the outer circle, heads together.

"Bing, you guys can dig them."

Lang Bing: "We have to dig herbs."

Lang Jin: "Oh, we can dig them."

Lang Rong: "You guys need to train to catch prey."

Lang Bing and Lang Jin looked at Lang Rong at the same time.

Lang Rong wasn't like the two of them; one led the youth gathering team, the other led the youth hunting team, while he ran between both.

Lang Rong: "How can I dig them alone?"

Lang Bing and Lang Jin looked at each other and lay back down.

Lang Jin looked at the large pottery pots bubbling with fragrance by the campfire and swallowed his saliva, "When we have a break, we'll go dig them together."
chapters.source_text:
窑口一开，里头依旧一股热气出来。林楸有些累，爬上窑口有些费力。
狼岩伸手，看着他。
林楸顿住，随后缓缓将手放上去，粗糙温热的掌心烫得他蜷缩手指，有些不习惯。
下一刻，狼岩稍稍使劲儿就将他带上去了。
兽人们蹲在窑口，往下探头。
“嗷呜！成了成了！”
林楸也跟着看了眼，道：“要下去搬上来。”
“王！我去！”狼安站出来。
放也是他放的，就该他拿。雄兽人们不知轻重，万一捏碎了……白费工夫。
亚兽人小心翼翼下去，里头一股热气烘着，都两天了，居然还没散干净。
可想而知，当时烧的时候里面有多热。
狼安先搬附近，他小心地托着兽人们练手的小陶罐，双手捧着，确认没碎开，再递出去。
外头，兽人们早已经站成一溜。
从山坡往下，一直延伸。
陶罐先到狼岩手上，怕林楸这会儿累着没力气。
入手坚硬，甚至比部落里原有的陶锅形状都精致。颜色发红，厚薄均匀，有些地方隐能看出一点泥条盘筑的痕迹，极细微。
才他巴掌大一个，很精巧。
狼岩看向林楸，眼里温和。他将罐子递过去，林楸拿着细细转了一圈，“成了。”
温度足够，不是把泥块烧干硬了一捏就碎的样子，成功陶化。
底下望着的兽人们松了口气，那叹息声，林楸都听见了。
他们眼神灼热，盯着林楸手上。
好小的一个罐子，可以用来装什么？
接着往下，依旧是兽人们练手的罐子。
狼安起先不敢动大的，将里头的小罐子、小碗几乎捡完了，大半都是好的。
再然后，兽人们看着窑口慢慢冒出来个大罐子。
很大，比祭司那个都大！
狼岩双手拎着放上来，林楸绕了一圈，与狼岩对视。
他笑，像坚冰化水，春日里探出头的第一朵春花。
格外漂亮。
“没问题。”
狼岩：“好。”
陶罐往下开始传，兽人们每个都有摸到手的机会。一个个小心得比对幼崽都轻，有忍不住动手敲一敲的，叫同伴抓住爪子，狠狠拍了一下。
被拍的兽人揉着手背，傻呵呵一笑。
陶罐传下去，一直到坡下平地，与那些大大小小的陶罐陶碗放在一起。
它有兽人们大腿高，兽人蜷缩着，能完完整整蹲进去。
“哇！”
“嗷呜！”
没抢到运送这活儿的兽人们将陶罐围住，看了又看，好几双爪子伸出来，在上面摸了又摸。
大陶罐直接送到了祭司跟前。
他杵着木杖，要凑得十分近了，细细地一寸一寸地看。
火焰将柔软的泥土变得如石头一样坚硬，泥揉成各种形状，接受火焰炙烤，最终有了这轰动部落的陶罐子。
他眯了眯眼，一时间竟看着蹲在坡上的林楸，竟不知道该说什么。
兽人们看着那窑口跟吐宝贝似的，时不时“嗷”一声，宝贝传到面前，又围过来。
即便每一个相似，一样的材质，也不妨碍他们激动。
在兽人们眼里，这些大大小小的罐子，就是食物。
“两个弯角兽。”
“四个弯角兽……”
“哇！好多两个弯角兽。”
狼安捧罐子捧到手酸，两个窑里的全部送出来完。兽人们一个抱上个罐子，往狼山去。
兽人们急急忙忙架起篝火，陶罐围了篝火三圈。
林楸被兽人们包围着，这次坐在篝火旁，仔细算了一下。
这一批大的小的泥坯算上，一共烧了有六十个，其中练手的小陶罐有二十四个，陶碗十二个，小陶锅十二个，陶筷陶勺什么都还不算，完好无损的，有差不多四成。
余下十多个大罐子跟陶锅，分两边窑烧。完好的大罐子有三个，陶锅则有四口。
第一次烧，已经很不错了。
但狼不满足。
狼莫跟狼石抓着林楸复盘，势必要把为什么坏这么多的原因找出来。
狼岩刚要凶人，林楸压一压他胳膊，笑着跟兽人们去了。
他也不满足。
还能更好。
“叫兽人们先用锅跟罐子都煮肉试试，狼安跟狼果都会，小心点，锅还有可能会坏。”
说完，林楸就回到自己小火堆边。
狼岩见兽人们跃跃欲试，稍一点头，狼安立刻领着兽人办。
因为陶锅在部落是个稀缺品，兽人们也只有在幼崽时期才能常常吃到陶锅煮出来的糊糊。
但是兽人们回想了一下，咂摸许久也没咂摸出个味儿来。
早忘了陶锅煮的肉糜是个什么味儿了。
只记得祭司那口陶锅煮出的药糊糊，那叫一个难吃！
但此刻，兽人们就地挖坑做灶，陶锅跟陶罐里灌水。
亲眼看着狼安他们把猎物的油脂切下来，放在小陶锅里反复煎，油脂渗出，扑鼻的香。
兽人们馋得靠近，围着陶锅趴了一圈。
他们都是捕猎跟采集回来的兽人，毛发凌乱，饥肠辘辘。但眼睛却像雨季时偶尔出来的太阳，亮得惊人。
狼安带领着狼雨、狼霜及留守部落的另外六个中青年亚兽人，围着陶锅转。
不小心后退踩了一下兽人爪子，狼安回头，道：“离远一点，走不动了。”
狼兽人默默往后退了一丢丢，继续流着哈喇子守着。
“安，什么时候能吃呀？”
狼安：“这才开始，要煎些油出来。”
今日兽人们弄回来的是尖角兽，兽人捕猎，无非就是这几种。
尖角兽的兽油不算多，三头尖角兽全弄完了，最后熬出来三个小陶罐。
狼安留下两个，另一个罐子的用来煎肉。
而锅里，则用没剃干净的尖角兽骨头跟部分肉块炖煮，足足三口锅的量。另一口锅，正好用油炒了兽人们带回来的野菜。
先放油，炒香了放楸的那些调料。
楸叫它们姜、蒜。
兽人打个喷嚏，爪子捂鼻，起先觉得味道奇怪，可随着葱姜蒜爆香，荤油的味道弥漫整个狼山山前。
兽人猛吸了几口——
篝火旁一下子沸腾了。
“安，好了没啊？”
“安，好香！好饿……”
狼安知道兽人馋，他也馋。他一边安抚，然后下切好的肉片。
一个陶盆的肉片，狼安下了一半。
这一下，油温激得肉片卷曲，噼里啪啦的响声热闹非凡，像雨季里遍布草原的所有虫子一起叫。
炒肉的味道猛蹿出来，离得近的兽人肚子长啸一声，随后捂着肚子打滚，“好饿好饿好饿……”
“嗷呜嗷呜嗷呜！！！”兽人们爪子刨得泥土草屑纷飞，要不是狼岩在旁边盯着，脑袋都钻进锅里了。
“安，什么时候好啊？”
“安！！！”
狼安被他们问得汗都出来了。
“快了快了！”他挥舞着临时从楸那里拿过来的木勺，手臂那一点肌肉绷紧，手都抡圆了。
热油爆炒，肉片熟透，亚兽人端着洗干净的野菜来。
狼安将其往肉片里面一倒。
兽人哀嚎。
“不要——”
狼安：“好吃呢。”
“呜……不吃草。”
“我的肉……”
不吃不可能。
这么点肉，百来个兽人，垫肚子都不够。
狼安继续抡勺子，头一回感觉到做饭也要费力气。以往都是肉块切了分了，兽人们自个儿烤就是。
他咬紧牙，继续搅拌。
一旁三口锅咕噜咕噜响，肉汤开了，兽人们原本对没多少肉的骨头不怎么感兴趣，但那香味一点不差。
狼岩看了眼另一个火堆前，几个兽人皱眉说着陶锅的事。
林楸抬头，与狼岩对视。
忽然想起他们今天下午挖的山药，冲着狼岩招招手。
狼岩站起，立马就过来了。
林楸盘坐在火堆前，仰着头道：“我们下午弄回来的山药，皮削掉，砍成手指长的一截放骨头汤里炖，味道很好，幼崽也可以吃。”
狼岩点头。
“用叶片隔着，手别沾着汁液了，会痒。”
狼岩：“好。”
林楸叫狼岩叫得习惯，兽人们厚实的爪垫按在地面，忍着抓心挠肺的馋意，被短暂地转移了下注意力。
“王，楸？”
“楸怎么一叫王就去了？”
“王有这么乖？”
一下对上狼岩的眼神，兽人闭眼捂耳。
王分明很凶！
“安，把今天楸他们挖的山药削皮，切断扔陶锅里。手别沾到汁。”
狼安看了眼狼雨，狼雨点头，立马带着几个亚兽人去。
“山药？”同样围观着陶锅的狼贝歪头，看到狼雨带着兽人靠近不远处那一堆长痒痒根。
“王，下次我们要采集那个吗？”
狼岩：“暂时不用，不好挖。”
采集队要先采集到满足部落需要的植物，挖山药太费时间。空闲的兽人们去挖一挖还好，采集队就算了。
狼冰跟狼金这些个少年兽人守在外面一圈，脑袋对着脑袋。
“冰，你们可以挖啊。”
狼冰：“我们要挖草药。”
狼金：“哦，我们可以挖。”
狼溶：“你们要训练抓捕猎物。”
狼冰跟狼金同时看向狼溶。
狼溶不像他们两个，他们一个带着少年采集队，一个带着少年狩猎队，只有他两边跑。
狼溶：“我一个兽人怎么挖？”
狼冰跟狼金对视一眼，又趴下了。
狼金看着篝火边的几口冒着香味儿的大陶锅，咽了咽口水，“等我们休息了，一起去挖。”
chapters.title: 第31章

chapters.translated_text:
On the other side, Lang Yu was leading several sub-beasts in peeling the yams.

Seeing this, Lang Shi called Lang Mu and the others over to help.

The beastmen used obsidian knives, but with too much force, the yams would snap in two, revealing the white flesh inside. As they peeled more, the leaves they were wrapped in became slippery.

The beastmen, stirred up by the savory scent of meat, couldn't keep their composure. They simply tossed the leaves aside and started peeling them by hand.

By the time Lang Yu returned with a pottery jar full of yams, the beastmen were following behind him, baring their teeth and grimacing in pain as they rubbed their hands against their fur clothing, almost rubbing them until sparks flew.

Lang Yan saw this and frowned: "Did you get it on you?"

The beastmen nodded miserably and reached out to show Lang Yan.

Their hands were rubbed raw and red, and even after washing them repeatedly, they were still itchy; they looked as if they wanted to peel that layer of skin right off.

Elsewhere, Lin Qiu had finished discussing the next clay mixture ratio and firing temperature with the beastmen, planning to continue testing tomorrow.

Here, Lang Mo and the others smelled the fragrant aroma of meat and couldn't hold back any longer, immediately returning to the campfire.

Lin Qiu hadn't intended to go, but his gaze inadvertently drifted over, and he saw the beastmen rubbing their hands in agony, with Lang Yan also frowning as he walked toward him.

He stood up and stopped in front of Lang Yan.

Before he could ask, Lin Qiu said, "It's fine, just roast them by the fire for a while."

Lang Yan's brow relaxed slightly, and he was no longer in a hurry.

He had already warned the beastmen not to get the sap on their hands, but Lang Yan had seen with his own eyes those impatient ones throw away the leaves and grab the yams with their bare hands.

They deserved to learn a lesson.

He said, "Shall we go eat together?"

Lin Qiu hesitated slightly.

Lang Yan: "If you're not used to it, just sit next to me."

Lin Qiu pursed his lips and nodded.

In Lang Yan's eyes, Lin Qiu was still very well-behaved, with a cold look on his fair face and nervousness in his eyes. He was suddenly reminded of his own childhood and reached out to gently ruffle his hair.

"It's okay, it's fine if you don't talk."

Lin Qiu was stunned.

Since he could remember, no one had ever touched his head.

In the eyes of others, he had always been unapproachable. Because of his cold nature and his lack of skill or desire to socialize, he had heard people call him arrogant more than once.

He didn't have any close friends, either.

Lin Qiu was a bit dazed.

A flash of amusement crossed Lang Yan's eyes as he said gently, "Let's go."

Looking at Lang Yan, Lin Qiu relaxed his shoulders and quietly followed him over.

The campfire burned bright red, with sparks rising toward the sky in the wind. The faces of the beastmen surrounding the fire were flushed red, and every one of them had a fiery gaze.

Sitting beside Lang Yan, Lin Qiu felt less uneasy as he listened to the rumbling of stomachs and the sound of people swallowing saliva coming from all directions.

He sat with his legs bent, resting his chin on the heel of his palm.

On the newly dug stove, the bone and yam soup in the three pottery pots was bubbling away. The soup had turned a milky white, and the fragrance was mouth-watering.

The few beastmen who had peeled the yams were now squatting by the stove, hunched over like penguins, foolishly holding their hands out to roast by the fire.

"It's not as itchy anymore!"

"Why does it stop itching when you roast it by the fire?"

"I don't know."

Lang Mu secretly looked at Lin Qiu; the sub-beast really knew so much.

Lang An had just added salt to the vegetables, stirred them, and immediately called for the sub-beasts to bring the jars over to fill them, then hurriedly continued stir-frying the rest of the meat.

Seeing the beastmen who were ostensibly there to roast their hands but were actually hovering around the pottery pot in hunger, their drool almost dripping into the jar, Lang An couldn't help but knock them on the head.

"Go to the campfire! Why are you in the way here?"

The beastmen rubbed their hands, feeling that the itch was gone, and looked amazed.

"An! It really doesn't itch anymore!"

Another beastman was surprised, "You're lying to us, right?"

"If you don't believe me, try it yourself!"

"Try it then!"

Lin Qiu rested his chin on his hand and watched the beastmen actually run toward the pile of yams, his eyes widening slightly. Suddenly, a pebble was thrown from beside him, and a beastman in the distance let out an "Ow!"

Lin Qiu turned his head.

He had seen it; Lang Yan was the one who threw it.

Lang Yan rubbed his fingers, his eyes a bit cold, and he turned his head to say, "They can be a bit stupid sometimes."

Beside the Wolf King, several wolf-beastmen lay on the ground, silently covering their ears with their paws.

They didn't hear anything.

They were very smart!

"Who hit me?" The beastman who had been hit by the stone turned back, eyes wide, looking completely foolish.

All the beastmen were staring at the pottery pots, eyes fixed, and not one of them answered him.

The wolf-beastman felt inexplicably uneasy, "Awooo?"

Lang Yan cast a glance at him.

The wolf-beastman threw himself to the ground, hiding his head in the crook of his arm, as if merging with the earth.

Lin Qiu pursed his lips, suppressing a smile.

It shouldn't be called stupid; it was just retaining the characteristics of a wolf.

They weren't purely human; they were beastmen.

"An, how much longer until we can eat?" The beastmen couldn't wait; if Lang Yan hadn't been sitting there, they would have already reached into the pot.

Lang An: "It's still cooking, isn't it?"

"The meat is cooked!" The wolf-beastman grabbed at the ground with his claws, tearing up the turf.

His eyes were fixed on the three pots of stew; the meat and bones were overflowing, and the oily soup was about to spill out. The aroma of meat enveloped them, and the beastmen licked their lips incessantly, as if they could taste it in the air.

Lang An: "Qiu, can the stuff in those pottery pots be eaten yet?"

Lin Qiu: "As long as the yams are soft, it's fine."

Lang An slapped a beastman who was sneaking toward the pot on the forehead, "I just put it in, wait a while longer."

He went back to continue stirring the vegetables with his ladle.

The beastmen endured the hunger, constantly clawing at the ground to try and relieve it. The ground by the campfire had almost been turned over by them.

Lin Qiu looked at their wolf claws—curved, gray-black or deep black in color, gleaming with a cold, metallic light. The claws were extremely long, like curved hooks.

Lang Yan was constantly paying attention to Lin Qiu, and seeing him looking at the wolf claws, he suddenly remembered that he couldn't shift into his beast form.

Beastmen usually only had trouble controlling their form during their cub years; after they grew up, they could do it as they pleased.

He touched Lin Qiu, who looked over with clear, frost-like eyes.

"Can you do it?" He looked at the wolf-form beastmen lying on the ground.

Lin Qiu hesitated, "I... haven't tried."

Lang Yan: "You just need to think about it in your heart, focus your mind..."

Lin Qiu looked into the beastman's deep eyes, which were filled with encouragement, his voice slow and soft.

Lin Qiu sat upright, his eyelashes trembling as he slowly closed his eyes, trying to feel it as he followed his words.

Like an innate ability, the thought flashed, and with a tearing sound, a smaller black wolf appeared on the ground.

"Awoo?" The beastmen tilted their heads to look.

Seeing that it was Lin Qiu who had shifted, they didn't think it was a big deal. They quickly twitched their noses and turned back to urge Lang An.

Lin Qiu lay on the ground, feeling a bit lost.

A soft, light touch came over his fur. He turned his head and saw Lang Yan picking up his torn fur garment.

He said, "Wasn't that simple?"

Lin Qiu pulled in his limbs, not feeling the slightest bit of discomfort from his first time as a wolf. He sat down, his black wolf fur smooth and glossy. It was better than the fur of most beastmen.

Lin Qiu looked at Lang Yan and nodded.

It seemed very simple.

"The fur garment..." Shifting back and forth like this, it wasn't convenient to wear fur clothes.

Lang Yan: "Our fur skirts all have ties; they loosen on their own when we shift into beast form."

Lin Qiu looked down at his large paws, his fingers moving, the curved wolf claws hooking into the grass on the ground.

He subconsciously shook them, and a soft chuckle sounded in his ear.

Lin Qiu: "?"

After turning into a wolf, it seemed he wasn't very smart either.

Lang Yan leaned over and hooked the weeds out of his claws, throwing them away.

"You won't be cold if you sleep in your beast form at night."

Lin Qiu: "I'm still used to my human form."

Lang Yan: "Either is fine."

"Then should I shift back?"

"Mm."

Lin Qiu took his fur garment away, shifted back after getting some distance from the beastmen, and looked at the torn strips of fur on the garment, gently hooking them with his hand.

He had no clothes to wear.

Lin Qiu put on his fur skirt and walked over, sitting down beside Lang Yan.

Lang Yan: "Is it broken?"

Lin Qiu: "Mm."

"I still have some unused fur; I'll get it for you later." Every beastman had a share of the tribe's fur, and Lang Yan giving his own share to him wouldn't cause anyone to say anything.

Lin Qiu: "I want to look for other materials to make clothes."

Lang Yan's gaze fell on Lin Qiu; his skin was too delicate, seeming to turn red at the slightest rub. In fact, the furs stored in the cave weren't as soft as the ones he tanned himself.

The ones Lin Qiu was covered in were already the two softest among his furs.

"What kind of materials?"

"Are there any plants, fibers..." Lin Qiu paused, looking up to meet Lang Yan's eyes.

Lang Yan tilted his head, "Fibers?"

Lin Qiu: "...You know, the outer layer of skin that is very tear-resistant? The kind that can be pulled into threads?"

Lang Yan recalled and shook his head.

Under the claws of a wolf-beastman, there was no skin that was tear-resistant.

But something that could be pulled into threads...

"Lang Bei is the captain of the gathering team; she knows more about this. You can ask her."

Lin Qiu: "Mm."

Today's meal was eaten quite late, with a total of four large, full pottery pots. Three pots of yam stew and one pot of stir-fried wild vegetables with meat that was about to overflow.

There were also several other baskets of fresh wild vegetables for the beastmen to eat if they didn't have enough.

The beastmen lined up, holding their large leaves for eating, and approached Lang An one after another.

Each beastman got two full ladles of stir-fry.

The first ones in line were Lang Mo and Lang Jin.

One was the greediest among the adult beastmen, and the other was the biggest eater among the young beastmen.

As soon as Lang An served the food, both beastmen couldn't even wait to sit down before taking a bite of the vegetables.

The meat slices mixed with the stir-fried leaves had an indescribable aroma, not at all like the grass-like taste they were used to when eating raw.

Although the meat slices were small and disappeared after a few chews, how could the flavor be so fragrant!

The two beastmen buried their heads and ate, feeling like they hadn't even tasted it properly before it was gone?

It was gone!

Lang Mo was heartbroken and immediately ran to the back of the beastmen's line to continue waiting.

Seeing this, the other beastmen immediately followed suit.

Lang An raised his ladle, glanced at Lang Mo, and flipped his hand, pouring the vegetables back into the pottery pot.

"No, each beastman can only eat once."

"Just a little bit." Lang Mo looked into the pottery pot.

Lang An: "I've already told the King."

Lang Mo drooped his head, then suddenly turned his head and said, "King, you're here?"

Lang An looked over, and Lang Mo instantly reached out his claw, which Lang An slammed down on—

"Awoooo!"

"Hmph!"

Lang An looked at the beastmen behind who had eaten once and wanted to eat a second time, reminding them: "The meat soup is almost gone, too."

Lang Mo was teary-eyed, holding his hand as he looked for Lang Xi.

Seeing him sitting to the side, holding a small pottery pot and using a wooden stick to fish meat out of the soup, the satisfied look on his face as he closed his eyes made him crave it to death.

Drink the soup!
chapters.title: 第32章
chapters.source_text:
另一边，狼雨带着几个亚兽人给山药削皮。
狼石见状，叫上狼木几个也来帮忙。
兽人们用曜石刀，力道大了，山药一下断成两截，露出里面白色的肉。等削得多了，叶片裹着也滑溜溜的。
兽人们被肉香激得静不下心，索性将叶片一扔，徒手抓着弄。
等狼雨端着装满了山药的陶罐回去时，兽人们跟在他身后，龇牙咧嘴，一脸痛苦地往兽皮上搓手，都快搓出火星子了。
狼岩见状，皱眉：“沾上了？”
兽人苦兮兮点头，伸手给狼岩看。
手都搓红了，还反反复复洗了好几遍，还是痒，都很不得就那一层皮给掀了。
另一边，林楸跟兽人们探讨完下一次黏土配比跟火候的事儿，打算明天继续试试。
这边狼莫几个闻到飘香的肉味儿，这才忍不住，立马回篝火旁。
林楸本没打算去，目光不经意往那边看，见看兽人们痒得直搓手，狼岩也蹙着眉往这边来。
他起身，停在狼岩跟前。
没等他问，他道：“没事，在火边烤一烤就好了。”
狼岩眉头微松，也不急了。
已经叮嘱过兽人们不要将汁液沾在手上，但狼岩却亲眼看见那几个急性子，直接扔了叶子徒手抓。
该叫他们吃一次教训。
他道：“一起过去吃？”
林楸有些迟疑。
狼岩：“不习惯就挨着我坐。”
林楸抿唇，点头。
狼岩眼中的林楸还是很乖，细白的脸上冷冷的，眼里有紧张。他一下想到了他小时候，伸手轻揉了下他脑袋。
“没事，不说话也没事。”
林楸一愣。
自记事后，还没人摸过他脑袋。
旁人眼里，他一直都是不好接近的。因为性子冷，不擅长也不喜欢与人来往，他不只一次听见人说他傲气。
他也没亲近的朋友。
林楸有些呆。
狼岩眼底笑意一闪，温声道：“走吧。”
他看着狼岩，肩膀放松，静静地跟在他过去。
篝火烧得红亮，火星随着风往天空上扬。围着篝火的兽人们面颊映得发红，各个眼神炽热。
林楸坐在狼岩身边，听着四面八方响起的肚子咕咕叫声，咽口水声，少了些不自在。
他曲腿坐着，掌根撑着下巴。
新鲜开挖出来的灶上，三口陶锅里的骨头山药汤咕噜咕噜冒泡。汤色已经渐白，香味扑鼻。
几个削了山药皮的兽人这会儿蹲在灶边，缩成企鹅样，傻呆呆地伸着手往灶火边烤。
“不那么痒了耶！”
“为什么烤着火就不痒了？”
“不知道。”
狼木悄悄看林楸，亚兽人懂得可真多。
狼安这边刚把菜放了盐，搅和搅和，直接招呼亚兽人抬罐子过来装，接着赶紧继续炒另一半的肉。
见跟前借着烤手的名义实则围着陶锅发馋的兽人，口水都快滴到罐子里了，狼安忍不住敲了敲兽人脑袋。
“篝火那边去，在这儿碍什么事！”
兽人搓搓手，感觉不痒了，一脸奇异。
“安！真的不痒了？”
旁的兽人诧异，“骗我们的吧。”
“不信你们自己试试！”
“试试就试试！”
林楸托腮看着兽人真往山药堆里跑，微微睁大眼。旁边倏地扔过去个石子，远方兽人“嗷”的一声叫。
林楸侧头。
他看见了，狼岩扔的。
狼岩捻了捻手指，眼神有点冷，偏头说：“他们有时候有点蠢。”
狼王身边，几个狼兽人趴在地上，默默用爪子捂住耳朵。
他们没听见。
他们很聪明！
“谁打我？”被扔石子儿的兽人回头，瞪着俩眼珠子，傻透了。
兽人们全盯着陶锅，目不转睛，没一个回他。
狼兽人莫名忐忑，“嗷、嗷呜？”
狼岩瞥去一眼。
狼兽人猛地伏地，脑袋藏臂弯里，像与地面融为一体。
林楸抿唇克制住上扬的唇角。
应该不叫蠢，叫保留了狼的特性。
他们不是纯粹的人，而是兽人。
“安，还有多久能吃啊？”兽人等不及了，要不是狼岩在这儿坐着，早悄悄往锅里伸手了。
狼安：“这不是还在做。”
“肉熟了啊！”狼兽人爪子猛地往地上一抓，草皮都掀了。
他眼睛盯着炖汤的那三口锅，肉骨头都装不住，油汪汪的汤都快溢出来了。肉香味儿笼罩住他们，兽人们不停地舔嘴，似都能从空气中尝到味儿。
狼安：“楸，那几个陶锅里的能吃了不？”
林楸：“山药软了就行了。”
狼安一巴掌敲在悄悄凑到锅边的兽人脑门上，“才放下去，再等会儿。”
他又回去，继续抡勺子翻菜。
兽人们忍受着馋意，不停地爪子抓地，试图缓解。篝火边的地皮差点被他们翻一遍。
林楸看着他们的狼爪子，弯曲的，颜色灰黑或者深黑，泛着金属一般的冷光。爪子极长，如弯钩。
狼岩时刻注意着林楸，见他看狼爪子，忽然想起他不会变兽形这事儿。
兽人一般只有幼崽时期控制不住自己的形态，长大之后就随心所欲了。
他碰了下林楸，冷霜似的干净眸子看来。
“会吗？”他看了眼趴地上的狼形兽人。
林楸迟疑，“我……没试过。”
狼岩：“只需要心里想着，集中精神……”
林楸看着兽人深邃的眸子，带着鼓励，声音徐而轻。
林楸端坐，抖着睫缓缓闭上眼，顺着他的话试着去感受。
像与生俱来的能力，念头一闪，只听撕拉一声，地面多了一头体型较小的黑狼。
“嗷？”兽人们歪头看来。
见是林楸变了兽形，不是什么大事。又飞快动着鼻子，转头催促狼安去了。
林楸趴在地上，有些迷茫。
毛毛上传来轻软的触感，侧头，狼岩将撑破了的兽皮衣捡起来。
他道：“是不是很简单？”
林楸收拢四肢，一点没第一次变狼的不习惯。他蹲坐好，一身黑色的狼毛顺滑光泽。比大多数兽人的毛毛都要好。
林楸看着狼岩，点头。
好像是很简单。
“兽皮衣……”这样变来变去，穿着兽皮衣就不方便。
狼岩：“我们的兽皮裙都系带子，变兽形的时候会自己松开。”
林楸低头看着自己的大爪子，手指动了动，弯弯的狼爪勾住地面的草。
他下意识甩了甩，耳边响起一声轻笑。
林楸：“？”
变狼之后，好像他也不聪明了。
狼岩倾身，勾着他爪子里的杂草扔掉。
“晚上用兽形睡觉不会冷。”
林楸：“我还是习惯人形。”
狼岩：“都可以。”
“那我变回来？”
“嗯。”
林楸带走了自己的兽皮衣，离远了兽人之后变回来。瞧着兽皮衣上绷开的兽皮条，轻轻用手勾了下。
没衣服穿了。
林楸穿着兽皮裙过去，在狼岩身边坐下。
狼岩：“坏了？”
林楸：“嗯。”
“我还有些兽皮没用，等会儿给你拿。”部落的兽皮每个兽人都有份额，狼岩给他自己那一份，没兽人说什么。
林楸：“我想找找其他做衣服的材料。”
狼岩目光落在林楸身上，他皮肤太细了，似乎一搓就会泛红。其实洞里储存的那些兽皮并没有他自己鞣制的那些软。
林楸身上盖着的，已经是他的兽皮里最软的两条了。
“什么材料？”
“有没有一些植物，纤维……”林楸一顿，抬头与狼岩对视。
狼岩歪头，“纤维？”
林楸：“……就是外面那层皮很耐扯？能扯成一丝一丝的那种？”
狼岩回想，摇头。
在狼兽人爪子下，没有耐扯的皮。
不过能扯成一丝一丝的……
“狼贝是采集队队长，她知道得多些。你可以问一问她。”
林楸：“嗯。”
今日这一顿饭吃得挺晚，一共四口装得满满的大陶锅。三口锅的山药炖汤，一口锅满得要溢出来的肉片炒野菜。
还有另外几筐新鲜的野菜，兽人们不够再吃这个。
兽人们排着队，捧着自己吃饭用的大叶片，一个接着一个往狼安跟前凑。
一个兽人满满两勺的炒菜。
这头一个就是狼莫跟狼金。
一个是成年兽人当中最馋嘴的，一个是少年兽人当中最能吃的。
狼安刚一打上菜，两个兽人都来不及坐下，先往菜里啃了一口。
肉片混着炒过的菜叶，难以形容的香气，一点不像他们生吃那样跟吃草似的。
肉片虽然小，嚼吧嚼吧就没了，但味道怎么会这么香！
两个兽人埋头苦吃，就感觉还没尝出来味儿，没了？
没了！
狼莫痛心，立马跑到兽人队伍后头继续排着。
其他兽人见状，也立刻跟上。
狼安抬起勺子，乜了一眼狼莫，手一翻，菜倒回陶锅里。
“不行，一个兽人只能吃一次。”
“就一点点。”狼莫往陶锅里看。
狼安：“我叫王了。”
狼莫耷拉个脑袋，忽然侧头道：“王，你来了？”
狼安看去，狼莫瞬间伸出爪子，狼安猛地一敲——
“嗷呜呜！”
“哼！”
狼安看向后头吃了一次还想吃二次的兽人，提醒：“肉汤也快没了。”
狼莫泪眼汪汪，捂着手找狼西。
看着他坐在一旁，捧着个小陶锅，用木棍在汤里捞肉吃。那一闭眼满足的模样，勾得他馋死了。
喝汤！

炒菜容易分，炖汤就难了。
陶碗陶罐加上之前的木碗，也不过二十几个。炖汤又烫，兽人们只能一批先吃炒菜，一批先喝汤。
山药炖得软烂，奶白色的汤味道香浓。
骨头跟汤里的肉块虽然依旧筋到，但汤鲜味美，一口肉块一口汤，兽人们吃得那才叫一个满足。
要是雪季的时候吃，想想就美！
这下不只抢着肉吃了，汤也抢着喝。
狼莫从狼西的小陶锅里扒拉出一根山药，嚼吧嚼吧，眼睛发亮。
分明兽人们削皮的时候还痒手的，现在吃起来却软糯极了。带着十足的肉味儿，混着汤一咽，肚里顿时就有饱腹的感觉。
“山药！楸！我们明天继续挖！”
林楸刚抿了一口汤，听狼莫隔着兽人跟他嚷嚷。
林楸：“明天不做陶了？”
狼莫耳朵一耷。
狼岩：“还剩得多，能炖两次。”
采集队的兽人捧着小陶罐先挪过来，“王，我们也可以挖这个……山药。”
原本都是叫长痒痒根的，现在都跟着林楸换了称呼。
采集队的兽人大多都是亚兽人，体力不及雄兽人，但心思细一些，也更灵巧。
他们以往采集的大多都是植物的瓜果嫩叶，根茎类的都很少。
今天吃了这山药，顿时就喜欢上了这细腻软糯的口感。
再喝一口混着肉骨头炖出来的汤，从肚子里暖和到四肢，舒坦！
想到他们以往烤一烤啃一啃就扔掉的骨头，多浪费啊！就是多喝点骨头汤，也够他们多饱腹一段时间。
狼岩看向一旁同样期待的狼贝。
狼贝立马积极表态道：“王，我们绝对保证采集的植物不会比原来少。”
狼岩：“既然你们都愿意，那你安排吧。”
“嗷！”兽人们高兴地捧着巴掌大的小陶罐离开。
跑了两步，又看看等着收碗的狼安。
“还有兽人没吃到肉汤呢，吃完了陶罐洗干净还回来。”
“知道了！”
采集队的兽人将狼贝围着。
“队长，这个……”兽人轻轻拍了拍罐子，“我们能一个兽人一个吗？”
狼贝：“我跟楸说说。”
“嘿……”
狼山前，兽人们从来没有一顿饭吃得能有今天这么满足。
虽然等待的过程长了一些，难熬了一些，吃肉的时候晚了一些，但炒菜的油香，炖汤的鲜香，叫兽人们埋头苦吃。
幼崽吃得尾巴一颤一颤的，脑袋拼命往木碗里栽，半张脸上都是油汪汪的。
“嗷呜嗷呜嗷！”
“嗷呜呜呜！”
好吃好吃好好吃！
成年兽人吃到后头，都打饱嗝了，还瞥着眼睛四处看看哪个没吃完的，后头直接抢了起来。
最后四口锅的食物，解决得干干净净。
林楸看着狼莫抬起锅，往嘴里灌那最后几滴肉汤，默默移开眼。
正巧对上狼岩视线，他问：“吃饱了没有？”
林楸抿唇，点头。
他唇色殷红，湿湿的，像揉烂了的粉色花瓣流出的汁液。狼岩见他脸色也泛着红，是吃好了的样子，这才放心。
“嗷呜！！！”
忽然的狼嚎声，林楸惊得瞳孔一缩。
狼岩看着吃爽了的几个狼兽人爬上狼山，对着天空长嚎。他木着脸，抓握两下，爪子有些痒。
老祭司倒是难得，没叫他去制止。
于是，兽人们一个接着一个，嚎得更欢快了。
“嗷呜，嗷呜，嗷呜——”
“嗷呜！！！”
许多狼一起嚎叫的声音是很震撼的，他们一声接着一声，一声比一声响。
狼嚎声传了很远很远，林楸能听出他们声音中的激动，还有希望。
这与他刚解禁时，看到的样子天差地别。
同样是一顿肉，只用陶锅煮了下，兽人们混着汤汤水水吃得稍稍饱腹了，便这么高兴。
狼嚎声悠长，回荡狼山，林楸被兽人们的嚎叫声牵引，心中腾起一股冲动。
“嗷呜？”他悄悄的，低低地学了一下。
狼嚎声阵阵，耳旁却落下一声轻笑，极清晰。
林楸脸上微红。
狼岩望着狼山，目光悠远，“他们其实忍耐了许久……谢谢楸。”
林楸：“我没做什么。”
狼岩摇头，眸子里带着前所未有的郑重。
“你让兽人们看到了希望。”
这些经历几代饥苦，一年又一年盼着有足够食物果腹的兽人们，这些曾经饿得靠睡觉度日，甚至给自己吃毒草的兽人们，在没有食物的灰暗中闷着头，艰难前行了许久许久……久到或许他们都麻木了，绝望了。
狼岩作为狼部落的王，对这些更有深刻的体会。
再不找出更多的食物，他们会死，部落也会像其他小部落那样彻底消亡。
即便祭司在努力，他们所有兽人都没喊着放弃，但事实是，如果这样持续下去，最多二三十年，就没有他们了。
狼岩看着林楸不怎么习惯，抖个不停的眼睫，眼里郑重慢慢转为温柔。
他轻轻的，试探地将手放在林楸的头发上。
林楸静看着他，没躲。
他便像小时候抱他时那样，轻轻顺了顺他的头发。
“楸，我怀疑过你。”
林楸抬头，绷起了脸，目光清澈。
“我故意的。”
故意露出来，故意叫他们知道。
他不是原来的狼楸，他也不想花费精力去装。反正都无所谓。
狼岩失笑道：“嗯，原来是故意的。就不怕被我们发现了会有事？”
林楸：“……”
他觉得狼岩此刻有点像逗弄幼崽。
“会被驱逐出部落，还是会死？”林楸淡然地说出这些可能性。
狼岩收回手，一个眼神，狼山上那些嚎叫的兽人一僵，终于屁颠屁颠跑下山。
他们成群结队，风一般擦过两人，那是一种极其夸张的速度，林楸甚至只捕捉到他们的影。
这与总趴在地上，要死不活一般的狼兽人，相差极大。
狼岩：“楸，狼部落不会自相残杀，伤害族人是大罪。”
“要是换了芯子？”
狼岩摇头，“你始终是你。”
“回去睡吧，已经很晚了。”
林楸仰头看天，不知什么时候起了乌云，星星看不见一颗。
祭司说，明天阴天。
林楸不理解狼岩那话说什么意思。
难不成只要壳子还是一样的，不论是哪个灵魂，都还是狼部落的兽人？
他起身，不知怎么心里有些不舒服。
他去溪边洗漱，头一次，比兽人们先一步躺进了草窝。
兽皮蒙在头上，遮挡了陆陆续续进山洞的兽人的视线。兽人们今天似乎格外活泼，不像以往进来就睡，还在不停说话。
林楸闷了自己一会儿，不知多久，沉睡了去。
晚间下了几颗雨，伴随着柔和的风，有些凉。
狼岩身边一动，他醒了过来。
看着整个藏进自己毛毛里的林楸，想起他说了那句话之后，亚兽人的情绪似乎就低落下来。
狼岩往后退了退，脖颈处的毛毛被林楸攥紧，又不得不稍稍仰头，叫他又拽下来些。
他坐起来，轻轻将林楸手里的狼毛拿出来，团成一团，塞入草窝两边。
虽然不知道楸积攒狼毛要干什么，但这些天他亲手薅下来的，狼岩都给他放在那里。
他将林楸抱起来，放回他的草窝里。
盖上兽皮，又回自己那边躺下。
楸不认可他说的那句话，他不愿意自己将他认作狼楸。
这事狼岩不好解释，这只是他的直觉而已。
不过他意外发现了楸的小脾气。他不乐意了就不说话，一个人闷闷的将自己隔起来，像罩了个套子。
狼兽人大多直来直去，他这般心思敏感的，极少。
狼岩想着，渐渐沉睡。
当林楸再次滚到他草窝里，他模糊的思绪又清晰一点，轻轻一叹。
两边草窝是不是做得太近了。
楸翻个身就滚过来。
*
次日，阴天。
楸醒来时，察觉到许多落在身上的视线。
他迷茫地与兽人们对视，兽人们倏地转过头，匆匆爬出窝里，飞快跑出山洞。
“嗷？”
林楸低头，与趴在隔壁草窝的幼崽对视。
“你怎么到狼岩……”说着猛然一顿，林楸看清自己坐在谁的草窝里，惊得一个起立，烫脚似的飞快离开。
他怎么，又跑狼岩草窝里了。
幼崽看他过来了，亲昵地凑过来，细嫩的小爪子踩着他腿上，往他身上爬。
林楸低头，余光却看着山洞的兽人。
等他们走完了，他搂住幼崽，低头悄悄道：“我什么时候滚过去的？”
“嗷！”幼崽欢欢喜喜摇尾巴，以为楸跟他亲近。
林楸卸下力气，瘫软在草窝中。
幼崽把他当软垫踩，挪到他肩膀，团好了趴着。
林楸听着他细细的呼吸声，手盖在幼崽身上，时不时捏一下，看着还算镇定，实则从脖子到脸上完全红透。
他睡觉应该还算规矩的。
幼崽被他摸得舒服，打起了小呼噜。
林楸看向两个草窝连接处，干草都被压平了。显然不是一次两次的事。
林楸闭眼，睫羽抖动，脸红得能烫饼。
狼果抱着陶罐进来，听呼吸就知道楸醒着，道：“楸，出去吃鱼了。”
林楸睁眼，眼眸浸了水似的，润润的。
“你怎么了？”狼果奇怪看着他。
林楸：“没什么。”
他坐起来，将幼崽还给狼果，保持着镇定往外走去。
应当……只是不小心。
chapters.translated_text:
It’s easy to divide up stir-fried dishes, but stew is much harder.

Between the clay bowls, clay pots, and the previous wooden bowls, there were only about twenty or so. Since the stew was piping hot, the beastmen had to eat in batches—one group ate the stir-fry first, while the other drank the soup.

The yam was stewed until soft and mushy, and the milky-white soup tasted rich and fragrant.

Although the bones and the chunks of meat in the soup were still chewy, the soup was fresh and delicious. With every bite of meat and every sip of soup, the beastmen felt incredibly satisfied.

If they could eat this during the snowy season, just thinking about it was wonderful!

Now, they weren't just fighting over the meat; they were fighting over the soup, too.

Lang Mo fished a piece of yam out of Lang Xi’s small clay pot, chewed it, and his eyes lit up.

Clearly, the beastmen’s hands had been itchy when they were peeling the skin, but now it tasted incredibly soft and glutinous. With the full flavor of the meat mixed into the soup, one swallow left them feeling instantly full.

"Yam! Qiu! Let’s keep digging tomorrow!"

Lin Qiu had just taken a sip of soup when he heard Lang Mo shouting at him from across the other beastmen.

Lin Qiu: "Not making pottery tomorrow?"

Lang Mo’s ears drooped.

Lang Yan: "There’s still plenty left; we can stew it twice more."

The beastmen from the gathering team hurried over, holding their small clay pots. "King, can we also dig for this... yam?"

Originally, they had all called it "itchy root," but now they had all followed Lin Qiu’s lead and changed the name.

Most of the beastmen in the gathering team were sub-beastmen; their physical strength wasn't as great as the male beastmen, but they were more observant and dexterous.

In the past, they mostly gathered fruits, melons, and tender leaves, rarely digging for roots or tubers.

After eating this yam today, they immediately fell in love with its delicate, soft, and glutinous texture.

Then, taking a sip of the soup stewed with meaty bones, the warmth spread from their stomachs to their limbs—it was so comfortable!

Thinking about the bones they used to just roast, gnaw on, and throw away, what a waste! Even just drinking more bone soup would be enough to keep them full for a while longer.

Lang Yan looked at Lang Bei, who was equally expectant nearby.

Lang Bei immediately expressed his commitment enthusiastically: "King, we absolutely guarantee that the amount of plants we gather won't be less than before."

Lang Yan: "Since you are all willing, then you arrange it."

"Awooo!" The beastmen left happily, clutching their palm-sized clay pots.

After running a few steps, they looked back at Lang An, who was waiting to collect the bowls.

"There are still beastmen who haven't had the meat soup. Once you're done, wash the clay pots and bring them back."

"Got it!"

The beastmen of the gathering team surrounded Lang Bei.

"Captain, this..." a beastman gently patted the pot, "can we have one per beastman?"

Lang Bei: "I’ll talk to Qiu about it."

"Heh..."

In front of Wolf Mountain, the beastmen had never had a meal as satisfying as today’s.

Although the waiting process was a bit long and difficult, and they ate the meat a bit late, the oily fragrance of the stir-fry and the fresh aroma of the stew made the beastmen bury their heads and eat with gusto.

The cubs ate until their tails were twitching, their heads buried deep into the wooden bowls, with half their faces covered in grease.

"Awoo awoo ao!"

"Awooooo!"

Delicious, delicious, so delicious!

By the time the adult beastmen finished, they were all hiccuping, yet they still glanced around to see who hadn't finished, and eventually started snatching leftovers.

In the end, the food in all four pots was wiped clean.

Lin Qiu watched as Lang Mo lifted a pot to pour the last few drops of meat soup into his mouth, and he silently looked away.

He happened to meet Lang Yan’s gaze, who asked: "Are you full?"

Lin Qiu pursed his lips and nodded.

His lips were a deep, vibrant red, moist like the juice from crushed pink petals. Seeing the flush on his face, Lang Yan knew he had eaten well and felt relieved.

"AWOOO!!!"

A sudden wolf howl made Lin Qiu’s pupils shrink in surprise.

Lang Yan watched as several wolf beastmen, satisfied from their meal, climbed up Wolf Mountain and let out long howls toward the sky. He kept a straight face, but his hands clenched, his claws itching slightly.

The old priest was uncharacteristically lenient and didn't tell him to stop them.

And so, one beastman after another joined in, howling even more joyfully.

"Awoo, awoo, awoo—"

"AWOOO!!!"

The sound of many wolves howling together was incredibly powerful; they went one after another, each sound louder than the last.

The howling carried very, very far. Lin Qiu could hear the excitement in their voices, as well as hope.

This was a world of difference from how they looked when he was first unsealed.

It was just a meal of meat, cooked in a clay pot, yet the beastmen were so happy just to have their bellies slightly filled with the soup and broth.

The wolf howls were long and echoed through Wolf Mountain. Lin Qiu was drawn in by the beastmen’s cries, and an impulse surged in his heart.

"Awoo?" He quietly and softly mimicked them.

Amidst the waves of howling, a soft chuckle fell beside his ear, extremely clear.

A slight blush appeared on Lin Qiu’s face.

Lang Yan looked toward Wolf Mountain, his gaze distant. "They have actually endured for a long time... Thank you, Qiu."

Lin Qiu: "I didn't do anything."

Lang Yan shook his head, his eyes filled with unprecedented solemnity.

"You let the beastmen see hope."

These beastmen, who had experienced generations of hunger and hardship, hoping year after year for enough food to fill their stomachs—these beastmen who had once lived on sleep to survive the hunger, and even resorted to eating poisonous herbs—had been trudging forward in the darkness of having no food for so long... so long that perhaps they had become numb and desperate.

As the King of the Wolf Tribe, Lang Yan felt this more deeply than anyone.

If they didn't find more food, they would die, and the tribe would perish completely, just like other small tribes.

Even though the priest was trying his best and none of the beastmen were calling for surrender, the truth was that if things continued this way, in twenty or thirty years at most, they would be gone.

Lang Yan looked at Lin Qiu’s fluttering eyelashes, which showed his discomfort, and the solemnity in his eyes slowly turned into tenderness.

He gently and tentatively placed his hand on Lin Qiu’s hair.

Lin Qiu looked at him quietly and didn't dodge.

So, just like when he held him as a child, he gently smoothed his hair.

"Qiu, I doubted you."

Lin Qiu looked up, his face tense, his gaze clear.

"I did it on purpose."

I did it on purpose to show it, on purpose to let you all know.

He wasn't the original Lang Qiu, and he didn't want to waste energy pretending. It didn't matter anyway.

Lang Yan laughed helplessly: "Hmm, so it was on purpose. Weren't you afraid that something would happen if we found out?"

Lin Qiu: "..."

He felt that Lang Yan was acting like he was teasing a cub right now.

"Would I be exiled from the tribe, or would I die?" Lin Qiu said these possibilities calmly.

Lang Yan withdrew his hand, and with a single look, the howling beastmen on the mountain stiffened and finally trotted down the mountain happily.

They moved in groups, brushing past the two of them like the wind. It was an incredibly exaggerated speed; Lin Qiu could only catch a glimpse of their shadows.

This was a huge difference from the wolf beastmen who usually lay on the ground, looking half-dead.

Lang Yan: "Qiu, the Wolf Tribe does not kill its own. Harming a tribesman is a grave sin."

"What if the soul inside has changed?"

Lang Yan shook his head. "You are always you."

"Go back to sleep; it’s already very late."

Lin Qiu looked up at the sky; dark clouds had gathered at some point, and not a single star could be seen.

The priest said it would be cloudy tomorrow.

Lin Qiu didn't understand what Lang Yan meant by that.

Could it be that as long as the shell remains the same, no matter whose soul it is, they are still a beastman of the Wolf Tribe?

He stood up, feeling somehow uncomfortable.

He went to the stream to wash up, and for the first time, he lay down in his grass nest before the other beastmen.

He pulled the animal skin over his head, blocking the sight of the beastmen entering the cave one after another. The beastmen seemed unusually lively today; unlike before, when they would just sleep upon entering, they were still talking incessantly.

Lin Qiu stifled himself for a while, and after some time, he fell into a deep sleep.

It rained a little during the night, accompanied by a gentle wind, which felt a bit cool.

Something moved beside Lang Yan, and he woke up.

Looking at Lin Qiu, who had buried himself entirely into his fur, he remembered that after he said that, the sub-beastman’s mood seemed to have dropped.

Lang Yan moved back a bit, but the fur at his neck was gripped tightly by Lin Qiu, forcing him to tilt his head slightly so Lin Qiu could pull it down again.

He sat up, gently took the wolf fur out of Lin Qiu’s hand, balled it up, and tucked it into the sides of the grass nest.

Although he didn't know what Qiu wanted to do with the collected wolf fur, Lang Yan put everything he had plucked himself in that spot for him.

He picked Lin Qiu up and placed him back in his own grass nest.

He covered him with the animal skin and went back to lie down in his own spot.

Qiu didn't accept what he said; he didn't want him to think of him as the "original" Lang Qiu.

Lang Yan found it hard to explain; it was just his intuition.

However, he had unexpectedly discovered Qiu’s little temper. When he was unhappy, he wouldn't speak, just sulking and isolating himself like he was inside a shell.

Most wolf beastmen were straightforward; someone as sensitive as him was rare.

Lang Yan thought about this as he gradually drifted off to sleep.

When Lin Qiu rolled into his grass nest again, his hazy thoughts cleared up a bit, and he sighed softly.

Were the two grass nests made too close together?

Qiu would roll over with just one turn.

*

The next day, it was cloudy.

When Qiu woke up, he noticed many gazes landing on him.

He looked at the beastmen in confusion, and they suddenly turned their heads, hurriedly crawled out of their nests, and ran out of the cave at high speed.

"Awoo?"

Lin Qiu looked down and met the eyes of the cub lying in the nest next to him.

"Why are you in Lang Yan's..." He stopped abruptly. Lin Qiu realized whose grass nest he was sitting in and jumped up in shock, fleeing as if the ground were burning.

How did he end up in Lang Yan’s grass nest again?

Seeing him come over, the cub nuzzled him affectionately, stepping on his leg with its delicate little paws and climbing onto him.

Lin Qiu looked down, but his peripheral vision was on the beastmen in the cave.

Once they had all left, he hugged the cub and whispered, "When did I roll over there?"

"Awoo!" The cub wagged its tail happily, thinking Qiu was being affectionate with him.

Lin Qiu let his guard down and slumped into the grass nest.

The cub used him as a soft cushion, moved to his shoulder, curled up, and lay down.

Lin Qiu listened to the cub’s soft breathing, his hand covering the cub, occasionally giving it a squeeze. He looked calm, but in reality, he was completely flushed from his neck to his face.

He should be a decent sleeper.

The cub purred as he was petted.

Lin Qiu looked at the connection between the two grass nests; the dry grass was all flattened. Clearly, this wasn't the first or second time.

Lin Qiu closed his eyes, his eyelashes fluttering, his face red enough to bake a pancake.

Lang Guo came in carrying a clay pot. Hearing the breathing, he knew Qiu was awake and said, "Qiu, come out and eat fish."

Lin Qiu opened his eyes, which looked like they were soaked in water, moist and bright.

"What’s wrong with you?" Lang Guo looked at him strangely.

Lin Qiu: "Nothing."

He sat up, handed the cub back to Lang Guo, and walked out, maintaining his composure.

It must... just be an accident.
