They had brought back something good, but instead of being praised, they were beaten into a wilted state by the priest.

Bao Xiu and the group of little wolves knew what that thing was, so they didn't move yet, quietly observing to see if these adult wolf orcs had been stung.

Seeing their faces were intact, they immediately rushed over to help affectionately.

"Uncle Huo, let us do it, let us do it."

Lang Qiao pushed against the little cub’s forehead with his hand, baring his teeth. "Don't even think about it."

Qiu heard the commotion and finally walked out of the cave. Seeing them carrying something that looked like a pottery jar on their shoulders, he was confused, but upon closer inspection, it wasn't a pottery jar—it was a massive beehive!

It looked like the hornet nests hanging from those tens-of-meters-tall trees, only it looked even larger.

Lin Qiu: "Are you guys okay?"

The orcs whimpered. The old priest had struck hard, but because the orcs were dodging and shouting at the top of their lungs, they hadn't actually taken much damage.

But they felt wronged!

"Qiu, look, is this the honey you wanted?"

Lin Qiu didn't dare to take it.

He looked at the old priest’s livid face and hurriedly said, "Where did you get this? You aren't hurt, are you?"

"No! This fell on the ground. When we were hunting, Lang Chou accidentally stepped on it. That’s how we found it."

Lin Qiu glanced at the priest, and seeing the old orc’s expression soften, he smiled and took the beehive.

"It’s good that you aren't hurt."

The old priest: "Hmph! Next time, don't dilly-dally, explain yourself first."

Langhuo and the hunting team orcs pouted, whispering, "That’s because you started hitting before we could explain."

The old priest’s hearing wasn't that sharp, so he didn't hear it, but that didn't mean he couldn't read the orcs' expressions.

He didn't leave either; he just stood there, wanting to see what this delicious honey Qiu spoke of really was.

The old priest straightened his expression. He wasn't greedy; he just wanted to see if it had any medicinal value.
chapters.title: 第96章

chapters.translated_text:
The rainy season had just ended, and the honey collected by the buzzing bees was limited. Plus, after Lang Chou stepped on it, there wasn't much edible honey left.

Lin Qiu opened the honeycomb, and inside were still some unhatched larvae.

He watched as a claw reached over, poked at the bee pupae, and asked in a low voice, "Qiu, can these be eaten?"

Lin Qiu felt the sky suddenly darken, and when he looked up, he saw beastmen surrounding him from all directions.

Lang Mo, who had asked if the bee pupae were edible, retracted his claw under the gaze, clasped his hands together, and grinned at him.

Lin Qiu: "Yes."

"Then I..."

A claw reached out lightning-fast, only to be slapped away by Lang An.

"What's the rush!" Lang An couldn't help but sniff the sweet fragrance. Seeing that Qiu really wasn't in a hurry, he couldn't help but urge him in a low voice, "Qiu, hurry, hurry."

Lin Qiu opened the honeycomb.

Inside, the white ones were bee pupae, and the golden honey was aged in the cells. Lin Qiu carefully took them out piece by piece.

The beastmen's eyes followed Lin Qiu's hands, their noses sniffing constantly, as if they could taste it just by doing so.

There weren't many pieces in total, and Lin Qiu estimated the number of beastmen around; there wouldn't even be enough for one piece each.

"Bring two more basins of different sizes, and a piece of clean linen cloth."

As soon as he finished speaking, a beastman brought them over immediately.

Lin Qiu wrapped the honeycomb in the linen cloth, twisted it tight, and began to squeeze.

The honey seeped out from the gaps in the linen, silky, smooth, and crystal clear, and that sweet scent with a faint floral fragrance exploded into the air.

The beastmen in the front row took a deep breath, then touched the corners of their mouths, grinning with silly smiles.

The priest was also sitting nearby, and no beastman dared to stand in front of him.

The old beastman gripped his cane, looking at the shallow layer of honey in the basin, unable to stop his throat from bobbing.

Realizing he was craving it, the old priest immediately sat up straight, looking solemn.

However, his aged eyes were glowing, glancing sideways back and forth, and seeing that no beastman was paying attention to him, he couldn't help but stare at the basin again.

Lin Qiu faced the scent of the honey directly; having not eaten it for a long time, he couldn't help but crave it too.

After squeezing the honeycomb wrapped in linen multiple times, the collected honey was only enough to fill a small jar the size of a palm.

As for the one that had been stepped on, Lin Qiu didn't touch it.

He put the honey away and looked up to see many beastmen with crystal-clear drool hanging from the corners of their mouths. Lin Qiu let out a chuckle, smiling brightly.

"There's still some left in the basin, you can taste..."

Before he finished, a claw reached out from somewhere in the pile of beastmen, and with an unexpected move, snatched the basin and ran.

The beastmen were stunned for a moment, then chased after it frantically. It was just like the scene of a herd migration, a massive spectacle that made the ground tremble.

In an instant, the beastmen had scattered completely.

Lin Qiu held the linen cloth, his hands covered in honey.

He watched the beastmen chasing each other, finding the right moment to reach into the basin with their claws. The sticky honey clung to their fingertips, and as they licked it, their eyes shone brighter than the sun in the rainy season.

Lin Qiu nudged Lang Yan, who was still sitting beside him, "I told you, it's delicious, right?"

Lang Yan looked at Lin Qiu's hands—fair, smooth, and slender, with fingertips flushed red from the effort. They were coated with a layer of shimmering honey, carrying a sweetness that no beastman could refuse.

Lang Yan’s Adam's apple bobbed, and it was only because the old priest was here that he restrained himself and looked away.

"What should be done with the rest?" His voice was slightly hoarse, and Lin Qiu looked over curiously.

"Is your throat uncomfortable?"

Lang Yan shook his head.

Lin Qiu smiled, and jokingly reached out, "Here, I've washed my hands, washed them many times. Do you want to..."

Before he could finish, Lang Yan grabbed his wrist and gently licked his fingertip.

As the warm tongue brushed past, Lin Qiu instinctively pulled his hand back, but the strength on his wrist increased, and Lin Qiu felt his heart tremble.

Lang Yan's eyes were as dark as a forest at night, as if they were about to suck him in.

Lin Qiu quickly looked away and used some strength to pull his hand back, a faint blush spreading from his neck to his face.

He stood up, grabbed a basin, and walked straight into the large cave.

The old priest looked regretfully at the honey residue Lin Qiu had taken away, smacked his lips, and glanced at Lang Yan.

Useless!

Inside the large cave, Lin Qiu walked straight to the end with his head down. He stood against the wall for a while longer, until his hands felt tired, before he regained his senses.

He looked at the wall covered in wolf claw marks in front of him, breathing in the scent of dry, cold stone.

Lin Qiu took a step back, looking at the linen cloth in his hand that was still dripping honey.

The honeycomb wrapped in the linen could still produce some honey if soaked in water. He had panicked and brought the basin inside, but where was there any water in the cave?

Lin Qiu turned around, looking at the bright cave entrance, his face still burning.

He stood for a while longer, and no beastman came in. Lin Qiu took a deep breath, walked out slowly, passed by Lang Yan who was sitting under the shed, and placed the wooden basin on the stove.

He threw the linen cloth in and poured in the hot water he had boiled that morning, just waiting for the honey to dissolve.

"Qiu!" Lang Jin came back holding a basin.

Lin Qiu was so startled his hand trembled, but he kept his expression steady and turned to look at the little wolf who was presenting the pottery basin like a treasure.

Lang Jin's round eyes were bright, and he leaned his head toward the basin excitedly, "Soaking it in water, can it be drunk?"

Lin Qiu: "Yes."

He ignored Lang Yan's gaze from behind and looked at the pottery basin in the little wolf's hands.

"Did you wash it?"

The pottery basin was clean, but there wasn't a drop of water to be seen.

Lang Jin held the pottery basin, stunned for a moment, licked his lips in embarrassment, and hopped over the low wall, "I'll wash it clean right away."

As the residual honey in the honeycomb dissolved, Lin Qiu, bearing the gaze from behind that felt like it was going to burn right through him, went to the stream to wash his hands first.

He squatted on the bank, looking at his reflection in the stream.

His face was still flushed, his eyelashes trembling restlessly, and the shyness in his eyes made Lin Qiu feel annoyed. He splashed the water, scattering the image in the stream.

He washed his hands clean, scrubbing until his knuckles turned red.

He watched the little wolf squatting opposite him, grabbing dried grass and stirring the pottery basin rapidly, the splashing sounds making him feel restless as well.

Lin Qiu pressed his thin lips together, and as he washed, he couldn't help but look at the finger that had just been licked.

Lin Qiu suddenly closed his eyes and took a deep breath.

This is crazy!

The next moment, his wrist was gripped.

He looked over in a fright; Lang Yan had arrived at some point, holding his hand with that same calm expression.

"You're going to break your skin."

Lin Qiu didn't hear him.

He was only thinking about his own chaotic thoughts, and seeing Lang Yan's calm appearance, a sense of defiance welled up.

Why should he be the only one in a panic!

He suddenly pulled his hand away and placed it on the back of Lang Yan's neck. Under the beastman's concerned and puzzled gaze, he stood up straight and kissed him on the corner of his mouth.

"Clatter—"

The pottery basin fell heavily into the water.

Lang Jin stared at them with wide eyes, instinctively covering his eyes, but couldn't help but open a small gap to peek.

Lang Yan lowered his eyes, smelling only a fragrance rushing toward him. It was like the faint, sweet scent of blooming flowers when all things recover after the snowy season, so intense it disrupted his heartbeat.

The corners of his lips were warm and soft, and Lang Yan's gaze enveloped Lin Qiu, who had already pulled away.

His Adam's apple bobbed, and he couldn't help but be enticed to lean closer to Lin Qiu, who was staring at him stubbornly with a face that was white with a flush of red.

Lin Qiu raised his hand, blocked his lips, and smiled.

Lang Yan's nose brushed against his palm, and he seemed to be able to smell that honey scent again—sweet and delicious.

"Qiu..."

Lin Qiu pressed his lips together, his lips rubbed moist and red.

He didn't look at Lang Yan's dark eyes for the moment, turning his head to grab a small stone and throwing it into the stream in front of the little wolf not far away.

Lang Jin immediately clasped his hands together, shouting happily as he ran, "I didn't see anything, I didn't see anything!"

Lin Qiu felt his palm moisten; he turned back, and Lang Yan was still maintaining his previous posture.

Lin Qiu withdrew his hand and immediately washed it clean in the water.

The sunset cast golden light, but Lin Qiu's cheeks were even more brilliant than the evening glow painting the horizon. His eyelashes were thick and deep; he glanced sideways at the beastman who was still motionless, shook his hands, and stood up.

"How long are you going to stay stunned?" He glanced at the beastmen sharing the honey water under the shed, "If you don't hurry, you won't get to taste any... mm!"

Lin Qiu was suddenly picked up.

He sat on Lang Yan's arm, his hands resting on his shoulders, his eyes widening slightly.

Lang Yan looked up, his chin resting on the young man's stomach, his sharp brows, keen eyes, high nose, and thin lips—his handsome features were fully exposed to Lin Qiu.

He seemed extremely happy, his gray eyes reflecting a golden, spotted light, and he whispered, "Qiu."

Lin Qiu's fingers tightened, "...What are you doing?"

"Qiu."

Lin Qiu felt his excitement, turned his head away, and his round earlobes were also stained with a beautiful pink, "Hmm."

"Qiu."

Lin Qiu saw that the little wolf had already run into the pile of beastmen, and the beastmen under the shed had stopped fighting over the honey water, peeking over at them.

Lin Qiu kicked him, "Put me down, don't you want to keep your dignity as the Wolf King?"

Lang Yan glanced sideways, and the beastmen under the shed all shrank back under the low wall, their hair standing on end.

Lin Qiu laughed out loud, hooking his arm around Lang Yan's neck and telling him to lower himself a bit. When their eyes were almost level, he leaned against Lang Yan, his feet dangling, and said, "Put me down now."

Lang Yan lowered his head, his forehead resting against Lin Qiu's shoulder, rubbing gently.

He didn't say anything, just like a Wolf King confirming his partner's heart, expressing his intimacy and joy in a clingy yet quiet way.

Beastmen's feelings are very straightforward, and becoming partners is also very simple.

Sub-beastmen and female beastmen generally look at appearance and ability; if someone is good-looking, can hunt, and can support a family, then they are a good partner.

Once they fancy each other, they find a cave and have a litter of cubs.

The Wolf King was already exceptionally reserved among the beastmen.

Lin Qiu felt the panic in his heart subside from his rubbing, his laughter clear and warm as a spring breeze. He leaned back on Lang Yan's shoulder, his hand pressed against his neck, and said as if grooming a big dog, "Alright..."

Lang Yan: "Is Qiu willing to be my partner?"

The Wolf King's voice was hoarser than usual, a bit tight. Lin Qiu glanced at the crowd of beastmen who were peeking again, and his face turned red once more.

"Put me down first."

Lang Yan's arms tightened, then he restrained himself and obediently put him down.

Lin Qiu straightened his clothes and moved his feet slightly until Lang Yan's figure completely blocked him, and only then did he look up at Lang Yan.

Lang Yan didn't get a response immediately and seemed uneasy; if his furry ears were exposed, they would have already drooped slowly. Only his pair of gray eyes remained fixed on him, as if afraid he would run away.

Lin Qiu grabbed his hand, and the next moment, it was tightly wrapped by a large hand.

Lin Qiu: "Gentler."

Lang Yan loosened his grip a little.

Lin Qiu felt uncomfortable being watched by his burning gaze. He rarely felt such intense emotions; he couldn't help but raise his hand to block it, only to find his hand being held.

Lin Qiu looked up, his face red, but his gaze was earnest, "You, you ask again?"

Lang Yan's chest heaved violently; no matter how turbulent his heart was, he acted as if he were holding a dandelion in his hands, his voice as soft as it could be: "Qiu, are you willing to be Lang Yan's partner?"

Lin Qiu smiled, his face glowing like the bright moon.

"I am willing."
chapters.title: 第97章
chapters.source_text:
才过雨季，嗡嗡虫采的蜜有限，加上狼丑踩了一脚，能吃的蜂蜜不多。
林楸将蜂巢打开，里头还有些没孵化的幼虫。
他眼看着一个爪子伸来，往那蜂蛹上戳了戳，小声问：“楸，这个能吃吗？”
林楸觉得天一下暗了，抬头一瞧，四面八方全围拢了兽人。
问他蜂蛹可不可以吃的狼莫被看得缩回爪子，两手交握，冲着他龇牙一笑。
林楸：“能。”
“那我……”
爪子飞快伸来，叫狼安一巴掌给拍开。
“着什么急！”狼安忍不住嗅闻那股香甜。看楸真不急，又忍不住小声催促，“楸，快点快点。”
林楸将蜂巢打开。
里头白色的是蜂蛹，金黄色的蜂蜜陈酿在巢室中，林楸小心地一块一块拿出来。
兽人们眼神随着林楸手动，鼻子不停吸气，仿佛这样就能尝个味儿。
总共也没多几块，林楸估摸围着的兽人，一个兽人一块还不够分。
“再拿两个大小盆来，还有一块干净麻布。”
话落，立马有兽人送过来。
林楸将蜂蜜用麻布包裹，拧紧，随后开始挤压。
蜂蜜从麻布缝隙渗出，丝滑流畅，晶莹剔透，那股带着淡淡花香的甜味道爆炸开来。
围在前头的兽人猛吸了一大口，再摸摸嘴角，咧嘴露出个傻笑来。
祭司也在一旁坐着，没兽人敢挡他前面去。
老兽人抓紧拐杖，往那盆里浅浅一层的蜂蜜上看，忍不住喉咙滚动。
意识到自己馋了，老祭司立马坐正，一派严肃。
不过那双苍老的眼睛冒着光，斜着眼看来看去，见没兽人注意他，还是忍不住盯着那盆里。
林楸直面蜂蜜的味道，许久没吃过，也忍不住惦记。
麻布裹着蜂巢挤压多次，收集起来的蜂蜜不过浅浅的巴掌大一个小罐子。
还有那被踩了一爪子的，林楸没动。
他将蜂蜜收好，抬头，见好多兽人嘴角挂着晶莹。林楸噗嗤一声，笑得灿烂。
“盆里没倒完，可以尝……”
话落，兽人堆里不知哪里伸出个爪子，出其不意，端着盆就跑。
兽人愣了一下，疯狂追过去。就像那兽群迁徙时的样子，阵仗极大，地面都被震得响动起来。
瞬间，兽人散得一干二净。
林楸拎着麻布，一手的蜂蜜。
他看着兽人们追逐着，找准时机，往盆里伸爪。黏腻的蜂蜜挂在指尖，兽人一嘬，眼睛亮得堪比雨季里的太阳。
林楸胳膊碰了碰还坐在身边的狼岩，“我说过，好吃的吧。”
狼岩看着林楸一双手，白润修长，指尖因为用力，泛着红。上面裹着一层微亮的蜂蜜，带着一股让兽人难以拒绝的甜味。
狼岩喉结滚动，堪堪因为老祭司在这儿，才克制着别开眼。
“剩下的，要怎么做？”他嗓音微哑，林楸奇怪地看过来。
“嗓子不舒服？”
狼岩摇头。
林楸笑着，玩笑似的伸手，“呐，我洗过手的，洗了好几遍。你要不要……”
话没说完，狼岩抓住他手腕，轻轻在他指尖舔了一口。
温热的舌尖擦过，林楸下意识手往后缩，但手腕上的力道加大，林楸心底发颤。
狼岩眸子黑得像夜晚不透光的林子，仿佛要将他吸进去。
林楸飞快移开眼，用了点力才抽回手，一抹薄红从脖子蔓延到脸上。
他起身，抓了个盆，直直进了大山洞。
老祭司遗憾地看着林楸拎走的蜂蜜残渣，咂摸两下嘴，瞥了眼狼岩。
不争气！
大山洞里，林楸闷头一口气走到底。对着墙壁又站了会儿，直到手上累了，才回过神来。
他看着跟前布满狼爪的墙面，呼吸间，是干燥阴冷的石头味道。
林楸后退一步，看着手中又要滴蜂蜜的麻布。
麻布里裹着的蜂巢泡水，还能泡出些蜜来。他慌慌张张的知道拿盆进来，但山洞里哪来什么水。
林楸转身，看着有些光亮的洞口，脸还有些烫。
又站了会儿，也没兽人进来。林楸深吸一口气，徐徐出去，经过坐在棚子底下的狼岩，将木盆放在灶台上。
麻布扔进去，倒上罐子里今早才烧的热水，只等着蜂蜜化开。
“楸！”狼金抱着盆回来了。
林楸吓得手一哆嗦，面上稳着，侧头看向捧着陶盆献宝似的小狼。
狼金圆眼亮晶晶的，兴冲冲将脑袋凑在盆前，“泡水啊，能喝吗？”
林楸：“能。”
他忽略后头狼岩的目光，看着小狼手里拿着的陶盆。
“洗过了？”
陶盆干干净净，但见不到一滴水。
狼金抱着陶盆，一呆，不好意思地舔舔唇，蹦跳着越过矮墙，“马上洗干净。”
蜂巢中残留的蜂蜜化开，林楸顶着后头仿佛要将他烧穿了的视线，先去溪边洗手。
他蹲在岸边，看着溪水中倒映的人影。
脸还薄红，睫毛不安地颤个不停，眼里透着的几分羞意，叫林楸一恼，一下拨弄水面，叫那水中的样子打散。
他洗干净手，搓得指骨泛红。
又看蹲在对面的小狼抓着干草飞快在陶盆里搅动，哗啦啦的，扰得他也心神不宁。
林楸抿紧薄唇，洗着洗着，又不自觉看着刚刚被舔了一下的手指。
林楸倏地闭眼，深吸一口气。
真是疯了！
下一瞬，手腕被捏住。
他吓得看去，狼岩不知道什么时候来的，抓着他手，还是那一派淡定的样子。
“皮要破了。”
林楸没听进去。
只想着自己乱糟糟的心绪，看他这镇定模样，一股不服输的劲儿跑上来。
凭什么就他一个人慌乱！
他忽然抽出手，搭在狼岩后颈。在兽人关切疑惑的目光中，直起身，亲在他嘴角。
“啪嗒——”
陶盆重重砸在水里。
狼金瞪大了眼睛看着他俩，下意识捂眼，又忍不住张开一点缝隙看。
狼岩垂眸，只闻到一股香气扑面而来。像雪季之后，万物复苏时淡而甜腻的芳花盛开，浓烈得乱了他的心跳。
唇角温软，狼岩目光笼罩着身旁已经撤开的林楸。
他喉结滚动，忍不住被诱引着，靠近面色白里透着红，倔强盯着他的林楸。
林楸抬手，一下挡住他嘴唇，笑了。
狼岩鼻尖抵着他掌心，似还能闻到那股蜂蜜的味道，香甜可口。
“楸……”
林楸抿了抿唇，唇瓣被他碾得润红。
他暂不看狼岩黝黑的眼，转头抓着一小块石头，扔到不远处小狼跟前的溪水中。
狼金立马合拢双手，边跑边高兴地嚷嚷：“我没看见，我没看见！”
林楸感觉掌心湿润，回头，狼岩还保持着刚刚的姿态。
林楸收回手，立马在水中搓洗干净。
夕阳洒下金光，林楸面颊却更比铺红天边的晚霞更盛。他眼睫密而深，侧目扫过边上还一动不动的兽人，甩了甩手，站了起来。
“还愣到什么时候去？”他看一眼棚子底下分蜂蜜水的兽人，“再不赶紧去，都尝不到……唔！”
林楸忽然被抱起来。
他坐在狼岩的手臂上，手撑着他的肩，双目微微睁大。
狼岩仰头，下巴靠在青年肚腹上，锋眉利眼，高鼻薄唇，俊帅十足的五官展露在林楸眼前。
他像是高兴极了，灰色眸子映着金斑似的光亮，低声道：“楸。”
林楸五指收紧，“……做什么？”
“楸。”
林楸感受到他的雀跃，别开头，圆圆的耳垂也染上一层漂亮的粉，“嗯。”
“楸。”
林楸见小狼已经跑到兽人堆里，棚子底下的兽人蜂蜜水也不抢了，探头探脑看过来。
林楸脚踢他一下，“放我下来，还要不要狼王的威严了。”
狼岩侧目，棚子底下的兽人齐齐往矮墙下一缩，汗毛都起来了。
林楸看得笑出声，勾着狼岩脖子，叫他放自己矮一点。待视线差不多齐平，他歪在狼岩身上，脚下晃悠，道：“快放我下来了。”
狼岩低下头，额角靠着林楸的肩，轻轻地蹭。
也不说什么，像狼王确认了伴侣的心意，黏糊却又安静地表达着自己的亲昵与欣喜。
兽人的感情很直白，结成伴侣也很简单。
亚兽人跟雌性兽人一般看脸看能力，要是长得好看，能打猎会养家，那就是个好伴侣。
相中了，便找个山洞，再生一窝崽子。
狼王已经是兽人中格外含蓄的。
林楸被他蹭得心里的慌乱平息，笑声清朗，春风般和煦。他仰靠在狼岩肩上，手紧贴在他颈侧，给大狗顺毛似的道：“好了……”
狼岩：“楸愿意当我的伴侣吗？”
狼王的声音比平日里哑，有些发紧。林楸扫过那一众又偷偷看来的兽人，脸皮又有些红。
“你先放我下来。”
狼岩手臂紧了紧，又克制着，听话地将他放下来。
林楸理了理衣裳，脚下微挪着，直到狼岩的身形将自己全部挡住，他这才仰头看向狼岩。
狼岩没及时得到回应，好像不安，要是毛耳朵露在外面，早就缓缓耷拉下来了。只一双灰色的眼睛，还一动不动紧紧盯着他，生怕他跑了似的。
林楸抓着他的手，下一瞬，被大手反过来紧紧包裹。
林楸：“轻点。”
狼岩又松了松。
林楸被他灼热的眼神看得不自在。他很少感受到这么浓烈的情绪，他忍不住抬手挡，却发现手被抓着。
林楸仰起头，红着脸，但目光认真道：“你、你再问一遍？”
狼岩胸口剧烈起伏一下，无论心中如何激荡，却似手中捧了一朵蒲公英，声音轻得不能再轻：“楸，愿意做狼岩的伴侣吗？”
林楸一笑，皓月似的脸上漂亮生光。
“愿意的。”

chapters.title: 第98章
chapters.source_text:
身体猛地往后一步，狼岩撞来，却又将他抱得紧紧的。
林楸下巴抵着狼岩肩膀。
兽人身上只穿了麻布短裤，上身裸着，林楸弯着唇角，被他抱得太紧，不得不垫着脚。
他感受到耳旁呼吸微急，林楸抬起手，掌心贴在狼岩后背，还有空冲着棚子底下的兽人们挥挥爪。
“嗷呜！！！”棚子底下，狼兽人脚踩矮墙，兴奋得仰头长啸。
“嗷呜嗷呜！！！嗷嗷……嗷呜！”
兽人想说什么，一时间却又不知道说什么，只能用嚎叫表达着这一刻的激动。
兽人们你挤我，我压着你。各个狗似的咧嘴龇牙，吐着舌头，尾巴都忍不住摇晃。
“王有伴侣了！”
“楸有伴侣了！”
“他们不是一直都是伴侣吗？”
混进来个什么？不管，兽人们兴奋得跟打了一百头猎物似的，沉醉又梦幻地在棚子底下乱蹿。
祭司抓着拐棍，想起自己刚刚说的“不争气”，再看现在……
他叹一声，想起老狼王的嘱托，想起狼岩还是少年时就担起狼部落的艰辛，没忍住，也跟着笑。
还行，还行，没叫他一把岁数了还给他操心。
今儿这天怎么就这么好看呢？蜂蜜怎么就这么美味呢？嗷嗷嗷嗷！今天能吃好吃的，今天必须得吃一顿好吃的！
兽人实际，四条腿儿或者两条腿儿乱蹦乱跳，不敢靠近溪边那两个，就围在棚子底下，从山洞跑过来，又从这边跑进山洞乱窜，像脱缰的野马。
跑完就围着狼安，“安！吃好吃的！”
“安，肉丸子！”
“安！幼崽吃的鱼丸！”
“安！吃肉，全部吃烤肉，不喝汤，也不吃草！”
狼安笑着，嘴巴合不拢，话却伤狼兽人的心，“想得挺美。”
欢乐的狼嚎换着乱七八糟的调子响彻狼山，林楸脖子都扬得有点酸了，他戳戳狼岩的腰，兽人腰腹收紧，硬邦邦的。
“抱够了没有？”
狼岩蹭他，像要将气味全蹭在他身上。
也不吭声，偶尔发出一点点呼噜，像撸猫撸爽了。
林楸情绪本就淡，两个胸膛靠在一起，隔着薄薄一层麻布，心跳都交合在一起。
他渐渐软了身子，泛了懒，由着狼岩抱着。
白净的面庞柔和，温润，那点清冷气被狼岩化在了他的怀抱里。
抱得林楸都快打瞌睡了，他动了动，狼岩还不松。
林楸忍不住踩他一脚，“行了。”
狼岩这才依依不舍地松开锁扣似的双臂，目光随林楸而动。
林楸瞪他一眼，活动着四肢跟脖子，慢悠悠往棚子底下去。
他看到好多张笑脸，面上都带着祝福。
风吹起他宽松的衣裳，青年修长的身姿如修竹，清瘦漂亮。他闲散自适，脚步轻扬。
后头狼王紧紧跟随，身形高大结实，腿上肌肉健硕，隐藏锋芒。
狼王守着自己伴侣，寸步不离。
兽人们本来想围着林楸嬉闹一番，看到自家狼王那护食样子，纷纷低头撇嘴，在林楸靠近时，往边上让开。
得了，这下靠近都不成了。
林楸只当兽人们怕狼岩，也不想叫兽人调侃，刻意转移兽人们视线道：“那蜂蜜，怎么样？”
“好、好吃！”
说起这个，兽人不管不顾的，也来劲儿了。
“楸！我们给你留了一点甜水。”
狼莫端着剩下的一点，全倒进了林楸的杯子里。
他夸张地伸长手臂，紧张地看一眼狼岩，远远地递过去。
林楸：“谢谢。”
兽人傻兮兮笑，身上一冷，懵着脑袋寻着看去，叫狼岩眼神冻得一颤。
以前怎么没注意到王这么护着楸呢？
狼莫默默融入兽人堆里，避开狼岩视线。
林楸感觉到那若有似无的尴尬，手肘别了下狼岩，低声道：“喝水吗？”
狼岩当其他兽人不存在，“你先喝。”
林楸抬眼，又对上兽人们隐隐的打探。他一口气灌了半杯蜂蜜水，往狼岩手里一塞，蹲灶前去忙活了。
再跟狼岩待下去，他又要不习惯。
狼岩收回视线，目光往兽人中一扫，顶着兽人们发馋的眼神，就着林楸的杯子，喝了几口蜂蜜水。
他泰然自若，族人面前收敛了神色，道：“都没事儿？”
狼莫：“没啊，我泥砖还没阴干。”
狼西一把捂住他嘴巴，忙道：“王，别听他说，我们很忙！忙着呢……”
狼岩一个个兽人看去，大伙儿傻笑，脚下跑得飞快。
敢看王的热闹，还得掂量掂量自己是不是日子过得太轻松了！
兽人散去，灶台前，林楸绷紧的肩背慢慢放松下来。
狼安几个中年亚兽人都是这么过来的，见如今他俩成了，心里感慨，也没说出来。
这是好事，兴许明年部落就能新添两个幼崽。
今晚这一餐吃得尤其丰盛。
部落里有的肉全弄来煮了，还杀了三只红鸟，都是之前那批长成的小红鸟中的。
考虑到楸说要留着红鸟下蛋，这三只是公红鸟。
晚上不吃鱼，直接烤了两头呦呦兽，整个一起烤，从天亮烤到天黑，放足了各种调料。
兽人们围着篝火，就着红鸟汤，啃着外焦里嫩的烤肉，满嘴流油，吃了个尽兴。
吃得美了，三三两两在草地上打滚儿，你追我赶，跟在屁股后头的幼崽都能被他们当玩具玩儿。
狼果一边解救被抛起来傻乐呵的幼崽，一边追着这些成年兽人打。
林楸听着这欢笑，侧头看着正在给他擦手的狼岩，他忍不住翘起唇，身体靠过去。
狼岩将林楸根根手指擦干净了，托在掌心细看了会儿，粗糙指腹蹭着那修长的手指，随后握紧。
“还吃吗？”
林楸摇头，今晚像兽人们要求那样，菜少，都是扎实的肉，林楸吃着有点撑。
“蜂蜜好吃吧。”
“好吃。”
“咱们现在有麻线，可以做纱网，到时候编几个草帽，将纱网沿着草帽缝一圈，遮住脸，就不怕取蜂蜜的时候被咬。”
狼岩垂眸，林楸直视回去。
“小心一点就行了。”
狼岩：“先过了祭司那关。”
林楸扣紧他的手，眼中闪过一丝狡黠，“那你同意了？”
狼岩：“再说。”
林楸：“行，再说。”
他翻身，想着那两头适应良好的咩咩兽，道：“雪季之前，还能抓几头咩咩兽回来吗？”
狼岩：“我安排。”
篝火随着风晃动，明明灭灭，一直到烧烬。
兽人兴奋了一下午，咬着破破烂烂的牙刷，终于消停。狼顺呸呸两声，吐出嘴里的兽毛，道：“牙刷坏了。”
狼岩在不远处搓着帕子，目光往兽人里一扫，道：“狼金。”
“诶！”小狼站得笔挺。
狼岩：“带队再做几批牙刷出来。”
“是！”
今晚小狼也很亢奋。
狼岩当看不见，洗净回窝，林楸已经在草窝里躺下了。
他喜欢蜷缩着睡觉，天冷就把脸藏在兽皮底下，只露出脑袋顶，天热也埋着头，只占据草窝一半。
狼岩安静看了会儿，心中迟来地有些恍惚。
“王？”后头兽人小声道。
狼岩：“嗯。”
站得有点久了，狼岩坐进草窝，后头的兽人翻个身，又阖眼睡去。
楸已经是自己的伴侣，按理说，就该睡一个草窝。
狼岩手指动了动，手指勾着两个草窝中间的障碍物，抽出几缕干草来……
林楸睡得依旧熟，却不知狼岩看了他半晚上。
雨季之后，兽人渐忙。
狼莫小队忙着烧砖，狩猎队忙着加紧让兽人填饱肚子，囤积脂肪，好熬过那个严寒的雪季。
天气时晴时雨，兽人们知道林楸要种麻草，空闲了就开垦土地。
一车车鸟粪跟麻草也从南边运回来。
天气转凉，地里的尾巴草也开始发青，直至枯黄。
沉甸甸的尾巴草穗坠着，一整块方方正正的尾巴草地，像刚刚从烤箱里拿出来的金黄色面包。
雨季过去一月，尾巴草该收割了。
这边祭司一下令，狼火带着小队最后一次去大泽，不仅带回来麻草种子，也把黑羽兽人带了回来。
羽涯这一个多月以来，睁眼是干活，闭眼梦里还在干活。
他想不明白为什么狼部落这么多事，还有那草，那鸟粪！他们弄这么多又不能吃，有点不就行了。
这次听说能去狼山了，头一个就想知道他们到底拿这些东西来干什么。
眼看快到狼山，羽千在前面叮嘱兽人：“一切听狼部落的安排，不让靠近的地方别靠近，不该问的也别问。别跟狼兽人起冲突，等做完了事，我们才可以早早回去帮部落囤过冬的猎物。”
黑羽兽人都应下。
羽千最不放心羽涯，忍不住道：“记住你来是干什么的，多学多看，该干的活儿好好干。”
“我没好好干吗？”羽涯道。
不就是话多了一点，说话都不行了？
羽乐小声道：“我看着他。”
羽涯炸毛，还没嚷嚷，叫羽千拍了下脑袋。
“这里不是我们部落，收敛一点。”
“哼！”
羽涯嘴巴硬气，待看到狼山前遍布的狼兽人，不敢再吭声。
既然敢让他们靠近狼山，那就别怕啊！还弄这么多兽人在这里守着，还以为他们多厉害呢！
羽涯滑翔而落，刚一收翅膀，就看见其中一个白净的狼兽人靠近。
他后头跟着几个抬着藤筐的兽人。
羽涯下意识防备，没来得及警告，就叫兽人给手中塞了一把石镰。
他懵了。
看看手里东西，转眼，所有黑羽兽人人手一把。
就看白净兽人手一挥，连带那些狼兽人一起，全部涌到狼山东边那块金黄的尾巴草地里。
不是？
他们才来！
才来！
都不能让他们喝口水，歇一歇吗？！

With a sudden step back, Lang Yan bumped into him, yet held him tightly in his arms.

Lin Qiu rested his chin on Lang Yan’s shoulder.

The orc wore only linen shorts, his upper body bare. Lin Qiu curled his lips, forced to stand on tiptoe because he was being held so tightly.

Feeling the slightly rapid breathing beside his ear, Lin Qiu raised his hand, pressed his palm against Lang Yan’s back, and still had the spare energy to wave his claws at the orcs under the shed.

"Awoo!!!" Under the shed, the wolf orcs stepped on the low wall, heads tilted back, howling in excitement.

"Awoo awoo!!! Awoo... awoo!"

The orcs wanted to say something, but for a moment, they didn't know what to say, so they could only express their excitement at this moment with howls.

The orcs squeezed and pressed against each other. Each of them grinned like dogs, baring their teeth, tongues lolling out, tails unable to stop wagging.

"The King has a mate!"

"Qiu has a mate!"

"Weren't they always mates?"

What was that that just mixed in? Never mind; the orcs were as excited as if they had caught a hundred pieces of prey, darting around under the shed in a dreamy, intoxicated state.

The Priest clutched his staff, remembering what he had just said about them being "disappointing," and then looking at the current scene...

He sighed, recalling the old Wolf King’s entrustment and the hardships Lang Yan had shouldered since he was a youth to lead the Wolf Tribe, and couldn't help but smile along.

It’s alright, it’s alright; at least he didn't have to worry about them at his age.

Why is today so beautiful? Why is the honey so delicious? Aoooo! Today we can eat good food, we must have a feast today!

The orcs were practical; they jumped around on four legs or two, not daring to get close to the two by the stream, so they gathered under the shed, running from the cave and back again, like wild horses off their leashes.

After running, they surrounded Lang An, "An! Eat something good!"

"An, meatball!"

"An! Fish balls for the cubs!"

"An! Eat meat, eat all roasted meat, no soup, and no grass!"

Lang An laughed, unable to close his mouth, but his words hurt the wolf orcs' hearts, "You wish."

Joyful wolf howls in various messy tunes echoed throughout Wolf Mountain. Lin Qiu’s neck was getting a bit sore from looking up; he poked Lang Yan’s waist, and the orc’s waist and abdomen tightened, feeling rock-hard.

"Have you hugged enough?"

Lang Yan rubbed against him, as if trying to get his scent all over him.

He didn't say a word, occasionally letting out a tiny purr, as if he were enjoying being petted like a cat.

Lin Qiu was naturally calm, but with their chests pressed together, separated only by a thin layer of linen, their heartbeats merged.

He gradually softened, feeling lazy, and let Lang Yan hold him.

His fair face was soft and gentle, the touch of coldness melted away in Lang Yan’s embrace.

He was held until he almost dozed off. He moved, but Lang Yan still wouldn't let go.

Lin Qiu couldn't help but step on his foot, "That’s enough."

Only then did Lang Yan reluctantly release his arms, which had been locked like a latch, his gaze following Lin Qiu’s every movement.

Lin Qiu glared at him, stretched his limbs and neck, and sauntered toward the shed.

He saw many smiling faces, all filled with blessings.

The wind blew his loose clothes, and the young man’s slender figure was like a piece of bamboo, thin and beautiful. He was leisurely and at ease, his steps light.

Behind him, the Wolf King followed closely, his frame tall and sturdy, his leg muscles powerful, hiding his sharpness.

The Wolf King guarded his mate, not leaving his side for a single step.

The orcs had originally wanted to crowd around Lin Qiu to tease him, but seeing their Wolf King’s possessive look, they all lowered their heads and pursed their lips, stepping aside as Lin Qiu approached.

Fine, now they couldn't even get close.

Lin Qiu assumed the orcs were afraid of Lang Yan and didn't want to be teased, so he deliberately shifted their focus, "How is that honey?"

"Good, delicious!"

Speaking of this, the orcs didn't care about anything else and got excited too.

"Qiu! We saved some sweet water for you."

Lang Mo brought over the remaining bit and poured it all into Lin Qiu’s cup.

He exaggeratedly stretched out his arm, nervously glanced at Lang Yan, and handed it over from a distance.

Lin Qiu: "Thank you."

The orc smiled foolishly, then felt a chill; he looked around, confused, and trembled at the icy glare from Lang Yan.

Why hadn't he noticed before that the King was so protective of Qiu?

Lang Mo silently blended into the crowd of orcs, avoiding Lang Yan’s gaze.

Lin Qiu sensed the subtle awkwardness, nudged Lang Yan with his elbow, and whispered, "Do you want some water?"

Lang Yan acted as if the other orcs didn't exist, "You drink first."

Lin Qiu looked up and met the orcs’ hidden curiosity. He downed half a cup of honey water in one go, shoved it into Lang Yan’s hand, and squatted by the stove to get busy.

If he stayed with Lang Yan any longer, he would feel uncomfortable again.

Lang Yan withdrew his gaze, swept it across the orcs, and under their hungry stares, drank a few mouthfuls of honey water from Lin Qiu’s cup.

He was calm and composed, softening his expression in front of his clansmen, and said, "Is everyone free?"

Lang Mo: "No, my mud bricks haven't dried yet."

Lang Xi covered his mouth, hurriedly saying, "King, don't listen to him, we are very busy! Very busy..."

Lang Yan looked at each orc one by one; everyone grinned foolishly and ran away quickly.

If you dare to watch the King’s business, you have to consider whether your life is too easy!

As the orcs dispersed, the tense shoulders and back of Lin Qiu at the stove slowly relaxed.

Middle-aged sub-orcs like Lang An had all gone through this; seeing that the two of them were now together, they felt emotional but didn't say anything.

This was a good thing; perhaps the tribe would have two new cubs next year.

Tonight’s meal was especially sumptuous.

All the meat in the tribe was brought out to be boiled, and three red birds were killed, all from the batch of small red birds that had grown up.

Considering that Qiu said they needed to keep the red birds for eggs, these three were males.

No fish tonight; they roasted two "You-You" beasts directly, roasting them whole from dawn until dusk, adding plenty of various seasonings.

The orcs gathered around the bonfire, eating the roasted meat—crispy on the outside and tender on the inside—with red bird soup, their mouths dripping with oil, enjoying themselves to the fullest.

After eating well, they rolled on the grass in twos and threes, chasing each other; even the cubs following behind were treated like toys.

Lang Guo rescued the cubs who were being tossed around and laughing foolishly, while chasing these adult orcs.

Listening to the laughter, Lin Qiu tilted his head to look at Lang Yan, who was wiping his hands, and couldn't help but curl his lips, leaning his body toward him.

Lang Yan wiped each of Lin Qiu’s fingers clean, held them in his palm to examine them for a while, rubbed his rough fingertips against those slender fingers, and then gripped them tightly.

"Are you still eating?"

Lin Qiu shook his head. As the orcs requested, there were few vegetables tonight, mostly solid meat, and Lin Qiu felt a bit stuffed.

"The honey is delicious, right."

"Delicious."

"We have linen thread now, so we can make gauze nets. When the time comes, we can weave a few straw hats, sew a circle of gauze around them, and cover our faces, so we won't be afraid of being bitten when collecting honey."

Lang Yan lowered his eyes, and Lin Qiu stared straight back.

"Just be a little careful."

Lang Yan: "Get past the Priest’s approval first."

Lin Qiu gripped his hand tighter, a flash of cunning in his eyes, "So you agree?"

Lang Yan: "We'll see."

Lin Qiu: "Fine, we'll see."

He turned over, thinking of those two well-adapted "Mie-Mie" beasts, and said, "Can we catch a few more Mie-Mie beasts before the snow season?"

Lang Yan: "I'll arrange it."

The bonfire flickered with the wind, dimming and brightening until it burned to ash.

The orcs had been excited all afternoon, and after biting on their tattered toothbrushes, they finally settled down. Lang Shun spat twice, spitting out the animal fur in his mouth, and said, "The toothbrush is broken."

Lang Yan was rubbing a cloth nearby, swept his gaze over the orcs, and said, "Lang Jin."

"Yes!" The little wolf stood straight.

Lang Yan: "Lead a team to make a few more batches of toothbrushes."

"Yes!"

The little wolf was also very excited tonight.

Lang Yan pretended not to see, washed up, and returned to the nest. Lin Qiu was already lying in the grass nest.

He liked to curl up to sleep. When it was cold, he would hide his face under the animal skin, leaving only the top of his head exposed; when it was hot, he would bury his head, occupying only half of the grass nest.

Lang Yan watched quietly for a while, feeling a belated sense of trance in his heart.

"King?" the orc behind him whispered.

Lang Yan: "Hmm."

Having stood for a while, Lang Yan sat into the grass nest, and the orc behind him turned over and closed his eyes to sleep again.

Qiu was already his mate; logically, they should sleep in the same grass nest.

Lang Yan’s fingers moved, hooking the barrier between the two grass nests, and pulled out a few strands of dry grass...

Lin Qiu was still fast asleep, unaware that Lang Yan had watched him for half the night.

After the rainy season, the orcs became increasingly busy.

Lang Mo’s team was busy firing bricks, and the hunting team was busy making sure the orcs filled their stomachs and stored fat to survive the harsh snow season.

The weather was sometimes sunny and sometimes rainy. Knowing that Lin Qiu wanted to plant hemp grass, the orcs cleared the land whenever they were free.

Cart after cart of bird droppings and hemp grass were transported back from the south.

As the weather turned cold, the "tail grass" in the fields began to turn green, and then withered to yellow.

The heavy tail grass ears hung low, and the entire square field of tail grass looked like golden bread just taken out of the oven.

A month after the rainy season, it was time to harvest the tail grass.

As soon as the Priest gave the order, Lang Huo led a team to the Great Marsh for the last time, bringing back not only hemp grass seeds but also the Black Feather orcs.

For over a month, Yu Ya had been working the moment he opened his eyes, and even in his dreams, he was still working.

He couldn't understand why the Wolf Tribe had so many things to do, plus that grass and that bird poop! They gathered so much, and it wasn't even edible; wasn't a little bit enough?

Hearing this time that they could go to Wolf Mountain, he was the first to want to know what they were doing with all these things.

Seeing that they were almost at Wolf Mountain, Yu Qian warned the orcs in front: "Listen to all the arrangements of the Wolf Tribe. Don't go near places you aren't allowed to, and don't ask about things you shouldn't. Don't get into conflicts with the wolf orcs. Once the work is done, we can go back early to help our tribe store prey for the winter."

The Black Feather orcs all agreed.

Yu Qian was most worried about Yu Ya and couldn't help but say, "Remember why you came. Learn more, watch more, and do the work you’re supposed to do well."

"Haven't I been doing it well?" Yu Ya said.

Was it just that he talked a bit too much? Was even talking not allowed?

Yu Le whispered, "I’ll watch him."

Yu Ya’s fur stood on end, and before he could shout, Yu Qian patted him on the head.

"This is not our tribe; restrain yourself."

"Hmph!"

Yu Ya was tough-mouthed, but when he saw the wolf orcs spread out in front of Wolf Mountain, he didn't dare to make another sound.

If they dared to let them near Wolf Mountain, then don't be afraid! And they had so many orcs guarding here; they probably thought they were so powerful!

Yu Ya glided down, and just as he folded his wings, he saw one of the fair-skinned wolf orcs approaching.

Behind him followed several orcs carrying rattan baskets.

Yu Ya was subconsciously on guard, but before he could give a warning, the orc shoved a stone sickle into his hand.

He was stunned.

Looking at the thing in his hand, in the blink of an eye, every Black Feather orc had one in their hand.

Then he saw the fair-skinned orc wave his hand, and together with the wolf orcs, they all swarmed into the golden tail grass field on the east side of Wolf Mountain.

No way?

They just arrived!

Just arrived!

Couldn't they even let them drink a sip of water or take a rest?!

It wasn't that the Wolf Tribe wanted to exploit the beastmen; the situation was simply urgent.

The past few days had been sunny, and the tail-grass had been drying for a few days, just reaching maturity. But as luck would have it, the priest said there would likely be rain in the coming days.

Looking at those stacks of golden grain ears, the wolf beastmen had guarded them for so long—how could they bear to waste even a little bit!

There was no time for explanations; as soon as the Black Feather beastmen arrived, they were immediately assigned to work.

The Wolf Tribe’s tail-grass had been cultivated by the priests generation after generation, making it vastly different from the wild tail-grass outside; the grain ears alone were several times larger than the wild ones.

The mature tail-grass exceeded the Black Feather beastmen's imagination. They stood at the edge of the field, clutching their stone sickles, momentarily at a loss for how to begin.

The golden tail-grass stretched out in a vast expanse, visibly wide, and one look at the heavy grain ears was enough to know how bountiful the harvest from this field would be.

If they had to rely on the beastmen gathering it, they probably wouldn't be able to accumulate this much even from the rainy season until before the snowy season.

The Black Feather beastmen knew how difficult winter was. Because they knew, the impact of this field of food was far greater than the impact of the wolf beastmen weaving nets, catching fish, or firing pottery to cook.

What beastmen lacked, always and forever, was food.

Yu Shan and the group of Black Feather beastmen stood stiffly before the tail-grass. Even Yu Ya stared blankly, his mouth opening and closing, unable to say a word.

The Black Feather beastmen stood in a circle like wooden stakes.

"Shan! Cut it like this."

Lang Yu had been to the Great Marsh twice to cook and was familiar with the Black Feather beastmen. Thinking they didn't know how to harvest, he grabbed a bunch of tail-grass and demonstrated by swiping his stone sickle beneath his hand.

The sub-beastman’s movements were nimble; he was used to doing these things.

Yu Shan’s voice was dry, "Okay."

Yu Qian knew what his partner was thinking. He patted his hand and said softly, "Let's work first, we'll see later..."

See if they could trade for it.

Those selected to come and work for the Wolf Tribe were all steady workers. After watching the Black Wolf beastmen for a while, everyone bent down and got to work.

When harvesting mature tail-grass, one’s hand must be steady, and the force must not be too great, lest the grains on top be shaken off.

There were over twenty Black Feather beastmen, and aside from those out hunting and gathering, almost all the Wolf Tribe beastmen were here too.

Everyone split into two teams, standing opposite each other from east to west, harvesting in silence.

No matter how well-polished a stone sickle was, it wasn't as sharp as an iron one, so the speed of cutting was limited.

The wolf beastmen were just as cautious as the Black Feather beastmen.

Lang An hunched over, carefully cutting a bunch of tail-grass. Feeling its heavy weight, he placed it gently behind him and couldn't help but say, "It's so good."

Beside him, Lang Shuang chuckled. He bowed piously toward the land, his calloused hands full of tail-grass, and swung his stone sickle.

Their generation of beastmen had faced food shortages since birth, having lived half their lives enduring hunger, never expecting to see hope.

"Thanks to Qiu, we didn't have to search for tail-grass in the wild weeds this year."

Thinking of the tail-grass they had planted in previous years, Lang An couldn't help but chuckle, and the melancholy that had been lingering in his heart dissipated.

Those beastmen who had left because of hunger would not return... they had to look forward.

The harvested tail-grass was transported to the front of Wolf Mountain by Lin Qiu, leading the Hunting Team Two members who hadn't left.

The ground here had been cleared; the beastmen had removed the weeds and packed the earth flat, using it to dry the tail-grass and make threshing easier.

When the time came, the dried tail-grass would be put directly into large jars and stored in the caves. If it rained, it would be easy to rush the harvest here.

The tribe’s little wolves were squatting here. They didn't wear their spare hemp shorts, only wrapping a mottled fur skirt around their waists.

The little wolves were in their growing phase. In previous years, they had been thin and lacked food, looking like bamboo poles. Now that they were full every day, their bodies had become sturdy, and they faintly showed the broad-shouldered, wide-backed appearance of adult beastmen.

The work of turning, drying, and threshing was easier, so it was all left to them.

The tail-grass would only be mature for these few days, and it just happened to coincide with the coming rain, so not a single person in the Wolf Tribe, from old to young, relaxed.

The little wolves were putting all their effort into threshing, their heads lowered, eyes fixed on the grains splattering everywhere, not even blinking.

Bao Xiu was mixed in among them, wearing a fur skirt with all the hair worn off, his skin dark and shiny. He stuck his butt out, beating the grain ears into a large wooden barrel that had been shielded, looking just like one of the little wolves.

Just as they were busy with the heat of the work, Lin Qiu returned with a basket on his back, leading a small beastman beside him.

It wasn't until Lin Qiu walked up to Lang Bing and Lang Jin that they noticed.

Lang Bing looked up; his usually neatly braided hair was covered in grass clippings and had become a bit messy. His cheeks were flushed, and sweat beads hung on his temples, stained with dust, making him look like a snow-white dumpling that had rolled in the dirt.

Seeing this, Lin Qiu smiled and picked the grass leaves off him.

Lang Jin stood up, helped Lin Qiu put down the basket, and glanced at the small beastman following Lin Qiu.

Lang Bing obediently let him pick the leaves off, and only when Lin Qiu withdrew his hand did he look at the Black Feather beastman behind him.

Lin Qiu: "This is Yu Le. The work of cutting tail-grass over there is tiring, so let him do this with you."

Lang Bing nodded and looked away.

The little wolf had a cold personality; if it wasn't one of his own, he was stingy with his words.

Yu Le lowered his head, his speech stumbling: "I, I should go back..."

Seeing his two little companions busy again, Lang Rong had no choice but to say, "Come to my side."

Yu Le complied, answering, "Okay."

His voice was thin, and he was young; sitting among the little wolves, he looked like a rabbit that had wandered into a wolf pack.

Bao Xiu had glanced at him when another tribe's beastman arrived, but Yu Le looked too weak, so he didn't have much interest.

Beastmen were straightforward, and their gazes weren't hidden; Yu Le lowered his head even further under his stare.

Lang Bing noticed and glanced at Bao Xiu, and the little leopard immediately turned his head and went back to thumping the tail-grass.

Lin Qiu carried the emptied basket a few steps, then looked back at the little wolves under the shed.

Lang Huo said that Yu Le was a little priest of the Black Feather Tribe, but he hadn't finished his apprenticeship.

He looked frail, and after bending over to cut tail-grass for a while earlier, he had almost fainted when he stood up. Lin Qiu was afraid something would happen to him, so he simply brought the little beastman over.

The little wolves weren't much older than him; beastmen of the same age could play together.

Yu Le sat in the pile of little wolves, not daring to glance around.

He was thin and small, huddling right next to Lang Rong.

Lang Rong taught him how to thresh; Yu Le watched carefully for a while, then worked on his own.

The little beastman’s hair was soft but as withered and yellow as the tail-grass in his hands. His face was the size of a palm, his eyes watery, and he pursed his lips as he swung his hands, even his breathing lightened.

He was physically weak, and the little beastmen in his tribe wouldn't play with him. Since birth, other than following the previous priest, he had always stayed by his grandfather's side.

Suddenly, Lang Jin sneezed, and it made his shoulders tremble in fright.

Lang Rong caught a glimpse of it out of the corner of his eye and couldn't help but ask, "What's your name?"

"Yu Le."

"My name is Lang Rong, the white-haired one next to me is Lang Bing, the one who sneezed is Lang Jin, the black leopard next to him is Bao Xiu..."

He introduced them in a string, and Lang Jin said, "You said so many, can he remember them?"

Yu Le gave a start and said softly, "I, I can remember."

"Really?" Not only Lang Jin and Bao Xiu, but the row of little wolves stretching toward the big cave all looked over, and Lang Bing also raised his head.

Yu Le felt timid under their gaze, his eyes becoming even wetter, already brimming with tears.

Lang Bing immediately lost interest.

He wasn't going to help take care of cubs from other tribes.

The little wolves looked at the teary-eyed little beastman, feeling baffled—they hadn't done anything!

Lang Jin glanced sneakily behind him, and seeing that Lin Qiu had walked far away, he shifted his butt and relaxed. He immediately stopped talking and went back to his own work.

The little wolves stopped looking over.

Yu Le lowered his head and wiped the corner of his eye.

Lang Rong felt like he was facing a great enemy; the honest child was flustered and stammered, "Don't, don't cry... Jin just has a loud voice."

Lang Jin’s ears twitched; he wanted to retort but was afraid Yu Le was truly frightened by his loud voice.

He didn't dare to make a sound, only grabbing the tail-grass and beating it quickly.

Grass clippings splattered everywhere, and the little wolves on both sides were affected, adding a few more bits of grass to their heads.

Yu Le felt embarrassed, his voice small: "I... I'm sorry, I'm not crying, really not crying... I just can't control my tears."

And he called that not crying!

Lang Rong looked to the side for help.

Lang Bing grabbed the wooden barrel and moved to the side, and Lang Jin was even worse, hiding directly at the other end.

Yu Le felt the atmosphere was wrong, so he simply stopped talking and buried his head in his work, grabbing the tail-grass.

The precarious tears still fell, hitting his legs. Yu Le lowered his head, and the long hair sliding down his shoulders blocked the tear tracks.

Lang Rong awkwardly scratched his fur skirt and had no choice but to bite the bullet and keep working.

*

Near evening, the wind picked up.

The wild grass swirled and swayed gently.

In the field next to the tail-grass, ginger leaves grew in clusters, herbs flourished, and the leaves rustled as they intertwined, lush and vibrant.

In the tail-grass field, only a few beastmen remained sitting on the ground to rest; the rest had moved to the front of Wolf Mountain.

Lin Qiu lifted the last bundle of tail-grass onto the cart, watched the black wolves pull it away, and then, losing all his strength, collapsed onto the ground.

The tail-grass harvest was finished, and the land was exposed. Only scattered grass stumps remained in the field, along with some fine weeds that had been covered by the tail-grass.

The weeds hadn't seen much sunlight; the upper leaves were green, and the lower ones were slightly yellow. They were tender and suitable for feeding the red birds.

Still sitting, Lin Qiu plucked a few more handfuls of grass and threw them into his basket.

After collecting half a basket, Lin Qiu braced his hands on the ground, completely out of energy.

He had been busy all day, only resting with everyone else during meals. By now, his tied-up hair had come loose, frizzy and mixed with grass leaves.

His body felt itchy, and sweat stung the cuts from the tail-grass, causing a prickling pain, but he had no strength left.

The setting sun hid behind the clouds, and the sky turned gray.

Lin Qiu felt dizzy and seemed to see Lang Yan walking over with long strides.

When he truly squatted in front of him, and the familiar scent enveloped him, Lin Qiu gave him a weary smile.

He spread his hands and said, "Hold me, I can't get up."

Lang Yan leaned over, his arms wrapping around his waist, his palms pressed against his back, holding him tightly.

Lin Qiu buried his nose in his shoulder, half-closing his eyes in laziness. In his drowsy state, Lang Yan picked him up and sat him directly on his arm.

Lin Qiu: "...Put me down."

Lang Yan just kept walking slowly forward. Lin Qiu leaned his head against his shoulder, reminded him once, and seeing he wouldn't put him down, just let himself sprawl there.

"Any harvest today?" Lin Qiu’s voice was soft and slurred.

Lang Yan: "Caught two baa-baa beasts."

"Mm." Lin Qiu’s cheek rested on his shoulder, very hot. Sweat stuck to their skin, and their body heat transferred, which wasn't very comfortable.

"I wanted to raise them..."

"They are for you to raise; there is other prey to eat."

Lang Yan avoided the pile of beastmen and brought Lin Qiu to the stream on the east side of Wolf Mountain.

No beastmen came here; his partner was thin-skinned and wouldn't let him hold him if there were too many beastmen around.

Lin Qiu leaned in his arms, watching him take his hands and wash them. His hands were large; one palm could cover both of his.

Once his hands were clean, he took a cloth from somewhere and wiped his sweat.

Lin Qiu chuckled muffledly, rubbing his forehead against Lang Yan’s neck.

"King."

"Mm."

"Are you tired?"

"Not tired." Lang Yan didn't stop his movements, his hand supporting the side of Lin Qiu’s face as he wiped his neck, "I like it."

Lin Qiu sat and let him wipe for a while, and when he caught his breath, he went directly into the water to wash from head to toe.

Lang Yan went back and brought him a set of clean clothes. Lin Qiu put them on, his long hair loose on his back, dripping water.

The wind grew stronger, and Lin Qiu squinted at the sky; the dark clouds were thicker.

"The weather changes just like that."

"Mm." Lang Yan stood behind him, using a force that could usually crush a prey's skull as gently as possible, his fingers hooking through the soft long hair, wrapping it in linen to wring it dry.

Before long, Lin Qiu couldn't stand anymore.

He yawned, leaned lazily back against Lang Yan, and said with a nasal tone, "Let's go back."

If they didn't leave, he was afraid he would fall asleep just standing there.

Lang Yan supported Lin Qiu’s lower back, "Do you want to..."

"No holding!" Lin Qiu grabbed his hand and moved Lang Yan to the front. He followed Lang Yan’s pace, leaning on him as they walked slowly toward Wolf Mountain.

Lang Yan: "I won't go out tomorrow."

"Resting?" Lin Qiu faced the wind, smoothing his brows, his whole body feeling clean and refreshed, only his face and neck were sunburned red.

Lang Yan noticed and touched them, and Lin Qiu tilted his head in confusion.

Lang Yan: "The Black Feather beastmen are here, I'll stay on guard."
chapters.source_text:
不是狼部落要压榨兽人，实在是情况紧急。
最近这几日都是晴日，尾巴草晒过几天，正好成熟。可偏偏祭司说，后面几天多半有雨。
看看那一摞摞金黄色的谷穗，狼兽人守了这么久，怎么忍心浪费一点儿！
来不及解释，黑羽兽人一到，立马被安排着干活儿。
狼部落的尾巴草是祭司一代一代培育出来的，跟外面野生的尾巴草有很大的差距，单是那谷穗就比野外的大几倍。
成熟后的尾巴草超出了黑羽兽人的想象，他们抓着石镰，立在土地边缘，一时间无从下手。
金黄色的尾巴草连成一大片，肉眼可见的宽阔，单看沉甸甸的谷穗就知道这一片地会有多少收成。
要是靠着兽人们采集，要想达到这样的量，怕是从雨季采到雪季前都积攒不了这么多。
黑羽兽人知道冬季的难熬，就是知道，所以此刻这一片的食物，给他们的冲击远远比狼兽人们会织网捕鱼，烧陶做饭的冲击更大。
兽人缺的，始终是食物。
羽山连带一众黑羽兽人拘谨地站在尾巴草面前，连羽涯也呆看着，嘴巴张了又合，说不出一句话。
黑羽兽人就跟一个个木桩子一样，围了一圈。
“山！像我这样割。”
狼雨两次去大泽那边做饭，跟黑羽兽人熟，他以为黑羽兽人不会收割，一把抓着一丛尾巴草，石镰从手下一划拉，给他们示范。
亚兽人动作利索，做惯了这些事。
羽山声音干涩，“好。”
羽千知道自己伴侣想什么，他拍拍他的手，轻声道：“先干活吧，之后再看……”
看能不能交换。
能挑选过来给狼部落干活的，都是做事稳妥的兽人，大家认真看了会儿黑狼兽人怎么做，便弯腰忙起来。
采收成熟的尾巴草，手要稳，劲儿不能大，免得晃掉那上头的果实。
黑羽兽人二十多个，狼部落兽人除开去狩猎采集的，也差不多都在这儿了。
大家分两队，东西相对站立，闷头收割。
石镰再怎么打磨，也不比铁镰锋利，割的速度有限。
不止黑羽兽人慎重，狼兽人也谨慎。
狼安佝着，小心割下一丛尾巴草，感受到那沉手的重量，轻轻放在身后，这才忍不住道：“真好。”
旁边狼霜笑了声，他虔诚地对着土地弯下腰，布满茧子的手抓满了尾巴草，挥下石镰。
他们这一代兽人，自出生时就面临着食物紧缺的局面，忍饥挨饿过了快半辈子了，没曾想等来了希望。
“多亏楸，今年不用在野草里找尾巴草。”
狼安想到往年他们种的尾巴草，也忍不住噗嗤一笑，那股缠绕心头的怅然也散了。
因为饥饿离去的那些兽人不会再回来了……他们要往前看。
收割好的尾巴草，由林楸带着没走的狩猎二队，运送到狼山山前。
这边的地面清理过，兽人们把杂草除了，地面夯平，用来晒尾巴草，也方便脱粒。
到时候晒好的尾巴草就直接装进大罐子里，放山洞里保存。要是下雨，这边也好抢收。
部落一众小狼在这边蹲着，有换洗的麻布短裤也不穿，腰上只围着一条皮毛斑驳的兽皮裙。
小狼正是长身体的时候，往年抽条又没食物，一个个跟竹竿似的。现在每天吃饱，身体健壮起来，隐隐有了成年兽人肩宽背阔的模样。
翻晒跟脱粒的活儿轻松些，都交给他们做。
尾巴草成熟也就这几天，偏偏赶上快要下雨，狼部落从老的到小的，没一个放松。
小狼憋足了劲儿忙着脱粒，脑瓜子垂着，紧盯四处迸溅的谷粒，眼也不眨。
豹休混在其中，身上一条皮毛掉光了的兽皮裙，皮肤黑亮，撅着屁股往做了遮挡的大木桶里敲打谷穗，俨然跟小狼们一体。
正忙得热火朝天，林楸又背着背篓回来，身边还领了个小兽人。
等林楸走到狼冰、狼金面前，他们才发现。
狼冰仰面看来，寻常编得漂漂亮亮的头发上沾满了草屑，凌乱开了些。他面颊泛红，汗珠挂在额角沾了灰，像雪白的团子往地里滚了一圈。
林楸见状，笑着给他摘掉草叶。
狼金起身，帮着林楸把背篓放下来，又看了一眼林楸身边跟着的小兽人。
狼冰乖乖由着他摘，等林楸收回手，才看向他后头的黑羽兽人。
林楸：“这是羽乐，那边割尾巴草的活儿累，让他跟着你们做。”
狼冰点点头，收回目光。
小狼性子冷，不是自家兽人，话都吝啬得说。
羽乐垂头，说话也磕磕绊绊：“我、我还是回去……”
狼溶见自家两个小伙伴又都忙起来，只得道：“你来我这边吧。”
羽乐顺从，应了声“好。”
他声音细，年岁也小，坐在小狼中间像误入狼群的兔子。
来个其他族的兽人，豹休倒是多看了眼，但羽乐看着太弱，他没多少兴趣。
兽人直白，目光也不怎么掩饰，羽乐被他看得头更低。
狼冰注意到，瞥了眼豹休，小豹子立马转过头吭哧吭哧打尾巴草去。
林楸提着倒空了的背篓走了几步，回头看棚子底下的小狼们。
狼火说，羽乐是黑羽部落的小祭司，但没出师。
他又看着瘦弱，刚刚弯腰割了会儿尾巴草，站起来差点晕倒。林楸怕他出事，干脆将小兽人带了过来。
小狼们比他大不了几岁，同龄兽人能玩儿到一起去。
羽乐坐在小狼堆里，眼神不敢乱瞥。
他瘦瘦小小一个，就挨在狼溶旁边。
狼溶教他怎么脱粒，羽乐认真看了会儿，就独自干活。
小兽人发丝柔软，却像手中的尾巴草一样枯黄。巴掌大的脸，眼睛水汪汪的，抿着唇挥动手，呼吸都放轻了。
他身体弱，部落里的小兽人都不带他玩儿。自出生以来，他除了跟在以前的祭司身边，之后就一直窝在阿爷身边。
旁边狼金忽然打个喷嚏，都吓得他肩膀一哆嗦。
狼溶余光瞥见，忍不住道：“你叫什么名字？”
“羽乐。”
“我叫狼溶，旁边白头发的是狼冰，打喷嚏那个是狼金，旁边黑豹是豹休……”
他一溜串地介绍过去，狼金道：“你说这么多，他能记住吗？”
羽乐一个激灵，小声道：“记、记得住。”
“真的假的？”不止狼金、豹休，还有快排到大山洞那边的一排小狼都看来，狼冰也抬起头。
羽乐被看得生出怯意，眼睛更是湿漉漉的，已经挂上泪花。
狼冰顿时没了兴趣。
他才不帮别的部落照顾幼崽。
小狼们看着哭唧唧的小兽人，一脸莫名其妙，他们又没干什么！
狼金贼兮兮地瞥了眼身后，见林楸走远了，才挪一挪屁股放松下来。他立马什么也不说了，忙自己事去。
小狼不再看这边。
羽乐低下头，抹了下眼角。
狼溶如临大敌，老实孩子被弄得无措，磕巴道：“你、你……别哭啊，金就是嗓门大。”
狼金耳朵动动，想反驳，又怕羽乐真是因为自己嗓门大吓到了。
他不敢吭声，只能抓着尾巴草飞快打。
草屑四溅，两边的小狼都受到了波及，脑袋上再添几片碎草。
羽乐不好意思，声音小小的：“我呜……对不起，我没哭，真的没哭……我只是控制不住眼泪。”
这还叫没哭！
狼溶求助地往旁边看。
狼冰抓着木桶往边上挪，狼金更是，直接躲到另一头去了。
羽乐感觉到气氛有些不对，他干脆不说话了，闷头抓着尾巴草干活。
摇摇欲坠的眼泪还是掉了下来，打在腿上。羽乐脑袋垂下，滑落肩侧的长发将泪痕挡住。
狼溶无措地抓了抓身上的兽皮裙，只好硬着头皮继续干。
*
快傍晚时，起风了。
野草打着旋儿，轻轻摇曳。
尾巴草隔壁的地里，姜叶丛丛，香草勃发，叶片交错沙沙作响，又是茂盛非常。
尾巴草地里，只剩三三两两坐地上休息的兽人，其余的都转移到了狼山山前去。
林楸将最后一捆尾巴草抬到板车上，看着黑狼拉着离开，泄了劲儿，瘫坐地上。
尾巴草收割完毕，土地露了出来。地里只剩凌乱分布的草桩，还有些尾巴草覆盖下的细碎杂草。
杂草没怎么晒过阳光，上层叶片青绿，底下微黄。正嫩，适合喂红鸟。
林楸就着坐着的姿势，又薅了几把草扔背篓里。
攒了半背篓，林楸手撑在地面，彻底没了力气。
他忙了一天，只吃饭的时候跟大伙儿一起歇一歇，这会儿扎好的头发散了，毛毛躁躁的，混着草叶。
身上有些痒，汗水浸在尾巴草割破的伤口上，有些刺刺的疼，但他已经没力气了。
夕阳藏在了云层后头，天空透着灰。
林楸晕晃晃的，好像看见了大步走来的狼岩。
待到他真的蹲在了自己面前，熟悉的气息笼罩过来，林楸冲着他疲惫地笑了下。
他摊开手道：“抱我一下，起不来了。”
狼岩倾身，双臂绕过腰侧，掌心贴在他后背，紧紧拥着他。
林楸鼻子闷在他肩膀，犯懒地半阖上眼。昏昏欲睡间，狼岩直接将他抱坐在了手臂上。
林楸：“……放我下来。”
狼岩只顾往前慢慢走，林楸脑袋靠着他肩膀，提醒一下，见他不放，也就放任地趴着了。
“今天有收获吗？”林楸声音绵软，含糊不清。
狼岩：“抓了两头咩咩兽。”
“唔。”林楸脸颊枕在他肩上，很烫。汗水贴着皮肉，体温传递着，并不舒服。
“我想养来着……”
“就是给你养的，有其他猎物吃。”
狼岩避开兽人堆，将林楸带到狼山东侧的溪水边。
这边没兽人过来，他的伴侣脸皮薄，兽人多了不让抱。
林楸靠在他怀里，看着他抓着自己手搓洗，他手大，一个巴掌能拢住他两只手。
手洗干净了，又不知从哪儿拿来的帕子，给他擦汗。
林楸闷声笑了一下，额头蹭着狼岩脖颈。
“王。”
“嗯。”
“你累不累啊？”
“不累。”狼岩动作不停，手托着林楸脸侧，擦拭他脖子，“我喜欢。”
林楸坐着让他擦了会儿，等缓过一口气，自己直接去水中，从头洗到脚。
狼岩回去给他拿了一套干净的衣裳来，林楸穿上，长发散在后背，往下滴着水。
风大了，林楸眯着眼睛望天空，乌云更厚了。
“天气说变就变。”
“嗯。”狼岩立在他后头，寻常能捏破猎物脑袋的力道放得不能再轻，指缝勾着那柔软的长发，用麻布包裹着攥干。
没一会儿，林楸站不住了。
他打个哈欠，往后懒懒倚在狼岩身上，带着些鼻音道：“回去吧。”
再不走，他怕在这儿站着就睡着了。
狼岩托着林楸后腰，“要不要……”
“不抱！”林楸攥着他手，将狼岩挪到前头。他踩着狼岩的步调，靠着他拉着慢悠悠往狼山走。
狼岩：“明天我不出去。”
“休息吗？”林楸迎着风，舒展眉头，浑身清清爽爽，只脸跟颈侧有些晒红。
狼岩注意到，手碰了碰，林楸疑惑偏头。
狼岩：“黑羽兽人在，我留守。”
